tei:div.tei:p: bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dpe tshogs bca' yig phyogs bsgrigs/bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags khang gis bsgrigs/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang /

mdun shog 'char 'god pa/ bstan rnam/dpe sgrig 'ganaX'akhur ba/ o rgyan chos 'phel/bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dbe tshogs bca' yig phyogs bsgrigs/bod rang skyong ljongs yig tshags khang gis bsgrigs/ ༄ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang nas bskrun te bkram/bod dmag khul la/ nga par 'debs bzo grwas par btab/shog kha 787 1092 1 ( 32 yig 'bru khri 37 3()01lo'i zla 1par ba/'i 1 par thengs 1 btab/par grangs ()1 —1 5()0 162sa7—22sdi—00931—ba73 —49 yig rigs (bod 16 )rin gong sgor 26 00

dpe skrun gsal bshad// bod sa gnas kyi lo rgyus dpe tshogs bca' 'i/ga phyogs bsgris/sa zhes nga/4 'di ni bod kyi lo rgyus spyi dang khyad nga/ra nang bstan tshas lugs bro/ra shes rtobs dang thib 'jus/ bya rgyu'i thad med du mi rung ba'i dbya da sa/zhi'i yig rigs ga 'a/ chen 'ig yin sa/shis/ da 'a1ma dpe deb 'don rgyu'i rgyu gron /3byung khungs shin tu dka/'a ba'i ba/nas bab 'og tu'ang 'di'i lo rgyus kyi dbya/da gzhi'i rin thang dang 'phra' phus//sa kyi khe gyong gnyis lo/nga/ gnad sang 'is che ba'i rgyu mtsham kho nar bsams te 'gro song gi gyong kha rang 'khur gyi thog nas dnge/ skrun 'grems spel zhus mod1/ 'on kyang dpe skrun dbos kyi bya rim nang yi/tsa/ rigs rnying khungs dpe deb tu legs bsgres/sa bya thabs skor gyi tshad ga'i 'i blang byar bzam/ dgos par brten 'di'i lo rgyus spra rjes so so'i yis/ sro/la yi/na pa lta bu'i tha sbad ming tshig gi dag cha la sogs pa'i yig srol mi ga/cis// pa gang tsam zhis/ yod pa dag ltos bcas kyi gcig gyur du ma bsgos mthu med byung ba'i nang re 'ga'i sar da dung ma ldeng ma 'thus pa'i 'an cha sa/nas/ srid na rgya che'i klog pa po mtshag gis dag nor 'dor len dgongs dpyad/ yod pa zhu/dpe sgrib 'ganaX'akhur bas/

dkar chag( 1) rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos spyon lam mtshan rtag/sa sko ra bstsal ba'i dran tho/ ༷ ༷ (1 )( 2 ) rgyal dbang spu phreng lnga pas lku 'bum byams nga/ dī/nga la bstsa' ba'i bca' yi/ga ༷ (8)( ༈ ) pho brang po ta la'i sum skas mgo'i bca' yis// (12)( ṭa ) rgyal dbang sbu phreng lnga pa chen ngo/sa lha ldan tsha 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i tshog/sa bzhus//sa dbe 'dun spyi la bstsal ba'i bca' yi/ga ༷ (15)( 5 ) rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa chen pos chos sde chen po 'a lu'i sgrub mchod bco lnga gsar tshugs skabs bstsal ba'i bca' yig shel dal/ra me long bzhugs so/ ༷ (36)( 6) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pas rnam rgyal grwa tshang la bstsal ba'i bca' yis gse ra spyo gnya' shing zhes bya ba bzhug/sa so/ ༷ ༷ (6/)(khya ) tshas sde chen po se ra theg chen spru/nga gi sgres khrims gnon sdems smor rgyal mchog bdun pa chen pos pe sprul lor bstsal ba'i bca' yi/ga gser tham chen mo 'byar ma'i ngo bshus dge// (71)

( da/ ) rgyal mchog bdun nga/ chem pos chos sde chen ngo/ se ra theg chem gyi/nga la bstsa'/ ba'i khrims su bca0ri ba'i yi ge rab sa/sal nor bu'i re long we/ /sa bya ba ba zhugs so// (96)/5(—) ra mo che ba'i sde grwa tshang bas/0 3 na/ bsam sa/tan gying gi bca' yis// rdom sa/nyis nor bu'i bang mdzong ces bya ba bzhugs/ so/ ༷ ( /17)( 10 ) gangs dam/ra gling gi bca' yis/ sa bon re/ mo srid skyong dang po'i dam / phab kyis me sna/nga lor bstsal ba// (143)( 11) di cho// srid skyong dang pos dar nor ri khrod ma bstsal ba'i bca' yeb (150)( 12) de cho/ rgyal thog/ dang po 'jam dpal bde les/sa rgya mtshos bstan rgyal gling da/bom la bstsal ba'i bca' yig/ ( /66)( 12) rje shes rab seng ges/ rgyung/ smad grwa tshang la sa/nang ba'i bca' yis la de mo rgyal thos si/sa rgyab gnon bstsal ba'i sko na zin// ༷ (168)( 14) 'o chu dgon gyi 'dul khrims bca' yig bstsal zin/ (174)( 15) tshe spyon gling rgyal thog gnyis pas se ra theg chen gling gi chos khri/ mas sogs byed sgo'i skor bstsal ba'i rtsa tshig (180)( 16) rta tshag ngab/ dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ nas stag lung brag mang thos bsam bstam gleng la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷ (191)

( 2— ) rim/ chen sgang btsun ma grwa tshang sis bca' sprug las/ tu lem/ nga/bo/sa kyi tho yis/ blang rdo/ra sa/sa nga/ ba'i sgrom/ pe 'es bya ba bzhus/sa so/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (209)( 1'i) bza/ chen sku phreng brgyad pas bkra shis lhun po dgon la bstsal ba'i bcan sna yig ༷ (21())( 19) kun gling rgyal thog gnyis pas se 'bras dag/'a dang rgyud grwa stod mid sogs dgo/na la/ ga gi dge /'dun pas nag chang sogs mi da/ge ba'i spyod tshul dang chas gos bye/ ma pa spyi mtshungs byed mkhan la lta rtos/ 'jug ga/cho/na dgos pa'i rtsa tshig (343)( 20) tā 'a/'i bcu gsum pas bkra shis chos 'phel gling dbo/na la btse la ba'i bca' yig ༷ (346)(21) thor nod rgyal pos zhus lta ra mtshan nyid/ grwa tshang gi dgon sde ba/sar btab zhu rgyu'i skyabs mgon rtse na/sa gser tham chen mo phab pa'i bca' yig zin bris/ (365)(22) drug cu sngags bon bcas kyi bca' yig drang thig dge legs kyi 'od snang bzhugs/ ༷ ༷ (380)( 22) tshas sde chen po theg chen dam chos dga' tshal gling gi khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge phyag na pad+ma'i 'al lung blang dor rab ba/sal me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ༷ (387)( 24) dung dkar bkra shis chos rdzong dgon gyi bca' yig ༷ (404)( 25) yig tshang gis dpal 'khor chos sde'i bca' yig thub bstan sa/dag la ba'i sgro na me /zhes bya ba'i 3 la bshus5 (31 3)

( 2(4) tā 'a/'i /bla ma sku phreng bcu tsa/sum pas/ phum/ tshogs bkra shis gling dgon du bca' yis/ bstsal 'char snan zhu/ ( 139)( 27) cha phreng rjing 'dzi dgon du bod ljongs spyi tshogs nas sbus/ / dam bca' yis/ bstsal rgyu'i snyan zhu zin bris/ (4 1rte )( 2shā) thob rgya' rab rgyas gling dbo/na gyi bca' khri/ma sa bsnyun la rgyu'i snyan zhur tā la'i bcu tsa//sum/ pa'i tshag mchan 'khod nga// ༷ (449)( 29) rtse gzim 'gas bos se ra dgo/na la bstsal ba'i rtsa tshig/ 'al bshus/ ༷ (4di6 )( ༈0) tā la'i bla ma spu phreng bcu sa/sum pas sa/yi li cha har shog gi dgon pa theg gsum rnam par grol ba'i gling du bstsa'/ ba'i bca' yig ( /61)( 21) sbug dam bca' yig bstsal 'char snyan zhu/ ༷ (7171)( ༈2) byams gling grwa tshang gi bca' yig ngo ma byams blar song ba'i ngo bshus zhus dab/ song / ༷ (478)( ༈༈) tā la'i bla ma sbu phreng bcu gsum pas rnam rgyal dge/ ldan/ lha khang la bstsal ba'i bca' yig bzhugs so/ (7185)( ༈4) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas mdo smad ra hor bkra shis lung rigs gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig (489)( ༈5) tā la'i bla ma sbu phreng bcu gsum pas mdo smad lung dkar dga' ldan tshas 'khror gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷༷ ༷ (491)

(༈6 ) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzu gsum pas hor yul dur bde wang gi bkra shis rdzogs ldan dge rgyas gling du bstsal ba'i bca' yig zla ba gzhon nu'i 'dzum rlabs zhes bya ba bzhugs so ༷ ༷ ༷ (494)(27) tā la'i bla ma sbu phreng bcu gsum pas mdo smad dgon gsar bkra shis dga' ldan chos 'phel gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷ ༷ (498)(2shā) tā la 'i bla ma sku phreng bzu gsum pas byang phyogs hor yul gyi dgon sa/sar bshad sgrub dge tshogs gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ (501)(29) tā la'i bla ma sbu phreng bcu gsum pas bar khams hor ye tha bon g.yung drung rab brtan gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig pad dkar chun phreng zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (504)(40) kong po chos rtse sprul sku thub bstan mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin lung rigs kyi zhu ba/ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (508)(41) kong po chos rtse sprul sku bslab skyon byung bar gzhis dgon dang bla brang la the byus tshul min rigs mi zhu ba'i gan rgya khag 'brel dge/ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ (509 )(42) kong po chos rtse sprul sku thub bstan mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin lung rigs sogs la chad gcod kyi 'char gzhi snyan zhu/ ༷ ༷ (511)(42) tā 'a 'i bla ma sku phreng bcu sa/su ma ༄ bas rnam rab ma thong sbo na

dwags po grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rnams la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (513)(44) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas mdo khams lha rtse byams pa gling dgon du bstsal ba'i bca' khrims/༷༷ ༷ ༷༷ (518)(45) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas mdo khams sho mdo dgon dga' ldan bshad sgrub gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig 'dul ba 'bum sde'i dgongs don rnam par bkra ba bzhugs so ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (524)(46) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzu gsum pas byang bya do bkra shis bsam gtan gling dgon la bstsal ba'i bca' khrims rab gsal sgron/ me zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ ༷ ༷ ༷ (529)(47) tā la'i bla ma sku preng bcu gsum pas rong po rab brtan dgon la bstsal ba'i bca' yig gsal byed nor bu'i 'od snang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ (534)(4shā) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas chab mdo dga' ldan theg chen byams pa gling du bstsal ba'i bca' yig (540)(49) tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pas sbas gnas pad ma bkod gter khongs mkhan ljongs e wam bde chen chos 'khor la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷༷ ༷ ༷ ༷༷ ༷ ༷༷ (551)(5༷) srid skyong rwa sgreng gis dge dgon kun 'phel gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷ ༷ (555)

( 51) srid skyong rwa sgreng gis rdo phud ches 'khor gling dgon la bstsal ba'i bca' yig ('u 63)( 52) gdan sa tsa/sum dang rgyud stong smad/ dge/ sde che chung gi dge/ 'dun pa nas chang 'thung tshu' min chos khrims las 'grol mi chog pa'i rtsa tshig ( du 72)( 52) mthong smon dwas/sa po grwa tshang gi bca' yig/ bskyar zhu'i sa bon/ (576)(54) srid spyong stag brag gis lo/nga stod dung dkar dgon/ la bstsal ba'i khrim/sa su bca' ba'i yi ge/ (583)( 55) spo stod phu dgon chos lngeng rin chen spungs kyi bca' yig ༷༷ ༷ ༷ (602)( 146) srid tham bca' yeg/ 'char zin snyan zhu/ (61shā1)(57) srid skyong stag brag gis stag brag dgon bar bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (620)( 5shā) srid skyong stag brag nas dga' ldan mdo sngags chos 'phel 'chi med grub pa'i byang chub gling du bstsal ba'i bca' yig ༷ ༷ ༷ ༷ (647)( 59) rgyal tshab stag brag nas chab mdo dga' ldan byams pa gling la bstsal ba'i rgyab gnon bca' yig ༷ ༷ (657)

rgyal dbang lnga pa chen bos smon lam mtshan rtags skon bstsal ba'i dran tho/me khye/ (spyi lo 1646 ) tshog/sa gnyis zla ba'i ma ma las/ /legs 'khrungs kun mkhyen chu 'e/la dbang / /thugs rje'i 'od kyis legs byas tshal/ /rgyas par mdzod cig zas gtsang sras/ /gang zhig ches brling rgyal bstan gser ldan ma/ /rnam dpyod mkhyen pa'i stobs kyis 'degs pa la/ /bstan 'dzin skabs gsum ga 'a/na gyis zla bral gyi/ /rgyan drug mchog gnyis pad dkar mig gang rgyal/ /rmongs pa'i tsha bas gdungs pa'i gangs can khrod/ /thub bstan snga na med pa'i dri gzhon gyis/ /khyab mdzod chos rgyal mes dbon lo paṇa tshogs/ /gzur gnas shes ldan yongs kyis phyag bya'i yul/ /'jam dbyangs rang gzugs mi yi srid pa'i gar/ /'gro la rjes su ston pa'i tsong kha pa/ /khyod kyi rnam dkar mdzad pa'i phung po 'di'i/ /sgod du tshangs pas khams gsum sprul bar nges/ /dge legs rnam bkra 'ja' 'dra'i gur khyim nas/ /phun tshogs shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gi klu/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba'i ring lugs rgya mtsho'i sder/ /brjod pa'i dngos po don dang ldan gyur cig / dge ba'i rang bzhin rgyas pa'i ku mu da/ /yon tan zla bar 'dun zhing chags pa'i chus/ / 'dab ma mngon par g.yo — 1 —

ba'i gra/sa/sa pa'i dbyangs// /rgya mtsho'i rgos can kun tu khyab 'di ma tshar/ /blo dman ༅/na gyi/sa blta ba'i ya la bral 'ing // /blo chen rnam/sa kyang the tshom khyos/sa ༄'i ྾ ༄ nga 'chang nga/'a// /blo bzang rgyal ba 'a lugs/ srol gzhung chen rnams/ /blo ྅ na bye bos thos bas ma bgyis nga/'i 'bras/ /rab tu brjod bral kun/ sas la pha mtha' ltar/ /rab ma/nga shes bya'i sa/tsug las ma lus par/ //rab tu brgal brtag/sa dbya da nga/sa 'byam sa klas pa'i// // rab dka/ ra rnam/ smin dkar por 'dzag/ pa'i rnga/ // tshul ldan 'khrul med sro'/ gyi dbyu gu yis/ /mngon par brdungs/ tshe rgol ngan dpung tshos/sa las/ // nom nga/ra rgyal ba'i ngo mtshar gtam gī dpyid/ /'a/khrul med yi ge'i lam du deng 'dir shar/ / de'ang 'o sko' / gyi sto na pa rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen zhes/ ris bral gyi 'gro ba mtha' dag la gcig tu brtse chen thugs rje'i bdag nyid can des gsungs pa'i bka' sde sgod ba/sum lung dang / de don nyams su blangs pa las lam mngon rtogs gyi rim pa ste/ rgyal ba'i bstan ba rin po che ni/ 'phags pa'i yul las ljongs 'dir/ sa spyod dam pa rnams dang / lo paṇa rnams kyi drin las ches dar zhing / khyad par gsung rab mtha' dag/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pas gtan la 'bebs pa'i mtshan nyid kyi sde zhes/ lo chen blo ldan shes rab dang cha gtsang sogs mkhas grub rim par byon pa rnams las ches cher 'phel ba las blo gsal rnams kyis thos bsam bgyis pa'i 'bras rtags dang / bstan pa rin po che'i mig rgyan du rab 'byams grwa skor zhes pa'i srol chos grwa chen po rtsed thang du sde srid rin po che phag mo gru pas 'dzugs par mdzad pa dang /gzhan yang yul gru du mar byung 'dug pa rnams dang cha mthun pa/ chos kyi rgyaX —po ༵— kha pa chen po'i mdzad pa/ srid pa 'di na rnam dkar gyi dge ba

la 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba'i cho 'phrul gyi dus ston chen po 'di nyid kyi thog tu grwa skor gyi srol 'dzugs pa 'gab tshul/ gsung rab rgya mtsho'i pha rol du son zhing / 'chad cing rtsod pa la smra mkhas ngag gi dbang por 'gran bzod pa'i chos rje rin po che dkon mchog chos 'phel/ mkhas mang blo gsal gling gi 'chad nyan las thog tu bzhugs pas gtso gnas slob dpon rnams gros bsdur thog nas shing glang smon lam dus gsar 'dzugs grub 'dug na'ang /nyi ma kha grangs nyung zhing grwa skor ba mangs pas hrung zad byed sla ba dang /smon lam chen mo'i do dam gang ci 'bras spungs spyi so nas mdzad pa'i stabs kyis grwa skor byas pa dang / 'bras spungs gling bsre byas par khyad med cig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang / rdo gcal du dam bca' ma bzhag par gdong gral du mi chad pa sogs bar skabs sa/ dge skos ci rigs kyis sger don spyi rab sa 'khyer gyi rnam pa'i bcos bslad sna tshogs 'dug par brten da cha me phag smon lam chen mo'i thob/ nas bzung 'gyur med lag tu len dgos kyi dran tho ni/mdo phyogs kyi grwa skor ba brgyad las mang ba mi byed/ de yang nyi ma bcu gsum tsam la mtshon na/ bzhi po shos dbye ba'i sho che bas rnam 'grel le'u ba'i pa dang / phar phyin skabs dang po gnyis la bshad chen nyi ma re re dang /bshad chung mdzod la nyin gcig byed/ sho de 'og mas bshad chen le'u gsum pa dang / skabs gnyis pa/ bshad chung mdo rtsal/ sho de 'og mas bshad chen le'u gnyis pa dang / skabs bzhi pa/ bshad chung dbu ma 'jug pa/ sho de 'og mas/ bshad chen le'u dang po dang / skabs brgyad pa bshad chung rang phyogs dge lugs pa yin na byang chub lam rim/drang nges rnam 'byed gnyis gang 'dod dang / sa lugs pa yin — ni 'di ga

gnyis gang 'dod 'dems/ bo dong / kar 'brug lta bu ma nges pa byung tshe/mngon pa kun las btus rtsa shes rgyud bla ma gsum po gang rung 'dems 'jug/dmigs bsal sngags rams pa byung na/ gong gi grangs la mi the zhing / lnga phyi dang gzhung yang sho sa dbye ma dgos pas/ nyi ma bcu gsum la mtshon na/mtshan nyid pa bzhi pos bshad chen ma phyed gnyis re dang / bshad chung nyi ma re grub pa'i de lhag gsum po la sngags rams pas bshad pa byed pa dang /dge lugs la/ bshad chen sa/sang 'dus/ bshad chung dus 'khor/ sa lugs la bshad chen brtag gnyis/ bshad chung bde mchog rnying lugs la bshad chen gsang ba snying po/ bshad chung rgyud bcu bdun gang ris/jo 'al/ bo dong / kar 'brug rnams bshad chen dus 'khor/ bshad chung ba ṭar byed spyor 'god ni/ skas gdang dang po ni/ 'grel pa don gsal las/ spyod pa'i gnyen por chos kyi 'khor lo ma lus pa rnam pa thams cad skor bar mdzad pa zhes sogs dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ don shes don ston rab tu byed pa ngag dang tshig rnams dri med pas zhes sogs/ rgyud bla ma las/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang zhes sogs/rtsa shes las/ gang gi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung zhes sogs/ 'jug pa las/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes zhes sogs/mngon pa kun las btus las/ khams rnams ni bco brgyad do zhes sogs/mdzod las/ gang zhig kun la mun pa gtan bcom zhing zhes sogs/ tshad ma kun las btus las/ tshad mar gyur pa 'gro la phan bzhed dang zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las/ rtogs pa'i dra ba rnam bsal zhing zhes sogs/mdo rtsa las/ nges par 'byung ba tshul khrims kyi dbang du byas te zhes sogs/—— 4 ——

so thar gyi mdo las/ snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na gras/sa zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/ bde gshegs chos kyi sku mnga' sras bcas dang zhes sogs/ lam sgron las/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad da/ga dang de yi chos zhes dang / skas gdang gnyis pa ni/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/sems bskyed pa ni gzhan don phyir zhes sogs/ mdo sde rgyan las/ sbyor ba'i sngon du snyeng rje dang zhes sogs/ rgyud bla mar ji lta ji snyed nang gi ni zhes sogs/ rtsa shes las/ gang zhig bdag la mi lta ba zhes sogs/'jug pa las/ rgyal ba'i sras po 'di yi sems gang 'gro ba rnams zhes sogs/ mngon pa kun las btus las/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa gang zhe na zhes sogs/ mdzod las/ zag bcas zag pa med chos rnams zhes sogs/ tshad ma kun las btus las/ ming dang rigs sogs spyor ba yis zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las/ gtan tshigs kyi ni tshul gsum la'ang zhes sogs/ so thar gyi mdo las/ 'di ni dam chos rgyal po yin zhes sogs/mdo rtsar dang po'i mkhan po nyid kyis bar chad dris nas zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub snyeng por mchis kyi bar zhes sogs/ lam sgron las/chung dang 'bring dang mchog gyur pa'i zhes sogs/ skas gdang gsum pa ni/mngon rtogs rgyan las/ sems mi 'gong pa nyid la sogs zhes sogs/mdo sde rgyan las/ rgyal sras rnams kyi sems bskyed ni zhes sogs/ rgyud bla mar rang don gzhan don don dam sbu dang ni zhes sogs/ rtsa shes las/lta dang nyan dang sgom pa dang zhes sogs/ mngon pa kun las btus las/sa'i khams gang zhe na zhes sogs/ mdzod las/ de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi zhes sogs/ tshad ma kun las btus las/ rjes dpag rnam gnyis rang — 5 ——

don ni zhes sogs/ 'jug pa las/ shes bya'i bud shing ma lus bsreg pa'i me zhes sogs/ mdo rtsa ba las/ rang gi dge bsnyen nyid du nye bar bsgrubs nas zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las/ tshad ma slu med can shes pa zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/ byang chub rgyur ni dge bsags pa zhes sogs/ bzhi brgya pa las/ tshul khrims kyis ni bde 'gror 'gro zhes sogs/rin chen phreng ba las/ dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang zhes sogs/skas gdang bzhi pa ni/ mdo sde rgyan las/ gnas rtsom 'bras bu 'byung ba che bdag nyid ces sogs/ rgyud blar byang chub sems pa'i tshul 'di na zhes sogs/ rtsa shes las/ bstan pa dag ni thams cad du zhes sogs/ bzhi brgya par de bzhin kun mkhyen sgra 'di ni zhes sogs/ mngon pa kun las btus las/ ci yis bslab par btags she na zhes sogs/ mdzod las/gang zhig gsum la skyabs 'gro ba zhes sogs/ tshad ma kun las btus las/gzhan don rjes su dpag pa ni zhes sogs/ rnam 'grel las/ gtan tshigs rab tu dbye ba'i don zhes sogs/ 'jug pa las/ mngon du phyogs pa mnyam bzhag sems gnas te zhes sogs/ spyod 'jug las/ spong ba'i sems ni thob pa las zhes sogs/ mdo rtsa ba las/ dbyar gnas pa khas blang bar bya'o zhes/ lam sgron las/ sems can dam pa 'byung ba mchog ces sogs/ mngon rtogs rgyan las/ de ni 'khor ba ji srid bar zhes sogs/ bshad chen bshad chung gi gzhung yod kyang spyor 'god 'jog mi dgos/ lngags rams pas spyor 'god kyi tshab tu bshad pa byed cing /dam bca' 'jog 'dod yod na ma gtogs ka dpe ma mi byed/ spyir grwa skor sga chos su mi 'gro ba'i do dam mkhan slob tshang mas byed pa dang / bye brag — 6 —

mdo'i grwa skor ba rnams kyi chos grwa smon lam kyi dam bca' yun ma thung ba'i tshod gzhung las pas byed cing / grwa tshang khag gi grwa pa rnams der 'du dgos pa'i do dam dge skos kyis byed/ grwa skor grub nas gdong gral du chung rgyu yin/me khyi hor zla drug pa'i tshes bcu gcig la dran tho 'di bzhin bkod pa/ slar rang dran gyis bzo bcos bzhin mi byed par 'di ga sor gnas byed dgos rgyu yin/ rmad byung bsod nams dbyar skyes ljon shing tshogs/ / kun mkhyen 'bras bu'i khur gyis rab dud pa'i/ / byed po zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa 'di/ / phyogs dus kun tu dar zhing rgyas gyur cig/ / /

rgyal dbang sbu phreng lnga pas sbu 'bum byams pa gling laXbastsal ba'i bca' yigachu sbrul/ (spyi lo 16di 2 )chos phung rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin dbyangs snyan rgyud/ /rmad byung ngag gi yol gor rab 'khyil ba'i/ /mtshungs med mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug dbyangs can lha/ /mgrin pa'i pad mar bzhugs la shis pa stsol/ /sgrib gnyis tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i nags kyi klung / /tshogs gnyis byen za'i phung pos rab bsregs pa'i/ /rnam 'dren de'i gsung dge 'dun bcas pa rnams/ /byang chub snyeng po'i bar du phyag gi yul/ / rgyal ba'i yab gcig 'jam mgon bong kha pa/ /bsams bzhin mi yi srid ba bzung pa'i sar/ /rnam gsum 'khor lo'i bya bas rab mdzes pa'i/ / 'dus pa'i sde 'di skye rgu'i bsod nams zhing / /'og min dag pa'i rin chen them skas las/ / nyer babs sprul sku'i sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i gar/ / bstan tshe dbus 'gyur 'chang gi lum bi'i tshal/ /mdo smad bong kha'i yul du 'phos pa bzhin/ /rgyal kun mkhyen pa'i 'dab ma rab rgyas par/ /brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis phan bde'i bh+ra ma ra/ / bsu ba'i sngon med pad dkar chun po 'dis/ / chu bskyed gzhan la gdung ba'i mdud pa grol/ / chas phra'i na tshod sgo nga'i sbubs rgya nas/ / gsang gsum mi zad —— 8 la

thams cad kyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i sman yon du sprul pa'i zlos gar bstan pa'i nor 'dzin gyi gzhir tsan dan gyi ljon pa lo 'dab g.yur du za ba'i steng du de bzhi/na gshegs pa seng ge'i nga no'i sku'i snang brnyan 'bum ༅/ra ba las ldan gyi skye bo du mas mthong ba'i gnas der/ chos sde thig tshugs na shar phyogs rgya mtsho chen po'i mthas gtugs pa'i bar du rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa 'phel rgyas 'byung ba'i rten 'brel du thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos 'bas kyis bcags 'i/nga gsung gi snang ba bstsal bar brten gsar du bskrun pa'i sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bca' khrims ni dge/ 'dun spyi la dgos pa'i khrims kyi rim ba rgyal ba bong kha pa'i bka' 'bum thor bur bzhugs pa'i yi ge gzhir bzhag bye brag dmigs kyis bsal ba/ bla ma las thog pas sgrig bsdams pa sogs chos lnga/na gyi bya ba'i rigs la nyan 'jog mthun rkyen du 'gro ba ma gtogs log sgrub mi byed/ nang mchod dang sman rta ma gtogs dgon pa'i nang du chang mi len/ gnang ba ma zhus par bud med mi gtong zhing 'ag tu mi 'jog dgon pa'i sgrig 'grim yin phyin gzhi byes tshang mar phu thung dang skra ring gri ring glo cha sogs 'ba' rengs kyi chas spros pa dang / zhwa ser ma gtogs zhwa rigs mi gcig pa mi gyon/tshogs su longs gtam smra ba/ bag med kyi spyod pa byed pa/ gnang ba ma zhus par tshogs su mi yong ba mi byed/ dpon po yul tshan mthun bsdebs sogs la brten pa'i chags sdang gis dkrug shing mi byed/ dgon spyir gnod pa'i nang gtam phyir skyel mi byed/ so nam sogs 'jig rten pa'i bya bas dam pa'i chos 'dul ba sun 'byung ba mi byed/ sgrig/ dang 'gal ba'i —— 10 — —

rig/sa la bla ma nga/ge/ slos sogs kyis snye 'gyangs pe ngas pa'i chad las byas pa tshul ba'i ma bsgrub dgos 'ing / de ltar mi bsgrub pa dang ngan rgyab byas/ pa sogs tshos sde'i bstan bshig/ chen por 'gro ba'i rigs la gnas dbyung sog/sa che chung bab thob kyi chad pa 'ge'/ zhing // der ma brtsis pa byung na rgyab banyer rgya sos si/ dpon po su 'os kyis gyis// mdor na chos sde'i sgrig tshul ldan du bgyis nga/'i dpang po dam can srung ma rnams kyis ma/dzad de tshar gcod rjes 'dzin gī 'phrin las kyi sgo nas/ chos sde chen po 'di nyid ji srid nyi zla'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams snang bar byed pa de srid du gnas shing rgyas pa'i mthu dang ldan par gyur cig phun tshogs rnam par dge ba'i gru dzings la// / brten nas kun mkhyen nor bu'i sping chen por/ // rab bgror don gnyis 'dod dgu'i da/pal 'byor la/ / 'gro ba mtha' dag/ longs su spyod gyur cig / ces sku 'bum byams pa gling gi bca' yig nyung ngu rnam gsal 'di ni/ sku 'bum chos rje grwa bu slob dang bcas pas bskrul ba'i ngor 'jam dbyangs bro/nga ma rgyal po'i lung gis/ zwa then/ tā zhwan/ tsi tsi'i pho/ shā wa'i tha no zhwa shi kyo'/ yi thang ba'i zhi/ la ta la/ tā la'i bla ma pa'i ra ra ra 'a 'azhes/ nub kyi lha ga/nas/ ches dge ba bde bad gnas pa'i sangs rgyas/bka' lung gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med rdo rje 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla mar grags shing / ming gzhan za hor gyi rigs las a wa spyo tī pa'i btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sder 'bod pa'i ldum bu pas rnam rgyal zhes pa chu sprul gro bzhin zla ba'i phyogs phyi ma'i dga' ba gnyis pa'i tshes la/ gnam sngon zhun mar 'khyil 'dra'i mtsho khri shor rgyal mo'i 'gram nas bris pa dza yan tu/——/ 11/ —/—

pho brang bo ta la'i sum skas mgo'i bca' yib/sa lug (sbyiXlo 1679)nyi 'og gi skye dgu spyi dang / skor gsum ru bzhi/ sgang drug bcas bod chen po'i rgyal khams su 'khod pa'i lha sde mi sde/ sog po tsho chen bzhi bzu// o rod tsho pa bzhi/ mtsho khri// shor rgyal mo'i 'gram du gnas pa'i rgyal po rgyal rigs sogs mchog dman bar pa mtha' dag la springs pa/tshe ring gnam kyi she mong gis yangs pa'i sa kun la dbang bsgyur pa bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po'i lhag bsam dang snying stobs btsan po'i mthus rgyal dbang tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs par mdzad skabs chu rta pho brang chen po bsam grub rtses gtsos pa'i mnga' 'bangs dang rgyal po nyid kyi rigs rgyud dang bcas pa mtha' dag gtan pa med pa'i mchod sbyin du spyor ljags mdzad pa'i tshe chos srid gnyis 'dzin nged rang nas ma lcogs pas 'jig rten srid skyong gi 'khur len sde pa rim par bskos shing /grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'di pa sa skyong sprun las rgya mtsho'i rus tsha yin pa ma zad/ gter sa rgya can sogs lung bstan 'ga' zhig tu bod kyi rje bor 'os pa lung gis zin pa nas shing yos lor 'khur len byed dgos tshul rgyu mtshan mtha' gsed nan chags byas kyang zhu nan ches pas 'khrol cha byed — 12 —

dgos shar grwa tshang sa/nyer pa blo bzang sbren pa brtan pa ngo dal//ra bas khri/ ra bkod pa rang 'dod chung zhing / bstan srid la rgya'i sar 'khur bsam che ba mu mthud thub la re byung ba sde pa rang yang lo gra/ngas jengs nas 'tshub 'dra 'byung nyen gyis nan zhus che zhing / brtag pa lan tsa/nyis gsum skyar ba dang / tshangs pa dung thod can la dri ba zhus pa so/gas kyang mtshungs nga/ nas sa//sar bskos kyis sgo dod par/ gzhan pa 'os dkon 'i/nga / sngar gyi brtas/ pa lung bstan sogs gang sa nas krong smad sangs rgyas nga rang la nam/ tan du lab 8 ra// yal yo la sogs thabs sna tshogs las dang len zhig mi 'dug kyang /dung dkar dang chu srin gyi dpe bzhin dgongs nga1 gtan nas ma khrol phyin bka' ma bcag par zhus/ de nas khur ya/ngas/ byed chog nga/ dgos tshul zer ba/ dngos gzhi rab tu byung na leg/sa pa'i char 'dug kyang tham/sa cad mkhyen/ nga dge/ 'dun rgya mtsho yan bka/'a gdams kyi rnam thar kho na lhur bzhes la dper ma mtshon/ dga' ldan pho brang lugs gnyis kyi mnga' thang je 'phel gyi 'go tshugs pa'i phyag mdzod rgya seng gnyis nas bzung / da lta phan sde ba blo bzang sbyin pa tsam ma gtogs tshangs spyod la gnas pa ma byung zhing /lhag par dpal phag mo grub pa dang / sde srid gtsang pa'i stobs 'byor las brgal ba/ shar dar rtse mdo yan gyi bdag por gyur pa'i dmag dang khrims sogs drag po'i rtsub spyod kyang sna tshogs dgos par tshangs spyod gcig pos rab byung du 'gro ba'ang dka' zhing nam lcogs bar 'khur len byed rgyur phyag mdzod bsko bzhag bgyis pa/ 'di ga ngos nas mi chos kyi 'khur len ma lcogs pa'i ngo tshab yin gshis/ 'di pas gang byas nged rang nas byas pa dang khyad med pas 'then khyer gyi gleng brjod med par kun gyis bkod pa g.yo — 13 ——

med dang / nged dang sde pa'i bar sel 'jug sogs byas tshe gzhung don la rgyar 'phyug tshabs che bas bden med rdzun bsgrigs kyi g.yo 'phrul byas chog rgyu min/ na tshod sogs nas mi spyogs pa'i 'khur len 'jog pa shar tshe nam yin la bzhag pa'i zur pa spyi 'gre bzhin/ byed lugs blo dang sbyar chog rgyu yin/'phags pa'i yul du sidha thoḥ phyogs 'dir don grub tu grags shing /'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu gyi yi zhes pa dbang thang dang bstun pa sa mo lug gi lo hor zla lnga pa'i dkar cha'i rgyal ba gnyis pa'i tshes la sde bzhi'i sgor 'phar rnam par phye ba pho brang chen po po ta la nas bres pa/ / / /

rgyal dbang sbu phreng lnga pa chen pos lha ldan cho 'phrul spyon lam chen klo'i tshogs bzhugs dge 'dunaXspyoXl bstsal ba'i bca' yigashing pos/ (spyi loX1675 )sngon goms thugs bskyed 'dzam bu'i shing gi 'bras/ /tshogs gnyis chu gter klong du yongs smin pa'i/ / mtshan dpe gser gyi snye ma g.yur za mkhan/ /zas gtsang sras kyi bkra shis sgo 'phar phye/ /lung rtags thig le mchog mar chags pa'i gdong / /rig byed chos phung brjod pa rnam dag khungs/ /sngon med dga' ba brgya pa tsong kha pa'i/ /zhabs sen zla ba gtsug tor rtse mor tshes/ / shāka seng rgyud sgras mu stegs ring dwags klad/ /'gems pa'i mnyan yod dus ston 'phags yul dngos/ /yongs 'phos 'jam dpal snying po'i mdzad chen rjes/ / 'jug rnams blang dor me long 'di la gzigs/ / de'ang sgron ma'i bskal pa bzang po 'di la 'o skol gyi ston pa sa gsum gyi sgron me gcig pu pa rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che ni/ /spyod 'jug las / ji ltar mtshan/ mo mun nag spren rum ma// /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ / de bzhin sangs rgyam mthu yis brgya —— 15 ——

lam na// /'du jig rten bsod nams blo gros/ thang 'as//'a 'byung // //che/sa dngos bstan sprun pa dang glos// mi khom nga/ dang dal 'byor gyi dper bzung nas brgya 'a/ma tsam/ du rnyed dka' ba'i nga/la 'byor gyi rten bsod nams kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi ma/thu la brten na/sa thengs 'ga' re tsam 'byung bar bshad nga/'i shugs la mthun nga/'i smag chen po'i nang du blog 'khyug pa srid pa bzhin du mun bskal ma tha' klas pa'i bar mtsham sa su sgron me'i bskal pa de bzhin gshegs pa byon pa'i/ bstan nga rim po che lha dang bcam pa'i 'jig rten thams cad bso/da na/ma/sa kyi 'i/nga rmad po che yen pa ni/ bde bar gshes/sa pa'i gsu ba rab 'a/sa byung ba'i dal//ra nas// she/ las 'bras ji bzhi/na bas ma/sa pa'i blang do/ra la brte/ ma/ na/sa 'di phyi kun gyi— bde spyid dpyid/ 7/ sa bon gang btab kyi 'bras bu ston gyi dus su mi 'chol bar 'byung ba'i phyir// dbu ma rin chen phreng ba las// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal kum// / de bzhin ngan 'gro thams cad do// //dge las bde 'gro thams cad dang // skye ba kun tu bde ba dag // ces gsungs la/ de yang / 'i ngas rgyas phal po che las/ 'dren pa la ni mthard thug med/ /de das/ sku ni gcig tu snang / /sku gnyis de dag bsam mi khyab/ /'jis/ rten khams su snang gyur kyang // /sku la gnyis su gyur pa med/ /ji ltar zla ba shar gyur ba/ /tshad med pa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ 1/chu yi snod du snang gyur kyang / / zla ba ga/nyis su gyur ba med/ /ces bde bar gshegs pa rnams kyi 'gro ba'i dbang po dang 'tsham par sku gsung thus/sa kyi bkod pa bas ma gyis mi khyab pa zhig ston pas na 'dren pa nyi ma 'i gnyen ni nges pa'i don du 'ob/ mim/ sdug/ po brko/da nga/ra sangs rgyas zin kya za 'dzam bu'i gling du mchog ga/ sprul pa 'i rkye 'i snang brnyan bzung ba'i 'gro blo'i dwangs mtshor zla —— 16 — —

bzugs/ bzhi/na thar ba thes/ pa 1 che chung si/ bas/da tshul ma/tha' klas shing / bye bras/ ma/nyam/ yo/da du ston pa drus/ sos//sa/ btul ba'i cho 'phrul gyi/ mchod nga/ yang mdo snge/—ma dzangs blun sogs su tshes gcig ma/sa bco lnga'i bar du bstan pa dang 'dul ba lung du tshes brgyad kyi cho 'phrul las nyi ma ga 'a/na rnams mi tsa/sal zhing rtogs brjod rin po che dpag bsam 'khri shing du'ang theg dman gyi rjes su 'brangs pa'i bshad tshul byung na'ang don cho 'phrul gyi mdzad pa bstan par mtshungs shing 'phags yul du dad ba'i rgyun bzang po gangs kyi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i ljongs 'dir so so'i bste gnas su dus mchod mdzad pa mang dab/ byung mod / gtso bor 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ de ba'i/na gshegs pa'i bstan 'di la/ /rnam pa sna tshogs bya ba byed/ /byang gi phyogs la brten nas ni/ /de yi tshe na 'byung bar 'gyur/ /lha ldan yul zhes bya ba yi/ / gangs can ri yi nang gnas pa'i/ / rgyal po mi yi lha 'e/sa pa/ / lo tsa bī rnams rigs su 'byung / //de yang sngags kyi don grub ste/ khongs spyod tshe dang ldan par 'gyur/ / rig pa longs spyod ldam/ zhes bya/ / mi yi bdag pos de yang 'grub/ /lo ni brgyad cur rgyal srid bya/ / des na rkun ma rnam par spangs/ / rgyal po nges ni srog spangs nas/ / de yang sngags ni myur 'grub ste/ / zhi dang rgyas da/nga bsil byed pa'i/ / 'jig rten sgrol ma zhes grags dang / / lha mo gos dkar mo dang ni/ / dkar mo chen mo gzhan phan brtson/ /rtag tu yid ni mi skyo ba'o/ /nge/ la sogs pa gsungs pa yi/ /de ba'i/na rgyal po mang po ni/ /rnam pa du ma mang po dag /kha dog sna tshogs sna tshogs gzugs/ / kha ba can gnas kla klo'i rgyal/ / de yang ston pa mchod byed pa'o/ / khyu mchog khyu mchog bzang po dang / / sa 'od de bzhin sa 'od —— 17 —

bzang // // nge bzhin/ pha rol gnon nyid dang / / rkang pa'i 'gros thes ldan pa yin/ //sa srungs/ dang mi be'u dang / //'od ldan nyid ni phyi ma yin/ / /tha ra/ra /3char rgyal ngang tshul te// /kla klo rnam pa sna tshogs yin/ /de 'og/ lus/sa ni rnam zhis/ cing /// / phyi rol skye dgus nye bar spyong/// / ces bstan pa'i nang tshan thugs rje chen ngo/'i za/ma/ sprul chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang lha mo rnam gsam sgyu sprul pa khri/ btsam/— bong jo 'be bza' thod dkar rnams stangs /—da da / mas dpyal gyi tshul bzung 'ing btsun mo snga ma gnyes kyis sangs rgyas dngos dang dbyer ma mchis pa'i jo shāka rnam sa/nyis sob/sa ga/dan drangs/ rgyal po ma yum gsum gyis pho brang ma rur sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe rigs ba gsum mgon po'i lung bstan ba'i na mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gyi lha khang rnams bod srin mo/ sa/na rkyal du bsgyel ba 'dra ba'i sa'i me btsa' sa//non pa'i tshul du bzungs pa'i mthar 'phrul snang ngang ra mo che'i sa//tsug 'a sa/ la/ nga les/sa nga ra bskrun nas bstan pa rim/ ngo/ che srol ba/ted/ par mdzad/ pa'i gzhi ma rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lo srid pa dang ma na zla ma/ mchis pa 'di nyid du cho 'phrul gyi mchod pa'i srol btod cing nyams ba med nga/ra gams pa'i mdzad nga ni /rgyal rabs bal/'a khol mar/ de nas khyad par bsnyen bkur cher mdzad pa/ /dbe/ slong byang sems shar phyogs sku 'khrungs pa/ / gsang sngags 'chang zhing rnal 'byor chen po ni/ /snyeng po'i mtha' can skyes chen dam pas ni// / zhal yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ / de la bsnyen bkur cher byed de das/ ni/ / 'phags pa'i gang zag dge sbyong mi/ stag go/ / zhes shar phyogs tsong kha'i yul du sbu bltams shing dge slong gi rten/ la nges gsang rdo rje theg pa'i rtogs pa mngon du gyur pa 'jam dpal snying po'i mtshan dang ldan nga/ —— 18 la

gang des 'og mim/ 'ing gis gtso bo longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku nges pa lnga dang ldan pa'i rten 'brel gyis gser gyi lha shākya mu ni la rin po che'i dbu rgyan sgron te longs sku'i rnam par 'al bsgyur thi/nga sri zhu rgya cher mdzad pa lung don dang /shin tu 'byor ba'i phyir rje bdag nyid chen po'i mdzad chen bzhi'i nang tshan lha sa 'i smon lam chen mor grags pa 'di nyid dgung lo nga gsum pa sa mo glang gi lo'i tshes gcig/ nas bco lnga'i bar lha mchod mi mchod 'in tu rgya che ba dngos bshams yid sprul gyi kun tu bzang bo'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba yid can rnams kyi blo'i ra ba las 'gong bar mdzad/ sa/bo bor rje btsun nyid nam mkha' mdzod la mnga' brnyes nga 'i 'phrin las kyi cha shas las byung ba yi/na mod/ gnas skabs kyi byed rkyen sde srid phag mo gru ba gong ma tshos rgya chen po kā ting da'i gu shrī ho wa nga gi lung la brten/ nas sne'u rdzong pa nang so nam mkha' bzang pos sbyin bdag gi mthil mdzad cing de rjes me pho spre'u'i lo 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan pa dang sne'u rdzong nga/ yon mchod bka' bgros te chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sping btab/ de nas bzung rje bdag nyid chen pos bka' ba/nang ba dang / sne'u rdzong nga du dben sha nam mkha' bzang po'i bzhed pa skong slad/ lha sa smon lam chen mo'i mkhan pos thog drangs/ 'al ta dang chab ril bas mtha' rten pa yan 'bras spungs pas mdzad/ tshogs pa se 'bras gnyis gtso bor gyur pa'i mdor na rab byung gi rtag/sa cha lugs dang ldan phyin ris su ma chad pa'i phyogs bzhi'i dgre/ 'dun 'du bar rgyal ba ga/nyis ba'i phyag/ len ltar/ de bzhin gshes/sa pa la dad ba med ba rnams gsang du dad/ pa dang / dad pa dang ldan pa rnams la'ang slar ba/sos btab ba'i ched — 19 ———

du/ snga dro snyan ngag mkhan rnams kyi gtsus/ gi nor bu dpal ldan dpa' bos mdzad pa'i 'khrungs rabs so ba'i pa'i chos thun re dang // dgongs mo sras bcas rgyal ba slob mar bcas pa rnams mos pa dang bden pa'i mthu las/mkha' khyab tu spyan drangs par mchod pa dang mjug bsngo smon gyis mtha' rten gdan dgung skyes dgu'i tshogs gsog gi dus kun tu bzang po'i sbon lam sogs tshas spyod kyi rim pa la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs dbyar mtsho ltar spel ba'i rnam dkar gyi las rlabs po che bskrun pa ni/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ skyes bu la las rdo rje zos gyur de la ni/ / zhu bar mi 'gyur gdon mi za bar phyir 'byung 'gyur// // de bzhin stobs bcu rnams la mchod bya bsod nams kyi/ /ye shes rdo rjes nyon mongs ma 'u sa 'joms par gyur/ /rtswa skam spungs nga/ ri po'i ma/chog tsam yod gyur kyang // / me ma/dab yungs 'bru tsam gyis de ni 'tshig 'gyur rte/ / de bzhin bde gshegs mchod pa hrung zad cig byas kyang / / hon mongs thams cad 'tshig byed mya ngan 'das/ rgyur 'gyur/ / ri bo kha ba can la mthong legs sman yod do/ / mthong zhing thos pas nad rnams thams cad 'i/ bar byed/ / de bzhin stobs bcu rnams ni mthong ngam thos gyur kyang / / yon tan kun ldan sangs rgyas ye shes 'thob par 'gyur/ /zhes phan/ yon mtha' klas shing / dge ba'i rtsa ba rgya chen por bskrun/ pa de tsam du ma zad bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la dmigs te me tog tsam gtor ba dang // sri zhur bya ba hrung zad bgyis pa'ang bsod ma/mas kyi tshogs ga 'a/la du med pa ni/ lung ga/zhi las/ gang zhis/ rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ /mchod rtem/ me tog sil ma spungs pas 'thor/ /'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser phye bre po ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang la 20 ——

mnyam pa yin/ /zhes dang / mkhas pa gang zhig rab tu sems da/da pas/ /sangs rgyas mchod rten la ni gom 'dor na/ /'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi srang tshad ni/ /stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa yin/ /gang zhig rab dang sems kyis sangs rgyas kyi/ /mchod rten la ni 'jim gong 'jog byed na/ /'dzam bu'i chu bo'i gser gyi gong bu ni/ / stong phrag brgya yang de dang mnyam pa min/ / zhes dang / snyeng rje pad dkar las// kun dga' bo yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas rigs kyi bu'am/ ris/sa kyi bu mo rab byung pa'am/khyim na gnas pa gang dag kha cig tha na ring bsrel yu/ngas 'bru tsam la bste stangs byed/ bla mar byed/ rim gror byed/ mchod par byed pa// kun dga' bo dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag thams cad kyi 'bras bu yongs su mya ngan/ las 'das pa yin te/ tha ma yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar nga smra'o/ zhes bsod nams kyi phung po'i tshad bzung bar dka' ba'i ngang tshul de la 'jug byar yod pa ni/ tshe rabs mang por goms pa'i legs byas kyi 'bras bu yo/ngas su dud pa'i bzang po'i bskal ba can yin la/ tshogs kyi zhing dam pa ni/ lung gzhi las/ dge slong dag dge 'dun ni lnga po 'di dag yin te/ lnga gang zhe na/ ngo tsha med pa'i dge 'dun dang / lug ltar lkugs pa'i dge 'dun dang / tshogs kyi dge 'dun dang / kun rdzob kyi dge 'dun dang /don dam pa'i dge 'dun no/ zhes lngar bshad pa'i nang nas slob pa dang mi slob pa'i don dam pa'i dge 'dun dang / phal cher kun rdzob so skye'i dge 'dun yin pa'i phyir/ mdo sde nyi ma'i snying po las/ gal te dge slong chos kyis gnas pa tshul khrims yongs su das/ pa ngo tsha shes pa dang / khrel yod nga phun sum tshogs pa dge slong lnga yang 'du na// rgyal po chen po dge slong gi — 21 —

dge 'dun de ni chos tshad med nga/ dang ldan pa yin cing sbyin ba/nas chen po dang / lha dang mi thams cad kyi mchod par 'os bar 'gyur ro/ zhes mchod gnas kyi yul dam nga/ra gyur pa de dag gi spyod tshul kyang bag med nga ra gyur na/ theg pa chen po la da/da pa rab tu sgom pa las/ sa yi bdag po rtag tu bag yod mdzod/ bag med sems can dmyal ba'i g.yang sar bor/bag med sems can/ dmyal bar mchi// zhes gsungs shing / de'i ldog phyogs ni/ lung phran tshegs las/ gang bag yod par byos shig ces zer ba bag yod pa ni chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba yin no/ zhes bshad pa'i bag yod pa ni/ 'phags pa thogs med kyis bag yod pa sa/nga zhe na/ ma chags pa dang / zhe sdang med pa dang / gti mug med pa/ brtson/ 'grus dang bcas pa la gnas nas ba/nga dge ba'i chos rnams bsgom pa dang zag pa dang bcas pa'i chos rnams la sems bsrung ba ste/ zhes bshad pas spang gnyer la blang dor phyin ci ma log pa byed pa'i gzob par lhur len pa ni bag yod pa ste/ des sgrubs shig so so thar par de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag bar rdzogs ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi byang chub dang / gzhan yang gang dag de lta bu dang mthun pa dge ba'i chos byang chub kyi phyogs rnams kyang bag yod pas thob bo zhes dang / mgon po klu sgrub kyis/ bag yod bdud rtsi'i gnas te bag med pa/ /'chi ba'i gnas su thub pas bka' bstsal te/ /de bas khyod kyis dge chos spel slad du/ /gus pas rtag tu bag dang ldan par mdzod/ /ces 'khor rnam pa bzhi'i rtsa ba bag yod la rag lus shing / bye brag tu/ rgan rim la bsnyen bkur dgos te/ lung gzhi las/bdag cag gi nang na su rgan de nas gong ma sreg gis shing zu gro dha zhig bstan —— 22 —

nas/ shes ldan dag sus shing n+ya gro dha 'di'i tshad ji tsam pa mthong glang po ches smras pa/ kho bo khyu dang lhan cig lam 'di nas 'gro ba na 'di'i srib kho bo'i lus dang mnyam pa kho na mthong ngo/ spre'u sa smras pa/ kho bo khyu dang lhan cig lam 'di nas 'gro ba na 'di'i srib kho bo dang mnyam pa kho na mthong ngo/de dag gis smras pa de bas kho rgan no/ ri bong gis smras pa/ kho bos 'di'i lo ma gnyis skyes pa na lo ma'i zil pa'i thig/sa pa lces bldab/sa so/ de dag gis smras pa/ 'di dag pas kyang khyod rgan no/ gong ma sreg/ gis smras pa/khyed cag gis shing zu gro dha'i tshad chen po'i rnam pa 'di mthong ngam de rnams kyis smras pa/ 'di mthong ngo/ kho bos sa bon rnams zos nas phyogs 'dir sbug pa bor ba de las skyes pa ni yin no/ de rnams kyis smras pa/ gal te de ltar na bdag cag thams cad kyi nang nas khyod rgan no/ de nas glang po ches thams cad la bsnyen bkur byed par brtsams so/ spre'u yis ni ri bong dang gong ma sreg la'o/ ri bong gis ni gong ma sreg kho na la ste/zhes dud 'gro yin kyang rgan gzhon go rim ma log par bsnyen bkur bas 'jig rten du bde skyid byung bar bshad do/ phran tshegs las/ dge slong de bas na deng phyin/ chad dge slong rgan rabs rnams la ming nas 'bod par mi bya rus nas 'bod pa mi bya ste/ btsun pa zhes brjod pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa zhes brjod pa ma gtogs par kun tu spyad par mi bya'o/ zhes bslab pa rgan gzhon sogs kyi rim pa ma nor bar gral gyi dang po dang rnyed pa gral rim nas 'grim pa sogs 'og ma dag gis rgo/nga ma la 'dud par bya bar gsungs pas na 'dus tshogs 'di dag tu'ang brlang spyod bag yangs su ma song ba'i grwa sa phan tshun gyi gral 'dzin sngar srol gang yin dang / de phyin phyogs bsdus kyi — — 23 ———

snyigs mar spyod pa'i dus 'dir yul dus dang bstun dgos pa'i phyir bal/'a srol mi 'dug rung gral gyi mtha' dkyil sog/sa kyi khyad gsung rab dang bstun na dgos par snang mod// rang bstan la ched du phan par mi 'gyur bzhin pho rus su ming btas/sa pa'i kun slong ngan pas dbyen du 'gyur ba'i spyod pa ni/sems dpa' chen bo bzang po dpal gyis// gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong bar khas blangs nas/ / dgra la sdug las thongs pa'i pho rgod po/ //rang gi sdom gsum yul nas 'don nyen gda'o/ / gnod sems rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs/ /dge spyong chos bzhi bsgrub par dam bcas nas/ /kha drag dbang chen 'dod pa'i nga rgyal can/ / kha/ sa blangs thog tu khel ba mi sa/da' 'o/ /rtag tu dman cha 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes khro ba la slar mi khro/rdeg pa la slar mi rdeg gshe ba la slar mi gshe/ mtshang ba 'dru ba la slar mtshang mi 'dru bar khas 'ches nas bsam spyor 'jig rten pa gzhung ma dang khya/ da par med pa/ kong btsun shes rab rngo/ rjes/ blo chags sdang gis 'chad ba'i ston chen dang / //khong 'jig rten pa'i ga bo bo rgad bu gnyis/ /khyad e 'dug kun slong sems la dres/ / zhes pa'i don thog tu babs dus 'di de 'dra'i ngang tshul byung ba/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i mdo las/ rigs kyi bu bdud sdig can gyis ni 'das pa'i 'og lo bdun brgya lon pa na/ nga'i bstan pa bye zhing bshig par 'gyur te/ dam pa'i chos nub pa'i tshe bdud sdig can zag pa can gyis zag pa med pa lta bur bsgyur te/ bya ba'i rtags kyis tshul byed pa bzhin du dge slong gi gzus/sa dang / dge slong ma'i gzugs dang / dge bsnyen gyi gzugs dang dge bsnyen ma'i gzugs dang rgyun du zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang /——— 25 ——

phyir mi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom nga/ dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi gzug/sa dang / sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis ba'i/ga par 'gyur te/ zhes sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la glags lta ba'i ched du yid srubs/ dge/ spyong gi gzus/sa ltar ba༅/da pa ni dus dbang gis 'byung ste zhing dge 'dun rnams 'thab rtsod la sbyar ba'i 'bras bu dge 'dun srungs kyi rtogs brjod du/ dgung gi gdugs tshod la babs pa na rab tu byung ba dag/ mgo bo tho bas bsnun te khrag babs pa dang 'du sgo bkag pa la brten nas bza' btung lcags khur gyur par bshad cing der ma zad dge 'dun gyi dbyen byas pa'i rnam smin ni/ lung rigs gter mdzod las/ bar bskal gcig gi bar du mnar med kyi sdug bsngal myong bar byed cing dbyen gyi mtshams med gnyis byas na mnar ped du lus nyis 'gyur la gzo/da pa sngar las nyis 'gyur du spyong dgos te//bskal par mnar med par smin 'gyur lhag pas gnod pa lhag/ par 'gyur/zhes sogs gsungs pa ni lung phran tshegs las/ zla ba skar ma'i tshogs bcas sa la lhung yang srid/ /sa 'di ri dang nags bcas mkha' la 'gro yang srid/ / rgya mtsho chen po'i chu ni skam par 'gyur srid kyi/ /drang srong chen pos rdzun gsu nga 'gyur ba srid pa min// /zhes bde bar gshegs pas rdzun gsungs pa'i skabs ni nam yang med pas nges par bden la de ltar yang bshes springs las/ khyod kyis dge slong bram ze lha dang ni/ / mgron/ dang yab yum dag dang btsun mo dang / / 'khor gyi slad du'ang sdis/ pa mi bgyid de/ / dmyal ba'i rnam smin skal nod 'ga' ma mchis/ / zhes rang gzhan gang rga/ ched du bsags pa'i sdig pa'i 'bras bu bdag nyid gcig bu'i thog tu smin pa'i phyir blo gros dang ldan pa rnams kyis blang dor gyi gnas ma 'dzol ba jeg gnad du ——— 26 ———

sta 'a / zo ngas bon lce steng po/ po pa pa ༅ ma 7shā chi— hūṃ/ba 'a/ma/ du bas/'a byeng nyes dz+wa 3/ 'u ra zu/nga du 'ji/— ra ba ngang 01 ri ma pa bras sngu nga'i/ ngang me ra sgyu theg chem gling pham tshum ra—ba pyung drus nga 'i/ sgyu lcags/ pho bye ba ma ra bzung tsha 'phru(mi chen mo'i/ dusapachabs ces// tu 'du tshogs ma jad ba'i na pa4 ra/brjod/ gleng rā cas sa yong ngom mi 'dul kung ‘pa1ra hūṃ 0 da'i hro/na gyis spra phyir thug/sa mi ma/dz+wa ma/ shā ci ris/sa dang snye char rab stong bahru sa/ cil shā 'ing rngo ma kyi lor 'bras/ spu ngas 5nga ge smo/sa dang bya rong pa thus/ nga 'i rkyen two nga ngang za po (dbyung rngod1 kre cho 'phrum / ྅ bu'i za drur sna tshogs nga 'i spyo cher 'e ba sngo za 4'i bsla/ba stom gyis skron 'a ra/ par 'a snang na4 'i/nga de rjes se ra ba dngo na slo/ba mas po/rtsad ma tshams dgos// tshu/ma byung ba phan tshun so so/ 'i byer phyos/sa ci yo/nga/ ji/ngas nga/la///sna sa/this grwa/ tshang brdo/snyer shāri/ 'phyongs rgyas nga blo bzang spyim pa ngang 'pham yu/la lha la/ nga nga sber 'o/sas yi—/ da/ra gnyis bdang pa'i tsa//sung rigs rnam/ grangs mang ba so sor spungs ba༅/da kyi longs su da sa pa byas/ dri / tsho/nga ri la/ bla ma tshan / pa rab 'a pa byams pa blo bzang tshos skyong be/sa dge sko/sa dus gral 'dzin gyi gral bzo ba dang ja gtong ba sos/sa pher rgya mang du byas shing dgon par 'byor nas 'di bzhin byas yo da pas dbyar mjug gangs la sgrol bye sna gas gtam btang ba rim lce sa mched pa 'bras spungs pa rnams kyi thugs su ma shong ba'i rkyen gyis skyor lung bla ma sgang ma bo/ rab 'byams pa ngag/ dbang rgya mtsho dang sprul sku dgos skyes kyi bu grags pa blo bzang sogs dge skos 'ga' re'i thog se ra ba phyogs kyi gral rnams rim shor dang / dge slong don grub rgya mtsho'i dge skos kyi thog ja gtong ba yang phyogs lhung ha cang che ba dang / rgyu rkyen 'ig la dpon sa lho mos mas se ra chos rje gnyal ston pa'i drung du skye rtags zhus par chu srin du skye ba'i sgo dgag par dge 'dun ———— 27 ———

sto/nga ra cam gyis / mi ma bla'i mdo chob/ chen cho gsu/nga bang lung bsgan 3༄ ba'i ma zus btab ra mo che/spu ba/rjo lar btsus/sa nga na mchod/ dbyangs pa bzhi ma gtogs mkhan pos thob/ drangs/ las sbo ba thams cad se ra ba kho nas ma/dzad nga1'i sne mo ba ci ritsa/sa kyi skyom la brtem lho pa dang sgo 'bor ba/'i gral gyi bar/ du 'bras spung ma/ nga/'i bla ma rnams bzhus/sa dga' 'i/ /nga grwa dmangs/ tshos/sa byings nges /'i dwo/ nga du mnyam bsres/ thog 0bza phag/ la dam/sa btang ska bas gling zhu ru dbom po'i dpa' dar 'a/ byung ba'i lo gling dgu ngang 1 ka ba'i la sbor mo byas 4—nga1'i nya khung gra/ma da/mis/sa bsal du bsgrib/sa ka 'i/sa/ yo/da 'dus/ par yang brdung 'tshos ngang ja thug ji ba'i na/ mi gtong ba so/tsam phan tshun sa/cib ngam sa//hrus/ rgyas/ dang / sa bya'i skron lam dus 'bras spungs dbe/ skos rba/na ba star sdong dka' bcu blo bzang rab brtan la byes pa'i sog ngo 'ig 'u/sa lag lan gī rnam pa byas par byes slob dpon nga bya bral rab 'byams pha 'jam dbyangs lhun grub kyis legs so'i lnga da/ra btags pa sogs se ra phyogs nas bstan ba'i ga/ si/ ba//nya' mi gnon par ga/zengs bstod pa byung 'ing 'bras/ spungs thos/ nas de rigs kyi skyon med tshul phan tshun gzigs stangs ma gcig cing rmu rgod la la ma pher ba'i rigs la sngon las dang gang du'ang gsha'am med pa skad kyis zla grogs 'tshol zhing ngang pa mtsho ngom dang 'us/ pa brag/ ngom gyi rgyab brten/khrel bdas la ngo sor 'khyer ba'i dge skyon sna tshogs byung 'dug pa da cha blang dor mdzad rgyu'i snying po lha sa smon lam chen mo'i gdong gral nub lha dang de'i rgyab sprod zhal shar gzigs tshun 'bras spungs pa dang / de'i rgyab nub lha rtsa gral nas bzung ba'i gral drug tsam se ra ba sha stag dang de nas mi ru bzhi sde bar gral gcig de rgyab se 'bras 'dres ma dang phyogs mtha'i dge 'dun —— 28 —

di phyim gral thams cad la ma sgyu nyam khe/ bas/ shis/ ma/ byung na rtsod glo nga blo/ rgyur ma zad bzhes pa rnam/sa phyogs mtshungs su mi yong ba'i tshogs kyi kun spyod la mang sa//nod par lca/nga / se ra'i khams tshan gyi mang 'gyed byung dus sbyin bdab/ gi spos sna re tsam yo/rngo ba lnga thog gi khungs dang / yis rigs sogs skyel rgyu mi 0dus/ rung bar skabs su tar sngong gis thog mar srol gtod/ 'dug/ pas mtshom khams tshan rnams nye che 'brel zab kyi byas 'dus/ pa sbyin/ bdag gi/ mi re tsam ma the ba blo ma rangs pa'i dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo ga'an du bsgyur thabs kyis rang ga'am la brten nas sdis/ sa/sag pa'i nyem 'dug sa/shis dper na se ra har ldong gi mang 'gyed lta bu byung ba'i tshe 'bras spungs dge rgan gyi rjes su kha/ mas tsham gyi bo so tsam gyi ched du se ra har ldong rga/ mi re phyim pa spos/ sna sbom lam chen mo'i las tshan du mi ga/tog/sa ga'i/sa skyon du mi 'gyur/ 'gyed shar kha gnyis dgos pa byung na 'bras spungs pa rang gi dge rga/na gnyis kyis gtong zhing se ra'i dge rgan las grogs lta bu 'a sa lag 'jug mi byed grwa sa so sor khams tshan 'dzin thebs dang dgra gnyen dbye 'byed lta bur 'gyed skal sna tshogs gtong srol 'dug rung sgron lam chen mor de rigs byas tshe dge 'dun spyi'i rnyed pa la gnod pa nas khams bod ngo bo rnams dang skyid sbug gcig pa'i nye logs kyi khams pa rnams la nyis skal lam gsum skal/ dge rgan dang rogs byed rnams la lnga skal lam bcu skal tsam yang gtod ba'i srol ngan par skabs su dar 'dug kyang da cha gong gsal mtha' dag rang skal las mi gtong 'phar chag med pa sbon lam gyi las tshab rnams deb gsal ltar yin/ sde pa bsod nams rab brtan gyi dus 'gyed gtong skabs gzhung gi sku tshab re yong gin 'dug pa/ sa khyi gsang sgo nas bzung bar bkab ma byung 'dra yang da cha — — 30 ——

mtsham/sa/ tshigs kyi mig lha dang bcas/ 'o/da pa 'as/ba/ 'bu'/ ba rnam ba/'ag gi sko bas 'bras spyo rtsengs ki bla ma nga/ba mdzad par bsngo rten dgos/ nga/ smos ma —dge da dab mas /mi 1 dgo/sa 'ing bro mangs slob nga/ngo ma pa dang nya 'o/gas — bla ma rmam sa la 'bul ba byas pa'e steng se ra har ldo nga si// byes pa slob dpon nga sog/sa la sbo mangs slo/ba dngo/ma cam las rim 'gros kyis chung ba ma gtogs 'dra ba mi byed// 'bras dru/ngas har ldong bo/ mang ja'i skabs se ra'i har ldong gi dge rgam spos sna mdun/ ja sos/sa la 'bod par dgas/ pa med// dpe des khams tshan gzhan rnam/sa la 'ang mtshon 'ing co dre las/ lnga'i mang 'gyed la bar ska/bas/ su/ spos sna da/nga 'gyed gtong ma/khan khong tsho'i dge/ za/na gyis byas 'dub nga 'bras spungs su co ne rnams la khams tshan gyi thob thang 'dug nga/sa/ dper na co ka sa/zhung pa 'bras spungs su rta bo/ na nga/ dang rgya ye wa nga gnyis por lo re mos kyi 'bab kyi yod 'dus/ pas de gnyis re mos su yin gyis gzhung pa'i mang 'gyed la gong gi har ldong gi dpe ji lta bzhin byed/ ra mo che'i smo na lam la yang 'bras spungs kyi glo ba dpon tsam byung la bzos sa/nga legs las lho pa spo 'bor bas gral la zhe brdung dang dge skos gsum gyis 'bras spungs pa'i grwa pa rnams la dgos med kyi zhen gsog mi byed cing / ja thug sogs bzhes pa rnams kyang phan tshun khyad med snyom par gtong / bya rung ba 'di spyid shod sde pa g.yul rgyal nor bu'i dus dban po skal bzang zer ba'i gzugs btsun zhig la khog zhus/sa byung tshe nga chos skyong du bya rung ba tsam yin byas pa las ming der thog pa rim gyi sgra 'chol ba ma gtogs shar phyogs sku'i rgyal po'i blon po grwa tshong 'dus bya khrid mig gcig pa min pas nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po'i blon po rdo rje grags ldan du 'al gyis bzhes pa tshal yang dgon rgya chen lta bu'i do zla ba— sde~X ༷ldas

rī/ bang she kyi ste rdza ba rjam sa kun sgos// mi mas sa/ kyis sgang ba tsam snang ba snga thos spyom /ra ma chen mo 'i gra1shā zhe 'dzim/ gyi dung zu/ btang tshum/ bo/ tsa zhus/sa ba7/sa cha byeng sngo/rtem med ma/(snang nga skos gra‘pa 'dzim gī/ nyi ma gra dam ngas thams cad tshogs zim pa/ rang gra tho//yo/ kas nga mang 'i nga brje ba/—hūṃ gshes gsar bu/ ba rgyu'i med sna drang dzo/rdung tshams byas ched lo ltar da che/ 0da du na thugs/ mi/ ma thum ba'i phyi ru la du btam / cha ban ceng zam/ smim mas/ ngo ra /mdzag nga/'i rgyun kho na'i das/sa/ bya che 'ing dgos tsā4 chung ba nas/ ra rbo che'i bo//ru / sbu 'i dus bya rung pa tsa/yu/la khang rgya/ba na/sa ra mo cher shra ma/ra byon/ ngos byu—ma sa nga bdan 'a/ dren ma zim/ bar tsho/ ba/ zhu0sa mi byed// de/ ma nga sngar smos kyi pham tshun thugs mi ma thun/ pa'i zing rkye/ pyi rgyu byas tshe mtha/'a kla/sa pa'i 'dus tshags 'di lnga/ bur phal mo/ che'i so/ skye'i dge/ /8dum/ ba'i/ na du sna nga ya/nga ga/nga zas/ si/ tshad ga/nga zag/ mi/sa bzung mi nus par ma ngo 'a /sa bshad pas skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag yang brgyad so sa/sa 'phas/sa pa'i dge/ (da dun dang der ma zad byang chub tu sems bskyed pa'i theg pa chen ngo /'i dge / /'dun so gas sbas pa'i tshul can dam pa ji snyed cig yod par nges pas/ de dag la khro ba dang rtsod pa mtshang 'dru ba ni/ 'jug pa las/ gang phyir rgyal sras rnams la khros pa yis/ / dri na dang khrims byung dge ba bskal pa brgyar/ / bsags pa skad cig gis 'joms de yi phyir/ / mi bzod las gzhan sdig pa yod ma yin/ / zhes 'byung la/ der ma zad 'phags pa dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su 'dzin ba'i mdo las/ shā ra dwa ti'i bu de bzhin du gang byang chub sems pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa gcig gis bar chad byed pa de ni chos dkon mchog gi phung po 'bum phrag mang po dpag tu med pa dag gi bar chad yin no/ / zhes jeg pa chen po'i gang zag gcig gis gzhan phan la 32 la

bsgrub pa 'a sa/ tshod rnga/ ra byed mas/'i sdes/ 'bras bsam/ gyis mi/ khyab nga ra bshad nga sa bas dang ldam 8 'dzi phyi kum gyi rtsa ba yi ma nga ri phyir gong smos rnams kyi za/nga nor 'dzo nga me/da nga ra brtson nga sa hur blangs na 'jig rtem/ kum tu gnas sabs dang ma thar ba/ mi/ bde/ bhū da rgya chem po 18byung bar 'gyur ba mi// ji za/na dā1/ sna gro ba'i sdub/ ba sprul sman tsa/cig pu/ / bde ba rgam/sa cang 'byung ba'i sams1 / bstan pa rnyed dang bku/ra bsti nga/nga / //bcas te ru/na ring gams byur cig/ / ces 'gro ba kun gyi nyon mongs pa'i nad/ ma 'u sa nga 'a—jo5/sa pa'i rtsi sman chen/ po phan nga / dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo dam/ nga sa ngas rgyas kyi bste na nga rin po che yin la/ de yang zu ngon pa mdzod/ du/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam/ gnyis te// // lung dang rtos/sa pa'i bdas/ nyir// do/ / di 'dzin byed pa thru byed dang / / sgrub par byed pa kho na'o/ // 'es lung rtogs/ kyi bstan nga1 de yang / ma pham pas / yi be 'bri mchod sbyin pa nga/nga // /nyam dang klos/ dang len pa dang / /'chad dang kha ton byed pa dang / /de sems pa dang sbo/zu/ nga/ ste/ / spyod pa 'di bcu'i bdas/ nyid kyi/ /bsod nams phung po dpag tu med/ / ces dge 'dun rnams klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan 'phel ba la rag lus/ de yang phan tshun mnyes bshin pa'i thugs mthun pa rtsa ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gso spyong la'ang rigs mang du yod pa sngon bsags kyi sdig pa sbyong gzhi gnas dang / bcu ba'i pa/ bco lnga pa/ gnod pa phyir bzlog rtsod pa phyir bzlog bkra shis pa rnams tshe 'di'i zag pa 'gog phyir mthun pa'i gso spyong gi khongs su bsdus pa'i dgos pa yang lung rigs gter mdzod las/ bslab pa gsum gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i sgo nas gnas skabs mngon mtho/ mthar thug nges legs thob la 33 la

'i /'idadagos nga// yed nga dang / byed nga ra sgom nga /'i bcas / pa dang mthum rnyi nga brte phyags/ bku shis / nga/ nga nga 1/ phyogs re ma ba nas da nga /྅ spyo/ bo ra —nga ngo /pa rnga ma rnga spyo chen pe 'byung ba'i/ 'bos nga / rngo da/ do/ 'es tsa/so spyo nga rga pham yo/ma bzang ra / der 4 za/nga dge/ 'dun ba/ ma/drum nga/'i ('bras bu 'i/ so sna ra thar nga ( — ma'i 'a/so// tshe dang ma sdom/ nga da/rtse/ re dun dang 4stan cis par/ rnga/thun nga nga dī/ra shes/ dge /sna dun mthun nga/ mi bye nga / kun tu dab/'a mi/ rtsod/ ma chos/ ba'i ba/ 'a ngo nga ga/cig/ cing chu dang 'o zu/ /'dres nga/ lta/ bur gyur nga / sto na pa'i bstam/ nga 'a/nga bas1'a bar byed na bde ba 'a/ res nga ra ba/mas par 'gyur ba je/ mu / rgya cher bsngags/ thing // mgo/ma po /'i ba lhas/ gtsub las bang rnam/saklog pa dang / //la/ ton gyis rgya'i/ legs sa/nas shog / rtas// par dge/ ('dun ma thun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang grub nga ra shog /ces smo/na lam mjad rnga/sa kyang 'es nus so/ 'u/sa can bsod nams nya phyis yangs pa'i los/ //nga/de skyed mu tis byur bur legs spungs pa// / sta ra brgyu'i sra da bur spen ba 'dus pa'i sde/ / srid zhi'i gdung ba kun gzhi/la che la/ mal/ na/ / de phyir phyos/sa lhung ri dwag/sa 'khrul rjes su/ / ma 'brangs lhag bsam rgyud las drangs pa'i mdas// / dge/ 'dun dbyen gyi la spyo'i mgrin gcod pa'i/ /'phongs skyen gnyis pa'i dga' byed lha thig snang / / legs byas ga ka'i yab cig las babs klung / //mtha' klas yang srid 'ji na lam 'ongs pa'i rgyun/ /byang chen chu gter 'phel klong ma rgan klu/ / gtan bde gdengs ka'i nor bu 'od 'bar shog / ces lus can kun gyi ma 'dris pa'i gnyen gcig pu rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po'i cho 'phrul gyi dus chen lha sa smon lam chen mo'i tshe dge 'dun rnams kyi nyams bzhes su bstar bar 'os pa'i bca' khrims dang —— — 34 ——

bzo tsa/ji mthun pa lta bu'i yi ge srid sgrub nyag phran 'di ni za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho /7jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes drin/ po jes pa 'ing yos nam mthongs zla ba'i tshes gcig spen pa snar ma'i 'grub sbyor gī nyin 'dzin ma'i spo sa las mngon par 'phags pa'i po ta lar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni sdom brtson rig pa 'dzin pa 'jam dbyangs gras/sa pas bgyis pa sarba dka li la spru bha warnyu/ / / /

rgyal dbang sku phreng lnga pa chen pos chos sde chen po zha lu'i sgrub mchod bco lnga gsar tshugs skabs bstsal ba'i bca' yig shel dkad me long bzhugs/me 'brug (sbyi lo 1676 )grangs med bska la mang dus nas ma 'dris 'gro ched thugs bskyed sa bon rnams/ / bya dka' rlabs chen rgyal sras spyod pa'i tshogs gnyis drod gsher dar drag nga/sa/ / chos gzugs dzam bu'i gser gyi snye mas srid zhi'i 'dod dgur lus can kun/ / sbyor mdzad lha yi lhar gyur skyo ba pa shākya seng ges dge legs stsol/ / khyod bstan nyi zla 'phags bod me zhal lam/ /'dren pa'i rta ljang lo paṇa mkhas grub kyi/ / ngo mtshar skyes rabs ljongs 'dir bu ston zhes/ / shes bya thams cad mkhyen de phyag gi gnas/ / sang gi ring lugs dbyar chu dus ngan dgun/ / ches phra pad ma'i skud pa'i srog zungs su/ /bdud rtsi'i thigs phreng sbyin mdzad tshar chen zhabs/ / yab sras brgyud par bcas pa bsngags bya'i gnas/ /khyad par 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos byang gling rje/ /rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i smin grol phyag bzhes nor/ /stsol la — 36 —

sprul pa'i zlos ga/ra 3/ lu pa/ / rin chen bsod nams mchog grub rigs kyi bdas/ / mgon des spyi dang bye brag lung rtogs rgyun/ /thub bstan rgya mtsho'i pha mtha' rnyed nus su/ /chad med 'bab phyir gsar bskrun rnam dkar gyi/ /'phrim/ las nam mkha'i ska rags mas mtshan min/ /ches dko/na bya dag/'a rnal 'byor rgyud sde'i tshul/ /bag la 'a ba'i ri mo rnying pa ring / /sngon rabs mkhas pa'i bzhed srol slar sa/sal ba/ /gzur gnas dpyod ldan snying po bdud rtsi'i dpyid/ /khyab bdag rdo rje sems dpa' mi ga/zugs can/ /dbang phyug rab brtan khu dbon sgrub khang pa/ / bka' drin zla med bla ma rnam gsum gyi/ /thugs dgongs/ chos kyi dbyengs su rab rdzogs shing / / gangs can dpal mo'i mngal du nyer sprums pa/ / mdo sngags lugs grol legs 'dzin tsan dan ljon/ / phan bde'i dri bsung dngar pos skye rgu kun/ / sim pa'i tshor ba myong ba sbyor de rmad/ /brgyud ldan rdo rje'i slob dpon slob mar bcas/ /sngas/sa rgya ting 'dzin phyag len 'khrul bral gyi/ / bgrangs yas dkyil 'khor sgrub cing nyer mtshad pa/ / bsod nams rgya mtsho'i jeng las dmigs su med/ /'on te sta bom/ ma tshang gzar dkyil la / / sprub mchod tshul bzhin ma bgyis ming po'i spyod// // rnam dag bstan pa'i bgrang byar 'os min 'bras/ /tshad ldan srol la ras bkar snum zhugs bzhin/ /de phyir mig rkyen ngan dper mi 'dzin par/ / 'dzol med blang dang dor bya ma lus gzugs/ / mngon sum 'char ba'i bca' yig ā dar za/ra/ / rjes 'brangs gzigs mor dngar nol lag tu long/ / de yang 'jam dbyangs sa skya lo tsā bas/ mchod bstod 'dud pa'i bdag nyid can/ / shis pa brjod sogs mi 'ag/la te/ /thams cad du yang ston pa yi/ / che ba 'ba' zhig ston phyir no/ / zhe/ sa ——— 37 ———

gsungs pa ltar yul khyad par can la brten nas shis pa brjod pa dang bstod tshig gi me tog ma na da ra 'thor ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas gleng bar bya ba ni/'o skol gyi ston pa sgrib gnyis kyi dgra tshogs ma lus pa bcoms shing yon tan mtha' dag mngon du mdzad zin pa'i 'dren pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras po'i bstan pa rin po che ni/ ji skad du/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /ces ris su ma chad nga/'i 'gro ba mtha' dag thog ma med pa nas las dang nyon mongs pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal gsum gyi zus rngu drag po'i nad kyis btab pa rtsa ba nas phyungs te zhi/ bar byed pa dam pa'i chos kyi rtsi sman la brten nas srid pa dang thi ba'i phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che lus can rnams kyi legs byas kyi zhing dam par bla nas blar bskul ba'i srid zhu dang bcas nas sems can rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen du yun ring por gnas par 'gyur bar gsungs pa mkhyas dbang da jis/ mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos po la/ /sgron pa 'is pa brjod de dper/ / zhes bshad ma thag pa'i 'dod nga 'i don de 'grub par gyur cig ces pa'i smon lam du mdzad pa yin la/don chen po dang ldan pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che de yang thos bsam sgom pa dar ba'i yul ni 'grel chen dri med 'od las/ 'dzam bu'i gling chen po zlum po'i rnam pa zheng du dpag tshad 'bum phrag sa/cig dang khor yug tu 'bum phrag gsum yod pa gang du mi rnams gnas pa de ni las kyi sa dang drug ni longs spyod kyi sar rig par bya'o/ 'dzam bu'i gling lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i ngogs na ste lhag ma ni chang la sogs pa'i ngogs na'o/ zhes ri rab ——— 38 ———

ldun po rdo rje'i dbyebs can du yod pa'i ka'i 'og tu longs spyod kyi sa'i gling drug dang de'i phyi rol du gling bzhi gling phran brgyad 'dzam gling chen por grags pa las kyis nga/ra gsungs shing de dang mthun par mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i rgyud las/ 'dzam bu gling ni chen po yi/ / dum bu bcu gnyis kyi ni dbus/ /zhes bshad la shing dzam bu'i ba/ la brten nas de ltar 'chad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod na'ang 'di pa'i lugs la 'dod rgyal gyi ming las sgra bshad rgyu med cing /'dul mngon sogs gsung rab spyi skad du/ lho phyogs kyi gling 'di nyid la 'dzam bu'i gling zhes pa las 'dzam gling che chung gi tha snyad ma gsungs shing /mdo rtsa bar mi ma yin pa'i 'gro ba dang / byang gi sgra mi snyan pa'i sdom nga 'i 'ing ma yin no zhes dang / sdom gsum du/ gling gsum skyes pa'i bud med las/ / 'gro ba gzhan la sdom pa bkag / ces byang sgra mi snyan par so thar kyi sdom pa mi skye bar bshad cing / mdzod du/ sgra mi snyan sgrib sa/sum du 'dod// ces las sa ma yin pa'i 'chad tshul dang lugs gcig la sdom 'byung las/ shar gyi lus 'phags ba lang spyod/ / de bzhi/na byang gi sgra mi snyan/ / gling gsum po yi mi rnams ni/ /longs spyod chen pos yang dag 'tsho/ /rnam rtog med cing rtog dpyod med/ / blun rdzongs bye brag mi phyed pa'o/ /'dzam bu gling du legs skyes pa/ /las kyi sa par rab tu grags/ /legs byas nyes par byas pa'i las/ /mchog dang 'breng dang tha ma yi/ /skye ba snga ma rnam smin 'dir// / skye bo kun la mthong bar 'gyur/ / zhes las kyi sa pa lho 'dzam sgo'i gling 'di nyid la ngos bzung zhing / mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dus 'khor dang dgongs pa mthun par bkral ba'i 'dzam gling chung ngu 'di dum bu bcu gnyis kyi gtso bor ba 'ag nas 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rabs — — 39 ——

bdun nub gling nas bzung gling dum bu bcu gnyis su rim bzhin 'khor ba las bskal pa gzhan gyis sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor can/ thams cad skyob gsum 'das rjes su bskal pa bzang po 'di'i gling bcu gnyis kyi 'gro ba'i don du/ 'khor ba 'jig gser thub/ 'od srungs/ shākya thub pa ba'i/ skye ba bzhes pa'i bzhi pa shāka rigs su 'khrungs pas mkha' 'gro rgya mtshor/ 'dzam bu gling ni chung ngu 'dir/ / bdag ni shākya'i riṭa rjes 'gro/ // zhes gsungs pa'i rang cag gi ston pa shākya don kun grub pa ni/lung las/ mnyan yo/da gnas bcas tsam pa ka / wa ra ṇa si yangs pa can/ /rgyal po'i khab dang drug po ni/ /de dag grong khyer chen por grag/sa/ /je/sa yu/la gru chen po drug gi cha shas ser skya'i rgyal khab chen por zas gtsang ma/'i sras su sku bltams nas rdo rje gdan gyi spo la theg pa 'og ma ltar na zad mi shes pa'i ye shes mngon du mdzad pa'am gong ma'i lugs la mchos/ gi sprul pa'i skur mngon 'tshang rgya ba'i tshul bstan pa bzhin 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis kyang de ltar mdzad pa'i byen rlabs kyis bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus mngon pa ba'i lugs la mkha' la zo ba btags pa ba'i na ga'o/ma gzhig dang bral bar gan/sa shing / gong du bshad pa'i yul de dag si// mi 'gyur ba'i lte ba lta bur yod bas ma spyo ga da dha ra zhes pa tsan+d+ra bar pre khro/ dha ra'i bsdu ba byas pas ma ga dha zhes dbul 'gyur 'chang du gras/sa pe 'di nyid 'dzam gling gi lte bar byas pa'i yu/la gru'i dbye ba dus 'khor las/ 'phags yul bod li rgya nag dang / / kai la sha dang gangs can che/ / zhes drub/ tu gsungs pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'phags pa'i yul du paṇa grub rnams kyis nyi zla ltar gsal bar mdzad pa las byang phyogs su dar ba ni/ 'jam dang/la rtsa — 40 —

rgyud las/ kha ba can du mtsho bre nas/ / sta la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ /zhes byang phyogs kha ba can gyi rgyal khams 'di thog mar mtshos gang ba rim gyis bri nas sru la'i ljongs su gyur par rgyal po ru pa ti dpung bcas bud ped kyi chas su bzhugs nas 'ongs nga/ las mched par yang bshad cing /yongs su grags pa spyan ras gzis/sa dang sgrol mas byen gyis/ brlabs pa'i spre'u dang brag srin mo 'dus nga/ las 'phel ba'i rus chen bzhi 'am drug sogs rim gyis mched de mi'i rgyal khams su gyur pa dbus su byas pa'i shar du rgya nag dang khri stan/ lhor rgya gar dang kha che/ nub tu stag sde dang gzig yan/byang du khrom dang ge sar gyis bskor bas yul gru chen po dgur grags pa'i nang nas bod spyi la dbang ba'i rgyal po phal cher sprul pa'i gang zag tu bshad cing /rje tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ mnga' bdag srong btsan sgam po'i dus gser gyi lha jo shāka rnam gnyis gdan drangs ra sa 'phrul snang sogs gtsug lag khang rten dang bcas pa mang du bzhengs nas srol btod/ lha sras khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan slob gnyis sogs lo paṇa rnams bla'i mchod gnas su bkur zan g.yang lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs shing thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas dam pa'i chos dar bar mdzad/ rje khri lde gtsug brtan gyi dus skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa sogs bstan pa snga dar la rgyal po sdig can gyis gnod pas 'phel grib byung na'ang slar bstan pa'i me ro stod mid gnyis nas gsos te so so thar pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba tshugs/ paṇ+ḍi ta smri ti snyon shrī ngo bo chen po dī paṃ kār ki snara'i bsod snyoms pa chen po shākya shrī sogs paṇa grub du ma dang / 'jig rten gyi mig gcig pu rin chen bzang po dang bla chen 'brog mi shākya ye shes —༷— 41 la

sogs mkhas pa grangs med pa byon te 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bstan pa spel bar phyi dar du grags pa de yang bstan pa snga dar gyi dus khri lde 'od srungs kyi sras dpal 'khor btsan/ de/'i sras mched gnyis byon pa'i che ba skyed lde nyi ma mgon stod du byon nas mnga' ris kyi rgyal po mdzad/ de la sras gsum byung ba stod kyi mgon gsum du grags/ spyid lde'i gzung khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal dbus nas sgyugs pa gung thang man pa chags/ de la sras gsum byung bar smad kyi lde gsum du grags pa'i chung ba skyid lde ba 'ad rta mag phyogs su phog pa la sras drug byung ba'i lnga byang phyogs su yod cing / gcig grum pa shab srad nyang yul rnams kyi bdag mdzad par nyang yul du sras khyung rtsad/'dre rtsad/ lce rtsad gsum gyis dbus gtsang ru bzhi grags pa las sum rtsen yul la 'gran pa ru lag nyang stod smad kyi sa cha so sor bgos te bzung nas mi ring bar dar gud byung mthar chung ba lce rtsas bskyangs/ nyang stod gzhung phal cher zhing la thag ma dang chu mig la brten pa las ped par lce rtsad kyi sa rnams bed chod pa'i phyir nyang stod kyi byang stod du rtsa rnams kyi rgyal rka dang /lho rgyud du yang yul bzhengs kyi 'or rka bya ba/ nyang smad byang du pa tshab rka mo che/ lho ru sna nam rka mo che rnams bzos par rka so so'i 'og nas son khal khri phrag re thon pa'i rka rnams ma 'jags bar bsrung mi sdod par rgya khrom lce mkhar dang / pa snam lce mkhar gnyis ba migs pa sogs stobs 'byor rnam dpyod phyag rjes nan tar che ba'i lce rtsad kyi gdung rgyud kha yar song ba'i rigs lce g.yu 'bum kyi sras lce btsun shes rab 'byung gnas kyis lo ston rngo rje dbang phyug ces pas mdo smad nas sdom pa blangs shing chos mang du zhus na/sa bod du byon pa'i nye gnas mdzad/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma la ngos 'dzin lugs —— 42 — ——

hri / mas ma pa rngo1nga ma rngo nga rma bya tha byung brten dpa/nga du sprus—/ nga 'i phye lo lo sbom dang lce nga1— /ma hūṃ/ba bsnyes lces thu rā bo/nga gi/ btsus/ /nga / ba/ pang ba mib/sa/// de rjas ྅ lu byung ngar brten jo je 'chang tshar pa chos/ rjes / la ba cam ljongs) bste na nga/ spu dzor kyi 3nga rba/ 'i sro/shā /dbye/da lo/ ston rin rdza/ ches gtsun/ la tsa/rngogang che na snang pas rngo//dzad /lce ma bcu ma/ sos/ sa/// lges /'a lu'i ma mgon rgyan bo//nga 1na /'eng lce/ btsum /shā / stson gyi ma/khan bung go ba ye/ 'es bo ༄ /nga drung la bsnye na nga ra zos/sa kung sna/ra rku sa/ra rnge rje ba/dan/ du 'jis/sa med byung gams sba sa par sde/ma4 nga/ ba/spu ra bzhes mdzang/ nga/ma ma/ mgon 'phags ru /pa jo rje ga/dan /pas chad nga 'i bu nga bon bor lce rdo rje gdan 'a—lu gas/ ra khang du grags pa bzhengs nga 'i rgyu ma / cha na gse/ra blungs/ kyi bas / / ma la bo/nga du byon ma/mu / ( re kun pa me/ kum/ la btsug 'a/sa/ kha/ nga ya gi su/sa bzhings/ dris par lo ston lci/sa bzhengs zer/ de ba'i na tsho nga 'dus kyi nga/bu rtse phrag// kha nas/ dris nga sa kyang ra na sngar ltar byung ba nas༄ / da rang gis/ bzhengs nga/ 'ig dbos snyam ste lce btsun gyis bdag lha khang 'ig bzhengs/ yar 'tshal bas nyid kyi mda' 'phangs pa gang slebs su brtsig pa lags zhus lan du de ltar bya zhes ga/sungs pa na lo ston mthu che bas yul thag ring zhig tu skebs dgos nas mda' nang gser gyes bkang ste phul ba 'phangs/ nga/ da lta'i dbu rtse rnying pa'i thad du dpal kha'i 'a lu zhig la thebs pas phun tshogs myu gu gsar pa bzhi/na du sde yar rgyas yong ba'i rten 'brel 'grig cing / mad/'a de dbus su bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la mda' 'bum du grags/ gong rga rgyu mtshan de dag la brten nas dpal zha lu gser bkang ngam yang yum chen mo'i lha khang gi lha thams cad la gser byugs pas gser khang yin yang zer// gang ltar rgyan gong bzhengs nas lo sum cu song ba me ———— 43 ———

chas rwa sde 'di snyeng brtsi bas pa'i/ dbu— rtse ra ma'i lho byang gnyis dang / ༅ra ma'i yu ma chem rdza /'i steng ra cha cho1ke be ma gon long byed sa bro /7nga rgyum/ /shā ma//ba/bu rtse lho zuXrngo rgyu rim po che bang spra ma sna tshogs 'a sa grub pa'i thugs/ je chem po'i sku tsho/ma(ri/ bzungs// de'i ྅/nga bstan nga / lta ra pyo sa/ra du pyom/ zos / jo bo kha ste pā ci'i ba/ khyang 'phabs sa/dan/ 5ngas shā /chu ngo tsa//nga tsa/'i 'gra/ma/ mas mi nyis /'gyur 'a sa che ba/'i ldan nas/ ris rga/sa/ 'a 'u 'i bar khur ba mgo/na po geng rga/ spru rwa / nga yi na // jo bo che'o pho ngang 'a/ ma ra rnge/ mdzad gdam drangs nas/ rab bams da zhus pa'i yum chem/ cho/'i spyan ma pa me tog chags / ma no phyos/sa kyi 'chad/ nyam kyang shin tu dar ngas chos rje thams cad ra/khyen/ pas mas na/ po gdan sa / pa la sa//dam/sa nga/4'a sa sa/tsus// las/ la/ nga 'di rdzo bo ma ti yi/ chen ngo/sa phyag phab 'go ba /ye shes ga/yung drung gis 'dul ba'i ba༅/da pa btsugs/ pa'i ṭi ta 'bum phras gsum pa dang sngos/ chem/ pos phyag phab bam/da grwa btsugs// /3dre khyung sa/nyis kyis chos gzhi byas pa ma/sa deng sang 'u/ bar du bshad grwa ma nyams pa'i grwa sa yin zhes pa dom/ la gnas par ma zad bstan pa phyi dar gyi sa/tsus/ lag/ khang dang 'dus sde chags pa'i thog ma lta bu yin pas drung chen rin po ches ta'i si tu byang chub rgyal rnga/tshan la phul ba'i chab shog tu/ bstan pa phyi dar gyi dus su sde 'di btab/ chos sde btsugs nas gtsug lag khang khyung mgo can brgya rtsa brgyad kyi ma mo yin/ gdan sa chen po snar thang lta bu'ang 'di pa'i ka chen gcig las gyes ba'i yal ga yin pas/ chos sde brgyud pa can gyi bdag po lags/ zhes ga/sungs/ jo bo chen po'i lung bstan dang mthun par mkhan brgyud gsum pa g.yu thog sgra gser bzang gi dus gtsang g.yas ru bye ma g.yu zur zhes pa'i gtsang 'gram du 'phags pa'i rdo sku dbu nyug tsam byas la — 44 la

bzhus//ma pa ma 'a/ —/ dro'i nu / bo'i 'u ga dzi dge/ bka/ma/ rngo rjes 'bum spi ra lu ba rga / lngob bos ra 6 /byed /'a gas ma shes/ bo/'i/ jo bo'i dbu /pa/ ba lnga ga pa da nga sa6 / sa tsher byed ci nga ngo 8 /sa spu /khrus / sa/zo /ra ba rdze bos mthong bar/ rten byed/ lngo/ da 1sa gang/na ma/ ba drongs par 3/sa gsu ma gso' / pa/ btob pas thugs rje'i shub//ca dkyes bye/nga du byon rnga sa rnga/ba/ na chem tham/sa cad ma bye/ ma 1༄ tshar chen gyi/ṭa rabamidāpatwa5 da/rwa /'ba'i — chu bo nga pe/'i (dgram/ / rin che na rku di/ sa/ brdza' /'dra/ ) rbang ya ngas spu// / rams/na po khyod sku dngos su byon pa'i tshe/ / mkha' 0 gros༄ rngond bstam mi la bzang rdzo bos1 rnyed/ / ba/sungs pa zom la bo/na/sa mi/nga ru/'a1 sa //'an du bda'o ma/ 'drongs par gam sa/ nu sa/tsang 'gram gyi lha mi/ma bang du gad mu / zangs/ de'i tshes 'a lu'i dge bshes brtso na 'grus kyis / rgyas 'breng bsdus gsum/ da/nga rtem/ brjes byus te ri phug tu bzhugs// 'o rgyus la lar stag/ gi rgya/ma mtsham gyi bus da// gnas nang gi/ lcag/sa ris sa sgo yan khrom pa ba/nyis rnams sna byams rjes / rgyan bo/nga la dmas brgyab mchong/ cha thams cad dang rdo rkye rang byom/ nga nga gdan drangs zer// chu /3/la 'khrugs pa'i dus rdza bo rku thabs kyis khyer ba ri phug ma'i nus pas gzhan du ma bgrod pa byang 'brog gi dzing du lus pa rig 'dzin chen po rat+na gling pa'i lung bstan chen mor/ zha lu'i jo bo chu mig la stod 'byon/ zhes pa'i dus rtags su snang / slar sku brnyan zha lur phebs pa gar bzhugs som nye'i tshe ma pang du bu bsdad chog ces gsung byon pas spyan ras gzigs kha rlu pā ṇi'i sbu mdun du bzhugs su gsol ba ni sa phyogs thams cad rang bzhen gyis 'phags pa'i skur lhun gyis grub pa dam tshig pa'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa'i rnam pa bzhugs par rten rdo rje 'chang tshar pa chos rjes/de lta'i dam tshig sems pa'i thugs ka'i dbus/ /ye shes sems dpa'i tshul du la 45 la

bzhus/sa/ nga/ rni// /gang sku stom gyi zla she//la ltar dka/ra 'ing / / nor bu chu she' ba'i/na du dngas/ kying tsa/ṭa༄ 'a / // 1/ rnga༄/da rngo/'i gnyen ltar 'od stong bza 'bar ba/ /bcu drus lang tsho sa/sar pa'i ma/ tshod can/ che//sa ngo ma/tshar ba'i bzags brjod mdzad/1 de lta ra rten brten nga/1/ 'dus sde/ bza/da spru ba kyi bstan nga dbyar mtsho ldar 'phel bar bkur bste rim gro ma/dzad ba'i sbyin bdab/ /lce'i gdung rabs rim nga/ra byon pa'i sbu 'ang ye shes kun dga'i lcam ma ga/cig mkha' 'gro 'bum 'gro ma/gon phyag na'i btsun mor byon pa ma/sa bzung /'jam dbyangs don yod rgya'/ mtshan dang dpa' ldan bla ma dam pa bso/da nams rgyal ma/tshan sbu/ mched bla chen kun rgya' ba yab sras sogs sa/dung rgyud khu dbon sku zhang na rim/ lnga'i bar sku nyer 'brel ba nas 'a lu sku 'ang du grags/phyag na'i sras bla ma dharma pā raka ta bo/nga du byon hor rgyal po ol ji du dang mjal dus bod/ na nged kyi 'ang po 'a lu khri dpon bya ba yod par lung las bzang po gnang dgos zhus pas// bla ma'i zhang po yin na nged kyi zhang po yin du chug la khri stong byengs pos phud du khur ba dang mi rabs kyi bar la khri/ gor 'jags su chug gsungs pa'i lung bzang po bstsal zhing / gong ma mchod yon gyi sku rim la dmigs nas rten gsum bzhengs pa'i thebs su gser bre brgyad dngul bre brgya'i gnang sbyin bstsal/ de yang yig tshang rnying pa las/de phyir sa skya'i dpon chen ni/ /zam glu gur ming dben hu yi/ /ming thob shākya bzang po de'i/ / deb ther shog dril can bzhin yin/ / khri skor de bas dbus gtsang gi/ /'ja' mo 'dzin lugs 'di ltar snang / /zhes khri skor bcu gsum gyi nang tshan/ tshong 'dus 'ja' chen zha lu pa'i steng du bya nog tshang ba'i dud/ lnga bcu rtsa bdun rgyab nas 'dzin/ zhes dbus gtsang so sor — — 46 ———

ji smo ra drus re'i dbus btsang be/ zu/tshams su nga/ra 'drob/ lbi skor ram / shā/ra 'bros ba/cang gre/ phyos/sa lces bsdu ba ji ltar yang bong du brtsa/da nga/'i 'a lu skru/ bror gyi bdag por gyur nga/she nas khri dpon ba 'a/na/ pa sa/ lhag pa gdung ga btsang ngo // 'a/sa 7/ ka ba'i// dam chos rgya gar ma 1/ sa spyo 'i spu 'ang / sbyin bdas/ rgyal ngo/ ste lnga sa che bar grags/ sa/yu/ thob/ sgra'i sra/sa lce 'bum/ nas sa//dung rus brgyad pa sku 'ang snga sgra'i sras rgyal chen rna/ma thos sras kyi sprul pa sku 'ang grags nga/ rgya'/ ma tshan gyis yo/ sbyol rnying pa la 'i/ga tsa/so sa lho nas shing cha drangs shing //rgya'i bza bo mkhas pa bkus/ ste rgya blubs sa// ru rtsi can sa/ser gyi /ga 'ji ra btsubs nga / che ba ba'i/ glo 'bur mig/ mangs ris su bres pa ga yu rtsi'i ba gam la na kam la sa/ser gyi 'gan 'ji ras brgyam nga// sa/ser khang rgya phibs gsu ma brtsigs/ ga'am/ rdzams nyis brtsis sa su yod pa/ brtan pa tshon sna/ brgya phrag gis bkra/ ba'i de bzhin sa/shegs pa'i sku gzugs bsam gyis mi khyab nga / gtsug lag kha/ nga nub ma gnyis kyi ga bo bo rang byon 'phags nga dang /rnam snang / lhor dus gsum sangs rgyas / byang du thub dbang / mi/ra du yum chen mo/ de'i 'os/ tu rgyal chen rnam thos sras kyi mgon khang dang bcas par 'khor gra/ngas kyis mi chod pas bskor ba rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa/gser gyi ba7//'a 'gyur sogs gsung rab rnams la mchod pa'i sprin/ phung phul du byung ba/ lcags ri'i khor yug gi nang du dge 'dun gyi gnas mal/ ra ba bzhi la mjod pa chen po bzhi btsugs 'ing / mdor na sku gsung thugs rten dang dge/ 'dun mchod pa'i gzhi rten/ mnga' 'bangs rnams bsdu ba rnam bzhis dbugs dbyung ba sogs chos rgyal mes dbon gyi rnam par thar pa la 'gran ba'in pa'i ngang nas da dung dge 'dun rgya mtsho lta bu la chos 'chad — — 47 — — —

— rter nga 'i gas bang ༄ ( — pas rdzogs sa/mang zhing 1 pa/za chem ‘pa nged ma/jos nga da dra sa/sa ma blud nga tsa/sum na 'tshom zla da/nga bral ba/'i chos rje /bla ma dam/ nga1 so gas /'kho/ na rigs 'jam dpal dpa' bo du ma / rgyas la spopo/ sems dang 'a chen po// sga / tshang rngo— ri ma chem zam rgyal/ gong gsum bde chen nga chos kyi dang/la ba / byung lhas/ nga gzu/ma/ nu bsod mam za // yo ba// pe dbom po bzang po sogs dbus btsang si/ dgo ba'i bshes gnyen gra/ngam med nga/ phel/ sngob tu gyur mas sde khyo da gsum / ngang rgyud snge bskru'i bshad sprub kyis sa/ngas/ can dang/'a/ mo'i khro ba yo ngas da su lce1 gnam gyis bskos pa/'i zu ngeng dang la phag rngo/ gru pa 6/ 'i si tu byang chu pab rgya'༄ mtshan sogs che rgu ma/tha/3 dag zhes rig//sa/ kyi cod pan du bskur// thus//sa sras lo tsā ba sos/sa da/ngos slo/ ba rnams la snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba ga/nyim pa shar tsong kha pa blo bzang pis/sa pa/'i dang rnal gyis rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang bka/'a man ngag/ ma tha' dag sa/san pas mtshon bu sto na/na tham sa cad ma byen pa'i 'phrin las ma dros pa'i ma tsho chem/ la sa rin/ med grub mtha'i chos rgyun chu bo rnam bzhi phyogs kun babs pas rgyang bstan/ yongs kyi phyi mo lta bur snang / de ma/sa mkham thog/ kha/ ya ra song mtshams nyid kyi bshad grwa rnams rim gyis 'gri/bas na'ang // ma/lo/ sa pa tsan+d+ra shrī/ shar chen ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje sogs 'brangs kyi mkham grub mkha' la rgyu ska/ra ltar rgyud sde ba'i 'i bshad sprub kyi rim pa ma nyams par gan/sa pa das/ rjes 'jus// 'du 'dzi dang le lo'i mal du 'byar ba du ma'i skyo na gyis dgun chu ltar nyag je phrar so nga mtsham sa chos rje thams cad mkhyen/ pa nyid sprul nga 'i zlos gar tshar chen chos rgyal po rda/nga / thams/ cad mkhyen pa mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug/ yab sras ba/nyis mkhan thog/ tu byon nas bstan pa'i me ro legs par sa/so bar mdzad la — 49 ——

1 rwa rdzu jem1 gī ma/bam thos mi che byon tshan mas /rwa 3 pa sgyuྈ ba ‘ za spyod rte/྅ da lo/ sto‘'i cha/ra rtsa5 4song pa ba che— che༈ ze jam / ra/co ma — sna sgyung ṭā//nga rje bka ma/'i spyo/'a
