4/chan ༷ rma྾ / dī// 'a khyab bdang / rdo zo sem mu/sgyu dang//'i ngo za rngo bam chen rim po che bas rā ma3da/sa1 ma pas ba sto/ba bstan/ ka che/ rkun pa/ ma cha zo ka —//pa — bzang rngod4sgyu rang—si stan/ zo 7bas ca‘ngang dbang pong yu /tsa—1 zom du sa rter ba ri/ mang pa za'i bcwa1cheX za spyo za/nga bye spru/sa kun ma lcen 'u) me1 —4(snye/ba/ma thus/ma — 3pa ba cas ma1 nga che spyo /ri mu/sa byed nga 'i tshom thar tshes mas pa/su nga snang pa / 2ba bad sa rngam sna nga da po jo/ rje sems da/ ngang ba rang sa/sa shā zla ba ma / bas rba/rngo༄ ri1༈ ri ra nga‘hūṃ po rngo /ka'i4sa/sa yum ngh+ru ma/ba1tsā rnga re/ ⑩su zu / dud pa/ra ba/ ce drwa3 — nga / pa mas brgyu‘nga/ de slob dpo na chen ngo/ kun bas bde bye /nga ngo / )da dang nga btsad bsna 3'a tsadam pas ngas/ zu 'u sa pa spru' (4'i spyor/ ra chos/ lo cwa ba rem chen/ bzang ngo ju bsgyur cing / pa'i pa chad/ nyan kyis sa/tam ma pha/ba nga/'i sto da lus ma ma4/da da / bas5/ hūṃ ba'i da rngo/ spo kuku mkhyen 'a bsas 'ong yon kan rgya ma/tsho'i bar1 dā ba'i / zu chab/ nga rwa4 bya‘ thams cad ma bye/na nga bu sto/na rin chen grub /ra bam(sna babs / 'ing dpa'/ lngar bla ma dam pa kun/ mkhyem 'phas/sa nga/ yo/na tan kyi ma/tsho'i ba/su nga gis/ nga'i rnal 'byor rgyud kyi phyag len dri ma meng pha 'di bla ma/ brgyud/ pa ga tho/na so dkar nas/ za/na skra dka/ra spi bar du rnal 'byor rgyud slo/ra la sbyangs nga/'i mabs pa'i 'dig len yin/ tshas kyi rnam grangs ga/sog pa'i lung thob re tsam/ byas na/sa brgyud pa'i phyag/ len bzang po chud gzon pa'i lag/ len bla chos la sa/tong ba'i sa/dus/ pa'i slob dpon gyi la ga lem gyis chud ma gzon/ ka yin/ pas khyed kyis kya/nga brgyud pa'i gdams ngag/ chud ma gzon par mgo thon cig gsungs pa bzhin du thugs la bzhag nas yig 'jog dang dbang bshad gdams ngag bris thig/ gar/ dbyangs/ ——— 50 ———

sogs tsa/ngas cam gyi ljongs su dar bar mdzad pa slar yang dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin nas thugs rje'i byim/ rlabs 'phrul bo che las/ mkhyen rab rin po che byon te rtse mo'i sgrub mchod gas/ra 'dzugs sogs nyams gsos cher mdzad nga sa rnam thar du/ nga dab/'a ldan nas bu ston thams cad mkhyen nga/sa /3 lur rnal 'byor rgyud/ kyi bstan pa spel ba la btang ba yin kyang 'a lu ba rnams kyis byed dpag/sa kyi phan thos/sa chen ngo/ ma byung bas tshos rje'i drung du 'gro ba la ngo sa/gong ba yod gsungs pa dang / rdo rje 'chang bka' 'gyur bas/rna/la 'byor rgyud 'di phyag len dag/'a la dkon pa 'dug pas dar 'i/nga rgyas nga/ zhig byung ma/ bsams gong dkar chos sder yo sa/ sprub mtshad nyin gcig spar thub1/ da 'a lur rnal 'byor rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor bcu gsum nga sgo ba'i 'i phyag len gar dbyangs rgyas pa zhig tshugs la re yin zhes pas mtshon 'phags bod rgyud pa'i dam pa rim byom/ gyi bzhid pa skong zhi/nga rje nyid kyi bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan khu dbon/ e waṃ sprub khang pa dpal ldan don grub ga/sum gyi zag med chos kyi dbyings su dgongs pa khyad/ par can rdzogs pa rje btsun bla ma nyid kyis lam gyi yon tan bogs 'don thub bstan spyi bye brag dang / khyad par nged rang gi rim gro sogs la dgo/ngas pa gtad de lo lo bzhin rgyal bas cho 'phrul bstan pa'i gnyan yod mchod pa'i dus chen gyi thog dpal ldan rnal 'byor rgyud kyi rtsa bsha/da cha mthun 'phros pa yan lag gi rgyud dang bcas nga/'i dkyil 'khor chen ngo bcu gsum/ dang/la rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs thun mong ma yin/ pa lha bcu gsum/ bstan pa rgyas ba'i rten 'brel du thub dbang ga/nas bcur bcas pa'i phyag mchod rnams kyi sgrub mchod rnams ga/sar 'dzugs kyis ris gsar —— 51 ——

spyor dgos pa'i rten du bka shis kha btags/ dngu' gyi rnam/ rgyal mjod rten/ jus/ lu hi'i gos ber nang ldan/ kha thi dmar ser/ gos rgyan sa//zhi sngo dmar/ gos lu hi yus/ rnams spus legs maṇ+ḍal/ mdong mo/ lnga bcu ma/ sos/sa khyo/ ma bsdoms dngul srang sum brgya lhag bcas/ rta lnga / dre'u gnyis/ ka ras yus/// gnyis kyi gnang cha dang bcas thugs rtsol chen ngo 'i bka' nan dang / sa/'an yang chos rje thams cang mkhyen pas chos kyi 'khor lo rgya chen bslor ba'i ri phug chos khri/ thang ma/'i steng du sa/ser thog 'bubs dgos tshul phebs pa bod yul kyi/ chos sde spyi 'gre las 'a lu pa'i bla grwa ga/nga gi go yul bzung ba'i /khral babs kyi 'bur nod dgos pa med na'ang // dpal ldam bla ma/༷dam pa'i bzhed ba sgrub nga dang rnal 'byor rgyur/ kyi bstan pa la bas mas/ nas mchong/ thebs dar rgyas chu btags kyis ga bos ga'i sa ma lag/ ba'i mi ser bsdad gro/nga /srel rkang bcu bdun/ drug/ zur gcig rdo thab pa sa/nyis kyi yo/nga dngab/ sa/'is thon sbrag/sa pa'i 'bru rkang thog sha mar ra lug la bo/nga brgyab bcas khyon mar khal stong phrag gnyis dang nyis brgya rtswa shing gi bdag thob gang yod dang // sa/zhis rtse nas bzang ja dang mi shan phred 'dres mkhar rgya'i dmar 'degs khal sum hru lhag bcas/ bu ram khal bcu zams gtong deb la 'khod pa'i spyor 'jags 'byed khra zur gsal ba'in zhu ba'i lo star chags su chad med dgos nga/'i blang dang dor bya'i bca' yig gi rim pa la/ gnas bcu ma gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu bzhi po rdza/mas phyas/ chen/ thig le las/ dbang med na ni dngos grub med/ / bye ma btsir yang mar med bzhin/ /gang zhig rgyud lung nga rgyal gyis/ /da/bang bsku ra med par 'chang byed pa/ /slob dpon slob ma 'i ma thag / dngos grub thob kyang —— 52 —— —

dmyal bar skye// /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ / bla ma la ni dbang nod zhu/ / 'es smin rung du ma byas nga/ra gsang sngag/sa byung rgya'1 du spyad pa nyes dmigs thin tu che zhing // sa/sang ba'i mdzod las/ dbang bskur yang dag sbyim ldam/ na/ / skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur/ // de yis skye ba bdun na mi/ // ma bsgoms nga ra yang sangs rgyas 'gyur/ / zhes dbang thob pa'i pham yon rgyud sde rnams su rgya cher bsnga sa/sa bste/ra yin 'a / dbang de yang slob dpom la legs par blto sa dgos kyi/ tsa/'an gyis ni ma yin te / 'jam nga/pa' sgyu 'phrul dra bar/ slob dngo na med par gyur na rbo/ 1 dngos grub 'thob par mi 'gyur bas / / slob nga/pon mtshan nyid bka/da/ par byu/ //zhes dang / rdo rje 'byung bar/slob dngo na la 'i dbang bskur 'thob// /ces gsungs// dbang yang rtsa ba༅/da sogs/ la slob ma 'i dbang dang slob dngo/na gyi dbang gnyis car thob dgos nga sa / chos grwa chen ngo / 'di sa/'i mkham slob zur 'a pa chad dang hor khongs byung ba rnams bo/nga dkar rdo rje gdan/ e 1shā/ chos ldan/ bkra shis chos sde sogs rgyud khungs gcig/ pa rnams na/sa dbang les/sa par nod rjes // mkhas pa'i dbang po dpang lo tsā ba chen pos/ rgyal ba'i sras kyi shes bya thams cad la/ / bslab par tsa/su/nga phyir ji snyed ma khyen nga yi/ // ye shes rgyu ru 'gyur bas shes ldan za/mas/ / byang chub don/ gnyer bas ma pas 'di blangs ris/sa// /zhes bla na med nga/'i byang chub kyi rgyu ru 'gyur ba'i sems kyi/sa kun nas blangs rte shes bya'i gnas sa/nga la'ang bslab rigs par gsungs na/ gsang chen rdo rje theg/ pa'i mngon dkyi'// sbyim/ sres/ sa/ra this/ dbyangs gsum// phyag len che phra mtha' das la zhib mor dpyad/ de thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nga sa bstan pa rin po che'i sa/sal byed ——— 53 ——

du 'gyur ba ma zad/ rang nyid ring por mi thogs par ye shes lnga lngan/ khyab bdag/ rdo rje sems dpa'i snyu mngon du byed pa'i dgos pa khyad par can rngo da pa'i phyir na 'og/ tu ga/sal ba rnams khong du chud par byas te bstar dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang dpal rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil chos/ bu ston rgam/sa cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rin chen bsam 'phel la mkhyen rab chos rje'i phyas/ len ji lta ba chos rje dbon rgya' bas zin bris su ma/dzad pa bzhin/ khrus kyi skabs su nang 'khrus// gsang khrus// rnal 'byor gyi khrus/ phyi'i khrus ba'i ste/ba༅/da rgyud rdo rje rtse mo'i rgyud las/ nyin re bzhin ni ci nus nga/ra/ / khrus ba'i dag/ ni rab tu bya/ / rnal 'byor ji ltar khrus bya ba/ // bo/ rim bzhin du rab tu bshad/ /sdom pa gsu ma la rab tu gnas/ ///dang po'i khru/ sa su brjod pa yin/ / gnyis pa rgyud las gsungs ba yi// / bshas/sa dang gso/la ba 'debs la sos/sa/ / phyag rgya bcing ba sa/sum nga/ ste/ / ba'i pa chu ste tha ma yin/ /rkye/sa sa//sungs pa'i sdom pa sa/sur / ni bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mor/ brtan pa ma thob bar du yang / / kha na ma tho rdul med cing / / sdom pa gsum la gnas par bya/ // so sor thar dang byang chub sems// / rig 'dzin nang gi sdom pa'o/ / zhes gsungs pas thos/ mar sdom gsum rnam par dag/ pa la sa/nas pa gal che zhing / de/sa nyam/sa su len rgyu'i cho sa/'i rim pa la cho sa/phyag len/ gar dbyangs/ sgo ba'i 'i cho ga rgyas pa gong ma'i phyas/ len chu bzas ma/ thus/sa sras lo tsā bas sku zhang nam mkha'i mtshan can la rdor dbyings kyi dbang gi/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i rjes sa/nang gi tshe/ bu ston rin po che'i dbang rdzas rnams gnang sbyin du bstsal/ nga'i rnal 'byor rgyud skor gyi bstan pa khyad brgyud pa dang bcas par gtad pa yin pas ma nyams ———— 64 ——

bgyis shig gsungs pa ltar dge 'phel chos rdzong du sgrub mchod sgo bzhi'i phyag len chos spyong chen po'i bstod ring sogs chag med du tshugs pa'i rgyun sku 'ang mchog legs rnam rgyal/ mkhas pa'i dbang po tsan+d+ra shrī/ slob dpon rin chen dpal grub/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje'i sku tshe'i stod kyi bar du yod pa/ dus 'gyur gyis ri phug bla brang shar chen du tshugs pa sbu 'ang chos rje phun tshogs/ sku zhang bsod nams mchog grub/ sku 'ang rin chen bkra shis bsod nams rgyal mtshan yan la dar rgyas su byung ba/ sku zhang nam mkha' chos ldan pa/ chos rje ka bzhi ba'i slob ma phyag chen pa'i har spyod kyi rnam pas do dam ma mdzad par chag ste nyag phra bar gyur pa 'phags pa'i yul du stod 'grel ba'i lugs ltar sid la zhes pa phyogs 'dir dmar ser can du grags shing 'jam dbyangs gong ma'i khab tu ting zi zhes rab byung bcu gcig pa'i me mo sbrul gyi lo chu shel gyi dbang po rta chen gyis nya pa'i tshes gcig la thog ma'i sngon 'gror slob dpon chen po bharnya kā ra lba rmas mdzad pa'i cha gsum gyi cho ga gsal byed yo ga ba chen po mkhas grub sangs rgyas tshe dpal gyis mdzad pa bzhin dbyangs nol dang bcas rgyas par sgrub pa nas brtsams te bkra shis kyi bar sgo bzhi'i cho ga'i phyag len zur gsal ltar dang / de bzhin du rdor dbyings 'grel lugs dbang chog rgyas pa'i kha skong kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa la byang gling chos rje'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ dum bu gnyis pa khams gsun rnam rgyal gyi dkyil chog chos rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad par 'jam dbyangs byang gling rje'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ bshad rgyud rdo rje rtse mo rigs bsdus kyi dkyil chog bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog la mkhyen rab rin po che'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ cha mthun gyi rgyud rdo rje la 55 la

'chang gi rigs dpal mchog rdo rje sems pa'i dkyil tshag thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston rjes mdzad par byang gling rje'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ dpal mchog rigs bsdus kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i dkyil chog gi dgongs don ji lta ba shar chen ye shes rgya mtshos legs/ par bkral ba la thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje gdan pa'i gsung mchan gyis brgyan pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin/ thog mar cha gsum/ bum ba 'bul ba/ sgo dbye ba/ phyogs gtor rgyas pa yan las/ gi rgyud chos dbyings gsung dbang gi dkyil tshag mkhas pa'i dga' ston dang bstod chen kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa la/ thig rtsa/ phyag rgya 'ching tshul/dkyil 'khor 'dri tshul/ cho ga'i lhan thabs rnams byang gling 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis mdzad pa sbyar ba/ 'jam dpal gsang ldan mkhas grub khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'am/ shangs pa dge bsnyen yong grags rgyal pos mdzad pa gang rung la/ mkhyen rab rje'i 'al slob dbang ldan chos 'khor ba dge/// 'dun dpal bzang gi lhan thabs sbyar ba/'jam dpal rigs bsdus rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin/ rtsa rgyud dum bu gnyis pa'i ngan 'gro dgug cing sdig pa dbral ba'i skabs nas 'phros pa'i tshul du gsungs pa'i rgyud kun rig rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dkyil chog kun mkhyen bus mdzad par 'jam dbyangs chos legs dpal dar bzang po'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ shākya seng ge gtsug gtor dgu pa'i dkyil chog bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa la byang gling pa rin chen bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis lhan thabs sbyar ba/ rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa yo gar bkral ba'i dkyil chog thams cad mkhyen pa bus mdzad par chos rje dbon rgyal ba'i lhan thabs sbyar ba/ phyag na rdo rje 'chi bdag 'joms pa'i ——— 56 ——

dkyil tshag 'chi med grub pa bu ston rin po ches mdzad par khyab bdag mkhan rin po che bsod na/mas mchog grub kyis re gzigs sbyar ba/ shar du sher phyin/ lhor sdong po bkod pa/ nub tu gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa/byang du gser 'od dam pa sde ba'i 'i gsung sgrogs/ sa tshag bu ston yab sras dus kyi phyag len ltar dbus kyi khro bo sprob rdor dbyengs rtsa lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ shar sgo ba rtse mo'i rdo rje slob dpon/ lho sgo ba rdor dbyings 'grel lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ nub sgo ba dpal mtshag rigs bsdus kyi rdo rje slob dpon/ byang sgo ba shākya seng ge ga/tsug tor dgu pa'i rdo rje slob dpon te lnga/ dkyil 'khor zhal 'byed skabs rdor dbyengs rtsa lugs kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyis bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho gar chos 'khor ba dge 'dun dpal bzang gis gsal byed lhan thabs sbyar ba la/ cha lugs/ 'dug stangs/ phyag rgya thab/ sreg rdzas/ mchod rdzas rnams bshad tshod bzhin/ grangs rdzun med pa'i sreg rdzas/ thab nang gzhal yas khang rdor dbyengs dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs spyan drangs par grwa tshang bzhi ga nas gan pa gzab mchor gyi rdor dbyengs mchod gar tshas rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gar yig la mkhas pa zla ba dpal rin gyi gsal byed slob rgyun gyi phyag len re gzigs mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang rin chen bsod nams mchog grub kyis mdzad pa bzhin rgyas pa slar kun rig sham bha ta'i gar las bzhi'i rnga brdung dang bcas pa chad par nye 'dug pas bu ston rin po che'i gsung rab la bslab rgyun sbyar nas ma chad tsam 'di bstan rgyun la bsams nas mkhan slob sne mo ba rnams kyis rgyas par gso ba'i khur bzhes/ rdul tshon chu bor gdan 'dren skabs kun mkhyen bus mdzad pa'i klu chog bzhin —— 57 ——

spyan 'dren byin rlabs kyi rgyun brtan pa'i phyir bsangs gtor sogs rdor dbyings rtsa lugs kyi slob dpon pa/ shis brjod kyi dus bkra shis kyi rim pa spyi 'gre la rdor dbyings kyi bkra shis mchod phreng nas byung ba/ bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i rtse mo'i bkra shis dang / dpa' mchog gi chos dang bkra shis 'phel byed bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa/ de thams cad la rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa'i dkyil chog so so la rgyud pa'i gsung rgyun ma nyams pa'i kha skong sbyar te/ slob dpon mkhas pa'i mdzub khrid steng nas byang zhing chub pa/ bu ston rin po ches mdzad pa'i yog ṭīka yid bzhin nor bu la mkhas pa tsan+d+ra shrī'i bshad sbyar bslan pa gtso bor bton/ gzhan yang thams cad mkhyen pa bus mdzud pa'i yo ga'i phyogs kyi gsung rab sru phyi rnams dang / de dag gi dgongs don gsal byed khyung po lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams sogs dngos slob rnams kyis mdzad pa dang /de rjes mkhas mchog tsan+d+ra shrī/ thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab chos rje/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal sogs kyis gsungs pa'i legs bshad las byung ba ltar cho ga'i tshig don/phyag rgya'i 'ching tshul/ 'ching mtshams sogs khong du chud nas mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len bzang po khyad du mi gsod par legs par brtags te mi shes pas dang gar sbyar ba'i 'khrul pa rnams ring du bor/ khyad par phyag rgya/bris thig gar dbyangs rnams dpe bltas pa tsam gyis mi shes pas slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag la gus pas mnyan te mkhas pa tsa zas mdzad pa'i bris thig gar dbyangs sogs kyi bstan bcos las byung ba ltar phyag len du thebs pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi mngon dkyil —— 58 ————

mthu stobs kyi dbang phyug rwa chen/ lo cwa bzhe/ mdzad par tshar chen rdo rje 'chang gi lhan thabs dang thams cad mkhyen nga mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug gis mdzad pa'i tshob/ sgrig sbyar ba/ tshar chen yab sras kyis mdzad pa'i/ rgyud 'debs 'a/ma rim gyi skron lam dang bkra shis/ 'a /sa sa/shin gyi bsrang gso dbyangs rol sogs tshar lugs kyi phyag len ga'am 'dres ped pa // 'phab/sa pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug rga mtshad/ tshag/ rje bla mas bas/'a gnang ba bzhin nged rang gi/sa rang bzo spangs rte yig rnying rnams las btus pa rgyas bstan 'dzad med nor bu rnams/ sgrub mchod grol ba'i sang nyin bzlog chen bzhi'i cho ga rgyas par bstar ba la sgrub mchod tshugs pa nas ma grol bar dpon slob bzhis gdugs dkar gyi cho ga/ rgya gar gyi slob dpon chen po tsan+d+ra go mi'i gsung rab kyi dgongs don 'khrul med so'i sprags 'chang chen po shākya dpal bas grub pa'i rtags mngon sum du bstan pa'i chog sgrig dang / 'jam dbyangs chos legs dpal dar bzang pos mdzad pa'i bdag mdun gyi steng nas zor rnams nus ldan du sgrub pa/ bstod res kyi rnam sras drag gtor/ gshed dmar drug cu pa chos rje thams cad mkhyen pa'i gsung rab ltar rgyud sde 'dzin pa chos rig rgyal mtshan gyis legs par bkral ba/ kha 'bar ma la lngags rnying ma'i nad bdag kha bsgyud gyi kha nang du me spar zhing rdzongs kyis bskul sogs byung ba dag gsar ma ba mi mkhas pa 'dras ming tsam la 'khrul nas sbyar ba sogs kyi lhad dang bral ba ba ri lo tsā ba'i dgongs don slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mos mdzad pa'i chog sgrig la gsal byed sngags 'chang shākya dpal ba'am rje chos legs dpal dar gyis sbyar ba gang rung /de ltar bzlog chen bzhi'i gtor rgyag skabs rnam sras kyi las bzhi'i rnga brdung —— 59 la

rnga 'gros spro ba gsum gyi 'chams dang bcas rgyas nga / gtor rgyag byas nga 'i sang nyin rdor dbyengs ba sogs kyis ma khyen rab chos rje'i phyag len bzhin gtor 'bul rgyas pa dang bstun/ gdugs dkar ba rnams kyis rgyas mtshan 'dzub/sa pa'i cho ga sgrub mchod la gegs sel gyi sku rim du dpon slob gsum/ res ma grol ring snga dro gzungs gra lnga'i sgrub mchod dang / dgong mo chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gso// gnas brtan phyag ma chod pa rnams kyis rje bla ma'i dgongs pa bzhin 'di ga'i ring 'tshor dmigs pa'i snga dro tshe chog rnams mdzad / thams cad kyis tshogs mnyam dang dbyes mnyam ngos tshogs 'phral thun mo nga du rdor dbyings/ rtsa lugs kyi dbu mdzad chen/ mos gnas lnga rig/ pa'i paṇa chen bu stom/ rin po che'i sku bstod gang rigs/ thugs sras lo tsā ba'i rnam thar gsol 'debs gsung rab ma/ sngon du btang nas zha lur bam/'a drin che ba'i bla ma rnams kyi 'di ga nas gsar rtsom dang nged rang gi/ ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad rnams gsung / sngags sde dgon ka/ra nub gnyis kyis bka' brgyad bder 'dus kyi khro rol dang 'brel ba'i sgrub pa byed/mchod rdzas dang dge 'dun gyi rnyed bkur rnams gtong deb gzhung gi dam 'byar nang bzhin chad 'khum med par gtong / ja ma las byed ma gtogs tshogs bzhugs ma yin par drag 'an su la'ang skal ba mi gtong thams cad kyis dam tshig dang sdom par gnas pa gtso bor 'don/ kun gyis bsnyen pa song na rab de min chog dpon gyis bsnyen pa nges par song ba/ cho ga phyag rgya dang bcas pa rgyugs ma 'phrod na tshogs su mi 'jug cing de rigs la ngo chen ngan skyob kyi rigs gtan nas mi byed/ tshogs la rang nang khom gyi res 'jog byas nas cho ga cha lag mi tshang ba dang na ba sogs khams kyis mi lhogs la 60 —

nges min par brel ba yod pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas chos khrims par gnang ba zhu ba dang / dbang shed kyi ras spyod sogs mig bltos gshas rkyen du 'gro ba drag zhan sus kyang mi byed gong gsal gyi rgyab gnyer dgos pa gzhis rtse rdzong sdod sbrel pos gyis/ bstan 'gro spyi'i bde skyed dang bye brag shes bya thams cad gzigs nga / bu stso/na rin po che yab sras kyi ring lug/sa ma pham mgon po dbus 'gyur 'chang du ma byon de srid bar du dar rgyas dang rang ga 'a/na gyi 'di dang gtan gyi 'dun ma la bsams nas khral 'jal tsam du ma song ba'i blo dang brtson pa'i nus pa ci yod kyis 'bad/ par rig/sa so/ nam mkha'i mtha' snyed lus can kun gyi bstan bde'i srog tu nyer so/nga ba/ / khyab bdag rnam snang rdo rje sems dpa'i mi zad rgyan 'khor bdud rtsi'i thigs/ rgya bod mkhas grub rim byon zhal lung chu gter che las slar 'don pa'i/ /rin chen bsod nams mchog tu grub khyod sngon med legs bris yongs kyi gtso/ / lugs ga/zhan/ ma 'dres 'jam dbyangs rwa chen gyi/ / phyag bzhes dus dgra'i dbang po ma he'i 'al/ / bcu gsum 'khor lo'i gsal byed tshar lugs zhes/ /'khrul rnyog dwangs mtshor dngos grub gzugs kun 'char/ / spang rtogs srang la byin rlabs bdog pa yis/ / lci dang yang ped sangs rgyas spyi srol kyang / /snyigs dus bstan pa'i srog tu thugs rje'i shugs/ /cher lhag gnas brtan bcu drug grags snyan dkar/ / phyis dar 'dus sde'i thog ma gser bkang zhes/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtsho 'phel ba'i mdzes rgyan du/ /ma pham bu ston yab sras ring lugs ding / / ches cher rgyas pa dpal ldan zha lu nu/ / bgrang yas rgyud sde yid bzhin rin chen mdzod/ / phul byung bsod nams zhing sa gshin po na/ / lha sngags ye shes mchog tu nyer sgrub pas/ /— 61 —

dngos grub rnam ga/nyis snye ma sa/yur za res/ / ngo ma/tshar bkod pa bye ba'i cho /'phrul che/ / nyi ma'i gnyen/ gyis legs bstan rta chen zlar// // sras bcas rgyal bar kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin/ / nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar slar phye 'bras/ / 'khor ba tshang tshing klung du las nyon gyi/ /gcan tsa/zan ga/dug pas rab gces ma rgan tshogs/ / thar pa'i rin chen gleng 'khrid sa mkhan che// 1/ bstan dang de 'dzin bshes gnyen tshogs 'phel zhi/nga / / sgra bsgyur 'jig rten mig gcig bu ston rje/ /rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i bzhed gzhung ga bor gyur pa// /legs bshad dbyangs kyi pi wang rgyud mang sgra/ /phyogs bral lus phra'i rna bar sban par shog /byang chen de srid bskrun kyang gzhal dka' ba/ /drim/ can rtsa ba'i bla ma rnam gsum gyi/ / dgongs pa bde chen chos dbyengs klong rdzogs nas/ / yol med thugs rje'i spyan gyis rtag gzigs shog/ tshe dbang lhun/ grub rab tu brtan pa yi/ / sa lam yon tan zla ba'i ma ma ru/ /bskyed rdzogs nyams rtogs ma nub dbang bzhi'i chu/ yongs babs nyung 'jug srid rtser phyur bar shos/ 'phrog byed kyis btegs sra brtan rdo rje'i khrir/ / mgon khyod zhabs zung bskal brgyar bkod byas te/ / nges gsang jeg mchog chos 'khor dal bzang gi/ / gdul byar bskor ba'i re 'bras lhun grub shog/ bstan 'gro'i don por dgongs bzhed tshul bzhin du/ /legs legs ldan ser chen rnam mang thos sras/ /las kyi gshin rje rdo rje rab brtan sogs/ / chos srung rgya mtshos 'phrin las lhun grub mdzod/ / gnam lo thog mar tshes pa yar gyi ngo/ /gza' skar dus spyor dge ba'i 'phrod bzang nas/ /bgrang yas dkyil 'khor mchod cing nyer bsgrubs pa'i/ /bkra shis 'jig rten kun tu khyab par shog ces chos sde chen po zha lu'i sgrub mchod bco — 62 —

lnga sa/sar tshus//sa kyi/ bca' yi/sa/ shel dkar me long 'di ni khya/ ba bdas/ bla ma dam pa rin chen bsod nams mchos/ grub kyis bka' bstsal ba dang du blangs te za hor gyi btsun pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sdes 'phags yul ba ā na la zhes pa phyogs 'dir mer grags 'ing / yi/ra phyogs rgyal khab tu ping shin du 'bod pa me pho 'brug gi lo/ legs sbyar gyi skad du lnga za shī ra zhes mgos nya ba'i zla ba/ rgya nag ba thi/ dbye zhes pa hor zla bcu ga/cig pa/ dus 'khor ba'i snyeng stobs kyi mun pa 'jug pa 'bring po'i dam/ra cha/ yon tan gyi dbyangs au/ gsal byed bskyed rim dang mthun nga/ 7// da/byangs yī/ ga/sal byed dza/ na tshod gzhon nu/ khams chu/ 'dod yon ro/ grub pa'i mtha'i nyi ma dbo// byed rtsis pa'i chu tshod kyi me bzhis skebs pa'i 'grub sbyor/ tan la bum pa'i dus spyor la rdzogs ldan gyi rnam bar thar pa bzhi'i sgo bye ba pho brang dmar po'i rir sbyar ba'i yi ge/ pa ni dpal grong sngags rams pa ngag dbang dge legs kyis bgyis pa dzam nu/ / / /

twaXla'i blaXm sbu grengaXbadun pas rnam rgyalaXgrwa tshang la bstsal ba'i bca' yig gsen gyi gnya' shing zhesaXbya ba bzhugasaXso/me rta lo/ (spyoXlo 172 6)thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mngon mtho'i yal ga la 'khyud nges legs kyi/ /me tog byang chub chen po'i 'dzum grol ba/ /ci 'dod ster ba'i dpag bsam bdag cag gi/ / skyob pa lha yi bla ma rgyal gyur cig / blo bzang rgyal ba gang be/ mdo dang lngags/ /zab rgyas mu tig do shal mgrin par 'chang / / don ldan grags pa'i sgra dbyangs 'dzam gling 'dir/ / yongs khyab 'jam dpal snyeng pos dge legs stsol/ / gzi byen stong du 'bar ba'i cod pan gyis/ / gsang sngags 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal tshab tu/ /mngon par dbang bskur rim gnyis grub pa'i gtso/ / shes rab seng ge mi yi nyi ma rgyal/ / thabs shes zung 'jug shugs drag rlung gi mthus/ / bdud dpung ga 'a/na sde bsdig pa'i zhugs chen po/ / rab 'bar dbus 'gyid dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ / 'jigs mdzad dpa' bo mchog gis rtag tu srungs/ / pad ma dkar po bzhad pa'i dri gzhon la/ /bung ba bzhin 'dus — 64 —

khrims lnga/na dge 'dum sde/ /blo gsal phyogs las nom par rgyal ba'i gar/ /khri/ mas su bca' ba'i/ yi/ ge deng 'dir spel/ / zhes yul khya/ da par can la bstod phyag gi me tog mngon par 'thor bas sngun bsus rte slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas/ sla ra yang mi g.yo'i sku mnga' khyod kyis srid gsum byon nas sprul rnam sa kyis/ / gshegs pa dang ni bltams dang byang chub 'i/ ba'i 'khor lo'ang ston par mdzad// // de ltar khyed kyis 'jig rten g.yo bag spyod can/ re ba'i 'a/gas pa ni/ / ma/nga pos bcings pa ma lus thugs rjes spru ngan 'das par bkra bar mdzod/ / ces gsungs pa ltar 'o sko/la gyi ston pa shākya seng ges 'jig rten ma rig pa'i zhags pas bcings pa'i /'gro ba mtha' dag rnam par gro'/ ba dang yongs su grol ba'i sa la 'god pa'i slad du ga/zhal du med pa'i dka' ba sprud de sa bcu lam lnga rim gyis bgrod nas 'jigs bral 'og min stug po bkod pa'i zhing du shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa rnam par spangs nas 'bras bu nges pa lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgyas te slar yang 'dod pa khams su mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis 'dul ba'i dus la 'bab pa na/ dga' ldan gyi dam pa tog dkar po dran bzhi/na shes bzhin du rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i rigs su sku bltams/ rgyal srid sbangs te dka' ba spyad pa dang bdud 'dul ba dang mngon par byang chub pa sogs kyi tshul bstan te gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal ji lta ba bzhin du chos phung ji snyed cig bka' bstsal ba rnams kyi snying po 'dul ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dngos dang ston pa'i 'ang go chod pa 'dul ba la bstod pa las/ rgyal ba ston pa de yis bstan bcos dag/ /mdo dang chos mngon yin gsungs 'dul ba ni/ /ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yi phyir/ /nyis — 65 —

'gyur phyag bya sangs rgyas chos gcig bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/de lta bu'i 'dul ba'i bstan pa ni dge /7dun tshul khrims ldan pa dag yod na yod kyi med na mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun rnams tshul khrims yang dag pa'i bcas mtshams las mi 'ad 'a zhing / chos spyod rnam bcu'i bya ba 'a brtson dgos pas da lam las dang smon lam gyis nye bar brlan pa'i rgyu las nged mdo sgad kyi sa'i char lang tsho'i pad ma rnam par ba 'ad pa la sa/nam bskos 'jam dbyangs mi'i nyi ma'i brtse ba'i 'od zer gyis bskyangs te sbu 'bum bslab pa gsum gyi spos chu'i dzing bur skyid bsrings pa sogs kyi tshe grags pa'i dri bsung gi nye ba bos nas/ gdan sa chen ngo/ se /'bras/ dge gsum gyi grwa rigs mos pa dang ldan pa du mas mtshon pa'i blo gsal dge 'dun bung ba'i tshogs 'dus ba rnams kha phyi blta dang grod pa nang blta'i dpe dang mi mtshungs pa yin gshis mig brgyangs dgos gras la rang gi gam du bcar ba'i grwa tshang du gzengs bstod pa ji skad du/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong / / nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar phyi so so thar pa'i tshul khrims kyis bcun zhing / nang sngags bla med la thos pa dang bsam bsgom gyis 'bras bu mi bskyod rdo rje skad cig nyid la thob par nus pa'i grol ba don gnyer can rnam rgyal grwa tshang 'dus tshogs kyi spang blang khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa la/de yang grwa tshang 'dir rtsa byed mi'i rigs na tshod lo bco lnga ma lon phyin 'jug sa med cing / rab tu byung 'os 'gal rkyen med cing mthun rkyen tshang ba dag dge tshul slong gi bslab tshig snga phyi sogs skabs babs kyis bsgrubs nas zhugs/ dgon sde gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i tshul khrims 'chal rigs 'jug sa med de/ rnam 'byed las/ lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag / zos pa la 66 —

gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ / tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ / yul 'khor bsod snyoms za ba min/ / zhes tshul 'chal dang bslab sdom la bag med pa'i rigs dge 'dun gyi dkor la spyod pa/ rang nyid 'phung tshabs shin tu che zhing /dge 'dun gzhan rnams kyang sbags nas sbal pa rma can bzhin 'gyur bar gsungs pas rab tu byung nas tshul khrims dag pa dang bag yod pa gal che/gzhan yang phyogs gzhan nas rab tu byung rigs nyes can gnas nas bskrad pa dang / mi skye ba'i bar chad dang gnas pa'i bar chad can dang srung mtshams mi zin pa sos/sa mi zhugs/ dge tshul rnams la yo byad bla gos/mthang gos/ 'ding ba/ lhung bzed/ shog li sogs dang / dge slong la chos gos rnam gsum gyis dbus dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i gos yo byad rnams spyir btang yul dus dang bstun pa'i rgyu sogs bzang ngan mtha' gnyis spangs pa dgos rung / gam bcar grwa tshang gi grwa pa gos chas bzang 'khyor gyon srol bcas/ bzang rigs las ngan hrul gyon sa med cing gyon pa byung na dge skos kyi rtsis blangs pa'i spyi rdzas su bsdu/ de yang gnas brtan lo brgya lon pa dag dang gsar bu ba dag tshul khrims mnyam pa ma bslab dgos pas/ de ring gi bsnyen rdzogs pa dang lo brgya lon pa'i bsnyen rdzogs pa dag srung sdom 'dra bar bstan pa'i shugs kyis dge tshul sogs kyang 'gre bas na/ gnas kyi bla ma bsten te dge tshul gyi bslab bya gnam tser ldeng ma'am 'dul 'dzin rin po ches mdzad pa dang / dma' mtha' yang blangs 'das kyi rkang grangs nges pa byas te bsrung ba dang dge slong rnams pham pa bzhi/lhag ma bcu gsum/ spang ltung sum hru/ ltung byed 'ba' zhis/ pa dgu bcu/so sor bshags pa bzhi/ nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis te khrims nyis brgya —— 67 —

lnga bcu rtsa gsum la spang blang gces spras su bya dgos par tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdor/ srog dang bral zhing shi ba na sla yi/ /tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral zhing shi bas ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad bar 'gyur gyi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pas ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spungs te rnam par ltung ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ de phyir ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang phrad/ / tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog / tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin/ / zhes sogs phan yon dang bcas gsungs pa bzhin yin pas tshig tsam du ma song bar nyams su bstar ngos dge sbyong la med du mi nung ba dul ba dang zhi ba yin la de'i rang bzhin du byed pa bzod pa yin te/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / / gzhan la 'tshe ba dge spyong ma yin no/ /zhes gsungs pas gzhan dag la phar mi gnod par ma zad// tshur gnod pa byung yang lan mi byed par bzod pa bsgom pa gshis lugs su byas te dri med 'od las/rgyal bas gsungs pa'i tshogs dbang mchog blangs nas rgyud 'di 'am ni bsdus pa yin// /rgyud rgyal ma lus thos slad yang dag ye shes lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ / khengs dang longs spyod 'byor pa du ma btang nas sems ni bla mar gtad byas te/ / sangs rgyas nyid kyi slad du gtso bo'i rgyas 'grel gzhan phan spyod pa mnyan par bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar rab gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob pa/ dma' mtha' yang 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dbang thob dgos shing / de mtshungs bsnyen mtshams gal che bas bla ma tshul ldan gyi man ngag gis brgyan te 'don cha — 68 —

'grel rim gyis bsnyen bam song ba'i rigs yod na dang / de min zang 'char can/ zla ba dang po nas zla ba drug pa'i bar dang bdun pa nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar zla ba drug re brje bskor gyis grwa pa mang skabs bcu re dang nyung mtha' bdun re nas khyon lo 'khor yong ba'i 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa tshad ldan gtong zhing / slar bskyar ma'i rigs gang mos kyi yi dam la bsnyen pa byas chog mtshams khag snga phyir mtshams g.yog re gtong 'phral sel gyi so so'i dge sbyor bgegs sel gyi rigs la bdun phrag gsum las mang byed sa med cing / de yang sgrub mchod dang gzhung gi sku rim dang 'grig na byed sa med 'don cha 'gril bstun rgyugs rdo rje slob dpon dang dge skos zung sbrel gyis len cing / grwa tshang la zhugs nas lo gsum ma song bar 'khor zhag la 'gro sa med/ nad gzhis chu tshan du 'gro dgos nges dang nad pa phyir spo dgos pa/ nyin kha shas don gcod gal cher 'gro dgos rigs rnams dge skos kyis 'di gar rgyu mtshan byung bstun babs bltas kyi gsal yong zhi/nga / nyin re'i gnang ba dge skos la zhus par 'os min gyi ster lugs byed/ rgyun sa/tan nyin gcig gi sgrig lam zhogs pa lag ris mthong mtshams nas dge skos la 'al ta zas brda sbyar/ dge skos kyis dge 'dun rnams 'od gsal la bzhugs par lha mo ba'i/sa glu dbyangs nges pa drug dang ldan pas bskul ba'i tshul gyis 'khar rnga chung rim nas bsnun te bzhengs brda gtong / dge 'dun rnams mnal gyi 'od gsal las rten brten pa rab 'byams lha'i 'khor lor bzhengs la dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i gos tshags legs par mdzad pa dang / nang du lha la gos 'bul ba'i dmigs pas na bza' bzhes te spyod lam rgod bag med par 'du khang nye skor du 'byor pa dang byang 'dren —— 69 —

gyis ltung bshags 'go skul byed pa dang dge skos kyis 'khar rnga'i 'phro gcod/dge 'dun rnams nas dgag bya dang dgos pa dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas khrus dmigs bsal btab ste khrus mdzad rjes rje bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi nyams mgur las/ sgo gsum sdig ltung dri mas sbags pa 'di/ /lhag par las sgrib spyong ba gnad che bas/ / rgyun du stobs bzhi tshang ba bsten pa gces/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rang rgyud 'khul nges pa'i nges 'byung gis kun nas bslangs te phung po gsum pa'i mdo gsung zhing lang tsho'i babs bstun gyi phyag la 'bad/ ltung bshags tshar gsum song ba dang bslab pa bgres pa dang mkhas grub che rim gyis 'byon pa las 'tshang ga dang rkang mgyogs mi byed/byang 'dren gyis gre sangs gnyis brgyab pa'i gral la mnyam bzhugs sdud par byed/ tshogs kyi 'al 'don dang tshogs yun sogs sngar rgyun bzhin dang gung tshigs skabs tshogs la bzhes khu brims te tshang mas lhung bzed du sta gon byas nas byen len gtong 'jog sngon du 'gro ba'i bla ma dbu mdzad pas dkon cog rjes dran sogs bskul/ nang mchod byin rlabs dang phud mchod bshams pa sogs chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas nang du phung khams lha'i dkyil 'khor la sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i tshul gyi longs spyod/ mnyam spud dang yon sbyong gi dbu rdo rje slob dpon gyis bskul/ chab ril bas lhung bzed kyi 'al chu brem/ phud mchod bskor/ tshogs grol ba'i gung gseng la shag tu mi 'gro zhing 'phong ra sogs mi byed par so sor dpe cha dang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la brtson pa dgos/ de mtshungs dgong ja grol nas na gzim brda ma btang bar shag tu 'gro sa med cing de bar skyor sbyang sogs la brtson pa dang / gzim brda gtong mtshams kyang mtshan mo thun drug tu phye ba'i thun — 70 —

phyed gnyis song mtshams la dge skos kyis gzim brda phul ba dang rim gyis ku co med par shag tu 'byon/ rgyun gtan mig mangs sogs dang long gtam sogs tshul min gyi bya ba rnams spangs te/ chos kyi rgyal po tseng kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i lam rim dang sngags rim/ tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad/mkhas grub rin po ches mdzad pa'i rgyud sde spyi rnam/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i dam tshig gsal sgron sogs la thos pa mdzad nas thun mong ba'i lam dang myur lam rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len la 'grus pa dgos/grwa rigs su thad nas rtsa bzhi chang dang bcas par mthong thos dogs gsum gyi skyon chags pa byung na gnas nas bskrod cing / 'khrug long kha 'thab tsam byed mi byung yang gnyis ka 'bud/ grwa sa phan tshun dang / yul tshan/gsar rnying / mi dpung grwa sdebs kyi 'thab rtsod/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang bstan bshig khrims 'gal byas rigs la gte po sde tshan dang bcas par rgyal khrims kyi rtsa ra skabs thob byas 'gro bas 'dir gsal ma dgos/ phyi dro'i kha zas dang sgog tsong tha mi kha la longs spyod pa byung na dge skos kyis rdog 'jug byas pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su brgya phyag re'i chad pa 'gel / lo ltar gyi sgrub mchod la dpal gsang ba 'dus ba'i sgrub mchod chu stod zla ba'i tshes gnyis nas grwa pa brgyad kyis nyin bzhi'i ring sa chog nas bzung rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor gzhung dang mthun pa'i sla chos su ma song ba'i dngos gang gtsang bzhengs te tshes drug nas tshes bcu gsum gyi bar sgrub mchod dngos gzhi dang bcu bzhi la sbyin sreg bco lnga la dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon spyan 'dren/zla ba bcu pa'i tshes brgyad nas grwa pa brgyad kyis rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgrub mchod kyis chog sta gon sogs gong mtshungs kyis rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la 71 ——

bzhengs shing/ bcu gnyis nas nyin bdun gyi bar sgrub mchod bcu dgu la sbyin sreg dang nyi shu la rdul tshon spyan 'dren sa ga zla ba'i tshes lnga nas bde mchog gi sgrub mchod sa chog dang sta gon rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor grwa pa brgyad nyin bzhi'i ring nu gang nges bzhengs nas sgrub mchod dngos gzhi tshes dgu nas bcu drug gi bar gtong / bcu bdun la sbyin sreg dang bco brgyad la rdul tshon spyan 'dren byed/ sgrub mchod gsum po'i 'don tshig gdangs dbyangs sogs dang zla ba ngo re bzhin gyi gso spyong bco lnga pa dang / bcu bzhi pa 'dul ba'i dus tshigs bzhin dang / rdo rje slob dpon pas 'grel ba bzhi/ sbrags 'chad thub phyin nag pa zla ba'i tshes gcig nas brgyad pa'i gnam gang bar gung tshigs grol ba'i gung gseng chen mo'i skabs chos mthun re 'chad pa'i sgrig lam rnams rgyud mid pa'i phyag len ltar byed/ chab zhugs grwa sa phan tshun nas sngar rgyun ltar btang na de mtshungs kyi zhag gang 'os dang /lo gsar nas zhag bdun gung gseng byed/ /de skabs khyim pa sun 'byen gyi 'jig rten pa ma dad pa'i rigs mi byed/ gal te byed mi byung na dge skos kyi mtshams tshigs byed/ grwa shag skor la dmigs bsal ma gtogs mi skya'i rigs mi gtong / brgyad gtor gyis mtshon dus gtor rnams lag/ deb nang bzhin ma chag pa sogs gzhung sger gyi rim gror bsnyan pa dang sems can la sman pa'i bsam pa rnam dag gi khur len byed pa gal che'o/ de ltar blang dor gsal ba'i nam mkha'i nor/ / dad brtson chos bzhin spyod pa'i skal bzang blo'i/ / pad mo rab 'byed ma nus btsun tshugs kyi/ / kun da zum pa'i snang ba bla na med/ /'dir bkod bca' ba'i khrims kyi rim pa las /spang blang 'das pa'i rmongs pa lug gi grogs/ / lugs zung drag po'i spyang la 72 la

ki'i mche ba yis/ / klad 'gems de lta bas na bag yod kyis/ /phyogs las rnam nga/ra rgyal ba'i 'dus sde 'dir/ / so thar khrims gtsang ngur smreg 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /'dzam gling sa yi rgyan bzhin gsang srugs kyi/ /mkhas grub skar tshogs lta bur 'phel bar shog / di ltar gam du bcar ba'i grwa tshang rnam par rgyal ba'i 'dus sde'i bca' yig gser gyi gnya' shing zhes bya ba 'di tā bla ma ye shes bstan pa'i bshes gnyen dang bka' blon da'i chin bā dur zung nas rgyud smad dang de min nged nas byas pa'i sku 'bum rgyud pa'i bca' yig ltar dgos tshul byung ba de lta na glang khal be'u la bkal ba ltar las ma 'das gshis/ ha lam smad rgyud grwa tshang gi bca' khrims la gzhi byas/ yul dus kyi bsgyur bkod dang bcas pa bskul ma'i dus bcar gyi stabs tshig spyor gyi spros bcas dor te shākya'i dge sbyong blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshor 'bod pas thil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lo nag pa zla ba'i tshes bcu gcig la phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po gru 'dzin gnyis pa nas bris/ / / /

chos sde chen po se naXthegaXchen gling gi sgrig khrims gnon sdems sgodaXrgyalaXmachog bdun pa chenaXpos me sprul lon bstsal ba'i bca' yig gsen thamaXchenaXklo 'byan ma'i ngo bshus dge/me sprul/ (spyi lo 1727 )dmigs med thugs rje'i rlabs phreng dkar po dus las yol min rgya mtsho'i gshis/ /phul byung snyeng stobs nor rgyas gzhon nus 'khyud pa'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ / zung 'jug rin chen khams bzhi'i lhun pos chad med bsrubs pa'i snyeng po las/ / rnam pa ga ka bdud rtsi'i no brnyes ste ku ṭa / pā rgyal gyur cig1/kun mkhyen lha yi rnga chen las 'phos chos kyi sdom ba'i 'i sgras/ /dbyig 'dzin lho ba rnam pa drug tu g.yos ba'i zlos gar dang / / lhan cig 'gro la mdza' ba gsar pa'i dga' ston mchog gi gter/ / spel mdzad 'phrugs ka shiXng ga bhe dang sbol 'dzin ma0khas bha ba bsngags/ 2/bsil ldan be+e zur dkar po'i phreng ba mgul ba'i do shal du/ / sgeg pa'i rtse dga' — 74 ——

khongs nas 'dzum ba'i lus can la ga pa rer/ /dgos (mdod ce das/ra stsol mdzad sngon byon lto lda( ka / spyon gyis/ /rnam thar bka' drin dran pa'i dum kyi mthar yang bsngags 'os gyur/ 2/ brgyad khri bzhi stong bka' yi snying khu rlung thob bcud kyi zas/ /rnam dbyo da lho bar bzhu ba'i gdams ngag sgres//sa par 'thul tsam gyis/ //chos min gser ldan spobs pa 'phrog byed sngom/ med brtul bzhugs 'chang / / sar ste mas da da0pal ༷ba stas drang srong gra/gas pa sa 'dir 'bar/ 4/ ma snad mkhyen )ba ba dkar rdul/ brtsegs ldun ngo/'i mched zla'i spor/ /mi 'jigs sbar khyem ba'i/ yis log smra'i ri dwags klad nga 'gems/ / bdag med nges don chos kyi sgra brgyas phyob/sa bcu'i khongs pa kun/ /'gas nus 'jam mgom/ mi yi seng ge ka khri pā lta 'dud/ 5// byams chen nam yang mi 'dzad tsa/nga ga'i chus/ / zhe sdang tsha reg gzhil byed hūṃ kyā yis/ /ring lugs tshad med gdong bzhi'i 'dzum phreng can/ / ye shes mes po'i sgyu 'phrul rmad du byung / 6/ mtha' med sems can 'khur chen gzugs kyi go/ / 'byed la snying rje'i nam mkha' yangs pa'i khyon/ / gang gdul 'phrin las rab 'byams ta ma la/ /rim byon pād da0kar ྅chang rna0mas phyag gi yul/ 7/ nga0ga ka tshangs sras ngang mo'i zlos gar gyi/ /mgrin mtsho dpal gyi mgur du dbyangs chags pa/ / blo gros zur phud lnga pa'i mkhyen bzang la /'dren 'os rgya mtsho'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ 8/ sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrug pa'i 'khor mtsho las/ /bslab gsum gru rdzing brtan pos yid can kun/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ / 'khrid mdzad rim byon mkhan brgyud tshogs la 'dud/ 9/ tshul khrims rtsa ba mi shigs yongs 'du'i — 75 —

rtser/ /mang thos da0/ge la 'dun pa'i me tog bkra/ /don gnyis 'dod/ gu'i 'bras dud bsod nams/ zhi/nga / /mchog gyur 'dus tshogs nag klung rgyal gyur cig 10/ las nyon kun 'byung 'thobs ngo 'i smag rum tshogs/ /mthar bskrod sa steng phan dang bde ba yi/ // snang byed 'od rlabs 'dzum pas sgod bcud kun// /grol snyam thu0ba bstam/ nyi ma las ga/zham/ gang / 11/ rgyal bstan snying khu dmar ser 'od kyi bcud/ /'thung pas rnam par grol ba'i 'dab ma brgya/ / cher ba 'a/da nywa ka ka ba'i daXse/ 'dun sde/ /sa chen pad mo'i tshal bzhin dge legs byas/ 12/ de phyir bsngags 'os ba dan sa ga/sum na/ //rnam par g.yo ba'i da0ge ྅dun ba ba riXm/ /nges legs lang tsho'i gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /rab gsal kar ba ba rdong 'di na mchis/ 12/'es shis pa brjod pa'i tshig gis sngon bsus te ba stes ka ka bhe ྅sa/ji ltar zla ba shar gyur pa/ /tshad/ med sa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ / chu yi sngo/da du snang gyur kyang / / zla ba gnyis su gyur pa med/ / de bzhin chags med mkhyen ldan rnams/ /chags med rnam par 'tshang rgya bas/ /zhing rnam kun tu rab tu snang / /sangs rgyas la ni gnyis snang med/ /'di las gcig kyang yod ma yin/ / sku ni gnyis sam gsum du med/ / ji ltar sems can bsam pa bzhin/ /tshad med par ni rab tu snang / /sbu ni 'das pa ma yin te/ / ma 'ongs pa yang sku ma yin/ / skyes dang byang chub mya ngan 'das/ /skad cig gcig gis rab tu snang / / ji ltar sgyu mar gyur pa'i gzugs/ /skyes pa ma yin 'ong pa yin/ / de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ / skye ba med las shin tu bstan/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/ yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i — 76 —

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams tshas kyi sku las g.yo ba mi mnga' zhing rnam par rtog pa med bzhin du dper na chu snod kyi bye brag so sor zla ba'i gzus/sa brnyan 'bang/ med du mtha' yas bar snang ba bzhin mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad rang gis brnyes pa'i go 'phangs mthon po la bkrir bzhed nas sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis khyab pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du rgyun mi 'chad pa las 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir lha rnams kyi gser gyi pad ma stong rga/ mtshan ma mthong ba las sangs rgyal stong 'byung ba'i ltas su shes te// kye ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang ngo/ 'o zhes bsngags par brjod pa'i dbyangs dar dir du sgrog pa las/ pad ma stong mthong ngam bskal pa bzang po zhes grags pa 'di la kyi dī bha sa stong 'byung ba'i nang nas ba0zhi pā rna0ma ྅dren shā0kya spung ge0sa lus can spyi dang / khyad par snyegs ma lnga lhas/ par bdo ba'i mi mjed kyi zhing 'di nyid phyag mtshan du bzhed te smon/ lam chen po lnga brgya btab/ bya dka' ba'i spyod pa mtha' yas pas bla na med pas byang chub mngon du mdzad de tshe lo brgya pa'i dus kyi gdul bya tha mal pa dag gis kyang mthong ba'i skal ba can du mchog gi sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par rol pas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa ni ka do ldus/ thub rnam sdig pa chu yis mi bkru zhing / / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ / nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min te/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes blangs dor gyi gnas phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i gdam ngag gi don gdul bya'i nyams su blangs pas rgud pa mtha' dag bzlog cing / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob — 77 —

par byed pa las thabs ga/'an gyis 'gro ba ma ngom mtho nges legs/ kyi sa ra dkri bar mi nus la/ de yang phywa/ nga mu ) sto ga0zhi ldus/ dge slong das/ tshul khrim sa goms par byas na ting nge 'dzin yun ring du sa/na/sa par 'gyur ro/ /༷ting nge 'dzin sdoms par byas na shes rab yu na/ ring du ba/nas bar 'gyur ro/ / thes rab goms par byas na 'di lta ste 'dod chags dang zhe sdong dang gti mug las sems yang dag pa kho/ nar za/ma nga ra grol bar 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/chags sogs thon/ mongs bag chags dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi rtsa bar gyur pa bden 'dzin de nyid bdag med pa'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i shes rab goms par byas nga/sa ldog la/ de'i bsgyur sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas sam ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro dgos/ de skye ba la lus ngag gi mi spyod mtha' dag la ldog cing / sems dul ba dang zhi/ bar byed pa'i spongs sems tshul khrims gal che ba la dgongs nas daXpal dgon ka pā sgri da ka/ khrims kyi rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs pa gsungs/ / zhes rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i snod bcud 'jig rten thams cad kyi rten sa chen po yin pa ltar tshul khrims 'di nyid yon tan thams cad skye ba'i rten nam gzhi mar bsngags shing /khyad par du sto sto tha0ra sdu'i ma0do la0sa/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ / 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa zhes/ / rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par/ / nan tan dge slong tshogs 'dun bstod/ / ces mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde sgod bstan pa yin kyang ston pa'i go mi chod/ 'dul ba'i sde snod bstan pa dang ston pa gnyis ka yin par gsungs pa dang ྅dul sta ྅nga ldas/btsun pa ji tsam gyis na — 78 —

ngam nga 'i mu zu ches pa 'e/sa1 bgyi/ /ji tsam gyis na 'ig pa jes bgyi/ /u pa la'i/ ji srid du las byed cing nan rtan byed pa yang yed pa'i bar du te las byed la nan tan byed pa ya/nga yo da na dam pa'i tshas yod pa zhes bya'o/ las kyang mi byed la nan tan byed pa das/ kyang med ma / de ni dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bya'o/ zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yod med kyang bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'du' ba'i sde sgod la nan tan dang las kyi cho tsa/ tshul bzhin yod med la rag lus kying / de yang bsil ldan ra ba dkar pos bris pa'i ljongs 'dir sprar dar la ku spyon ku sdib pa / shrīb pa da0pa' da kyi bka' drin las rab tu byung ba'i sde gsar du btsugs pa sogs bstan nga rin po che nyin mo'i snang bas blangs dor la rmongs pa'i mun pa'i go skabs rgyang ring du bskrad mod kyang / ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa dang the tshom gyi dri mas sbags par gyur pa'i tshe/ dpal mnyam med dī ༷ ku ḍi spyi dz+nyā na0/sa slar yang bstan pa'i rtsa ba la nyes pa'i dri ma mtha' dag bsal te rgyal ba'i bka' sde snod gsum po ma lus pa gdam ngag tu shar ba'i srol rnam bar dag pas gangs can/ gyi ljongs khyab par 'gyur/ slar rgyal ba'i mdo bsngags kyi chos tshul mtha' dag la 'khrul pa phra mo tsam yang spangs te ston pa'i bstan pa la thub dbang gnyes pa lta bur gyur pa ni/ ba daXpal sna ba0'i rgyud ༷sa/ nga ni myang ngan 'das 'og tu/ /sa yi steng 'di stong pa na/ /khyod gnyis byis pa'i gzugs can gyis/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par gyur/ /de'i tshe dgon chen rab dga' ba/ /kha ba can nang yod pa yin/ /zhes gnas dang dus dang dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi ming zur bcas rje btsun 'jam dpal — 79 —

dbyangs dge slong gi gzugs can gyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang 'dra bar mdzad par lung gis bstam/ pa ltar/ rdos spyo spyol dwo dwong khri da ldan dī ba spus rgyud sdur ku pa'i bka' drin las mtha' dbus kyi lus can tshad med grangs med pa zhig mdo sbag/sa kyi blangs dor phra 'i/nga phra ba la'ang lta ba'i mig da/nga snang ba thob nas rgyal bstan dri ma med pa'i sros/ 'thud par gyur/ bye brag tu rje bdag nyid chen ngo sa// se ra chos sdings su rtsa she'i 'grel chen rig pa'i rgya mtsho mdzad pa'i dus gser bzhun las grub pa'i sher phyin gyi yi ge gsal la ma 'dres pa bar snang la gzigs nga/sa theg chen bzad sgrub ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas 'dus pa'i sde zhig 'byung bar lung bstan pa ltar byams chen chos rje sha kya ye shes kyis 'debs par ma/dzad cing / de nas brtsams gsan da rgyud ba zhes sde/mas da0pa' ka grub kyi phreng ba rim bzhin tshar du dngar ba dang / khyad par dbyangs cam ba 'ad pa dbe/ 'dun rgya mtsho nas /de / sa/ 0 0 /de rje'i() /mi /de 0bzungs thaXms ka lda/—na/ pā gong nywa (ma spyom/ dag sa — 'phangs mthon/ por dbang bsgyur thing / skal ldan gyi skye bo mtha' yas pa thos bsam bsgoms pa'i gru dzing la brten te nges legs kyi nor bu len pa 'jug ngogs rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra ba'i ga/'is gyur pa se ra theg pa chen po'i gling zhes yongs su grags pa'i grwa sa chen po 'di'i dge 'dun rnams kyi kun tu spyod pa'i rnam par thar ba ni/ki do ldus/srid ba'i gzugs rnga gcod phyed lam/ /ngas ni khyod cag rnams la bstan/ /de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa ste/ / khyed cag rnams kyi bya dgos so/ /zhes ston pā thugs rje can de nyid kyis/ 'o skol la srid pa'i nyes brgya drung nas 'byin pa'i thabs tshul ji lta ba bzhin du 'doms — 80 —

par mdzad pa la rang gi blangs dor phyin ci ma log pas ji ltar bstan pa sa ma bzhus ru/ ma/ dper ma/ sman pa ma khas pas nad kyi zug rngu gtan ma//sa 'joms par byed nus pa'i sman bzang zhing phangs pa byin du zin kyang //nad pa rang nyid kyi/ ma 'thung na nad las thar ba mi 'gyur zhing / rang gi nyes pas rang brlu sa pa dang 'dra bas na spyir sde snod rin po che gsum khyad par rab tu byung ba snams kyis blangs dor ston nga 'i 'du/za ba'i sde snod la ji ltar gsungs pa ba'i/na nyams su bstar ba las lhag pa'i bca' khrims ma mchis pas na 'u nga sde bzhi las gsungs pa'i bcas mtshams gzhir bzung yul dus kyi dbang las byung ba'i daXge bdun sgyi naXng khriXms baXca' )'i shi ge0ra 'a spyod )ra ṭī baX'i ka pā lta/ grwa tshang byes snad gnyis dang sa/sar btsug/sa lngags pa bcas grwa tshang khag gsum dang nang tshan khams tshan/ mi tshan so sor ma 'dus pa mi yong gshis ga/sar du zhugs ring la 'gal rkyen bar chad ba'i dang bral zhing mthun rkyen lnga tshang ba zhig gis dge bsnyen dge tshul dge slong gi bslab pa'i bar rim gyi nod pa la/ rang rang gi yo byad/ bla gos/mthang gos/ dge slong la de'i steng du snam sbyar dgos pa ༷ rkyen ma 'dzoms ma/ rgyu rung ba la byin rlabs chags pa yin mod kyang / rkyen 'dzoms tshe rgyu de tsam gyis chog pa ma yin pas 'dul ba nas ji skad bshad pa'i chos gos gsum rung ba tshad ldan dang gding ba lhung bzed sogs gal chung du ma song bar tshags su tshud nges byed/ des mtshon zhwa ser zla gam sogs nung mthun gyi gos gyon pa las/ gos phu thung can/ pags rigs kyi gos/'phar zhwa/ glo cha/ ske rgyan/ ther gzan/ rgya sog gi lham/ 'jam 'gag gis mtshon pa mi gyon cing / skra tshad las lhag pa mi 'jog tshogs — 81 —

su/ longs spyod 'a1 /3du ba'i tshe/ tshogs skad ma byung bar mi 'byon tshogs/ zad byung ba bstan kun spyod zhi dul gyes 'du ba las rgyug 'phyongs 'phros gtam ku co so gas kyis mi 'du 'ing / tshogs dung btang mas spud 'byed ma phye bar spyod lam/ sa/nga mdzes/ kyis bzhugs pa las spyod rtsing mi mdzad/ me khang gi sbo/ dang / ltag sgo sogs4 mgyo/sa lam gzhan nas mi bgor/ tshogs gral du 'kho/ da pa'i rim pa yang /// rang rang gi/ ba mi ba pa'i go rim ma 'chol bar bzhugs nga/ las rkang mgyogs mi byed hrung / ka ba/ 'a/la ba sogs la mi snyes/ bo/sa kyis ma btums par mchi4ma snabs 'dor ba/ gnyid// greng mo/ lag rtsed/ kha g.yeng // mig g.yeng / kha btums// gzhogasaXg/hrus sog/sa ma yin par mu tig star la brgyus pa ltar yid du 'ong ba bzhug/sa shing / 'al 'don gyi rim pa la / thugs ma sa/ye ngas 'ing tshang ma mgrin gcig dbyangs gcis/ gis dang ba 'dren pa byed/ bza' btung gi tshe hub cag bo/ sgra dang bcas pa dang / lces hog pa sogs mi mdzes pa rgyang ring du bsrings te kha zas sman dang pa dra ba'i dran shes kyis bsten par mjad//gral khrod du dge 'dun la brda sprod dgos rigs byung na dge bskos las gzhan pa mi 'gro/ rgyun gyi tshogs la yun ring thung mtha' gcig tu nges bzung dka' ba 'dug kyang 'breng ngo ra cha bzhag na/ spyin bdag gi sku rim dmis/sa bsal gang dgos rigs kyang ma chad pa 'gro nges shes pa las zom lus mi yong ba dang / gzhan ma skyabs sems gnas bcu phyag mchod sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i mang ja dang po'i gong du smon lam bzhi dang de rjes mdo tshar gsum dang seng gdong ma'i gzungs 'phreng 'khor re dang bcas pas bstan 'gro spyi bye brag la gnod pa dang dgon khrod du rku ma byed pa/ dge 'dun gyi ——— 82 la —

dbyen byed pa/ rtsa bzhi/ chang dang bcas pa spyod pa/ se ra shar dang tha 'og rnams su chang btsongs pa/ bsha/sa ra byas pa sogs la dmigs zlogs pa tshar gsum byed/ de rjes sa lam dang ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams gdangs dang bcas bab chag re mos kyis btang ba'i mjug tu gtor 'bul dang gtor ma brgya rtsa drug hru pa bcas sngar sbol chag med gtong / mang ja dang sne bzhag byed lugs sna tshogs pa 'ig byung na/sbyin bdag sogs khag bsun dang / ma dad pa'i khyim pa bsun 'byin gyi rgyur 'gro ba 'dug pas na/ gtan 'khel grwa pa nyi shu rtsa lnga re'i sar ja spor do re dbang tu byas nas/ dge 'dun gsum stong gi rtsis la ja nyag drug cu/mar de'i sum skor la ma mtha' byas pa'i bzang ngan 'breng gsum gyi 'gro tshod gang yin drang por bshad pa'i sbyin bdag rang gi 'dod pa spyor ba las 'os min/ gyi len che mi byed/de mtshungs 'bul ba dang sne bzhag che kha gsum/ chung kha brgyad mgon khang snyan dar sogs gang phul bab mtshungs las rtsod pa spu tsam mi byed/mdun ja gzim khang la sbar tshad bzhi/ dge skos la sbar tshad do re/ ja ma chu len me 'bud bcas la sbar tshad re/ dge rgan grwa rkyang 'khyer 'khos med pa'i rigs kyis sbyin bdag/ gi sne lan dgos par btung ja'i thebs 'dengs tsam gyi tshod dad 'bul dang len las mi 'os pa'i ham che mi byed/ 'du khang du mar nyag re'i mar khu 'gro tshod kyi mchod kong gnyis dang / snga ja yin na da/ge bskos gnyis la dpal 'bar re/ tshogs la zhun mar gnyis rung khang la zhun mar gnyis bcas las lhag pa mi len/ rung khang la ja tshul do dam pa gcig ja ma gsum/ me 'bud gnyis// chu len ga/nyis/ zhal ta ba —— 83 ——

gnyis/ sbyin bdag si/ mi gnyis ma gtogs mi 'jog ma/nga ja nas byams chen chos rjer ja phud lngar rgyun dang / sbyin bdag la rkyan tshad gsum/rig grwa bar rkyan tshad do/ byams smon/ bzang spyod/ gtor sgrub bcas la rkyan tshad re ma gtogs mi 'khyer/ gzim khang du rkyan/ tshad do las lhag pa dmigs bsal dgo/sa rigs byung na dge bskos la gnang ba zhusashe gnang las 'os min mi byed/ sngar srol la byes mid gnyis kyi ja mas rkyan/ bu bzu gcig re dang stod ja mas rkyan/ bu bdun bsgrigs cing / ma bsgrigs na sne bzhag gcod ba'i srol med 'dug par/ da cha rung khang du ja khra 'di/ngas pa yod pas/ de rigs dkrig chag ma dgos/ ja ro spungs nas 'jog pa las thab g.yog gis 'khyer na ja mi thon pa'i rkyen dang / kha zhag bsags kyang tshogs pa la gnod gzhir 'gyur bas mi bsags/ 'gyed dang tsha ra dge skos kyis tshogs gtam rgyun la nad pa mtshams pa'i rig/sa ma gtos/sa 'a/la mngon du ma 'gyur bas skal ba blangs mi chog ces gtong ba'i srol ldar/dpe mtshams pa/ grwa bslo/ra ba/ rang mtshams kyis 'bul sdud du phyin ba sogs skal ba mi gtong bas mtshon 'gyed gtong rtsa tshig gi don las g.yo med byed/ khams tshan dang mi tshan ci rigs nas phyogs lhung dang za 'dod kyis mang ja dang 'gyed sogs tshogs chen gi bsnyen bkur grwa tshang la bsgyur ba/grwa tshang gi bsnyen bkur khams tshan la bsgyur ba sogs yong gi yod 'dug ya dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo 'phrog pa'i nyes pa bsam las 'das pas 'bras bu brnag dka' ba kho na'i rgyu sgrub pa las ma mchis pas de rigs gtan nas mi byed/ gzhung nas btang ba'i mang ja'i ja gad gzim khang ga/nyer sdod dang ja tshul do dam pas khur len sngar srol bzhin byed/ spyi sos phogs rgyag dus la 84 la

bla gnyer dge slo/sa gzhung gi ngo tshab sogs sbrel bas chos grwa ba sogs la ga/hong lugs dang grwa tshang yas mas gnyis sngar ltar re mos byed/ skal ba sos/sa dgos nges kyi rigs la tshang mas zhib 'jug gi/sa rgyag pa las nye dga' phyogs skyor gyi sa/tong rgal mi byed/ sde 'di ga'i thos pa don gnyer gyi rigs kyis gso dbyu/da tsis sogs rig gnas ga 'a/na la mtshan nyid kyi bslab gnyer ma tshar bar don gnyer byed mi 'jug lus kyis rkyen zeg cing shes rab yod bzhin du tshas grwa mi 'grim par sos dal du mi sdod/ cing tshong khe spogs dang ma/sa bun 'dzugs pa sogs mi byed/ snga thog shes rab dang the/mu/ 'dod yod pa'i rig/sa rnams dang por ra ba stod du phyin pa'i bsdud tshad la bslab gnyer dang / grwa sar po ti ga'am ma rnams la bslab sbyangs mthar phyin/ pa'i dge/ bshes mang rigs pa dang / de rigs the/sa 'dod med/ pa la yas chag mas chag gi tha snyad byas pa'i rnam 'grel sogs kyi g.yeng ba bskyungs te dbu phar gyi tha'/ phreng la dmar 'jus byas nas po ti bzhi zur bkol dang bcas pa tshang ma 'gril ba'i dge bshes re yang yong gi yod 'dug kyang / phyis grwa sa rang du bsdus tshad rnam rtog sod sod re btang bas gzhen la bslab sbyangs 'gro ba'i go yang 'gags shing po ti phyi ma'i bslab gnyer la yang hrung zad gnod yod 'dug pas na/ bsdus grwa 'os rigs ma gtogs/ tshad mar don gnyer yed pa rnams ra ba stod du 'gro gang 'dod gtong ba dang / grwa sar phyi log gi skabs kyang bkag bya mi byed/ de mtshungs sngags kyi thos bsam don gnyer can gyi rigs kyang / rgyud stod smad du 'gro ba yang bkag cha mi byed//zhogs nga/'i mang ja grol bstun grwa tshang la/ ga/ so so'i chos grwa'i 'khar rnga'i brda byung ba dang bstun chu phyi phan gyi so so'i chos rwa chos 'chad kyi sgrig lam kun — 85 ——

spyod gang yin la cha bzhag pa'i thos bsam je 'phel gyis bstan/ pa rin po che'i rgyan du 'gro ba byed/ sngon khams sogs kyi gzhi ba byed srol mi 'dug kyang /bar skabs su sna tshogs shig byung yod 'dug pas da nas bzung khams sog dang sa/zhis dgon yod pa'i rig/sa kyi gzhi ba byas mi chog dbu phar gyi bslab ga/nyer chag nges la ma gtogs ming btag/sa kyi rigs mi ster/ dbu phar rtsi bzhag gi steng nas tshang ma song zhing / 'dul mdzod rnam 'grel sob/sa phyogs dod nges pa'i yon tan bzang nges can la sde 'di ga'i dka' bahru dang / dbu phar 'dul bcas rtsi ba 'ag gi steng tshang ma song zhing /mdzod dang rnam 'grel dpe thog nas song ba'i bslab gnyer bzang nges par smon lam sogs gdong gral ba'i ming btags dang / se ra rang gi rdo gcal rab 'byams pa yang po te'i 'gro lugs gong ltar gyi bslab gnyer bzang rigs kho na la gtod/ so so'i chos grwa dang grwa tshang yas mas gnyis kyi rig/ chung / tshogs chen/ rigs grwa/ dbyar gnas sogs kyi bshad pa dang dam bca' ring thung po ti so sor byed srol gang yin sngar srol bzang po bong 'phel du gtong ba las sla bcos byed bdes nyams chag tu 'gro ba mi byed/gling bsre tshar bstun rig chen gyi tshogs langs kyang po ti phyi ma 'dul mdzod gnyis nas dgun/ gyi gling bsre —bas sba rgol dang / dbyar gyi gling bsre bas phyir rgol re nges par len pa dang / dka' bzu bar ma zad gdong gral ba sus kyang gling bsre'i bshad pa tshogs langs la mi bldab cing / gzhung don bor ba'i spyi bshad kyi bshad yams mang ba dang / lo lo bzhin gzhung chung gcig la ldab sogs gling bsre'i bshad pa dang tshogs langs pa sus kyang mi byed/ gdong gral gyi ming btags thog mar byas pa nas bshad ring bar — 86 —

gzhung snga phyi/ phyis gzhung bcas bzhi la bshad ring gtso bor bton/ bar gzhung snga ma yan chad yang yang len pa dang / ma mtha' yang bshad ring nas phyi gzhung gi bar rim par blangs te ma rdzogs bar gyi lo gsum tshun la gya tshom du dgongs pa zhus gnang mi byed/ ming btags pa'i rigs la bslab gnyer med kyang rin gyis hos chog pa yod 'dug zer ba sogs gleng bcas bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par grwa sa grwa tshang so so'i mtshan don la yon tan med rigs kyis ming btags blangs ba shin tu gnod pa yong 'dug pas bla ma sogs sne mor mngags pa rnams kyis blo gzu bor gnas pa'i tshul dang mthun pa byed/ bla ma bsko bzhag dgos rigs gang 'dra zhig yin kyang grwa dmangs zhal mthun spi 'os nges shes pas mtshon yon tan can drag rim las khams tshan mi tshan sogs kyi ngan shed spyir btang dmigs bsal la bsnyad pa'i nye dga' phyogs lhung gi 'os tho mi bkod/ tshogs chen dge skos bsko bzhag sngon du grwa tshang khag la di ching ba dur dri ba byed bcug pa'i don bzhin bcas mtshams kyi yi ge logs su bkod pa ltar dang spyi gnyer bcas kyang so sor bab 'brel yod nges pas 'os min 'os thor mi rgyag de mtshungs tshogs chem/ dbu mdzad kyang grwa tshang gnyis nas 'os babs sngar sbol ltar byed/ ngam ring sogs phyogs la grwa bskor la 'gro mi rnams kyang yon tan 'breng tsam med par btang na grwa sa'i zhabs 'dren yong gshis so so'i slob dpon pas bslab gnyer med pa rnams 'gro sa med pa'i bsdam ra byed/de mtshungs gsang phur 'gro mi tsho yang / phar phyin gyi thal phreng song mtshams 'gro zhing / bshad pa'i yun nyi ma dang mang ja'i grangs bcad sogs sgrig lam la ji ltar yod pa bzhin las rang gang 'dod gyi mtshams nas log pa'i — 87 —

dbang shed kho na byas zer ba'i gleng yang yod 'dus/ pas de lugs la ma song ba'i tshul gnas gang yin las rang 'dod mi byed/ zho ston gyi skabs zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i gung tshigs thon nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig gi gung tshigs tshun la nye 'brel gyi bud med sogs dgon nang du tsha/nga bar gnang ba sbyin/ de nas phyir log gi tho brtsigs pa da/nga / phur mjal skabs zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nyer drug gi gung tshigs nas gnam gang gi gung tshigs tshun la gnang ba sngar ltar ster kyang dgon/ nang du chang 'thung / glu gzhas/nub mo sdod pa sogs blo lad dang mi mdzes pa'i rgyu yin 'dug gshis de rigs byed du mi 'jug grwa tshang phan tshun gyi slob dpon bar spyir btang mchod 'brel zhu bar bkag cha med kyang / grwa tshang gcig gi grwa pas gcig shos kyi slob dpon par brtse bzhag mi nyan/ dbang rjes gnang lung zhu sogs kyang mngon chung las chos rwar gnod pa'i bag yangs mi byed cing / mdo sngags gang gi sgo nas kyang gnas skabs mthar thug gis dgos don ji 'dra zhig sgrub dgos kyang rang re'i lugs sbol 'di nyid kyi mi chog ba dang mi mthun rgyu cig kyang med pas yid ches kyi nges pa gting nas drangs te lta grub mi gcig pa'i rigs la shes 'dod mi byed dgon nang du bstan pa spyi dang dge lugs las lta grub mi gcig pa'i rigs kyi chos spyod mi 'don/sgrig 'gal gyi skor/ rtsa gzhi chang dang bcas la mthong thos dogs sa/sum gyi sgo nas rtsad chod pa dang / dge skos la kha lan lag lan slog pa byung na gaṇ+ḍi shog thod kyis gnas dbyung gtong zhing / de las gzhan pa rmas khrag byung ba/ gri bton pa / lag 'thab byas pa sogs nyes byas kyi rigs la gang dang gang 'tshams kyi tshar gcod rjes 'dzin byed/ nang tshags kyi la 88 ——

sgrig lam kun spyod kyi do khur dge bskos gnyis kyis nye dga' phyogs skyor spangs pa'i gzu bor gnas pa byed dgos cing / lar rgya'i khog dang phyi nang gi khrims gcod dgos rigs gzim khang gnyer pas drang bzhag gi bkod khyab byed/ mda' rdo skor mchongs mig mang sha rda ra sogs bag med kyi spyod pa'i rigs dgon phyi nang gang sar bkag cha gang dam byed/ grwa sar zhugs ma thag pa dang / btsun chung rigs dge rgan med par thab mi 'dzin cing /grwa sa phan tshun dang khams tshan 'thab rtsod kyis mtshon dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang / bstan bshig khrims 'gal byas rigs gte po sde tshan dang bcas par rgyal khrims kyi rtsa ra yong 'gro ba 'dir gsal ma dgos/ gnas mjal ba bud med yin phyin gnang ba zhus pas nyin 'khor las bsten skyabs mi byed/dgon nang du skya ser dmangs bcas kyi rta bzhon nas mi 'gro zhing / myang gzhas ma yin pa'i glu dang rgyang 'bod ku co'i sgra che ba mi sgrags/ zhing las kyi rigs grwa pas byed sa med/ lta grub mi gcig pa'i mi dang g.yung po sogs grwa tshang dang khams tshan so so'i thob khungs yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas bsten sgor byas na/ phan mi thogs shing gnod pa'i rgyur 'dug pas mi bsten/mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa nas gnas skor la rtsol ba byas na blo lad dang slob gnyer la gnod pas chos grwa ba rnams 'gro sa med/ dge 'dun la bgod ring mi chog pa'i rnyed pa'i rigs spyi pa'i mdzod du 'jog bod rang du bsod snyoms byed pa 'dul ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun pas bkag cha mi dgos 'dra yang / rgya sog yul khams sogs la spyi don gyi 'bul sdud slong mo byed mi ma gtogs spyi don med par kha mthun gyi slong mo mi byed/ dge 'dun gyi nang khrims dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ngos ma blangs par song rigs dang / dgon — 89 —

ga 'a/na nas nyes can phud pa'i rigs kyang mi bsten/ nag chang gi byung nye pa'i dgag bya shin tu che ba yin 'dug pas dbyar chos dgun chos gnyis kyi dus su gnang ba gtan nas mi ster zhing / gzhan yang bla ma mjal ba mchod 'jal/ 'u lag lta bu'i dmigs bsal gtong dgos rigs ma gtogs bud med 'grims 'grul gtan nas byed mi 'jug dgon khang phan tshun gyi nang mchod tsam ma gtogs chang gi 'grims 'grul kyang bkag cha gang dam dge bskos kyis do khur byed/ mgar ba/ lham mkhan/ sprang po sogs mi nag gi gzhis sdod byed du mi 'jug lha sar don gcod la yong pa lta bus mtshon 'grul pa'i rigs la sger rgan ham pa can la las khams tshan gyi thob khungs yin pa tsam la brten/ chas ka la rgya bsdems gnas tshang du 'tshangs ba'i 'phrog bcom shed khyer byed pa'i rigs byung bgros 'dug pa grwa sa chen po rnams rlabs kyis 'gro dgos gshis de rigs grwa ba'i zhabs 'dren dang /rab tu byung ba'i kun spyod dang 'gal bas mi byed khrom la bre srang spor gsum spyi gzim bla brang yas mas gnas khag gnyis ma gtogs gzhan ma sus kyang mi rgyug snga mas tshong thag ma bcad par phyi mas hab thob dang lkog tshong mi byed/gling gseb tu 'gro lam chu yur sogs snang ba gang dran mi bzo/ lcags ri'i rgya sgo bzhi/ dar chen bcas gzim khang dang / bla brang gsum nas 'dzin spras byed/ lcags ri'i sa rtsi thob khungs so so nas legs pa gtso 'don gyis gsol/ dgon nang du bla brang khag dang gzim khang bcas la rta drel sogs dge 'dun gyi yo byad sgrub rten la dgos nges ma gtogs bag med kyi nyar tshags mi byed/ spyi gnyer la rta gsum re/ ja tshul do dam par rta gnyis/'bul bar byung rigs tshong bsgyur ma thub pa'i rigs zla gcig tshun dang /— 90 —

phyos/sa nas don gcod pa skebs skabs zhas/ snga la mang mtha' byas pa///bams tshan dang spyil bu che ba sos/sa su zhag gsum tshun gnang ba zhus gnang las de phan rta dre/la sogs su sa kyang mi gso/ gling gseb tu bong bu 'as/ por mi 'jog rga 'og se ra shar rnams su chang nyo tshong dang // bshas ra mi byed/ nag bcangs mi bsreg bya phag mi tsa/so// dgon pa'i rgyab ri dang nye skor du bya dang ri dwags mi brngen// rig grwa snga thog ba/ mas tshan re mos kyi gtong srol yod 'dug kyang g.yeng bas bslab gnyer la gnod gshis rig grwa spyi gnyer dang byams sbo na bzang spyod da lta'i srol lam bzhin gtong / gso spyong gi tshe gaṇ+ḍi'i brda nam byung la dge tshul slong 'du bar nus pa tham sa cad byon nas rang rang gi phyir bcos sngon du 'gro bas gso spyong mdzad cing /dbyar gnas dgag dbye'i dus kyang tshang mas 'du ba sogs dge 'dun gyi kun spyod gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang / ljongs rgyu'i tshe dam bca' mchod mjal sos/sa bag yod las spyod rtsing rigs mi byed/ des mtshon/ dge tshul slong thams cad kyis rang rang gi bslab bya che chung la blta rtog dang / bslab pa rgan pa dang gnas kyi bla ma sogs la bsten te bcas mtshams mtha' dag mig ltos yar blta'i sgo nas lag len la 'debs ci thub ngos bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i bca' khrims rnam par dag pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing dam par 'gyur ba zheg mdzad dgos pa ni/ rje bdag nyid chen pos/ dge 'dun gyi khrims su bca' ba dang po mdzad pa las/ rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la gus pa dang bstan pa rin po che la gcer spras su 'dzin pa dang / bstan pa phyogs re bar ma song bar rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i gnad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lugs bzang po mi nub — 91 ——

par ston par mdzad pa rnams kyis shin tu rlabs che ba'i thugs khur bsnams nas rang yang de 'a/ gnas shing / gzhan ya nga de la da so/sa/ chos mthun pa mthong na legs par bsngags pa'i sbo/ nas brtson pa chen pos thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ mdor na mtho dman 'bring gsum thams cad nas thugs khur rgya chen po bsnams la dge 'dun gyi khrims su bca' ba 'dis gzhung sbong bar mdzod/ rgyal ba sras da/nga slob ma'i tshog/sa bka' sdod dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyung / mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas 'a'i la bgegs med par bde blag tu sgrub par mdzad du gsol/ bslab par bya ba'i gzhi phyogs re ba ma yim/ pa'i gnad yongs su rdzogs pa rwa/ bslab tshul phyogs re ba ma yin/thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa gsum char gyi sgo nas bslab pa'i khrims su bca' ba 'di sgo/ thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du sa/nas par gyur cig ces ga/sung pa ltar yin/ de ltar bslab bya'i gnas la bag yod kyi sgo nas tshul bzhin du gnas pa gzhir bzung / mngon pa mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ /sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes pa'i don bzhin lung sde snod gsum la 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bslab sbyang la zhe thag pa nas brtson pa chen pos thos pa'i shes rab kyis mkhas pa'i gral du son nga/ dang / thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa'i snying por byed/ /skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar ba 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar kha phyir bltas kyi dred por ma song ba thos pa'i don de dag gdams ngag gi snying po shes pa'i sgo nas rgyud steng du bsam pa dang bsgoms pa'i nyams len la gzhol bas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'phel bar mdzad dgos/ spyir bstan pa dge 'dun gyi sde la la 92 la

rag lu/sa pa dang de'i nang nas kyang bstan pa'i snyi nga po dri ma med pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'di'i zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i sde kho na la rag lus/ khyad par du yang thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu'i grwa sa chen po ser 'bras ra/be/ sa/sum 'di nyid yin pas na/ 'di dag tu bstan pa rin/ po che 'dzin skyong gi rab tu byung ba'i ngang tshul las 'gong nas/ chu za 'bo/ nas rnyogs pa'i dpe ltar 'byung bas mtha' dbus kyi 'gro ba tham sa cad kyi mig rgyan du 'gyur zhing / spyir kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs dang bye brag dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i ring lugs 'di nyid dri ma med par rgya mtsho'i gos can la gzhi mtha' dag la khyab cing / mi nyams gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs tshul la 'bad pa lhur len pa mdzod cig smras pa/ thog ma bar mthar dge/ ba'i dam chos 'dzum/ /rnga g.yab dkar po las 'phos sim pa'i rlung / /kun mkhyen phyag gi 'du byed rnam dkar gyi/ /'dzin las bsil sbyin cho ga rmad po che/ /skye ba'i chu bo thur du 'bab ldan rgyun/ /srid gsum gnas ngan 'dzings pa'i ral khur khrod/ /rgya gyur 'khor yang pha mtha' rnyed dka' ba'i/ /rgyu gcig 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri 'joms slas/ /bdag med ye shes khams kyi zho 'thung rus/ /rtse mo brgya pa'i mtshon snon 'chang ba po/ /bag yod khrims kyi sa srungs steng 'gying ba'i/ / thar 'dod mchod sbyin brgya pa las gzhan su/ /de phyir rgyal bstan sngo yang ma yi rgyal/ /dri med so thar 'od 'bar nyin mor byed/ /rnam grol pad tshal gnyen du rtag 'char zhing / /tshul 'chal 'byung po'i bya tshogs long gyur gcig / thub bstan gdengs can gtsug na ser 'od che/ /'phro ba'i nor bu zhwa ser can gyi lugs/ /mtha' klas yid can bsod nams sgo skal du/ /phan bde'i 'dod rgu char du brtan brnyil shog /la 93 la

bslab gsum se 'i/nga rwa bas 'khrigs nga 'i dbus/ /zig chin bshad sgrub 'byung khungs chos kyi gling / /rnam grol 'phags pa'i bste gnas 'og min zhing / /srid mthar mi nyams slar nas slar 'phel shog / skye bar tshad med phan pa'i nu zho yis/ / legs bzang ma gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa/ / gnas skabs bde dga' nor bu'i them skas la/ / 'dzegs nas sku ga/sum khang bzang myur bgrod shog / ces mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i bste gnas 'gro kun bsod nams sa/sog pa'i zhing sa dam par gyur pa se ra theg chen gling zhes snyan grags kyi ba dan sa gsum na mngon par mtho ba'i chos sde chen po khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge rab gsal nor bu'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni snga sor rang lo bzu bzhi pa lcags glang lor stod pa slob dpon rab 'byams pa phun tshogs bkra shis/ smad pa slob dpon rab 'byams pa bsod nams rab bstan/byes slob dpon rab 'byams pa blo bzang nam mkha'/ dge skos smad rab 'byams pa tshangs dbyangs don grub/ byes dka' bcu ngag dbang rin chen/spyi so smad rab 'byams pa blo bzang rab brtan/ byes rab 'byams pa blo bzang dpal 'byor bcas kyis bskul ngor sgrig lam skor gyi bca' yig dang srol snga phyir byung ba rnams nas snying po bsdus pa'i bca' yig zhig song ba/de skabs nged rang na tshod phra bas zin bris la blta rtog 'jug pa tsam las gang cir zhib cha ma byung stabs slad rang lo sum hru pa legs par sbyar ba saṃ sgro ta'i skad du phid la/ dbang phyogs gong ma'i rgyal khab tu ting zi/ stod 'grel du dmar ser can/ dbang thang dang bstun me mo sprul lo smin drug gi nya ba'i dkar phyogs gral tshes dge bar shākya'i dge slong blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshos sngon ma'i bca' yig la gzhir byas te pho brang chen po po ta —— 94 —
ske

rgyal ma chog bdun pa chen pos chos sde chen boXse na theg chen gling la bstsal ba'i /khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge nab gsal nonaXbu'i me long bye/sa bya ba bzhugs so /me sprul lo/ (spyo lo 172yi7)dmigs med thus/sa rje'i rlabs phreng dkar po dus las yol min rgya mtsho'i gshis/ /phul byung snying stobs nor rgyas gzhon nus 'khyud nga 'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /zung 'jug rin chen khams bzhi'i lhun pos chad med bsrubs pa'i snyeng po las / /rnam pa kun mkhyen bdud mi'i ro brnyes sgo ram shing pa rgyal gyur cig / kun mkhyen lha yi rnga chen las 'phos chos kyi sdom bzhi'i sgras/ /dbyeg 'dzin lto ba rnam pa drug tu g.yo ba'i zlos gar dang / /lhan cig 'gro la mdza' ba gsar pa'i dga' ston mchog gi gter/ / spel mdzad 'phags yul shing rta che dang srol 'dzin mkhas grub bsngags/ /bsil ldan mi dur dkar po'i phreng ba mgul pa'i do shal du/ /sgeg pa'i rtse dga' khong nas 'dzum pa'i lus can lag pa rer/ / dgos 'dod ci dgar stsol mdzad sngon byon lo paṇa rgyal blon gyi/ /rnam thar bka' drin dran pas dus kyi — 96 —

mthar yang bsngags 'os gyur/ /brgyad khri/ ba'i stong bka' yi nying khu rlung thob brgyud kyi zas / /nom dpyod lto bar bzhu ba'i gdams ngag sgris par 'thul tsam gyis/ //chos min gser ldan spobs pa 'phrog byed sngon med brtul zhus/sa 'chang / /mar me mdzad/ dpa'/ yab sras drang srong grags pa sa 'dir ‘ra bar/ /ma smad mkhyen rab rab dkar rdul brtsegs lhun po'i mched zla'i spor/// /mi 'jigs sbar khyim bzhi yis log/ smra'i ri dwags klad pa 'gems/ 1/bdag med nges don chos/ kyi sgra brgyas phyos/sa bcu'i khong pa kun/ /'as/sa nus 'jam 'gon mi yi seng se tsong la pa la 'dud/ /byams chen nam yang mi 'dzad ga ka'i chus/ /zhe sdang tsha reg gzhil byed shākya yi/ //ring lugs tshad med gdong bzhi'i 'dzum zeng can/ /ye shes mes po'i sgyu 'phrul rmad du byung / /mtha' med sems can khur chen gzugs kyi go/ /'byed la snying rje'i nam mkha' yangs pa'i ngos/ /gang 'dul 'phrin las rab 'byams ta ma la/ /rim byon pad dkar 'chang rnams phyag gi yul/ /ngag dbang tshangs sras ngang mo 'i zlos gar gyis/ /mgrin mtsho dpal sgyu mgur du g.yang chags pa/ /blo gros zur phud lnga pa'i mkhyen bzang la/ /'gran 'os rgya mtsho'i bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /sdug bsngal rba klong 'khrug pa'i 'khor mtsho las/ /bslab gsum gru dzing brtan pos yid can kun/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i khang bzang nyams dga' bar/ /'khrid mdzad rim byon mkhan brgyud tshogs la 'dud/ /tshul khrims rtsa ba mi shigs yongs 'du'i rtser/ /mang thos dge la 'dun pa'i me tog bkra/ /don gnyis 'dod dgu'i 'bras dud bsod nams zhing / /mchog gyur 'dus tshogs nags klung rgyal gyur cig / las nyon kun 'byung 'thibs po'i mig rum tshogs/ / mthar bskrod sa steng phan dang bde ba yi/— 97 —

/snang byed 'od rlabs 'dzum pas sgod bcud kun/ /grol snyam thub bstan nyi ma las ga/zhan sa/nga / / rgyal bstan nying khu/ dmar ser 'od/ kyi bcud // /'thungs yas rnam bar grol ba'i 'dab ma brgya/ / cher ba 'ad zhwa ser 'chang ba'i dge 'dun sdes// /sa chen pad mo'i tshal bzhin dge legs byas/ /de phyir bstod bsnga/gas ba dan sa gsum na/ / rnam par g.yo ba'i da/ge 'dun blang dor rim// // nges legs lang tsho'i gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ / rab gsal nor bu'i pe long 'di na mchis/ / zhes shis pa brjod pa'i tshig/ gis sdun bsus te/ sangs rgyas phal po che las/ ji ltar zla ba shar gyur pa/ /tshad med pa yi gzugs brnyan rnams/ / chu yi snod du snang gyur kyang / / zla ba gnyis su gyur pa med/ / de bzhin chags med mkhyen ldan rnams/ /chags med rnam par 'tshang rgya bas/ / zhing rnams kun tu rab tu snang / /sangs rgyas la ni gnyis snang med/ /'di las gcig kyang yod ma yin/ /sku ni gnyis sam gsum du med/ /ji ltar sems can bsam pa bzhin/ /tshad med par ni rab tu snang / / sbu ni 'das pa ma yin te/ / ma 'ongs ba yang sku ma yin/ /skyes dang byang chub mya ngan 'das/ /skad cig gcig gis rab tu snang / / ji ltar sgyur mar gyur pa'i gzugs/ / skyes pa ma yin 'ongs pa min/ / de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku/ / skye ba med las shin tu bstan/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ yang dag pa rdzogs sa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos kyi sku las g.yo ba mi mnga' zhing rnam par rtog par med bzhi/na du dpe na chu sgod kyi bye brag so sor zla ba'i gzugs brnyan 'bad med du mtha' yas par snang ba bzhin mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad rang gis brnyes pa'i go 'phang mthon po la bkrir bzhengs nas sku dang gsung dang — 98 ——

thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam par dkar ba'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa 'khor ba ji srid pa de srid du rgyun mi 'chad pa las 'jig rten gyi khams 'dir lha rnams kyis gser gyi pad ma stong gi mtshan ma mthong ba las/sangs rgyas stong 'byung ba'i ltas su shes te/ kye ma bskal pa 'di ni bzang po'o zhes bsngags pa brjod pa'i dbyangs dar dir du sgrog pa las/ pad ma stong mthong ngam bskal pa bzang po zhes grags pa 'di la/ rgyal ba nyi ma stong 'byung ba'i nang nas bzhi pa rnam 'dren shwakya seng ges lus can spyi dang khyad par snyegs ma lnga lhag par bdo ba'i mi mjed kyi thing 'di nyid phyag mtshan du bzhes te smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab/ bya dka' ba'i spyod pa mtha' yas pas bla na med pa'i byang chub mngon du mdzad de tshe lo brgya pa'i dus kyi gdul bya tha mal pa dag gis kyang mthong ba'i skal ba can du mchog bi/ sprul pa'i sku'i rnam par rol bas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa ni/ mdo las/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi bkru zhing / / 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min te/ / chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar blang dor gyi gnas phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i gdams ngag gi don gdul byas nyams su blangs pas rgud pa mtha' dag bzlog cing / thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob par byed pa las thabs gzhan gyis 'gro ba mngon mtho nges legs kyi sar bkri bar mi nus la/ de yang lung sman gyi gzhi las/ dge slong dag tshul khrims goms par byas na ting nge 'dzin yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ ting nge 'dzin goms par byas na shes rab yun ring du gnas par 'gyur ro/ shes rab goms par byas na 'di lta ste/ 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang gti mug —— — 99 —

las sems yang dag pa kho nar rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ chags sogs nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi rtsa bar gyur pa'i bden 'dzin de nyid bdag med pa'i gnas lugs phyin ce ma log par rtogs pa'i shes rab goms par byas pas ldog la/ de'i rgyur sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa'i zhi gnas sam ting nge 'dzin sngon du 'gro dgos/de skye ba la lus ngag gi nyes spyod mtha' dag las ldog cing / sems dul ba dang zhi bar byed pa'i spong sems tshul khrims gal che ya la dgongs nas dpal dgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par gsungs/ / zhes rgyu ba dang mi rgyu ba'i sgod bcud 'jig rten thams cad kyi rten sa chen po yin pa ltar tshul khrims 'di nyid yon tan thams cad skye ba'i rten nam gzhi mar bsngags shing /khyad par du so so thar pa'i mdo las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ / 'di ni khyod kyi ston pa zhes/ / rang byung nyid kyis gus bcas par/ / nan tan dge slong tshogs mdun stod/ / ces mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde snod bstan pa yin kyang ston pa'i go mi chod 'dul ba'i sde sgod bstan pa dang ston pa gnyis ka yin par gsungs pa dang 'dul ba lung las/ btsun pa ji tsam gyis na dam pa'i chos mchis pa zhes bgyi/ / ji tsam gyis na zhig pa zhes bgyi/ / yu pa li/ ji srid du las byed cing nan tan byed pa yang yod pa'i bar du ste las byed la nan tan byed pa yang yod na dam pa'i chos yod pa zhes bya'o/las kyang mi byed la nan tan byed pa dag kyang med na de ni dam pa'i chos zhig pa zhes bya'o/ zhes rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yod med kyang bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i sde snod la nan tan dang las kyi cho ga tshul bzhin yod med la la 100 la
