rag lus par gsungs shing / de yang bsil ldan ra ba dkar pos bris pa'i ljongs 'dir snga dar la rgyal blon paṇa grub byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bka' drin las/ rab tu byung ba'i sde gsar du tshugs nga sogs bstan pa rin po che nyin mo'i snang bas blang dor la rmongs pa'i mun pa'i go skabs rgyang ring du bskrad mod kyang / ma rtogs pa dang log pad rtog pa dang the tshom gyi dri mas sbags par gyur pa'i tshe/ dpal mnyam med dī paṃ ka ra shrī dz+nyā nas slar yang bstan pa'i rtsa ba la nyes pa'i dri ma mtha' dag bsal te rgyal ba'i bka' sde snod gsum po ma lus pa gdams ngag tu shar ba'i sbol rnam par dag pas gangs can gyi ljongs khyab par gyur/slar yang rgyal ba'i mdo sngags kyi chos tshul mtha' dag la 'khrul pa phra mo tsam yang spangs te ston pa'i bstan pa la thub dbang gnyis pa lta bur gyur pa ni 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rgyud las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das 'og tu/ /sa yi steng 'dir stongs pa na/ /khyod nyid byis pa'i gzugs can/ gyis/ /sangs rgyas mdzad pa byed par 'gyur/ /de tsho dgon chen rab dga' ba/ / kha ba can nang yod pa yin/ / zhes gnas dang dus dang dga' ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling gi ming zur bcas rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs dge slong gi gzugs can gyis sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa dang 'dra ba mdzad par lung gis bstan pa ltar chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bka' drin las mtha' dbus kyi lus can tshad med grangs med pa zhig mdo sngags kyi blang dor phra zhing phra ba la'ang lta ba'i mig dang snang ba thob nas/ rgyal bstan dri ma med pa'i srog 'thud par gyur/ bye brag tu rje bdag nyid chen pos se ra chos sdings su rtsa she'i 'grel chen rig pa'i rgya mtsho mdzad pa'i dus/ gser zhun las grub ba'i sher phyin — 101 —

gyi yi ge gsal la ma 'dres pa bar snang la gzigs pas theg chen bshad sgrub ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas kyi 'dus pa'i sde zhig 'byung bar lung bstan pa ltar/byams chen chos rje shākya ye shes kyis 'debs par mdzad cing / de nas brtsams mkhan brgyud byang chub sems dpa' mkhas grub kyi phreng ba rim bzhin tshar du dngar ba dang / khyad par dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho nas bzung thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma rim byon dag gis chos kyi khri 'phang mthon por dbang sgyur cing / skal ldan gyi skye bo mtha' yas pa thos bsam sgom pa'i gru dzing la brten te nges legs kyi nor bu len pa la 'jug ngogs rgya mtsho chen po dang 'dra ba'i gzhir gyur pa se ra zeg pa chen po'i gling zhes yongs su grags pa'i grwa sa chen po 'di'i dge 'dun rnams kyi kun tu spyod pa'i rnam par thar pa ni mdo las/ srid pa'i zug ju gcod byed lam/ /ngas ni khyed cag rnams la bstan/ / de bzhin gshegs pa ston pa ste/ /khyed cag rnams kyis bya dgos so/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar ston ba thugs rje can de nyid kyis 'o skol la srid pa'i nyes brgya drung nas 'byin pa'i thabs tshul ji lta ba bzhin du 'doms par mdzad pa la/ rang gi blang dor phyin ci ma log pas ji ltar bstan pa la ma zhugs na/ dper na sman pa mkhas pas nad kyi zug rngu gtan nas 'joms par byed nus pa'i sman bzang zhing phangs pa byin du zin kyang / nad pa rang nyid kyis ma 'thung na nad las thar par mi 'gyur zhing rang gi nyes bas rang bsrus pa dang 'dra bas na spyir sde sgod rin po che gsum/ khyad par rab tu byung ba rnams kyis blang dor ston pa'i 'dul ba'i sde sgod las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin nyams su bstar ba las lhag pa'i bca' khrims ma mchis pas na/ lung sde bzhi las gsungs pa'i bcas mtshams — 102 —

'dor ba/ gnyid/ gleng mo/ lag rtsed/ kha g.yeng / mig g.yeng /kha btums/ gzhogs ga rgyas sogs ma yin par mu tig star la brgyus pa ltar yid du 'ong bar bzhugs shing / zhal 'don gyi rim pa la thugs mi g.yengs shing tshang ma mgrin gceg dbyangs gcig gis dang ba 'dren par byed/ bza' btung gi tsha hub cag gyi sgra dang bcas pa dang / lces byog pa sogs mi mdzes pa rgyang ring du bsrings te kha zas sman dang 'dra ba'i dran shes kyis bsten par gral khrod du dge 'dun la brda sprod dgos kyi rigs byung na dge skos las gzhan pa mi 'gro/ rgyun gyi tshogs la yun ring thung mtha' gcig tu nges bzung dka' ba 'dug kyang 'bring por cha bzhag na sbyin bdag si/ sku rim dmigs bsal gang dgos rigs kyang ma chad pa 'gro nges shes pa las/ zom lus mi yong ba dang / gzhan ma skyabs sems gnas bcu phyag mchod sogs sngon/ du 'gro ba'i mang ja dang po'i gong du smon lam bzhi dang de rjes mdo tshar gsum dang / seng gdong ma'i gzungs phreng 'khor re dang bcas pas bstan 'gro spyi bye brag la gnod pa dang / dgon khrod du rkun ma byed pa/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen byed pa/ rtsa bzhi/ chang dang bcas pa spyod pa/se ra shar dang tha 'og rnams su chang btsongs pa/ bshas ra byas pa sogs la dmigs bzlog pa tshar gsum re byed/ de rjes sa lam dang ring 'tsho'i tshigs bcad sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams gdangs dang bcas bab chags re mos kyis btang ba'i mjug tu gtor 'bul dang gtor ma rgya rtsa drug hru pa bcas sngar srol chag med gtong / mang ja sne bzhag byed lugs sna tshogs pa zhig byung na/ sbyin bdag sogs khag bsun dang / ma dad pa'i khyim pa sun 'byin gyi rgyur 'gro ba 'dug bsams/ gtan 'khel grwa pa nyi shu — 104 ——

rtsa lnga re'i sar ja spor do re'i dbang du byas nas/ dge 'dun sum stong gi rtsis la ja nyag drug hru/ mar de'i sum skor la ma mtha' byas pa'i bzang ngan 'bring gsum kyi 'gro tshod gang yin drang por bshad pa'i sbyin bdag rang gi 'dod pa dang sbyar ba la 'os min gyi len che mi byed/ de mtshungs 'bul ba dang / sne gzhag che kha gsum chung kha brgyad mgon khang nyin dar sogs kyang gang phul bab mtshungs las rtsod pa spu tsam mi byed/ mdun ja gzim khang la sbar tshad bzhi/ dge skos la sbar tshad do re/ ja ma chu len me 'bud bcas la sbar tshad re dge rgan grwa rkyang 'khyer 'khos med pa'i rigs kyis sbyin bdag gi sne len dgos par btung ja'i thebs 'dengs tsam gyi tshod dad 'bul dang len las mi 'os pa'i ham che mi byed/ 'du khang du mar nyag re'i mar khu 'gro tshod kyi mchod kong gnyis dang / snga ja yin na dge skos gnyis la dpa' 'bar re/ tshogs la zhun mar gnyis/ rung khang la zhun mar gnyis bcas las lhag pa mi len/ rung khang la ja tshul do dam pa gcig ja ma gsum/me 'bud gnyis/ chu len gnyis/ zhal ta ba gnyis/ sbyin bdag gi mi gnyis ma gtogs mi 'jog mang ja nas byams chen chos rjer ja phud sngar rgyun dang sbyin bdag la rkyan tshad gsum rigs gra bar rkyan tshad do/ byams smon/ bzang spyod/ gtor sgrub pa bcas la rkyan tshad re ma gtogs mi 'khyer/ gzim khang du rkyan tshad do las lhag pa dmigs bsal dgos rigs byung na dge skos la gnang ba zhus gnang las 'os min mi byed/ sngar srol la byes blod gnyis kyi ja mas rkyan bu bcu gcig re dang / stod ja mas rkyan bu bdun bsgrigs shing / ma bsgrigs sne gzhan gcod pa'i srol yod 'dug par da cha rung khang du ja khra 'dangs pa yod pas de rigs dkrig chag — 105 —

mi dgos/ ja ro spungs nas 'jog pa las thab g.yog gis 'khyer na ja mi thon pa'i rkyen dang / kha zhag bsags kyang tshogs pa la gnod gzhir 'gyur bas mi bsags/ 'gyed dang tsha ra dge skos kyis tshogs gtam rgyun la nad pa mtshams pa'i rigs ma gtogs zhal mngon du ma gyur pas ska la ba blangs mi chog ces gtong ba'i srol ltar dpe mtshams pa/ grwa skor ba/ rang mtshams kyis 'bul sdud du phyin pa sogs la skal ba mi gtong bas mtshon 'gyed gtong rtsa tshig gi don las g.yo med byed/ khams tshan dang mi tshan ci rigs nas phyogs lhung dang za 'dod kyis mang ja dang 'gyed sogs tshogs chen gyi bsnyen bkur grwa tshang la bsgyur ba/ grwa tshang gi bsnyer bkur khams tshan la bsgyur ba sogs yong gi yod 'dug pa dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo 'phrog ba'i nyes pa bsam las 'das pas 'bras bu brnag dka' ba kho na'i rgyu bsgrub pa las ma mchis pas de rigs gtan nas mi byed/ gzhung nas btang ba'i mang ja'i ja gad gzim khang gnyer sdod dang ja tshul do dam pas khur len sngar sbol bzhin byed/spyi sos phogs rgyag dus bla gnyer dge skos gzhung gi ngo tshab sogs sbrel ba'i chos grwa ba sogs la gtong lugs dang / grwa tshang yas mas gnyis sngar ltad re mos byed/ skal ba sogs dgos nges kyi rigs la tshang mas zhib 'jug gis rgyag pa las nye dga' phyogs skyor gyi gtong thal mi byed/ sde 'di ga'i thos pa don gnyer spi rigs kyis gso dpyad rtsis sogs rig gnas gzhan la mtshan nyid kyi bslab gnyer ma tshar bar don gnyer byed mi 'jug lus kyis rkyen theg cing shes rab yod bzhi/na du chos grwa mi 'grim par sos dal du mi sdod cing / tshong khe spogs dang nas bun 'dzugs pa sogs mi byed/ snga thog shes rab dang shes 'dod yod pa'i rigs rnams dang por ra ba stod du phyin — 106 —

pa'i bsdus tshad la bslab gnyer dang / grwa sar po ti gzhan ma rnams la bslab sbyangs mthar phyin pa'i dge bshes mang ris/sa da/nga / de rigs be/sa 'dod med pa la yas chag mas chag gi tha snyad byas pa'i rnam 'grel sogs kyi g.yeng ba bskyungs te dbu phar gyi thal phreng la dmar 'jus byas nas po ti bzhi zur bkol dang bcas pa tshang ma 'grel ba'i dge bshes re yang yo nga gi yod 'dus/ kyang / phyis grwa sar rang du bsdus tshad rnam rtog sod sod re btang bas gzhan la bslab sbyangs la 'gro ba'i go yang 'gags shing / po ti phyi ma'i bslab gnyer la yang hrung zad gnod yod 'dug pas na bsdus grwa 'os rigs ma gtogs tshang mar don gnyer yod pa rnams ra ba stod du 'gro gang (mdod gtong ba dang / grwa sar phyi log gi skabs kyang bkag cha mi byed/ de mtshungs sngags kyi thos bsam don gnyer can gyi rigs kyang rgyud stod smad du 'gro bar yang bkag cha mi byed// zhogs pa'i mang ja grol bstun grwa tshang khag so so'i chos grwa'i 'khar rnga'i brda byung ba dang bstun chu khye phan gī so so'i chos rwa chos 'chad kyi sgrig lam kun spyod gang yin la cha bzhag pa'i thos bsam je 'phel gyi bstan pa rin po che'i rgyan du 'gro ba byed/ snga sor khams sog gis gzhi ba byed srol med 'dug kyang / bar skabs su sna tshogs shig byung yod 'dug pas da nas bzung khams sog dang gzhis dgon yod pa'i rigs kyis gzhi ba byas mi chos/ dbu la gyi bslab gnyer chags nges par ma gtogs ming btags kyi rigs mi ster/ dbu phar brtsi bzhag gi steng nas tshang ma song zhing 'dul mdzod rnam 'grel sogs phyogs dod nges pa'i yon tan bzang nges can la sde 'di ga'i dka' bcu dang / dbu phar 'dul bcas brtsi bzhag gi steng nas tshang ma song zhing / mdzod dang rnam 'grel dpe thog la 107 la

nas so/nga ba'i bslab gnyer bzang nges par spyo na lam sos/sa sa//dong gral ba'i ming btags dang / se ra ngang si/ rdo gcal rab 'byams pa yang po ti'i 'gro lugs bo/nga ltar gyi bslab gnyer bzang rigs kho/ na la gtod/ so so'i chos grwa dang grwa tshang yas mas gnyis kyi ris/sa chung / tshogs chen/ ris/sa grwa/dbyar sa/nas sogs kyi bshad/ pa dang dam bca' ring thung po ti so sor byed srol sa/nga yin sngar srol bzang po gong 'phel du gtong ba las sla bcos byed bdes nyams chag/ tu 'gro ba mi byed// gling bsre tshar bstun rigs chen/ gyi tshogs langs kyang po ti phyi ma 'dul mdzod gnyis nas dgun gyi gling bsre bas snga rgol dang / dbyar gyi gling bsre bas phyi nol re nges par len pa dang / bka' bzu bar ma zad gdong gral ba sus kyang gling bsre'i bshad pa tshogs langs la mi bldab cing / gzhung don bor pa'i spyi bshad kyi bshad yams mang ba dang lo lo bzhin gzhung chung sa/cig la bldab pa sogs gling bsre'i bshad pa dang tshogs langs ba sus kyang mi byed/ gdong gral gyi ming btags thog mar byas pa nas bza/da ring bar gzhung snga phyi/ phyis gzhung bcas bzhi la bshad ring gtso bor bton/ bar gzhung snga ma yan chad yang yang len pa dang / dma' mtha' yang bshad ring nas phyi gzhung gi bar rim par blangs te ma rdzogs bar gyi lo gsum tshun la rgya tshom du dgongs pa zhus gnang mi byed/ ming btags pa'i rigs la bslab gnyer med kyang rin gyis hos chog pa yong 'dug zer ba sogs kyi gleng bcas bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par grwa sa grwa tshang so so'i mtshan don la yon tan med rigs kyis ming btags blangs pa shin tu gnod pa yong 'dug pas bla ma sogs sne mor mngags pa rnams kyis blo gzu bor gnas pa'i tshul dang mthun pa byed/la 108 la

bla ma bsko bzhag dgos rigs ga/nga 'dra zhig yin kyang grwa dmangs 'al mthun gyi 'os nges thes pas mtshon yon tan can grwa rim 'a sa/ la/ mas tshan mi tshan so/gas kyis ngan shed spyir btang dmigs bsal la bsnyad pa'i nye dga' phyogs lhu nga ge 'os tho mi bkod/ tshogs chen dge skos bsko bzhag sngo na du grwa tshang khag la da/'i ching bā dur dri ba byed bcug pa'i don bzhin bcas mtshams gyi yi se logs su yod pa ltar dang / spyi gnyer bcas kyang so so ra bab 'brel yod nges las 'os min 'os thor mi rgyag/ de mtshungs4 tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyang grwa tshang gnyis nas 'os bab lngar sbol ltar byed/ ngam ring sogs phyogs la grwa skor la 'gro mi rnams kyang yon tam/ 'bring tsam med nga ra btang na grwa sa'i zhabs 'dren yong gshis so so'i slob dngo na pas bslab gnyer med pa rnam sa 'gro sa med pa'i bsdam ra byed/ de ma tshungs gsang phur 'gro mi tsho yang phar phyin gyi thal phreng song mtshams 'gro zhing / bshad pa'i yun nyi ma dang mang ja'i grangs bcad sog/sa sgrig lam la ji ltar yod pa bzhin las rang gang 'dod kyi mtshams nas log pa'i dbang shed kho na byas zer ba'i gleng yang yod 'dug pas de lugs la ma song ba'i tshul gnas gang yin las rang 'dod mi byed/ zho ston gyi skabs zla ba drug pa'i tshes nyer dgu'i gung tshigs thon nas zla ba bdun pa'i tshes gcig gi gung tshigs tshun la nye 'brel gyi bud ped sogs dgon nang du yong bar gnang ba byin/ de nas phyir log gi tho brtsigs pa dang / phur mjal skabs zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i tshes nye drug gi gung tshigs nas gnam gang gi gung tshigs tshun gnang ba sngar ltar ster kyang / dgon nang du chang 'thung / klu gzhas/ nub mo bsdad pa sogs blo lad dang mi mdzes pa'i rgyu yin 'dug gshis de rigs byed du mi — 109 —

'jus/ grwa tshang phan tshun gyi slob dpon bar spyir btang chos 'brel zhu bar bkag cha med kyang / grwa tshang gcig gi grwa pas cig shos kyi slob dpon par brtsis bzhag mi nyan/ dbang rjes gnang lung zhu sogs kyang mngon chung las chos rwar gnod pa'i bag yangs mi byed cing / mdo sngags gang gi sgo nas kyang gnas sga/bas mthar thug gi dgos don ji 'dra zhig bsgrub dgos kyang / rang re'i lugs srol 'di nyid kyis mi chog pa dang mi 'thus rgyu ci yang med pas yid ches kyi nges pa sa/ting nas drangs te lta grub mi gcig ba'i rigs la shes 'dod dang dgon nang du bstan pa spyi dang dge lugs las lta grub mi gcig pa'i rig/sa kyi chos spyod mi 'don/ sgrig 'gal gyi skor/ rtsa bzhi chang dang bcas la mthong thos dogs gsum gyi sgo nas rtsad chod pa dang dge skos la kha lan lag lan slog pa byung na/ gaṇ+ḍi shog thod kyis gnas dbyung gtong zhing / de las gzhan pa rmas khrag byung ba/ gri bton pa/lag 'thab byas pa sogs nyes byas kyi rigs la gang la gang 'tshams kyi tshar gcod rjes 'dzin byed/ nang tshags kyi sgrig lam kun spyod kyi do khur dge skos gnyis kyis nye dga' phyogs skyor spangs ba'i gzu bor gnas pa byed dgos shing / lar rgya'i khog dang phyi nang gi khrims gcod dgos rigs gzim khang gnyer pas drang bzhag gi bkod khyab byed/ mda' rdo skor mchongs mig mangs shor da ra sogs bag med kyi spyod pa'i rigs dgon phyi nang gang sar bkag cha gang dam byed/ grwa sar zhugs ma thag pa dang btsun chung rigs dge rgan med par thab mi 'dzin cing / grwa sa phan tshun dang khams tshan 'thab rtsod kyis mtshon dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang / bstan bshig khrims 'gal byas rigs pa gte po sde tshan dang bcas par rgyal khrims — 110 ——

kyi tsa ra) yo/nga 'gro ba 'dir ga/ru/la ma dgos / gnas mjal ba bud ped yin phyin gnang ba zhus pa'i nyin 'khor las bsten skyabs mi byed/ dbo/na nang du skya ser dmangs bcas kyis rta bzhon nas mi 'gro zhing / gyang ga 'a/sa ma yin pa'i glu dang rgyang 'bod/ ku co'i sgra che ba mi sgrog zhing las kyi rigs grwa pas byed sa med/ lta grub mi ga/cig pa'i mi dang / g.yung po sogs grwa tshang dang khams tshan so so'i thob khungs yin pa rgyu mtshan du byas nas bsten sgor byas na phan mi thogs shing gnod pa'i rgyur 'dug pas mi bsten/ mtshan nyid kyi grwa sa nas gnas skor la rtsol ba byas na blo lad dang slob gnyer la gnod pas chos grwa ba rnams 'gro sa med/ da se// 'dun la bgo ring mi chog pa'i rnyed pa'i rigs spyi pa'i mdzod du 'jog bod rang du bsod snyoms byed pa 'dul ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun pas bkag cha mi dgos 'dra yang /rgya sog gi yul khams sogs la spyi don gyi 'bul sdud slong mo byed mi ma gtogs spyi don med par kha mthun/ gyi slong mo mi byed/ dge 'dun gyi nang khrims dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa ngos ma blangs par song rigs dang / dgon gzhan nas nyes can bud pa'i rigs kyang mi bsten/ nag chang 'di 'byung nye ba'i dgag bya shin tu che ba yin 'dug pas dbyar chos dgun chos gnyis kyi dus su ba/nang ba gtan nas mi ster zhing / gzhan yang bla ma mjal ba/gnas 'jal/ 'u lag lta bu'i dmigs bsal gtong dgos kyi rigs ma gtogs bud med kyi 'grim 'grul gtan nas byed mi 'jug mgon khang phan tshun gyi nang mchod tsam ma gtogs chang gi 'grim 'grul kyang bkag cha gang dam dge skos kyis do khur byed/ mgar ba/ lham mkhan/ sprang po sogs mi nag gi gzhis sdod byed du mi 'jug lha sar don gcod la yong ba — 111 —

lta bus mtshon 'grul pa'i rigs la dge rgan ham pa can la la sa //bams tshan gyi thon khungs yin pa cam la brten/ chas ka 'a/ rgya bsdems sa//nas tshang du 'tshangs pa'i 'phrog brtsam shed khyer byed nga 'i rigs byung gros 'dug nga //grwa sa chen po rnams rlabs kyis 'gros dgos sa/shis de ris/sa grwa sa'i 'bas 'dren dang rab da tu byung ba'i kun spyod dang 'gal bas mi byed/ /krom la bre srang sbor gsum spyi gzim/ bla brang yas ma sa sa/nas dag gnyis ma gtog/sa gzhan ma sus kyang mi rgyub/ lnga mas tshong thag ma bcad par phyi mas hab thob dang lkes/ tshong mi byed/ gling gseb tu 'gro lam chu yur sogs snang bar ba/nga dran mi bzo/ lcags ri'i rgya sbo/ ba'i/ dang dar chen bcas gzim khang dang bla brang gsum nas /7dzin spra sa byed/ lcags ri'i sa rtsis thob khungs so so nas legs par gtso 'don gyi/ba/ sa/sol/ dgon nang du bla brang khag dang gzim la// nga bcas la rta dre'u sogs dge 'dun gyi yo byad sgrub rten la/ dgos nges ma gtogs bag med kyis nyar tshags mi byed/ spyi gnyer gnyis la rta gsum re/ja tshul do dam par rta gnyis/ 'bul bar byung rigs tshong bsgyur ma thub pa'i rigs zla gcig tshum/ dang / phyogs nas don gcod par skebs skabs zhag lnga la mang ma tha' byas nga / khams tshan dang spyil po che ba sogs su zhag gsum tshun gnang ba zhus gnang las de phan rta dre'u sogs sus kyang mi sa/so/gling gseb tu bong bu 'a/ga por mi 'jog tha 'og se ra shar rnams su chang nyo 'tshong dang / bshas ra mi byed/ nag bcangs mi srid/ bya phag mi gso/dgon pa'i rgyab ri dang nye skor du bya dang ri dwags mi brngon/ rigs grwa lnga thog khams tshan re mos kyis gtong srol yod 'dug kyang g.yeng bas bslab gnyer la gnod gshis rigs grwa spyi gnyer dang byams smon bzang spyod da lta'i —— 112 —

sro/po 'a/ma ba'i na gtong // gso spyong gi tshe sa/ka'i brda nam byung la dge tshu la slong 'du bang nus nga tham sa cad byon nas rang rang gi phyir bcos sngon du 'gro bas gso spyong mdzad cing / dbyar gnas dgas/ dbye'i dus kyang tshang mas 'du ba so gas dge 'dun gyi kum/ spyod gong 'phel du 'gro ba dang // ljongs rgyu'i tshe da/ma bca' mchod mja'/ so sas bag yod las spyod rtsing rigs mi byed/des mtshon dge/ tshul slong tham sa cad kyis rang rang gi bslab bya che chung la lta rtog dang bslab pa cha/na pa dang gnas kyi bla ma sogs bsten te bcas mtsham ba mtha' das mig ltos yar blta'i sgo nas lag len la 'debs ci thub ngos bsta na pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i bca' khrims rnam par das/ pas 'gro ba thams cad kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing dam par 'gyur ba zhib/ mdzad dgo/sa pa ni/ rje bdag nyid chen pos dge 'dun gyi khrims su bca' ba dang po mdzad pa las// rgyal ba sras dang slob mar bcas pa la gus pa dang bstan pa rin po che la gces spras su 'dzin pa dang / bstan pa phyogs re bar ma song bar rgyal ba'i dgongs pa'i gnad yongs su rdzogs pa'i lugs bzang po mi nub pa la brtson par mdzad pa rnams kyis shin tu rlabs che ba'i thugs khur bsnams nas rang yang de la gnas/ gzhan yang de la 'god/ chos mthun pa mthong na legs par bsngas/sa pa'i sgo nas brtson pa chen po thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ mjo/ra na mtho dman 'bring gsum gyis thams cab/ nas thugs khur rgya chen po bsnams la dge 'dun gyi khrims su bca' ba 'di'i gzhung srong ba mdzod/ rgyal ba sras dang slob ma'i tshogs bka' sdod dang bcas pa —rnams kyis kyang / mngon par 'dod pa'i gan/sa 'di dag bgegs med phar bde blag tu 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ bslab par bya ba'i gzhi'i —— 113 ——

phyogs re ba ma yin pa'i bsta na pa'i gnad yongs su rdzogs pa la ba mi ba tshul phyogs re ba ma yin pa'i thos pa dang bsam pa dang bsgom pa gsum char gyi sgo nas bslab pa'i khrims su bca' ba 'di sgo thams cad nas phyogs thams cad du dar zhi/ nga rgyas la yun ring du gnas bar gyur cig ces gsungs pa ltar yin/ de ltar bslab bya'i yo/nas la bas/ yod kyi sgo nas tshul bzhi/na du gnas pa gzhi/ra bzung / mngon pa mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis re/ / lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed pa/ / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ // zhes pa'i don bzhin lung sde sgod gsum/ la 'chad nyan gyi sgo nas bslab sbyangs la zhe thag pa nas brtson pa chen pos thos shes rab kyis mkhas pa'i gral du son pa dang / thos pa'i rjes 'jug sgrub pa snying por byed/ skye ba'i rdzong las tshegs chung thar bar 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar /kha phyir blta/sa kyi dred por po / song bar thos nga 'i don de dag gdams ngag/ gi/ snying ngo/ra shes pa'i rbo nos rgyud steng du bsam pa dang bsgom pa'i nyams len la gzhol bas 'u nga rtogs kyi bstan pa 'phel ba mdzad dgos/spyi bstan pa dge 'dum/ gyi sde la rag lus pa dang / de'i nang nas kyang bstan pa'i snying po dri ma med pa gangs can gyi ljongs 'di'i zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i sde kho na ma rag lus/ khyad par du yang thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bu lta bu grwa sa chen po se 'bras dge gsum 'di nyid yin pas na/ 'di dag tu bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong gi rab tu byung ba'i ngang tshul las 'gong na// chu rka 'go nas rnyogs pa'i dpe ltar 'byung bas/ mtha' dbus kyi 'a gro ba thams cad kyi mig rkyen tu 'gyur zhing / spyir kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs dang / bre brag dpal mnyam med ri bo dga' ldan pa'i ring — 114 —

lugs 'di nyid dri ma med par rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi gzhi mtha' dag la khyab cing / mi nyams gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs tshul la 'bad pa lhur len pa mdzod cig smras pa/ thog ma bar mthar dge ba'i dam chos 'dzum/ /rnga yab dkar po las 'phos sim pa'i rlung / / kun mkhyen phyag gi 'du byed rnam dkar gyi/ /'phrin las bsil sbyin cho ga rmad po che/ /skye ba'i chu bo thur du 'bab ldan rgyun/ /srid gsum gnas ngan 'dzings pa'i ral khur khrod/ /gya gyur 'khor yang pha mtha' rnyed dka' ba'i/ /rgyu gcig 'jig tshogs lta ba'i ri 'joms slad/ /bdag ped ye shes khams kyi zho 'thung rus// /rtse mo brgya ba'i mtshon rnon 'chang ba po/ /bag yod khrims kyi sa srung steng 'gying ba'i/ /thar 'dod mchod sbyin brgya pa las gzhan/ su/ /de phyir rgyal bstan sngo sangs ma yi rgyan/ /dri ped so thar 'od 'bar nyin mor byed/ /rnam grol pad tshal gnyen du rtag 'char zhing / /tshul 'chal 'byung po'i bya tshogs long gyur cig /thub bstan gdengs can gtsug na gser 'od cha/ /'phro ba'i nor bu zhwa ser lugs bzang gis/ /mtha' klas yid can bsod nams bgo skal du/ / phan bde'i 'dod rgu char chen rtag snyil shog / bslab gsum se shing ra ba 'khrigs ba'i dbus/ /theg chen bshad sgrub 'byung khungs chos kyi gling / / rnam grol 'phags pa'i bste gnas 'og min zhing / /srid mthar mi nyams slar nas slar 'phel shog /skye bar tshad med phan pa'i nu zho yis/ /legs bskyangs mar gyur 'gro ba ma lus pa// /gnas skabs bde dga' nor bu'i jem skas la/ /'dzegs nas sku gsum khang bzang myur bgrod shog / ces mkhas mang rgya mtsho'i bste gnas 'gro kun bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa dam par gyur pas se ra theg chen gling zhes snyan grags kyi ba dan sa gsum na mngon par —— 115 —

mtho ba'i chos sde chen po'i khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge rab gas la nor bu'i me long 'e/sa bya ba 'di ni/ snga sor rang lo bcu bzhi pa lcags glang lor stod pa slob dpon rab 'byams nga phun tshogs bkra shis/ smad pa slob da/pon rab 'byams pa bsod nams rab brtan/ byes slob dpon rab 'byams nga blo bzang nam/ mkha'/ dge skos smad rab 'byam sa pa tshang dbyangs don grub/byes bka' bcu ngag dbang rin chen/ spyi so smad rab 'byams pa blo bzang rab brtan/ byes rab 'byams pa blo bzang dpal 'byor bcas kyis bskul ngor sgrig lam skor gyi bca' yig dang / srol snga phyir byung ba rnams nas snying po bsdus nga 'i bca' yig cig song ba/ de skabs nged rang na tshod phra bas zin bris la lta rtog 'jug pa tsam 'a/sa gang cir thi/ba cha ma byung stabs slar rang lo sum cu pa legs par sbyar ba saṃ sgro ta'i skad ru sid la/ dbang phyogs gong ma'i rgyal khab tu ting zi/ stod 'grel du dmar ser can/dbang thang dang bstun nga me mo sprul lo smin drug gis nya ba'i dkar phyogs/ gral tshes dge bar shākya'i dge slong blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshos sngon ma'i bca' yig la gzhi byas te pho brang chen po pho ta lar legs par sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni zha lu mkhan po ngag dbang yon tan 'byung gnas kyis bgyis pa dza ba/ / / /

na mo che bzhiXsdeXgrwa tshang dga'aXldan bsamaXgatan gling giXbaca' yig don gnyis non bu'i bang mjod ces bya ba bzhugs so/dus rabs bcoXbargyad pa'i lo rabs bzhi bcu tsam/dpag med bsod nams ye shes 'khor lo'i mtshon/ /rnon pos brdar ba'i snying po bden don gyi/ //bzu gnyis cha las nam yang mi nub pa'i/ /gzi 'bar nyi ma'i gnyen gyis dge legs stsol/ /thabs shes la 'jug/ rna/ma 'byed sa bon gyis/ /rang rang spangs rtogs dbyar skyes myu gu'i dpyid/ /skyed sring bdag gzhan phan bde'i 'bras bu mchos/ / stsol mdzad theg gsum dge 'dun phyag gi yul/ /sa hor ris/sa mtho ma la ya yi spor/ /mngon mtho'i kho lag yongs rdzogs dpal gyi shing / /bslab gsum dad pa 'thul des srid zhi yi/ / tsha gdung yongs bcil zhi ba 'tsho la 'dud/ / zab yangs shes bya'i gshes dang rab mnyam pa'i// /chu gter byang chub sems gnyis rlabs phreng da//ra/ /'dzum pas bde legs kun tu dga' mi mgron/ /bsu 'dra mar me mdzad ces gcig tu bsngags/ / mi shes dgra las rab rgyal ban ṭa ha/ /bskul las mdo sngags legs bshad sgra bo ches/ / rtas/ tu yid kyi ngal gso —— 117 —

ster ba'i lha/ /'jam mgon rtsang kha pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid dang zhi bas bsdus pa'i dngos kun la/ /rjes su song ba'i chos sku'i 'phrin las mkhar/ /dogs med 'char ba mi bzod yon tan kyi/ /cha tsam ma dmigs rgyal ba'i rmad thar gshis/ /khyad par 'khor ba'i gcong rong nyam nga las// /sgrol byed dang po la 'os spong ba'i khrims/ /lu gu rgyud du spel ba'i dpyang thag 'dir/ /so so thar zhes dam pa rnams kyis bsngags/ /de phyir spangs rtogs yon tan bzi chen po/ //khong nas 'char ba'i rnam grol bsam 'phel nor// /sgrub byed bslab khrims gtsang mar bca' ba'i zong / /byin gyi skal bzang tshogs rnams da longs shig / ces yul dam pa rnams la bstod bsngags man+da ra'i char chen/ po phan pa sngo na du btang nas skabs don gleng bar bya ba ni rgya che rol pa las/ mi dang sangs rgyas 'byung rnyed dka'/ /dad pa'ang shin tu rnyed nga/ra dka'/ /mi khom brgyad sbangs rnyed par dka/'a/ / chos nyan pa ni gtso bo yin/ / sangs rgyas 'byung dang dal ba dang / / dad dang chos nyan dam pa dang / /de dag thams cad da rnyed kyi// /bag med ma lus rnam par spongs/ / /gal te bskal pa khrag khrig tu/ /chos thos mi 'gyur srid pa de/ / khyod kyis de ring rnyed zin gyi/ /bag med ma lus rnam spang byos/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar//rang re rnams kyis bskal pa khrag khrig du mar sgra tsam yang thos par dka' ba'i bde 'gro'i rten dang / de'i nang nas kyang rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du thon re gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang dbang po dang 'tshams par legs par gsungs pa'i lung gi chos rnams/ bstan pa'i gtad rabs chen po bdun la sogs pa khams gsum kyi hon mongs pa ma tha' dag spangs pas rgyud tsan dan spangs pa lta bur bsil ba/ gser dang bom — 118 —

mnyam pa nam mkha' dang lag mthil du mtshungs pa'i sems dang ldan par gyur pa'i dgra bcom pa rnams nas bzung rna ba nas rna bar bar ma chad du brgyud pa dang yang dag par dzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos kyi gdul byar gyur pa rnams nas brtsams te gdul bya'i shes rgyud la 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i 'khor lo rin po che bzhin du gcig nas gcig tu 'khos pa'i bslab par rin po che gsum gyi rtogs pa'i bstan pa yongs su gsal ba'i dam nga 'i chos dang mjal ba'i rten bzang po dal ba brgyad dang 'byor ba bcu tshang ba 'di 'dra ba klu dbang gtsug gi nor bu bas kyang rnyed dka' thing don che ba yin la/ de ltar rten bzang po thob pa'i skabs 'dir/ tshoms las/ mi dran pa dang bag med dang / / brtson 'grus chung dang kun sdom med/ /gnyid dang snyom dang g.yeng ba ste/ /'di dag bslab pa'i bar chad pas/ /khyed kyis yan lag der rtogs la/ /dran pa chud ni ma gzon cig / ces dran pa nyams pa dang bag med pa dang brtson 'grus chung ba'am le lo dang /dbang po'i sgo yang dag par mi sdom pa dang / gnyid dang / snyom las dang /sems dmigs pa gcig la gtod par byed pa'i bgegs rnam g.yengs rnams tshul khrims kyi bslab pa sogs la bar du gcod pa'i chos su gsungs shing /khyad par bag ped pa ni nyon mongs pa kun gyi gzhi dang dkar po'i chos thams cad nyams pa'i rgyu gcig bur ma rdo/ las gsungs pa las na de'i gnyen por dus rtag tu bdag gi lus kyi spyod pa ni ci 'dra/ ngag gi spyod pa ni ci 'dra/rgyud kyi bsam pa ni ci 'dra zhes brtags te/ tha na rang gcig pu gnas pa'i lus kyi spyod lam lag pa brkyang bskum lta bu la'ang 'di 'dra ba ni dngul ba dang byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod sogs las ma bkag gam/ de dag las la 119 la

gnang ngam/ rang g.yin la phan pa zhig gam gnod pa zhig gam/ 'di las dge ba'i phyogs 'phel lam mi dge ba'i phyogs 'phel yang na de dag gang yang ma yin pa'i btang snyoms lung ma bstan zhig gam snyam du legs par brtags nas 'dul ba nas gnang ba sogs 'jug pa'i phyogs yin na de la gnas nas ma nyams par 'phel ba'i thabs la brtson thing / gal te ldog pa'i phyogs yin na/ de ya thag tu bya ba de las log nas slar yang de lta bu mi 'byung ba'i thabs la brtson pa byed dgos pa sogs mdor na dus rtag tu dran pa dang shes bzhin bsten nas lus ngag yid gsum zag pa mi dbe/ ba'i phyogs las sems bsrung ba ni bag yod brten pa'i don yin pas/ de nyid nyams len gyi snying por byas nas bsgrub dgos la/ de ltar bag yod skye ba la'ang /rje btsun byams pa mgon pos/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa goms las yang da/ga don yul ye shes 'byung / / de las chos thob de yod de la blo gros rab tu skye/ / gang tshe de ni so sor rang rig med na ji ltar nges/ / zhe/sa dang por blang dor gyi gnas ston pa'i gsung rab la thos pa med na gang la dran shes dang bag yod bstan pa'i gnas la rmongs par 'gyur bas na thos pa gal che 'ing de la brten nas thos pa'i don tshul bzhin yid la byed pa'i bsam byung dang / de las yang dag pa'i don mthong ba'i sgom byung dang / de las sa dang por rab tu dga' ba sogs kyi tshas thob cing / de las 'bras bu rnam par grol ba sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par gsungs so/ de ltar blang dor gyi gnas la thos pa tshul bzhi/na du byas pa'i rjes su bag yod la brten te/rang gis khas blangs pa'i sdom pa'i bslab bya sogs blang dor gang shes pa —— — 120 ———

rnams lag len la bkal nas tshul khrims rnam par dag pa zhig dgos te/de med na thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa lta zhog mngon mtho lha mi'i go 'phang tsam yang mi rnyed par ngan song du 'gro bar 'gyur ba ni/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ ji snyed chos kyi rnam pas byang chub kyang / / thos pas brgyags pas tshul khrims mi bsrung na/ / tshul khrims 'chal ba ngan 'gror de 'gro ste/ /de la thos pa mang pos skyobs mi nus/ /zhes gsungs/ gsan yang tshul khrims 'chal bas tshe 'di nyid la'ang ston pa dang lha dang grogs tshangs ba mtshungs par spyod pa rnams kyis dmod par 'gyur ba dang / yid mi bde ba dang / 'gyod pa mang ba dang / gtam mi snyan pa 'phel bar 'gyur ba sogs nyes pa du ma bskyed cing / tshul khrims nyams pa'i rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bus tshe rabs gzhan du bde 'gror skyes pa'i tshe yang hon mongs tha/sa che bas tshul skru/ mas bsrung dka' bar 'gyur ba ni rnam ba༅da rig par/tshul khrims nyams pa la nyon mongs pas yongs su gdungs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / kun tu 'tshol ba'i sdug bsngal dang / gnod pa'i sdug bsngal dang /'dod pas phongs pa'i sdug bsngal dang / dogs pa'i sdug bsngal dang /gleng ba'i sdug bsngal dang / kun tu spong ba'i sdug bsngal dang / bkur ste med pa'i sdug bsngal dang / tshe phyi ma la ngan song rnams su rnam par smin pa'i sdug bsrul dang / bde 'gro dag tu yang nyon mongs pa mang ba nyid kyi phyir tshangs par spyod pa dka' ba nyid kyi rgyu mthun pa'i sdug bsngal te rnam pa bcu gnyis 'byung bar gsungs pa lta bu yin pas de dag la sogs nga 'i nyes dmigs mtha' yas shing / tshul khrims legs par bsrungs na/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba ni/ dpal —— 121 ——

mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes dper na sa chen po la snod bcud kyi 'jig rten brten pa bzhin du tshul khrims kyi gzhi la yon tan thams cad skye zhing rag las par gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang slob dpon chen po zla bas/ so so skye bo rnams dang gsung skyes dang / / rang byang chub la bdag nyid nges rnams dang / / rgyal sras rnams kyi nges par legs pa dang / / mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrims las gzhan med/ /ces lam du ma zhugs ba'i so so skye bo rnams kyis mngon mtho dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang rgyal sras rnams kyi nges legs byang chub 'grub pa'i rgyu'i ga bo bor gyur pa tshul khrims las gzhan med par gsungs pa la/ de ltar dge legs thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshul khrims la'ang / theg pa gong 'og nas bshad pa'i rim pa mang du yod pa las/ slob dpon chos kyi tshong dpon gyis/ ji ltar 'di ni shing rtsa gtso bo ste/ / rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis kyi gzhi/ / de bzhin dam chos tshogs rnams thams cad kyi/ / gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ / zhes ljon shing gi rtsa ba ni yal lo ma sogs 'dzin pa'i gzhi dang 'phel ba'i rgyu yin pa ltar 'dul ba ni/ lung dang rtogs pa'i dam chos thams cad kyi gzhi dang rtsa bar gsungs pas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhi ma ni 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i so thar gyi tshul khrims kho na yin par bsngags so/ des na phan bde'i rtsa lag thub bstan yun ring du gnas shing rgyas par byed 'dod pa dang / rang nyid mngon mtho dang nges legs kyi phun tshogs thob par 'dod pa'i shes ldan yin na spyir dam pa'i chos dang / de'i nang nas bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la brten nas lus —— 122 ——

ngag yid pa / sum/ 'jug ldo sa/ gi bcas/ nga 'i mtsham1sa las mi 'da' ba 'ig dbo/sa shing / khyad si ra du yang sa/ngas can gyi ljongs/ 'dir mdo lngas/sa yo/ngas su rdzos/sa pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan nga/ la ma kau/ sas pa dang los/ par/ rtos/sa nga dang / the tshom gyi dri ma mtha' dag bsal nas sand/ dom/ ma lus nga/ bhan mo ltar gsal/ ngar mdzad nga/'i 'jam mgon blo bzang gra/sa/sa pa'i jes su zhu/ gas pa rang re'i dgre/ ldan pa rnam/sa kyi srol ka ni mkhas pa yid bzang rtse bas/ dus kye dbang si/sa dge/ slong lhod pa'ang mang rab byung ba na rje btsun dam pa blo bzang grag/sa nga 'i dpal gyis dang por skyor mo lung du mkhan chen blo gsal ba las 'du' ba leb/sa nga/ra blangs/ phyis dben pa'i gnas rnams su sgrub pa snyeng ngo/ra ma/dzad nga/'ang 'du' ba'i kun tu spyod pa las ma 'das/ phyis 'khor skyong ba'i tshe'ang drung na 'khod pa thams cad /'dul ba nas ji za/da bshad nga 'i chos gos gsum gding ba dang lhung bzed la/ sogs pa mkho ba'i yo byad rnams 'dzin du bzug jo bo chen po lha gcig gi man ngag la brten nas skyes bu gsum la blo sbyangs nas 'khor ba mtha' dag las yid 'byung ba'i blos sdom pa thams cad so so thar pa mtshan nyid pa la bkod/ de dag gi spyan ltos la brten nas bod kyi khams 'dir 'dul ba'i bstan pa nyi ma shar ba ltar gyur pa yin no zhes bsngags pa brjod pa don la gnas pa bzhin/bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i gnang bkag phra zhing phra ba nas brtsams te lag len la jebs pas gzhir bzung / tshad ma gsum gyis dpyad bzod pa'i rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus pa gdams ngag tu bzung nas de don sgrub pa snying por byas pas rang gzhan thams cad gnas skabs kun tu 'tshengs pa'i lugs ma gtogs/ gsung rab kyi dgongs don ras su bor te man ngag —— 123 —— ——

chung chung re la sgrub pa'i ma/thil du 'dzim nga/ skad byas mas ga'am dom lta tho/sa/rang dom du lha mi'i go 'phang tsam thob pa'i rgyur 'gyur pa'ang dka' ba'i sa phyod ci yang med pa de lta bu bya ba'i srol ma mchis pas na ston pa dang de'i rjes su slo ba pa'i mkhas grub ched ldan de dag/ gi mdzad pa la mig/ ltos nga /ra bltas/ nas ci shes ci nus su bslab dgos rgyur/ da lam ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dngos da/nga mi gnyis bar rgyal ba rang nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang brnyan jo bo mi ba spyod rdo rje pho brang rgyas/ btab/ ra rdza/ che'i gtsus lag khang gi nye 'dabs/ su stan chags pa'i ba'i sde grwa tshang dga' ldan bsam gtan gling zhes gra/sa/sa shā4 /3di ni dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i sprul pa mnga' bdag khri ral gyi dus da/ma ba'i chos kyi srol sngar yab mes kyi dus las kyang ches cher dar ba mdzad nas rab byung rnams la bkur bste dang phu dud lhag par che ba dang / lha ldan du shar du ka ru dang rbe ru lhor dga' ba dang dga' ba'i 'od ces pa'i dge 'dun/ gyi sde btsug/sa pa'i nang tshan gyi dga' ba zhes pa yin tshul bzhi sder rang gi grwa bgres rgan/ rabs kyi ngas/ rgyun la yod ces gleng zhing /slar yang bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi dngos slob mkhan chen tshul rdor bas lha sa dmar po'i ri'i 'dabs kyi khang ser mar btsugs nas nyams gsos mdzad/ de rjes slob dpon bsod nams 'phel bas gdan sa bskyangs nas 'chad nyan sogs spel/ slar yang / bla ma ston pa sangs rgyas dpal bas lha sa'i bla ma khang gsar dang / dgon gseb shar nub zer ba'i sa gnas 'dir btsugs nas gzhi gsum gyi phyag len sogs rgyas par mdzad cing / mkhan chen bsod nams shes rab kyis gdan sa bskyangs/de rjes su pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi dngos slob bsod nams bla mas/ dwogs — — 124 —

pa dir btsus/sa nas ra sa spang lung dbo/na pa zhes mang du chags par sher phyin kyi nyams len/ so/gas dar rgyas che ba byung / de ma/sa stos/sa ldam/ shes rab rdo rjes bla ma mdzad nas gcod kyi nyams lem/ sogs dar// de nas jo bo chen po lha sa/cis/ a ti shas thub bstan dri ma med pa'i srol sa/rtod skabs sbas ti dgra bcom pas bzung nas 'dul ba'i phyag len rgyas par mdzad de rjes su/ bla ma 'a/nga sogs dam pa mang pos tshal pa khri/ dpon 'a/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par byas pa'i phyir dang // khyad nga ra jo bo'i zhabs tog/ byed pa'i sbu sa/nyer mar mo che ga/tsug lag khang bo/ 'dzin spras sogs la dmib/sa/ sngar lugs bzhin 'dzugs dgos pa'i zhal brko/da phebs par brten/ ra mo che'i bar skor du tshugs/ ming ma nga bzhi sde zhes thogs pa nas ma so/ma/ po bya rog gdong can gyi sprul pa dpon dga' bde da/pal bzang po'i brgyud 'dzin tshal pa khri dpon mang dag/ gis zhabs bdas mdzad nas bka' gdams kyi lta grub rnam dag gi sgo ma/sa 'chad nyan spel ba'i bla rabs kyang /mkhan chen dkon mchos bla ma/ slob dpon ston pa bsod nams/ mal/ na chen kun bzang pa/ mkhan chen bkris bzang po sogs byung / de rjes chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa nyin mor byed pa'i snang bas sa steng yongs su khyab par brdal ba'i dus skabs bstan pa'i spyin bdag chen po chos rgyal sbo/'u phas 'al bdag mdzad nas rje'i dngos slob byang sems blo gros rgyal mtshan gdan sar bskos/ rim gnyis kyi nyams len sog/sa rgyas par mdzad/ de rjes slob dpon dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs bla rabs mang dag cig brgyud pa'i rjes su kun gzigs chen po tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i dus dge rgan gras tshangs dbyangs chos grags kyis bskyangs skabs ra mo che'i mdun phyogs su spos/ de nas — 125 —

slob dpon mtha' yas rgyal mtshan/ gyis bskyangs nas gzhi gsum gyi phyag len dar bar mdzad/ de rjes dpon slob grags pa blo kros kyis bskyangs/lcags byi lo/ bar lam 'thor rkyen du song dus phyag mdzod du tshud pa'i grwa tshang rang gis dngos chas sku sa/sung thugs rten gyi mtshon pa dang / sa zhing // gnas gzhi/ dkor sa dge khongs sogs kyi dbang rigs bdag thob tshang ma me bya phan ltar phyir slob byas te sngar nas sde 'di nyid dgon mang dang gras yim// 'dug don ltar nyams gso byas pa nas 'phel rgyas che zhing / bla ma ngag dbang mkhas mchog dang / slar yang dpon slob mtha' yas rgyal mtshan bskyar ldab kyis bskos/ de rjes su grub dbang sems dpa' chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis skyong bar mdzad nas rim gnyis kyi nyams len sogs chos spyod dar rgyas che/ da lta bla ma dngos grub nyi mas gdan sa bskyang skabs bcas gong smos rnams la khungs dag min ci rigs yod shas che yang bzhi sde bla grwa nas lo rgyus kyi yi ge zhig gtad nas de nang gang 'os bca' yig tu thebs pa dgos tshul byung bar brten zur phran la bzo bcos byas pa ma gtogs de ga sor gnas bkod pa yin cing / brag sgo rab 'byams pa'i rtsod yig tu tshal pa khri dpon kun dga' rdo rje'am si tu dge ba'i blo gros zhes lugs gnyis la mkhyen spyan yangs ba des ra mo ched btsugs nas sgrub mchod thebs su zhing sbyar ba sogs deb rnying gi brjod bya dang mthun pas khri dpon des gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa don la gnas tshul gsungs/ gang ltar yang sde 'di zhwa ser cod pas 'chang ba'i lta grub gtsang ma bzung nas lha ldan sogs su gzhan phan gyi gsos su che ba zhig yin 'dug pa na/ sde 'dir 'dus pa rnams kyis rang re'i ston pas brtse ba chen po'i sgo nas gnas skabs mthar thug tu bde — 126 —

legs 'phel 'ing / sdus/ bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa las thar ba'i thabs su blang dor ji ltar bstan pa rnams la sgang blang bya dgos shing / de yang 'dul ba lung sde bzhi/ dang / de'i dgongs pa 'grel ba'i bstan bcos mdo rtsa ba sogs 'dul ba'i sde snod kyi bka' bstan chen po rnams las lhag pa'i bca' khrims ston pa'i yi ge/ zur pa mang dgos pas de dag dang / blo gros dman pa dag gis dge tshul slong gi bslab bya tshig nyung ngur bsdus nas ston pa'i gzhung tshad thub pa'i dam pa gong ma mang pos mdzad pa ci rigs la lta rtog legs par bcug ste/ rang rang gi bslab bya las ma 'das pa zhi/ga nges par dgos/ yus dus dang bstun pa'i nang khrims bsrung dgos sogs dmigs bsal 'dri rgyu la thog mar gsar 'jug skabs/ chos sde che chung gzhan nas gnas dbyung byas rigs dang / rigs dang dbang po la skyon yod pa sogs mi 'jug cing / skyon med rigs kyang lo brgyad las chung ba mi rdzong / rdzong 'os rigs sne spyor byed mi nas/ thog mar bla ma dang bgres song la zhus 'khrol nges mang ja gnyis/ bzhes thug gcig bla mar lnga tshan dod dngul zho bzhi/ spyi par dngul srang gang dang lnga tshan dod zho bzhi/ shing rin ṭam kha gcig mchod khang dang mgon khang so sor snyan dar dod zho do/ sne gzhag bzhir zho gang dang bcas 'bul/ zhugs zin nas 'don chos rnams ma thon gyi bar dge rgan ma bsten par sdod pa med cing grwa shag kyang mi sprod/'dul ba'i dgongs pa bzhin du gnas kyi bla ma bsten nas rang rang gi bslab bya khong du chud pa byed cing / rang gang dran gyi spyod lam chos dang mi mthun pa mi byed/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi gso spyong gnyis la dge tshul slong 'du bar 'os pa gang yin tshogs nas ltung ba byung ba rnams la bshags sdom sngon du 'gro — 127 —

bas bslab bya yongs su spyong ba'i thabs la 'bad/// thams cad la bla bo/sa//ma thang bos/ gding ba// lhung bzed zhwa zla gam sogs rab tu byung ba'i cha lug/sa rnams dang // dge slong la de'i steng du snam sbyar gong ling lta bu'i rgyu la ma bltos pas ras so/gas la bcos nga sa nges par 'grig/ pa byed/ skra ring gri ring / pags ris/sa kyi gong dang phu thung can/ 'bar zhwa/ glo/ cha sogs tshul dang mi mthun pa'i cha 'u sa/sa gzhi byes gang du'ang mi byed/ tshog/sa su 'du tshogs skabs tshogs brda btang ba nas/ dung gtong ba'i bar la tshogs gral du 'dus ngos// gdong gral la skad dang 'don/ jos nges nga rnams dang / gzhan ma ra bslab gral mkha/ sa gral sogs go ma log pa'i ngos nas gral du mu tis/ star la brgyus pa bzhin/ mdzes par 'khod pa ma gtogs rkang rkyong gzhogs snyes sogs mi byed// mang ja tshogs su dmigs bsa'/ gyi bral bas 'gro dgos byung na gnang ba zhu zhing / de min tshogs nas 'grim 'grul mi byed/ ma/nga ja dang sku rim sogs phyi nang gang du'ang 'al 'don gyi rim pa dbu mdzad kyis gang bskul rnams mgrin gcis/ dbyangs gcig gis gsung ba ma gtogs kha btums/ mig g.yengs/ 'khros pa/gnyid log pa sogs mi byed/ bza' btung gi tshe hub cag gi sgra sogs 'dul ba nas bkag pa'i rigs rnams spangs te 'du shes brgyad bsten pa sogs dran pa dang shes bzhin gyi sgo nas longs spyod/ tshogs su rjes la lus tshe tshul mthun/ gyi phyag gsum byas nas dge skos la gnang ba zhu/ zhal 'don sogs dge tshogs bsags pa rnams bla med rdzogs byang gi rgyur 'dun pa drag pos bsngo ba dang gzhan phan sems bskyed kyis zin par byed/ dgongs mo sku rim la yang 'khar rnga'i brda btang 'phral la zhwa zla gam dang bcas 'byon pa — 128 — —

las gzan rkyang mi mdzad/ rgyal bstan spyi dang bya/ da nga ra rje btsun tsong kha pa'i ring lus/sa dar ba/ mchod yon gyi zhabs brtam// bod khams su nad/ 'khru/ ba/ so gas mi 'dod nga spyi dang bye bras/ lha ldan du 'byung bzhi'i gnod/ 'tshe zhi phyir du gdus/sa sher/ sgrol ma// dmigs brtse ma/ kun rig mi 'khrugs pa / tshe dpas/ med/ sman bla// 'od zer can ma/ lo ma gyon pa// rigs gsum mgon po bcas kyi gzugs dang // yig brgya/ 'bas brtan gyi sbon tshig chos srung spyi sger gyi gtor 'bul/ bstan 'bar ma dang 'dod gsol gyi tshigs bcad sogs gang 'tshams btang nas grol rjes rang rang gi shag sogs su dge sbyor dang / skyor sbyang la brtson pa ma gtogs dgos ped kyi long ga/tam spru bas mtshon 'khor ra mi byed cing / dge skos nas kyang ma tshan mo bskor nas lta rtog byed/ phyi nang gang nas kyang grong chos/ dang // dmigs bsal gyi bsnyen bkur zhu mi byung tshe grwa rigs so so'i nye ltos yin na sger brda gcig ma gtogs/ de phyin dge slos nas brda 'phros byas pa'i gang babs ma gtogs kha g.yar g.yo 'phrul gyis spyi khongs nas sger brda len pa sogs mi byed/ brda gang byung nas kyang dril bu/ lhung bzed/gding ba sogs cha lag gang dgos rnams tshang bar bsnams nas 'byon/dge skos nas kyang grong chog gi rigs dang rgyun gtor bskang gso/ lha bsangs/ mchod 'bul sogs la so so'i 'don cha la dbyibs bltas kyi nges pa sogs skabs su gang babs 'khor res phyogs lhung nye 'gyangs spangs ba'i brda rgyag dang / sngar rgyun bzhin dbu mdzad la lho sgo dang / mgon khang / dgon nang gi grong chog phyi mi gal che'i rigs sogs la dmigs bsal gyi brda rgyag byed/ tshogs sogs ma 'grims par dgon nang du grwa — 129 —

tshang si/ rdom/ dang / dmigs bsal spyi tshas kyi las sne thog zin yin na ma sa/togs ga 'an mar rang don gyis po/tan sdod byed mi rnams la skal ba gsum thob ma gtog/sa phobs/ /'gyed chu ra lo bas ra sog/sa kyi skal ba mi gtong / nge/ rib//sa (ma las sne sos/sa kyang bab bltas byed/ spyi khongs nas grong chos/ gi/ brda mi rgyas/ btan/ sdod ma yim nga 'i tshogs byol byed mi'i ris/sa 'a sngar rgyun ba'i na zla thob phogs mis rgyag rgyur zla ga/cig 'khor zhas/ du phud// de phyin phyogs 'gro spyi 'gre ltar byed/ grwa rigs rnams nas kyang grong chog sogs la 'gro ba'i tshe rgan pa tshul ldan gyi bslab byar nyan pa'i sa/zhan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan dang bsod nams kyi zhing sar gang 'gro byed pa las re ltos 'cha' ba'i sbyin/ bdag/ sog/sa bslu ba dang / khyim pa sun 'byin gyi ngad log tu 'gro ba'i bag med rigs gtan nas mi byed/ grwa dmangs nas kyang las sne ba dang bgres so/nga rang las bslab pa dang yon tan gyis rgan nga/'i rigs rnams la tshul mthun gyi gus 'bas byed pa ma gtogs ltos med kyi rigs mi byed/ gyon pa phu dung can spyi zhal ta ba mgon po ba gsum nas dgun zla gsum ring ma gtogs/ dus gzhan dang tshogs dbus su mi pyon/de phyin nad pa sogs nas nang du dmigs bsal gyon dgos byung tshe gnang ba zhu/ grwa rigs khyem pa'i nang du 'ag sdod mi byed cing gal che dmigs bsal gyis sdod dgos byung na zhag gsum tshun dge skos dang / de las 'gyangs pa'i rigs rnams bla ma dge skos gnyis kar ja zhu dang bcas gnang ba zhu zhing / gnyis kas 'os min legs par gzhigs pa'i ster lugs byed/ phyi mi skya ser la ma bltos par dgon nang du grwa pa'i nad g.yog dang dmigs bsal gyi zhag sdod byed tshe dge skos la gnang ba zhu/ dngos chas gtan nas — 130 —

med pa'i nad pa'i rigs la las sne pa rnams nas lta rtog ngos grwa tshang nas 'tsho skyong byed/ de mtshungs grwa rigs dngos chas 'khyer zhan pas gzhung dang grwa tshang gi rtsis 'khri'i dngos chas che chung chad pa rnams dus 'gyangs med par grwa tshang nas bsgrubs rjes skyin tshab ma 'grig par grong chog la dmigs bsal gyis btang ba'i gun gsab byed 'jug bud med kyi rigs dgon nang du yong bar gnang ba zhu zhing / zhag sdod dang pe 'bud chu len sogs byed sa ped/ sbyin bdag gi sne len byed dgos rnams spyi pas byed cing sbyin bdag 'byor pa che chung dang phyi nang gang la yang bla ma'i bsngo rten sne gzhag bzhi dung dar/ mchod khang gi snyan dar/ shing rin/ bca' yig tu dmigs bsal yod rigs ma gtogs ja thug gang yin la rgyun jar brtsi med kyi shing rin skar phyed brgyad res chung mtha' byas pa dge skos dang spyi pa zung sbrel gyis sbyin bdag la dgos tshul bshad nas gang byung sprod yul so sor sprod cing / ma lhogs pa'i rigs la yu tshugs kyis rtsod pa mi gtong / mang ja'i sbyin bdag kyang spyi pas ma gtogs las sne ba su yin gyis bskul sa med/ grwa rigs nas kyang 'dir yong nges kyi mang ja dang 'bul ba mgon gzhan du bsgyur ba dang / phyogs lhung nye 'gyang gis gtong tshod dang / chung khyad kyis spor gcog mi byed cing / so so'i nye can ltos bcas kyi bsnyen bkur zhu mi gang byung dge skos dang zung 'brel gyi gtong lugs byed pa ma gtogs rang dbang thag gcod mi byed/ mang ja gtong tshod sogs dge skos nas byed/ja rgyugs 'gro khungs bla mar lte ri ma skyogs tshad bzhi re 'gro ba dod dang /gsol dpon dbon po gnyis la skyogs tshad do re/ nad pa dang nang g.yog sdod mi gcig dgon nang gi mtshams pa dang don gal che dmigs bsal — 131 ———

gyis sdod cing / tshem bu ba gcig spyi 'bul byed sku'i rigs kyi bzo bo ngo g.yog la skyogs tshad do re gtong zhing / nad g.yog dang tshem bu ba gcig pu 'di ga'i grwa rigs yin na ma gtogs tshwa 'gyed kyi rigs mi gtong / spyi 'bul byed rgyu'i rigs kyi bzo bo ngo yod la bla spyi sne mo ba'i ga/tong sgo ma yin pa'i phyi nang gi 'gyed nas ngo skal re gtong / spyi pas mtshon sne mo ba'i gtong rgyun gyi brngod btags dang / bzhes spro bzo mi la skal ba'i rigs mi gtong / bla mar skal ba gsum/ g.yog gnyis la ngo skal re/ dbu chos/spyi gsum/ dkon gnyer/ chab ril/ mgon po ba/ dung pa rnams la skal 'phar re dang / me 'bud chu len gnyis dang sa/da pa gcig bcas la ngo ska/la re gtong / bla ma'i shas yong gi zhing steng nas sa sprel lo dngo na slob sprags rams pas btsugs pa'i gtong thebs su/ me sbrul lo sems dpa' mchog sprul rin po che nas gnang ba'i dngul srang bcu tham pa bcas kyi thog na/sa lo lo ba'i na cho 'phrul zla ba dang / sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga/ chu stod zla ba'i tshes ba'i/ tha skar zla ba'i nyer gnyis rnams la mang ja sbyor legs gnyis dang bzhes thug bcas kyi thog bla ma mchod pa gung rgyur bla gtor mchod chas sogs gtong deb nang gsal bzhin dang / mchod khang ma bo/na khang gnyis la snyan dar bkras btags te/ dung dar bkras btags sne ga 'ag bzhi la pā tse ra/ gong gsal cho 'phrul/ chu stod/ tha skar zla ba gsum so sor dge 'dun rer 'gyed sman kha re/ sa zlar dge 'dun rer kha btags pā tse ra dang dngul skar phyed brgyad re theb rtsis kyi skam 'gyed/ gong gsal mang ja brgyad la ba'i ra shing rin mi dgos shing / bzhi'i 'ing rin du dngul zho do sprod/ rje bla ma'i dus mchod zla ba bcu pa'i nyer lnga la ja thug dgu'i —— 132 —

thog bla ma mchod pa gsung rgyur/ gdan gung gi tshar dgongs ja bu ram thog sne mo ba dbu chos spyi gsum la bdun sder re/ mchod gtor dang tshogs 'khor 'os 'tsham sogs gtong deb nang gsal bzhin dang / 'gyed dge 'dun rer kha btags pā tse ra dang / dngul skar lnga re snyan dar bkras btags gnyis/ dung dar bkras btags gnyis sne ga 'ag pā tse bzhi/gong gsal mang ja lnga'i shing rin du dngul zho phyed gsum sprod cing / tshwa 'gyed nas sni mo ba lnga dung pa chab ril bcas la skal 'phar re/ me 'bud chu len gnyis dang gad pa gcig la ngo skal re gtong / sa lug lo dpon slob sngags rams pa'i dgongs rdzogs gtong thebs su dngul srang bdun cu tham pa sbyar ba'i grwa tshang rang nas khur len gyi lo ltar hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes gnyis dang gsum la tshogs yongs la ja thug dgu re btang ba'i nyin thub thog sman bla'i mdo chog gsung rgyur sku yom/ tshogs bzhugs sa/nga yin la nyin rer dngul skar lnga re dang / bla ma dpon g.yog la skal ba bzhin/ sne mo ba lnga dang dung pa chab ril bcas par skal 'phar re/ me 'bud chu len gad pa gsum la ngo skal re gtong zhing / gzhan mar skal ba'i rigs mi gtong /spyi pa'i las 'dzin dgongs pa zhu mi'i rigs nas bgres song tshogs dbus su dngul srang brgya dang nyi shu re 'bul zhing / las sne slu dod yin gshis byas pa che chung yin zer ba'i spor gcog gi rig/sa mi byed/ las 'dzin byed mi rnams nas kyang phogs gtong tshang ma tshul mthun dgos rgyur/ rgyun ja dang zla ba byung ngo cog be/ tshes brgyad bco lnga gan/ma stong sogs kyi sman bla gtong ba'i ja 'phar re/ lo re min bla tshar re 'don rgyur dge rgyun sbyar bar sa ga'i bco lnga dang / bcu bdun/ chu stod kyi tshes bzhi/ tha skar zla ba'i — 133 ———

nyer gnyis/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu gcig rnams la ja 'phar re/gong gsal dge 'dun rnams kyi tshwa ra rgyag rgyu/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi dgu gtor dang / zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer brgyad rnams kyi ja thug dang /gung tshigs kyi tshwa ra/ shas skor/ lnga mchod nyin lnga / lo gsar rtsam nas dngul ja phogs sogs dang rtsis sprod skabs ja mar tshwa bul gyi 'gyed sogs gtong rgyun nas slob dpon la skal ba gnyis/ g.yon gnyis la ngo skal re/nad pa dang nad g.yog dgon nang du mtshams mtshan nyid tshang ma bsdam mi dang grwa bgres spyi chos kyi las sne thon zin/ ri khrod du tshul mthun gyis sdod mi dang / grwa sar bslab gnyer sha stag byed mi'i rigs bcas la phogs gtong gis mtshon phyi nang gi skal pa'i rigs rnams gtong / dgon nang gi bla zur rigs la sne mo ba'i gtong phogs kyi rigs nas ngo skal dang phyi nang gi 'gyed dang tshwa ra'i rigs dang skal 'phar re gtong / gzhan ma phyogs mthar bla gnyer dang / rang don gyi 'gro mi/ spyi chos kyi las sner zol byol gyis phyin pa sogs la lnga mchod nyin dang po'i gdan bzhes dang / lo gsar gdan bzhes kyi gsum zur bcas skal ba gsum thob ma gtogs/ phogs 'gyed sogs skal ba'i rigs mi gtong zhing / spyi don du bsdu 'brel gyi rigs byed dgos byung yang de rnams la mi 'gel mgon po ba'i skor yang spyi pa thon zin rnams sho ltar la bskos pa'i ma lcogs pa'i rigs rnams dngul srang bcu re phul nas dgongs pa zhus khrol byed/ byed mi rnams nas gzhung gi bzhi grwa rgyun tshugs dang gzhan yang gzhung sger gyi bskang 'phar ma'i rigs yang yang yong rgyun 'dug par do dam pa dang bcad khra yod rigs kyi bskang 'phar byung ba rnams la rgyun tshugs mi the ba'i mgon po ba'i thog tu grwa pa — 134 —

gsar 'phar brda rgyag byed/ mchod gtor tshegs ched dmar rgyan dkor cha dang / dad 'bul snyan shal bcas bcad khra yod med la ma bltos pa'i mgon po ba rang la bdag tu 'jug grwa pa'i thob cha phogs lon rnams grwa rigs nas len/ ja thug mgon po bas tshul mthun gtong ba grwa pa dang nang mthun na ma gtogs gzhan ma grwa pa rang nas shes pa byed/ gtong sgo'i skor zla ba byung ngo cog la mang ja re dang bzhes thug re/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer bdun gyi gung tshigs la ja thug gnyis dang tshwa ra/ 'gyed drug ṭam re/ 'jog dngul bal ṭam gyi srang bcu dang rtags brgyad kha btags/ lo gtor spo 'dzugs skabs 'jigs byed tshogs rgyugs thon zin yan la bskang ba nyin mtshan gnyis kyi zhabs tog zhu bar nad pa dang mtshams pa ba gong du phud/ bla ma dpon g.yog gsum la skal ba bzhi/ dgon nang du sdod mi'i bla zur rigs la ngo skal re dang / dbu chos spyi gsum la skal 'phar re gtong / grwa bgres spyi chos kyi las sne thon zin ri khrod du sdod mi dang / grwa sar bslab gnyer sha stag byed mi/ nad pa bcas la ngo skal re gtong zhing / gzhan ma gtong deb nang gsal bzhin las skal ba'i rigs mi gtong /mgon po bas rgyal khang gi thug gnyis rgyal mtshan bcas brje/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyer lnga'i gung tshigs la dbu mdzad kyis ja thug gnyis dang tshwa ra/nyer drug la dge skos kyis gong tshud thog 'gyed dngul skar lnga re dang /dkon gnyer gyi 'jog dngul srang drug dang / dge skos nas dad 'bul re/gong gsal dbu chos mgon po ba gsum gyi dgu gtor gtong sgo rnams nas/bla ma dpon g.yog la tshwa ra nas skal ba bzhi/ 'gyed nas skal ba lnga/ dbu chos spyi gsum/ dkon gnyer/ mgon po ba/ chab ril/ dung pa — 135 —

bcas par 'gyed nas skal 'phar re dang / tshwa ra ngo skal/ me 'bud chu len/ gad pa gcig bcas la tshwa 'gyed gnyis ka nas ngo skal re gtong /gong gsal bla spyi mgon po gtong sgo tshang ma gtong deb nang gsal nyams med gtong ba'i do dam deb gnon bla ma dbu chos gsum gyis byed dgos la/gtong dus so sor brda 'phros gtong / lha sa dang ra mo che'i mgon po ba/dkon gnyer sogs kyis mtshon las sne ba rnams kyi rtsis sprod kyang / dus thog so sor sprod pa ma gtogs ngan shed khyer gyis dus 'byangs brtsi med rigs byas tshe gnas dbyung sogs bab bltas byi chad pa 'gel/ las sne ba so so'i rtsis sprod kyi dngos chas chad lus ngo thog bsgrigs nas rtses sprod pa ma gtogs bar khyad kyi rigs mi len ceng dngos po gzhan gyi tshab 'jug kyang mi byed// lcags bye phan gyi spyi sger gyi grwa shag rnying pa gang yin grwa tshang nas bdag tu bzung ba'i byas pa che nges kyi rigs la dmigs bsal sprad dgos byung na ma gtogs gzhan ma dbu chos bgres song rnams gros bsdur spyi thog 'don chos thon tshar ba rnams nas zhus don cha snyoms kyi sgo nas sprod pa las chas kar bltas pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/ gong gsal lo rta tshun la sger shag gsar rgyag byas rigs rnams kyang phugs grwa tshang rang du 'jags pa byed pa ma gtogs tshong sgyur gyi rigs mi byed/ dgon pa rang gi 'dzin khongs mo bran gtong 'os kyi khang par chang ma'i rigs mi 'jog dgon pa'i phyi nang bar gsum la spyi bla brang grwa rigs so so'i 'dzin bdag gang byed kyi sgo sge khung dkar phibs rab gsal sogs la chu khebs dang zhig gsos byed dgos rnams lus su ma song ba so sos 'phral 'phral byed cing / rab gsal steng gi rgyal mtshan gnyis dang chu khebs/ yol ba phyi nang gis mtshon gdan cha —— 136 ——

rnams bla brang nas bsgrig mdun gyi rgyal mtshan dang sgo mchor chu khebs dge skos nas brje/ mdun gyi thug gnyis chab ril bas brje/ thug bzhi dbu mdzad kyis brje/ rtse'i rgyal mtsham dang sa dkar yang spyi pas gsol/dgon nang du rta drel gyis mtshon dud 'gro'i rigs bsten skor mi byed cing /dmigs bsal ra che'i smon lam skabs dang 'jigs skyob lta bu'i spyi bla brang grwa rigs rnams la gal che dka' med kyi bsten dgos rigs la gnang ba zhu/gzan sog kyang dgon nang g.yab slor steng shod gang du'ang mi 'jog grwa tshang rang si/ don dang spyi pa bla ma'i shas zhing sog/sa ma gtogs grwa rigs rnams nas tshong khe zhing las bu lon sogs gtong sa med/ ra che'i dgo/na gnyer dang mgon po ba gtan tshigs rnying pa'i don ba'i/na bzhi sde bar 'jags gnas yin 'dug don la bgres song re rnams nas 'os tho'i thog bgres song dang spyi pa'i las khur du 'jug 'os kyi grwa rigs gcig bcas lo re bzhin dkon gnyer du bsko zhag nges 'jog gdong dang rtsis sprod len spyi dam 'byar ba'i tho zur gsal nang bzhin byed/ spyi rdzas skor la yang do dam byed mi bgres song rnams bslab gral ngos gcig bsko zhag thog dbu mdzad dang dge skos gnyis bcas lag sbrel gyis bsam pa rnam dag gi sgo nas gces spras byed cing / yig bris sogs kyang grwa tshang rang gi yig tshang du 'jog pa ma gtogs su yin gyis bdag mi byed/ dgos dus su dge skos dbu mdzad sa/nyer pa tsa/sum 'dzoms thog nas len/ spyi 'bul zer ba'i rigs dang sku yon dod dge 'dun rer 'di tsam zeb rtsis yin zer ba'i spom 'bul gyi dngos po rna/mas grwa tshang spyi nang len cing / de rigs kyi gsal cha gang yang med pa'i spom thag yin zer ba'i rigs rnams spyi las thog par sprod/— 137 —

dbyangs rnga chings dung rgya gling gtor bzo sogs bslab sbyangs dgos par bslab mi yang dge skos nas 'os rigs la btsugs par khur len gyi bslab sbyang ngos phyi nang gang du'ang 'gro dgos byung tshe dang len gyi 'gro lugs byed /bslab dus ja dgos rigs spyi pas gtong / 'don chos 'dril ma tshar bar gnas skor dang phyogs 'gro'i rigs mi byed/ sgrig 'gal skor la/ rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga la mthong thos dwogs gsum gyi rtsad chod pa byung rigs rnams gnas dbyung byed cing / gzhan ma phyi nang gang gnas dwogs gnas yod tshul gyi rtsad ma chod rigs la mdo sgrub kyis mtshams gcod byed/ gnas dbyung byas rigs rnams slad char che btsan sgul spyod kyi ngo chen sogs zhu mi byung yang gtan nas mi 'jug cing / bsten sgor yang su thad nas byed sa med/ dgon nang du nang mchod dang sman rta'i chang ma gtogs mi len cing /spyi so sogs nas dmigs bsal gyi len dgos byung tshe gnang / ba zhu zhing de min rgya sgo yan pa mi 'grim/ phyi nang gang du phru gu chung rigs ma gtos/sa 'thab mo rgyag pa/ gri 'don/ rmas 'don/ mda' rdo/ me spor sogs bag med byas rigs la gang 'tshams kyi dbyibs bltas pa'i tshar gcod rjes 'dzin bla ma dge skos nas byed cing / 'thab mo brgyab rigs la bslab pa rgan gzhon gyi go bab bcas gzhon par brgya phyag re thol du bkal nas gzhan ma 'gan tshabs dang bstun pa'i chad nga/ gcod lugs byed/ dge skos kyis sgrig drang por mnan pa la kha lan byas tshe zhugs sgo sor gnas dang / lag lan byed mi dang grwa tshang du bsam chung drin log gi dgra bzung byas tshe gnas dbyung byed/ sngar rgyun bzhin chad las kyi mang ja'i rigs la do dam dbu chos nas byas pa'i bzang ja spor nyag bzhi/ mar gsum skor tshwa 'o shing rin la 138 — —

skar phyed brgyad/ 'bul ba che chung si/ dod dngu'/ thos/ ༄tu phab pa grwa tshang spyi nas lem cing / bla mar bsngo/ rten dod tho sa/nga // mgon khang mtshad lang gnyis kyi prun dar la zho ba/nga / sne gzhan/ ba'i la zho gang // dung dar pā tse kha gta/ sa/sa rnams so sor sprod// rang rbo/ngas ngos len sos/sa kyis nga/bo/ngas pa rtsa zhu byed mi'i rigs mas/ mang ja spyor lem/ gcig/ gi thub sa/zhi gong bzhin dang / 'ing rin skar lnga // bla spyi gnyis la lnga tshan dod zho brgyad/snyan dar bkras legs gnyis/ dung dar pā tse gcis/ sne sa/zhan sman legs kha ba'i rnam/sa bsgrub/ bgres song rnams spyi ngon gyi 'tshog 'du'i ska/bas 'phral phugs su skebs ba/nga che bsam/ par gang shar lab pa las so so'i phyog/sa lhung nye 'byangs spugs su bcub/ pa'i rigs gtan nas mi byed / dngos chas yod rigs nas grwa tshang gi spyi rdzas pror chad lus la ma sprad pa ba 'ag pa rku shor ba dang bor ba sogs byung rigs rnams gshin gson so so'i dngos chas thog nas skyen tshab bsgrig dgos la dbu chos nas brda 'ded kyi do dam byed/ gnyer par spyi rdzas tho nang bzhin sprad stegs nas chad lus kyi rigs byung tshe/ bla ma dang bgres song nas gong gsal do dam byed mi dbu chos gnyer gsum la spyon tshab sgrig tu 'jug bca' yig 'di rdon gyi sgrig gnon rtog 'jug dge skos nas byed cing / sne mo pa rnams nas kyang phyogs lhung nye skyor gyis sgrig dang bca' yig rtsa tshig sogs ras sor skyob bsub kyis bzhag rigs byung tshe/ bgres song nas 'gal tshabs dang bstun pa'i las sne brje 'jog sogs bab bltas kyi chad pa gcod lugs byed/ bca' yig klog pa dang dus mnyam du spyi tshogs mdo sgrub kyi yig bris/ bas/ yod tshul bzhin du bya dgos pa'i gzhung gi rtsa tshig rnams kyang sba gsang med par sgrog — 139 —

cing / gong bsa'/ sgrib lam/ gī bror bla spyi dbu gsum gyis gzhir bzu/nga / dge skos na/sa kyang phyogs lhung nye dbyangs spangs pa'i dag pher yong ba zhig/ ma byas tshe dge/ 'dun thugs mi mthun nga da/nga / sgrig lam yang sa/non mi bde ba'i rgyur 'dug/ pas drang ba 'a/ga/ da/ma ma/chog dang chos srung dang nga btsugs kyis byed/ de ltar spyi dang bye brag gi blang dor bshad pa rnams nges par byas ma/sa tshul bzhi/na bsru/ngas tsha// mngo/ sde snye ma'i snyeng po las / gal te dbe/ slong chos kyi sa/nas pa tshu' khrims yongs/ su dag pa ngo tsha shes pa dang khyel yod pha phun sum chob/sa pa dge slong lnga yang 'du na/ rgyal po chen po// dge slong gi dge// 'dun de ni chos tshad med pa dang ldan pa yin cing sbyin gnas chen po dang / lha dang mi thams cad kyis mchod par 'os par 'gyur no/ zhes gsungs pa ltar rang nyid gnas skabs kun tu bde bar 'gyur ba'i mdun ma'i rtsa ba yin par ma zad/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa su zhig gis mthong ba dang / thos pa dang thal mo sbyar ba tsam gyi bkur ste chung ngu bgyis pas kyang bsod nams tshad med nga sdud par byed pa yin pas na/ rgyal pa'i sras po thogs med bzang po dpal gyis/ gzhan gnod gzhi bcas spong bar khas blangs nas/ /dgra la sdug las thongs pa'i pho rgod po/ / rang gi sdom gsum yul nas 'don nyen gda' 'o/ / gnod sems rtsad nas thon par byin gyis rlobs/ / dge spyong chos bzhi bsgrub par dam bcas nas/ /kha drag dbang chen 'dod pa'i nga rgyal can/ /khas blangs thog tu 'phel ba mi gda' 'o/ / rtag tu dman cha 'dzin par byin gyis rlobs/ / zhes pa ltar mkhan slob kyi spyan sngar gzhan gnod gzhi dang bcas pa sogs mi mthun phyogs spong bar khas blangs nas phyi'i kun spyod rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha la 140 la

lugs blangs te 'i ba dang dul ba ltar snang yang nang dug sa/sum kha hrung zad kyang ma bri ba'i phyogs 'dzim spyi chags sdang dang // bro/ ba la slar khro// rngeg/ nga la slar rdes/ / gshe/ ba la slar gshe// mtshang 'bru ba la slar mtshang 'bru ba so sa/sa/ gang khas blangs pa'i ldog phyogs mtha' dag nyams su blangs nas rang 'tshengs pa dang / sa/'a/na la phan thog/sa pa'i dge/ sbyor don ldan blun sa/cig kyang mi/ 'byung ba'i spyod tshul de lta bur ma song bar rang sa//'am/ tham/mu cad la tsa/nas sko//bas kun tu bde bar 'gyur ba'i thabs tsha/da du byung ba dam/ pa'i chos kyi nying khu lhas/ pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa'i lam drang por zhus/sa rnga/ 'ig dru nas kyang bya bar rigs so/ lhun sdug rab yas 'os/ min/ dkyil 'khor ma/sa/ /cho 'phrul rin chen them skas las babs1 te/ / bye ba phras/ brgya'i gling du shākya'i tob/ / chu nang zla ba'i gzugs bzhin sa/ra du zlos/ / gsungs dbyangs/ mi zad tam bu ra yi rgyud/ / drangs pa'i 'dul ga/zhung (sna bum sde'i dbyangs snyan po/ //sa/nga gi thos 'dzin bu gar son tsam gyis/ /sgyur dod sred yid kyi zug rngu ci nga/nga sel/ / 'on kyang bdag tu blta ba'i gcong rong du/ /shugs drag rba klong rab 'khrug chu bo bzhis/ /dbang med bdas pa'i deng dus skye bo phal/ / ngan song thur gyi phyogs su rgyug la rings/ /de ltar rang g.yon kun la sdug bsngal gyi/ / byed po nyon mongs gdon chen gzhom pa'i slad/ /blang dor ma 'a/dres tshogs gsum phreng ba ru/ / spel ba'i rigs sngags cho ga 'di nyid bskrun/ / dge des zas gtsang sras so'i mdo sngags bstan/ / ma la yar skyes zhwa ser ring lugs kyi/ / dbal gyi 'khri shing dar drag ri bsung gis/ / phyogs kun phan bde'i dga' ba rgyal byed shog / sde 'dir gtsug lag yongs la bshad sgrub kyi/ / gan mdzod srid mthar mi nyams blar 'phel la 141 la

zhing / // ma tha' yas 'gro rnams bslab gsum jem ska/sa la// ///'dzegs nas/ byang grol gzhal med gyur 'jug shos/ / ces ra mo che bzhi sde grwa tshang dga' ldan bsam gtan gling gi bca' yis/ don gnyis nor bu'i bang mdzod ces bya ba 'di ni bzhi sde bla grwa thun mong na/sa gong du bkod pa'i nang khrim/sa spang blang gi rim pa rnams ji/ba gsal 'khod pa zhi/ga ma byung na lha ldan dang thag nye ba'i ga/shis kyis rtsod gleng gi rgyur 'dug bas sne mo ba dang bgres song rnams mol bsdur gyi thog nas yang tig 'di lta bu yig tshul gyi zin bres dang / rigs kun byed pos mkhan/ chen bstan pa'i mnga' bdag paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa nas bstsal ba'i bca' yig mig ston bcas bskul ma byung ba'i ngor shākya'i dge slong blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni byams gling mkhan po blo bzang tshe ring gis bgyis pa'o/ / / /

sa/ngas dkan gling gi bca' yig sa bonaXde mo srid sgrong dang po'iXdam phab kyis pre glang lon bstsal ba/me glang / (spyi lo 1757)oṃ bde legs su gyur cis/ phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sbu/ / mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i gsung / / ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ / shākya'i gtso bo de la gus pas 'dud/ / zla med ston pa de yi sras kyi mchog / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kun spi khur bsnams nas/ / grangs med zhing du sprul pas rnam rol ba/ / mi pham 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu dpag par dka' ba rgyal ba'i yul/ /ji bzhin dgongs pa 'grel mdzad 'dzam gling rgyan/ / klu sgrub thogs med ces ni sa gsum na/ / yo ngas su grags pa'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /shing rta chen po gnyis las legs brgyud pa'i/ / zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod pa'i lam/ / ma nor yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad bsdus pas/ / gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mar me mdzad la 'dud/ / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs/ / dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal la 143 la

dbyangs/ // ga/ngas can mkhas pa'i tsa/tsug thun tsong kha pa/ / blo bzang grag/sa pa'i zhabs la gus nga sa 0/dung/// / dge legs yen tam ma 'u sa —sna byung ba'i sa/ma/sa / / dri med blo bzang bstan/ pa'i khang bzang rtser/ / chos kyi rgyal mtsham/ 'dzin pa'i pa da/pa' yon can// // dpa/za ldan bla ma'i 'bas la gus nga ru 'dud// /blo bzang rgu'/ ba ku/na kyi thus/sa rje ni/ /gcis/ tu bsdus nga/ yo na tan rgya mcho'i dpa' / // hūṃ ma grub 'phrin las bzang po'i mdzad pa can/// // rje btsun bla ma'i khubs la gus nga sa 'dud/ // sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyam/ snga du/ / tshas ba'i ma/ spru ba nga ra byed/ pa'i ga/nga zab/ 'a// // baྈ chad bsru nga zhing skyong bar 'a/ 'a bzhes pa'i/ / chos skyong bsrung ma'i tshogs/ — ba gus pas 'dud / / zhes ma chod nga ra brjod na/sa 'a sa su/ bya nga la/ / spyod /'jus las // ///'gro// ba'i sdus/ bsal smran gcig/ ngu/// / bde ba tham sa cad 'a/byung ba'i gan/ma/ / bstan pa rnyed nga/nga bkur bste dang / / bcas te yu na ring gnas gyur cig /ces gsungs rnga / ldar/ /zu gyur 'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman/ / bde ba 'byung ba'i sgo sa/cis// pu// / yang dag par rdzogs ba'i sangs rgyas kyi/ // bstan nga rin po che 3di nyid yin/ / de yang mdzod rtsa bar/ /ston pha'i dmas/ chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtos/sa pa'i bdas/ snyed cam/// / de 'dzim/ byed dang smra byed/ dang // / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes gsungs nga/ ltar lung rtog/sa kyi bstan nga/ gnyis su nges nas 'di gnyis 'phel rgyas che 'ing yun ring du gnas pa zhig gal che bas// grol nas grol ba'i lam yang sto na/ / bslab pa da/ga la rab tu gus// // 'ing gi dam nga yo na/ sa/nas shing / /dge 'dun la ya/nga phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes skye rgu'i phan bde 'byung ba'i gzhi/ /dbe/ 'dun gyi sde 'dul khrims gnas pa la rag las nga sa/ dga' lngan —— 144 ———

sangs dka//nga zam pyol gleng rga/ dbe/ 'dun gyi khri/ mas su bca' ba brjod par bya'o / che shā/ dang po dgre/ 'dun gyi sde 'dir 'jug nga 'i gang zab// gi rim nga // ma/do rtsa bar1/ dang por mkham/ po nyid kyis bar chad dris rte yongs su dag pa la skabs da su/ dbye'o/ 'e/sa gsu/ngas pa ltar/ sdom pa skye ba/ gnas pa// mdzes pa// khyad par du 'gyur ba la rab tu bcad pa sa//su/ma / zhwa lo theng gsum/ rku thabs su/ gnas nga// dgon sa/'an nas ras phobs ba/ nag/ cam// nyes can/ zur dze can/ la ga bsdum sogs nad/ chen pos thebs pa'i ris/sa mi 'jug bas ma pa'i khya/ da par/ dge bsnyem/ nyid dang / dge tshul nyid da/nga // dge slong nyid das/ gis snga ma bsnyen par ma rdzos/sa par phyi ma mi bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar sdom gsum thob par byed pa la// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song zhing 'kho/ ra ba las nges par 'byung 'dod kyi bsam pa ga/la che/ rtsa bar yo byad drug das/ tshang na rab tu byung zhing /bsnyen par rdzogs par bya'o/ zhes yo byad kyi rim par dbyebs kha dog gi sbo nas rung ba/ tshad dang ldan pa'i chos gos rnam gsum/ rtse zhwa/ stod 'gag smad sham gzan/ grwa lham/ gding ba/ lhung bzed/ sho ka li sogs tshang ngos blo tshod dang bstun/ dge tshul glong sos/sa kyi sdom pa bsgrub 'jug mdo rgyud du ma nas lung bstan zhing / mtshan thos pa tsam gyis thar pa'i sa bon 'jog par nges pa'i pha blo bzang grags pa zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar grags pa de nyid kyi gsung rgya mtsho lta bu'i nang nas/ nying khu dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'di yin la thos bsam/ lhur byed pa'i grwa tshang skar tshogs rnams kyi nang ma/sa/ dpal smad rgyud grwa tshang sgrigs sor ba 'ag/ nang par snga bar langs te gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i sgo nas shag sbya nga dang khrus — 145 —

sol//sa / tshar jes// 'du la/ nga thog/ chas dung gtong 'ing // dge/ 'dun rnam/sa/ spyo da mtham mdzes nga ra byas ma/sa 'dus/ dbo/sa 'ing /// dge tshu/la slong rnam sa bslang/ gral/ dang sa'/ma ma rnams/ blo kha mtho nga/ma/'i gra'/ la bzhus/ ru/ pa dang / byang 'drem/ gyis skyabs 'gro bskul zhing / dge slo/sa kyis/ sgo gcod nga rdam sa dus mnyam byed/ tshogs kyi skabs ma/ ba dang 'a/ la ba la ste ba sog/ru 'dus/ 'u sa/sa/ za lus//sa// gyon lugs// 'thung lus/sa / 'don pa'i bar chad du 'gro ba'i rigs nang khri/ mas dang 'gal ba byung na dge skos kyis gang 'gab kyi bkod pa byed// skyab4/ 'gro/ gams bcu tshar rjes / rgyun 'don/ gdugs dkar gyi 'go btsugs ba dang ja dang po sa/tong / ja mchod 'dren pa mnyam med dbyangs dang bcas chag med byed/ ja bzhes tshar ba dang / bstan pa spyi sger gyi snyer 'tshe/ nga/ge 'dun ma/nga du dkrug shing mi ma/thum/ pa'i rigs la dmigs pa'i sher snying tshar gcis/ ga/ bzlog pa byed/ja rgyab tu sa lam sogs yab sras kyi shī bstod rnams la dbyangs ring mo ma chag pa byed/ gdugs dkar tshar gnyis song ba dang / ja gnyis pa song rjes lha mo'i gtor 'bul bye da/ chab ril bas chab sa/tong ba dang dge skos kyis 'du khang thog nas 'khar rnga gtong zhing bla ma chos rwar phebs nas gsang ba 'dus ba'i bskyed/ dzogs/ yi dam gyi bskyed rim/ gsang 'dus mngon/ rtogs ma bu/ 'don chos sogs gang 'gab kyi rtsis bzhag gtong / blo la ma chud par dge skos kyis rdo/ dam byas nas dmigs bsal re gnyis ma gtogs shag la 'gro sa med// tsha rting ma'i mang ja tshogs lugs1// 'don chos sogs gong dang 'dra/ ji ltar 'tshams par dge skos kyis chos rwa'i 'khar rnga gtong / tshogs ring thung sogs la yong ma thub na dge skos la ——— 146 la

gnang ba zhu/ bla ma chos rwar phebs/ sgrol ma tshar nyi shu rtsa gcig sher snying tshar gsum/ bzlog pa bcas grub rjes/ gsung chos lam rim sogs gang 'ag/ba kyis gsung chos 'chad/ dgong ja sos/sa kyi tshogs lugs tshogs yun ring thung sogs gong 'dra/ dgong ja grol rjes sku rim gyi 'khar rnga gtong / sku rim la sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig sher snying tshar sa/sum/ bzlog pa byas jes/ rgyud gzhung le'u bzhi re smad rgyud lugs kyi dbyangs dang bcas bstan nas 'as/ ba'i la mtshams sbyar gyi bar 'don/ rgyud gzhung 'don rgyu med pa rnams slob chung ba zhig gi do dam byas pa'i 'don chos sogs 'dzin dbyangs byed 'jug las tshan gyi rim pa bla gnyer gros thog nas dge skos lo re bsko bzhag byed pa'i brje mtshams lnga mchod chen mo'i dus dang byang 'dren skad bzang ba 'don chos gdangs dbyangs nges pa/ dung mkhan gnyis/ 'al ta ba lag gtsang ba/ dkon gnyer/ chab ril ba rnams lo grangs kyi nges pa yod/ tshogs 'don gyi rim pa/ sa lam gsum/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ skabs gsum pa/ gsang ba'i rnam thar/ thub dbang brtan sgrol ma/ dgos 'dod kun 'byung ma// rgya chen ma/ phun tshogs yon tan ma/ blo bzang rgyal ba ma/ thub dbang zhal pad ma/ mkhyen gzigs ma/ jo bstod/ smon lam lnga/ gdugs dkar sgrol ma sher snying /rnam 'joms ma/ bskang gso/ nag po skor gsum gyi lha mo/ cho ga gsang 'dus mngon dkyil bstan 'bar ma rnams btang / nyams bzhes/phyi 'dul ba/ nang gsang sngags yin pa'i dge tshul slong rnams rang rang gi bsrung bya rnams sdom tshig nas 'byung ba bzhi/na bsrung sdoms gal che/ rtsa ba bzhi la mthong thos dwog/sa gsum gyi skyom/ byung na sa/nas nas dbyung zhing /—— 147 ——

bka/gas par/ bla mar ja 'kho/ ra gsum gyis gtsos pa'i bdun tsham// tshogs la mang ja/ las tshan rnams la sne ga3/ ga mchod khang du dkar me sban dar rnam sa 'bu'// chang ni nyes nga kun gyi gzhi ma yin 'dug pas phyi nang bar gsum gang du sngags kyang tshobs la mang ja/ bla mar 'bul ba gsum tshan/// las tshan rnams la sbo sa/'ag phyi nang gang du yang phyog/sa cha 'then 'khyer sob/sa dbe// 'dum/ gyi dbyen du 'gro ba'i rigs byung na rtsa ba dang khyad mi 'dug pas// nge/ lugs kyi gte ngo/ gnas dbyung // chad pa gong bzhin 'gre/la/ de 'og nas/ che ba zam/sa 'a mang ja/ bla mar sa/sum tshan/ las tshan rdzams la ste/ ga 'ag brgya phyag rnams 'ge/la/ gos phu thung pho ching glo gri/ phor shubs ba rnams 'dogs sa med/ phyi nang ba/nga du yang khyi/ ma/ pa bsun sbyin gyi rigs/ ma/dang pa/ 'ur rdo/ rdo sgor so ga/sa bag/ med byed pa byung na/ ma da' gzhu/ 'phrog/ cing / gsan ma rnams la dge skos kyi nyes chad 'gel/ dge smos la kha /rā na lag 'a/na slog pa byung na gnas nas dbyung 'i/ nga chad pa tshogs la mang ja// bla mar 'bul mtshan/ las tshan rnams la ste ga/'ag dge skos la bshas/sa pa dngul srang gang gis ga bos pa'i lnga tshan/ dgon du na chung 'grim 'grul byed dgos byung na dge skos la sa/nang ba zhu/ gnang ba ma zhus na nyes chad mang ja re 'gel/ rtswa 'brog ram 'bros/ gi dpe chos mtshams yun ring na dgag bya che ba 'dug pas ston/ da/pyid chos/ mtshams zla re byed pa'i de bshul chos thog gang ma/nga 'jug dgos/ tshas rwa tshugs phyin mar ngo mar ngo'i gso spyong chag med byas/ ga'i gsu/ma gī phyag len/ dbyar snga ma zhal bzhes dang dgag dbye rnams bstan pa'i snying po yin 'dub/ pas chag med gal che/ zla re bzhin bstan nga spyi sgor gyi sku rim la dmis//sa la 148 ———

pa'i dgu gtod byed/ dgu gtor la bskang gso/ ma shes pa 'gro sa med /pha bla ma'i dus mchod lnga mchod chen mo'i thog la gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod/ 'ag bco lnga / gsang 'dus ma shes nga/ 'gro sa med/ nyer lnga'i nub mo dkar me rgyas pa 'bul ba'i do dam dge skos kyis byas pa'i dmig/sa brtse ma gang mang 'dren// tshogs skal gyi mtshams/ bla mar bdun skal/ gnyer pa/ dbu mdzad/ dge skos/ 'al ta ba// dung mkham/ gnyis/ dkon ba/nyer bcas par nyes skal/ nad pa/ mtshams pa/ spyi las sos/sa dmigs bsal/ 'as/'a zhig ma gtog/sa/ ngo ma med phyin dkor skal mi ster/ bla brang gnyer pa'i g.yog yin nges rnams la mgo skal ster/gnyer pa 'jig rten mkhyen rgya che ba/ yong stangs che ba zhig gal che bas 'os 'du byas nga 'i brtag sgril gang babs nas lo gsum re byed pa dang / 'di kha'i mchod gzhis yong 'bab dang bsnyun chos thog sgru ba mchod sogs kyi gtong deb zur du ba/sal/ gong tshis/ la mi gnas pa'i rigs byung na bla gnyer dge skos rnams gros thog nas gang 'os kyi chad pa 'gel/ bshad/ sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba mi nyams pa zhes gong 'phel bya ba'i phyir du/ bca' khrims/ lcags phag hor zla gsum pa'i gza' tshes 'phrod sbyor bzang ba'i nyin dga' ldan sa//ngas dkar rnam rgyal gling bla brang du sbyar ba'o/ gtsug lag/ khang rnams klog pa dang / /kha ton gyis kyang legs sa/nas shog /rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / / de 'dun don yang 'grub par shog //bslab pa gsum ldan ngur smrig 'dzin pa yi/ / 'dus pa'i chogs kyis gnas 'dir yongs sa/nga zhing / / rtag tu bshad sprub bya ba'i sri/da mtha' bar/ /thub bstan phyog/sa bcur rgyas pa'i bkris shog / / /— — 149 ——

de klo srid spyongaXdang pos danaXnon di khrodaXl bstsal ba'i bca' yigame glangaX/ (spyo lo 1757)oṃ bde legs su gyur cig/ phun tshogs dge legs bye bas bskrun pa'i sku/ /mtha' yas 'gro ba'i re ba skong ba'i gsung / /ma lus shes bya ji bzhin gzigs pa'i thugs/ /shā kya'i gtso bo de la gus pas 'dud// /zla med ston pa de yi sras kyi chog / rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kun gyi khur bsnams nas/ /grangs ped zhing du sprul pas rnam rol ba/ /mi pham 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /shin tu dpag par dka' ba rgyal ba'i yum/ /ji bzhin da/gongs pa 'grel mdzad 'dzam gling rgyan/ /klu sgrub thogs med ces ni sa gsum na// /yongs su grags nga 'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /shing rta chen po gnyis las legs brgyud pa'i/ /zab mo lta ba rgya chen spyod pa'i lam/ /ma nor yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnad bsdus pa/ / gdam pa'i mdzod 'dzin yar me mdzad la 'dud/ / dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen sprun ras gzigs/ /dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam dpal dbyangs/ /gangs can mkhan pa'i gtsun rgyan bong kha pa/ / blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /dge legs yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ / dri med blo bzang bstan pa'i — 150 ——

khang bzang rtser/ / tshas kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i kun gyi thugs rje ni/ / gcig tu bsdus pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /lhun grub 'phrin las bzang po'i mdzad ba can/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ / dus gsum rgyal kun mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus pa/ / dus 'dir snyigs ma'i sems can ma dungs rnams/ /'dren phyir mi yi srid pa'i rnam rol can/ /bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ / chos spyong srung ma'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ / ces shis pa brjod pa'i tshigs kyis mdun bsu/sa te ji skad du mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / sa bzang ba zhes sogs dang bshes springs las kyang /mthun par gyur ba'i yu la na gnas dang / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/nyin mo skye bo'i 'du 'dzis dben zhing / mtshan mo sgra chung ba sogs yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i sa/nas/ dgon/ pa chen po ste/ ri khrod sogs su dge spyor nyam1sa su len par gsungs pa ltar/ bde chen thar pa gling gi dben gnas 'dir dge 'dun ha cang grwa mangs na/ g.yeng ba che zhi/nga 'du 'dzi mang ba dang / gdan sa chen po'i mkham rin po che dang las byed pa rnams kyi thugs /pa phog na ma 'as/ba nga sa ma1tshams ja la sos//sa pa zhu mi byung ma/// 'al 'a/sa/ 'byor dga' bas/ ri khrod/ 'dir bla ma ma gtos/sa nga/'i dge 'dun nyi shu rtsa gsum 'a/sa mang ba bca/ pa ldu/da/ skabs su ma/ babs nga/ra zur du 'dug nga dang / snye smor du yang dam/ngas ma'i sgreg la mi da thus pa'i khang nga/ sobs /'u/
