brgyab nas bag med zol bde byas nas sdod sa med/ slar 'das grongs la sogs pa byung nas tshab 'jug dgos pa byung na/ 'jug pa po yang / gtso chen gdan sa chen po'i grwa pa/ sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa/ gzhan grwa sa sogs nas gnas dbyung byas pa ma yin pa/ tshong byed ha log pa'i rigs ma yin pa/ thar pa don gnyer gyi blo dang ldan pa/ mkhan rin po che'i sku zhabs su snyan gsan phul nas legs par brtags te ri khrod 'di nyid du sdod pa'i gnang ba thob pa dgos pa dang khyad par du yang sgrub gnas 'di nyid/'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub gnas gtso bor gyur ba'i rab bde mchog gi cho ga cha lag yongs rdzogs dang / rje bla ma'i lam rim che chung gnyis/ tha na'ang bde mchog gi bdag bskyed dang bde lam gnyis rgyugs sprad nas 'jug cing /sgrig chas skor yang / spyir dge slong gi rtags cha lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i gding ba/ lhung bzed/ rgyud phor/ rtsam khug phye phor sogs dang /rdor dril/ cang ti'u sogs phyi nang gi cha rkyen rnams tshogs par byas nas 'jug pa ma gtogs gang byung 'jug sa gtan nas med/ zhugs nas nyams su blang rgyu ni/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gyi gzhir brten legs par gsungs/ /zhes sungs pa ltar/ tshul khrims ni yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas/ rang gi khas blangs pa'i sdom pa gsum la gces spras tshul bzhin byas nas rgyud ltung bas ma gos par byed/ gal srid dgos pa byung tshe ji mi snyam par mi 'jog par so so'i gzhung nas bshad pa'i bshags sdom tshul bzhin byed/ dus rgyun du blo spyong dang / lam rim sogs la nyams len ga bo bor byas thog rab gsang bde 'jigs gsum/ma mtha' yang bde 'jigs gnyis yi dam gyis gtso bo byas nas bsnyen sgrub — 152 —

dang / bskyed rdzogs la spyong ba ci thon byed/ mdor na chos spyod kyi bya ba thams cad rje bla ma'i gzhung lugs dri ma med pa la brten pa ma gtogs rnying bon sogs kyi dpe cha la nyams len gtan nas mi byed cing / chos sgrub 'gal rkyen zhi ba dang / mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i phyir chos skyong yang skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim dang mthun par/ myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa/ rgyal po chen po rnam thos sras/ chos kyi rgyal po phyi nang gsang gsum/ dpal ldan lha mo sogs la gtor 'bul bya zhing / spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas pa dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs pad brtan pa dang / sgrub pa po la bar chad med pa gdung shugs drag pos dus rgyun du 'phrin las bcol/ chos mtshams yar 'dus skabs dus mtshams las mi 'da' zhing / khyad par mtshams rwa 'dzugs skabs/mtshams la dus mnyam du bzhugs thub pa dgos/ gal te rkyen dbang gis 'byor ma thub tshe rgyu mtshan dang bcas gnang ba zhu/ mtshams rwa las zhag bcu phan 'gyangs tshe/ mang ja re'i chad pa dang len byas nas sgrub/ zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes gcig nas 'go btsugs zla ba bzhi'i ring la dgun mtshams/ dbyar gnas kyi ring dge 'dun pa thams cad sbu mtshams la bzhugs shing / gal te re gnyis bges/sa dbang gis mtshams la sdod ma thub pa dang mtshams grol dgos pa byung na/ gnang ba zhus nas thob pa dgos shing / de'i ring gi bsnyen bkur ba sogs kyi skal ba mi len/mtshams kyi ring la blo spyong dang lam rim sogs la gzhi byas/ gsang bde 'jigs sogs kyi bsnyen sgrub dang / rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la mthun gzhir byas nas sgrub pa gtso bor byed pa ma gtogs yi ge 'brel ba sogs —— 153 ——

mtho por mi 'jog pa/ phar 'gom tshur 'gom byed pa/ mchod pa'i las kyi skabs kha ras ma bcings par 'phros gtam sogs kyi kha chus ma rung par byed pa sogs gtan nas byas mi chog cing / lhag par chos skyong 'di dag shin tu gnyan cha che bas mchod gtor rigs la sbags pa byung na/ mchog thun gyi dngos grub lta zhog chos skyong rang la 'khon zhing srog gi bar chad du 'gyur bas mthong chos myong 'gyur gyi rnam smin kyi 'bras su mngon sum gyi tshad mas grub pa bcas/ rang srog rang gis gces par gyis la gnas 'di dag la shin tu gzab pa gal che/ dbyar dus zla ba ngo re bzhin nyin grangs skabs dang sbyar ba'i dbyangs sbyangs re byed cing / de yang dbyangs kyi rkang grangs nges pa tsam gyis mi chog skad gdangs gtso bor bton pa'i bslab spyongs phul du phyin pa byed/ sgreg gnon gyi slob dpon nas phyogs lhung sgangs pa'i drang ba 'ag lhag bsam gyi sgo nas sgrig lam tshul mthun gnon dgos shing / gtso bor tshul ldan bgyid pa dang ma bgyid pa mtha' dag gi dpang po legs nyes kyi stangs 'dzin rdo rje'i srung ma khyad par can rnams kyi bya ra ma g.yel bar mdzod gcig de lta/ra bslab par bya ba'i gnas rnams dran shes bzhin gyis zin pa'i bag/ med pa'i ga/nas mtha' dag la sa rgyab kyi phyogs te/ nyin mtshan du 'khor lo gsum gī bya ba la brtson par byas pas/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'phel thing rang ga'an gyi don rgya chen ngo/ 'grub pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba yin no//smras nga// ma/tha' dang tshad bral 'u/sa can 'gro rnams/ kyi/ / bde les/sa kum gī ba'i ra gyur thub pa'i bstan/ / de 'dzin ris/sa snga/sa/sa 'chang ba'i 'dus nga 'i sde/ // 'phel rgyas srid mtha'i bar du gnas gyur cig/ rgyal ba gnyis nga//'i chos srid rin che bstan/ /'u/sa can kun gyi ga/tsug/ gi rgyan mchog tu/ /na54

za pa ba /nga ba pa'i ra ) dri/nga nga pa'i rim rngams da ma ḍi/ rma pa 'byor ‘ldar chen pa / rje bar ba/ nyid chem ngo ḍi) dpe pang thar nga/'i/ rjem su 'jug/ cing / sngo za byung gi rtsam// nga/ra rjes /ba rnam/nu/ bye ras su/ ma bor nga'i nyam sa 'i/ma du thebs / pa drug nges she nga ra dbos nge —/ ngo ji skang/ du so so/ tha/ra nga/bo ma rdo —rā sa/ se/ma/sa rta bo ba'i ma nga/ ka/sna nga 'a1 / / ma rdzun pa'i sa/zer rnon btab pa yi // / gros ba dri sred si zang / re'i/ 3 ma/ 1/ tshes she byin/ nga/ so/ so spyo rba rta ma thul ba snye da rmam sa ༷ sab dang ma tshung ra4 nga/'i rtso por ༵/—༷/ ma ra ro ma sgom/ nas rang rgyur 'du/la pa/'i tha/ngos ༷ / tsa3 bzu jo ro/ ge glo/nga rjam sa la gh+ri/ ma ru/ snyam brgya rnge ba3 rtsa pe /da / /ma / / dge ba / 1 / blung da das/ zo drwa3ba pobs bslab byu ji// mas/sa rjam sa mi /ba mas bras / ldad sa/ces༄ pa/ra bsrung nga/ bor༄ shā5 ra ma1 zad bco bor dge/ tshu' / zla nga5ge sto/ma/ mo/nga ge/ bsrung bya/ mi tshangs par spyo nga nga / ma/ byim par len pa/ sros/ sa/cod pa rdzum du ji/ ba ste rtsa ba/'i dang 1/ de'i ya na 'a ga nyes4 pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba chang 'thung ba rnams srog dang brdos rte bsrung dgos thi/nga / de ltar bsrung nga/'i phan yon kyang sa lceng po 'khor /rā bcu pa'i da mdo la sa// sang si/ dam chos rab tu /'jis/ pa dang / / bde ga/shegs bstan pa 'gags par gyud pa'i tshe/ / nyin ma/tshan du ni bslab pa gcis spyod pa/ / bsod nams de ni do bas khyad par 'phags/ /zhes dam pa'i chos la nan tan mi byed cing bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa nyams dmas pa'i snyigs ma lnga ches cher spyod pa'i gnas skabs 'di dag gi tshe lus ngag gis rnam dkar gyi phung po gzhan byed pa las/ tshul brems sna gcig nyin mtshan gang yang rung ba gcig tsam la bsrungs pa phan yon/ che zhing bsod nams kyi 'bras bu mtha' yas par gsungs la/ sa'an yang snying rje chen ngo pad ma dkar po las / kun dga' bo phyi ma'i dus zad nga 'i dus / — — na (3/pa

du —/zangs pa —— — //nga— ka'atshams kye thru/rā nga 'i rong ba'i sna tshob/sa su spom nga mi bde bar bshes na nga snam sa)/ kyi tshas —nyid yin /shā / de gsang sgron me'i— bskal nga (rem bzang po/'i bskal nga ra gras/ru4 pa 'bi 'a/// rnam 1'dren stong byo'o/ nga/'i tsha/nga chan bskal bzang za/ sangs/ rgyas bzhi nga / rgya'/ ba zas sa/tsang rga sras po zhes ma/tshan gyi grags/ sko / shā/ mu gsu/ma ma tshan / par ga/yo ba de nyid kyis rdzogs ma las kyang ches cher snyen/ba/ da / rang cas/ gdu za dka'i /'gro nga rnams kyi don du ma chos/ gi sprul nga—/'i sbur mngon par rdzogs/ nga/ra ma—/ngas rgyas mas/ chos kyi 'khor lo ga da lam du bgor ba ༄/ bsta nga/ rin ngo che ni lha dang bcas pa'i lus can yongs kyi phan bde ma lus / pa /'byu/nga ba'i sbo ga/cis du/ 'i/na la gshe / / dpe / su grangs nges 'ing / lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin par byed ba yang dge 'dun sgyu sde 'a/ rag/ lus shing // dge/ 'dun spi sde na nga /la /na chos/ ma nyams nga/ /pa brten nas sdom nga len pa dang tshu'/ bzhin bsrung ba dang nan tan/ du byed pa yod na dam pa'i tshas ma nub pa dang / de las phyi nol du gyur na dam pa'i chos nub par gsungs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gnas mi gnas zhes pa'ang rab tu byung ba'i sde rnams kyi bslab khrim/sa tshul bzhin spyod pa la rag lus pa na/ de yang / bstan pa snga dar la mnga' bdag khri srong lde'u btsan gyis mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho spyan drangs te sad mi mi bdun rab tu byung ba nas bzung bsil ldan gyi ljongs 'dir dge 'dun gyi sde dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing / bstan pa rin po che ches cher dar bar mdzad kyang / 'dod lha'i rigs gyur glang dar mas bsnubs pa la brten phyi dar la bla chen pos bstan pa'i me ro mdo smad nas gsos shing / bla chen gyi sdom rgyun la brten nas 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar zhing / khyad par kha che'i — — 167 ———

dga' lda na pa'i ba/sa nga brnge sa/sa gyi grwa tshang khya/ da nga ra du 3phags pa dang//rwa༄/ ldam/mi/da/ rgyud/ nga/'i lugs dang / de/ 'a sa ga/'an pa'i/ lha gro rnam/ sras/ gu/ra 'a 'a//ngu/ tra/ lcam sre/nga / rjes 'brangs za/ma/sa kyi gdangs dbyangs/ rnga ching da) rnam sa thams/ cad ma/byem/ nga bsod mams rgya ma/tsho sos/sa kun mkhyen rgyu(ma ba/'i nga/bang ngo/ tham/sa cad mkhyen pa rim/ byom rnams kyi mthong ba rgyud nga 'i bya sa bzhes da/sa//'a ldan ngo brang ba'i lub/sa su grags pa bsgo bor bton cing / gur 'al/ pu tra bcas la thun mong ma yim pa'i tshar lugs kyi zur brgyan da/nga bcas so so'i lugs ma 'phyugs shing / dbu mdzad kyi 'don ‘4 dal brel star chas/sa shing thang lhod/ du ma song ba/ dbyangs sogs dbu mdzad kyi blo dang sbyar ba'i 'don sgrig ma 'phyus/sa pa so so'i ska/da la g.yo zol med cing mgrin gcig dbyangs ba/cig gis 'phyar ba zur bzhi nas/ 'degs pa la sa bag med kyis gnyid log pa/ kha btums/ rtsig pa dang ka ba la snye ba/gleng mo dang / lag rtsed kha g.yengs/ mis/ g.yengs byed pa/ cag hub kyi sgra dang mchil sna 'dor ba sogs tshogs gral du spyod lam mi mdzes pa'i rigs mi byed cing / tshang mas rnam dkar la sgo gsum 'jug pa gcig tu sgril ba'i lhag bsam dag gis rim gror 'gyur nges pa byed/ bza' btung la longs spyod pa'i tshe/ rang lha'i snang zhen dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas rang gi lus thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo la nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du longs spyad na bsod nams kyi tshogs chen po rdzogs pas kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyod/ bsnyen bkur zur du zhu mi'i rigs rgyu mtshan zhus nas btang thog sbyin bdag la dgos pa'i rim gro'i 'al 'don rnams kyang dad zas chud mi 'dza' ba'i phyir gnad smin yong ba byed/ gung seng gi skabs so so'i — na58 ——

khyim du 'dro// ra bo/sa zer na dbe 'dun thu las spyor sdong/ pa dang mang khrims nga/kyis nga1/'i nyes chad/ nga ngul srang lnga len/ ba'am/ ba/nga 'os brtag/sa / las byed pas dgre /'dum gyi gtsug las/ khang che/ chu'i tsa/nod nga sogs las ma bsrungs pa dang / spyi rdzas dase/ 'dum gyi thus/sa 'dod ldar ma yin par /rang ldo/na du chud zos byed sa med// gong ge/ bcas/ mtshams rnams la sa 'as/'a tshe/ bla ma la la/ btabs ja sba sa// gcig/ da/ge 'dun dmangs la ma/nga ja bcu/ sa//nyer nga la za ba'i khri/ ga kha brtags bcas zhu ngo med par sgrub — dgos shing / bstan pa rgyas/ pa 'i thabs su bca' yig si/ sa/zhung sbong bar mdzad cing // rnam pa thams cad du// sbo sa/su/ma gyi spyod lam gang byas kyang /skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan/ 'byor ldan bsod nam sa gsog pa'i thing sa ces sa/sungs pa ltar/ gzhan la ltos te bsod nams tsa/sos/ pa'i zhing dam par 'gyur ba dang / rang la ltos te thar pa'i rgyur 'gro ba mdzad 'tshal/ li thang mnga' khul gyi skye bo ser skya drag 'an mtha' dag su gang gis kyang / dge 'dun gyi dben gnas gtsug lag khang dang / grong khyer sa 'dabs chags nas sdod pa dang nye skor du ru ba bsdad nas ku co'i sgra sgrog pa sogs thugs dam la gnod pa'i rigs dang / dge 'dun gtsug lag khang sku gsung thugs rten/ mkho rdzas yo byad thugs dam dge spyor sogs la gnod pa 'gal rkyen du 'gro ba'i rigs ma byed par/ mthun rkyen phan grogs su gang 'gyur byed cing / mdor na ri khrod kyi bca' yig 'di bzhi/na tshang mas sbangs blangs yang dag yong ba gyis/ zhes me glang zla tshes la/ / / /

dam nga/'i chos 'jis par gyur pa'i dus na gang das nga'i bstam nga 'di (rā4 rab tu 'byung bar 'gyur ba dag rab ka byung mas bu'i la ga nga/ nas bzung ste/ bu da/nga lha na drug tu chang spyogs sa/nga be/ phyir chang ma'i khyim nas chang ma/'i byem du 'khyam /sa pa/ nga'i/ dam pa'i tshas 'di'i rjes su/ ba mi/bas pa de das tham/sa cad kyang / ku/ na dag/shā bo bskal nga/ bzang po 'di la yongs su/ mya ngan 'a/ma 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ zhes dang kun dga' bo nga'i bstam/ nga/ ('di la gang das/ dge/ spyong gi ris/ru4 cam/ dge/ thrung kan te ma/ dbe/ spyo nga du mkhas 'ches/ pa dge spyong lta ra bcos nga// ngur smrig pyon pa 'byung ba de dag thams cad kyang bskal/ nga bzang po 'di/ la sa/nga byam/sa pa mas rno/sa nga/ la thug gi bar du phyis 'byung ba'i sangs rgyas/ bcom ldan 'das de dag gi 'og tu mthar gyi mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur no/ zhes bstan pa 'di la rab tu byung bar khas che ba'i tshum 'chal dang / rtag/sa tsam 'dzin pa dag/ kyang bskal nga/ sogs la ma/ ltos nga/ra mya ngan las 'da' bar gsungs na/ tshul bzhin du bsrung na ma ngon par mtho ba dang / nges par legs nga/'i 'bras bu zad mi shes nga/ thob par 'gyur ba lta ci smos pas/ de bas na bcom ldan 'das kyis lan gcig ma yin par bsngags par mdzad pa'i bstan pa'i rtsa ba so so thar pa la nan tan du bslab pas 'di phyi'i bde legs thams cad kyi rtsa bar 'gyur ba zhig ci nas kyang gal che zhing / de yang thog mar rigs pa 'dzin pa'i 'dus grwa 'dir gsar du bzhugs pa rnams dge slong yin na/ chos gos rnam gsum/ gding ba/ lhung bzed sogs rung ba tshad ldan dang / dge tshul yin na bla gos thang gos gding ba/ lhung bzed tshad ldan/ zhwa zlam sogs hrul chas min pa'i tshogs 'grim gyi yo byad rnams tshang bas 'jug cing / tshogs 'don gsar 'dzin —— 160 — —

dgos pa rnams slob dpon sogs la brten nas bslab sbyangs la brtson par byas ngos myur bar khong du chud pa byed/ de yang nyin 'as/ phrug/ gcig la mtshon na dmigs bsa'/ 'phar tshogs dgos pa rnams phud/ nyin re tshos/sa thengs lnga re byed pa'i dbyar dgun dang bstun sgreg gnon gyi slob dpon pas brda' sbyar ba dang tshogs la 'du zhing / nyams mgur las/ sgo gsum sdig ltung dri mas sbag/sa pa 'di/ /lhag par las sgrib spyong ba gnad che bas / rgyum/ du stobs bzhi tshang bar bsten pa gces// / zhes gsungs pa ltar/gnyen po stobs bzhi tshang ba'i bshags sdom gyi sgo nas rgyud ngag par byed dgo/sa pas/ lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs rnam so so'i khos bstun gyi yid gyi gsal 'debs dang bcas/ ltung ba spyi bshags tshar gsum gyi ring phyag 'tshal/ zhogs tshog/sa dang po la/'jigs byed kyi bdas bskyed yongs su rdzogs pa// tsha rting mar phyag drug pa/las gshin/ dpal ldan dmag zor ma/ rnam sras/ gur/ zhal/las mkhan pu tra/ lcam sring bcas kyi mngon rtogs/ spyan 'dren /bshags pa dang bcas pa/ gung tshigs la chos skyong so so'i bskang gso dgongs ja dang por/ pe har/ tsi dmar/ thang lha tshangs pa/ rdor legs/ khar kha rgyal po/ dbang bsdud rgyal po bcas rjes 'brangs kyi bskang gso dang bzlas pa gtor bsngo dang bcas pa/ dgongs ja phyi mar/bstod pa/ nyer bsdu/ shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan pa bya zhing / de yang 'jigs byed kyi cho ga bdag 'jug cha lag dang bcas pa mgon chos gnyis kyi gdangs dbyangs/ phyag len rnams rje bdag nyid chen po'i sras mchog rje btsun shes rab seng ge'i bzhed srol 'dzin pa mnyam med ri bo ——— 161 la

khang bzang rtser/ / chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i dpal yon can/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ / blo bzang rgyal ba'i kun gyi thugs rje ni/ / gcig tu bsdus pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i dpal/ /lhun grub 'phrin las bzang po'i mdzad pa can/ /rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ / dus gsum rgyal kun mkhyen brtse gcig bsdus pa/ / dus 'dir snyigs ma'i sems can ma rungs rnams/ /'dren phyir mi yi srid pa'i rnam rol can/ /bskal bzang rgya mtsho'i mgon la gsol ba 'debs/ /sngon tshe bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan snga ru/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa'i gang zag la/ /bar chad srung zhing skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ / chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud/ / ces 'is pa brjod pa'i tshigs kyis mdun bsus te ji skad du mdo sde rgyan las/ blo ldan gang du sgrub pa'i yul/ legs par rnyed dang gnas bzang dang / sa bzang ba zhes sogs dang bshes springs las kyang /mthun par gyur ba'i yu la na gnas dang / zhes sogs gsungs pa ltar/nyin mo skye bo'i 'du 'a—dzis dben zhing / mtshan mo sgra chung ba sogs yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i sa/nas/ dgon pa chen po ste/ ri khro/ da sogs su dge spyor nyar/sa su len par gsungs pa ltar/ bde chen thar pa gling gi dben sa/nas 'dir dge 'dun ha cang grwa mangs na/ sa/yeng ba che 'ing 'du 'dzi mang ba dang / gdan sa chen po'i mkham rin po che dang las byed pa rnams kyi thugs/ ‘ma phog na ma 'as/ba nga sa mtshams ja la sog//sa nga zhu mi byung na// 'al las/ 'byor dab/'a bas / ri khro/ da/ 'dir bla ma ma sa/togs nga/'i dge/ 'dun nyi shu rtsa gsu/ma 'a sa ma/nga ba ba/ru/ pa ped// ska bas su ma/ babs nga ra zur du 'dus/ nga dang 1// snye sko/nga du ya/nga dmangs ma'i sgres/ la mi 'thus nga/'i /khang pa sos/sa na63

spyod du 'gro ba'i tshe/ rtse zhwa ma gtogs pa'i zhwa rigs mi gcig pa'i rigs mi spyon/ phyogs phebs kyi skabs chos gos rnam gsum/ gding ba/ shog li dang lhung bzed sbrags pa rnams shin tu gra 'grig cing / snga 'gro rteng rgyugs min pa'i tshang 'dzom gyis spyod lam shin tu dul ba'i 'byon/ rung khang sogs su sgrig gnon gyi slob dpon pas kyang yang yang lta zhing gtsang sbra ma thon pa dang / ja thug nu nga ma byung ba'i digs la zem 'jog ma song ba'i rgyu mtshan byed cing / ma nyan pa'i rigs la sbug tu slob don zhus zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad kyi tsha rteng mar/ dze ta ri'i lugs kyi rnam rgyal ma lha dgu'i cho ga bdag bdun dang bcas pa gtong zhing / tshes brgyad 'dir dpal mgon zhal gyi dus gtor yin kyang cho ga'i dkyus gcig bas gur zhal/las mkhan pu tra/ ben tse bcas kyi gtor chog bskang gso rgyas pa gshegs gtor dang bcas pa ma chag pa byed/ tshes bcu la slar ma rgyud thams cad kyi rgyal po lu i pa'i lugs kyi dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi bdag mdun dbang chog dang bcas pa smad rgyud grwa tshang gi phyag len ji lta ba bzhin 'dzugs rgyu dang / tshes bco lnga la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi ras bris dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i bdag 'jug len cing tshes grangs dang bstun pa'i nyer lnga'i zhogs pa mchod bzhengs dang / dgongs ja nas tshugs pa'i du sa gtor chen mo nyin gsum dang / nyin bzhi pa la/ bde mchog dang 'jigs byed gang yang rung ba'i bdag 'jug re len/ dmigs bsal gyis gtor rgyag dgos pa rnams la gos chas zung zad gzab pa'i gang cir gra 'grig yong ba byed/ lo gsar gyi skabs/ dbal ldan 'dod khams dbang phyug ma'i/mchod gtor gzab bshams byas pa'i bskang gso shin tu rgyas pa tshogs — 164 —

'khor gtong skyong dang bcas pa byed/ hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad zhing skyong dbang po'i dus gtor la/ mchod gtor gzab shoms byas pa'i gur zhal las mkhan pu tra beg tse bcas kyi bskang gso tshogs 'khor gtor skyong dang bcas pa tshar lugs kyi phyag bzhes ma nyams pa nyin gnyis kyi ring shin tu rgyas pa byed/ dus gtor chen mo 'di dag gis mtshon dmigs bsal dgos pa rnams la/ dung chen/ rkang gling sogs spros bcas don dang ldan pa byed/ lo ltar dgun nyi ldog pa'i gdong du/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi 'phrin las bzhi'i sbyin 'dren smad rgyud pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin rgyas par byed/ gzhan ma dmigs kyis bsal ba'i gtor sgrub/ gtor chen/mdos bskang sogs kyis mtshon rim gro dgos pa'i rigs mtha' dag la/'khor lo/ gtor ma rdzas/ bca' gzhi/ bsnyen sgrub/ phyag len phra mo tshun chad la'ang sla bcos su ma song ba'i so so'i lugs ma 'khrul zhing dngos gtsang ba gzhan gyi dang ba 'dren cing rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi mig rgyan du 'gyur ba zhi/ga nges par dgos par ma zad/ so so'i gang nyams su len rgyu'i smin byed kyi dbang / grol byed kyi 'khrid/ rgyab brten gyi lung /rjes gnang / rigs gtad phyag bzhes sogs 'bad brtson chen pos thob cing / skabs su babs pa gang yin gyi lha'i nga rgyal gsal snang sogs gang che bar ma zad/ chos skyong so so'i las bcol man ngag dang bcas par zhun thar gcod/ gtor bzhengs kyi skabs su'ang / dkon mchog gi sri zhu la bsam pa'i gtsang sbra gtso bor 'don dgos pa ni rnam pa thams cad du gal che ba zhig 'dug nung bgyi ba de las ldog pa'i bza' btung tshar ba dang lag pa ma bkrus par gtor ma bzhengs pa/ gtor sgod ma phyis pa/ gtor snod mi — 165 —

mtshams dang mi mthun pa'i las mi byed/ sgrub sde spyi'i don ma gtogs tshong dang khe spogs bun gtong ba sogs gtan nas byas mi chog dus rgyun zhag bcu yan gzhan du 'gro dgos tshe gnang ba zhu dgos shing / bla ma ma bzhugs tshe gnyer par zhus bas go chod/ gling nang du dus rgyun khal rta dang / khyi/bzhon ma sogs nyar tshags byed sa med cing / rtswa gsog ma sogs dmigs rkyen la gnod pa'i rigs mi byed/ bud med zhag sdod byed sa gtan nas med cing / gtugs dgos byung na bla ma dang gnyer pa la gnang ba zhus na gtugs shing / gling gi nye skor du thal ba dang mi gtsang ba mi 'dor zhing /mdor na mang ja'i gsol chu la gnod pa'i rigs mi byed/ dge 'dun gyi thugs dam la gnod pa'i sgra rang gis mi byed cing / gzhan la byed sa med pa'i go ba bskyed/ dge 'dun grogs phan tshun la dag snang gang 'byung las/skyon brjod pa dang kha rtsod lag 'dres sogs thab mo'i rigs gtan nas med/khang pa dang lhung bzed sogs nyo tshong byed pa med/ ri khrod pa zer ba zas gos sogs gang byung gi 'tsho ba zhig dgos na'ang deng sang yul dus kyi dbang gi chos ldan gyi bya ba sgrub mir gnyer pa re yang dgos 'dug pas/ de yang bla ma la las bcol ba ni chos lugs gnyis ka dang mi mthun pas bla ma dang rnal 'byor pa 'phyag khri mchog lta bu mi tshe hril por mi dang gdong mi 'phrad par mi tshe sgrub pas 'da' ba'i rigs dang nad tshabs chen pos thebs nas las byas mi nus pa rnams gong du phud/ de min ris dang rus stobs 'byor sogs kyi dregs pa mtha' dag spangs te rnam smin dkar por 'dzag par dgongs nas thams cad kyi theg pa khur blangs los byed/ gal srid dge 'dun gyi las bcol ba mi byed par gzhis dgon ri khrod gzhan dang pha mes kyi — — na66 la

yong ba gyis/ smras pa/ lhag bsam dbyar gyi lang tshos bskul ba'i rnga /khrims ldan mdongs ma'i legs bog te/ / bshad sgrub phan bde'i sgro gdugs skor ba la/ /rnam kun brtson pa'i zlos gar byed gyur cig/ /'di lta'i tshogs gnyis ma dros klung chen las/ / dal 'byor dzam bu'i ljon 'dab rab rgyas te/ / sbang rtogs sa bcu'i 'bras bu'i ro bcud kyis/ / bstan 'gro'i phan bde'i nyer 'tsho'i rgyur gyur shog / ces sa rta lor 'o chu bkris chos gling dbo/na gyi bca' yig 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bla ma las sne 'dus dmangs bcas nas bskul ngor shākya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa rta tshag rje drung ho thog thu ngag dbang thub bstan skal bzang bstan pa'i sgron mes pho brang dga' ldan rnam rgyal gyi gzim chung dga' ldan yang rtser bres pa'o/ / / /

rje shes nab seng ges3rgyud smad grwa tshang la gnang ba'i bca' yig la de mo rgya'aXthogaXgis rgyab gnon bstsal ba'i snyan zin/chu 'drug (spyi lo 1772 )gsham gsal srid spyong ji hran shan si yongs 'jin de mo ho tho thu nas gnang ba'i bca' yig don bzhin sor gnas rgyun 'khyongs dgos pa'i 'di nas kyang dmigs bsal gyi rgyab sgon sbyin pa yin pas slob dpon/ bla ma dbu mdzad/ las sne bcas rim 'byor nas 'jug bsgon rgyun 'khyongs su yong ba gyis/ chu 'brug zla tshes/ zhes gser dam chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/grangs med 'gro la brtse bas rab dgongs nas/ / rlabs chen tshogs gnyis legs par bskrun pa'i mthus/ / skye rgu'i don gnyis ma lus 'byor gyur pa'i/ / mnyam med zas gtsang sras la mgon phyag mtshal/ / de yi bstan pa spyi dang ni/ / khyad par bstan pa'i snyeng po mchog / 'dus pa'i bstan la 'jug pa yi/ /bca' ba hrung 'ig 'dir brjod bya/ /de la 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che la zhugs nas snyigs dus kyi tshe gcig la sangs — 168 — —

rgyas thob par 'dod pa rnams kyi 'jug sgo zlas dang bral bar gyur pa/gsang ba 'dus pa'i lam rim pa gnyis la slob cing / rgyud don la thos bsam mdzad pa rnams kyis thugs nyams su bzhes rgyu la/ grwa tshang 'dir 'byon pa'i dge slong rnams kyi ma mtha' yang bsdoms kyis bsdus pa'i khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi bsrung mtshams legs par zin cing thugs nyams su bzhes pa zhig dgos/ dge tshul rnams kyis kyang bslab bya che ba thugs kyis ma lcogs na yang / blang 'das so drug gi bsdoms tshig gi steng nas bsrung mtshams zin nas bsrung ba zhig dgos/ de'i steng nas lam rim ma mtha' yang nyan pa sogs kyi sgo nas lam thun mong bas rgyud sbyangs pa zhig dgos/ de nas byang sems kyi bslab bya rtsa ltung bco brgyad/ nyes byas bzhi bzu zhe lnga dang / sngags kyi bslab bya rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ sbom po brgyad/ bla ma lnga bcu pa nas bshad pa'i sbom po rnams kyi bsrung mtshams zin nas bsrung ba dang / gso spyong dang dbyar khas len dgag ba dbye la sogs pa'i las gral 'du ba rnams kyis sngon du ltung ba byung ba rnams phyir bcos tshul bzhin du byed pa dgos/ de nas khyad par du glo bur du byon pa snyeng pa la brten nas byon pa'i de ltar min kyang rung thog mar kun gyis dge skos la gtugs ste/ dge skos kyis kyang brtags te/ grwa sa gzhan du gras phog pa sogs dang rtsa ba bzhi la mthong thos dwogs gsum gyi gzhi yod par grags pa rnams grwa tshang 'dir mi 'jug par bcad/ skyon de dag dang ldan bzhi/na du rnying pas khrid byung na rnying pa la dge 'dun gyi tshogs chu skyel ba sogs chad las zhag bcu bzhi'i bar spyod par bcad/ de nas tshogs la 'du ba'i tshe gaṇ+ḍa'i brdu ma byung bar du mi 'du zhing byung ma thag spyod lam — 169 —

zhing las/ bun skyed gtong len sogs rang gzhan 'phung du 'jug mkhan 'ga' re yod tshod la 'di dag yong rkyen yang / khrims gnon gyi byed por bskos mi btsugs shing 'go byed bla ma dge skos sogs las sne rnams nas sgrig lam tshul bzhin ma mnan pa 'di rang la lan rtsa thogs 'dug pas rnag thog tsag 'gel gyi so so'i thad du nyes pa gtong 'os che yang phyin chad tshul bzhin yong re'i gnas skabs ngang 'then bgyis pa da nas bzung de rigs bar ma dor ma song ba dang por las sne tshang mas dgon sde'i sgrig lam cha phra mo tsam yang nyams pa med par bgres gzhon bar pa thams cad la rgyun du gnon dgos shing / rang gi kyang 'khur dgos nges la/ thog mar grwa tshang slob dngo/na so sos kyang bshad lung gi rgo/ chod nges shes pa'i chos 'chad nyan/rgyas bsdus mtshams pa'i rtsis ba 'ag dpe 'dzin skyor sbyangs/ rtsod pa rgyugs len gyi rim pa thams cad dus rtag tu tsha 'khyer grang 'khyer du ma song bar dbang po rab 'breng brtul gsum gyi blo dang mtshams nga ra thabs ma/las kyis bsnyun bskul nye das//'a phyogs hūṃ ngas su ma song ba da/gos rgyu dang / lhas/ par ming btags sder sbyin yang la/ bshad ngon stong mgo bde mtho snyeg can gyi zhus ba/nang dang sder sbyin/ za dbang gi/ rjes su ma 'brengs nga/ra rnam dpyong/ 'gran zla dang bra' ba'i rig/sa la lha rams nga/ / bzhin bslab sa/snyer bzang rim gyi sa gleng bsro dang / rdo rams nga/ sos//sa bab 'brel gang yod dngos/ ga/ma/sa drang ba 'a/ga bes spyong len byas nga/'i gle/nga ngan spu tsam med pa byeng / ka' na nga/nga ba/shis nas slo/ba gnyer 'a / dang zhen che ba'i sbyangs/ brtson go rib/ 'dra lam 'am byed pa4 rgyus//sa tsam yo da ma che/ bshos/sa/ bab 'bre'i satan/ nas ped nga/'i lha rams / nga/ so sa/sa ri nga btas/sa kyi rig/sa byung na// che/'i bam/ bcar na70

sa/togs/ rang gang 'dod dang ngo chen sos/sa gang yang mi byed par/ bcad / /gong gi bcad pa rnams phas 'as la ba'i nyes pa byung na dge skos dang bgres pa ba/stun pa'i chad pa gang bcad pa de mi 'khur ba'i log sgrub byas pa byung na grwa sa ma/sa dbyung bar bcad/ ngo chen rgyab kha bdag gnyer sogs byed pa byung na de nyid la yang chad/ las gang thob sbyo/da par bcad/ mdor na mtho dman 'bring gsum kun gyis rgyal ba'i bstan pa'i snying po ring du ga/nas pa'i phyir du bca' yig 'di'i gzhung srong bar mdzod/ 'gro ba'i sdus/ bsngal sman gcig pu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i ga/nas// // bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang / / bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig / gtsug/ lag khang ma/nga klog pa dang / / kha bton gyis kyang legs gnas shog / rtag par dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don ya nga /ra grub par shog / bslab par 'dod pa'i dge slong dag / dben pa dag ni thob par shog / g.yeng ba thams cad spangs na ni/ /sems ni las rung thob par shog /ces dpal ldan rgyud smad grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi bca' sgrigs skor thog mar rje shes rab seng ges bstsal ba'i bca' yig lo mang bskul zad kyis tshig bshus dam brjes thog rnying pa bcas phyir bsrings song ba sgrig lam kun spyod thad bslab khrims rnam par dag cing / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin chos 'chad nyan sgrig kun spyod sogs sngon gyi srol bzang gang ci mi nyams yar rgyas 'byung phyir khyod rang slob dpon bla ma dbu mdzad/ dge skos sogs kyis gtsos las sne rim 'byor nas ngo 'dzin zol 'jog tu ma song ba'i gong don ltar rtsa 'dzin rgyun 'khyongs tshul bzhin du spyod pa gyis/ zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge chu pho 'brug lo'i rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi bral ches dge bar ra sa 'phrul snang gi gtsug — 172 —
'a) lngan bstan rgyal trīsprul rgyu zhus ma 0 thus

rta bsgo/ ma/ pa// mtshon cha /'dog/sa nga1/ thod// bcings/ sto da rjen 'bud nga1 sog/mu/tsā mi chos grwa zhing brten sem sa/ can phra'o bu mngon chung si/ 'tsho spyo nga //phyi na/nga gi bla dngo/na che phra mas—/ tsho regs rta kha/la/ 'e nu sogs la 'os min gyi lnga/ /la khri/ ma/sa bka la mi tshal/ ༅ba la rdo bu steng / khra thod ge/da/ 'gu lung dmar// mo rag/ khe tshe sa/'is / dngu'/ zam rdo chung la phu dal/ra no dud la/sa//nam/ 'khru shug pa tsa/ya /sa/ rnga/ dbra/ga/ chung bras/ bya mo sna / mdor na di/la chung dang rngu chu sngon rngo /'i tshod mtshams tshun chad la dbron ga/zhung gi she ru'i mtsher sa sdod/ mal yin zhu sog/sa/ ji ra mas sa/mas ba'i ma/ ji yim ba/sa/ 0dgos / mi byed nga / da/nga sa/te dang byeng 'ing grwa gte sogs ma deb ku// ngas thub snga srol ba'i na sgru ba blang dgos rgyu/ dkor sa da/gre khu/ ngas 'os bab bla las/ bka/'a 'brug rnying gsum/ bon tshas sogs / ste grub mi mthun pa bsten mi chog nga/ dang / rtsa ba bzhi la 'as la tshe rgyang /'bung/ sa 'dzin gang 'os bshags pa/da7/ra me/ snyan shal// mang ja 'dib/sa long / ja sbag nyi shu rtsa lnga/ mo 'gal/ ja 'khor drus/ 1bcas sgrub cing dgongs 'khod don tshan rnams/ yul khams bde/ skyid 'byung ba'i gzhi/ rtsa dge 'dun rnams kyi tshul khrims rnam par dag/ pa dang dge bcu'i sbangs blangs/ mi chos gtsang ma bcu drug la rag la sa pas ser skya tshang mas 'gal ba'i las la mi zhugs pa dran shes bag yod kyi zin pa byed dgos/ mdor na sdom gsum gyi bcas mtshams lag len tshul bzhin byed pa rnams la bstan srung rnams kyi las gzhi/'i 'phrin las mi g.yel ba dang de dag dang 'gal ba dang bas/ma sbyor ngan pas sde 'di'i sgreg khrims bzi/ba/ pa sogs byung na mngon spyod/ drag pos tshar gcod par mdzad du gsol zhes gnyer du gtad pa yin pas tshang mas spangs blangs 'dzol med la na74 la

ba'i ba༅da nga/ sos/sa chos che ba rnams bcag na ga/dmas ngas/ 'phrod mi sbyin par bcang/ zim thum/ chung ba rnams bcas/ ma/ ji ྅ ra rigs pa/'i chad nga/ byed nga ra bcad/ grwa 'dir spra bad phebs pa'i nga/ge/ slong bgres nga/sa dge// skos dang // dge/ chul bgres pa'i zha'/ ta ba'i thus/sa 'khu/ ra bsnam/sa/ da/bo/sa /lhag nga/ra rtsa ba ba'i 'i ltung ba 1la mthong thos dwogs tsa/sum gyi tsa/zhi byung ba dang khri/ mas gros/sa med par nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang gnas cig/ tu tsag tu 'dug nga ngang // ma byin len che chung gang yang rung ba byas pa dang / lag 'bre' pa'i /'thab rtsod byas nga/ dang myos 'gyur 'thung ba dang / dge 'dun spyi la tsa//nod pa'i khyim sun 'byin sob/sa byas nga rnams grwa sa 'di nas da/byung bar bcad/ cha/da pa ma/ gtos/sa dus min/ gyi kha zas dang sgog pa zos/ pa dang / la ma du 'byon nga/ dang / sbyin bdas/ 'di'i khyem du spyod lam mi mdzes pa byas byung na/ dge 'dun gyis dbus su ji ltar 'tshams nga/'i phyag spyod par bcad/ chos bar gyi ring gang du bzhugs nga/'i gnas rnams su yang gnas tshang gang yin pa la g.yar po bskyis 'grul slong gro sogs kyi gnas tshang sun 'byen pa mi byed par bcad/ dge 'dun gang du 'du ba'i gnas su phyogs gcig tu bzhugs pas chog pa yod na gnas tshang zur du mi 'tshol bar bcad/ mi mangs kyi nang du bzhugs pa la dgag dgos chen po byung na dge skos sogs la gnang ba zhus nas zur du gnas tshang 'tshol/ de la yang khyem pa sogs kyi khyim du khrims grogs med par mi sdod par bcad/ lam du 'byon pa gnas khang sogs la ham sha dang snga rgyug sogs gang yang mi byed par bcad/ gnas mal/ gnas khang / bslab gral sogs la/ dge skos dbu mdzad sogs bka' gros bstun pa'i bslab pa rgan rim nas 'bog pa ma — na75 —

chang (ba ngu /'bod gnas/ su/ skye/ blu ma//la/ma de yi 0da lo/ ra du hūṃ/ we/mu/ sis/sa ngabs bya che bas4 nges/ pa ra rdo ngam byed1/ tshogs/ /3bo/ ra lta bu'i/ skabs su bdud rtsir mo/sa/ nas nu nga cam byed gro ma/ gto gas we/ /na 'dod kyi 'o /ngas4 gyo/ spyod/ sdom gsum 'a/ gces spras dang / sa/so spyo nga / dbyar bsnas1/das//ba/ dbye sogs ba/dru/ gsu ma lci nyam sa lem gtsor ('don thos/ /mdon tshas kyi rim ba snga/ra srol sa/nga 3da rnams sgra das sa/sa la sa/su/ma/ dbyangs rol brdung dkrol sos/sa sang la khungs sa/tug/ de kha'i phyag lem/ da / nyams/ nga zhig dbo/sa/ tsal 'ad/na gyi tshe li/ 4rngo sa/ 'them tsa/ ngo/na /'then ra sa /da lug sko da sogs mi mdzes nga 'i spyon da/nga pe' 'ing mtha' dbus kum nas dang ba 'dren pa 'ib/ da/bo/sa 'i/nga // 'tshos/sa la phebs/ pa'i tshe spyod lam tshul gyi/sa phebs pa ma gtos/sa ba/nyis sa//su ma dpung gshib nas/ ngag 'khya/ la ba 'a/da sgra sos/sa spyo da/ lam mi mdzes nga 'i ris/sa sprangs ma/ru/ gra/'a/ la bzhugs pa'i dus bdun bre kha/ bcad pa lta bu/ rgyab a long bsko ra ba lta bu dbu lo yas/ gi snye ma ltar cung zad na/nga du 'gug nga sogs dgos shing la/ ba dang rtsig par bsnye ba// sa/ya sa/ lta sa/yon lta zla gam kyis mchu btums pa/ gnyid dang gleng mo smra ba/bza' btung 'u/ tshe lce phyir phyung ba/ zas ma 'ong gong nas phor pa gzed pa cag cag phu phu'i sgra sgros/sa pa sogs byas mi chog pa ga bo cher dge skos kyis do dam byed dgos/ 'chogs grol nas gsar bu rnams kyis dpe cha blo 'dzin skyor sbyang sogs dang / rgan pa rnams nas lam rim bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi nyams ba'i/sa phyag skor sogs la brtson pa las snang ba rgya yam/ du ma song ba dgos shing / thar pa don gnyer gyi bsnyen mtshams sa/dan sa gsum dang rgyud stod smad sogs la ngo/na tan don gnyer gyi 'gro nges yin che gnang bka/ga —— 176 ——

mi chog phyir 0ma byor skabs / glo ba tsa/nyer phan thogs nges byung tshe dmis/sa bas la 'os/ bab dang / grwa sar rgyun ring ma bsad kyang sbyang stobs tsa/nga yang med tshe 'di ga'i sgrig lam spyi lta ra khur/ rdor slob kyang dbang lung thob pa/bsnyen tshad dang ldan ba/ dbu mdzad yang skad dang 'don nga/ bzang ba/'khur /8dzin/ tsa/zhan yang spyi sems che zhing gzhung drang ba sa bor 'don byed//lo ltar rgyun tshog/sa sogs kyi 'a/la 'don skya bas pems bga' lda ma ‘rto brgya/bla mchong // gnas bzu/ smon 'a1ma gyi rim pa/ yi dam ma bo/za chos// lha cho// tsham sras/ shus/sa ldan// rgyal po/ dam can sos/sa bskang gsol/'jam dang/snyel mtshan brjod/ sman bla/ sgrol sa/dus/sa ma/ ṇi ri 1 sprub/snyung gnas/ 'jigs byed bdag 3jug rgyud mid phyas/ len ltar tshas spyod sogs zla 11tshes 6la drung pa'i 'das mchod/ tshos khrims pa brje len/byams sku gling skor sogs dus mchod kyi rim pa lo 'khor rgyun gtong deb 'gyeng khra zur ga/sal ltar mchod pa/ bsnyen bkur /'al 'dom/ sos/sa nyams chag med pa dgos gal dang // mchod gnyer khag rnams las grwa rigs byings nas tshong khe bun so/gas mi chog rab tu byung ba rnams 'tsho bas phongs par mi 'gyur bar mi srid pa rgyal bas sa/sungs pa ltar na// bcas khrims dang 'gal ba'i las mi byed/ dus mchod sogs dmis/sa bsal skabs bud med dgongs zhus kyi gling du btang ba las/ dus rgyun du dgongs zhus mi bya/ dgo/na gyi nye 'khor g.yas g.yon/ mdun/ rgyab ri klung gang du srog chags la gnod pa byed pa dang / rku 'phrog sogs gtan nas byas mi chog cing / de rigs byung tshe ngo dga' zol 'jog med pa'i brda 'ded byed dgos/ che btsan dmigs bsal ma rtog/sa su thad nas gling du — — 177 —

'o chu dgon/ spru/ 'dul //khrim/sa bca' yig bstsal brin/ / sa ja— ( spyo ja 979shā )6 rdo/ sti ste/ / sngo na sgo che/ thugs ba nga dzam sgo ri /sgyu da/nga da/ ‘/ shā rngo byer / / zan rā4/ sa/nyis lngo ba/ter klong sto rab prim/ nga rdo re / / 4 rme/char dnge / po/mu / ra kyi rtse ma/ sa//ru ra za mkhan// / zas da gtsang sras/ kyis rngo/kra shis/ ste / / 'ang kar bye / / 'jam dbyungs/ rang sa/zus//sa dri/ yi srid nga/'i gar/ / ma nga lngos sdom sa/sum/ rin chen rgyan 'a pa chang 'i/nga // /'gro/ rwa/ pan bde'i bzhin ras ngom/ mdzad pa // / dus gsu ma/ rgya'/ ba tsing kha pa la /3dur// / ma/gon po gang ge snyan rgyud ga/nga sa/'i rgyun/ // ga/ngas ljongs ska/la bzang (re gro ba'i phan nga/de 3/ dpyid/ / 'khrul med legs/ drangs rjes su 'doms mdzad pa'i/ / ba so ldu phreng rgyud par bcas la 'dud// / ces mchod brjod kyi pad dkar phreng bas thod bcings te ji skad du/ / ji ltar mtshan mo mun na/ga spren rum na/ /glog 'gyu skad cig rab snang ston pa ltar/ /de bzhin sangs rgyas mthu yi rgya lam na/ / 'jig rten bsod nams blo gros thang 'as/'a 'byung / // zhes gsungs pa ltar mi khom nga/ mun khrod na/ bsod nams kyi 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi mthu las dal 'byor gyi rten glog 'gyu za/da cig ma 'a/na cig thob pa'i skabs 'dir/ rnam grol thar pa'i sa bon theb nges pa zhig dgos pas/ de yang rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che'i sgor na78

bde 'byung ral pa'i khrod du nyer mdzes pa'i/ / dkar phyogs mtshan mo'i mgon ltar 'phel gyur cig /slu med lha dang drang srong rig pa 'dzin/ /myur mdzad las gshin dmag zor ngal bsos so/ /gur zhal beg tse mthu ldan chos srung gis/ / rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med lhun grub mdzod/ / ces pa gam du bcar ba'i lngags rgyun du zhu—gas pa'i rig 'dzin 'dus grwa rnams kyi lag tu blang bde ba'i bca' yig bag yod khrims kyi rnga chen zhes bya ba 'di yang sngon nas 'dri 'dun yod pa'i thog sgrig gnon slob dpon zur pa dge slong blo bzang chos rgyal gyi yang yang bskul zhing / nye char sgrig gnon gyi slob dpon dge slong blo bzang tshul khrims dang / gam du bcar ba'i dge slong don grub bstan 'dzin nas kyang blang dor lag tu blangs bde ba'i khyad yi ger 'khod pa zhig byung na zhes yang yang bskul ba la brten shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa ngag khang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshos pho brang chen po po ta la'i gzim chung rigs gnas kun gsal du dpa' bo zhes pa lcags pho 'brug gi lo'i dbo zla ba'i gral tshes phun sum tshogs pa'i thog sug bres su/ bgyis pa sarba dza ga tam/ / / /— na 47(1 ——

che smon gling rgyal thog gnyis pas se na theg chen gling gi chosaXkhrims sogs byed sgo'i skon bstsal ba'i rtsa chigalcagasaX'abrug (spyi lo 192 0 )'jam dbyangs mi yi zol can gong ma hang ti'i lung gis/ nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi las don/ 'khur 'dzin zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin byed dang la ldan no min han rgyal tshab dga' ldan shri be/ thu sa ma ti nga/ka ho thog thur 'bod pa'i gtam/'phags chen phyag na pad+ma'i 'dul zhing bsil lnga/na rwa ba dkar po'i ljongs 'dir gnas shing rgyu ba'i khyi/ma nas khyim med par rab tu byung ba'i chos bzhin spyod pa'i skye 'gro spyi dang / bye brag rnam grol don du gnyer ba'i yang rtse chos sde chen po'i slob dpon las sne/ 'dus tshogs dang bcas pa mtha' das la bzlo ba/ 'jig rten gyi phan pa dang bde ba ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sa/zhi rtsa bla na med pa ni/ kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin po che dang / 'jam mgon bla ma chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bzhed sro'/ dri ma bral ba bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'di dag 'dzin skyong spel ga/sum gyi sgo na/sa —— 180 la

mi nyams dar rgyas su gyur pa la rag las mi/nga de yang 'khor lo gsum gyi sgo nas 'chad spel nyams su len pa'i gtso bo gdan sa chen po gsum gyis dbus pa'i dge 'dun gyi sde rnams kyi bca' khrims gtsang ma'i sgo nas 'dzin skyor sbyangs rtsod rigs sogs rlabs su che ba bgyis pa'i rang gzhan gyi don lhun gyis 'grub pa zhig dgos rgyur blo bzang thub dbang rdo rje 'chang gi bka' 'dul ba lung sde ba'i// mdo sngags lam rim blo spyong sogs kyi rtsa tshigaskyabs 'gro dang sdom gsum so so'i bslab bya dge 'dun spi nang khrims skor la gong sa yas phyin rnams nas rim par bstsal ba'i bca' yig dang rtsa tshig rim pa'i dgongs don sor gnas byung phyin mang du smras pa la dgos ngo/na lhag po ma mchis mod/ 'on kyang snga lo gong ma bdag po chen po nas kho bo cag la chos srid yongs kyi 'go 'chings phyag na pad+mo'i rgyal tshab tu lung las kyis mngon par dbang bskur ba nas bzung zhing 'di'i lugs gnyis chos srid kyi bgyi ba rnams mi nyams gong 'phel nyams pa sor chud kyi lhag bsam rnam kun yid la bcags te bla ma las sne rnams zla chos mjal kha sogs la yongs skabs dang ched btad kyis 'di kha nas grwa sa'i sgrig lam skor la lhod yangs med pa bkod pa nan tan dgos lugs yang yang smras pa ma zad 'di nas sa gnas so sor bya ma rta btang ste lta rtog bgyis nas gzhigs par/ dge 'dun mangs yod thad/ nas nang khrims dang thos bsam sgom gsum gang 'u/ sar yang bstan pa rin po che'i mig rgyan du che ba zhig 'dug na'ang / khrims 'gal dge spyongs sha tshugs 'dzin pa'i dam nyams sdig can las 'bras dang / lugs gnyis bka' khrims btsan po khyad du bsad pa'i bag med ngan pa lang shor re sa/nyis nas nas/ chang dang / tha mi /la/ tho/ mig mangs/ ra khe/ tshong dang /— 181 ———

mdzes pas 'du zhing / bslab gral la bzhugs pa dang spyi dang mthun pa'i chos spyod kyi dus su gtam gzhan mi gleng bar bcad/ gzhan gyi thugs yul du mi bde ba'i bzhugs lugs dang / chos spyod mi byed pa sogs la dge skos kyis brtags nas ji ltar rigs pa'i phyag bcad nas dge 'dun gyi dbus su bzod par gsol bar bcad/ dgag dgos chen po byung na ma gtogs bsngo ba ma tshar bar du mi byon zhing / 'byon dgos byung na yang dge skos la gnang ba zhus nas 'byon pa dang dge 'dun gyi gnas brtan dang / dge skos kyi chos ldan gyi ngag bcag pa'i bka' blo mi bde ba byas pa dang / chos ldan gyi bya ba la log sgrub byas pa byung na dge slong yin na dge slong nyid tshogs pa'i dbus dang dge tshul yin na gnyis ka tshogs pa'i dbus su phyag brgya re 'tshal du bcug nas bzod yar gsol du bzhugs par bcad/ nad pa byung ba'i tshe nad pa rang la rim gro'i chas yod sa legs la med kyang dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs brtse bas rim gro byed pa dang / yang glo bur du byon pa'i bslab bya lam rim bskyed rdzogs kyi 'khrid gsan pa rnams kyis kyang /gong gi thun mong ba'i bslab khrims dang mi 'gal bar spyod par bcad/ de nas rgyud la thugs sbyong mdzad pa rnams kyis bstan pa la phan thogs pa'i sde snod 'dzin pa sogs dmigs bsal dgos ba 'ga' res ma gtogs grwa tshang 'dir ma mtha' lo gsum tshun chad du bzhugs nas slob gnyer la 'jug pa'i rim pa ni/ dang por chos thog gsum tshun chad du rgyud rdzogs par bzung nas dge skos la tshan thog rim pa bzhin sprod pa dang / de'i steng nas mdzub khrid gtong ba sogs la 'jug par bya ba dang gsung chos che chung gang gsan kyang dgag dgos chen po byung na ma gtogs rang dgar mdzub khrid 'grel — na82 —

chos rwa ba tshang ma rigs lung gtong bar 'gro sa ped/ grwa sa'i bla ma zur sdod rigs byung na/ nye 'khor du rgyal dbang mchog gi zhabs brtan bsgrubs nas sdod pa las pha yul sogs thag ring du log sa med/ bla ma dge skos sogs nas sgreg lam ma mnan na bstan pa 'go nas bshigs pa yin pas da nas bzung phyogs lhungs dang / rgyu la ma bltas par sgreg lam che phra tshang mar 'khur med ma byas par tsha nan rgyun chags su dgos rgyu yin/ de mtshungs dbu mdzad rnams nas grwa sa'i 'don rta dbyangs nyams pa med pa'i sngar gyi phyag srol gang yod yar rgyas su 'gro nges nas chos thog so so'i sku rim zhal 'don so/gas sprar rgyun sgrig lam gang yod las mgyogs myur rgyun thung ba sogs gtan nas byas mi chog bsam bzhin bstan 'gro'i don mdzad/ sprul sku rnams dang rgyud grwa grwa sa'i dge bshes rnams kyis gtso byas thar pa don gnyer ba rnams kyis bstan pa'i 'khur khyer te/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhis bsdus pa'i lung dang / skyes bu gsum dang rim pa gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i bstan pa gru bzhi lam pa'i pha chos bla na med pa mi nyams gong 'phel zhig ci nas dgos rgyur/ de don yid bzhag gi chos tshul kun la khas len dri sdur dpe 'khrid/ myong 'khrid/ bshad lung dang / 'khrid rgyun sogs tshogs bshad/ slob bshad kyi chos bka' ma lus pa'i nyams len chos rgyun dkon pa'i rigs rnams rtsad dpyod don gnyer chen pos thob par byas te rang rgyud smin cing grol nas gzhan dag tshul de la 'god pa'i sgo nas thub bstan mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan dus rtag/ tu tshug/sa pa jeg dang blo kha dma' ba rnams kyis rang rang 'khos dpags kyi chos la don gnyer cher bskyed kyi ming dang mthun pa'i bstan pa'i bya ba byed dgos rgyur 'di snang chos brgyad kyi bya byed la ngo tsha dang — 183 —

chog shes gtan nas med cing / dam pa'i chos la chog shes che mdog byas nas/ 'don cha dang / cho ga phyag len sogs gang ngam/ bslabs pa'i mtho 'dod nga rgyal can ming dang don mi mthun pa/ mdog dang bro ba mi mtshungs pa'i mkhas pa'i 'khur 'dzin pa'i rigs nas chos dang / chos pa'i rkang drangs pa'i go thos rigs byung tshe rgyal khrims kyi rjes gnon yan por ma song ba gtong rgyu dang / yang gal che ba 'ig la gso spyong sogs gzhi gsum gyi phyag len gyi thad mtha' dbus kun tu tshad mar 'dzin cing bstan pa'i gsos su che ba zhig dgos pa la dbyar gnas dang yar mar gyi gso sbyong skabs su bzhugs mkhan ji nyung jeg yod skad la da nas bzung las sne rnams nas do dam gyis dge tshul slong ma lus pa tshang 'dzom gyis gso spyong rnam par dag pa zhig rgyun 'jags su mdzad pa las gso spyong ma grol bar skor ba dang /gling dbar khrom sogs la grwa ba gcig kyang 'gro mkhan byung tshe 'dzin bzung bo//sa tshar gcod byed/ de mtshungs dbyar khas len ma byas par su yang sdod sa med/ rab byung gi rtags cha lugs chos gos rnam gsum/ gding ba/lhung gzed/ chu tshags/ mkhar gsil sogs rung ba tshad ldan nges par bcang dgos/ grwa sa grwa tshang / khams tshan mi tshan sogs kyi tshogs la phyi dro'i kha zas sogs mi rung ba'i zas zhus pa byung tshe spyin bdag dang las byed tshang mar mang ja dang / brgya phyag gi nyes pa gtong / yang dge 'dun mangs yod kyi dad gus dang / chos zhu sa'i bla ma tshad ldan yin na ma gtogs chos min log sgrub mkhan gyi bla ma 'chal pa lta grub mi gtsang ba'i rigs la dad gus dang chos zhu sa med/ chos skyong yang sngar nas grwa sa grwa tshang spyi nas bsten mchod byed mus yin na ma gtogs khams tshan mi tshan/——— 184 ———

ri khrod phan tshun sogs nas mi res 'dre re bsten gsol byas mi chog de mtshungs spyil bu so so'i khang thog tu bsangs khog 'dzugs pa dar lcog sogs kyang btsugs mi chog rgya khang dang / rgya khra sogs kyang gtan nas 'dzugs sa med/ spyi khang rwa skor bcas la 'bru dang sgog tsong / la phug sogs kyang btab mi chog phyugs dang rta bong khyi sogs tshags sa med/ rta ra dang /rta bres/ khyi tshang sogs bcos mi chog dgon nang du sprang chas kyi mi yan /pho yan mo yan lho slong ba byung na 'phral du gling srung pas phyir 'don/ mang ja grwa ja sogs kyi chu kha ma mnyam pa/ lhag rab tu ma byung ba'i rigs la sbyin gtong sogs byas na khro chu 'khol ma sbyin pa dang khyad par med pas lhag nol rnams 'pho dgos pa yin/ khyad par tshogs chu'i rigs la chu tshags ma rgyab pa 'di bzhin thams cad kyi tshe la gnod tshabs che ba'i rkyen du 'gyur bas da nas bzung dbyar dus su chu tshags nges par bsgrigs te srog chags la mi gnod pa byed dgos/ mgon khang yas mas tsam ma gtogs/ spyi khang spyil bu/ grwa shag bcas la bskang gso gtong skabs nang mchod chang gi byas pa dang dril ma ḍa/ rnga sbug rol mo dkrol ba sogs zing cha med par thos bsam bslab gnyer rang gtso 'don byed dgos rgyu yin/ mgon khang yas mas sogs su bskang gso ba sngar rgyun grangs bcad las lhag 'thol rgya cher mi 'gro ba byed/ khams tshan mi tshan so sor gtong thebs dngos gnas gang yin gyi gnyer pa 'khor rgyu las gcig la gnyis 'gran gyi je 'phel mang dag gis bslab gnyer la gnod pa'i rkyen che shos yod 'dug pa/ des na zang zing gi phyogs kho nar shas mi cher ma zhen pa nas/ 'chad rtsod spel ba'i nyams len yar rgyas su 'gro ba zhig ci nas dgos rgyu yin/ bla ma dge skos nas chos — — 185 —

mtshams su yang rtsod pa 'dzin skyor sogs la bstun bskul gnad du 'gro ba byed/ da dung gal che shos gcig la grwa sa dang de'i khongs gtogs ri khrod dang / gzhis dgon sogs kyi ser mo ba re gnyis kyis dud stongs kyi sa zhing nyos nas khyim khang dang sa cha 'dzin pa/ tshong dang / bun skyed/zhing las dang g.yul las rbos 'debs pa/ chu 'gyed pa/ pho g.yog mo g.yog bsten nas chang las byed pa sogs 'jig rten khyim pa las kyang 'dod bsnag zhen pa che ba'i dam nyams bsam bzhin bstan bshig khrims 'chal dge spyong gi sha tshugs 'dzin pa'i rigs/ nye 'khor dang / phan tshun yul gru 'ga' la 'thor tsam yod pa'i go thos byung bar da nas bzung skya min ser min las ngan gyi pho tshugs pa 'di rnams 'jig rten khyim pa'i gras su sdod pa las/ chos byed dge 'dun gyi gras su gcig kyang sdod sa ped/ gal te da dung dbyar rtswa dgun 'bu ri bong rdo rdzus byas nas sdod mi byung tshe/ chu gram mnyam sdod kyi las bhe rnams nas mi shes pa'i rgyu mi 'dug pa so so'i 'go byed nas gnas dbyung byas rjes/ 'di nas rgyal khrims kyi nyes pa drag po dang bcas phyogs mthar sa 'dzin la gtong rgyu yin/ de mtshungs spyi so dang gnyer tshang khag sogs dge 'dun spyi'i las byed rnams nas kyang rang khongs chos gzhi/sa khag rnams la rgyus yod/ sha tsha tshul mthun gyi gzhis gnyer sogs 'go byed tshang ma go chod btang nas chos gzhis mi ser dang bcas ji srid bar 'ther skyen du mi 'gro ba'i brdabs gsigs med pa'i bskul mkhas kyi gtong jebs sa zhing rnams lhag bsam dag pa'i 'debs bskol bgyis dge 'dun gī 'du sgo gtong sgo sog/sa nyams chag med pa dgos rgyu la spyi gnyer phyag mdzod sogs ngan pa lang shor re gnyis nas phyag 'debs las sger zhing la 186 — ——

mang ba 'ig bya sa/ tshas gzhis mi ser dud /ba ma/nga po rtsa 'thor la btang nas de dag gi sa zhing thams cad bzung nas 'thor 'phros ngan hrul mi ser re gnyis yod pa la sa/yog bskul 'be/la ba lus/sa gnyis khyad bsad kyi rang snang gang ༅/ra byed mi byung tshe bo/nga ltar phyobs mthar sa 'dzin la gtong ba las 'os ma 'das/ gtong sgo gtong mi rnams ma/sa lhas/ don lo chu lam rgyug gi phogs ja tshul bzang po 'a/dengs bzhin/ du dge/ 'dun la ma btang bar rgyas bsdus kyis nyar tshags sogs byed/ mi mang dag zhig yod tshod 'dra ba/ phyin chad tshul mthun bgyis na so sor 'di phyir legs tshogs che zhing / 'di nas so sos sgog nyar gyi 'bru rigs ji yod khang pa 'di nas 'di thon gyis zhes bsgyur byang thog 'don mi ched mngags gtong dgos byung na mi legs pas rjes yong sngon dran gyis spang blang tshul bzhin rigs shing gra rgyun gyi skor 'di yang don med dge 'dun rnams thugs che/thun khrims mi gtsang ba'i rgyu zhig yong gi 'dug pa/ des na sngar gyi thob khu/ ngas mi dbang 'jam dpal dbyangs sangs rgyas rgya tsho'i be+e ser sogs nas lam ston ltar thob sa thob khungs/sngar sa sngar gnas gang yod byed pa las/ rnying pa nas gsar par 'go skor dang / ham rtsod sogs byas pas dge 'dun phan tshun thugs mi mthun pa dang dbyen dang 'khrug slong gi rgyur 'gro ba'i rigs gtan nas byas chog rgyu min/ yang bud med kyi rigs dgon nang du 'grim 'grul gtan nas byas mi chog cing / rang gi ma yin na'ang gnang chen spi skabs ma gtogs rgyun gtan gnang ba zhu sa med/ gal te dgon nang du bud med gnang ba ma zhus pa'i rigs byung tshe byed gte khag theg dang bcas gnas dbyung dang 'go byed so sor mang ja phyag lnga brgya re'i chad las 'gel/ de mtshungs nag chang rku ——— 187 — —

gsu ma/ tha mi kha/ sbab/ rgyas/ pa/ lha mor grags pa khram pa/ da/gon/ phyi nang gang du yang sto da gos dang / paṇa zhwa gyon pa// dbo/na nang rta bzhon nga / sbog gcod byed nga/ sogs bstan la gnod nges kyi bya ba 'di rnams drag zhan mtho dman su thad nas byas pa srid tshe/ nag chang rku gsum tha mi kha bcas zhu ngo sgron brgyud med par gaṇ+ḍi shog thod kyi gam/sa dbyung byed/ sbag rgyag sho mig mangs sogs la khams tshan dge rgan dang spyi khang rgam/ pa bcas nas 'phral 'phral las sner brda spyor byas nas tshogs gsham du rkyang phyag brgya phragadakar me snya na shal sogs byas rjes nyes bab la ga'i/gas pa'i lus steng la rtsa 'dzin rdo tsa/cal dar chen sogs la nyim gsum bzhi'i ring bcings nas 'joganye ngar dgon phyi nang du spyod lam mi mdzes pa'i rigs spyi dang // lhag/ tu khyem pa yin na'ang / dgon pa'i khrom dang / nye skor du chang 'thung ba /chang sgod thogs pa/ tha mi /la 'then pa/ 'thab 'dzings byas pa/ ku dang // shu/ skad brgyangs byed mi byung tshe spyi khyab tshogs chen dbe/ skos sog/sa nas nyes brdung gi tshar gcod 'phral mar byed pa las spom yor zom lus su mi 'jog yang las sne rnams nas 'di sa/'i ngag bkod dang len gyi tshas khrims tsha nan tshul bzhin bgyis par ga 'a/na dag skya ser drag yang ko gsum gyi rigs nas/ yig rgya 'bebs pa sogs log sgrub byed mi byung tshe zhu mkhan la nyes pa babs lci ba dang g.yin dag la zlog bsgyur gyi mtshams spyong mi dman pa byed/ de ltar slob dpon las sne 'dus tshogs dmangs dang bcas pa rnams nas ji ltar bsgo ba'i tshig bzhin nyams su blangs nas chos sde chen po'i sgrig lam kun spyod kyi rim pa cha phra mo tsam yang nyams pa med pa yong ched 'phral du grwa tshang khams tshan mi tshan khongs gtogs ri khrod dang bcas pa — 188 —

tshang mar 'thal 'u sa med pa'i gan rgya ma tha' 'doms kyang don tshang tshul bzhi/na len lugs ngos dge 'dun dmangs yod la thugs bzod mi bde ba sa/tan nas med thog bag meng/ (phang shor rnams kyang rtag tu bas/ yod la spyor thub pa zhis// ci nas dgos rgyu'i/ snying po yin na de khu 5nga / dung chen khar ma song ba'i/ bla ma dge/ go sa sogs nas rang rang gi shā/sa thog ring thang lhod med pa 'khyo/ ngas/ par byas te/ la/sa sne 'phos na yang sgrig lam rdo lag brgyud kyi tshul du 'gro dgos pa'i chos/sa chen dge sgos gas ra pa 'byung 'gyur gang yin nas sngon yo da bca' yig da/nga / byeng sgo rtsa tshig 'di rdo/na mtha' 'doms do khur shon tshang re byas nas rang gi 'a sa/ thog bar 'khyongs pa'i tshul 'di ji srid bar gnas pa'i spangs blangs g.yo med dgo/sa rgyur/ gal srid de las ldog pa'i chu nang rdo skyur lta bu byung tshe// 'di nas nga/gon phyi nang sogs phan tshun thams cad du nyan ga/non sa nyul btang ba'i lag tu brgyab nga byung tshe khyod rang 'go byed dang bcas pa 'phungs long bas/ de ltar mi 'gyur ba'i gong don che phra mtha' dag la blang dor 'dzol med du spyod pa dang / mdor na chos sde chen po gsum gyis gtsos pa'i dge 'dun le lag dang bcas pa rnams nas gzhan la grub mtha'i phyogs ris/ nang tshags grwa sa'i zhen khog chags sdang rus zhen/ 'gran 'dod nga rgyal byed pa sogs gtan nas spangs te/grwa pa phan tshun/ grwa tshang phan tshun/ khams tshan phan tshun dang bcas pa thams cad/ blo 'dod 'khur sems skyed sdug gcig pa'i sgo nas rtag tu thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom pa'i rim pa mtha' dag yar ngo'i zla ba ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i thabs tshul la 'bad pa ci nas gal che/ ces go bar bya ba'i yi ge rnam gnon lcags po 'brug lo'i rgyal zla'i —— 189 —
sdo 'an ṭī

yang bya med pa ni ji skad du/ dpal ldan zla bas/ gang tshe rang dbang 'jug hrung ma/thun sa/ma/sa pa/ / sal te 'di bdab/ 'dzin par mi byed na / /g.yang sar ldung bas gzhan dbang 'jug 'gyur ba/ / de las phyis nas gang gis slong bar 'gyur/ / zhes pa ltar yin pas des na bsgrub rgyu'i chos rnam par dag pa yang gang zag dbang po rab 'bring kun gyis nyams su blangs kyang khe/ shin/ tu che ba ni/ 'dul ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid yin cing /de'i phyir grub chen skal ldan rgya mtshos/ spyir bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i thabs/ /thing dag/ pa dge 'dun sde la rag don de phyir dge 'dun spyi khrims la/ / thabs mkhas pa'i sbo/ nas phan btags na/ / chos 'dul ba'i phyag/ sbol yun ring gnas/ / zhes gsungs pa lta ra dge 'dun gyi sde sa/sar skrun dang rang gi slob ma rja/mas sdom pa gsum gyi bcas mtshams gtsang ma/'i sgo nas bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar zin nga zhig byung na grub 'bras thams cad kyi nang nas rab da/nga phul du byung bar dgongs te bdag can rnams kyis 'dren mchog dam pa rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri thog bdun hru pa rgyal ba'i yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍita rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang chos 'phel dpal bzang po nyid nas thugs bskyed bla lhag tu che bas bstan 'gro'i bde thabs kho na'i ched du/ rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i nyid sgrol byed ces pa shing pho spre'u'i lor sngon byon skye dngos phu stag lung brag mang gi sa'i char yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams sgrub la gzhol ba'i bste gnas su chags 'debs par mdzad pa'i mang thos bsam gtan gling gi sgrub sde de nyid kyi spong ba pa rnams nas thugs nyams su bzhes rgyu'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa bstar ba la/thog mar 'jug pa po rten gyi gang zag zhugs nas blang dor ji ltar bya tshul/ — 192 ——

de'i yan las/ sgris lam thor bu'i skor dang gsum/ dang po ni grwa pa dang rgyud grwa sa/zhis dgon sogs gang nas phebs pa yin rung de kha'i skyid sdug dgongs pa zhus khrol byas shing blo thas/ rbad chod kyis gnas 'dir dben pa don du gnyer ba zhis/ yin na snyan gsan kha bsod re phul thog bla brang dang gnas kyi bla mas 'dul ba'i dgong pa ltar dpyad nas/ bar chad kyi chos ha cang rgan che ba dang ha cang gzhon che ba sogs ma yin pa dang / dgom/ ga 'a/na nas sa/nas dbyung byas/ nga/ sos/sa kha smras ngan pa phog pa dang // rtsa ba bzhis bslab pa ma rung par gyur nga/ ma yin zhing / rab byung la ma kho ba'i yo byad drus/ 'a/ sos/sa pa thams cad tshags su tshud/ na// sgrig gral dge slong tshad ldan zhig la brten nas sgrub sde 'dir 'jus/ cing / 'jug sgo'i nyin mchog spru' rin po che dang / gnas kyi bla mar mjal dar re/ mgon por snyan shal/dgung tshigs tshogs thun gcig gzab rgyas dang / sbu 'gyed dngul zho re/skyabs rtem/ bsod btags ya/na gang 'byor/ 'dom/ bskul kha btas/sa gcib/ bla brang / gnas bla dbu mdzad/ sku gnyer bcas la sne ba 'ag brgyad sbag re shing rin dngul skar lnga rnams kyis ma mthar bgyis te zhus/sa sgo legs bar grub thog 'don cha'i rigs gang yod rnams le lo'i dbang du ma song bar lo gcig tshun du blo 'dzin gyis byang chub bar byed/ gnyis pa zhugs nas blang do/ra bya tshul la rgyun gyi spang blang spyir bstan pa dang / tshogs kyi sgrig lam bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ mi shes pa ltung ba 'byung ba'i sgo khegs pa zhig ci nas gal che ste blang dor gyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs ma go bar la/ 'don gyi grangs gsog pa tsam la bogs cher mi thon nga/ ni/ rje bla mas/ blang dor gnas la kun nas 'thoms ba'i mun/ / yang la 193 ——

dag thos pa'i sgron mes ma bsal bar/ /lam mi shes na thar pa'i grong mchog tu/ / 'jug par 'gyur bar sbos kyang ci 'i//ga dbo/sa/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir thos pa gang byas kha phyir bltas su ma song bar/ chos kyi mde'u rtse nang du bskor te nyams su len shes pa dang / khyad par sdom gsum so so'i bslab bya dang lam rim blo spyong sogs nyan te/ gcig shes gnyis she/sa las/ len la thebs pa zhig dgos pas/ des na gang la nyan pa'i yul yang mkhas grub thams cad mkhyen/ pas nyin zhag gcig gi skyel ma la yang blo gtad thub mi thub sna tshogs pa yod na skye ba gtan gyi mdun ma rtsa ba'i bla ma 'tshol ba'i tshe/mtshan nyid tshang ma tshang the tshom tsam yang mi skye bar khye dang glo ba 'phrad pa ltar 'jug ga la rigs/ zhes gsungs pa ltar bla mar ma bsten pa'i gong du leg/sa par brtag dgos la/ chos 'brel bzhag nas mdzad pa cir snang yang spyon rtog gi blo bkag ste/ dad pa spyong nus na bla ma'i ngos nas ji ltar yin rung sangs rgyas thams cad der 'dus te byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ po to bas bla ma yon tan che dang chung min gang la dad pa de yis de 'dul/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas/ rang gi bla ma la skyon brjod pa sogs dam tshig nyams pa'i mi dang 'grogs 'dres mi byed/ des na rgyun du gnas pa'i bla ma nas kyang / rang la lhos pa'i sgrub sde rnams dam pa'i chas la spyor gang thub las 'jig rten gyi las la mi bskul/ slob bu rnams nas kyang gnas kyi bla mar bsten lugs 'dul ba nas ji ltar gsung pa ltar las/ ma gus pa dang mgo gzhug med pa'i rigs mi byed par chos ldan gyi bsgo ba rnams la nyan 'jog byed/ gnas kyi bla ma 'chad nyan byed thub pa zhig yin na ji ltar 'os par sdom gsum gyi bslab bya dang / lam rim blo spyong gi rim pa bskyed rdzogs la 194 ——

sogs rgyud dang sbyor rgyu'i chos ci rigs ston pa las sgra snyan ngag sman rtsis sogs tha snyad mang po'i g.yeng ba mi byed/ bla slob tshang mas kyang thun drug gi rnal 'byor ma chag pa'i zhar la ltung ba dngos bgrang byas te/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi bcas 'gal rnams nyin zhag gi drug cha'i thun tshod las ma 'das par bshags pa dang / so thar gyi nyes pa rnams nyal kha tshun du bshags te ltung ba dang zhag tu mi 'grogs pa byed/ 'gro 'dug spyod lam thams cad du'ang shes pa rgya yan la mi gtong bar dbang po'i sgo bsdams te dran shes rgyun chags su bsten/ dge slong rang rang gi rung khang dang yo byad thams cad la 'du shes 'jog lugs shes par byas te byin gyis rlob sbung spang lhung man chad kyi gos pa'ang phyir bcos kyis dag par byed cing / tshogs chus mtshon tshang mas chu tshags ma brgyab par chu la longs mi spyod/ gzhan yang nang re bathin dang me reg gi tshe dus dran bsten cing / za ltung gi mjug dang zag pa 'dor tshe chab nges par len/ bla ma dang rten gyi drung du 'gro ba dang za btung gi dus rnams su mchil lham 'bud cing / rngul gzan ma gyon par gnas kyi nye 'khor las 'da' bar mi byed nga/ sogs spyod lam gang gi tshe yang ston pa thugs rje can rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas bcas 'as/la gī ltung ba che phras ma gos pa la 'bad/ khyad par grogs tshang pa mtshungs par spyod pa la khros na 'khor bsgyur gyi skye ba grangs med 'grub pa'i bsod nams nyams par mdo las gsungs pas/ bla ma dang chos grogs nang phan tshun la pha ma spun zla'i 'du shes bzhag ste bsam spyor thad lhad med nga/ra byed pa ma ga/togs/grwa pa gzhis dgon yul grong gcig min gyis dpung sdebs phyogs spyor dang bla spyis nad g.yos/ tu bskos pa sogs min pa shas/ sdebs za 'du sogs mi byed/ — 195 —

gos gdan lham sogs yo byad rnams kyang 'dul ba dang mthun par sgrig khungs ltar gyi grwa mtshungs byed pa las mi 'dres mi byed cing / tha ma kha 'then pa dang nad la phan phyir ma gtogs sgog tsong sogs zas spyod mi gtsang ba'i rigs longs mi spyod/ mgon por nang skyems dang bla med kyi sgrub rdzas su dgos nges byung na phran tshegs ma gtogs chang gi 'grim 'grul mi byed cing /so so'i spyi por bud med mi gtong / gling gi nang dang nye 'khor du zing cha dang ku co mi 'don/ zla ba yar mar gyi gso sbyong skabs so thar mdo yongs rdzogs 'don longs med tshe sdom pa gsum gyi bslab bya'i sdom tshig rnams chag med du 'don/ mtshams nang sgrig gral du yod min la ma ltos pa'i dge tshul slong tshang ma gso spyong la 'du dgos shing / gal te bsnyen mtshams pa dang nad pa nges can yin na 'dun pa dang yongs dag 'bul len byed/ de bzhin du dbyar snga ma zhal gyis bzhes nas dgos pa shin tu che ba byung na ma gtogs glo bur dgag dbye mi byed par mtha' zhag dang bcas pa bsrung zhing /dus kyi dgag dbye bgyis pa'i phyis nyin ljongs rgyur rgyang grags 'das par phebs te rgyun chags gsum pa dang gtor ma cha bzhi sogs mdzad pa las khyim pa sun 'byin rigs mi byed/ lo dus bsod snyoms la phebs skabs na bza' mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba'i thog yo byad drug dang paṇa zhwa mkhar gsil maṇ+ḍal bcas bsnams te spyod lam gang legs kyi sgo nas phebs pa las phan tshun 'khon rtsod dang bag med pa'i kun spyod sogs byem pa ma dad par 'gro ba'i rigs sbangs te dran shes tshul bzhin du bsten nas dad pas sbyin pa che chung thams cad chud mi 'dza' bar rang gzhan kun gyi bsod nams spel thabs rlabs po che'i gnad sdus pa yan lag bdun pa sogs kyi zhal 'don — 196 — ——

mdzad 'os rnams dang bzhugs gnas bcas su dang ba gang 'dren gyi sgo nas dga' dad spro gsum gyis phebs te ska mgo'i gzhis su sngar srol bzhin mdzad sgo rnams kyang 'chug las med pa byed/ smin drug zla ba nas bzung gnam lo gsar bzhad la phyogs pa'i bar du bla slob tshang mas sbyor ba'i chos drug dang 'di brel ba'i lam gyi rim pa la blo spyong ba sogs dge spyor la tshig sbrel gyi mtshams rgya dam sgrags can rang gzhan rjes su yi rang gi gnas su 'gyur ba zhig nges par byed/ de ltar dgun mtshams sogs dang res 'ga' dge 'dun rnams gso spyong la lhan cig tu tshogs ma thub skabs rang rang gi spos khang du gso spyong byin rlabs gral tshed chug med du mdzad/ skyes chen dam pa rnams gyi gsung chos dbang lung gi rigs zhu bar phebs na ji tsam thogs nges kyi ring bkag cha med cing / 'gyed dang bsod stoms sogs kyi skal bkang chad med gtong / 'on kyang de'i bar lab gleng med pa mdzad ngos nas bka' chos grub phral log byon pa ma gtogs 'khyams nyul mi byed/ thag ring thung ga/nga du phebs/ kyang yo byad drug dang gtor cha/ maṇ+ḍal/ paṇa zhwa 'khar gsil lam sba 'khar gang rigs bcas 'bral med kyis ri khrod pa'i kun spyod tshul mthun gyis phebs pa las/ sbyin bdag gis dbang med dang na ba sogs kyi rkyen min par bzhon pas mi 'gro/ mtshams min pa'i dus kyang ma mtha' snga dgong gi thun gnyis po gzugs brnyan tsam ma yin par sem/sa la 'dzin rgyu yod pa re dang / thun mtshams rnams su lam rim blo spyong / skyes bu dam pa'i rnam thar lam 'bras kyi rnam gzhag ston pa'i gzhung rim gnyis kyi 'khrid sogs tshad ldan gyi gzhung la dpe klog rgyud dang 'dres nges phyag dang skor ba sa ts+tsha 'debs pa sogs sgo mtha' dag nas tshogs gsog — 197 —

sgrib spyong gi thabs la brtson/ ga 'a/na yang nyams len gnad du mi 'gro ba'i rkyen sdug shos lto gos kyi don du nor rdzas la 'dod pa che ba dang chog mi shes pa 'dir snang bas/ lho gos ngan ngon tsam gyis chog shes pa sogs 'phags pa'i rigs bzhi la gnas pas/ nges pa don gyi dge spyong gi tshul dang mthun pa nges can du byed/ gnyis pa tshogs kyi sgrig lam bye brag tu bshad pa la/tshogs brda btang ba dang spyod lam gang mdzes kyis gding thong chos gos maṇ+ḍal dang bcas te ma 'gyangs par 'du zhing / rgan rim bzhin 'du khang du phebs nas thog mar ltung bshags dang spyi bshags gsum la sogs pa phyag 'tshal dang sbrel ba sngon du btang / de nas dge bshes rnams bslab pa rgan rim dang de rjes dge slong rnams kyang bslab pa rgan rim bzhin gral du 'khod/bzhugs tshul yang ha cang gyes pa dang sgur ba ma yin par lus 'drong bo srangs dbu lo g.yag gi snye ma ltar byed cing / kha btums gzhogs gcus g.yas lta g.yon lta/ ka ba dang rtsigs par bsnyes pa/ gnyid dang longs gtam gzhan la mig lta dang mchu tshugs byed pa/ bza' btung la spyod pa'i tshe hub cag sogs spyod lam mi mdzes pa'i rigs spangs te tshul dang mthun par bzhugs/ tshogs 'don gyi rim pa ni bla ma mchod ba phyag chen gsol 'debs rtsa ba dang bcas pa gnas bcu phyag mchod/ sku rim rnam gsum/gtor ma'i rigs so thar gyi sdom tshig rgyas bsdus gnyis/ sngags byang gi bslab sdom min bla/ 'jigs byed bdag 'jug dang bcas pa/ jo bstod bsdus pa/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ smon lam bdun cu pa sogs smon lam dang chos spyod rigs/ mgon chos lha mo rnams kyi bskangs bshags gtor 'bul sogs tho zur gsal du 'khod pa ltar gyi zhal 'don rnams dal brel ——— 198 ——

'tsham zhing rta 'dur gang yin sngar rgyun ma nyams pa dang / g.yas 'then g.yon 'jen du ma song bar dbu mdzad dang bstun nas mgrin gcig tu 'ur chem gyis 'don/ dbu mdzad sogs kyi skor/ de yang skyabs mgon dam pa de nyid kyi dgongs bzhed ltar rgyud grwa rnam gnyis la dge bshes gral du 'gro nges rnams sgrub sde 'dir phebs phyin skur gnyer sogs gzhon khral mdzad mi dgos pa dmigs bsal gnang 'dug pas/ gnas blas ma lhogs skabs so thar gyi mdo 'don rgyu dbu mdzad kyis byed rgyu/ gaṇ+ḍi brdung rgyu sogs dge bshe/sa rnams nas sngar rgyun bzhi/na mdzad 'os su che bas rgan rim bzhin mig dpe yar ltos kyis mdzad pa dang / yang dge slong —mangs gras nas skad dang 'don cha gang mtshams byung na/ gnas brtan dang mangs nas dbu mdzad du bsko zhing / dbu mdzad byed ring gral dge bshes yin min gyi mtshams su spo/ gnas bla dang dbu mdzad gnyis nas lo re bzhin bca' yig sgrog sbyang thog sgrig gnon gyi gzhi rtsa gzung ba la tshang mas ngag bkod dang len sgrubs/gal te dge bshes rnams nas ma lcogs pa byung tshe de 'og nas dbu mdzad sogs zhugs sgo'i rgan rim bzhin byed/ skabs 'gar dmigs bsal ma gtogs nyin re tshogs thun gsum re las mi tshogs/ tshogs kyi ja thug bdun snga phyis sku gnyer nas tshod 'dzin gyis gtong zhing / dmigs bsal dbu mdzad la 'dri/ thun zhugs kyi dge slong shin tu rgan chos pa dang nad pa yin na g.yog dang mthun rkyen gang yang med nges rigs la dge slong spyi dang bla brang nas gros mthun gyis gnang ba thob na ma gtogs rgyun ja'i skal ba mi gtong / lo re sa ga zla bar sprung gnas dkar po cha brgyad dang / dbyug pa zla bar 'jigs byed bdag 'jug zur sa'i rigs la sbyin bdag gis ——— 199 ——

'dod mos dang zhogs tshogs sngar rgyun bzhin las de phyin gyis ja thug rnams shag so sor 'bul 'gyed gtong mi rnams nas skyabs gnas mchog sprul rin po cher sku skal gcig dang gnas kyi bla ma nas dbus bzung dge tshul dang tshogs chu len pa'i bar la ngo skal re/ skyabs rten gang 'byor/ 'don bskul/ sne bzhag snyan shal rnams gang thon/ bla brang mchog sprul rin po che dang / gnas kyi bla mar skal 'phar 'bul min sbyin bdag rang gi 'dod mos byed/ zhogs re dge tshul gyi mchil lham phud gtsang sbra gang che'i thog gral gshams nas phyag gsum phul te dal thung rim bzhin byin len stob cing / nyin dgung yol nas btung ba thams cad la rung chu 'debs/'bru'i rigs dang / rtsa ba'i sa bon sogs la me mtshon gyis rung ba rnams kyang lag len du bstar/ rgyun ldan tshogs tshogs rgyu'i rigs thams cad la brel ba che bzhag chung bshol gyis phebs pa las don med khag 'dogs kyi bag yangs su mi bzhugs/ gal te dmigs bsal gyi brel ba yod nges dang gzugs gzhi ma bde ba bcas kyis yong ma thub pa sogs nas dgongs zhu ring thung bla ma dang dbu mdzad gnyis cha la zhu zhing sku gnyer la brda spyor/ de min gnas skor dang gnyan khrod 'grim pa sogs don che na'ang / rgyal dbang kun dga' dpal 'byor kyis/ khyod yang na tshe dang sgrub pa snyoms/ /yang na phyogs med kyis ldum bu gyis/ / zla 'ga' zas 'tshol gyis gnas skor de/ / 'gro min sdod min gcig ma lags sam/ / zhes gsungs pa'i don ltar sde 'dir zhugs zin nas dran rgyu mang na dge sbyor mthar mi thon cing mig lhos la gnod pa las ma 'das med/ 'on kyang dgos rkyen kyi dbang gis nye ring gi gnas skor dang 'khor 'ag log mi 'gro mthu med lta bu byung tshe bla brang — 200 —

gis kyang dgongs khrol dgos shing / zla ba gcig phan 'byangs na de nas bzung tshur ma 'byor gyi bar du 'gyed kyi rigs dang bsod snyoms kyi rtsam pa sogs kyang spyi pa nas mi sprod/ de mtshungs dus chos su gyur pa dang rtsa dgongs zhus rigs kyi bsod snyoms dang phogs lhag len rgyu bsdad rigs rnams kyang gzhan dag la bskur ba dang khyer sa med cing spyi khang du len/skyabs rten gyi rigs gang nas byung yang spyi par bsdu zhing tshang mas spyi don gang legs su 'gyur thabs la brtson par byed/ gsum pa de'i yan/ lag sgrig lam thor bu'i skor ni/ 'di kha'i mgon po'i sku gnyer 'di nyid sngar nas phyi mi skyed sdug la med pa re gnyis nas byed srol byung yang blo phyir gtad lta bu'i bka' blo ma bde bas/ gong sa skyabs mgon dam pa'i dgongs pa bzhin 'di ga'i dge bshes min pa'i sgrig 'grim pa rnams nas zhugs sru rim bzhin sbu gnyer byed bzhin pa ni bab 'os che ba ma zad/ nam rgyun dge 'dun dmangs kyi gsol chas zhabs 'degs sgrub dgos stabs gal don shin tu che gshis/ phyin chad kyang dge bshes min phyin rim bzhin sku gnyer byed pa las dgongs zhu mi byed/ gal te sku gnyer ma 'then gong chos 'dul ba nas gsungs pa ltar srol dang tshangs spyod sogs kyi bar chad du 'gyur ba lta bu'i rkyen gyis sgyid sdug mi len mthu med byung ba ma gtogs/ dang gi gong ma sku gnyer rtsis blangs ma zin pa yin na/ de man chad thams cad 'dra bar bslu chas dngul srang gsum spyi par ma phul na 'gro gtan nas mi chog rang gi gong mas sku gnyer mis blangs zin pa yin phyin de'i rjes ma des nges par sku gnyer byed pa ma gtogs bsru ba dang rtsa dgongs zhu sa gtan nas med/'on kyang gzugs gzhis gnad ma theg pa lta bu yin nges la bla brang dang /— 201 ——

gnas brtan grwa dmangs bcas nas zhib 'jug gis gnang ba thob na/rang dang sgrig 'grim pa tshad ldan zhig gis khas theg nges byung tshe phyi nang gang yin kyang 'os nges zhig tshab 'jug byed pa las spyid sdug len sa med/ sku gnyer nas byed sgo'i rim pa la 'du khang dang mgon khang so so'i rten gsum mchod chas sogs la 'dzin spras/ dge 'dun gyi zhabs 'degs bsgrub rgyu/sbyin bdag gi ngos len sogs bya ba sne mang 'gan che gshis rogs byed dge tshul zhig nges par brten dgos ba blo gtsang zhing / kha nyung ba bya ba thams cad la yid gzhung zhing gtsang sbra che ba rang gi bkod pa 'gro nges shig sngon tshud 'tshol grub bgyis te/ 'du khang mgon khang bcas par gad bdar dang phyi bdar sogs gtsang sbra gang che/ yon chab kyis mtshon mchod pa 'bul shom/ mgon po dang gzhi bdag gi bskang 'phrin gtong rgyu sogs star chags chu bo'i rgyun bzhin thang lhod med pa byed// rgyun ja dang zur sa'i ja thug gang yin kyang rgyu cha til 'bru tsam yang chud ma zos par tsha 'khol thon gsum gyis ljags spro nges byed/ chu kha mtho dma' yang / mi kha grangs la zhib rtog gis tshod gtan 'khel bzung nas/ dge slong rnams dang las byed gsum bcas par mang nyung dang gar sla mnyam 'gyed rang dag tu nges par 'gro ba zhig byed pa ma gtogs sla chos su btang nas lhag lus rnams rang gis longs spyod pa dang gzhan la ster ba sogs la nyes dmigs shin tu che ba ni lam rim chen mo las/ dge 'dun dang dge slong la bsngo pa me tog la sogs pa tsam yang rang gis spyod pa dang khyim pa la ster ba dang khyem pas longs spyod du mi rung bar gsungs shing / kha na ma tho ba yang shin tu che ste mdo nyi ma'i snying po las/ spu gri rnon po dag gi su/ / rang gi yan lag — 202 ——

gtub pa bla'i// /dge 'dun dag la bsngos zin nga// /khyem pa rnams la sbyin mi bya// /me lce 'bar ba lta bu yi/ /lcags kyi thu lum zos pa bla'i/ / dbe/ 'dun das/ las gang de ni/ /dge 'dun gyi las longs mi spyad/ // ces rje bla mas mdo'i khungs dang bcas te sa/sungs pas dge tshul dang chu len pa gnyis la ma gtogs tshogs kyi ja thug mi ster zhing / do dam dang bkod 'doms yang yang byed/// gzhan yang ska 'go gzhis ka'i ngo g.yog gis mtshon/ sbyin bdag skya ser drag zhan thams cad la rang gi lag 'don gyi go bab dang mtshungs pa'i kha lta ngo len gang legs byed pa las sbyin bdag rnams dge 'dun dmangs la blo log tu 'gro rkyen gtan nas mi byed/ lo gsar gyis mtshon dmigs bsal kha btags dgos rigs kyang sngar lam bzhin tshem lus med par gtong / sbyin bdag bsnyen bkur zhu mi byung na gnas brtan dbu mdzad sogs la rim ba'i na brda 'bul/ rtsam 'gyed dang gtor rtsam sogs sbyin bdag blo rdzogs phyir phral phral du bkye ba las lhag mi 'jog rung khang nang yo byad dang bsnyen bkur kun la 'dzin spras gtsang sbra gang ches bkod 'bras thon pa byed/ zla ba yar mar gyi gso spyong la 'brangs shing 'chug med bzung ste nam yin gnas brtan dbu mdzad sogs la gnang brda 'bul/ cha bzhi'i gtor ma sogs mchod pa bzhengs dgos rnams kyang dmigs bsal mi lcogs nges can byung na ma gtogs sku gnyer rang nas bzhengs pa las/dge slong gzhan la bsun gtser mi gtong / spyin bdag so so'i zhal 'don gang yin gyi mchod pa sogs sgrig shom gang dgos tshem lus med pa bgyis thoga'al 'don 'di yin sogs gnas brtan dang dbu mdzad gnyis la go brda 'phrod nges 'bul/ sku gnyer nas dge tshul gcig brten mus yin kyang ——— 203 —

tshogs kyi 'a/bas 'degs nar ma sgrub dgo/sa khar 'grul pa glo bur ba byung tshe mi lhogs nga/'i rnam pas tshogs dang dge slong rnams kyi 'a/bas 'degs thus shor 'byung nye bas/ 'di lo nas bzung chu len pa mi gcig spur ba yang / kha nyung las/ gtsang 'gan len khag theg dang bcas pa zhig/ dgos pas btsun pa yin na lo re dge slong rnams dang bsod stoms la sdeb 'grem thog 'gro pong gang yod dang / rgyun ldan yang dge slong rnams dang 'gro yong /khyad med las gla cha zur du mi dgos // mi skya yin na/ phogs/ dang bsod snyoms gyi skal ba ma gtogs /'gyed gang yin skal ba sprod cing sko la spyi pa nas ster/ gla'i tshod 'os bab bla brang nas gnang / des zhabs 'degs zhu rgyu spyi pa'i mi yin gshis dge slong rnams kyi chu dang dgun mtshams kyi dus sogs skabs mtshungs sha/ga so/ sor chu skyel/ gtsug lag khang gi nye 'khor dang bcas par nyin re bzhin gad bdar/ dgun kha ba phyags rgyu dang dbyar wa kha thig tshag sogs 'dzin spras khur len/ rgyun ldan spyi don gyi 'a/bas 'degs gtso bor bzung ba'i dge slong rnams dang sku gnyer la rogs ram gang dgos byed/phyin chad chu len pas sku gnyer gyi las grogs la gsar du phan gshis/ sku gnyer dge tshul bcas nas kyang spyi don dang tshogs pa'i zhabs 'degs sngar rgyun zhu 'os gang yin lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhu ba las/ zhe med sgal ral du 'jog pa dang chu len par spyon dkri zhe bsun sogs mdor na ma rabs kyi spyod pa phan tshun su yi thad nas kyang mi byed/ gzhan yang lo rer sku gnyer la 'bras spyi nas ja mar gyi phogs thengs gnyis dang 'bru khal nyi shu tham pa/ska 'go gzhis nas kyang zla shas kyi phogs phran bcas kyi khar/ 'di ga'i 'du khang dang mgon po'i snyan shal gser skyems kyi yon/ phan tshun yas mas kyi ——— 204 ——

grong chog gang yod bcas kyi yong sgyur ba ba rnams kyi thog sbyin bdag byung ba rnams kyis gzhi bzung te dbyar gnas zla ba phyed gnyis ring gzab rgyas gtong srol sngar nas lam byang yin na'ang / re sa/nyis la rgyu chas sa/deng min byung yang sa/tam don mi phongs pa lta bu'i byed dka' tsam yod skad la brten//sku gnyer gyi gtong rgyun sa rtse rnams kyang 'di lo nas bzung gsol rgyu tsa ma ma sa/togs sa dkar bla brang la zhus chog pa bcas sgo du ma nas tsa/sar du yang cha phran bu re yod stabs/ dbyar gnas sngar rgyun nyam/sa med gtong rgyu'i gtan tshigs su bkag 'os che na'ang / de bzhin bgyis na sbu gnyer rnams blo khur ches rkyen du 'gyur ba ma zad/ phyen chad sku gnyer rnams nas yong 'bab gang byung thams cad dkon mchos/ dang las 'bras dpang gsol spis dbyar tshul sogs gtong nges la tha tshig bkag rdon mi 'dug pas ba 'ag sku gnyer re gnyis nas rang 'dod sbugs 'tshangs lta bu'i dbyar tshul gyi sbyin bdag sha thang thang du bstsal ba byung 'dug na'ang / rgyun ldan gyi sbyin bdag rnams bsun rkyen du 'gro bas mi byed/rnyed pa byung nas dge 'dun la mi 'bul ba ni gong du bshad pa ltar rnam smin shin tu lce bas ga la rung /rgyu mtshan des na rje btsun sangs rgyas rdo rjes/rgyu 'bras zhib tig ngang nas/ /dgon pa'i zhabs tog rem na/ / de ka chos rang yin pas/ / 'bad na legs so drung chen/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ lhag bsam rnam dag sgo nas zhabs 'degs sgrub pa zhig byung na 'dus byas kyi dge 'byor gzhan dag de'i brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro ba bcas rang rang la yong 'bab gang byung dngos zhen skyon chags kyi kun slong gtan nas med par/ dbyar gnas nam 'khyol ring bzhes spro nges zhig btang na des 'thus pas/ zla dus zhag grangs kyis bcad mtshams ma — 205 —

dbo/sa/ 'on kyang dbyar rnyed kyis mtshon/ rgyun gyi ja thug sogs dge 'dun gyi rnyed rdzas thams cad la bsam sbyor log pa til 'bru tsam byas pa dang byed du bzug pa med do zhes dbyar tshul mthar/ gnas brtan gyis dbus bzung dge slong tshang 'dzom gyi dbus su mchog gsum dang las 'bras la bden pa brdar zhing ye shes kyi mgon po las mkhan gzhi bdag thogs btsan dang bcas pa dpang gsol gyi bro bor zhus thog byas byung la zhib pa'i gtam gyis sngun bsus te 'os bab kyis legs dar bkon// bla brang nas dge slong spyi pa'i rgyun ja lo rer ja ko rtse brgyad pa yan sbag bcu gnyis dang mar lha nyag gi khal drug hru tham pa re/ sku gnyer la shing rin ṭam srang bcu gnyis/ rgyun thug gi brdor tshag spus 'bring ba'i/ gling dgu/ zhib thal dang / tshwa bul zad len bcas gnang ba'i zhal dan mdzad 'dug pa las ja mar rnams ston dpyid gnyis la dus res gtsang 'grel dge spyi tshang 'dzom gyi thog 'bul zhing / ja dang nyag mig sogs phan tshun yid ches kyis ngo 'phrod nges byed/ mtshams min pa'i tshe rgyun ja dang zur pa tshang ma'i ja mar 'don dgos sogs kyi mnyam tshogs rigs thams cad la brda byung 'phral phebs pa las/ snga ring phyi thung mi mdzad cing brel ba yod nges yin na dgongs pa nges par zhu/ bla brang dang dge spyis bkod khyab byung na ma gtogs gnas kyi mtshams las grol ba'i grong chog gi brda rang don du mi len/ mdor na be'u bum sngon po las/ /snying nas thar pa 'dod pa rnams kyis/ /skyes pa'i yul spangs nye du thag bsrings/ / mthun pa'i yul 'dug bshes gnyen rtag bsten/ /'du 'dzi kun spangs tshul bzhin yid byed/ /de la thar pa ring ba ma yin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang yul dang nye du'i 'khri ba chod cing / grong pa'i skye bo sogs mang por 'grogs — 206 —

'gris/ ngang don med kyi 'chal gtam/ 'gro 'dug nyo tshong sogs bya byed ma/nga ngo mi rtsom 'i/nga / chen po'i ngo 'dzin sogs kyi sna thag mi la mi gtod par/ da res mdo sbags yongs rdzogs kyi lam cha tshang ba dang mjal dus tshe lhag 'di'i steng nas/ spang gnyen blang dor gyi nyams len rmad du byung bas gtan gyi mdun ma'i gzhi/ rtsa tshugs ba zhig ci nas kyang mdzad par rigs so/gal srid gong gi bca' khrim sa las /'as/la bar spyod pa byung na bla ma dge 'dun gyis sa/nas min bzod pa ma song bar bstan pa'i 'a/bas tog tu bsams te bab 'os nan tur gyi chad las phyi lam khegs pa nges par mdzad dgos shing / de la'ang rtse med rigs shar na chos spyong dam can rgya mtsho rnams kyis ji ltar 'tshams pa'i 'phrin las kyis tshar chod cig ces gnyer du gtad pa yin pas ji srid rgyal bstan nam gnas kyi bar du tshul bzhi/na 'bad par 'tshal/smras pa/ 'dren mchog nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rjes zhugs te/ / mang thos tshul bzhi/na sgrub la gzhol ba rnams/ / thog mtha' bar du dge ba'i 'bras smin pa'i/ / sdom gsum gtsang mar bsgyur byed rgabs 'di bsgrubs/ / dge 'dis rgyal bstan spyi dang bong kha pa'i/ / ring lugs phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyas pa dang / /khyad par sde 'di mi nyams gong 'phel zhing / /yul 'di skye dgu'i zhing gi mchog gyur shog / thub bstan skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ / sgrub pa'i sde 'dir bar du gcod ba kun/ / zhi zhing bshad sgrub mthun rkyen dbyar mtsho ltar/ / gong du spel ba'i 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig / ces dben gnas stag lung brag mang thos bsam bstan gling spong ba pa rnams la khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge bskal bzang thar bar bsgrod ba'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri thog —— 207 — —
