bdun cu pa yongs 'dzin/ paṇ+ḍi ta rdo/ rje 'chang ngag dbang chos 'phel dpal bzang po'i mchog gi sprul pa'i sku 'jam dpal/ chos 'phel dbang phyug sde 'di'i sa/nas kyi bla ma mang thos tshul ldan/ sos/sa lung rtogs yon tan du ma/'i thugs rgyud legs par phyug pa'i bshes gnyen chen po tshul skru/ mas rnam rgyal gyi gtso mdzad/ spong ba pa rnam sa dang bla slob dge /ra dun sde dang bcas pa la thugs dad lhag bsam rnam nga ra dag pas sri zhu lhur len pa'i bstan pa'i spyin bdag mkhan phyag rman chos ngab dbang bde ldan/ phyag mdzod dge slong blo bzang dar rgyas dang / phyag mdzod dge slong don grub chos bzang bcas nas rin chen gnyis nga/'i maṇ+ḍal sbo 'dog can/ rgyal ba tshe mtha' yas kyi sbu brnyan/ tshe mdo glegs bam/ ka dam ga/dung bstan / bkra shis 'es rab dkar lhing a she dang / 'char ga/zhi'i zin tho bcas bskul ba'i ngor/ rta tshag sprul ming 'dzin pa ngag dbang blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i khro mo zhes pa shing pho 'brug lo'i sgron sgro zla ba'i/ yar tshes dge bar dbus gtsang kun bde gling gi gzim chung bde ba can du sbyar ba dge/ legs 'phel/ / / / ———— 208 —

ninaXchen sgang btsun maXgrwa tshang mi/saXbaca' sgrig yin ba / te/byed nga peb spyod rje/༷skye da/ dra/nga da/zad bkab ba ༷ba brten sgrom da byedaX//ba /byaXzab zab(1ba /ba da//shing sprul/ ( spyo lo 8 1845 )oṃ su ste si rti/ grangs med 'ing gi rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab kum/1/ / sbom/ 'a/ma byed po'i sa/cig char bskrun pa'i gzugs/ / dran pa'i mod la blo yi dpal ster ba/ / gang dang gnyis med bla ma dam pas skyong // / gdod nas rnam dag spros pa'i rba rlabs nye bar zhi ba'i dbyings su gzim kyang gang 'tsham gar gyi rol pa ston/ / mi rtogs rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgya las nam yang ba/yo ba med kyang gang 'tsham las bzhi'i tsha zer 'phro// / thog med las nyon gyis bskyed 'khor ba'i 'phrul 'khor ba'i/ga la rtag tu brel yang gang 'tsham rna ba'i bdud rtsi spel/ / snyig/sa dus thub bstan phyogs re'i grags min gling bzhi'i khyo/ na kun yongs rdzogs mnga' bdag 'khor ris//sa/ rgyud par bcas rnams bsngags/ /yid 'ong rin chen sa 'dzin lhun po'i ngos// /yid 'ong rin chen 'phreng ba spel legs bzhin/ / yid 'ong rin chen sgang pa'i gdung rabs la/ / ngo tshar dad pas bsam bzhin phyag bgyid/ / mchog gsum —— 209 —la

thus/sa rje'i 'od stong bdas/ po ni/ / 'gro 'di'i legs byas rta bdun gyis drangs na/sa/ // phan bde'i snang ba rab 'byams 'gyed mkhas nga / / sbags 'chang chen po'i dus 'dir dbe/ legs stsol/ / /je/sa mchod par brjod nas / 'dir skabs su gleng bar bya ba ni/ rin chem/ sgang btsum/ ma grwa tshang gis bca' sgrig/ lag tu len dgos kyi tho yig blang dor gsal ba'i sgron me 'di yin pas// de yang sngon sa phyogs 'dir bdag nyid chen po sa skya nga/ṇ+ḍi tas dbyar gnas gnang pa'i bla yo yo da cing / sa phyogs 'di nas rin po che'i rigs ba/la zur gsum 'a/ sogs zur du ma dod pa mang byung 'ing / deng sang gi bar du'ang 'byung bas na sa phyogs 'di la rin chem/ sgang du grags/ de nas rnam byung zhes pa sa pho 'brus/ lor/ dpon chen shukya bzang ngo/sa dgon pa btab de/rgya nag gi me tog ra ba'i gtsug/ khang dang tshul mtshungs nga/sa/ me tog gling gi gtsug lag khang zhes kyang grag/sa/ phyis ta dben kun dga' nyi ma sbu mched/ nas sa lo chen po sogs bla ma gong ma rnams kyi bste gnas mdzad pas//gdung rgyud bzhugs pa'i bla brang che bzhi/'i ya gyal bla brang rin chen sgang du grags pa'i gnas khyad par can 'di nyid mi nyams shing dar rgyas su bya ba'i phyir/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyis btsun ma grwa tshang gsar btsugs bka' drin bskyangs pa 'di yin zhing / de la spyir chos byed kyi sde rnams su gzhi tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas/ rgyal ba'i bka' dang / dgongs 'grel gyi bstan bcos tshad ldan rnams la thos bsam sgom gsum tshul bzhin bgyis pas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang 'jig rten du phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba ni rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin/ des na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dge 'dun la rag las zhes pa'i rgyu mtshan de yin/— 210 —

de skad du rgyal ba gnyis pa dbyig gnyen zhabs kyis/ tshul gnas thos dang bsam ldan zhing / bsgom pa la ni rab tu spyor zhes dang / chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas mdor na sangs rgyas gdung rabs dang mthun pa'i thos bsam sgom pa gsum/ bsam pa dag pas sgrub byed na/ sangs rgyas brtan pa shes par bya zhes gsungs pa yin/ des na dgon gnas 'di nyid du'ang thog mar rgya dpon mkhan rin po che'i drung cho ga rnam par dag pa la brten nas sdom pa yang dag par blangs pa'i sgo nas/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lung du ldan bar byas te thos bsam bsgom gsum la rim gyis 'bad dgos pa yin/de yang thog mar khrims gtsang zhi/nga chos byed rnams thugs mthun pa ni shin tu nas gal che ba'i mi gtsang spyod kyi char gtogs 'khrig pa'i tshig tsam yang mi brjod/ srog gcod kyi char gtogs 'bu srin tsam la yang ga/nod pa mi skyel/ma byen len gyi char gtogs nas phul gang tsam yang mi rku/ brdzun gyi char gtogs rang gi grwa tshang la zhen pa'i ham lab tsam yang mi smra/ gzhan yang dpon slob sogs dkrug pa'i phra ma mi 'jub/ rang gzhan gnyis ka la gnod pa'i tshig rtsub mi smra/ thos bsam gyi bar chad du 'gyur ba'i ngag 'khyal mi smra/ gzhan nor bdag gis byed 'dod pa'i brnab sems mi byed/gnod len ngan sems ma skyes pa'i dran 'dzin mtho dman su la'ang log lta ma skyes/ pa'i sbangs blangs tshul bzhin byed dgos rgyu yin/ der ma zad rang rang gi pha ma mam mgon skyabs med pa'i nad pa lta bu yin na ma gtogs gzhan skyes pa zhag tu mi bsten/ btsun ma rnams kyang rang rang gi gnas ma'/ rnams su sems rnal du phab te/ chos mthun gyi bya ba kho nas dus 'da' bar ma gtogs gnyis gsum sogs ma/nga du tshogs na yar bla ma dkon mchos/—— 211 ———

mar rigs drug gi sems can kun/ la med pa la sgro 'dogs dang yod pa la bskur 'debs sogs kyi mthar mnar med du skye ba'i rgyu gtam ngan sna tshogs 'phel ba yin pas slob gnyer slob dgos tsam yod na ma gtogs/ gcig pur gnas pa gal che/ nges na yang dag pa'i sgo nas chos spyod bgyid dgo/sa gyi rim pa zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes bcu la gur drag gi cho ga yang tshes nyer bzhi la rje btsun sgrol ma'i dgongs rdzogs su bla mchod sgon lam yongs rdzogs/'jam dpal mtshan brjod bcas/ yang hor zla bcu pa'i tshes lnga nas dgun chos la 'dus nas cho 'phrul zla ba'i smon lam ma grol bar tshang ma thags sogs spangs te tshogs khang du bzhugs pa'i bos nas ma ṇi dang chos spyod ci grub byed/ de bar 'u las/ gang dgos grol cha yong yang hor zla bcu gcig pa lo gsar skabs 'al 'don/ cho 'phrul smon lam skabs bzhin hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi nas nyin gsum gyi bar snyung gnas kyi cho ga hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar snga dro gtor ma rgyas pa/ de nas bla mchod yongs rdzogs/ rjes 'brel smon lam yongs dzogs/ mjug tu sgrol bzlog sogs sku rim sa/nga rgyas bcas nyin re bzhin tshang mas sa/nang dgos dang / zla ba ril por btsun ma brgyad re zhabs skor la 'byon dgo/sa rgyu yin/ tshes gcig na/sa bco lnga'i bar/ 'khar rnga brdung 'phral lag bde ba rnams kyis brda byed/ zla smad la brda med pas rang tshod kyis 'gro dgos//hor zla gsum pa'i tshes brgyad la lu dgon 'byor 'jags la 'al 'don gong mtshungs/ hor zla bdun ba'i tshes bcu bzhi la dbyar stong ska/bas bla mchod sa//zhung srang dang ngo 'i cho 'phrul gong mtshungs/ hor dgu nga 'i sa mtshad la zhal 'don gong mtshungs bcas ja cha chos spyod sogs gong 'khod de rnams kha —— 212 —

yod lag yod dgos rgyu yin pas shar mnon byed/ btsun ma gsar du byas pa'i rigs yin na/ zla ba lnga tshun la klog tshul bzhin yong ba byas/ lo gcig song nas sgrig tshang ma blo la nges dgos rgyu yin/ tshogs nam tshogs dung brda byung 'phral phyi bshol med par 'dus nges blo bla ma dkon mchog la lhing bkal nas chos spyod rnams la mgrim/ gcig dbyangs gcig byed pa ma gtogs kha gcus mgo gcus sogs byas gtam gleng ba dang / lhag par kha 'thab lag 'thab so/sa/sa kyi rgya 'dre byas pa byung na chos byed dbyem gyi gzhi ma yin pas nag che chung la dpags pa'i dran 'dzin khrod nges shes pa'i chad pa spyi chos kyis 'phral du 'gel/ hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig na/sa bco lnga bar 'jam gtong dgos kyi rgyu gnyer khang 'ong thog nas sa khal sum hru dang sa bre bcu spyi pas zhu/ dang po'i tshes bcu la tshogs 'khor yongs rdzogs skrum khog gcig bcas phud phye do che ba gcig dkar rgyan bcas dgos / lu dgon 'byor 'jags su phyag sa/zhung nas 'jam mang ja nas 'gyed bcas gnang ma ṇi 'tsham dang / hor zla dang po'i 'bas skor ba rnams la phyag gzhung nas phogs zhu// zla re'i rje btsun sgrol ma'i dgongs rdzogs la mang ja phyag gzhung nas gnang / snyung gnas skabs tshes bcu ba'i nyin mi dpon chu zam bcas nas yon bdag dge bskul las byung ba'i gtong gzhi gtong / bco lnga gug pa/ bcu drug/ ngag grol la spyi pas mang ja gcig gzhan mi dpon nas thos chen nas 'gyed bcas gtong ma yon la// bzang rba khal gnyis/ ngan rba kha/ la gnyis bcas gnyer khang 'ong thog nas zhu/ zla ba bcu ga/nyis pa'i tshes nyi shu la ma ṇi tshul ja dang / dang po'i bcu drug la grol ja gnyis phyag sa/zhung nas gnang // 'u lag byung tshe spyi ba khyer nas/ drug cu ma zin bar —— 213 —

skor rim gyis 'gro dgos/ spyi zhing rtsas g.yul la drug hru lon pa dang spyi pa khyer ba ma gtogs tshang ma 'gro dbo/sa/ bsod snyoms la 'gro dgos kyi rigs rnams kyang bstan pa'i mig rgyan la phan pa'i kun spyod gang gtsang ngos/snga dgong thugs dam gyi sgrig rim sogs yang dag pa byed/ bsod snyoms la gang 'gor ma gtogs/ snyed btags kyis grogs yul du mi sdod chas kha khyor can med pa'i rigs/ tshogs pa mthun snang du grub pa/ thag/sa sogs la 'gro dgos tshe spyi chos la grol ja zhus pa'i dbyar zla ba gsum re 'gro/ de min grong yul gdan sa dan khrod yo/da pa rnams 'ag gsum sogs sbrel nas mi sdod// kha yul ba /3ga lnga sogs sbrel nas mi sdod/ lha chen rgyun gyi mang ja dkar rgya rigs la dbu byed bzhi spyo/ pa bzhi 'grol rigs rnams 'byon dgos/btsun ma sgrig rgyugs pa'i rigs yin na/ rang rang gi chas gos lus/sa mthun ma gtogs/ tshos mdog ma bsgyur ba'i gos skya bo sogs gyon mi mchog bo/nga 'khod de rnams dang 'gal tshe spyi pa'i ngo srung med pa bos rigs kyi chad pa 'gel/ spyi pa las thog pa su yin de chos khrems kyi go jod kyang yin pas dgon pa'i sgrig/ rnam gzhag spyi pa'i lag len sogs thag pa khur blangs byed dgos rgyu yin zhing // dbu byed kyang las thob/ su yin des rang rang gi brel ba ci yo da kyang / che bzhag chung snol ngos tshogs che chung gang la yang skebs pa dgos rgyu yin/ spyi nga 'i gtong ga'i sgrig lam kun spyod phra mo sogs 'dir ma gsal ba rnams snga rgyun bzhin mthun phyogs rnams kun gyi thugs la bcangs phyag len la thebs par byas/ mi mthun pa'i phyog/sa rnams rgyang ring du spangs nas/ bstan nga/ dang 'gro ba sems la phan pa'i sngo thogs pa zhig ci nas kyang dgos rgyu lags/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa —— 214 ——— —

rgyud bla ma dang / grub gnyis dang la ster yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bar chad kun sel 'dod dgu'i re skong ba'i/ / chos srung nor lha bcas kyi bkra shis shog /zhes bca' tshe rin po che blang dor gsal ba'i tho yig mun sel sgron me 'di bzhi/na dgos gnad gal che ba'i rgyu rkyen bstan pa rin po che snga dus zhi/ga nas bca' yig dang 'brel ba'i gang ci'i 'gyed sgo rnam par dag pa mun sel sgron me lta bu zhig yod tshod 'dug rung / bstan pa rin po che la las dbang smon lam log pa'i bdud sprul las byed grul mi btub pa rnams kyi phyi gyar dmigs ped mig ste phyogs su med par brten kho bo ngan can bsod nams mtha' nu zhal ba dam pa gong ma rnams kyi zhabs sen rdul phran tsam yang 'khod par mi nus kyang las dbang shugs che'i lang tsho na khra dag tu gral gyi mgo gzhug ldog pa gnam pa'i yas byen rnams kyi bkas mngags pa bstan pa rim po che phyi nang sa/sang gsum gyi rjid khur lci bas na nyams pa gso dang gsar du bskrun pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag dpe med bgyid khung 'di rigs la 'gal 'khrul nyo tshogs dri ma'i gos dag gtsang sing shel ltar sbyangs pa'i thugs rje chab kyis 'khrus ba dang rab dkar dad pa'i lhag bsam rnam dag la log smon re gnyis rnams nas bzang spyod los nga 'i lam ston mdzes tshul g.yang pa ston pa'i dbang du mi 'chor ba mchog gsum rin po che mkhyen mkhyen/ shing sprul zla tshes la dge legs 'phel/ / / /

paṇa chen sbu phreng brgyad pas bkra shis lcun po dgon la bstsalaXba'i bca' yigame byi/ (spyiXlo 1shā76 ) don dam chos dbyings 'gyur med bde chen mkha' dbyings las/ /thog med nas goms ma rig mun pa'i rmag rum tshogs/ /pha mthar skrod phyir mtshan dpe'i gzi 'bar sprul sku'i gar/ /'gro ba pad+mo'i gnyen gcig zas gtsang sras de rgyal/ / thub pa'i bstan pa rim gtad dgra bcom bdun/ /shing rta'i srol 'byed rgyan drug mchog gnyis sogs/ /'phags yul dbyig 'dzin lto bar tshar dngar ba'i/ / paṇa grub rkang 'thung tshogs la spyi bos btud/ /thugs bskyed snying stobs btsan po'i shing rta yis/ /'phags yul rin chen gling nas bstan pa'i dpya/ /ljongs 'dir 'dren mdzad mkhan slob chos rgyal tshogs/ /lo paṇa bcas pa'i bkrin tshad bzung bral/ /'phags yul paṇa grub gtsug rgyan mar me mdzad/ /gangs can shing rta'i srol 'byed 'brom ston rje/ /'khu rngog la sogs lha chos bdun ldan pa'i/ /bstan 'dzin bshes gnyen tshogs rnams 'dul bya'i yul/ /gang gi blo gros rtsibs stong 'khor lo — — 216 la

yis/ /bskal bzang rgyal ba'i gsung rab gleng chen la/ /dbang bsgyur grags pas 'jig rten che rgu'i gtsug / zhabs sen la reg 'jam dpal snying por 'dud/ / mkhyen pa'i kha mtha' rgyal ba'i gzhal dka' zhing / / brtse ba'i gting dpog dgra bcom gyis kyang min/ / nus pa'i rlabs phreng sus kyang bgrang dka' ba'i/ / rgya mtsho'i spun zla dge 'dun grub de bsngags/ / rgyal ba'i sras po dam pa tog dkar gyis/ /rang gi cod pan rgyal tshab la bcings bzhin/ /gang gi chos srid rgyal sar dbang bskur ba'i/ rim byon mkhan rgyud tshogs la cis mi dad/ /ngag la dbang 'byor phyogs res tshims min blo gros mchog gi chos kun thos/ /thos don bzang po'i thugs kyis legs bsam shes bya rgya mtsho'i de nyid rtogs/ /rtogs rnams 'jig med brtson pa'i go chas legs bsgom rnam pa thams cad mkhyen/ /mkhyen ldan thub mchog bstan pa'i lang tsho dar la drag dpa'i sdes skyongs shig / rgyal ba'i ring lugs lcag mchog srad bu la/ /snang mtha'i sgyu 'khrul lo nyi ta kha'i tshogs/ /chad med star du brgyus pa'i ma li ka /blo ldan gtsug gtor rgyan du cis mi 'ching / dus gsum dri mas nyer sbags bdag blo'i ka la sha/ / bka' dang bstan bcos gtsang ma'i chab kyis legs bkrus nas/ / mdo dang rgyud sde'i bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis 'gengs mdzad pa'i/ /yongs 'dzin tshogs kyi zhabs gdan pad+mo spyi bor len/ /'gro la ma cig bu ltar nyer brtse yang / /gdul dka'i gshed mar khro gtum nyams brgya yis/ mi bsrun brlang por spyod rnams tshar bcad nas/ rgyal bstan skyong mdzad 'dod khams dbang mos srung / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i mtshan ma mchog / mthon por bsgrengs pa'i mtho ris khang bzang na/ / chos srid skabs gsum mtshon cha brtan 'dzin — 217 —

pa'i/ /sa yi chos sbyin brgya pa'i tshogs rnams bsngags/ /rnam bkra rin chen gzhi/ la nyer grub cing / /'gro tshogs gshis brjod glu dbyangs rtag len pa'i/ /mi 'gyur lhun po'i spun zla chos kyi sde'i/ /phra thi/ba khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge'i phreng / /chos srid khrims gnyis lugs bzang skyes bu'i srog /blun po spyon pa'i zlos gar gyis 'phral ba'i/ /chad mthud rin chen brgya phrag srang bu 'di/ /rgyal ba dgyes pa'i chos sprin las gzhan ci/ /rab mang blo ldan mgu ba bskyed byed pa'i/ / brjid ldan gser gyi rdo rje'i gnya' shing 'dis/ / blun rmongs 'chal por spyod rnams gnya' mnan te/ / bzang po'i lugs bzang spel la spro dga' brtas/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa ta spura'i rgyud las nye bar drangs te 'dir brjod par bya ba ni/ sgron me'i bskal pa 'di la sangs rgyas stong byon pa rnams kyi nang nas me tog phal pa'i dbus su pad+ma dkar po ltar bsngags pa bdag cag gi ston pa rnam 'dren bzhi pa mnyam med zas gtsang sras po 'di nyid sngon bskal pa dpag tu ped pa'i sru rol nas byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/mthar skye ba gcig gis thogs pa'i rgyal ba'i sras po dam pa tog dkar por gyur nas dga' ldan chos kyi rgyal srid la dbang bsgyur/ rang gi cod pan byams pa'i dbu la bcings nas/ / rgyal tshab tu dbang bskur te glang chen dkar po'i zol gyis 'dzam bu'i gling du gshegs nas yum lha mo sgyu 'phrul ma gso sbyong mdzad pa'i ldums su bzhugs/ ga tshal du sku bltams/mtshan gzhon nu don thams cad grub par gsol/ yi ge dang rtsis dang 'phongs la sogs pa sgyu rtsal thams cad kyi pha rol tu son/ chags sred dang bral yang 'jig rten gyi chos dang mthun pa'i tshul tsam du btsun mo'i 'khor —— 218 ——

dus zo'/ rwa shā tre ) che/ja da pa bsta na/ phyos/sa pa cu'i sa༄ ngas rgyas rngam/sa hūṃ thugs/ rje ba'i sgyu pa nga dang / na rga/ /'chi ba'i sdus bsru/'a ro/nga / spru bas rnga༄ 'i/ dge/ zla/nga zam /sa gzigs nga1/mu sgyu /'bo/ ra nga la thus/ru— phyung da/ byes ma// nas/—bye/ ma/ med nga/ra rab tu byung / mi rañja ma'i chu /shā gram du lo drug ge/// bar dā ra7//'a bye da drab po cha/rdzad /tswa7 tshong ge zu bku 3mu / 'a /sa rtswa blangs nga 'i/ sta na 'a/ byang chub kyi 'ing bo/ drung du rdo rje/nge skyi la sdu/nga si/sa ma/nyam 8 ra ba 'ag ste sro da 41/ bdung btu—ra / tho rengs bla na med nga byang chub kyi 'bram/ bu mngom du ma dzad de lnga ra lnga sir lnga sde bzang ngo sos/sa la bdan ba'i chis/ kyi 'kho/ ra /rwa / bskor/ mthar sa du(rwa/ bya rtag 'dzin/ can rnams tshan/ (rā1 ba ba'i dri ra grong khyer rtswa can du rngo nga su mya ngam las/ /snad/3 ba'i tshul bsta na pa sogs mdzad pa bcu ba/nyis kyi tshul bsta na pa'i nang nas mtshas/ tu gyur pa ni rje bdag nyid chem pos// mdzad pa kun nas gsung gi ni/ mdzad pa mchog yin zhes/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i mdzad nga ni/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi phan bde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid can du bshad la/ de yang rgyal tshab byam sa pa mgon pos/ /gang zhig don ldan chos dang nyer 'brel zheng / /khams gsum kun nas nyon mongs spong byed gsungs/ / zhe ba'i phan yen ston par mdzad pa gang / /de dag drang srong gsung yin bzlog pa gzhan/ /zhes yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba mtha' dag gdul bya'i rgyud kyi hon mongs pa'i gnyen po dang / mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i thabs dngos dang / de'i yan lag tu gyur pa 'ba' zhig yin la/bstan pa rin po che de nyid kyang 'dul ba las/ gnyan yod gnas bcas tsam pa ka / wa ra ṇa si yangs pa can/ / rgyal po khab dang drug po ste/ /——la 219 — —

'di dag grong byer chen/ ngo ra grabs/ / jes/ grong khyer nge dab 'us ma/tshon tsa/nga na 'khror rnams bzhi bzhus/sa pa'i yu/la dbus su bsa' bsngu rim pa sa/su ma mdzad cing / rgyan drug mchos gnyis la sogs pa'i pa khya/ grub rnams kyis dgongs pa bkral zhing gtan 'a phab nas dgo/ngas 'brel gyi bstan bcos kyang dpag tu med pa mdzad de nyin mo ba'i na/ gas//nga bar mdzad/ de/ snyed sangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dar tshul ni 'jam/ dpal rtsa rgyung las/ nga yi dus nas lo brgya na// / la/ ba can du mtsho bre nas/ // sa la'i nags ni 'byung bar 'gyur/ 1 'es gsungs pa ltar/ bod 'bi/ thog/ ma mtshos gang nas yo/ da pa rim/ gyis bri nas nags tshal dang / mi'i 'gro ba rnams chags shing /de yang thub//sa rje chen po'i rnam sprul spre'u dang / sgrol ma'i sprul pa brag/ srim/ ga/nyis 'dus pa las/ gdong dmar sha bzan gyi phru gu drug byung ba mi'u gdung drus/ tu grags/ de dag la rim par mched de rgyal po sogs med par sil bur spyod pa la thog mar rje bo la snga ba gnya' khri/ btsan po byon/ de nas rim ba'i na rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa brgyad pa dpal kun/ tu bzang po'i rnam sprul lha mtho mtho ri snyal shal kyi dus spang skong phyag brgya pa sogs pho brang gi yang thog tu babs te dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes/ de nas gdung rabs bzhi song ba na 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bod kyi sa bkra ngan pa bzlog byed mtha' 'dul dang yang 'dul ru gnon gyi gtsug lag khang rnams bzhengs/ sgrol ma'i sprul pa rgya za kong jo dang / khro gnyer can ma'i sprul pa bal za khri btsun gnyis kyis jo bo shākya mu ni dang / mi bskyod rdo rje sogs sprun drangs rgya dkar nas bal po'i yul gyi slob dpon mang po spyan drangs te thu mi stom ṭas mdo rgyud kyi chos mang du bsgyur te bstan pa'i srol — 220 ——

tsa/hod/ de nas rgyal rabs lnga nas rje btsun 'jam dpal byams kyi rnam sprul chos rgyal khri/ srong lde 'u btsan gyi mal/ na ngo/ sgo ti sa ta dang / slob dpon pad+ma sbom sogs spyan drangs// dang la bsam/ yo/sa mi 'gyur lhun gī grub pa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs/ mkhan pos bsad mi bdun sog/sa rab tu byung // lo tsā bas chos mang du bsgyur te rgya/la ba'i bstan pa dar bar mdzad/ de'i rjes mnga' bdas/ khri ral pa can gyis lo bca/ du ma sprun drangs ma/sa gsung rab kyi don rtogs dka/'a zhing 'gyur mi legs pa rnams skad sa/sar bcad kyis ga/tan la 'phab/ glang dar ma 'u dum btsan gyis 'dul ba'i bstan pa bsnubs 'ing / rten brten par bcas nga rnam sa bshigs nas rgyal ba'i bstan nga ming gi/ lhag ma tsam du gyur ba'i dus su sngon gyi thugs bskyed dus su smin ba lha lung dpal gyi rdo/ rjes/ rgyal po sdig can tshar bcad nas ring 'ig lon pa na bla chen dgongs pa rab gas la gyis bstan pa'i me ro mid nas spar bar mdzad/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa dpal ldan a ti sha ni za hor rgyal po'i rigs su sku bltams/ gzhon nu nyid nas rig pa'i gnas mtha' dag thugs su chud cing / grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma du mar rgyud sde rnam bzhi'i gzhung mtha' dag la sbyangs pa mdzad/yi dam gyi lha dpag tu med pas zhal gzigs shing / rgyud 'bum phrag gcig dang bzhi brgya lnga bcu rtsa gcig gsan/ gzhan yang phyi nang gi grub mtha' rgya mtsho lta bu'i pha rol du son pas 'phags yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad kyi gtsug gi nor bur gyur pa de nyid bod chos ldan gī rgyal pos spyan drangs/ pad dkar 'chang 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs slob tshogs mtha' klas pas bka' gdam pa'i srol byang chub lam gyi sgron ma gzhir bzungs/ lha — 221 —

chos kun lngan kyi bstan nga1/'i sgron me/sa bod yu la mum nas/ gre/ gling rum da7//ra por bsgyu ra bar ma/dzad do// ji skad du yang tshas kyi rgyal po sngong btsan sga/ma po'i bka' chems ka ba shing lo cam/ du sbas pa mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bzhin dpal mar me mdzad kyis gter nas bzhes par/ dbe/ slong byang sems ma/ra phyogs sku 'khrungs pa'i/ / gsang sngags 'chang 'ing rnal 'byor chem ngo/ 'i/ / snying po'i mtha' can skyes/ chen dam pa yis/ / 'al yang bsgyur zhing bsnyen bkur dam pa mdzad/ / de la bsnyen bkur cher byed de das/ ni / //'phas/sa pa'i ga/nga zag dge sbyong sha stas/ rgo// / 'e/sa da/nga / dus gsum ma bye/ na pa'i slo ba dpon pad+ma ka ras / / 'jam dpal sprul pa gdul bya bstan pa'i dpal/ / mdo sngags bsta na 'dzin blo bzang grags pa 'byung / // jeng 'dir 'das nas byams pa'i drung du 'gro/ / zhes sogs tshad ma'i lung gis zin pa'i rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa'i bdag po rang cag gi rnam 'dren/ dam pa rje btsun tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal zhes snyan grags kyi ba dan srid gsum gyi rtse mor rnam par g.yo ba de nyid ni mdo smad tsong kha'i yul grur yab klu 'bum dge dang / yum shing za a chos gnyis kyi sras su gser 'phyang zhes pa me mo byi'i lor sku bltams/ dgung lo nar son pa na dpal a ti sha dang / rdo rje gtum po'i dag snang rgyun du gzigs shing / chos rje don grub rin chen gyi drung du tshe snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes mtshan blo bzang grags pa gsol/ gzhon nu blo bzang grags pa khyod/ / sngon sbyangs dge ba'i las 'phro can/ / sngon tshe dam chos bdud mi'i ro/ / 'thung ba'i bag chags yod par nges/ / zhes dbus gtsang gi phyogs su gsan bsam la 'byon par bskul ba bzhin byon te ngam ring sa skya snar thang sogs ris med kyi ——— 222 —

chos grwa du mar re mda' ba sa/zhon nu blo gros / chos/ rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan sog/sa yongs 'dzin du ma'i sprun sngar phyi nang be rig/ gnas ma/do dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i bka/'a dang bstan bcos la thos bsam sgom pa dpyis phyin par ma/dzad/ dbus gtsang gi chos sde chen ngo/ rdzams su grwa bro/ra mdzad cing / kha che'i bsod snyoms pa ma hwa paṇ+ḍi ta sha kya shrī bha dra 'es nga gsum gyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsus/ gi nor bur gyur nga/ nyang gi mkhan rgyud bal/'a bzhi pa tshu'/ khrems rin chen gyis mkhan po mdzad de dad pa'i dge/ 'dun/ grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen nga/ra rdzogs / grub chen dpal bo rdo rje lo tsā mdzad/ de bla ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs las chos smor ci rigs pa gsan /bsnyen sgrub la gtso bor mdzad pas rje btsun/ nyid kyis 'al dngos su bstan te the tshom gyi dri ba nga la gyis zhes bka'i snang ba bstsal ba ltar de nas bzung the tshom gyi gnad thams cad srid pa gsum na 'gran zla med pa'i yongs 'dzin bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs la dgos pa gcod par mdzad pa yin la/ yi dam gyis bya bral mdzad dgos par lung bstan pa bzhin 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad dang bcas 'ol kha sogs su sgrub pa snyeng por mdzad pas bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad sku lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs te gsung gi snang ba rgyun mi chad cing / dngos grub rnams kyang 'bad ped du stsol ba sogs byung / rje rang nyid kyi gsung las/ khyed kyi bla med theg pa'i tshul/ /yod dang med pa'i mtha' spangs te/ /ji bzhin 'brel bar lung bstan pa/ / klu sgrub gzhung lugs kuṇ+ḍa'i tshal/ / dri med mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas/ / gsung rab mkha' /༄ thogs med rgyu/ /mthar 'dzin rnying gi mun pa sel/ / log smra'i rgyu dkar zil gnon pa/ /— 223 —

dpal ldan/ zla ba'i legs ba༅/da kyi/ / 'od/ dkar 'a—phreng bas gsal byas pa/ /bla ma'i drin/ gyis mthong ba'i tshe/ / bdag gis yid kyi ngal gso thob/ /ces chos thams cad kyi gnas lugs ji bzhin rtogs par dka' ba rnams kyang phyin ci ma/ log par thugs su chud/ che ba bzhi/ dang ldan pa'i bstan bcos skyes bu gsu ma/ gyi lam gyi rim pa'i snying por gyur pa bdag pas ga/zhan gces par sgom pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ pha rol du phyin pa drug bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi la sogs pa lam thun mong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa gsang sngags rdo rje pheg pa'i lam la brten nas skal ldan gyi gdul bya bgrang las 'das pa lam bzang mchog la dkri bar mdzad pa sogs rgyal bas kyang gzhal dka' ba'i rnam par thar pa brjod du med pa kun gyi mthong chos su gyur ba'i rkyen gyis nub phyogs kyi rgya mtsho nas rtsa/ra phyogs kyi rgya mtsho la thug gi bar du zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i sa chen po'i rdul bzhin khyab pas na de nyid 'dzin pa'i sras slob kyang bgrangs dka' yang rags rim tsam ni/ sras kyi mthu bo rnam gnyis/ chos 'brel gsan pa'i dbang gis bzhag pa'i bla ma gsum/ snga tshar bzhi/ bya bral la theg pa'i phyag phyi 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad dang gsang bdag gi lung gis zin ba'i 'khor/ 'phrin las nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i 'khor lnga/ bstan pa'i sgron me lta bu'i slob ma bahru/ byang sems gzhan don nus pa drug sogs sras slob mtha' yas pa'i nang nas sras kyi mthu bo rnam gnyis kyi ya gyal thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po ni glegs bam rin po cher/ chos dge ba bcu yis khyad 'phags pa/ / gling phun sum tshogs pa 'dzam bu'i gling / / sgos myang zhabs sa yi lte ba yin/ / sa de yi nang nas khyad 'phags pa/ / mtho — 224 —

bkri/sa brtan nga lhun po'i 'dabs1/ //nor pad+ma/ ra tsa/ bye bur mdun/ /zu/ /sa tsa/nas dang sang zag gcis/ car lung bstan pa ltar dpal sa skya 'i bya 'ang/bas 'as dang phan rnying gnyis kyi sa mtshams gung ru ru ba rgyus ngar mtsho las/ byung ba'i nga ba ma gon ngo/ rdo rje dang / yum jo mo nam spyid sa/nyis kyi sras su lcags mo 4 tsa/ mi/ lor sku bltams/ ma/tshan pad+ma rdo jer gso' / 'khru/ ngas pa'i nub mo dgra jam/ byung bas yab yu/ma gyis rdo gseb tu sbas nga/ ma/nga nyin gzigs su/ byon/ pas bya rog chem/ po zhig gi/sa srung ba dngos su gzigs/ phyis dpal ma bo/na/ zhal bzhi pa yi/na par grags/ dgung lo bdun par snar thang mkham/ chem grub shes rab par da/ge bsnyen gyi sdom pa bzhes/ rgya stson tsaṇ+ḍa pa las rgya bod kyi yis/ rigs mtha' dag gsan spyong mdzad/ dgung lo bco lnga pa la dpal snar thang gi chos grwa chen mor snyigs dus kyi thub pa chen po grub pa shes rab pas mkhan po// byang pa chen po blo ldan nga/sa slob dpon mdzad de tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes/ mtshan dge 'dun grub dpal du gsol/bzang po zhes phyis rang nyid kyis 'dogs pa mdzad par grags/ paṇa chen sad shri a bha ya ki tī/ nar thang gnyer 'dzin pa/ phyag chen bsod nams blo gros/ dbon ston thub pa dpal bzang / ston pa dge ba dpal/sems dpa' chen po kun bzang pa/ nong ston sha kya rgyal mtshan/ thang po che nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ gsang phu shes rab seng ge/ bro sa pa dpal ldan rin chen dang / rgya mtsho rin chen/ mkhas grub rje/ chos sding g.yul rgyal ba yon 'byung / bo gdong paṇa chen 'jigs bral/ shang pa kun mkhyen/sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims dpal bzang / rta nag chos rje a nan+ta pa/sgrol ma ba 'jam dbyangs bsam grub rdo rje/ bo gdong chos bzang pa/— 225 —

dngan lhom grung/ nga nga/nga 'a /// du/nga rtse tshes/ rje rnam / mkha/krā dpa' / zur lang ra/ bsod/ ma/mas hūṃ na grub thru/na ji rem chen /'a phe / mi / / /'a jam dbyang sa rim// chen rgya—'ag mtsham/ / lo chem thugs rje dang/la/ ku/ma ma/khyam/ tshas rje/ sa/ skya pa tshas rje seng rgyan pa ba// rim ngo che kun das/sna dang la 3 na/ sna nga thang ma /lan chen grags pa / non grub so/sas/ yongs ka'adzin dam nga/ mtha' nga/sa pa / pa la sa phyi ma/nga gi rib/ nga 'i gam/sa dang bka' pod chen po rnam nga /dru // po/sang sngas/sa tsa/sar rnying si bla ma yi dam tshas spyong srung ma/'i smin grol dang / bskyed rdzogs kye rim pa sogs (ra la/sa na bsam phu0༄/ phyi/na nga/ mdzad// khya/ da par 'jam/ mgon chos kyi rgya'/ po rtsang //ba pa chen po dang / rgyal tshab thams cad mkhyen nga dar ma rin chen/ 'dul ba 'dzin nga chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan rnams dbu'i rigs kyi ced pan du bzhes te che ba bzhi dang ldan nga 'i skyes bu ga/sum gyi rim pa sogs la thos bsam sbo/ma nga sa nyin mtshan dus 'da' bar mdzad de zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba/'i bstan pa'i srog shing chen por gyur/ da/gung lo bha shu pa lcags stag zla 2tshes 1 1nyin mkhan slob gnyis sprar bzhin dang / gdan sa ba grags pa shes rab kyis gsang ston mdzad de dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par nod de 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur/ de nas dbus phyogs su byon te gsang phu gling stod mthong smon gyi gdan sa lo kha g.yar mdzad/ gnas nang du thub dbang gi mdzod spu nas zla ba nya gang zhig shar te sbu la thims pa sogs mtshan ltas ngo mtshar ba byung / dbus su lo bcu gnyis bzhugs/ slad gtsang du phebs te snar thang / byang chen ri khud sogs su bzhugs/ ri khud chos sde'i gdan sa'ang mdzad/ rje btsun byams mgon gyi sku bzhengs/ gtsug ——— 226 la

lag khang la rdo gcal bting zhing skron lam yang 'dzugs par mdzad/ byang chen du rbeg chen pho brang btabs/ rje btsun sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub mdzad pas 'al dngos su gzigs/ gzhan yang 'jigs byed/ phyag drug pa/dpal mgon zhal sogs yi dam lha dang chos spyong srung ma'i tshogs kyi zhal brtan cing gsung gi dbugs dbyung kyang thob/ — rab byung zhes pa me yos lor bsam grub rtser byon nas dpon chos skyong dar la bka' lung gnang brag dmar bla brang du rten bzhengs kyi 'go btsugs ston pa dang sgrol ma'i sbu brnyan mthong ba don ldan gnyis bskrun/ lo de kha'i smin drug zla ba'i nang glegs bam rin po che'i lung bstan dang / snar thang du rje rin po che'i bka' gnang zhing / rgyal yum 'dod khams dbang mo'i lung bstan ltar dar rgya/sa dpon bsod nams dpal bzang pas sbyin bdag byas te/ sa brtag pa gzhi bdag la gtor ma 'bul ba sogs gzhung bzhin mdzad nas/ chos grwa chen mo bkris lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling zhes khams gsum 'gro ba mtha' dag gi phyag dang mchod pa bkur bste dang bste stang du bya ba'i 'os su gyur pa mdo sde dang rgyud sde 'dzin pa kun gyis 'byung gnas 'di nyid btab/ bdag cag gi ston pa dang / rje btsun byams mgon gyi sbu shin tu che bas dbus gser sku/ lugs sbu/ 'jim sku/bris sku/ gos sbu le tshan/ bka' bsgyur sogs sku gsung thugs rten mchod rdzas bcas dngos gtsang bar bsgrub par mdzad/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas rab gnas kyang rgyas par mdzad/ shing rta lo dge 'dun stong phrag gsum 'dus te/ mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas mnyan yod cho 'phrul mchod pa'i dus ston kyang tshugs/— 227 —

paṇa chen ye shes rtse mos sngar bde ba can du 'byon bzhed yod na'ang phyis dga' ldan du 'byon bzhed yod pa yin zhes zhus par/ kho bo la de lta bu'i 'dod pa phur btsugs ma med/ bde ba can sogs na 'dul bya yang dag pa 'ba' zhig yin/ de bas ma dag pa'i 'dus bya rnams 'dul ba'i phyir re zhig 'di khar sdod pa yin zhes 'gro ba kun la ma gcig pa'i bu ltar mnyes shing byams pa'i 'phags mchog mig mi 'dzum ngur smrig gi zlos gar bsgyur bar grags pa 'ud tsam ma yin par don la gnas pa'i gsung ma bcos lhug par grol/ nyin mtshan 'khor mo yug tu 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi bya ba 'ba' zhig gis dus 'da' bar mdzad pas rgyal bstan spyi dang khyad par zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs rgya mtsho'i pha mthar khyab par mdzad/dbu ma'i rnam bshad dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba'i me long tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi dgas legs par bshad pa zhes bya ba/ dam pa'i chos 'dul ba mtha' dag gi snying po'i don legs par bshad pa rin po che'i 'phreng ba sogs rgyu pha nol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang / 'bras bu sngags kyi theg pa las brtsams pa'i gsung rtsom gyi rim pa yang mang du mchis/ de gar zhing 'di'i gdul bya thams cad smin grol la bkod zin pa'i rjes su shing rta lo dgung lo gya lnga pa dgun zla 'bring po'i tshes brgyad kyi tho rengs ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dpag tu med pa dang bcas gzims khrir mtha' ma'i mdzad pa bstan/ 'al gdams ltar gdung zhugs la phul bas dbu thod ril bu dang / dung g.yas 'khyil gyi rang byon ring bsrel gyis gtams pa dang bcas byin rlabs kyi rten du bzhugs pa'i dngul gdung rang cag gi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs pa 'di lags/gang gi zhal las gsung gi bdud mi thob pa'i bu slob ni mkhas grub nor bzang — 228 —

rgya mtsho/ rab 'byams pa smon lam dpal/ 'dul 'dzin blo gros sbal pa/'dul nag pa dpal ldan bzang po/ bya btang sems dang/'a chen po/ paṇa chen bzang po bkris/ shangs ston dri med bshes gnyen/ drung dpal tshul ba/ mkhan chen bzang po dpal/ chos rje bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rabs byams pa bkris bzang po/ rje dpal ldan chos skyong / rgyud pa sbyin pa dpal/ rgyud pa grags bzang / rgyud pa kun dga' don grub/ mnga' ris rgyal mchog paṇa chen kun rig mdar ston byang dpal/ drung sha ri'i bu/ bla ma byang gling pa/ chos dpal/ bka' bcu smra seng sogs snga tshar/ mkhan chen shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen lung rig rgya mtsho/ rje grags pa bsam grub/ stobs ldan 'od zer/ kun mkhyen chos 'byor dpal bzang / 'jam dpal grags pa/ gnas rnying pa 'od zer/byams chos pa grags yon/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas dbang phyug byang pa blo gros mgon/ bka' bzhi pa dge 'dun bsam grub/ thon sangs rgyas dpal rin/ lho pa don grub dpal/ bka' bcu kun dga' dpal rin /dbang phyug dpal/ dpal ldan bzang po/ don chos pa rin chen rgyal mtshan te bar tshar/ gnas rnying rin po che kun dga' bde legs/ rje dbon blo bzang nyi ma/ chos rje shes rab dar/ mkhan chen grags shes/paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ rta nag chos mdzad/ 'brong rtse chos rje chos kyi blo gros/ bka' bcu pa ye shes bzang po/ gangs can pa rgyal ba bsam grub/'jam dbyangs blo gros/ rnam rgyal grags pa/ 'jam dpal bzang po/bla ma ldun rtse ba/ sman lung pa/ yon tan dpal 'byung // shes rab dpal ldan/ smon lam pa/ mkhan chen grags pa/ sa skya pa sangs rgyas — 229 —

byang chub/ u ri pa shes rab dpal/ tshul khrims bzang po/ bka' bcu chos 'phel rgyal mtshan te phyi tshar/ gzhan yang mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i bu slob kyi tshogs mtha' yas pa byung ba las/ de dag gi nang nas chos kyi rje paṇa chen bzang po bkris rgyal tshab tu gyur/ de nas rim bzhin paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen ye shes rtse mo/ phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ mnga' ris lha btsun blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen sharnyi pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/pan chen don yod rgya mtsho/ shangs ston blo gros legs bzang / gnas rnying chos rje chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ shangs ston chos dpal rgya mtsho/ phyug gzhung ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shangs ston bsam grub dpal bzang / myang ston dam chos yar 'phel/ myang ston lha dbang blo gros/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun blo bzang ye shes/paṇa chen rdo rje 'chang blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/ paṇa chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang po rnams rim bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po'i 'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phangs mthon por 'khor lo'i mtshan mas spa ba'i zhabs zung rnam par bkod de/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams la 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas legs par gtan la phab te 'chad pas skal ldan gyi skyes bu lha dang bcas pa byang chub kyi sa la bkod/rtsod ngag rdo rje'i thog mda' log smra phas rgol gyi smra ba thung ngur byas/ rtsom pas rang gzhan gyi sde pa kun la mkhas par grags pa kun gyi khengs pa ming gi — 230 —

lhag mar byas/ thos pas thub pa'i bstan pa yongs su rdzogs pa rang rgyud la mngon du mdzad/ bsam pas de dag gi don phyin ci ma log par thugs su chud/ sgom pas bdag 'dzin rnam pa gnyis po drung nas phyung ste rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sar gshegs nas bdag cag gi ston pa'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag 'jam mgon 'gro ba'i bla ma khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen po blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi ring lugs gser mdog cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid dar rgyas su mdzad pa'i phyag rjes kun gyi mthun snang du grub pa 'di lags/ de rjes rang nyid ni yul gtsang ljongs g.yon ru'i cha thob rgyal zhes bya ba'i yul grur lha las mchod pa bru'i rigs su btsas/ paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma'i sku'i skye bar kun gyis sgro btags par brten gdan sa nas phyag mdzod pa sogs kyi gser bum gyi khongs su bcug rang rgyud la brtags na rang gi lto ba zas ji tsam gyis khengs pa'i tshod kyang mi thing ba ma zad/ nyon mongs pa ni stobs che/ gnyen po ni stobs chung ba rang rgyud la grub pa 'dir dpags na paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i sku'i skye srid lta zhog gang zag chos ldan zhig gi skye srid kyang yin pa'i tshod du mi 'dug rung / sngon rgyal po mya ngan med kyi skye ba sngon ma zhig byis pa'i dus su bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa bsod stoms la gshegs pa mthong nas dad pa'i sems kyis sa sbar ba gang phyag gi gsol lhung du phul ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba de la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'og tu 'gran zla med pa'i rgyal po chen por gyur te/ gnod sbyin shing rta bcu pa'i rigs sngags 'grub pas nub gcig la 'dzam bu'i gling du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyi snying po can gyi — 231 —

mchod rten bye ba btabs pa sogs bstan bcos khungs ma rnams su bshad pa ltar rang nyid kyang skye bo sngon ma zhig tu lus ngag yid gsum gyi dge ba rlabs chen zhig gi mthu la brten nas bum pa las thon/ skyes bu mchog dman thams cad kyis bong ba la gser du gzigs pa'i 'khrul snang gis lha mi'i mchod gnas su gyur pa'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa nas bya ri dwags gshor ba'i ling pa yan chod kyis phyag 'tshal ba dang / rnyed pa stobs pa sogs chos tshigs bcad gcig kyang blo nas mi thon pa'i byis pa nas bzung dkor nag gi 'dam du byings/ lo drug yan rtsed mo dang klog slob pa sogs spel mar byas/rang lo drug pa mngal shol rtsis pa'i bdun steng du slebs pa lcags pho spre'u lo chos grwa chen po bkris ldun po'i gtsug lag khang gi dge 'dun gyi dri gtsang khang du rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i sku'i thang sham nang gzhug tu bzhugs pas mtshon byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po'i snang brnyan gyi drung du don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te mkhan chen rdo rje 'chang chen po rje btsun ngag dbang ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mkhan po yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang blo bzang bstan pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos las kyi slob dpon sogs dad pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa nos/ deng skabs bsam tshe thob pa'i dus mtshams ma go ba'i dbang gis rgyud la sdom pa skyes yod tshod du ni mi 'dug 'on kyang 'jam mgon bong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa 'dzin pa'i paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sku'i yang srid du sgro btags pa 'di'i drin las skra bregs te gos ngur sprig gyon nas rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs la slob khul du byed pa 'di byung ba yin lags/ de mi da cho dkon — 232 —

mchog gsum skyabs gnas yang dag tu khas mi len zhing / nag chang gi khrod du byengs pa'i bon po rnga gshang g.yas 'khyer g.yon 'khyer du dkrol ba bzhin las 'os ci la yod/ 'di tsam gyi bka' drin yang tshe rabs kun tu gzhal bar dka' ba lags/ rang lo bdun steng du skebs pa lcags bya lo rang nyid la byis pa rtsed mo'i 'du shes las ci la yod kyang mdzod pa sogs bgros nas paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po nas paṇa chen gong ma bstan pa'i nyi ma'i bar du gzhung lugs 'bum phrag du ma'i mnga' bdag mkhas grub gyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa 'ba' zhig mu tig gi 'phreng ba star la brgyus ba ltar zam ma chad par zhabs sen 'jigs pa med par bkod pa'i gser gyi khri de la byis pa ngur smrig gi gzugs su byas pa yig drug gi don tsam yang mi shes pa de dad rdzas kyi dpya' khral sdud pa por bkod rang ngos nas dge sdig gi blangs dor lta zhog khri 'di la 'dug nas zang zing gi bdog pa 'di tsam 'bad med du 'byung ba 'di dga' snyam pa tsam yang dag ga la yod/ bsngo ba'i kha phral 'phrod tsam byung ba de las dang po thob pa tsam gyi dga' ba byas/ de nas rim bzhi/na chos spyod bsdus grwa mtha' 'phreng sogs slob gnyer gyi khul byas/ rang la yon tan rtags gsal gyi go ba chags pa tsam med rung / grub mtha'i kun slong dang grogs 'ga'i dbang gis dpal ldan zla ba grags pa sogs dbu ma pa'i bla ma mang po dang / bod rang du'ang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dri ma med pa du ma bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa la kun slong rnam par ma dag pas bskur ba du ma btab ste ngan 'gro myong nges pa'i rgyu tshogs rngam po che bsags/ rang phyogs su'ang rje btsun bong kha pa/ mkhas grub rje/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos rgyan/ paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes/— 233 —

paṇa chen sku gong ma bstan pa'i nyi ma tsam dang / rgya gar du'ang phyogs glang tshas grags gnyis tsam las gzhan ma gang la'ang tshad mar mi 'dzin pas dal 'byor thob pa don med par gyong po rwa'i spun zlar 'gyur nye ba na khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dbang dang 'al gnyis yongs 'dzin dam pa rnams kyi bkrin dang /khyad par 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba ngur smrig gi zlos gar bsgyur ba rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'jigs med go cha thub bstan lang tsho'i sde rnams kyi rnam thar bka' 'bum gyi rim pa phyi rabs gdul bya'i don du bzhugs pa rnams mig gi spyod yul du gyur ba'i rkyen gyis sngar byas kyi sdig pa la dug khongs su song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems dang / phyin chad srog la babs kyang mi bgyi snyam pa'i sdom sems kyis grub mtha'i kun slong ngan pa mtha' dag rgyang du dor te zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid gzhir bzung ris su ma bcad pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa rnam par dag pa kun la thos pa'i sgro 'dogs bcad nas thos don bsam zhing bsam don nyams su len pa'i khul du yod pa 'di lags shing / slar yang gangs can gyi ljongs 'di'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa dri ma med pa rnams la thos pa'i sgro 'dogs kyi mtha' legs par bcad te/ bsam sgom la gtso bor 'bad cing 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas phyogs dus kun tu dar rgyas su byed par smon bzhin du gnas pa 'di'i bkrin gyi phung po ni tshe rabs gang ga'i klung gi bye ma rnyed du stong gsum rin po che sna bdun gyis 'phyur bur gtams te nyin re bzhin lan brgyar phul kyang gzhal ba'i go skabs ma mchis/ de nas rang —— 234 —

glegs/ bam gsum pa dang / 'a/sa chog za/ma rgyal gser mnog tu sa/sal nga ltar ma zad/// rje btsum lngung kha/ pa chen pos kyang bca/ chen rgyud las bsnyen par rdzos/sa pa'i mkhan ngo ba7/'a ba'i nga tshul khri/ mas rin chen las da/ge slong go/ sdom pa bzhes shing / 'jam dbyangs bkra 'is da/pal ldan nga sos/sa kyang de nas/ brgyud pa bcas la brten rang nyid kyang ya nga bskyar du bsgru ba rgyu lab brjod kyi rgyu las pe/da/ stabs dang po snyed nas paṇa chen rgyud rnam par da/ga nga/ zhig byung cha/ snyam se 'bras dbe gsum sogs dbus phyos/sa/ su pan chen rgyud las bsnyen/ par rdzog/sa pa'i mkhan ngo/ra 'os nga re rigs su yod rtsad gcod mdzad dgos kyi phur bu lhogs yongs 'dzin rim/ po cher snyan 'bul nan tan zhus rung nge rigs tsa/tan nas med tshul phebs ga'i/sa sa//tsang ljongs dang khams phyogs sogs su rtsad gcod nan tan bgyis rung sdom rgyun 'di nyid las bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan por 'os pa lha khang mkhan rin po che tsam du nges nas spyan 'dren gyi pho nya ma/ngags pa bzhin byon te/ chos grwa chen po bkris lhun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rgyal ba'i gling gi gzim khang rgyal mtshan mthon po'i gzim chung yid dga' chos 'dzin du rje btsun/ tsong kha pa chen po'i thugs dam gyi rten mnyam med thub pa'i dbang po'i sku brnyan khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang ye shes la bstsal ba'i byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i drung du mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rab dang dmigs pa med pa'i thugs rje chen po mnga' zhing brtan mkhas kyi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa'i gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po bcas pa phra mo las kyang mi 'da' ba'i tshul khrims kyi dri bsung phyogs brgyar khyab pa'i — 236 —

'phas/sa nga/ nye bar (ra khor ba 'dir 'phos pa lta bu don gyi slad du mtshan nas dro sa pa lha la/ nga mkhan rin po che byams nga/ bkris chos 'phel gyi ma la/ ma/ po/mdo sngags phyi nang rig pa'i grub mtha' rgya/ mcho'i pha rol tu son nga gzim ba/ nga 'og 'dul ba 'dzin ba chen ngo byam/sa pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin snyan grags kyis las kyis sko/ba dpon/ rgyal bas 'u nga bstan ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun da/ga 'a bzang po'i chos kyi gdan khri la mngon par dbang bskur ba thar rtse 'dul ba /'dzen pa chen po ngag gi dbang phyub/ 'jam dbyangs rim chen rdo rjes/ gsang sde stom pa'i spyob dngo na/ mdo dang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag ngor mkhan zur phan/ bde'i 'dul ba 'dzin nga/ chen po dpal ldan blo gros rgyal mtshan gyis grib chod pa/ ga 'an yang phyi ma tshan nyid/ theg/ pa'i ba༅/da rtsod dang / nang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i mtshan bcas mtshan/ med kyi rnal 'byor la brtson/ pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin/ pa chen po byams pa 'jam dbyangs phun tshogs kyis grangs 'dzin pa/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin la chen po byams pa chos phun tshogs kyi grogs dan pa/gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po byams pa snyeng rje bzang po/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po byams pa chos dpal bzang / gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po byams pa bsod nams 'od zer/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po byams pa thugs rje phun tshogs/ gnas brtan 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po byams pa kun dga' dpal ldan rnams kyis kha skong mdzad de/ lha khang mkhan chen byams pa bsam gtan/ rgyal mtshan gyi las chog ma nor don gsal gyi steng nas na tshod ldan zhes pa shing mo phag gi lo de la dus tshigs dgun dang / dpyid/ dbyar/ dbyar thung ngu /— 237 —

dbyar ring po dang lnga la sa dbyi da kyi/ dus/ de las zla ba gsum du yong 'i༄ la/sa dpyid zla mtha' chung // de la nga/ra ngo dang mar ngo sa/nyis su yod nga/ 'a/sa yar ngo de la gral tshes bco lnga yod pa'i nang tshan bco lnga pa/ de la nyin mo dang mtsham cho/'i cha gnyis su/ yo/da/ pa 'a/sa nyin rngo/'i cha/ de /ma yo/rma yi tam 'a sa/ skya/ra rengs shar ba/ nyi ma ma ger ba/ bha ma shar ba/ nyi ma brgyang/ cha shar ba/ nyi ma bzhi cha thar ba/ lnga dro'i dus/ gung tshigs ma yo/la ba/gung na/ dus/ phyi dro'i dus// nyi ma bzhi cha lus pa/ nyi ma brgyad cha 'u/sa pa/nyi ma ma nub pa/ bha ma nub pa/ rgyu skar ma shar ba'o zhes gsungs nga rte ra/ nyin mo'i cha bcu ba'i las/ nyi ma brgyang/ cha shar ba'i dus grib tshod skyes bu gcig dang rkang nga/ gnyis kyi che dge bsnyen nas bzung tshigs gsum bar mad chad du mngon du gyur pa bcu tshang ba'i sgo nas bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po yang da/ga par bsgrubs de yang dge slong la rab tu gces ba'i mdo las/ dge slong zhes bya tshas kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /dge slong zhes bya rdo rje'i srog shing yin/ /dge slong zhes bya sdug bsngal spong ba yin/ /dge slong zhes bya rgyal ba'i sras po 'o/ /dge slong zhes bya nyon mongs srog gcod de/ /dge slong zhes bya thar pa'i lam 'gro yin/ /dge slong rang gi ngo bo bstoms pa ste/ /zhes pa ltar na bla na med pa'i rnyed pa'i mchog rnyed par 'dug rung / de nyid las la la'i tshul khrims bde ba ste/ /la la'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal yin/ /tshul khrims ldan pa bde ba ste/ / tshul khrims 'chal ba sdug bsngal yin/ /zhes gsungs pa la dpags na/ bdag dang bdag 'dra'i gang zag la khe bas nyen che bar gda'/ 'on kyang phas pham pa bzhi rnams kyi gang yang rung ba'i ltung ba ma byung ba gang yin pa de lta bu ni tshul khrims nyams pa ma yin no — 238 —

wes ba rnga— nga 'ur+sha ra na/ rwa ma nga/ bzhi ngo tsa/nga dung gi ltu nga bas sa/so/ ba'i tsa/zong le ma nga bo/sa che/nga stabs tshu'/ khri/ mas ma nyams tsam gyi grangs su tshud dam/ snyam// de nas 'ag ༅/sa bar bkris lhun po'i rlo/ba dngo/na rnam nga / bzhi// spru' sku dang //dge ba'i bshes sa/nyen 'ga' 'is/ sogs po/nyug mar po/nas pa dang 1 phyog/sa 'dus kyi dge slong sa/sar sgrub dang / bskya ra sgru ba kyi rigs sogs bsgrub 'dod yod rigs ma/nga ba la don gyi slad du mtshan ma/sa smos te mkhan chen 'du/la ba 'dzin pa chen po nyid kyis dge slong gi dngos po yang dab par bsgru ba par mdzad pa'i las slob dang gsang ston ci rigs pa'i 'bas 'deg/sa kho bos kyang bsgrubs/ de ltar kho bos paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi gser gyi ga/dan khri/ la 'dzegs pa nas bzung da lta'i bar du 'dir bzhugs dge 'dun thams cad kyis kyang kho bo la yon tan til gyi cha shas tsam yang med nung dad zhen gyis kho bos 'dzub mo gar bstan shar du ngos 'dzin pa'i bdag rgyan bla na med pa mdzad pa ma zad/ kho bo la gnyug mar gnas pa dang / phyogs 'dus ser skya mchog dman mtha' dag gis phyag 'tshal ba dang / mgo bo rkang pa la gtugs pa/ bdog pa'i dngos po stobs pa sogs bsten bkur dang phu dud phul du phyin pa byed pa 'di dag kun kyang dge 'dun gyi sde chen po 'di nyid kyi bkrin las byung bar kha tsam ma yin par gting nas ngo shes rnyed par brten/ rang ngos nas kyang dge 'dun gyi sde la dad dam rtse gcig pa nam yang g.yo ba med cing / zhabs 'gyur du 'gro nges pa las byed ma rung pa 'khrul las chos khrims gzhig ral du gyur pa nyams pa sor chud dgos rgyu'i bkod khyab zhus par dge 'dun rnams nas kyang dang bas kun blangs kyi thugs nyams su bstar bas sngar bzhin sor chud ——— 239 ——

pa 'di dang thugs 'byed kyi sbyor rtsa'i bskyed sa/tong gi/sa chos byed tshas/ la mi khom nga ra dge 'dun rdzams thugs nga/ma bad yo da pa thos nas de dag kyang phyir bsdum thos/ zur du bko/nga/ khyab bgyis te spyi sger rang rang gi/ sde bzhi'i dang1la mo na ci bder bsgrub chos/ pa 'di tsam/ zhig 'bas/ 'gyur du so nga bar 'jin na la/sa gtsa/na ma da bar rngo thogs pa 'ig ma 'grub rung // slang/ nas chos srid /ru gas sa/nyis kyi sgo nas dge 'dum gyi sde chen po'i 'bas 'gyur du 'gro nges pa du ma thig/ 'grub na ci ma rung snyam pa'i dam bca' ying/ la tsan dan/ dang tsan dan spi dri bzhin du nam ya/nga 'bra/la ba me/da par gnas shing / bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i byin mthu las lus ngag yi /da gsum la gsar 'tshes ma/ gos nga ra paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen nga dge 'dun grub nga/ dpal bzang po'i 'jigs/ bral gdong lnga sa btegs pa'i gser khri/ la 'khod nas bstan pa'i bad/ga po rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal dang / 'phas/sa mchog phyag na pad+ma ngur smrig/ gi zlos yo/ra bsgyur ba thams cad mkhyen nga/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho /'jigs/ med bo/ cha thub bstan lang mtsho'i sde zung gi mdzad bzang la bdag cag so skye tha mal pas 'gran pa'i go skabs ma mchis kyang / de dag gi mdzad nga/ la mig yar lta'i tshul du zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs 'di nyid sa/zhir bzung phyogs bral gyi rgyal bstan kun la thos bsam sgom sa/su ma 'chad rtsong/ rtsom gsum gyi rim pa la 'khor mo yug tu brtson/ khul du gnas bzhin pa 'di la gas/ di/ ltar gong du bshad pa ltar 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo ngur smrig gi zlos gar bsgyur ba thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pos lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro kun gyi bsod nams kyi tshogs spel ba'i slad du thugs bskyed kyi 'jug pa bla na med pas bskrun par la 240 ————

rmya zang/ shā༄ nge za1 ༄ grwa chem ngo dang1di snyeb du bzhugs nga 'i dge 'dum rnams kyi t+tan ma/tshan rdzum tu 6ma sa/ su/ bstar bar bya ba/ mi/ bshes springs las/ log/ par lta ba 'dzim dang dud 'gro/ dang / / yi dwags 'id dang dmya' ngar skye ba dang / /rgyal ba'i bal/'a med pa dang ma tha' kho/ ba tu/ /kla klo/ra skye dang / glem zhing lku kas pa nyid/ /tshe ring lha nyid gang yang rung ba 'i / /skye ba jes bgyi mi kho/ ma spyon brgyad po/ /de das/ dang bral khom pa snyed nas ni/ /skye ba bzlog pa'i slad du 'bad par mjod/ / ces pa ltar/ rang cag rnams mi khrom brgyad dang bra/za/ dal ba brgyad dang ldan zhing // ji ska/da du yang // mi nyed dbus skyes dbang po tshang / /las mtha' ma los ga/sa la da/da/ /sangs rgyas byon dang dam chos ston/ //bstan pa gnas dang de rjes 'jug // sa/'an phyir snyeng na/sa brtse ba'o/ / zhes nga/ ltar gyi 'byor pa bcu dang ldan pa'i rnyed par dka' ba mi'i 'u/sa rten ren po che 'di nyid da res rnyed pa yin lags// 'di yang rtag tu rnyed sla ba ma yin te/ spyod 'jug las/ rgya mtsho cher g.yeng gnya' shing gi/ /bu sa/ra rus sbal mgrin chud ltar/ / zhes dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i khar gser gyi gnya' shing bug pa gcig pa zhig rlung gis bskul te phyogs bcur g.yeng bzhin gnas pa dang / rgya mtsho de'i nang na rus sbal long ba zhig gnas te/ de lo brgya brgya ma/ru/ rgya mtsho'i de'i steng du mgo bo yu/ga tsam re byed pa na rus sbal long ba de'i mgrin pa gser gyi sa/nya' shing gi bug gar chud pa ni ches dka' yi/ de bas dal 'byor gyi lus rten rnyed par dka' bar bshad cing / der ma zad dal 'byor gyi lus rten thob pa tshul khrims rnam par dag pas gzhi bzung/ sbyin sogs kyis grogs byas/ smon lam dri ma med pas mtshams sbyor dgos pa la/ de bsgrub pa'i rten ngan song la 241 —la

par dka' 'ing snyed kyang don med/ 'di ni de lta bu ma yin par rnyed par dka' la rdo/na chen po dang ldan pa'i dal 'byor gyi lus rten rin po che rang cag rnams kyis rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin lags/ de yang slob springs las/ bde tsa/shegs lam rten 'gro ba 'dren par chas gyur pa'i/ /sems kyi stobs chen mi yis rnyed pa gang yin pa'i/ /lam de lha dang klu yis mi rnyed gnod sbyin dang / /mkha' lding rig 'dzin mi 'am ci dang lto phyes min/ /zhes rigs drug gi rten gang las kyang chos sgrub pa'i lus rten la dal 'byor gī lus 'di nyid khyad par du 'phags par gsungs la/ /de lta bu rnyed pa'i dus 'dir tshe rabs thams cad du bde ba bsgrub pa'i thabs dam pa'i chos la tshul bzhin du mi 'bad par zas gos gnas mal sogs tshe 'di'i bde ba bsgrub pa tsam 'ba' zhi/ga gis dus 'da' bar byed pa ni rang gis rang bslus pa de bas tshan che ba med do/ spyod 'jug las/ /'di 'dra'i dal ba rnyed gyur nas / /bdag gis dge sgom ma byas na/ /'di las bslus pa'ang gzhan med do/ /'di las rmongs pa'ang ga 'a/na med do/ /zhes gsungs shing / snying po ji ltar len pa'i tshul la yang / bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' 'ing rta'i sbol 'byed kyis phyin ci ma log par bkral/ lo paṇa gyis bsgyur/ mkhas grub gnyis ldan gyi bla ma las rim par brgyud pa'i dam pa'i chos dri ma med pa la thos bsam sgom ba lhur len dgos shing / de yang rje bdag nyid chen pos/dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du stsol/ zhes bsam sgom gnyis kyi sngon du thos pas chos la sgro 'dogs kyi mtha' legs par gcod dgos 'ing / thos bya'i chos ni rje bdag nyid chen pos/ 'di na rdzogs sangs rgyas su bgrod pa la/ /zab mo rdo rje theg dang phar phyin theg / ces rgyu 'bras kyi theg pa gnyis ——— 243 — —

su gsungs pa las pha nol tu phyin pa'i theg pas rgyud ma sbyangs par sngags kyi theg pa la 'jug mi rung 'i/nga / thog mar lam stegs lta bur gyur pa pha rol du phyin pa'i theg pa de la 'ang nang gses kyis dbye na sde sgod rin po che rnam pa gsum du yod lags/ de da/sa/ la pho tshod tsam ma yin bar slob dpon mkhas pa'i ngag la brten nas legs par sbyangs te 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gang la'ang gzhan drin mi 'jog pa'i spobs pa rnyed pa'i thabs la rtsal ston/bsam sbom la rnying por bsgril/ bslab pa gsum lam gyi srog tu bzungs/de dag kyang mkhas grags ngang gtam 'dod sogs nyon mong pa'i grogs su song na rgyal ba'i bka' dang tshad ma'i bstan bcos mtha' das/ gi don dang rgyab 'gal du 'gro zhi/nga / rang gis rang la phung sna 'dren pa'i nyes spyod thams cad kyi rtsa bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i dbang du ma song bar nyon mongs pa'i gnyen por 'gro nges pa thig la 'bad pa ni rang cag rnams kyis bsgrub bya'i sa/bo bor gyur pa yim/ te/ bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ 'chad na blo yi mig 'byed la/ /rtsod na rgol ba'i klad 'gems shing / /rtsom na bstan pa'i srol btod pa'i/ / slob dpon rang gi srog las gces/ / thos bsam grub pa'i rgya'/ mtshan la/ /bslab gsum nor bu dang ldan pas/ / nyes spyod rims nad kun sel ba'i/ / rgyan mtshan 'dra ba srog las gces/ / zhes gsungs shing/ khyad par slob dpon chos kyi tshong dpon gyis/ rgyal ba ston pa de ni/ ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yi phyir/ gnyis 'gyur phyag byas sangs rgyas khyod gcig bzhin/ zhes dang / so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ nga ni mya ngan 'das gyur na/ /'di ni khyed kyi ston pa zhes/ /rang byung nyid kyi gus bcas par// / nan tan dge slong tshogs mdun bkod/ /—— 244 ——

ces mdo sde dang mngon pa'i sde sgod kyis bstan pa'i go chod kyang / ston pa'i go mi chod la/ 'dul ba'i sde snod kyis gnyis ka'i rgo chod pas/ des na ji skad du'ang / ji ltar 'di ni shing rtsa gtso bo ste/ rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis ka'i gzhi/ /de bzhi/na dam chos tshogs rnams kun gyi yang / /rgyu dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin/ par gsungs/ /zhes bdag cag gi ston pa'i bstan pa'i gzhi ma lta bur gyur pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa brjod bya'i gtso bor ston pa'i 'dul ba'i sde sgod la bshad sgrub thos bsam dpyis phyin par 'bad de/de/'i brjod bya'i sa/tso bor gyur pa gnang bkag sgrub pa'i bslab pa'i cha phra mo la'ang ji mi snyam par mi 'dor bar nan tan/ chen pos tshul bzhin nyams su blangs na gnas skabs mngon/ mtho lha mi'i rten bzang rgyun mar thob cing /sgrib gnyis bag chag/sa dang bcas pa'i g.yul las rnam par rgyal te/rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang bde blag tu thob par gyur te/ sum brgya par/ nyon mongs dgra ga/yul rgyal byed tshul khrims te// /dge tshul btul zhugs chu len mig pa dang / /'chi ba'i 'tshe ba 'byen par byed pa'i thabs/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub dpal nod dbang bskur yin/ / zhes gsungs nga/sa/tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung na phan yon che zhing/ ma bsrung na nyes dmigs chen po dang yang ldan pa yin te/ klu e la'i 'dab kyi lo rgyus las kyang shes nus shing/ gzhan yang chos bsgrags pa'i mdo las/ dge slong dag sbog dang bral zhi/nga shi ba ni sla yi/ /tshul khrims nyams shing ga'i/ga pa ni de lta ma yi/na no/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sbog dang bral zhing shi bas ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur gyi// tshul khrims nyams shing gzhig pas ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par ltung ba chen la 245 la

po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /zhes gsungs/ tshul khrims bsrung ma nus par tshul khrims 'chal ba'i gang zag gis 'chab sems kyi ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan bzung nas dge 'dun gī dbus su gnas pa las bslab pa phul ba phan yo/na che ste/ji skad du yang / /gang zhig bslab la mi gnas pas/ //bde gshegs rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa las/ /bslab pa mi gnas skad cig la/ / gzugs bor khyim sar gnas pa bzang/ / zhes gsungs shing / / ga 'ad yang tshul khrims dang mi ldan pas dad zas la spyod pa ni nyes pa dpag tu med pa dang ldan te// lung rnam 'byed las/ /lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ / tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ / yul 'khor bsod snyom za ba min/ /zhes gsungs 'ing / gzhan yang 'dul ba lung sde bzhi/ mdo rtsa me tog 'phreng brgyus sogs rgya gzhung / ṭik+ka nyi ma'i 'od zer lung rig gter mdzod/ rin chen 'phreng ba sogs bod 'grel/gzhan yang 'dul ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos yod do cog gi dgongs/ don rnams thugs yul du nges par mdzad shing / bye brag tu khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ya chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs 'di nyid la 'dul ba'i bslab pa la phyag len gtso bor mdzad cing / tshul khrims kyi bslab pas ni bsam gtan dang / shes rab kyi bslab 'phel 'i/nga yun ring du gnas par byed pa sogs phan yon dpag tu med par gsungs pa rnams la nges shes dang bcas pa'i sgo nas 'dul lung bstan bcos dang bcas pa rnams nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis rang cag rnams la thugs brtse ba'i sgo nas bkag pa ste spyad par mi 'os pa rnams spangs shing bsrungs/ gnang ba ste spyad par — 246 — —

'os pa rnams spyad/ /bsgrub par gsungs pa ste/ nyams su len dgos pa rnams 'bad pa chen pos bsgrub cing nyams su len dgos te/ dper na nad kyis gzir ba'i skyes bu zhig la sman pa mkhas pas sman sbyin zhing / kha zas dang spyod lam gyi blang dor ston pas na/ tshe 'di'i srog bsrung ba'i phyir des byin pa'i sman 'thung zhing / ji ltar bsgo ba las mi 'da' bzhin/rang cag rnams nad thams cad kyi rtsa ba nyon mongs pa'i nad kyis gzir ba la srid gsum na 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i sman pa chen po mnyam med yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi snan thams cad kyi mchog tu gyur pa dam pa'i chos kyi bdud brtsi byin nas/ 'chal na 'di phyi'i bde 'bras thams cad kyi sbog rtsa gcod par byed pa'i bslab pa'i rim pa ji ltar bka' bsgo ba bzhin sman gyi mchog dam pa'i chos kyi bdud mi la nam yang tshims pa med par longs spyod dgos pa ni/ /rang cag rgyal ba nyi ma'i gnyen gyi rjes su bzhugs te skra dang kha spu bregs/ gos ngur smrig bgos nas gang gi ring lugs la slob pa'i rab tu byung bar gtogs su cog kun gyi bca' khrims kyi gzhi ma'am gtso bo yin pas gzhir bzungs/ /zhar byung yul dus gnas skabs dang bstun pa'i dge 'dun gyi nang khrims kyi rim pa gdan rabs gong ma rnams kyi khrims kyi bca' ba'i yi ge mdzad pa rnams kha 'thor bas rtsa ba 'dzin dka' bar mthong nas de dag thams cad kyi dgongs don rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdus/ snga phyi'i dbang gis tshig don 'gal rnams deng sang gi dus su dgag gal che'i dbang du btang / de dag tu mi gsal ba deng sang gi dus su med du mi rung ba'i khrims su bca' dgos pa rnams rang blos gang spobs dang / khyad par mdo rgyud rgya mtsho la gzigs pa'i spyan — 247 —

ras rnam par yangs shing / nang thugs dam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i chos rje rin po che rnam pa bzhi dang / thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi chos khrims kyi gdugs dkar po'i yu ba phyag mtshan du bzhes nas las nyon gyi tsha gdung gis gdungs pa'i skye rgu la phan bde'i grib bsil bla na med pa spyin pa po dge bskos chen mo sde pa ja rgyab pa bcas pa la'ang zhal mol gyi dgongs len dpyis phyin par zhus te legs cha mtha' dag phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas ri mor spel ba la/ thog mar grwa btsun gsar 'jug skabs bcad mtshams sngon mar chu rta bstsal ba'i thugs dam gyi dgongs don gzhir bzhag gi bod sog khams gsum mnga' res pa dang bcas pa'i grwa btsun gsar 'jug thams cad la grangs bcad dngos 'brel yod nung / grongs chad 'thor 'khyad sogs dang lo lo'i 'jug grangs ga bsdur med par brten 'al grangs chag tshab ci che byung gshis/ sba lo nas bkod khyab kyis 'di lo'i 'jus/ grangs phon gang che yong thabs bgyis nung /da dung gnam gī lha 'jam dbyangs gong ma bdag po chen po'i gser snyan du 'khyol ba'i 'al grangs dngos 'brel ma longs stabs rgya deb dang mthun pa'i zhal grangs ji bzhin ma longs ring grwa tshang so sor 'jug grangs sngon yod thos bsam gling par nyi shu rtsa dgu/ dkyil khang par bcu gnyis/ shar rtse bar bahru dgu rnams las chag mi chog cing / spar bca' gang thub byed/ de mtshungs har gdong // khal kha/ bsam lho'i 'bab khungs sog po yin nges dang / co ne/ rgya khams pa/ tre hor/ gu stag dpe thub pa/ rdzong dga' ba bcas 'di kha rang du gra rgyun la rang yul nas lam rkyang che gnyer spyos yong rigs byed nyung chos mthun kha khe mtshungs pa rgyugs chung sngar lam —— 248 ———

ltar sbugs 'dren zol spyor med par sprod rgyu yod na zhal grangs la phan slad grangs bcad med par 'jug dus gsum po gang rung dang bstun nas 'jugaslar zhal grangs dngos 'brel longs rjes thugs mthun khrims gtsang byung na dge 'dun 'phel rgyas che smon yul gyi gnas las ma 'das dung / grangs tshad las brgal na bkra mi shis pa yong tshul bgres gra'i gsung las thos 'ing /khya/ da par grwa tshogs ha cang che na kha ma 'dus lta bus bkod lam du 'gro dka' thing der brten chos spyod rig lung sogs kyang ji bzhin ma byung dwogs dang /phogs sogs bla brang gzhung rkyang gi gtong sgo dge 'dun ji tsam 'phel rgyas che rung dkon mchog gi 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pas mi 'grigs pa ga la srid kyang / dge skos chen mo rim byon gyi gtong sgo'i chad chos gathis sogs 'bab yong sprar yod gang yin las med khar/ phyis dus dbang gis tshong 'dus las sgo rnams kyang rim/ pas ji zhan du 'gro rgyur song gshis gra ma 'grig yong gnas dang / khyad par grangs mang kha 'dus dka' stabs der brten thug/sa mthun khrims gtsang yang 'byung dka' ba'i gnas bcas dge skyon che gshis/ de mtshams nas ja rgyab pa'i sprod khongs yig rigs gras su yod pa'i gra btsun gsar 'jug skor la gdan rabs gong mas chu rta zla 1 1tshes 15nyin bstsal ba'i bcad mtshams thugs dam rnams dbang ma sbyar ba'i nang ba'i/na nyams len g.yo zol med par byed pa las/ bo/nga gsal rtag par chu lam shor bgyis mi chog cing / yang 'al grangs chag che byung na gong gsal ltar dang / zhal grangs bzhengs mtshams thugs dam zur pa'i dgongs don ltar nyams su bstar rgyu bcas mdor na zhal grangs bzhengs min la bab bltas kyi 'di dang / chu rta'i thugs dam gnyis re mos lta bur nyams len —— — 249 ——

byed pa las rang snang sa/nga dran dus nam yang mi byed/ /bod sog kham gsum mnga' ris pa dang bcas pa'i grwa btsun gsar 'jug gang byed thams cad grangs gzhan dang / gzhes dgon sogs nas gnas dbyung bgyis rigs/srur phan rab tu byung nas pham par gyur pa'i chos bzhi gang rung la mthong thos dwogs gsum yod pa 'thab bkrol can bros byol du 'ongs pa rtsod gzhi can g.yul las la zhugs myong gi grwa rigs/ bshan pa/ nya pa/ ling pa sogs srog gcong byed pa gdol pa'i rigs dang / mgar ba/ ko pags mkhan sogs bod 'dir rigs ngan du byed pa rnams dang / grong sa/seb pa 'tsho chas kyi phyir dang sa cha ma zin pa/ lo bdun ma lon pa/ zhar long theng gsum rkang rdum lag rdum sogs dbang po yan lag la skyon can/ chom rkun pa/ zhol/ rnam sras/ bde legs sogs nye 'dabs su khyem tshang dngos gzhi yod bzhin par yul gzhan du skyes pa tsam la sgo btags byas pa/phyogs mtha' nas sde grong gong gsal rnams su nang tshang bsgril rigs sogs 'dir smos min la ma ltos par dgag bya dgos pa rig pas grub mtha' dag khams tshan dge rgan nas nye 'brel dang yul mi'i babs za sgo'i rje 'breng sogs la brten sgog bsubs kyi las khungs 'og mas gong mar mgo skor gtong ba/ chen po ltag 'khur sogs mi byed/ de ltar ma yin pa'i 'jug rung ji yod rnams kyang har gdong / rgya tri/ co spyo/ rdzong pha ba/ gu stag dpe thub pa/ khal kha/ bsam lho ba bcas rgyugs chung sprod lam gang yin dang / de byengs bod btsun gang yin chos spyod yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs sprod lam shar dod bcas mdor na rgyugs chen rgyugs chung ji ltar yin rung / sngon chad las tshan 'ga' zhig gi dus rngan pa'i 'gro lugs dang /——— 250 —

yul mi dkar nye sogs kyi la babs kha dregs kyis gna' bo'i lung la dwangs len byed pa sogs chos grwa'i sgrig lam dang rgyab 'gal du 'gro rigs ji snyed cig byung yod tshod du 'dug pa de rigs gtan nas bgyis mi chog cing /gal srid phyogs re nas ster cha'i rjes 'breng sogs la brten ngo sgog zol spyor du 'gro rigs bgyis pa shar tshe dge skos chen mo dang / ja rgyab pa gnyis phan tshun gcig skyon gcig si/sa rtogs par byas te 'di khar 'phral du rgyu mtshan dgos rgyur de thog dkar sa nag 'ded kyi bkod pa phyis lam khengs pa gtong rgyu yin/ yang che btsan khag nas rgyugs sogs la'ang ma lhos par 'jug dgos tshul sogs dbang shed kyis byed dka' shar tshe byed mi ngo bo 'di khar rtsis sprod dang 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan byung tshe/ de bsnyun bkod pa mthar phyin bya rgyu las zol 'jog spug gtum mi byed/ 'bab khungs kyi thad la lnga thog khams tshan so so'i 'bab yig gzhir bzhag gis ltar chags gtan 'bebs yin 'dug kyang / bar skabs sgrig lam rim lad kyi dbang gis rku thabs dbang shed sogs kyi sgo nas 'di yin byung yod tshod mi 'dug pas/phyin chad so so'i 'bab yig gzhir bzhag gi dngos gnas gang yin las rku thabs zol sbyor/ dbang shed gra btsun brje 'phrul/ mi dod sprod len/skye sprul gyi rigs sogs la skye ba sngon ma'i mi tshan gang yin la 'jug pa dang /g.yo zhus yig tham gyi rigs la'ang brtsi sgo gtong pa med cing / mdor na mi tshan so so'i 'bab yig dang / rgyab 'gal du 'gro rigs gtan nas mi byed/grwa sar tshud rjes grwa tshang so so'i chos spyod rgyugs sprod len sngar lam ltar dang /sgrig spo len gyi skor la slob dpon rnams nas bgro gleng dang na tshod kyi 'bab la gzhigs te spos chog pa dgos tshul phebs pa mi 'thad pa ci la srid kyang /— 251 —

rtsod rgyugs le 'e nga sogs kyi rtsa 'dzim do dam bas— grwa chos khrims pa so sos rgyun dkangs dbos rgyu dang / sku ri rtsa sko ra cho'i skabs dbe/ bros chen mo nas g.yam 'a/ rgyus tsam ma yim/ nga 'i gzis/sa rtog sgo/ra tsa/yeng dang // tshas grwa smo/ra che sang sa ra dpe/ cha ngang nang rogs dge/ zan zam sa/ ma/sa kyang so so'i dge / sa/tho/na/ 'a/ nang tshags snad gnon mig/ blta byed/ bgro/ gleng tshad ldan mi byed par phyar sa/ lang byed pa ༅/ra tshe dge skos chen mo dang tshas grwa chos skru/ mas nga/ sob/sa/ nas tshig gis sbyangs bshad dang dran 'dzin thub nan thog yang re (— dga' de/ dag si/ mang do sa/sa dang dpe cha'i dge/ rgan so so ra nang tshags brda spyor kyis ma bo 'og lus chug gi bkod rgyab byed du 'jug de nga/nga slob gnyer bskyed rben dbo/sa rgyu sogs legs slob rtsa (ra ji ma dgos rigs gang ci drang 'brel phan tshum/ 'dra ma/nyam byed pa las/ rang phyog/sa mgo 'don dang /po/(nan phyogs ma/bo/ ga/non gyi dbang du 'gro rigs bgyis ma/ 'thus rgyu min cing /dpe cha dang nang rogs dge rgan rnams/ nas krung dngos por zhen pa'i 'gro don du ming btags pa'i/ maṇ+ḍa la/ gtor ma/ chos sgrog sogs du ba lang rgyugs kyi nang rogs dge rgan nas dge gzhon 'khyams bskyur dang / dpe cha'i dge rgan nas kyang dpe rgyugs len pa dang / gsad 'khrid sogs thud shod sha stag yong gi 'dug pa phyin chad de rigs su ma song ba gtso 'don dang / gal srid phebs dgos rigs shar kyang nyin ltar dge gzhon la dpe rgyugs len pa dang / gsar 'khrid sogs byed rgyu ma chag par byas te yangs tig 'khyams bskyur thud shor 'gro rigs mi byed pa grwa tshang nas kyang slob gnyer gyi 'gros dang bstun/ bsdus 'bring / bsdus chen la rim spo/spyor dpon bsko ba/ tshig gis gzengs bstod/ phreng ba dang kha zas kyi —— 253 ———

gnang spyin ster ba sogs 'dzin rtsod gang sar lcag skul dang 'brel ba'i thugs rjes gang 'dzin mdzad dgos/ slob gnyer byed mi rnams la dge skos chen mo nas kyang lcag skul dang 'brel ba'i thugs rje gang che dang / yang re gnyis nas slob gnyer ltag 'khur gyis sgrig lam la ltos med byas pa byung na/de/ dag la dge skos chen mo nas spyi mthun bab thob nyes pa gnad smin gtong ba las slob gnyer la gong rgyag gis o zob tu mi 'jog de ltar bka' bza/da 'dzin rigs la grwa tshang rnams nas kyang slob gnyer ba yin tshul gyis ngo chen sogs sgrig lam la gnod pa'i rgyab lang mi mdzad/ shar rtse ba rig grwa che chung bo/ zla rgyugs sbar rgyun ltar la cha gnas/ de nas so so'i dbang po'i bab dang bstun pa'i dbang po rab nas grwa tshang so so'i yig cha gar bzhag gi bsdus grwa yongs rdzogs/ 'bring rga/sa bsdus tshan che byung spel ba'i le mtshan bcu gcig nas bdun gyi bar gang rigs/ tha mas bsdus tshan che chung spel ma'i lnga nas gsum bar gang rigs rgyugs song thob/ sgrig grwar sdod yun gyi lo grangs dang / rang lo'i na tshod lon nges rtags gsal gyi 'gro lugs shes shing / rnam 'grel le'u dang po'i gzhung chen drug gi rang lugs rgyugs 'pher sprod rgyu byung na spo/ de nas rig chen la ma thebs bar dge rgan la ma brten par gcig pur sdod pa med cing / slob gnyer re ba yod rigs la gnod 'gal shin tu che bas deng phyin chad rig 'bring pa dmigs bsal gyi rigs la ma gtogs dgongs chen mi ster/ thos bsam gling par snga dus ltar rig 'bring du 'phos pa nas bzung zla gcig song mtshams su/ mtha' 'bring le'u bzhi'i gzhung chen rnams kyi 'phros yongs rdzogs kyi rgyugs 'bul len byed/ dbang po rab kyis bsdu tshig dang po'i rtsa ba dang / mtha' la 254 la

'phreng le'u ba'i/ yongs rdzogs/ 'bring gis rtsa ba gong dang rang lugs nyer lnga'i steng le'u dang po dang / gnyis pa'i mtha' gcod/ tha mas kyang rtsa ba gong dang / rang lugs nyer lnga'i steng le'u gnyis pa'i mtha' gcod yongs rdzogs rgyugs 'bul ma byung tshe rig chen du mi spo/ slob gnyer byed mi'i rigs la spos rgyag dang phyogs 'gro sogs kyi dgongs pa mi ster zhing / grwa tshang dang / mi tshan sogs kyi las khral kyang / babs gang yangs byed//rig 'bring nas phar phyin du spo rgyu 'di ba'i na mig ltos shas rkyen che bas slob dpon rin po che rnams nas dam sgrags gang che mdzad dgos 'dug rung /grwa tshang slob dpon pa 'ga' zhig gi dus slob gnyer re ba med tshul rtags bkod kyis mang tsam btang bar brten/ mig lhos shas rkyen ci cher byung 'dug pas phyin chad grwa tshang bla thog re re'i dus slob gnyer re ba med ngos re zung tsam las/ phar phyin 'phreng rgyugs grangs mang btang na mi thus shing /de yang dbang rtul yin nges dang / na rgas gzugs gcong sogs kyi bab bstun las/ bzhes sgo'i rjes 'brengs su ma song ba mdzad dgos/ grwa tshang bla thog re re'i skabs dbang rtul gzugs gcong na rgas sogs kyi bab la brten phar phyin 'phreng rgyugs re zung tsam gtong skabs kyang mngon rgyan skabs dang po dang / mtha' 'phreng gi gzhung chen rang lugs tshem med rgyugs 'bul dgos rgyu/ gong gsal ltar/ mtha' 'phreng gi rgyugs rnams dbang po rab 'bring tha gsum la dpags pa'i gang rigs gtsang 'bul byung na rig chen du spo/ 'di'i gtong sgo'i skor la bla sprul thob nges/ srugs bon gyi rgyud ma nyams pa'i zhabs drung / sger rigs khungs btsun gyi rje drung /zha ngo'i brgyud las gson nges pa'i chos mdzad de 'di dag kyang thog ma grwa sar — 265 —

'jug sgabs nas bzung dngos gnas/ thob nges yim na ma gtogs rang mi nga ga/nga shar gyis mi btags ming chog cing / 'a'i/'i/ mi /bas/ su'ang bla spru la sogs snyu drag dang / /lams sog bcas dngos ba/nas yin na ma gtogs//sku 5/ka gi gtong sgo mi ga/to nga de datsa yin nges rnams/ nas sku drag bo/ ga/teng sgo btang kyang / gsar khral dang sdod gams srur rgyun ldar las/ dnge/ rgyus/sa spyi 'dre la re khengs byed nga/ med cing / dkyus ma'i rigs sgreg spo mgyogs khyad sogs kyi ched khyongs ja gtong rgyu sogs bcad mtshams sngon ma na rim du bkag pas gtan nas she mi byed/ thos bsam gling nga ra dmigs bas/la gī/ rig chen 'dzim grwa'i dbus su dam bca' tshad ldan 'jog pa dang / ston dpyid gnyis kyi 'phros mtshams sbyar gyi rgyugs 'di dam pa gong ma rnams kyis da/nga la ldan 'dod khams dbang mor gnyer du gtad sa/shis/ 7dbang po rno rtul sus kyang sla bcos dang khral bcos su ma song bar so/ sos bdag don bdas/ gces dgos rgyu dang // grwa tshang nas kyang dam sgrags gang che mdzad rgyu//rig chen pa'i rtsed mo 'ang gang spam las khyim pa sun 'byen du 'gro rigs mi byed/ de byengs rig chen pa'i sgrig lam thams cad brjod rgyu 'dzobs che ba'i rgyu las med gshis/ grwa tshang so so'i rig chen 'dzin grwa'i bca' yig ga/zhir ba 'ag bzhin 'phyus/ med nyams len dgos rgyu/ rig/ chen nas phar phyin du spo rgyu'i skor la bca' bsgregs snga ma rnams su/ lo lnga ma song bar spo sa med cing / dbang rtul spo dgos la dka bar rtsa ja gcig gtong ba las spos zhes pa tsam las gsal kha thon pa'i byed bde zhig mi 'dug pa/ zhib na thos bsam gling par rig chen 'dzin grwa'i mi 'bor la gzhigs pa'i lo bzhi lnga gang rigs kyi thog sbyor chos 'khel zhing de skabs nges ja dang bca' yig ja — 256 ——

bcas btang ste lo gcis// song mtshams sgrig spo lam byang yin 'dug pa sngar rgyum/ ltar byas 'thus rtsod med dang / dka ba'i thog/ nas lo lo'i rnam 'grel ming btags gsar bzhengs pa gnyis gnyis 'gro rgyun bcas bsnyon med ngos stom/ dpyid kyi 'phros rgyubs gnyer gtad/ la brtem dam sgrags ga/nga che stabs /dbang rtul ris/sa la bka' spyongs che bas lo khral 'khur ma tshams lo grangs ma thims kyang / dbang rtul yin ngos dka bar rtsa ja btang ste spo rgyu'i thad lo gcig khongs nyam bar rtsa ja dpyid tshas dang rting dbyar chos dang po bcas la gsum re ngang / dbyar chos gnyis pa/ dgun chos dang ngo bcas la ba'i re ste/ byo/ na sgril rtsa ja bcu bdun dgos thog nas// rjam 'grel spyi bsgyur ba sa/sar nges gnyis kyi ngos ja dang / gsar bzhugs ba/nyis kyi ga/sar ja re dang / sko ra ja re bcas khyon lnga dang 'grig dang / de 'phros lhag ma bcu gnyis lus par dka ba'i thog nas grongs chad dang / ru/la don sogs byung na tshab gsar ji yod kyi gsar ja dang / skor ja bcas 'di thog tu phan pa byas thog rin chen ba sgrig spo'i khyad rtsa ja ga/tong mkhan yod rigs nas phyir 'then bya rgyu dang / de rigs ma byung phyin gong du rtsa ja lnga 'grig 'phros bcu gnyis lus pa rig chen pa dbang rtul re nas rtsa ja gnyis re btang thogaphar phyin du babs thus la yangs ti lo gcig khongs rig chen pa dbang rtul mi drug dang / dam bca' chen mo'i 'phreng rgyan ja gtong mi gcig bcas bdun las lhag pa spos mi chog cing / slar dbu ma ba zla gtugs la brten po ti che ba'i spyi bskyur ba dang / grwa skor ba sogs bzhengs min byung tshe/'di gar rgyu mtshan gnang 'byor bsnun bab la gzhigs pa'i 'gro lugs mtha' ma bkag pa byed rgyur rgyun gtan 'di nang bzhin nyams len g.yo med — 257 —

mdzad dgos/ dkyil khang par sngar lam du lo khongs spyi bskyur zhu mkhan ji yod la rgyugs bsdur gyis thon su bzang la sprod pa zhig yod 'dug kyang de ltar byas tshe/ phyis bshad grwa rim nyams stabs ming btags zhu mkhan rnams kyang ji dkon la song tshe/ de mtshams rgyugs bsdur sogs kyang sngar byung gi lo rgyus tsam du 'gro nyen che bas/ phyin chad spyi bsgyur ba dang / grwa skor ba'i rgyugs bsdur la lo ltar lnga mchod chen mo'i thog rtags gsal 'gro lugs shes pa'i slob gnyer ba ji yod zur 'byed thog de byengs lo khral thon zin yan chad la rgyugs bsdur thog rgyugs bzang rim gyis 'dul bsam dbu ma ba rgan gzhon/ phar phyin rgan gzhon bcas/ 'di ga'i spyi bskyur ba bzhi dang /dpal chos grwa skor ba bzhi rim gyis sprod rgyu/ de rjes zur 'byed byas pa'i slob gnyer ba ji yod la rgyugs bsdur thog ang dang gnyis la rnam 'grel spyi bskyur ba gnyis sprod/ rgyugs bsdur 'di dag la dbu phar 'dul mdzod tshad ma ste/ lnga gang rigs kyi rtsa 'grel steng nas sprod pa las rje'i rtogs brjod bdun legs ma/ bla ma mchod pa/ shes bya'i mkha' dbyings ma/mtshan brjod sogs/ tshogs chen grwa tshang / mi tshan sogs kyi tshogs su 'don ba'i chos spyod rigs gtan nas mi len yang / dbang rtul lo ltar rgyugs bsdur skabs rgyugs zhan pas ming btags ma byung bar rim lus kyi lo grangs bzhi lnga song mtshams sgrig grwa'i le tshan rnams thon rjes/ phar phyin du spos 'thus/ shar rtse bar rnam 'grel dka'i 'phros bshad ma thon pa'i rigs la ming btags spyad mi chog cing / dbang rtul yin nges 'phros bshad thon re med rigs kyis le'u dang po'i 'phros bshad thon phyin gnyis la ma thon na rig chen ja gcig 'gyed ṭam re/ de mtshungs dang po dang gnyis — 258 —

pa thon nas gsum pa lus na sho re/ gsum pa yan thon nas bzhi pa lus na ṭam phyed re bcas rim pas bca' bshas kyis btang nas spo/ de yang shar rtse ba de bzhin zhal grangs nyung gshis rig chen pa'ang nyung bas 'phros bshad ma thon pa'i rigs phar phyin du spo rgyu/ de bzhin a dam sgrags gang che'i sgo nas mi dgos par gtsor 'don mdzad dgos/ grwa tshang gsum gang 'dra mnyam gyis rig chen nas phar phyin du 'khor thog po ti che'i spyi bskyur dang /dpal chos grwa skor la gtong 'os rigs kyi dbang po rab rnams nas po ti lnga gang rigs gcig gi rtsa 'grel yongs rdzogs/ 'breng gi rtsa ba yongs rdzogs dang / mtha' dpyod 'grel pa gang rigs nas shog grangs brgya tham pa/tha mas kyang rtsa ba gong bzhin dang / mtha' dpyod 'grel pa gang rigs nas shog grangs lnga ba tham pa re rgyugs 'bul byed rgyugs 'dra mnyam gyis ming btags lhags na rtsod pa bzang ngan gyis bshan 'byed des kyang bshan ma phyi na sgrigs spo/ snga rteng gis dbye 'byed thog gzhung don slob gnyer bab bsnyun gyis ming btags sprod rgyu/ lo lo'i dpal chos grwa skor ba thos bsam gleng pa brgyad/ dge rgan gnyis/ shar dkyil gnyis nas bzhi re dang /dge rgan re re bcas grangs bcad yin stabs/ dge skos pa'i phyam rtse zhes rgyugs med kyi 'phar dang / grangs bcad khongs su 'ang g.yo zhus pa brten pa'i rgyugs med du gtan nas mi gtong spyi bskyur ba'i gtong sgo'i thad rje gong mas chu stag bstsal ba'i thugs dam dgongs don ltar dpyid mtshams skabs chos grwa ja re dang / khri dar phyi mdzod/ snyan shal sprar rgyun bshad sbyong ja rkyang thog slob gnyer ba sogs mgron sngar lam/ ming btags zhu rten phyi mdzod lhag 'bul bzhes mi mdzad/ grwa skor dge rgan nas bsdu bya'i gsum — 259 —
