zur bsdud tsho ja bshad sbyongs gtor ja sogs la mu mthud pa'i nang sgyid sbar med mi byed/ ming btags thon pa'i skyid skyed sngar lam ltar de byings don med grwa rkyang khag sun dang / slob gnyer la sad rkyen 'gro rigs mtho dma' sus kyang mi byed/ lo lo'i 'di kha'i ming btags gsar bzhengs pa rnams nas kyang / bshad rtsod gang sad zal thon bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan du gyur pa zhig mdzad pa las gtong sgo su bzang dang gos rgyan su mchor la dwangs dod mi byed/ dpal chos grwa skor ba rnams 'di nas thogs pa nas bzungs grwa tshang phan tshun phyogs lhungs 'then 'khyer sogs grwa sa'i zhabs 'dren du 'gro rigs gtan nas mi byed par phan tshun gcig phan gcig thogs kyis bshad rtsod gang sar gra legs 'grig yong ba gtso bor bton te grub mtha' gzhan phyogs kyi khrod du ngo gnong mi dgos par smra ba'i mgrin pa mthon pod btegs chog pa'i sgo nas rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa'i gsos sman du 'gyur nges pa 'ig dgos rgyu/ ngam ring grwa skor ba rnams kyang de mtshungs de dag la 'di kha dang grwa tshang gsum chos khrims khang bcas nas kyang dngos shugs nyang gnon thog thus mi byung rigs la 'khor bstun bkod pa thus nan byed/ tshogs gsog pa'i ming btags 'di bzhin sngon dus nas bla brang du zhu sbol 'dug pa slob gnyer re ba yod rigs la byung tshe bshad grwar gnod 'gal che bas grwa tshang nas 'di yin gyi gsal cha ma byung tshe don ma rtogs kyis sbugs 'dren du 'gro nyen che bas sngon tshud nas slob gnyer re ba yod gras tshogs gsog pa zhu min rtsad gcod thog de rigs yod tshe zhus mi chog pa grwa tshang so so nas khyi bdag pos khegs pa dgos rgyu dang / bla brang du'ang slob gnyer drag gras tshogs gsog pa zhu 'dod yod pa 'di bzhin la rtsol thal med pa zhes gung gseng gi —— 260 —

snyan zhu dgos rgyu/ de rigs ma yin pa'i lo lo'i tshogs gsog pa rnams nas kyang po ti lnga re mos kyi so so'i thog gang babs kyi gzhung la dge rgan mkhas pa'i ngag rgyun las 'byung ba ltar gyi bshad pa gang yin tshig gsal smra dag 'gro gang che byed pa dang / sbugs 'dren dang gdang ring mi byed/ de ltar ming btags gang rigs thon zin pa rnams nas kyang ming btags thon pa dang /slob gnyer bskyur ba dus mtshungs mi byed par grangs 'dir po ti phyi ma rnams kyi slob gnyer ltar ma chad tsam las ha cang si/sa nyag phra bar 'dug pas re med rang ma yin pa'i blo rig gsal ba rnams nas dbu 'phar 'dul mdzod bzhi la dge rgan la brten slob gnyer dpyis phyin pa byed rgyu dang / g.yin yang yon tan thams cad kyi 'byung gnas yi ge yin pas de la yang mnya wad sogs rgya yis/ dbu chen da/bu chung sogs bod yig ste yig rigs la spyong thar dang / sa/'an yang so so'i skabs babs dang bstun rgyud bzhi rtsa 'grel sogs sman gzhung / sum rtags/ brda gsar rnying gi da/bye ba dang ka tsaṇ+ḍa sogs sgra/ me long ma sogs snyan ngag 'chi med mdzod sogs mngon brjod/ dbyangs 'char rtsis dkar nag sbu gsung thugs rten gyi cha tshad/sku rgyu brtag pa sogs ris/ pa'i gnas spyi bye brag la dal ba med par bslab ste/'di phyi'i legs tshogs kyi rtsa ba thos pa la nan tan du bslab 'tshal/ kham sog rnams pha yu/la thag ring nas chos byed don gnyer du yong par song gshis gdan rabs bong ma rnams nas las khral mi dgos pa'i babs yangs rtsal 'dug nga/ra so sos bka' drin bsam shes dang rang rang gi rgyud kyi yon tan rtsa ba tshugs thabs la bsam rgyugs chen 'phrod nas dpe cha'i dge rgan bsten te slob ba nyan dang 'brel ba'i sgreg rnams spo phyogs bod sog kham gsum khyad 26 1

med kyi de khongs nas drag gras ṭik+ka sogs la rim gtong byed/ shar rtse bsam lto ba rnams nas zla rgyugs kyang sngar srol bzhin 'bul/ chos thog so so'i sngags grwa gsar 'jug rnams kyang rnam 'grel la ming btags blangs te grwa skor thon ba'i dge bshes gong phud du gtong lam ltar chags thog chos thog dang bstun grwa tshang so so'i skal thob zha chag med ba dgos rgyu/ de dag kyang rgyud grwa rang du rgyugs sprod lam ji yod gtsang 'phrod ma byung rigs mi 'jugasngags ram pa'i rigs 'di 'ang rig chen nas phar phyin du spos zin pa ma gtogs bsdus grwa rig 'bring rig chen gyi thog nas zhur mi 'jug pa'i do dam grwa tshang rang nas mdzad dgos shing / gal te grwa tshang nas ma mkhyen par sa 'og dar btags kyi 'di phyogs zhus gnang byung tshe de mtshams grwa tshang nas mkhyen rgyur slar yang rgyu mtshan snyan zhu byung don tsam 'jog byas thus sngags su zhugs nas kyang dge tshul gsar bu'i dus su thos gling chos grwar sdod srol la de skabs rtsed 'jo dang bzhad gad sogs mdzes min sna tshos/sa 'dug pa phyin chad de lugs su ma song ba byed/ rgyugs su mi dgos pa'i 'don cha'i rigs rnams kyang so sos bdag don bdag gces kyis blo 'dzin dgos rgyu/ khyad par dge rgan mtshan nyid dang ldan par brten te 'don rta dbyangs/ thig tshon/ dbyangs nol/ mchod bzo/ 'chams/ dung rgya gling / phyag rgya 'ching lugs yan chad/ rdo rje 'chang blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi bzhed pa ji lta ba 'phyug med dgos rgyu/ de nas dge slong bsgrub ran mtshams nas tshigs phyi ma'i sdom pa rnam par dag pa blangs te gsang 'jigs sogs bla med dang / kun rigs sogs rnal 'byor rgyud/ phyag rdor 'byung 'dul sogs spyod rgyud rnam rbe sogs bya rgyud/ nag po skor gsum sogs — 262 —

chos skyong skor bcas so so'i dbang dang rjes gnang gi smin byed legs par nod nas char can bsnyen mtshams kyang g.yar khral tsam ma yin par rab mtshan ma/ de min dus grangs kyi bsnyen pa rdzogs med pa byed/ de yang sku gsung thugs kyi bcad rgya ma ral bar tshad ldan stan thog gcig tu byed pa las brnyed pa dang / 'jig rten bya bzhag sogs kyi ched 'phrad kha gtong ba dang phyir thon sogs gtan nas mi byed/ zur tshogs char 'phar khag dang sbyin bdag khag gi rim 'gro gal che dmigs bsal yod dus ma gtogs tshogs sgrig gang rtag ngos dbu mdzad nas 'don sbul gang byas kyi zhal 'don gnad smin 'don ba las bzhad gad dang phan tshun gleng mo sogs mi byed/ gson gshin gyi don du sku rim cho ga sogs su byon pa rnams kyis kyang bgo skal zhal 'don thad spyor mdzad pa las chang 'thung bzhad gad sogs khyim pa sun 'byin du 'gro rigs mi byed/ gtso cher grwa tshang 'di bzhin rgyud grwa zhes pa'i mtshan don dang mthun pa zhig dgos rgyur 'dug kyang deng skabs rgyud kyi 'chad nyan ltar ma chad tsam las mi 'dug pa phyin chad 'di mur lus na gsang sngags kyi bstan pa nyams pa'i rgyur 'dug yas da nas bzung char can rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub mchod yod skabs dang dgu gtor sogs 'char 'phar gtor rgyag skabs char can dang dmigs bsal gyi sbyin sreg yod dus dang / bla brang gi sbu rim 'phar ma bskangs gso grangs mang gtong rgyu yong skabs sogs dang chos seng gang yin phud/ de byings tshogs chen chos thog gang yin dang grwa tshang chos thog thos gleng par cha bzhag gi de'i ring la chos grwa gnyis chag med thog gsang 'dus kyi rtsa rgyud/ de'i 'grel pa sgron ma gsal ba dang ldan zla ba'i zhabs kyi mdzad pa la rje btsun bong kha pa chen pos yang — 263 —

'grel gyi mchan bu dang bcas pa de'i sa bcad bsdus don mtha' gcod myu gu bcas bzhi sbrags kyi 'dzin chos 'gro gang che gnang thog 'grel dpon pa drug gis gtsos bsnyen mtshams thon zin gang yin gyis dpe thog nas sa/non rgyu dang / sa bcad 'chol rigs la 'grel dpon pa rnams nas brda 'bul bya rgyu sogs ngo lkog med pa dgos rgyu/ nad gcong tshogs grwa mi pher ba'i rigs dang / zur tshogs nyin gang ma/ gson gshin gyi don gal che sogs dmigs bsal dka' med phebs thub min rigs la grwa tshang bla brang dang chos khrims khang du dgongs pa zhu thus las/ de byengs tshas grwad chag med phebs dgos/ / chos thob/ re re'i thog rtsis shag thengs gnyis re bla ma dang chos khrems pa gnyis nas byed/ de yang 'dzin chos nyan pa tsam gyis mi chog par rtsod pa dgos pas 'grel dpon pa rnams kyis dbu byas dge tshul slong thams cad kyis rgyud rtsa 'grel dang / bskyed rdzogs las 'phros pa'i rtsod pa tshad ldan rgyun mi thung ba mdzad dgos shing / khas blangs kyi dri ba dang rtsod rgyugs/ len pa sogs kyi do dam zhal nas rang gis dam don mdzad thog nga/bang po rab 'bring tha gsum la dpags pa'i lo zla dzag bskyed ga/nga rung thon nges pa dgos rgyu/ bde mchog sgrub mchod skabs rtsa rgyud 'grel bas rdon kun gsal rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa gnyis mtshams sbyar gyi 'dzin chos rtsod pa bde mchog gi rgyud rtsa 'grel dang / de'i bskyed dzogs las 'phros pa'i bgro gling mdzad/ dka' gnad kyi khas blangs dri ba sogs gong bzhin mdzad dgos/ rgyun tan yang bshad rtsod gang sar zal thon yong ba'i lcag bskul gang zab thog zal thon byung rigs la gnang sbyin sogs gzengs bstod dang //'dzin rtsod gang sar do mi gal byed mi dang dgongs zhu ma byas par chos/ grwa 264

dang rtsis shag la bsdad rigs la slob dpon dang chos khrims pa nas snyeng khams ma zhan pa'i nyes pa phyis lam khegs pa gtong rgyu bcas mdor na rgyud kyi bshad rtsod 'phel thabs bla grwa rgams cad nas gtsor 'don mdzad dgos/phyogs thon mdzad rgyu'i bla ma rnams nas kyang dang por 'di kha'i nges rgya byung ba nas zla ba gnyis bar chos zhu dang gra sgrig la bzhugs/ de nas re khengs med par thon te dgon pa so so'i bca' yig gi dgongs don dang / gdan sa 'di kha'i bca' sgrig don bzhin chos khrims kyi mgo 'doms kha tsam min pa mdzad dgos ma zad/ khyad par gzhis dgon khag 'di bag yangs che bar brten gzhis byes kyi grwa pa la tshogs su chang gtong ba dang / gtong sgo'i rgyur dmigs nor lug ched du bcad pa'i shas gtong sgo gtong ba sogs nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lugs dang ye mi mthun pa du ma 'dug pa 'di rigs phyin chad gzhis dgon gang sar gtan nas mi byed pa'i rtsa 'dzin bla ma so sor rgyun 'khyongs su byed/ gal srid 'gal 'das shar tshe 'di nas rtsad gcod dang 'brel ba'i rnag thog gtsag 'gel gyi bkod pa byed nges yin/ rang nyid kyi kyang 'di khar bzhugs pa bzhin gyi sgrig lam 'khur shes dpon g.yog thams cad lus dang grwa chas 'bral med/ dgon pa'i phyi nang sogs gang sar chang 'thung len tshod du 'jug pa sogs gtan nas mi byed cing / sa zhing 'debs skyong dang / nor lug gi bed spyod/ 'bol nyo dkon tshong /bun gtong sogs bla ma'i bya ba las rgyab kyis phyogs pa de rigs gtan nas mi byed/ rang nyid dgon gnas gang yin du gtan sdod kyis grwa rigs mgo 'doms khrims gnon byed pa las bla sa bgos gtong / dgon ri khrod gzhan ma'i phogs grwa dang nyis 'dzin sogs bgyis mi chog cing / sngon nas — 265 —

'gro rgyun gang yod kyi bla sa 'di dag gi bla ma gcig rjes gcig gnod rgyud grwa rang nas gtong rkyang las sku drag sogs kyi kha 'dzin dang / bla sprul khag dang / dgon khag so so'i grwa pas khri 'dzin byed pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/slar khri 'khyur mtshams rgyud grwar ri bong tshang log mdzad rgyu'i skor/ rtsa ba bzhi la mthong thos dwogs gsum gyis skyon med pa dang / bla sar lo bdun song tshe phyir log mdzad rgyur rtse shod kyi maṇ+ḍal rten gsum rgyud grwa tshogs yongs su gding ja gcig bcas mthun grub gan rgya'i dgongs don gzhir bzhag thog bla sar phebs ring tshogs chen phogs yig nas dud pa slar 'jug dgongs song gshis so so'i grwa tshang gang yin gyi slob dpon dang chos khrims khang du dge skos chen mo bcas par sngags khang gi khri dar dang mnyam pa'i kha btags re 'bul rgyu/ de byengs mthun grub gan rgya'i don la sor gnas/khams sog gi yul du bla mar phebs rigs rnams nas kyang dgon pa so so'i chos khrims mgo 'doms dang sbyin bdag ngo 'dzin sogs rnam dkar dang 'brel ba'i gdan sa 'di ga'i mtshan don dgung du 'degs pa dang / zhwa ser gyi bstan pa rin po che mtha' dbus phyogs kyi 'khor lor khyab pa'i thabs tshul sgo gang zab nas 'bad pa las sdom gsum gī tshul khrims la rtsing hral du spyod pa sogs bstan pa dang / gdan sa'i la rgya la rma 'byin pa'i rigs gtan nas mi byed/ khyad par gong ma chen po'i sku'i mchod gnas su gyur pa'i rgya nag phyogs su thon dgos kyi bla ma rnams nas zhwa ser gyi bstan pa dad rgyas che min gyi rtsa ba gong ma chen po'i chab srid la rag las par bsam gzhigs kyi bstan pa dang chab srid yar rgyas yong thabs la sgo du ma nas 'bad dgos sngags pa'i las tshan rnams nas kyang so so'i bgo skal gyi bya ba chos —— 266 —

khrims sa nas khrims gnon ngo lkog med ngos/ bzang po la gzengs bstod dang ngan pa tshar gcod pa sogs 'di dang rgyud grwa rang gi bca' yig dgongs don gzhir bzha/ga gi khrims gnon rgyun skyong dang / dbu mdzad nas cho ga brkangs gso sogs zhal 'don/ char 'phar thams cad mgyogs khyad sla bcos su ma song bar rnga tshigs gdangs dbyangs thams cad dam pa gong ma'i phyag len gzhir bzhag 'phyug med dang / mchod dpon nas mchod sa/tor thams cad rgyu 'gro bor zegs su ma song bar gtsang sbra gang thon thog 'du khang dang lha khang khag gi gad phyis mchod 'bul bdag 'dzin byed rgyu 'ang rang don rang gces dgos rgyu/ nor gnyer gnas kyang char can gtong sgo thams cad nyams med gong 'phel yong thabs dang / gtso bor mchod rdzas rnams la chag grum bor zegs 'thor 'phyar ral rdol sogs mi 'byung ba'i nyar tshags gang zab dgos rgyu dang / ja dpon thugs dpon rnams nas kyang gzhung sger gyi gtong sgo chud mi gzon par bum pa sib blug gis ja thug rnams kyang gang legs yong ba byed/ de mtshungs 'chams dpon pas 'chams kyi rkang grangs dang / dung dpon gyis dung tshigs sogs so so'i bgo skabs gyi bya ba thus gshor med pa yar rgyas yong ba dang / spyi khyab tu ji skad du yang gsang ba 'dus pa'i rgyud phyi ma las/ gang zhig rab bzang 'dus pa'i rgyud ni nyan pa dang / 'don pa byed dang klog pa dang ni sems pa dang / mchod par byed pa dang ni 'dri 'am 'drir 'jug pa/ byang chub rdo rje 'dra blta de la rtag phyag 'tshal/ zhes gang zhig 'dus pa'i rgyud 'di nyan pa dang /'don pa dang / klog pa dang / de'i don sems pa dang / gzhan la 'chad pa dang / rgyud kyi glegs bam la mchod pa byed pa dang / rang gis la 267 la

'dri ba'am// ga 'a/na 'dri/ra 'jug/ pa tshun chad rdo rje 'chang dang mnyam nga/ra sa/sungs nga/'i phan yo/na nga/nga / khyang/ nga ra 'jam mgon chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen ngo 'i bstan pa rim po che 'ji nying gnas mi gnas kyang rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di nyid kyi 'chad nyan nyams ma nyams la ras lus par rang cag bo bstan/ nga 'i chos 'byung be+e ḍūr+ya ser ngo ra ba/sungs pa so/gas thugs la nges par mdzad de bla grwa thams cang kyi rgyu/da/ kyi 'chad nyan 'dzin rtsod la blo nus kyi rtsal rngo/da bton te nyams/ ba so/ra chud/ mi nyam/mu/ pa go/nga 'phe' yo/nga thabs 'a/ ba bo bor 'bad dbos/ sngags pa'i bla ma las sne rna/mas/ nas de/ kha/'i las tshan gsar bkod dang / rgya sog la/ ma/sa bod kyi bla ma phyos/sa thon dgos rigs kyi 'os tho bsdu skabs kyang drang 'bre'/ 'os nges dkon ma/chog dpang btsugs bsdu ba las/ phyogs ldungs kyis so so'i phan gnod sgrub byed du 'gro/ ris/sa mi byed/ grwa tshang ga/zhan gsu/ma gyi las tshan pa rnams kyis kyang rang rang gi/ go skal gyi bya ba rnams phyogs lhungs gnod bskyod kyi dbang du ma song bar ji lta ba ba'i na bsgrub dgos dang / khyad/ par grwa chos khri/ mas pa rnams nas/ mtshan nyid slob gnyer dar rgyas yong ba'i lcag skul gnad smin rang gzhan phyogs lhungs su ma song ba byed/ dge skos pa'i 'os tho 'di bzhin thog mar grwa tshang so sos bsdu skabs mi tshan go rim yod pa 'chol ped thog snga dus nas sngags pa'i las tshan che khag rnams 'jug pa med cing / dgon khang pa'i thog nas byed pa 'di yang phyis byung ba yin pas de rigs ma yin pa'i slob gnyer drag pa dang / 'byor ldan can rgyu drang zhing mi bab lhings ba sogs 'os nges rnams 'jug de yang 'os nges rnams nas 'os thor mi yong ba'i thabs dang mi 'os pa nas yong thabs byed pa sogs kyi dbang du ma song ba dgos rgyu/ — — 268 ——

de mtshams 'di kha nas/ brtas/sa pa dang 'brel ba'i dbe/ bskos las 'khur 'dzin dbos kyi thar/ ga byung 'phral dwangs len byed nga/ las tham/ ga phyir 'bu'/ da/nga rdan/ bur sos/sa/ bgyis mi tshab/ cing / nges ba nas rtsis ma ba'i/sa kyi bar la dge skos las thos// pa dang grwa tshang sogs su nyes pa'i rgyab ba/nyed/ zhwa ngo sgro ma/ brgyung/ so/gas mdzad tshe rim ba'i na rang nyid kya/nga las khungs de/ la/ 'i thog tu phebs rgyur dgongs/ bzhes kyis khrims 'gal 'dod da/bang sgrung/ phyogs su mi 'gro/ ba mdzad dgos/ dge/ bskos 'di bzhin ngh+ru/ khya/ ba kyi khroms gzom/ du song gshis byed dang byas zin gyi rigs la mtho dma' sus kyang g.yos/ bskul bgyis mi chos cing so so rang rang nas kyang sngags grwa yin na tshos/sa su sgribs rgyug dang / min tshe da phan tshogs 'du so cho/'i skabs mchod khang thar du ba/sol jar 'dzoms lam 'dug kyang thams/ cad mkhyen/ nga/ dge 'dun grub kyi gser khri// ra 'kho/ da nas spyi khyab kyi khrims gnon byas pa jeg dkyus ma da/nga nya nyung mnyam 'dres/ byed ba cung 'dra chag/sa min stabs phyen chad tshos/sa chen ja thug so so'i skabs bla brang rtse gzim chung 'gag tu bzhugs 'thus/ dge bskos chen mo las thog pa nas kyang rang ga zhan phyogs lhungs kyi dbang du ma song bar phan tshun thams cad la snyoms gdal gang che yong ba dang / dge bskos chen mo rang yang tshogs sogs la chad med phebs ste zhal 'don dal 'brel dang gdangs sogs sngar lam 'phyug med yong ba dang / dge 'dun rnam/sa nas kyang snyun gzhi sogs la brten nas tshogs grwa mi pher ba dang / mi khom skabs mtha' ma bka' pas rgyun gtan tshogs su gang rtag thob don med kyi gleng mo dang / bzhad gad sog/sa mi mdzad par spyi sger gye bsnyen bkur dang / sku rim la dgongs 'al 'don chos spyod kyi rim pa gnad smin gcig la 269 — —

bsgril mdzad dgo/sa/ yang phyar g.yeng ba 'ad gad sgrig lam ltos med byed rigs la nyes pa phyis lam khegs pa gtong gnang mdzad dgos/ tshogs kyi bzhugs gra' bca' yig chen mo'i dgongs don sor gnas las rkang mgyogs gral mi mdzad/ tshogs chen dbu mdzad dag nas kyang char 'phar 'al 'don gang ci ra1gyogs khyad sla bcos su ma song bar gdangs dbyangs 'do/na lugs gang ci nyams pa sor chud ma nyams pa gong 'phel yong ba byed/gzhan yang 'a/sa tshan nga/ rnams nas so so'i las don nyams len la sdig spong dge sgrub rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyu/ dge bskos chen mo'i gtong sgo'i slo/ra la bca' sgrig snga ma 'gar za bde chung khyad la dgongs bu ram dang 'khur ba sogs gtong sgo rim chag byung yang 'gal ba med tshul gsal yang gtong sgor khag dkris kyis dgon zhol gang sad 'khar ma'i za bde brdabs bsigs med nges/ spos dri zhim pa gtso bor gyur ba'i bu ram dang 'khur ba'i bsnyen bkur yang gang legs gtong ba phun/ sum tshogs pa'i yan lag yin ga/shis sngar rgyun bzhin gtong khyad par dgongs mo'i sku rim dang / skor tshor yong min sgrig pa yan la tsho par zhib 'jug dang / bsdus grwa ba rnams la'ang thugs zhib bka' khyab kyis yong min byung rigs la za bde brdabs bsigs kyi dbang du ma song ba'i nyes pa phyis lam khegs pa gtong gnang dang / de mtshungs chos grwar yang dgongs chen dang 'phral sel dgongs zhu byas pa phud/de byings chos grwar gang rtag yong ba'i bka' khyab dang gnang chung 'khyams bskyur byed rigs la skabs bstun bka' bkod mdzad rgyu bcas grwa tshang so so'i slob dpon rin po che rnams dang / chos grwa chos khrims pa so so'i rgyun 'khyongs su mdzad rgyu dus 'khor ba 'di bzhin phyis sgrig rim lad kyis bsgrub — 270 —

ma/chod skabs tsam las rgyun ga/tan tshos/sa su tshang dka' ba dang / 'al 'dom/ rnams kyang mthugs khyad sla bcos sha stag la brten/ gdangs dang mchod rol tshun chad 'di yin med pa zhig 'dug pa phyin chad de rigs su ma song bar spyir mi lus thob dka/'a ba dang / thob kyang rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal dal/'a ba/ mjal kyang gsang sngags rdo rje jeb/ pa'i bstan pa 'byung dka' ba khyad par dang po'i sangs rgyas gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i lam bzang 'di lta bu nyams su len rgyu da res tsam yin snyam pa thugs yul du bcangs te tshogs sgrig gang rtag dang / 'don chos/ sa/dngas dbyangs/mchod bzo/ gar// thig tshon/ phyag rgya 'ching lugs tshun tshad snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa bu ston thams cad mkhyem pa'i bzhes pa bzhin 'phyug med nyams len rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyu dang / de dag la dbu chos gsum nas rgyab gnyer rtsa 'dzin nan tan byed dgos/ zla bskangs/gtor ma/ maṇ+ḍal/ gnas bcu khag byams chos pa/ mtshan brjod pa rnams kyang so so'i tshos/sa grwa chag med thog bgo skal 'don thal spyor mdzad pa las gleng mo bzhad gad sogs bgyis mi chog cing / 'di dag gi mgo 'doms sngar lam bzhin ja rgyab pa rang nas byed/ char 'phar bka' 'gyur ba rnams nas kyang sgrig lam gang ci sngar rgyun ltar la zhabs 'don gyi gdangs lhad phal cher 'di nas 'jug pa zhig 'dug pas phyin chad tshogs chen zhal 'don ltar las ra thon lug thon spyo lab kyi rnam par mi 'gro ba da/nga /khyad par ma rkang lta bu bka' 'gyur gsung sgrog 'di bzhin tshig gsal sgra dag 'gro nges 'don pa las yig ltar mchongs nas 'don pa dang / bar 'chol 'don pa sogs chos la brten ba'i sdig pa rngam po che gsog pa de rigs mdzad la 271 la

mi chos pa so sa/sa/ gang ci'i mgo 'dzo/ma mu/ chos khrims/ khang rang nas ma dzad dbo/sa / spyid na dang dgu brtsebs ma'i char pa /dbebs la phyis dus tham sa cad phebs 'dzem/ lces/ /'a/ma gra ngas nyung ba dang / tsa/nga yod rnams nas/ kyang phral mngon lta ngu/ra so nga byen tsa/sa mam than sha stos/ yong /'dus/ pa 'di rigs bzad ma/ra byung na byem nga/ su/na (dbyin du yang 'gro nyen che bas sems cam gyi bde spyid dang / chab 'bangs kyis phogs 'bul sogs da ma/'a thrungs la dgongs snyeng rje ngang lha sa bsam zwang du 'jus/ pa'i thugs 'dun gyis phebs te sprun dmis/sa zal 'don gī rim/ nga sgo sa/nga zab nas mdzad dmas/dgongs chen sko ra sngo na dus rje so/nga mas bstsal ba'i bca' sgro/ga ltar la sor po//nas yin na'ang / bar sga/bas yid sru/ba rgos dam/ra gī brtul zhugs 'dzin rnga/ 'as/'i 'khru'/ las chos lī/ mas kyi che 'dzin mdzad ngo/ rjams kyang mdzad dka/krā 'a/ brtem/ rgya che nu re//da du so nga 8 dus/ pa de mur lus tshe slob gnyer sgris/ lam gachod 'grol thin tu che ba yo/nga rgyur 'dug nga/sa phyin chad/ yongs 'dzin rdo rje 'chang dang / skyed ma/ ya/ba sazhis so sor dgongs chem/ mi bzhir h+pho ba dpon rin ngo che rnam ba'i so sor dgongs chen mi grangs gong mtshungs la ston dpyid lcogs ldu/na byung tshe thebs re gtong / 'di kha'i phyag ma /dzod pa zur pa dang grwa tshang gi slob zur nga1'i rigs la da/rgongs chen mi sa/sum re/ dge/ bskos las thog par sku tshab nga dang rgyun bskangs pa gcig thus kyi sngags/ nga/ gcig gnyer pa dang dmis/sa/ slong ba re/ grwa tshang gi/ sku tshab dge skos chen mo'i/ skyor gnon chos khri/ ma sa nga gnyes/ rtsa g.yog chos khrims pa rgan gzhon gnyis/ bka' 'gyur sku tshab pa dang chos khrims pa gleng 'ag/ba brang dpon/ ltas// sgo tshas khrim/sa pa/ ma chen bcas dang / de ——— — 272 — —

byings/ dngab sko sa 1ma/ ru/nga/ ba//ce/ngas drus/ la bso/da sboms ska/bas sos/sa 'a lhos/sa/ nges bza stong na zebs re ba /las rgyun du mi ba'i re/ tshos/sa/ chem dang / sbabs la/ nga las tshan pa sogs ngo bor dbo//ngas chen yo da gras tshogs chem dbu mdzad gnyis // 'chi du khang sbu gnyer/ dung mkham za/ma/ bsgom sa/nyis/ ja ja/ngo/na/ tshogs sa/so ga ba/ gī/nga srung ba/ sba gas pa / ma chod/ nga/pon nga/ ngang / nor tsa/nyer ba/ bka' 'gyur yod ska bas ba7/(re 'gyur nga brgya dang dgu /mas zla/'i dus/ 'khor spru nga ma/tshad/ skabs dus/ 'khor ba bzu drub/ dang / ja ma/ ba/sum/ ma /tshad ga/yo/ba// ba/cas/ mdos chem / bal//'a 'gyur 'phar ma/ sos/cad/ snya dra/rngo bstan srid kyi sku rim/ char 'phar tim/ 'khyo/ ngas/ yo/da sprabs ngo yo da ngang ja ma bcas la dgongs pa gleng med ngos/ nge/ byings sru sas khang 1/dus 'khor ba1/ gnas bcu ya/sa/ mas/ maṇ+ḍal// sa/hor ma// zla bskangs/ rgyun bska/ngas khag sos/sa so so'i tshogs 'du rkye rim go/nga du grol tshe sku rim bror tsho tshogs chem/ spyi 'gre ltar rgyus/ chos grwa yang de mtshungs byed/gsol gzim sogs/ nang ma rtse drung gang yin la dgongs chem/ mi gnyis re dang / sbu gnyer che mor g.yob/ mi gsum// ma bo/na khang pa gang yod dang / ja ma/kun gling chos sgrog pa mi bzhi da/nga / thab g.yog sa/cig 'cham spyongs tshugs pa ma/sa/ sa/stor rgyas/ ma tshar gyi bar la 'cham/ pa ngo yo/da/ ngos kum dī/nga du sdod ring chab dzing chu ma mi gcig skyed na'i nub rgyud ldum ra'i sbu gnyer/las tshan pa ser mo ba gang yi/na dang // rtse drung du 'o/da la ga/yo/ga dgongs chen mi re/ sku drag nang ma dang 'dod gcig gi las tshan 4/ rtse drung sogs mi gnyis gsu ma// bzhi lnga/ drug bdun/ dgu bcu ji ltar yod kyang rtse drung rnams nang ma'i zla khongs nas mi lhos/sa pa mi 'dug ga'i/sa sger du ——— 273 ——

dgongs chen 'phar gtong mi byed cing / phyogs sdod rtse drung / las zhabs chab gcig dgongs zhu byas pa'i dar rgan/ drung 'khor mtho dma' bar gsum gyi rigs bcas la dgongs chen gtan nas mi gtong / tshogs chen 'du khang sku gnyer la g.yog gnyis/ bcu gsum mchod nas lnga mchod bar la par pa bzhi dang grwa tshang re skor gyi par g.yog bzhi/ rtse thab chu ma gsum/ rtse phyag shar gī gnyer g.yog gcig las ka gal che yod dus bar thab mi thebs/ sgang gcal dang pad sdong sku gnyer/ thug khang brang gnyer gcig tshogs chen sgrig grwa'i thog nas lha bres khang du rgyun gtan 'gro mi bris pa du yod/ bla brang yig 'drir rgyun sdod byed mi gang yod dang / rgyun 'don pa bcas ngo bor dgongs chen/ bla brang sngags khang gi mchod dpon pa/ sngags pa tshas khrims pa/ nor gnyer pa/ bla brang gsol 'degs pa bcas so sor g.yog mi gnyis re sngags pa'i ja dpon gcig dang / thug dpon gcig spyi par grwa tshang rgan pos spyo gas min gyi sde pa gnyis/ thos bsam gling grwa tshang rgan po gnyis dang / rgan g.yog bzhi/ chos sgrog pa mi gcig har gdong dge rba/ma/ dang / gnyer pa bzhi re/ grangs med che ba rgan po gnyis/ rgya khams pa dge rgan gnyis dang rgan po gnyis/ ba 'ad pa rgan po gnyis/ gcen lung pa rgan po gcig co ba dge rgan gcig/nor bu chos 'khor gling pa rgan po gcig nor bu dga' ldan pa dang /dga' ldan rab rgyas pa so sor rgan bo gnyis re/ legs bshad gling pa rgan po gcig dkyil khang grwa tshang rgan po gnyis dang rgan g.yog gsum/mdangs chen mi tshan gyi rgan po gcig khal kha'i rgan po gcig gu ge ba rgan po gcig dang mi sna gnyis/ pi thub par rgan po gcig dang mi sna gnyis/— 274 —

stag mo bar rgan po gcig dang mi sna gnyis/ shar rtse grwa tshang gi rgan po gnyis dang rgan g.yog gnyis/ chos sgrog pa mi gcig thon pa'i rgan po gnyis/ bsam lho'i rgan po gcig dang / dge rgan gcig chos grwa chos khrims pa bzhi ngo bo so sor sku rim la dgongs pa gtong srol 'dug kyang /sku rim la yong na sku rim sgror tsho gang sar so so'i phyogs su 'doms che bas deng phyin chad chos grwa chos khrims pa bzhi la dgongs chen ped pas so so'i chos grwar phebs dgos smos med thog dgong mo'i sku rim la yang chag med phebs te so so'i phyogs su mig lta byas thog sgrig lam lhod med byas pa byung rigs la chos grwa'i thog bkod khyab byed/ de mtshungs tshogs chen gyi tshogs thun gzhan rnams la'ang mtshan nyid chos gra chos khrims pa rnams chag med bskyod de bkod khyab mig lta byed rgyu sngar rgyun ltar dgos rgyu/ ngos kun gling dang bde chen pho brang sogs su skyod skabs so so'i sku gnyer la dgongs chen jebs re/ grwa gras las/ bzo shes mi'i rigs la 'di kha'i las ka khe rkyang yod skabs ngo bor dgongs chen dang sgo ja/ las ka zin mtshams rgyun du dgongs chen dang sgo ja mi ster/ spos rgyag pa/ spos brdungs pa/ shug las pa/ na gi ba rnams kyang las nam zin bar la dgongs pa dang / slob gnyer re ba yod rigs spyi sger su thad nas slob grwar 'jug gtong mi byed cing / re med bcug rigs la rje gong ma'i phyag dam du dgongs chen bstsal 'dug pa bzhin sngar rgyun gtong / de ltar dgongs chen grangs bcad gong brjod ltar las 'phar ba su thad nas zhu gtong mi byed cing / de yang rang gi rtsa g.yog dang 'dod gcis/ ming btags slob gnyer sogs kyi re ba med rigs ma gtogs/rtsa g.yog dang 'dod gcig min pa/ slob gnyer re ba yod rigs bcas la — 275 ——

dgongs chen/ phar phyir/ rig grwa che chung bsdus gra sogs sgrig ga/nga gi steng nas kyang mi gtong yang rang la mi dgos bzhin du gzhan la dgongs chen bogs mar gtong ba sogs mi /3tshams pa'i spyod ngan du thad nas bgyis pa shar tshe dge skos chen po rang nas kha dregs kyi ngo 'dzin sogs su ma song bar 'phral 'phral gsal cha dgos rgyu/ de mtshungs sbo/ ja 'di yang snga dus rgan gcong tshogs grwa mi pher ba'i rigs la bstsal ba yin 'dug kyang deng skabs tshog/sa mi kher khrom pher ba mang bas khrom tshogs gang yang mi pher ba'i rigs dang / nad sa/yo ga mtshams g.yog yin nges sogs nges can nga/gos rigs la ma gtogs so so'i 'dod dbang bsnyad btags kyis/ zhu mkhan byung tshad la mi ster zhing / skabs skabs su dge sko sa chen mo rang nas bro ja'i thog rtsis shag/ mdzad de rgya che mu med du mi 'gro ba dgos rgyu/ gzham yang 'di kha'i grwa rig/sa phyi nang phyogs kun gang sa/ra sha 'byar dang tsha(ma phyi ma phu thung can/ nor ma pus shubs/ lo/nga sto da/ stod slob/ 'a/sa/ shubs/phyu pa da/ngos/ gri ring / skra ring / lo/ zon/ khams lham/ mgo/ bor ras gzan dkri ba sogs 'ba' hreng gi/ chas dang / sa/'am yang rgya so/ga/ ge cha lus//sa rdzams gtan nas byas mi chog cing / de mtshungs gzan rnge/da pa rgyab reng du 'gro ba dang / yi/ma thab rgyab mdun gyi sul sogs ngos bzung med pa'i zlum po dang 1/ spyo khang phan tshun gyi thog steng nas rgyang 'bod byed pa sob/sa kyang dgas/ bya dang / khyad par phyogs 'gro'i skabs sger g.yo ga/ so/gas grwa pa dkyus ma'i rigs kyi 'ba' hreng si/ chas dang / sbu drag khag/ nas sog chas sogs sprod rgyu 'di bzhin mtho dam /'a bar gsum sus kyang byas mi chog cing / sngags nga/ so sa/sa yon rgyugs pa rnams nas rtsed zhwa sos/sa dgon ——— 276 — ——

gnas 'di rang gi chas dang / de byengs phyogs 'gro ba gzhan rnams nas grwa chas dngos gtsang bo/ steng jo zhwa lta bur rab byung gi cha lugs las 'ba' hreng rgya sog khams gsum gyi chas sogs ya ma/ bzung gi cha lugs spyi sger gyi bstan pa la rma 'byin pa'i spyod ngan 'di rigs bgyis mi chog cing / de dag la 'di kha grwa tshang bzhi/ chos khrims khang bcas nas do mi gal du ma song ba'i nyang gnon blta rtogs 'thus tshang bos 'gal rigs la chen po'i ngos 'dzin so/gas kyi dbang du ma song bar rjes gnon mib lar phan pa sa/tong rgyu/ sngar phan gsol ba/zim sogs sku drag nang mas sgog rtse dang / de man chad kyis stod bo/sa rnam/sa dgon pa'i phyi nang gang sar gyon lam shar rdod yin kyang 'di la rigs sgres nas mig ltos ngan pa rim 'phel yong nyen che bas phyin chad dgon nga/'i skor 'a/ma tshun chad la ser mo ba mtho dma' bar sa//sum sus kyang sgog rtse sto da gos char phebs phu thung can char lham ra ྅ rtse dang / so/ be rtsi so /sa tsa//rtan na/sa mi gyon/ char phar dus ston so so'i skobs kyang grwa chas ma/ mo gang legs gyon pa las sgog rtse dang / stod gos sogs phu thung can mi gyon/ smon 'a1ma chen mo'i skabs dgon nang ma song gshis pyon chog nga/ 'dra zhis/ 'a pa dus/ kyang dge 'dun gyi tshogs dang nye bas de skabs kyang gyon mi pyon ljongs rgyu'i skabs phar lam skor lam pham chad gyon chog pa 'dra zhig 'dug kyang dgre 'du/ma gyi sde dang lhan cis/ tu skyod dgo/sa bshes mi pyon// ngos phyogs 'gro'i rta gral skabs dang so so rang rang phyogs thon skabs kyang skor lam gyi rta bzhom/ par ma slobs bar spyon mi chos/ cing // nge/ nas gyon te 'gro rgyu dang tshur lam yang skor lam du rta babs pa dang chabs cig phud de de'i nang tshum/ la gyon/ dri/ chob da phan gling sru/nga pa dang dgu btor sogs kyi yar —— 277 ——

gsol ba rnams nas stod gos gyon lam 'dug pa 'di yang phyin chad mi byed/mdor na deng phyin chad dgon pa'i skor lam nang tshun la ser mo ba mtho dma' bar gsum sus kyang gar 'chams kyi skabs su phod ka che chung phud/ de byings gos phu thung can gyi rigs su gtogs po cog gyon mi chog par bcas pa yin pas 'di kha dang grwa tshang bzhi chos khrims khang bcas nas rtsa 'dzin rgyun 'khyongs su mdzad dgos/ bstan lar phan nges kyi gta/ ma gleng rgyu yod na ngo thon bgyis thus las de min dge 'dun byings la khag dkris pa'i bla grwa rgyab 'gal du gtong 'dod kyi bsam ngan khog tu bcug ba'i yig 'khyams 'di rigs mtho dma' rang gzhan sus kyang sbyor gnang med pa dang / blo nye bar rlom pa rnams kyis kyang phan tshun phan gnod dge skyon gyi gtam yod kyang ngos thug gis byas thus las/ ston pa la dge slong legs pa'i skar mas gnod sbyin gyi 'jigs pas sdigs pa dang / ji ltar byes pa chung ngu la nar son pa'i gang zag gis sdigs pa bzhin du kho bo dus gnas kun tu dge 'dun las 'jigs pa dang / zla ba las tsha zer mi 'phro bar nges pa rnyed pa 'ig la grwa mang khang 'khur ba'i ngan lab yig bskur gyi rigs 'di gtan nas mi spyor bar gsol ba 'debs pa lags pas/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis spyi rab tu byung ba dang / khyad par dge slong la khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum sogs bcas la mi dge ba bcu ni rab tu byung ba'i dge slong lta zhog khyem pas kyang bsrung dgos na/ de'i nang tshan dag gi las bzhi/'i ya gyal khra ma ni nyes pa chen po dang ldan te/ rin chen phreng ba las/ khra ma yis ni bshed dang bye zhes nyes pa dpag tu med par gsungs shing / khyad par rgyu zhe sdang gis kun nas blangs te/ bsam pa dge 'dun gyi sde dang dbye — 278 —

bar 'dod pa las lus ngag gis kyang grogs byes te bya ba mthar phyin par rgyas pa 'di lta bu'i 'bras bu ni ngan song mu mtha' med pa bka' pod rnam pa lnga la sbyangs pa mthar phyin pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi thugs/ phul du nges zin pa la phran nas grub zin sgrub pa'i gsal sbyor ci la zhu dgos gang ltar thugs kyi glang po dran shes kyi lcags kyus btab ste mdzub mo nang du bkug nas dgongs 'tshal/ gal srid yid bskyur gyi rigs sbyar ba shar tshe sbyor mi ngos zin par byas te chabs cig rtsis 'bul yong ba byed/ yang spyor mi 'di yin med par yig 'khyams thon rigs dang / yod tshul gyi gleng thon sogs byung tshe sa gnas so so'i bdag po la nyes pa kha tsam min par gtong nges yin pas de lugs bag zon rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyu/ yang grwa rigs 'ga' 'ig yul dang gnas skor du bskyod pa/ gzhis dgon gtong las/ tsha chu sogs la khag dkris kyis gzhis dgon yul sogs phyogs mthar don med du yun ring bsdad de/ de dag tu bag med kyi spyod ngan byas pa shar tshe 'di kha dang chos khrims khang sogs nas rtsad gcod kyis slob bstun nyes pa mig lhos la phan pa gtong rgyu/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen po'i bzhed pa thun mong ma yin pa thos pas rgyud legs par sbyangs nas bsam pa dang sgom pa la 'jug pa yin pas thos med sgom la 'jug pa blun sgom rgan po'i rjes su ma 'jug par lo drug hru'i bar du thos pas rgyud legs par sbyangs te de mtshams nas bsam pa dang sgom pa la 'jug pa'i slad ri khrod du spyon kyang thus/ ri khrod la phebs nas kyang gnas der slebs pa tsam gyis byang chub thos pa ma yin gyi rang gis ji ltar thos pa rnams nyams su len dgos la/ de yang 'ga' zhig ri khrod du slebs nas dge sbyor nyams len gyi rim pa la mi 'bungs par 279 —

gshin gson gyi don du sgro btags te khul de'i grong gseb tu chu bzhin myul ba dang / chos rgyags su ming btags sa zhing 'debs spyong / bun bskyed gtong tshong khe spegs/ dge phrug spyong thar/ rta drel/ gnag lug bsten pa/ zas gos sogs phran bu'i don la ri khrod pa nang phan tshun du rtsod pa byed pa/ yul mi dang nye 'brel skyong thar sogs rab tu byung ba'i bya ba las rgyab kyis phyogs ba'i spyod ngan 'ba' zhig la brtson ya ches mang bas de lta bu'i bya ba thams cad rgyang du dor nas gzhi/ gsum dang gzhan yang ltung ba mi 'byung ba'i thabs la 'bad cing / rgya la byung yang skad cig kyang mi 'chab par de ma thag tu bshags bsdoms tshul bzhi/na byed pa sogs bdag cag gi ston pa'i rjes 'jug tu gyur to cog kun gyis kams su blangs bya 'dul ba'i sde snod du bshad pa'i gnang bka' bsgrub pa'i bslab pa rnams gzhir bzung tha snyad rig pa'i gzhung lugs la ga bo bor mi 'bad par gsung rab thams cad snying po'i bcud bsdus pa skyes bu gsum gī rim pa'i rnam gzhag rje btsun tsong kha ba chen pos mdzad pa che chung dang thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i gser gyi yang bzhun/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i lam khri/ da 'jam dpal 'al lung sogs yig cha khungs la brten nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bshes gnyen dam pa'i zhal las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin/ 'go/ ba'i/sa gnyen bsten tshul nas mjug gzhi lhag gi bar shar sgom tsam ma yin par nyams ma skyes kyi bar thun du bcad de sgom pa phar phyin rbeg pa'i nyams len/ gsang sngags kyi nyams len yang chos skyong skor sogs la ga bo bor mi byed par gsang ba 'dus pa sogs pha rgyud bde mchog sogs ma rgyud kye rdor sogs gnyis med rgyud sde/280 —

rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde gtogs pa'i yi dam gyi lha rang nyid gang la mos pa zhig gi smin byed kyi dbang sgrol byed kyi 'khred/ rgyab rten gyi lung dang bcas pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi drung du legs par nod nas/ thob thob tsam ma yin par gdams ngag gi mtha' rgya legs par bcad de rtsa ltung bcu bzhi dang sbam po brgyad sogs bsrung bya'i dam tshig dang /gzhan yang bsten pa dang zag pa dang mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin bsrung la/ gal te rtsa ltung lta bu byung na rdo rje slob dpon las dbang bskyar nas len pa dang / ga 'a/na rnams la bshad pa dang yid kyis sdoms pa sogs rgyud sde'i dgongs pa bzhin 'bad la/ de'i bskyed pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i mtshan bcas dang mtshan med kyi rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu 'bad nas rab tshe 'di nyid la bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa dang / 'bring bar dor mchog 'grub pa/ tha ma'ang lam sna zin tsam zhig yong thabs la 'bad dgos pa ni spyir dal 'byor thob pa dang /sgos ri khrod 'grims pa'i dgos don lags pas thams cad kyis 'bad 'bungs bya bar rigs so/ bdag cag gi ston pa thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa de nyid kyis myos 'gyur gye btung ba ni srog gi phyir yang ma gnang zhing / de'i dgongs pa 'brel bar byed pa'i 'phags bod kyi shing rta chen po rnams kyis kyang nyes pa tham sa cad kyi skor gsung la/ des ma zad dgra bcom pa legs 'ong gi gling gzhi dang / 'phags pa dbyegs gnyen gyi lo rgyus/ bum pa can gyi skyes rabs rnams kyi kyang nyes pa thams cad kyi rtsa bar rtogs pas na grwa rigs che 'breng chung gsum/ bla brang gi lho zan sku drag nang ma las tshan pa rtse drung dkyus ma/ brang mchod khag sogs ser mo ba'i — 281 —

rigs su gtogs pa thams cad kyi dgon pa'i phyi nang / sde grong / rdzong gzhis/ gzhis dgon so so'i yul/ phar 'gro tshur yong gi lam bar/gling ma/ chu gzhung / tsha chu/ grang chu'i sa sogs dus gnas gang du yang myos 'gyur gyi btung ba thig gcig yan la longs spyad mi chog cing / 'di kha dang slob dpon rnam pa bzhi/ chos khrims khang ja rgyab pa bcas thun mong nas rgyab sgo so sor sgug ra zhib 'jug thus nan rgyun 'khyongs thog rta bzhon rkang thang mtho dma' bar gsum thams cad la ha rgyugs len rgyu sogs 'dra mnyam gyi de thog nas myos 'gyur gyi btung ba thig gcig yan ji ltar rigs la longs spyad pa thon tshe de 'phral zhib gcod dang 'brel ba'i nyo tshong byed mi gang yin la za 'dod tsam ma yin pa'i lus steng rang du nyes pa rnag thog gtsag 'khel gtong rgyu/ yang de rigs lan gsum byas pa shar tshe rtsa ra gnad smin btang ste grwa sa gnas dbyung dang / lto zan yin la lus steng du rtsa 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung byed/ rgyud grwa'i gras nas chang btung rigs byung tshe de 'phral grwa tshang nas dbyung rgyu/ de snga rgyud grwa nas gnas dbyung bgyis rigs tshogs chen gras su sdod lam 'dug kyang phyin chad rgyud grwa nas dbyung ba dang / grwa sa gnas dbyung byed ba chabs cig byed/bla brang lto zan dang grwa rigs che 'breng chung gsum bcas ser mo ba gang yin smod med nges drung 'khor drag zhan dang gnyer tshang pa sogs skya bo'i rigs kyis kyang dgon pa'i nang du chang 'thung len mi byed/ nang mchod dang gser skyems/ tshe chang sogs yin nges rnams kyang dkar bum/ shel bum sogs chos khrims khang rang gi dam 'byar nang du len pa las tham ga med pa'i sgod dang rdza dam sogs kyi nang du len pa med cing / ar zug sogs kyi 282 ——

skabs su yang las byed gla mi skya bo sha stag yin kyang chang gtan nas mi len/tshogs chen/ dbu mdzad dang / sgrol ma dbu mdzad sogs kyi wa seng zhes khag dkri byed 'dug pa 'di dang / dgos pa med pa'i 'khur chang bcas phyin chad bkag pa yin pas mi len/ bla brang dang dge skos pa sogs spos rgyag pa'i rigs kyis spos chang la'ang gling 'gab tu tsan dan nam gu gul gyi phye ma chang ban re la bre gang tsam re non par btab te dkrugs nas dgon nang du len/ spos brdungs shug las/ spyi pa/ grwa tshang so so'i las mi rgan po rgan g.yog sde pa bcas nas las kar la/ ga dkris kyi chang la dgongs zhu byed pa dang / 'ga' zhig gzugs gcong la snyad pa'i dbo/ngas zhu byed pa sogs yod 'dug pa 'di dag bltas ngan 'a/ rang gsang med par byur la ngo so yin pas che 'breng gsum sus kyang chang la dgongs pa zhu ster/ nyo tshong 'thung len gtan nas byas mi chog gzhan yang sku drag nang ma/ las tshan pa/rtse drung / brang mchod grwa rigs mchog dman thams cad kyi phyogs zhol dus gnas gang sar mda' dang / me mda'i rtsed 'jo/ lha mo sogs rtse ba/ rkang bro glu gzhas/ dus gnas kun tu sho sbag 'grig dang mig mang /sha rta ra sogs yul lugs gzhan gyi rtsed mo dang bad mchongs 'dzin kha skye ba sogs lus rtsal ngoms pa/ rdo skor 'phen pa/ sgra snyan/ gling bu/ da'i ching / yang ching sogs sgyur gtong mi byed/ skya bo'i rigs kyis kyang dgon pa'i mtho khongs su bgyis mi chog 'di dag gi mjug gnon chos khrims khang rang nas mdzad de dung mtsho sogs gling kha dang / gzhan yang phyogs zhol gang sar nyang gnon gyis rtsing spyod kyi bya ba de rigs byed mi su byung la 'phral 'phral bka' bkod mig lar 'doms nges gnang dgos/——— 283 ———

ba///'am/ ya nga dgon nang du khos/sa ma'i nang du sgob/ ris/sa 'debs skyong byeng/ pa dang // dung mtsho so /gas su dbya/da dus/ sman chur /ba// tsa/ nga/kris/ kyis bab/ ma ngas su bskyod de khyim pa sun 'byin du 'gro ba'i las dbye ba dang / ba/nas skabs kum tu gri 'don/ rgya 'gre// bstes/ res dang // 'dzim/ kha bkye ba//rbor /la dang / tha mi kha /'thung 'then byed nga so/gas// shar tshe dge no sa chen go na nga/ nga7//krā bkod snyes 'gel yo/nad smin dang / bo/nga gsal de rib/sa lto zan mtho da/man su thab/ na/sa byas pa byung yang 'bi/ bar 'phra' 'phral rgyu mtshan byu nga bsnyu/ phyi ra ‘shā /5/ /bes/sa pa'i snyes nga gtong nges yim/// ga‘nam lang dgon na/nga du ba/ tshal 'a/nga ping co/gas ho tshong byed nga/ med cing / gra'/ phun pa / dang rā/ la so/sa//ru / su a /lce lha mo dbo 1/ dmas sbyo ngas so sa//sa kye gzis//sa mor bskyod pa dang / cha༈ra zus/ sogs sob/sa kyi ska bas glu dang btsas skad byed pa 'ang dbo/na nga 'i mig 'a/ma/ la ba//nod pas phyin chad de rigs mi 0byung ba'i 'bo/ 'doms chos/ khrems la/ nga rang nas mdzad dgo//sa/ dgre/ skos chen mo nas chos/ thog/ yin/ la ma lhos par spyor sbyangs sprar 'u sa/sa ba'in dang / gsang rgyug sogs thabs gang mkhas kyi sgo nas g.yul skyor sbyangs mdzad mi/ rnams nas kyang g.yul min la ma lhos par rang don rang gces rgyun 'khyongs thog de yang chos spyod tsam min par bsdus grwa sogs so so'i sgrig grwa'i mtshan nyid blo 'dzin byas rigs rnams ga bor 'don dang / sman gzhung sogs rig gnas kyi gzhung la skyor sbyangs byed mi byung rigs la'ang dgag bya byed pa chos spong gi las tshabs po che yin pas bskyed thon yo/nga thabs kyi lcag bskul cho 'drar byed grwa rigs rtsa ba bzhi dang 'gal ba smos med thog dgon gnas 'di rang gi phyag srol la srog gcod pa la phyi phu dang / phug non yan/ ma byen len pa ——— 284 ——

dngul zho gang dang de ri ba'i dpya dbos yan/ dmag khrag/ thon pa'i bsteg res byas/ pa myos 'gyur gyi btung ba la lan gsu ma du longs spyo da pa/ sngags pas myos 'gyur btungs pa sos/sa 'di'i mgo ra/jug tu ga/sal ba'i grwa gnas dbyung dmigs bas/la dgo/sa rigs rnams dang / gzham/ ya/nga 'di kha grwa tshang bzhi/ chos khri/ /rnga /sa khang sogs khri/ mas sar snang chung brtsi med kyi khyad sod byed/ pa dang / sgre/ga/ lam stos med/ tshabs che byas rigs gnas dbyung byed pa las/ rang sa//'a/na dga' min/ byo gas ldungs la brten don chang chung la snyad de gnas dbyung byed rgyu dge 'dun rnams thugs mi phebs pa'i rgyu dang /grwa tshogs che ba'i bar chad du 'dug pas mi byeng// sa/la sri/da sa/na/da dbyung dgos rigs rnams kyang 'di kha dang chos khrims khang bcas par rgyu mtshan ma byung bar la sa khungs gzhan dag nas rang mtshams sgo rgyab thag sa/cod byed pa 'di lugs 'gal tshabs che yim/ 'dug nga sa phyin chad bgyis na mi 'thus/grwa sa grwa tshang sogs la phan nges dmig/sa bsal 'di nas bso/da nga/ byung na las/de min grwa sa 'di nas dbyung rigs lto zan dang / khongs gtogs/dgon khag ri khrod byengs kyi skyed sdug la'ang gtan nas bcug mi chogaphyis su mi thams cad bag yangs la dga' bas grwa sa dgongs zhu byed mi mang tsam byung ba da bar dgongs zhu byed mi so so'i 'dod pa dang bstun dgos pa rim gtong byas pa yin kyang grwa tshang la gnod 'gal che zhing / mig ltos la'ang gnod par 'dug pas phyin chad rang la grwa sar sdod mi zhan pas rkyen yod nges yin na rgyu mtshan bar dpang dang bcas byung bstun grwa pa dgongs pa zhu srol yong rgyu las sdod ma 'dod pa'i dbang gi spyon med skyon can gyi gras su zhugs nas bar dpang sogs khungs skyel ra sprod gang yang med pa dgongs zhu — 285 —

byed rgyu 'di phyin chad sus kyang mi byed/ bar skabs dge skos chen mo rnams la thugs khag ci la srid kyang chos khrims pa sogs kyis 'phrul la rten khrom dgon zhol gang sar za bed kyis skya ser thams cad la brdabs bsigs ci che byung 'dug pa 'di mur lus tshe khyim pa sun 'byin cing / dge 'dun rnams kyang thugs khrel rgyu las ma 'das pas phyin/ chad khrims kyi khroms gnon ngo das/'a phyogs lhungs med par rgyal po sgrig bcad kyi dge rgyun spur nas 'bab bzhin/ khro/ ma khral gang yin bsdu len dang / byed/ 'dzol byung rigs la'ang tshabs che chung dang bsnyun pa'i slad la 'doms ched khrims gtam rtsa ra sogs dbos rigs skabs sbyar/ phral mis tshon nyam thag 'khral zas 'tshol bsgrub kyi ched mar dkros/ bya sgong / 'jag ma/ bsangs/ bul/ spra ba/me rdo sogs phra cho/'i rigs la gnang ba zhus gnang gis tshong khral sogs sa/tan nas mi ba'i/sa par nyam zag la byams skyong sogs lugs zung gi khrims srol tshangs pa'i thig ba'i/na srong ba las/ ngo dga' phyogs skyor rgyu mtshan phran bu la snyad nas dngos po gtsang len/ bab med kyi nyes 'gel/ brdung brdeg/rnam dbye ma phye ba'i bsgyur gtam sogs ltogs sla za snyad kyi rigs gtan nas mi mdzad/ tshong khral dang nang tshong gi skor zhib cha rje btsun blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis bstsal ba'i bcad mtshams thugs dam dung dam 'byar ba lcags lug gi gan rgya/ yang lcags lug dge skos chen mo dang bzhad tshong pa spyi la bstsal ba'i bcad mtshams dung tham 'byar ba chu spre chos khrims pa dang /gzhi/sa zhol gnas khag tshong pa spyi la bstsal ba'i bcad mtshams/ yang khrom tshong dang sha tshong skor la bstsal ba'i bsnyel tho/ tsha la'i tshong khral skor la chu 'brug bstsal ba'i thugs dam/ yang de'i gsham gsal thugs dam rnams ——— 286 ——

dbang ma 'byar ba/ grub mchog stobs ldan dpal bos 'dus sder nyun gzhi'i skor la shog dril gnyis bstsal ba'i dgongs don ltar tshang mas spangs blangs tshu' ba'i na mdzad rgyu'i bca' sgrig chu 'brug hor zla 2tshes 12la mdzad pa rnams kyi dgongs don gzhir bzhag nyams len mdzad pa las 'phar ma'i brdabs gsigs bzod ma bder 'gro rigs gtan nas mi mdzad/gsan yang dbo/na zhol gyi khongs su don phran bur snyad de skya ser gang sar za 'dod la brten pa'i bsnyad gtser gtan nas mi mdzad/ chos khrims pa rnams la'ang byas mi chog pa'i ma so/ 'og lus chug gi da se/ slo/sa chen mo rang nas bka' bkod mthil phyin mdzad dgos/ dge 'dun byings la thugs khag ga la srid kyang dge skos pa 'khyur mtshams dang 'phyur zin bcas la dbang shed mtho 'tshams spud rgyag sogs dang / bar skabs 'byung pos rgyud bskul 'ga' zhig nas dge slo/sa pa 'khyur mtshams tshogs dbus nas rdo 'phen pa/'khur chung bsnyen bkur 'bul sar chos khrims pa la khyad sod dma' 'bes byed pa sogs lus/sa gnyis kyi khrims la ji mi snyam pa'i spyod ngan sna tshogs byas 'dug pa phyin chad de rigs gleng ngan til shun gyi cha tsam thon pa shar tshe lo zla zhag grangs la ma ltos par rtsad gcod mthar phyin byas rjes byed gte rgyab byed mi dang bcas pa la lus srog gi steng du nyes pa phyis lam khegs pa gtong rgyu yin/ 'di kha slob dpon rnam pa bzhi/ dge skos chen mo/ ja rgyab pa bcas nas drang 'brel bkod pa bshad rigs la snyom chung 'gro lugs dang mthun pa'i ngo chen byed pa mtha' ma bkag pas/de min mtho dma' su thad nas kyang dbang chen rti/ nga tu bcug ngo chen khar 'khur ba'i gnang dka' bar 'gyur rigs gtan nas mi byed/ gal srid byas pa shar tshe ri bsgul mtsho — 287 —

'khyoms byed po dang sgron brgyud pa chabs cis/ tu dbyung / slob dpon rin po che rnams nas kyang bsdus grwa nas ming btags kyi bar sgrigs lam dpe thog nas gtong rgyu dang ma 'gal ba'i sgri/ga dar phyi mdzod dkar gtsang re 'bul bzhes las de lhag kha btags che chung dang rten sogs gleng tsam med pa mdzad dgos/ grwa rigs bgres ga thon bar gsum su thad nas kyang so so'i dad 'bul byed pa mtha' ma bkag pa'i sgrig dang ming btags zhu rten la skyabs 'jug tu ming btags pa 'di gtan nas mi 'bul/ de mtshungs 'di kha bla brang dang chos khrims khang ja rgyab pa'i sar bcas gang sar so so'i don dag zhu rten la skyabs 'jug tu ming btags pa yar dkon mchog la mchod pa'i mchod pa dang / mar ngan slong la spyin pa'i sbyin pa gang du'ang mi 'gyur ba ngon med kyi grwa rkyang khag sun dang / sgres/ khrims rim gzhig gi rgyur 'gro ba 'di rigs gtan nas mi byed/ gzhan yang grwa tshang slob dpon rnams so so'i chos grwar chag med phebs te 'dzin chos rtsa' rgyu dang / slob gnyer lcag bskul bgro gleng dri ba sogs mdzad dgos rnams g.yar khral tsam ma yin par dpyis phyin par mdzad dgos/ der ma zad grwa tshang so so'i sgrol 'don khag dang / tshogs chen gyi rlon tshogs rnams la'ang thugs brel med skabs phebs thub na legs tshogs shin tu che thing / kha sngon slob dpon rin po che rnams la sku rim la phebs min dri ba zhus par thos bsam gling slob dpon rin po che nas zur bzhi rgyun gtan sku rim la phebs srol ped tshul phebs byung yang / rgyun gtan thugs brel med skabs phebs lam yod ces bdag cag gis yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid kyi gsungs las thos shing / der ma zad slob dpon gsar pa khri 'don skabs dang bstan 'bar ma rnams la phebs —— 288 ———

rgyun 'dug pa 'dis kyang ris nga/sa 'grub cing / ngos cas/ gi dran lam du'ang zur bzhi sbu rim/ la phebs nas bsngo yig mo/ da skabs gsung bsngo tsa/nang ba'ang bsal bar dran pa bcas/ phebs lam yo/da nges yin/ 'dug nga/ru4/ /phyin chad thugs brel so/sa/sa cher med skabs nges nga/ra phebs/ thub ba ra/dzad dgos/ lo dri/ bar/ dge/ ba mtha' dag yang da/ga/ sa//so byed cing / sdig nga ma/tha' dag yang das 'dir spyong ba/ dge/ ba sa/so phyir dang sdig pa rtsa/mas/ sbyong phyir/ de bzhin gshe4/sa pa'i gso sbyong zhe/ sa bya 'o/ zhes/ dge/ ba bso 'ing sdig pa sbyong bas na bse sbyong zhes bya la / de mang dus/ sa/nga gi tshe bya na zla ba phyed phyed kyi tshes/ bsngo phru 'a1'o zhes bya ba smras/ te1 bce rngu1 pa zu/sa pas bcu bzhi pa yang bstem/ pa yim/ te tshes gcis/ nas bco lnga'i bar gyi blu ma gang yang rung ba las nyi ma tsa///cis/ chad pas spyir zhas/ bcu ba'i yod pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten kyi dbang du byas/ rte bcom ldan 'das kyi kyang so/ sor thar pa'i ma/do las gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa zhe4she gsungs par zad kyi dngos su na zla ba'i ngo de'i tshes grangs ga/nga la bha ma sa//cis chad/ pa de nyid la stongs su dor bar zad kyi/gso sbyong gi nyi ma la nyi ma chag pa ma yin pas gso spyong bcu ba'i pa zhes bya ba'i nyi ma de nyid tshes bco lnga pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ rnam pa gang gi gso spyong zhes bya ba de'i phyir so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pas gso spyong zhes bya ba smras te sems drang po sgrub pa la sogs pa dang / 'gal ba zlog pa la sogs pa'i rnam pa gzhan gyis kyang tshul khrims gso bar byed pa yod pas de dag gsal ba'i phyir so sor thar pa'i mdo 'don pas so zhes 'dul ba rgya cher 'grel las gsungs pa ltar/ tshes 'ag gi gso spyong bco lnga pa 'ba' jig yin kyang /nyin 'ag gi dbang gi lo gcig la bcu bzhi pa drug dang bco lnga pa bco brgyad —— 289 —

'byung bas/ ji skad du yang mdzod 'grel las/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi/ /zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'das/ shing / /lhag ma phyed ni lus pas na/ /mkhas pas 'a/ga mi thub pa dor/ /zhes gsungs pa dang / gzhan yang lo dri bar/ rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga bcas/ /chu stod khrum smad smin drug bar/ /'di rnams kyis ni nag po'i phyogs/ /zla phyed gso spyong bcu ba'i/ pa/ /zhes zla ba de rnams kyi mar ngo'i gso spyong bcu bzhi pa/ yar ngo gang yin dang / gong du smos pa'i zla ba de dag ma yin pa'i gzhan rnams kyi mar ngo'i gso spyong rnams bco lnga pa te bsdoms pas lo gcig la gso sbyong nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'byung ba dus rung gi gso spyong dang / gzhan yang karma shar las bkra shis pa'i gso spyong dang / gnod pa bzlog pa'i gso spyong / bsdums pa'i gso sbyong / dag ni gang gi tshe bya dgos pa de'i tshe bya bar zad kyi dus nges pa ni med do/ zhes bkris gnod bzlog bsdus pa'i gso sbyong rnams gang dgos pa'i dus su bya ba las/ dus nges pa med kyang 'di kha'i phyag srol du tshes dgu dang / bcu drug nyi shu lnga rnams la char can du mdzad lam dang /gzhan yang bstan srid kyi sger gyi sku rim 'phar ma'i gso spyong bcas gang sar nad pa dang / mtshams pa yin nges ma gtogs grwa rigs mchog dman/ bla brang lto zan che 'breng chung gsum bcas ser mo ba gang yin pham par gyur pa'i chos bzhi la 'gal 'das med pa thams cad phebs dgos/ yang 'gal 'das yod bzhin du dge 'dun gyi las la 'du ba 'bras bu brnag par dka' ba 'byen nges pa'i las yin pas 'di khar so so'i dge skyon yod rigs mi 'cham par drang 'brel rgyu mtshan mol te gso sbyong sogs dge 'dun gyi las la mi 'du/ yang dge skyon yod bzhin du dge 'dun gyi sde la ji mi snyam par — 290 ——

yong rigs shar tshe de thog 'di kha nas phyis lam khegs pa'i nyes pa brnag par dka' ba gtong nges ma zad/ chos srung ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams dus gnas kun tu rang cag gi spyod pa la sgrib med du gzigs pas ring por mi thog par bka'i chad pa drag po myong bar 'gyur ba gdon mi za zhi/nga / las kyi rnam par sbon pa ni dus nam yang chud mi za bas tshe rabs du mar ngan song nas ngan song mu mtha' med par brgyud dgos pa dang / de las nam thar ba'i tshe na yang myong ba rgyu mthun byed pa rgyu mthun bdag po'i 'bras bu rnams shin tu bzod dka' ba nyams su myong dgos pa'i tshul sogs 'phral rgyang phugs gsum gyi khe nyen tshang mas thugs la bzhag ste bag yod rgyun mar mdzad dgos/ nad pa dang mtshams pa yin nges rnams la tshogs chen dbu mdzad gnyis dang / 'du khang sbu gnyer bcas nas 'dun pa dang yongs dag cig car du len rgyu dang / tshogs su 'bul rgyu rnams gcig kung chad med thog 'dun pa blangs nas 'ag sdod sogs 'dul ba dang 'gal ba'i rigs mi byed dge slong rnams nas dge slong dang / sdom pa gong ma gnyis kyi phyir bcos/dge tshul rnams nas kyang phyir bcos/ spyi bshags/ gtor ma cha bzhi/lhag par snyeng po rnams bgres pa rnams kyis rang don rang gces dang /gzhon pa rnams la dge rgan so sos lcag bskul gyis rgyugs sprod len 'pher ba 'dzin 'jug blo 'dzin byas pa tsam gyis mi chog par gso spyong so so'i skabs khral mngon tsam ma yin par 'don dgos/ khyad par dge tshul gī gso spyong dngos snyeng po 'di yin pas snying po ma phul bar 'gro rgyu 'di bgres gzhon mtho dma' sus kyang mi byed/ dge slong rnams nas kyang dus gcig la dge tshul gsum las lhag pa'i snyeng po mi len/ snyeng po'i nang gi gso spyong —— 291 ——

bcu bzhi pa/ bco khri pa/ gnod bzlog dbyen bzlums/ bkra shis zhes dus kyi tshig spo dgos pa rnams dang rang ming 'jug dgos pa sogs rang gis shes pa dang mi shes pa gzhan la 'dri ba/ dge rgan nas slob pa sogs tshul bzhin rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyu/ dge slong gi gso spyong dngos so sor thar pa'i mdo nyan pa yin gshis dge slong bgres gzhon tshang ma so sor thar pa'i mdo mi thos sar mi bzhugs/ dge tshul gyi gso spyong skabs khyim pa pho mo sbos med thog dge slong gso spyong gi skabs dge tshul rigs kyang bltar mi bzhugs pa'i bsrung bsdoms dang / gso spyong byed mi yin na ma gtogs phyogs tha'i grwa rigs yin pa bltar mi gzhugs pa'i bsrung bsdoms khyim pa ltar byed/ gso sbyong la 'byon mi rnams kyang chos gos rnam gsum tshad ldan las yod bzhin du rnam rten gyon pa sogs mi byed/ dus rung gi gso spyong rnams nyi zla la sgra gzan 'jug pa'i mtshan ma dang bsnyun sang gi skya rengs ma shar gong la bskyar rgyu sogs legs bar gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos 'dul ba las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin mkhan slob thams cad kyis gtsod 'don rgyun 'khyongs mdzad rgyu// nad pa dang mtshams pa'i rigs 'dun pa phul ba dang rtsa bzhi sogs la dge spyon yod rigs phud/ de byengs gso spyong la ma 'dus pa'i rigs la da bar grwa sa dbyung lam shar dod yin kyang / 'ga' zhig grwa sar sdod ma 'dod pas ched du sdod pa sogs grwa tshogs la gnod 'gal che bar 'dug pas/ phyin chad grwa pa gnas dbyung byed rgyu phyis 'then thog gso spyong la ma 'dus pa'i rigs la 'ib dpyod mthil phyin gyis sdod mi ngo bo dang spyi khang steng shod par gsum du sdod mi shag mtshes pa bcas la skabs bstun gyi nyes pa gcod nges yin/ de yang snga ja'i gso spyong 'di bzhin gnyis la — 292 —

brten pa'i rjes lus 'byung nyen che ba dang / nyin mo yang tshes grangs nges min la brten zhol sogs la bskyod nas gso spyong thog 'byor min gyis lus nyen che ba bcas lte ba dge skos chen mos tshogs brda phul bas mi thus pa med 'dug kyang gal po che la yang skyor gyis dpe bzhin phyin chad snga ja'i gso spyong la spyi khang so so'i steng shod bar gsum la rgyun tan sdod min la ma ltos par shag mtshes pa so so'i sgo du yod la gso sbyong ran pa'i brda sbyar te gnyis sod rgyud nan tan bya dgos dang / gso spyong nyin mo yin na tsha rting ma gyes gdong spyi khang so sor sdod mi'i rgan 'go gang yin gyis dgong jar gso sbyong yin lugs spyi khang der sdod gang yin la go nges brdu sprod dgos rgyu/ yang nyi zla'i mtshan ma dang bsnyun glo bur du gso sbyong bskyar dgos skabs chos khrims pa rnams kyis spyi khang thams cad la brdu 'phros nges pa byed/ de thog nas le thogs shar tshe lus mi ngo bo shag mtshes pa/ rgan 'go/ chos pa bcas le 'phri gang yin la skabs sbyar bkod pa mig lar 'doms nges bgyid rgyur de lugs bag zon rgyun 'khyongs dgos rgyu/ kun skyobs gling du yod pa'i mgon khang pa rnams nas kyang dus rung yin min la ma ltos pa'i 'di khar gso spyong gang yod skabs gso spyong mdzad dgos ma zad/ 'di kha'i grwa gras de khar yod rigs rnams krung de gar chabs cig gso sbyong mdzad dgos/ snga ja'i gso spyong la phan tshun gnyid so rgyu dang / nyin mo dang nyi zla'i mtshan mas glo bur gso spyong mdzad dgos rigs la mgon khang pa'i sgrig grwa'i khongs yin min la ma ltos par brda sbyor byed rgyu bcas gnyer pa sogs nas le thogs med par nan tan byed dgos/ yang de dag la le thogs rigs shar tshe lus mi ngo bo/ shag mtshes pa/ gnyer pa sogs le 'phri gang yo/da la skabs sbyar ——— 293 —

nyes pa dgon pa dang dpe 'gre byed/ nad pa dang / mtshams pa'i rigs la 'dun pa dang yongs dag gcig car du len pa dang / tshogs su 'bul ba bcas 'du khang sku gnyer nas 'di khar gang byed ltar chad med tshul bzhin bgyid dgos/ yang 'ga' zhig nas gso spyong la snam sbyar mi gyon pa sogs 'gal tshab yod 'dug pa phyin chad de rigs mi 'byung ba'i bkod pa dbu mdzad sogs nas nan tan byed dgos/ phyogs bskyod sogs kyi skabs su'ang dge slong grangs tshang na mdo thon pa zhig gis mdo ston te dge slong gso spyong chad med byed rgyu dang / dge tshul yod na snying po len pa sogs 'di gar gang mdzad ltar byed/ grangs ma tshang na gso sbyong byen rlabs byed rgyu sogs 'dul ba 'dzin pa chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis gzhi gsum gyi cho gar ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin spangs blangs rgyun mar mdzad dgos/ thos bsam dang / sgrub pa 'phel ba dang / rang gzhan gyi lus srog la gnod pa spang ba/ gnas ral ba dang / grum pa 'chos pa/ mu stegs pa dag kha zer ba spang ba/ don mang ba dang bya ba mang ba spang ba/ ston pa'i bcas pa mthun pa sogs dgos pa du ma'i slad dbyar gnas par khas blangs dgos te de ltar yang dbyar gnas par khas blangs par bya'o/ zla ba gsum du 'o/tshes basbe drug la'o/ dbyar zla 'bring po nya'i phyi de nyin par gyi'o/ dbyar zla tha chung nya'i 'o zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dbyar khas blang ba la snga ma dang / phyi ma gnyis las/ 'dir phyag len du spra ma nyid zhal gyis bzhes pas dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya'i gso sbyong gi nyin gnas mal stobs pa bskor ba dang /khrims kyi bya ba brjod pa dang / gsol ba'i las bya ba dang / grangs bzungs ba'i phyir tshul shing brims pa/ de blang ba/ bsdus nas grangs —— 294 — —

bzungs te dge 'dun la brjod pa/ gtsug lag khang dang gnas mal stobs pa sogs 'dul ba las ji ltar bshad pa bzhin thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang pos phyag len du 'debs par mdzad pa da lta'i bar du ma nyams par gnas bzhin pa 'di nyid mgyogs khyad sla bcos sogs kyi dbang du ma song bar gso spyong gi skabs bzhin zhib tshags gang thon dang khyad par lnga lo nas bzungs tshul shing gi grangs dngos gnas bgrangs te ji yod dge 'dun gyi dbus su brjod rgyu'i srol gtod pa 'di yang nyams med rgyun 'khyongs yong ba mdzad dgos/ khyad par dngos gzhi khas blang rgyu'i tsha ga ni ji tsam snga ba de tsam du phan yon che bar gsungs pas bcu drug gi tho rengs gi cha zin ma thag gaṇ+ḍi'i brdas bskul nas dge 'dun thams cad 'du khang du 'dus te dge slong re re'i drung du gsum man chad 'khod nas dbyar khas blangs srugs tshig lan gsum brjod pa phyag len sla bcos su ma song ba mdzad dgos rgyu dang / 'du khang du phebs ma thub pa rnams kyang gaṇ+ḍi'i brda byung ba nas gtsug lag khang gi yang thog gi rgya phub kyi gañji ra'i tog la nyi ma shar gyi bar gang yang rung ba la mkhan slob dbyar bdag pa gang rigs kyi drung du phebs te zhal bzhes mdzad dgos bcas don lta gon la phebs pa tsam gyi mi chog mkhas blangs pa'i sngags tshig lan gsum gyi bar tshul bzhin brjod pa zhig dgos pas de don tshang mas thugs la 'jags dgos/ kun gling du yod pa'i mgon khang pa rnams dang / lho zan dang 'di kha'i sgrig grwa'i khongs nas de khar gtan sdod byed mi du yod nas dbyar gnas kyi lta gon dang /dbyar dngos gzhi khas blangs pa'i cho ga bcas 'di khar ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin mgyogs khyad sla bcos khral mngon du ma song bar phyag len rnam par — 295 —

dag pa tshul bzhin dgos rgyu dang / 'di dag la 'gal tshabs yod med 'di nas nyang gnon rtsad gcod kyi 'gal rigs la bkod pa skabs sbyar phyis lam kheg pa gtong rgyu yin/ dbyar gyi nang du klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan la brtson pa dang / gzhan yang gnas ma stobs pa po rnams nas ji ltar bsgos pa ltar gyi khrems su bcad pa rnams las 'da' mi rung zhing / khyad par spyod yul gyi grong las brgal te 'gror mi rung bas phyin chad dbyar gnas ma grol ring la gling kha chu gzhung sogs dgon pa'i tho khongs las brgal bar phebs bzhugs mi mdzad/ gal srid dge 'dun gyi don dang gang zag gi chos ldan gyi bya ba'i ched la phebs dgos rigs shar tshe zhag gcig nas bdun gyi bar la mkhan slob dbyar bdag pa gang rigs kyi drung du byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags tshig lan gsum brjod nas mtshams kyi phyi nol du phebs bzhugs mdzad chog cing / zhag brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar la byen gyis brlabs pa tsam gyes mi chog par dge 'dun gyi ched la yin na dge 'dun gyi dbus su spro ba 'dri ba dang / gang zag gi chos ldan gye bya ba'i ched la gsol ba gdabs dgos shing / gnyis ka la las byed pa'i dge slong gis gsol gnyis kyi las byas te de'i rjes su mkhan slob dbyar bdag pa gang rigs kyi drung du zhag brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar ji ltar dgos pa'i byen gyis brlabs te mtshams kyi phyi rol du phebs bzhugs mdzad dgos pa bdag cag gi ston pa'i bka' dri ma ped pa 'phags yul gyi gnas brtan chen po yon shāka gnyis la sogs pa'i legs par bkral zhing / gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen po 'dul ba 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug gi nor bu grags pa rgyan mtshan dpal bzang po nges par — — 296 —

thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa yab sras kyi bzhed pa bzhin kho bos srol gtod/ 'di lo dar rgyas su bgyis te srol bzang po legs par btsugs pa 'di nyid ji srid mkha' la nyi zla'i bgrod pa ma chad kyi bar du byon dang 'byon 'gyur gī mkhan slob grwa bcas thams cad kyis mi nyams shing /yun du gnas pa'i thabs tshul la 'bad 'tshal/ yang gal srid byen rlabs ma byas par mtshams nang las brgal te 'gro ba dang / zhag brgyad phan chad la mgyogs khyad sla bcos kyis dge 'dun gyi dbus su gnang ba ma nod par byin rlabs tsam gyis chog par byas te 'gro ba sogs yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' la'ang tshad mar mi 'dzin pa'i byed mdzol de rigs lto zan grwa rigs gang sa nas thon pa shar kyang ljongs rgyu ma zin bar gyi skor skal gcod rgyus mtshon mig lar phan pa'i rtsa 'dzin kha tsam min pa gtong nges yin pas de lugs tshang mas dran shes rgyun 'khyongs su bsten dgos/ kun gling du rgyun bzhugs mdzad pa'i mgon khang pa lho zan/ 'di kha'i sgrig grwa'i khongs bcas dbyar khas len mdzad pa gang yin gyis dbyar gyi nang du khrims su bca' ba rnams tshul bzhin bsrung ba dang / klog ya thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan la gang ba bon thog khyad par dgon pa sogs spyod yul gyi grong las brgal bar 'byon bzhud gtan nas mi mdzad/ gal srid dge 'dun gyi don dang gang zag gi chos ldan gyi bya ba'i ched la 'byon dgos shar yang 'ag gcig nas bdun gyi bad la dbyar bdag pa'i drung du dbyar gyi byin rlabs/ brgyad nas bzhi bcu'i bar la dge 'dun la tshogs kyi dbus su gnang ba nod de byin gyis brlabs na 'byon rgyu bcas mdor na 'di khar ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin phyug med rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyu dang / de dag 297 —

la'ang 'gal 'das byung rigs la skabs sbyar nyes pa dgon pa dang phyogs mtshungs byed/ dbyar khas blangs pa'i 'bras bu dgag dbye ni nges par bya dgos te/ gzhan du dbyar khas blangs nas byin gyis brlabs te 'dir dgag dbye'i nyin sar glo bur du lhags pa'i dge slong gis kyang dgag dbye bya dgos shing / dbyar ral ba dag gi dgag dbye bya dgos te/ dgra bcom pa sa ka lhas/ /sdig pa sman gyi gso spyong gi/ / dgag dbye byas nas yang mi bya/ /gso sbyong dag par bya phyir te/ /dga' phye yang ni de nyid yin/ /zhes de'i nyin sar gso sbyong bya dgos la/ dgag dbye las gzhan pa'i gso spyong mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ dus kyang dbyar snga khas blangs na dbyug pa zla ba'i tshes bco lnga la dgag dbye bya dgos la/ dbyar zla ba gsum du gnas ba'i mthun rkyen ma tshang ba'am 'gal rkyen nye bar gnas pa na dgag dbye byen gyis brlabs nas/ gnas gzhan du 'gro ba'i zla ba gcig gam phyed dang gnyis 'das pa na dgag dbye byar rung bar bshad pas rang cag rnams snga dus bsod snyoms la byon dgos gshis zla ba phyed dang gnyis nas dgag dbye glo bur ba mdzad de phebs dgos pa/ phyis gdan rabs gong ma rnams kyi bkrin las phogs sogs mthun rkyen lhun gyis grub pas bsod snyoms sogs la brten ma dgos kyang dgag dbye glo bur ba mdzad rgyu sngar gyi srol rgyun la gnas pas go sla ba'i phyir hor zla dang bstun na hor zla 7stong la dgag dbye mdzad pa phyag len du 'dug cing / dgag dbye'i rtswa zor pa lngar dge 'dun rang gis 'thog lam 'dug kyang / dgag dbye ma grub gong du song gshis cung zad 'brel chags min yong lugs sngags chen zhal snga nas 'beb pa bzhin 'di nas gnyer tshang la bkod khyab kyi 'thog 'bul zhu rgyu dang / stong la 298 — —

gi nyin ltung ba phyir bcos sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i dgag dbye stobs pa bsko ba dang / khyad par ltung ba da/nga rdzas kyi dgag dbye bya ba sogs thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub kyi dus phyag len du ji ltar btab pa da lta yang ma nyams par ga/nas bzhin pa 'di nyid mkhan slob grwa bcas thams cad kyis sla bcos su ma song bar na/na tan mdzad dgos ma zad/ 'di'i nyin gyi gso spyong yang dgag dbye'i sngar tshig brjod pa nyid yin pas bgres gzhon tshang mas dge slong re re'i mdun du gsum man chad 'dug ste rtswa zor pa bsgol ba bzungs nas dgag dbye'i sngags tshig lan gsum du zla ba thams cad kyis chad med sla bcos su ma song bar mdzad pa las sngags tshig ma brjod par log 'gro ba sogs gtan nas mi byed/ lnga lo nas bzungs rtswa zor pa bsdus te grangs ji long dge 'dun gyi dbus su brjod rgyu'ang nyams med rgyun 'khyongs su mdzad dgos/ de nas gnas la zhen pa spong ba'i phyir ljongs rgyu ba la yang nad pa dang mtshams pa mi khom nges can rnams 'di khar rgyu mtshan byung bstun phud/ de byings dge tshul slong thams cad so so'i rang chas kyis phebs te rgyud phyag gsum pa 'don pa sogs byes dang / sa gnas kyi zhal 'don rnams tshul bzhin mdzad dgos/ nad pa dang / mtshams pa mi khom pa sogs min bzhin du ma phebs pa'i rigs la skabs sbyar nyes pa'i bab bkod byed rgyu/ grwa tshang gi grwa pa/ lto zan/ 'di kha'i sgrig grwa rigs bcas kun gling du dbyar khas len byas pa gang yin thams cad nas dgag dbye dang /ljongs rgyu mdzad rgyu yang 'di khar 'dul ba'i dgos pa bzhin ji ltar mdzad pa ltar phyug med 'jos bder ma song ba tshul bzhin mdzad dgos dang / yang dgag dbye dang ljongs rgyu la ma byon pa sogs thus min byung rigs la slad la — 299 —

'doms byed skabs lbur chad nga/ gcod nges yi ma pas bag yod tshu'/ ba'i ma bsten 'tshal/ tshogs chen dbyar dgun bca' yig skabs bla brang lto zam skya ser gyi rigs dang / khru gas pa mgon/ khang 44 sa mas/ zur tshos/sa khag sogs mdor na 'dir smos min la ma ltos par na/da nga/ dang mtshams pa yin nges ma sa/togs tham sa cad phebs dbo/sa 'ing / yang re gnyis ma/da pa dang mtshams pa dri/ma bzhin/ du 'am du ba da/nga / nad mtshams// sa/nga rung 'i na kung da/go/ngas zhu ma/ byas par bsdad ris/sa 'a/ skabs sbya ra nyes/ rnga4 tsa/skong rgyu /rgyud grwa'i bca' yis/ la(bdang srugs/ rnga5 du yod 'du dgos/ gong dang mtshungs / rab tu byung ba'i las/ su bya ba klog nga thos bas/ra/ dang / spong ba bas ma sa/tan gyi rim pa gnyis las ma 'das kyang rgya' po kri kri'i dris ltas thog tu babs pas deng skabs bdag cag gi ston nga/'i rjes 'jug tu dz+nyā/ ma pa phal cher bye/ ma las thar kyang bye/ ma gyi bya ba las ma thar bar phal cher tshong khe byed pa mang bas shing yos/ lo ra/dzod pa no min han gyi dus 'bul len byas pa'i sa/na rgyar spyi sger gang sa nas tshong khe/ bde/ 'bru dngul bskyed gtong thams cad rgyal bsdus gang thub byed dgos gsal yang rim pas je rgyas su song ba las rgyas spro bsdu mi byung mi 'dug pa 'di'i rgyu rkyen brtags shing dpyad na sngon dus spyi par gsol dpon phan khang nas bzhes tsha'i sbyor rtsa yod khar/ phyis sbu mchod khag gi mchod mar kyi thebs rtsa rim 'phel byung thog gsol che dpal ldan ja rgyab pa'i las 'khur 'jog khad phul ba'i bzhes tsha'i sbyor rtsa dang / gshe dpon nam bstan khyi lo lo'i 'gyed kyi spyor rtsa sne 'doms gang mang yod pa grwa tshang rgan po rgan g.yo/ga rnams la bed gtong byed rgyur bkram pa de dag kyang shes rig dang 'byor 'khos che min sna tshogs la brten de dag gis kyang blos —— 300

'khyud min/ byung rigs mi tshan so sor bkram par brten// tshong dang khe bed/dngul bun 'grems bsdu rgya cher 'phel rgyu'i rtsa ba der thug pa 'dra 'ing /gzhan yang lag ldan yod rigs rnams nas 'di la rigs bsgres/ te tshong khe bed/ 'bru dngul gyi bun gtong rgya cher byed pa dang // gzhan yang bun bdag khag gi/sa bun bo skyed khrel min byung rigs la spyi pa'i ma dngul yin tshul khar 'khur nas 'ded gtser byed ba sogs nyes pa du ma'i sgor 'dug/ cing /rgan po rgan g.yog 'khri ba'i mi tshan khag gi grwa ris/sa rnams kyang dgongs babs med nges yin 'dus/ par brten gam bcar ga/sol dpon chen mo nas bzhes tsha'i spyor rtsa bla brang rang du phyir bzhes yod pa zhes snyan zhu 'byor byung rung / dge 'dun gyi sde la bsngos pa'i rdzas bla brang du len/ rgyu cung ma thad cing / ma dngul gang yin 'gyed du phul te rtsa med byed rgyu mi thad pa mi 'dug kyang / lo lo/'i bzhes tsha dang / 'gyed kyi gtong gzhi rtsa chag rang du song tshe rten 'brel gyi gnad la mi gtugs par bsam/ bzhes tsha'i spyor rtsa gsad 'phar dang / 'gyed kyi spyor rtsa bcas zur 'dzugs thog yang tig gtong gzhi rnams kyang mi chag cing / dge 'dun gī thog tu bskyed bsgyur dka' spyongs sogs kyang mi dgos pa bcas legs lam gang chags go nyis chod du 'grub pas da cha gsol dpon phan khang pa'i bzhes tsha'i spyor rtsa sogs ma dngul srur nas gnas gang yin las med pa 'di dag grwa tshang rgan po rgan g.yog rnams nas so sos mgo bkrus gdong dag byed pa las mi tshan spyi thog tu 'grel rgyu sogs gtan nas mi byed cing / dge 'dun gyi rdzas yin par bsam shes kyis ngan skreb za rgyag bed spyod sogs mi byed par gtong shes bsdu shes kyis gang sar le mi thogs pa byed/ gal srid 'gal 'das byung rigs — 301 ——

la'ang ngo bo rang la skabs bstun/ bab bso/da byed pa las mi tshan sogs don med pa'i mi mang la brdabs bsig/sa su 'gyur rigs mi byed/ de ltar grwa tshang rgan ngo rgan g.yog sna/mas nas spyi nga/'i ma dngul yin nges bun bskyed/ gto/ nga byed pa las/ de byings grwa ris/sa bgres gzhon su thad nas kyang 'bru dngul gyi bun bskyed ba/tong dbyu da dngos kyi rigs 'bel nyo kon tshong / rta /khe// bong khe sogs khe bun tshong las kyi rigs dang / bsgrub zhing 'debs skyong sogs ga/tan nas mi byed par thos bsam sgom bsgrub chos spyod kyi rim pa la ma/na tan du mdzad dgos/ chos kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos bre dang srang la sa/yo sgyu byed pa 'jig rten khyim pa rnams la'ang bkag na rang cab rab tu byung ba rnams kyis byar mi rung ba smos mi dgos kyang / nge/ sru rang re'i sgrig grwa'i khongs nas kyang tshul bzhin ma yin pa'i bre srang gis g.yon/ rmongs par byas pa byung yod 'dug pa rang rgyud/ la sdig las tshabs po cher 'gyur ba smos ci dgos/ bstan pa spyi bye brag dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa'i 'bas 'dren du 'gyur bar bsam phyin chad de rigs bgres gzhon sus kyang mi mdzad// gal srid byas rigs byung ba la chos khrims khang nas rtsad gcod dang 'brel ba'i 'di gar rgyu mtshan byung bstun slad la 'doms nges kyi nyes pa theg par dka' ba gcod rgyu/ bka' gdams glegs bam las/ bshad tshogs rgya mtsho lta bu na'ang / khrims ni hrung zad lhod par gyur/ /mig gcig pa dang mche ba can/ /khrims 'chal byol song skye bar byed/ zhes pa'i lung thog tu babs te bar skabs nas chos khrims zhi/ga ral du ci cher song bar brten/ dgon nang du grwa rigs sogs dgos med du mas rta drel khye sogs bsten pa rim dar du song ba 'di mur lus phyin dgon pa gzhan dag nas —— 302 ——

'byor mi rnams kyi spyan lam du mi mdzes 'ing / bzan pa nyo sgrub dang snga dro dgo/nga zhogs chu blud pa dang 'khrud pa sogs kyis mtshon don mang ba/ bya ba mang bar 'gyur ba dang / rta sbang khyi lud sogs kyis spyi khang so so dang srang mdo mi btsang bar 'gyur ba sogs dgos nga chung zhing / dgag bya che bar 'dug pas phyin chad bla brang spyi sa/ grwa tshang sogs kyi do/na du phyogs 'gro yang yang byeng/ dgos pa rnams phud de byings ser mo'i rigs su sa/thogs pa thams cad kyis dgon nang du rta khyi bong bu sogs rgyun gtan nyar bdag mi byed/lhas par gseb dang rgod ma sogs ched nyos kyis skye 'phel byed pa dang / rta gseb kyi rigs la bya bcos byed/ pa rnams ser mo ba'i rigs su gtogs po cog gis dus dang gnas skabs gang du'ang gtan nas mi byed/ de rigs byas pa shar tshe skabs bstun nyes pa slad ‘mar phan pa gcod nges yin/ tshas grwa yod skabs dgun/ ja gtong rgyu 'di bzhim/ rig lung bgro gleng la gnod tshabs ci cher 'dug pas phyin chad tshogs chen dang grwa tshang chos thog skabs bcas gang sar spyi sger su thad nas gung ja dgos tshul gleng yang btang na mi thus pas dgong ja spyor sbrel du gtong ba'am rgyun ji thog tu phan pa gang rib/sa byed/ mang ja'i thog nas phyi 'gro gtong dgos kyi rigs dang // rnam gzhag che chung/ ma ja dang bzhes tsha'i dgo/sa cha len lugs sos/sa tshang ma rje gong ma'i phyag dam nang bzhin sor gnas g.yo med rgyun 'khyongs dgos rgyu/ 'gyed kyi skor la dngul 'gyed dang thebs rtsa sogs ji ltar yin kyang / dge bskos chen mo dang ja rgyab pa zung nas lta rtog mgo 'doms legs par byas te 'phar 'dren sogs spug 'dren du mi 'gro ba byed cing / skad 'phar 'dren/ rgyu sogs kyang dngos gnas las chad lhag gi dge skyon mi yong ba byed/ yang —— 303 la

gal srid nyis skor thebs pa sogs byung na nor /'khrul dang dgos dbang gang yin zhi/ba dpyud/ de nod 'khrul yin na phyir bsdus kyi 'jog rgyu dang / dgo/sa dbang be/sa byas rigs 'a/ rtsa ra/ dang bcas gnas dbyung byed rgyu sogs/ jib tshags byed pa la/sa nyes pa yod mim/ gyi zhib dpyod gang yang med nga/ra blun rtags kyis hol rgyugs mi byed/ sngon dus slob dngo/na zur pa rnams /nga/ skal 'phar yod nga/ bar skabs/ chag 'dub/ kyang / phyin chad slob dpon zur ba dang ma rdzad pa zur pa'i ris/sa la nyis ska/la chad med sprod phyogs thog bla ma khag gi zhabs phyi dang / gzhis dgon dang / mi tshan khag gi la sa tshan dngos/ gnas yin pa phud/ de byengs grwa rigs bgres sa/zhon su thad nas kyang bag yangs khyad par sa/zhis dgon/ ri khro/ da khag so so'i yu/'a/ sog/sa phyogs mthar rgyun sdod byas mi tshag cing / 'di khar yang tshang mas tshos/sa chen dang grwa tshang chos thog gi phos/sa bzhes ma te chos grwa sku rem sgrol 'don sogs rgyu/ga pa las don med kyi gsos dal du mi ba/zhugs // khyad par sgreg grwa'i gras nas rdzong gzhis 'dzin pa dang / rdzong sdod ka'i sa gnyer gyi g.yog tu sdod rgyu sogs bslabs pa 'cha' ba'i rgyu dang / sa zhing 'debs skyong srog gcod kyi bkod pa bya rgyu sogs gang sa nas sgris lam dang rgyab 'as/la du 'gro ba thig 'dug pas phyin chad rdzong gzhis 'dzin pa dang / rdzong sdod gzhis gnyer gye g.yog tu 'gro ba sos/sa gtan nas mi byed/ phogs 'gyed dgongs pa'i skor bar skabs byer gzhig ci che byung 'dug pas phyin chad rgyal rtse dang /ngam ring grwa skor la byon mi gang yin/ nad pa dang mtshams pa yin nges ma gtogs de byings bla brang gzhung don la phyin rigs sos/sa su thad la'ang phogs 'gyed kyi dgong pa zhu gtong mi byed/ nad pa dang mtshams pa yin —— 304 —

nges so bas/ nga/mngam) nga / zhu ngos / rlams kyang nga/se/ skom chen rdza/ dang ja rgyab nga/ zung snge/1 — 5 kyi thos rig dbo/ngas zhu byas ma ma btog//sa phyos//sa re nas dbo/ngas pa zhu gtong mi / byeng// chos grwa'i rtsis/ mig/ gi/ dbo/ngas pa yang bo/nga mtshungs / byed/phyogs 'gro'i dgongs pa zhu rgyu 'di ba'i ma/ spra dus sro'/ med pa 'ig/ la bar na/bas mas 'gro phar tshas khang dang ja rgyab pa'i ba ra kha btags/ re re dang 'khor bstun kha bta sa/bshe re re) bcas bye/ ra nas phyim/ cho rka/ rwa4 dang // sgrig rgyus ru jog nga/ song//sa/ zhu da/bo/rud/ pa su/sa btsug/ma/ med pa snyen sro' 'is dar /'du dug/ pa ste nga ༄ ra pa /'a)go bar dgo/ngas nga / zhu rgyu dang / tshur ske bas/ ma/sa sgrig rgyus/sa tshog ba'i bzang ba zhu/ rgyu bcas sngis/ lam/ la nga/cha rma 'i legs1 cha yen 'dus ku/nga /snyam zhu'i/ /la btag/sa mang po 'bul len byed pa 'di bzhin sgrib/ lam/ la/ phan rgyu med lar non med du grwa rkyang la 'gro/ sgo dang khag sum/ ci che'i rgyur 'dus/ pas phyin chad zhu/ rten la btags kyi sro/la gtan za/sa mi byeng// nga/ra 'gro khar chos khrir/nga/ khang 'a/ rdo ting brdungs nas phyin tshag pa'i dbo//ngas zhu byas thos dge/ bskos/ chen pho nas sa/ra 'gro dang / don sa/nga yin sos/sa rtsa thi/ba dang /'brel ba'i 'khrol cha sa/mang te 'di nas/ thon nga/ nas bzung tshur 'khor ba la chang dang // sho bas/ hor kha dang tha mi kha 'thung 'then byed pa/ dor ma pus shubs // —thu thung can gyi bo/sa gyon pa so/ga/sa/ rtsing spyod/ bgyis mi chos/ par gzhis byed gang sa/ra lus/ rwa/nga gra chas 'bral med thog dge slong grangs su longs na gso spyong dang / grangs su ma longs nga/'i gras la/'ang gso spyong byen rlabs byed pa sog/sa 'di khar sdod pa ltar gyi sgrig khrim sa/ 'khur thes dgo/sa rgyu dang / 'di khar tshu/ma mthun byed min 'di ma/sa nyang gnon rtsad gcod kyis ma byung ba'i ris/sa la 'khor bsnyun nyes pa phyis lam kheg/sa/ pa sa/cod/ rgyu yin —— 305 ———

lugs bcas go brda 'phrod nges pa'i bka' bkod mthil phyin mdzad rgyu dang /de mtshungs ja rgyab par yang dgongs zhu/ 'i thog gar 'gro dang don gang yin sogs kyi rtsad gcod sgrig lam 'khur shes dgos pa'i bkod khyab sogs gong bzhin byed/ tshur 'khor skabs chos khrims khang du rdo ting brdungs nas sgrigs su phyin tshag pa'i gnang ba zhu ba dang / de mtshungs ja rgyab par yang zhu dgos bcas grwa ris//sa bgres gzhon su thad nas kyang dge bskos chen mo dang ja rgyab par gnang ba ma zhus par 'gro 'dug mdzad mi chog cing / phar 'gro tshur 'khor gyi dgongs pa dang gam/nga ba zhu rten kha btags 'bul bzhes ga/tan nas mdzad mi chog pa bcas phyin chad 'di rang ltar sor gnas rgyun 'khyongs mdzad dgos/ lto zan che 'bring chung gsum thams cad 'di khar mgron brgyud kyis gnang ba ma zhus par phyos/sa 'gro bgyis mi chog grwa sa 'di nyid mtshan nyid kyi rtsod grwa yin gshis slob gnyer 'dzin skyor la gnod 'gal che bar dgongs bla brang dang / grwa tshang bzhi// zla bskangs pa dang /rgyun bskangs pa sogs 'char cam/ ji yod ma gtogs rnga sbug 'di bzhin la bka' bya che bas chos khrims khang du dbo//ngas pa zhu srol 'dug pa lngar bzhin byed sngon dus thos bsam gling pa dang dkyil khang pa gnyis 'gyed kyi mdzad sgo phyogs mtshungs yin 'dug kyang deng skabs dkyil khang pa lnga sar gnas yod tshod mi 'dug rung / da lta ltar byas 'thus las bkod pa ma dgos shing /thos bsam gling pa da lta'ang sngar gnas yin 'dug pas phyin chad kyang ji srid bar da lta ltar byed pa las gra tshang gzhan lugs la ngan 'gran mi byed// phyis yul gru phal cher dang khyad par 'di phyogs rkun ma dar bas gdan rab gong ma rnams kyis 'bad pa chen pos bskrun par mdzad pa'i gtsug lag khang shar ———— 306 —— —
