nub kyi sku gsung thugs rten rnams dang / sku gdung khag bcas rtsa 'gangs shin tu che bas yul gnyan pa dang / spyi khang khag la rkun shor yang yang yong ba 'di yang grwa rkyang la don med kyi gyong gun chen po yong 'dug pa lhag bsam gyi blos ma bzod par dgon pa'i phyi'i rgyal sgo khag la nyams bzo dang 'brel ba'i nye logs kyi spyi khang rnams nas mtshan mo sdoms gcod dgos rgyu'i bkod khyab bgyis pa bzhin phyin chad sus kyang 'gal med thog sa sros nas rgyal sgo thams cad bsdoms te de tshun chad phyi nang sa/nga sa nas 'grul bzhud byed mi che chung ji ltar yin kyang 'byed len bgyis mi chog cing / snga dro yang grwa rigs 'das grongs kyi phung po skyel rgyu'i khyad kyis snga phyi dmigs bsal las de byings nam ma lang bar la rgyal sgo rnams phye mi chos/ pa bcas nyams len rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyu dang / 'gal 'das yod min 'di nas blta skor thog dmigs bsal bkod pa dgos rigs 'di nas 'phral 'phral bgyi rgyu/ dgon nang du sdod mi su thad nas kyang mu lto ba dang / grwa sa gzhan dag nas gnas dbyung byas nga/'i btsun pa dang / rten med pa'i skya bo sogs khungs lung med pa'i mi rigs g.yog tu sgor bskyel byed rgyu 'di rang g.yon/ thams cad la rkun shor gyi rgyur 'dug pas 'di yang gtan nas mi byed/ slob dpon rnam pa bzhi dang / dge bskos chen mo/ ja rgyab pa bcas nas slad kyi mig la 'doms ched nyes pa'i bab bkod gnang 'os kyi rigs kyang che ba la lus steng la rtsa ra dang / de min gyi rigs la dngos po'i nyes pa/ mar me brgya phrag sogs gang la gang mtshams kyis slad la 'doms nga mdzad pa las don med par so sos za 'dod kyi snyad gtser brdabs bsigs su 'gro ba gtan nas mi rigs te/ skyes mchog lo chen sprul sku stobs ldan dpa' bo chen pos/ de la 307 ——

phyir mtshan nyid ma bla ma gsum sogs lugs kun gyi bdag po 'gag 'doms che ba rnams nas dpyad 'phral chad pa chos dang mthun pa gcod dngos chas 'phrog mi dgos/ bstan dgra dgon par ma zhog 'phrog bcom byas na pham pa yong/ zhes gsungs pa 'di rang cag rab tu byung ba dge 'dun gyi sde'i lugs zungs kyi khrims kyi las byed pa rnams kyis thugs la nges par 'jags dgos pa zhig 'dug pas dgongs par bzhugs ba dang / zhol sogs grong gseb gang sar bka' 'gyur 'bum sgrog sogs sku rim la 'byon dgos rnams nas kyang lam bar tshogs song sogs gang sar chos 'don/ sbu rim tshul bzhin mi mdzad par don med kyi gleng mo dang / ba 'ad sa/da/bsteg res/ 'dzin kha bkye ba sogs khyim pa mi dad par 'gyur rigs gtan nas mi mdzad cing / de ltar mi 'byung ba'i mgo 'doms rgan 'go su yin nas byed/ dgon nang du sdod mi che 'breng gsum thams cad na/sa rgyun/ tan me la zon lcag gang che dang / khya/ da par tshogs chen/ grwa tshang bzhi dang /mi tshan so so'i rung khang khas/ gsol 'degs pa dang / gnyer tshang bzhes spro khang / rta rwa'i rtswa shing / grwa rigs dang / lto zan so so'i me shing bcas la'ang so sos bdag don bdag gces kyis nyad tshags sa/nga dag byed pa las bag yangs 'khyams bskyur du mi 'jog gling srung pa nas kyang dgon pa'i tho khongs kyi srang dbar rnams la blta rtog 'ib 'jug gi/sa lud dang / khyi ro dbyung ba/ sprang slong sogs nas ngu lab skad col mi byung ba/khyad par rgyab ri nas/ dgon nang la rbab nyen yod la rbab g.yul byed pa dang / dbyar dus rgyab rir dud 'gro che chung tsa///tong mi 'jug pa sogs rang khri'i las don lhas/ bsam hur bskyed thon pa dgos rgyu dang / nam tshod pa 308 — ——

nas kyang cho 'phrul smon lam gī skabs sogs snga ja snga ba dgos rigs la nam tshod mi phyis pa dang / snga ja'i gsos spyong khag gi skabs sogs snga ja 'gyangs ba dgos skabs nam tshod mi sngas pa/ rgyun tan snga phyi ran pa sogs gang sar le ma thogs pa dgos rgyu/ dge bskos chen mo nas cho 'phrul sgon lam gyi skabs sogs dmigs bsal ma gtogs pa'i rgyun tan dgon nang du bud med 'gro 'ong byas mi chog pa'i dgongs pa zhu tshad la ster yangs mi mdzad/bad skabs sngags pa'i rung khang pa'i bud med rnams gos sbu spel gyi rgyal sgo brgyud nyin ltar dgon nang 'grul bzhud byed pa bzhin byung song ba phyin chad de rigs kyang gtan nas mi byed// bar skabs shig dgon pa'i tho khungs/ su gdug 'dre rtsa sbugs su 'dren pa kha yar byung yod tshod 'dug pa/ phyin chad la mo chos skyong sogs dmigs bsal ma gtogs gang khog zhus/sa byas mi chogachos srung kyang ye shes kyi spyan ldan rdo rje'i srung ma las/ ngo/la rgyal sogs mkha' ma rgyu ba'i yi dwag/sa/ 'dre ngan gyi rigs la gsol kha byed pas mtshon bsten cing skyabs su 'gro ba nang pa sangs rgyas nga 'i 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro'i 'gal zlar 'dug pas mi byed/ gzhan yang lam 'phreng dga' zhig na yi dwags gdugs pa can gyi gnas gzhi sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i sgor ma zhugs pa'i khyem pa rnams rta 'bab pa dang phyag 'tshal ba sogs gus par byed dgos pa 'ga' 'i/ga yo/nga 'dug pa de dag la'ang rang cang gi ston pa'i rjes su zhugs pa rnams sa gnas de dag tu slebs pa na 'byung po mi la yin de la phan pa dang /thi ba dang / dge ba'i sems kyi skar ma rab rib sogs kyi chos bshad nas gsur gtong ba sogs kyi sbyin par mos nas byed pa las 'jig/ rten pa ltar phyag 'tshal ba dang / rta 'bab zha phud/ 'phral yun gyi smo/na lar/ 'debs —— 309 ——

pa sogs gtan nas byed mi rung bar bka' dang bstan bcos tshad ldan du ma las 'byung bas de rigs mi mdzad bar gong brjod bzhin nyams len rgyun 'khyongs su mdzad dgos/ khams gsu ma 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ 'on te rkang 'thung khrod na yong 'du ltar/ /shing rta che gnyis bzhed gzhung skyes bu gsum/ /lam gyi rim pa dī pam ka ra nas/ / yongs brgyud bka' tsa/dmas snyan pa'i grags pa 'bar/ /tshul 'di ches phra bstan pa'i me ro tsam/ / slar gsos gangs can ljongs 'dir rgyas mdzad pa/ /'jam mgon blo bzang grags pas rab bkral ba'i/ /legs bshad 'di ko sngon med yid bzhin nor/ /zhes bstsal ba ltar 'phags yul gyi shing rta chen po rnams kyi bzhed pa jo bo rje lha gcig dī ka ra yab sras kyis gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir spel bar mdzad pa jo bo bka' ga/dmas pa'i ring lugs slar yang khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen pos ma rtogs pa dang / log par rtogs pa rnams gsal te dar zhing rgyas par mdzad pa'i zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid 'a/ skal ba dang ldan pa'i gang zag thams cad kyis bslab par 'os pa yin la khyad par rang cag gi me tog/ 'phog pa'i lha skal lta bu thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tseng kha pa chen po'i sras kyi mthu bo gnyis kyi ya rgyal yin zhi/nga / gang gi ring lugs 'dzin pa kun gyi gtsug rgyan du gyur bas zhwa ser cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i chos sde chen po 'di nyid kyang 'debs par mdzad pa yin la rgyu mtshan dper na 'dir bzhug/sa mkhan slob dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas thams cad kyis khams gsum spi rgyal po bong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs —— 310 ————

'di nyid la rgyu'i theg pas rgyud sbyangs nas 'bras bu'i theg pa la slob pa sogs rim can du bslabs nas thos bsam sgom pa thams cad 'di la 'bad nas 'chad rtsod rtsom gyi sgo nas nyams pa sor chud pa dang / mi nyams pa gong du 'phel ba'i thabs tshul la rtse gcig tu 'bad pa ni rang cag rnams kyi las su bya ba kun gyi rtsa bar gyur pa lags pas thams cad kyis lus ngag yid gsum brgyun pa cher bskyed de 'bad tshal/ gzhan yang rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen ba ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ 'phags bod mkhas grub nam mkha'i skar tshogs kyi rnam dag so so'i lugs bzhin yongs bstar ba'i/ /dus gsum rgyal rnams gshegs shul nyer bgrod pa/ /mang byung nyams su len 'os kho na'i yul/ /zhes gangs can kyi ljongs 'dir mkhas shing 'grub pa brnyes pa'i shing rta'i srol 'byed rnams kyi so so'i bzhed srol mi 'dra ba snga 'gyur rdo rje theg pa/ dpal ldan sa skya pa'i ring lugs/ gzhan yang dwags shangs zhi byed pa so gas grub pa'i mtha' gzhan rnam sa kyang so so'i gdul byar gyur pa rnams kyis nyams su blangs byar 'os pa 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pas de dag la'ang cha rmod ya ba// sgrogs pa sogs chos spong gi las tshabs cher 'gyud bas bgres gzhon thams cad kyi ming mdzad pa dang / de das/ 'dzin pa'i gang zag kyang rab byung dang khyem pa'i rten mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas de rigs 'di phyogs byon pa sogs la shes/ par cha rmod dang mi gus nga/'i rnam 'gyur byed pa sogs rang rgyud 'a/ mi dge sa bon bskrun pa rmos la dgos kyang / khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs dang / gdan sa chen po 'di nyid bcas spyi sger thams cad kyi 'bas 'dren du 'gyur bas bgres gzhon mtho dman bar ga/sum sus kyang mi mdzad/ bon dang rtags brtan ——— 311 ———

pa sogs grub mtha' rnam dag ma yin pa kun la rlung ltar grags pas mig can g.yang mchongs kyi de dag la 'jug pa byung dgos mi 'dug kyang / bar skabs shig la ba bla ma sogs thabs kyi cha thams cad la skur ba 'debs pa'i ha ༄hwa shang gi lta ba dang phyogs mthun par 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig la chos 'brel nyan pa sog/sa kha yar byung yod 'dug pa phyin chad rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos/ phyag rdzogs bu g.yum lta ba 'od 'dir grags/ / dbu ma klu sgrub bzhed srol lta ba'i rtse/ / zhes bstsal ba thugs la brtags te rang cag rnams 'phags mchog klu sgrub kyi bzhed gzhung thun mong ma yin pa khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs thams cad kyi snying po'i srog tu gyur pa zab mo dbu ma'i lta ba thams cad kyi yang rtser son pa 'di lta bu nyams su blangs byar yod bzhin du 'tshal dang btsag gi dpe bzhin ring lugs ngan ba de rigs la nam yang 'gram chung ldang rigs pa ma yin pas de lta bu'i bshes gnyen ngan pa'i rigs la mi bsten/ rang sde'i ring lugs la'ang thog ma nas legs par brtags te mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bsten pa las sbyangs min gyi mkhas pa dang / sgoms min gyi grub thob/ mi mang dang thug 'phrad byed pa'i mtshams pa sogs rgyu 'bras snga phyi go ldog pa'i tshul chos can la mi bste na/ 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug bod kyi lha skal yin pa dang / de'i sprul sku par 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs mdo rgyud bka' gter du ma nas lung bstan cing / khyad par thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa chen pos dgon gnas 'di nyid gsar 'debs mdzad cing thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos 'di nyed kyi gdan sa mdzad pa sogs sbu 'phreng na rim nas thugs rjes ma bor ba'i chos srid gang sa nas — 312 ———

mthun rkyen phan pa bla med bsgrub par mdzad pa sogs bka' drin gzhal dka'i gnas las ma 'das rung / legs nyes 'byed pa'i blo gros kyi mig ldong zhing / phrag dog gi myos khrus yid rnams par bslad pa 'ga' zhig gi rjes su blun po pha'/ cher ri bong cal 'grogs kyi brgyugs nas rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa sku 'phreng phal cher dang / khyad par khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho la phya skrod kyis las tshabs po che gsog pa rmeng med/ phyin chad ma dag pa'i bya ba de rigs la mi 'jug par rnam thar gsan mig sogs gsungs rnams la zhib tu dpyad de bcos min dang bcos pa'i jad pa gang rung skyes na dang / de ltar ma gyur kyang rang nyid dmyal bar 'dren pa'i las tshabs po che de rigs mi gsog gzhan yang grwa tshang / mi tshan/ rgyu rkyen phyogs lhungs 'jin 'khyer byed pa 'di dge 'dun gyi dbyen gyi gzhir 'dug pas phan tshun che chung su thad nas kyang mi byed/ gling skor sogs dgon pa'i tho khongs rnams su gdugs phub pa dang / kran ma'u rtse gyon pa/ mgo bor ras gzan dkri ba/ rgyal sgo yas mas nas rta bzhon pa sogs byung rigs rnams la lugs mthun gyi bkod khyab chos khri/ mas khang rang nas mdzad dgos/ gong gsal de dag la dgon zhol phyi nang gang sar spyi'i khrims kyi 'tsho 'dzin dge skos chen mo rang nas 'khur bzhes thog grwa tshang so so'i khongs slob dpon rin po che rnam pa bzhi dang / chos grwa chos khri/ mas pa rnams nas rtsa 'dzin dang ja rgyab pa nas rang khri'i las don dang / chos khrims khang dang / grwa tshang bzhi sogs gang sar dge skyon snyam/ lcag 'bul rgyu/ 'di nas spyi khyab kyi mgo 'doms rtsa 'dzin rgyun mar byed rgyu bcas rang cag ma khan slob tham sa cad thugs 'dun — —— 313 ——

rtse gcig pa'i sgo nas rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'dzin/ pa'i dge 'dun gyi bya ba rnams mi nyams shing gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs tshul la nan cher 'bad tshal/ mdor na byung dang 'byung gyur gyi lugs zung gi khrims lugs kyi cha thams cad brjod par mi lang ba'i rnam smin nag por 'byin pa'i sdig pa'i tshogs kun spong ba dang / 'di phyi'i bde ba ster ba'i dge ba'i rigs su gyur pa mtha' dag 'gangs chen pos bsgrubs pa la brtson dgos shing /slad na sa blang dor mtha' dag bca' yig chen mo dang yi ge 'di nyid kyi steng nas rtsa 'dzin byed pa dgos rgyur 'gal 'das byung rigs la tshabs che chung dang bsnyun pa'i nyes pa gam rdzong rgyang 'bud/ grwa sa gnas dbyungs lus steng rtsa ra/ nang chas gzhung len// dngos po'i nyos bsgrub/ mar me brgya phyag tshig gis nan rgyur sogs gang la gang 'gab kha tsam min pa gcod nges ma zad yig gzhi 'di skor gyi tshig gi cha phra mo tshun chad dam can rgya mtsho spyi dang khyad par rgyal yum 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug dpal ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo re ma tī 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnyer du gtad pa yin pas bag med par spyod pa rnams la ring por mi thogs par bka'i chad pa drag po rdo rje'i thog dang mtshungs pa 'bab par 'gyur ba gdon mi za zhing / tshul bzhim/ spyod pa rnams la tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor mnga' thang snyan grags bshad sprub 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba sogs legs tshogs mtha' dag gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i gdong grogs mdzad pa'i 'phrin las kyang stsol yod pas bag yod tshul bzhin du bsten la sdig spong dge sgrub kyi nyams len rgyun 'khyongs su yong ba 'tshal/ smras pa/ rgyal mtshan phyogs las mngon par mthon po'i legs bris bdag po'i khang pa na/ /legs byas rin chen bzhi/ las —— 314 ———

nyer grub 'jis//sa/ bral sa/dong lnga nga / yi khri/ ra// //'i ga/sa༄ nyes blta ba'i 'dren byed stong 3 na nga/ yi mtshad/ sbyin brgya nga/ rme tra༄ / / rdzun min bden pa'i tshig 'di bsgra gas tshe za 'a/ lngan /'chi med rna ba'i ma/sos/ / ('dod sems chang gis yid kyi sa/zhon nu ra ro bas/ / lugs zung khrims kyi gom pa'i 'degs 'jos/ 'a/pyo ra 'a/khyor por// / 'god cing ngam/ 'gro'i sa//yang sa che 'a //reng mi dgos nga/ma/ // bden min 'cha/pha tshig/ da'— med smra dang /'di mi /'dra/ / kun gyis rang nyid bzang por bskur ba'i phyir// / les/sa nyes bdem/ rdzun dbye ba mi 'byed nga/ra/ / the/sa bzhin bzang rdzus lung zung bre/ mas kyi sro//nga/// / 'chal por gtong 'di dam pa'i lugs dang 'ag/la/ / blo gros mchog gi lus stobs rtsal rdzogs kyang / / khengs pa'i myos khus gzu bo'i yid bsgyur te/ / yun du zas skom sbyin pa'i rje bo'i ngag / mi nyan gnyis 'thung spyod pa 'di ches dman/ /'dod la brkam pa'i zang zing bdog pa dngas/ / thar par bgrod pa'i them skas khrims kyi srol/ / mnyam par brje 'di dam pa'i lugs yin na/ / sngon byon chos rgyal mes dpon tshogs kyis nongs/ / de lta'i 'dzin khrims 'dul khrims grub bcom pas/ / sha kya'i rjes 'jug 'chal tshul tshur g.yengs shing / / khyem las gdug pa'i srog chags kyis gtses pa'i/ / snang tshul 'di ko shes ldan su yi bzod/ / phyogs 'dzin bya gu'i 'phrul pa'i ri dwags phyi/ /ma bsnyegs kho bo'i lhag bsam gnam ru las/ /'phos pa'i dam bca' gsum ldan tshig mda' 'dis// /khrims 'chal lang ka'i mgrin pa deng 'dir bcad/ /dge tshogs nam mkha'i nor bu'i zer 'phreng gi/ /thub bstan me tog mdzes pa'i dga' tshal du/ /zhwa ser ring lugs su ṇ+ḍa dī ka'i tshogs/ /'dab ma'i 'dzum 'al lhod por grol bar shog / de nyid 'dzin la brtson pa —— 31pe

dri/ lhong pa ba 'di // 'phags༄ do/nga so bye'i dge bci5 bshes4 gcem tshogs zabs/ zung rnge rje'i 'u/shā sa ri/ tsam zhing / /'phrim / sgyu sa ba gsab ba mtha73 shā ma ba/za shā gyur cis/ /mngo rgyud bku ba'i ri mo sa'i sa/1 'khyi'/ du/ /mis nga 'i mtsham mar drem grub dung mas si/4 sgyu // rgya' ba'i/ da/ma chos sgra dbyangs bsangs mthon por/ / nyi/da ma tha'i bar du chad rnge/da sgros par shos/ 1 skye ma ma 'tshi'i klung ba'i rtag 'bab—pa/'i/ // ma/tha' nga/pob/ nus bral 'jis rten ma/tsho klong du/ 'gro ba klu tshogs 'jig da/ nga rdzu/ma bral te/ / ba/de skyed sa/tsus/ nor gzi 'ong/ mas 'bar 1 4 / dge bcu kum tshang myang ‘/'bas ri dbang rtser/ /khrims lda ma/ sa spyod ba rgyud bdungs pa'i sgras/ //phas rbo/la sbyem skyes 'a/sa rgyal dpal ma/tsham dong / /sta gams/ mthon pa'i rtse rbo/ra bsgreng ma gyur cis/ /lhab bas ma ri dwags ma tshan mu/'i rgyam 'chang ba'i / / bsil zer 'di spro'i byed po rgyu ska ra bdas /// bar sa/ thong/ dus me'i 'tshe bas mi tshugs 'ing //'jis rten da /ra po bsgyur ba'i/ nus thob tho/sa/ / dus mtha'i zhug//sa dang 'thor rlung 'tshubs ma 'i klung rum nas // // rgya'/ bstan ma/ gzibs gar dgu'i nyam/sa ldan dmag zor lhas/ / tshib/ 'di 'a/sa 'gong thal bar byed dang lhan ceg tu/ // tshul ba'i na spyod pa'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor yar zlar mdzod/ / stobs bcu mthar son bde bar gsheg/sa dang de'i gsung chos/ / stobs bcu la slob 'phags dang so skye'i dge 'dun/ bcas/ / stobs ldan 'jig rten 'di na dko/na pa'i mchog rjams kyis/ / stobs ldan bden tshig 'di ni deng 'dir 'grub par mdzod/ // ces chos grwa chen po bkris ldun po dpal gyi sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling ngam mkha/ 'a 'gro ma'i brda'i skad du mo khyud 'dzin du grags pa mdo dang rgyud sde ma lus pa'i 'byung gnas 31 6 ———

rib// pa 'i sa/tshas lnga/ thugs su chud kha'i mkhas nga ma lus pa'i bste gnas grub pa'i rig nga/ 'dzin/ pa rnams rol/ ba'i dga' tshal/ nges nga ra thams cad mkhyem nga/'i sa ra bgrod nga /'i the ma skas/ 0da jig rtem/ dang 'jig/ rten las 'das pa'i yo na tam/ ren po che ma/ lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas / chos grwa chen po 'a'u/ nyid du bzhugs nga 'i mkham slob tshogs chen dang / grwa tshang la/ ga rga/ las tshan nga/// dbe/ 'du/na bgres/ ga tho/na par gsum/ bla brang gi lho zan ser skya mtsha sa/ dman bar ga/sum bcas mtha' dag nas nges da/gos pa'i yi ge/ khri/ mas gnyis srog gi chad ma thud rab brjid gser gyi rdo rje'i gnya' shing che/sa bya ba 0da de ni rgya/la mchos/ thams da/ cad/ mkhyen pa chen pos/ deng dus rgya gar rgya nag hor bod/ so/gas/ / sngon byung ma rab ngang tshul lugs gnyis lbi/ mas/ / cher nub ngan spyod ngo gso/ra 'phyer dus 'dir// / /legs bad bas/da kyang tsu ta'i/ rka/nga gnyis ba'i na/ /byu/sa deng ska/bas rtsod/ lnga/na sbogs ma lnga ches cher bod pa'i dus 'dir rgya gar/ rgya nag hor/ bod dang / bod chen po'i yul gru phal cher du sngon gyi rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis dge ba bcu'i srol gtod/ mi dge ba bcu bkag nas khrims su bcas pa rnams phal cher nub pa'am/ ma nub kyang mthun par spyod pa ches dkon pa'i dus 'dir lugs zung dang mthun pa'i gzu bo'i tshig 'di lta bu smras kyang tsu ta'i yul du rkang gnyis pa la mir mi 'dzin pa dang / spre'u sa mi la 'jug ma med ces 'khyar ba ltar mi 'phya ba ltar mi khyur 'dres dka' ba'i dus su babs pa dang /khyad par rgyal mchog thams cad mkhyen pa chen pos/ sha tshar rlom pa'i drang po'i gtam gyi mdar/ /col chung snying kha rmas te dngas ma'i dgrar/ /'dzin pa mang phyir dus ngan skye bo yi/ / blo dang bsnyun pa'i mol mchid 'grogs —— 317 —

'u sa/sa sa/ces / / 'es ba spu la ba ltar rang bos nas / spyo byer gyi bstam/ pa nyam ma pa dang / lda/ge/ 'dum gī sde'i /'dul lbims 'ib// pa/ spyo sbe/ra gī bstan nga/ dang / bstan pa'i bad/ga po grwa pa rnam/sa kyis 'bas drang ga/sa pa'i lhas bsam spru blos ma bzod par rang g.yin phyogs su ma lhungs par gzu bo'i blom khrim sa ga/ nyis lce 'u/gas da/nga mthum/ pa'i drang po bo tshis 'ab//sna zhis/ smras krung col chung dag phan ba6sa/sa pa sa/nong/ par bzung ste dngas ma'i dgra/ra 'dzin/ rnga/ la dpags ma 'es bzhin bzang rdzus/ mi smra ba'i btul bzhus//sa 'dzin pa ba4 thad sna sa /ldan kyang de nyid kyi 'phro la sa // bdab/ mi/ra bzung ba'i grwa slob zad bo/ ra 'ang ngas / 'a1/ ༈/ zo‘ma 'a pa gros sa ngo bzung 'phral du mthun grub ༷kung / sre gas/ ma ra bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu chud 'dza' bas/ / drang po'i tsa/tam gleng bzang ngan dbye ba 'byed// /ces dang / lo chen spru'/ sku stobs ldan dpa' bos/ /las byed sbu dbang yod pa rnams na/sa rang nyid re ltos dang bcas pa lugs gnyis las 'das pa'i khrims med byed ngan mu byams 'dod pa'i spug srol byas ma/ de las lhag tu bstam/ dgra ma mchis so zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ legs nyes btang snyoms su 'jog pa bdud kyi pho nya'o/ zhes gsungs te/ de ya nga rang nyid kyi bdag tu bzung ba'i grwa slob 'khor 'bangs rnams la bzang ngan sogs dbye ba cher mi byed par gdong dkar nag dang bsnyun te zol thus 'grogs mkhas pa dang kha 'jam tshig bred kyis gzhan ngo 'dzin pa'i thabs tshul 'ba' 'ig byed pa 'phral thams cad mthun grub che ba'i legs tshogs yin kyang / phugs mar de kha'i ngang nas 'dul khrims lam lugs thams cad rim pad 'chal zhing / chos spyod bshad rtsod rnams rim gyis 'grib pas 'bad/ pas bsgrub pa'i 'bras bu chud 'dza' bar rte18 —

gyur bas/ de ྅/ra mi byed nga ra 'u tsa/sa gnyis dang ma/thu ma/ pa'i drang ngo 'i ga/tam gleng ba dang bden brdzun bza/nga ngan kyi dbye ba 'byed dbo/sa/ 'e/sa lung dang po'i bo/na dang lung sa/nyis pa'i don ni mkhan po// bla brang phyag ma/dzong/ glo/nga/ dngo na bzhi/ dge sko/sa chem/ mo/ ja rgyab pa so sa/nub (spus/sa/ gnyis /skrums kyi bya ba byed pa'i rang nga/bang yod pa rnams nas/ rang nyid dang po so so la re sto/sa bcas pa rte skyabs/ yu/'a/ du bzung ba rnams kyi/ sa rgub rtem ma bon/ dpung rtas// 'khur gyis lus sa sa/nyis la 'angs shā4 ste 'gro/la ba'i skrums med kyi bya ba ('ba' zhig byed/ las byeng/ rnam/sa nas kyang rang snyed ma lto/sa rwa5 rmams spyob dbo/sa/ nga/ra brten / ngan the/sa khrim/sa lugs dang 'ab/'a / rigs rnams kyang rim pas de kha'i ngang la mu 'byams ma snyam yid la 'dod nga sa sbub/ srol byas na te shes bzhim/ du ma shes pa'i badz+ra byas nas bzang po la gzengs bstod dang / ngan pa tshar ma bcad na de ltar spug gtums byed pa'i las byed de rnams las lhag tu bstan pa la dgra byed pa gzhan ma mchis so zhes pa'i don dang / lung gsum pa'i rdo/na ni legs pa ste lugs gnyis dang mthun pa la gzengs bstod dang nyes pa ste khrims 'gal rnams la chad pa chos da/nga mthun par mi gcod par bzang ngan thams cad btang snyoms su 'jog pa ni bdud kyi pho nya'o zhes de lta bu'i las byed pa rnams gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi bdag pos byen gyis brlabs pa yin no zhes pha'i don te/ de dag mig gis mthong zhing rna bar yang thos/ don yid la dran pas skye bo blo gros chung 'ga' tsam gyis da phan btags pa gnod par bzung ba tsam la brten nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa ni ches mi 'thad par mthong zhing / 'dul khrims sdom pa'i bca' che 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes ched du bskul ba po dang tshig 31 9

spyor dang bcas bsgrigs kyi 'gro lugs 'dzi/ lta bu zhig byung na legs zhes bzung 'don byed pa sogs ni gtan na/sa ped pa rin po che rnam gsum dang /sa/'am yang mngon the/sa/ la rang dbang thob pa thams cang/ kyi thugs kyi spyo nga/ yu/la du gyur ba ltar yin rung rang nyid kyi bsam pa'i 'char sgor rgyal ba'i lung rtog/sa/ kyi bstan ba gam/sa mi gan/sa de 'dzin ba'i dge/ 'dun gyi sde 'a/ ras lus shing / de 'ang 'dul khrims rnam par dag mi dag pa'i dbang gis rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzim nus pa dang mi nus/ pa'i khyad par che zhing / khyad par khams sa/sum cho sa kyi rgyal po tsong la/ pa chen po'i ring lugs 'di nyid mi// phyi 'dul ba'i kun spyo da rnam par dag pa ga'i ra bzung dgos shing / thar/sa cad mkhyem nga/ snye 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po nas bzung mkhan brgyud rim pa'i dgongs pa yang der gnas mod/ 'on kyang bar skabs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa bo/nga ma mdzad pa'i mtha' ma bstan pa nas kho bo cag nar ma son gyi bar der kha btsan/ zhi/nga dbang che bar grags pa ches mang zhing de dag kyang rang don khog tu bcug pa'i bya byed mang bar brten gdan sa'i phyi nang bar gsum gyi 'dul khrims gnon pa'i las byed pa phal cher thugs sgyid lugs pa'i tshul kyis so so'i las thog mdzad ring phul tsam de rtad gi dgongs bzhes rgya che ba ma mdzad par brten bshad rtsod dang sgrig lam thams cad rim nyams su song ba bar skabs mdzod pa blo bzang dar rgyas spi dus mkhan slob thams cad 'al bsnyun pa'i bca' sgrig gsar du byas shing / lo shas bar de'i mjug gnon kyang na mar byung bar brten sgreg lam nyams pa sor chud cing bshad rtsod kyang gong 'phel byung yod 'dug kyang / de rjes mdzod pa sogs las byed tshang ma rim par khri 'phos rjes rtsa 'dzin mjug gnon nan —— 320 —

chags/ ma byung bar brten/ grwa tshang slob dngo na 'as/'a 'is gi/sa ba༅da rtsod/ 'a sa/jod (snabal che ba'i sgris// spo mgyogs da/nga / ris 'brung nas da ba ra phyim du mang po gtong ba ming rtag/sa zhu jim da/nga sgrib/ dar sogs ba/nga sang rje bong mas / me/ sbas bsgo 'a1 ba'i/ thugs dam dang // mdzod zur dus kyi bca' pa sprus/ so tsa/mu/ sa/nga dang yang ye mi/ ma thum nga/ 'ba' 'ib byung 'ing / phran/ bu'i sgrib/ lam bsad rtsod /nga/ thugs 1nga/khur pa che ba rnams la/'ang sa/nga ru/ nas ri1ma nga/ra thug/ru bsu na byung bas thugs/ sgyid/ 'u sas pa ji/ tho/ma ma dzad nga/bos pa so/gas byung bar brtem bshang grwa/ yang ches nyam// phra ba dang / sa/'am yang da se/ bros nga rim byo/ma rnam 'i 'o/ re'i/ mas rgyun mdzad ring kyang thus/sa rang dbang ye/ mi 'dus nga/ra la btsan sa/zlam das/ gi 'al ngo ngam/ra nag la blda dgos rnga/ dang / ci zer2 'a/ rgyal ba'i bab/'a ltar mngon par bstod da/gos pa sogs thams cad mkhye/ na nga1 dge 'dun grub nga 3 dpal bzang po'i 'jigs med seng ge'i khri la 'khod nas bca' yig rin po che phyas/ mtshan du bzhes pa 'ang dbo/sa pas dbum gyur cing //dge slos nga rnams nas kyang dgon zhol gang sar phran bu'i nyes nga/ byung rigs la dngos ngo/'i nyes pa 'ba' zhig gi ltogs sla za snyad byas par brten/ sgrig khrims non rgyu med khar phugs dge skos pa rang la'ang rtsod gzhi yong ba dang /gzhan yang rab tu byung ba yin ngo cog gis myos 'gyur la longs spyod mi chog bzhin du spyi pa'i las ka la rgan po rgan g.yog sogs la byed pa rnams kyis chang la bag med byed cing ar zug sogs kyi skabs chang ban mang po dgon nang du len pa dang nad ga/cong can rnams kyis chang la dgongs zhu byas pa sogs la brten/ dgon pa'i phyi nang gang sar chang gi btung ba ches dar bar gyur cing / yon bdag dad can gyi btab nga/'i 'gyed sogs bsnyen —— 321 —

bkur rnams kyang chang rin du das/ 'gro ba dang phyog/mu/ thon sogs kyi zo bas kyang phu thung can 'ba' hreng gi chas/ da/nga // so/sa/ chas rdor ma pus shubs sogs la sbeng zad kyang 'dzems bas/ med cing ar zug sos/sa dbo/ma chang du'ang glu dang btsas sprab tsa/sang mthon por byed pa dang / 'a—sa byed nga rnam/sa nas sgrig la/ma mjug/ sa/nom/ nyes pa'i bab ba bo/da mdzad dgos rjam/sa kyang snyems chung grwa rkyang ris/sa 'a/ thub tshod ‘sgru bu las la/ btsan rgyal dpung bzang ba'i ris/sa kyis ltos med ji ltar byas kyang mig ngan pa tsam yang lta mi nus pa sogs/ sgrib/ lam ba༅/da rtsod tsa/nga sa/ra yang the/sa ldan gyi brtags shing dpyad na mchi ma bku ba'i gnas las ma 'das pa de mur lus tshe bstan pa spyi dang / bye brag khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa'i 'gram gzhi lta bu nas zhig 'gro ba dang / rang phyogs pa'i grwa sa chen po gzhan dag nas byon pa rnams kyi gzigs lam du mi bde zhing / grub mtha' gzhan dag rnams kyis 'phya ba dang / khyim pa rnams ma dad par 'gyur ba sogs gdan sa 'di kha'i zhabs 'dren du gyur ba bcas blos ma bzod bar bstan ba'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims dang / yul dus gnas skabs dang bsnyun pa'i dge 'dun gyi nang khrims rnam par dag pa gdan rabs gong ma rim byon gī dgongs pa ji lta ba gzhir bzungs/ mdo dang rgyud sde'i bshad rtsod gong 'phel du 'gyur ba zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam gyi bskul ba ste/ de yang nges pa don gyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos de ltar chos srid blang dor rang nyid la mi ldan spyo bo'i brjod pa lta bu'i tshig smra la mkhas rnams khrel yang ston zla ltar/ ches dkar sems bzang ba la nyes pa med ces gsungs pa ltar rang nyid chos srid — — 322 ——

kyi blang dor la blta ba'i mig ches phra zhing / lugs gnyis kyi yon tan gang dang yang mi ldan bzhin du 'dab chags ne bo'i 'don pa bzhin gzhan la col chung gi tshig mang po sgrogs pa mkhas pa rnams khrel ba'i rgyu las ma 'das te blun po smra ba nyung na mdzes zhes pa ltar kho bo cag lta bu rang gis rang la dma' 'beb pa'i rtsom rtsom gyi ngag 'khyal mang po 'di bor nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs 'dzin 'di 'os yin 'dug kyang paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa'i yang srid du sgro btags nas thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po'i gser gyi khri la 'khod de gdan rabs gong ma rnams kyi mtshan gyis byen gyis brlabs pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde chen po 'di nyid kyi drin lan rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang mjal zhing / zas gos mthun rkyen rnyed pa thams cad 'bad pas bsgrub mi dgos par rang bzhin lhun grub tu 'byung ba sogs tshe rabs kun tu bkrin ga'al nus bral ba 'di lta bu zhig yin bzhin par rang gi yon tan gyi ma /khyob pas tshig spyor ba gtsang min la brten mkhas pa rnams kyis rang nyid blun por 'jog pa tsam la dgos nas mi smra ba'i brtul zhugs bzungs te bstan pa'i rtsa ba dge 'dun gyi 'dul khrims zhig pa la ji mi snyam par mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin du 'dor ba ni dkon mchog dbyengs nas khrel bas 'di dang gtan gī mdun ma 'phyugs pa'i rgyur nges la 'jig rten du yang rang nyid ngo tsha dang khrel med/ pa'i grangs su 'jog pa sogs khe chung la nyan che ba dang /ma zad spyi sger gyi bstan/ pa dang gdan sa'i mtshan don snying la brnag pa'i ston/ zla'i rjes su 'gro ba'i lhag bsam kyi sgo nas smra ba la nyes pa'i gnas skabs med snyam pas yid spro ba bsrings shing le lo dang sgyid lug nga rgyang du dor brtson/ pa dang / snyeng stobs kyi go cha cher 'phogs te khrims su bca' ba 'di —— 323 ———

nyid byed pa po gtsang rong gi sa'i cha thob rgyal zhes bya ba'i yul grur 'od gsal lha las mchod pas rgyal rigs bru'i rigs su skyes shing / thub bstan snyeng pos 'jam mgon bong kha pa chen po'i ring lugs gser sbyangs cod pan 'chang ba'i bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas phyogs med kyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa yongs la slob khul du byed pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo bsgyur/ bla na med pa/lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das zas gtsang sras po'i rjes 'jug gi gdul byar gyur pa'i dge slong la jeg chen gyi rigs su gtogs pa dang / theg dman gyi rigs su gtogs pa gnyis las theg dman/ de la bye brag tu smra ba'i sde pa bco brgyad yod pa las/ rtsa ba'i sde pa bzhi'i ya pyil gzhi thams cad yod par smra ba'i sde pa'i dge slong / nang gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rim pa gnyis kyi mtshan bcas dang / mtshan ped kyi rnal 'byor la brtson khul du byed pas rig pa 'dzin pa/ ming ni 'phags yul kyi snyan ngag mkhan chen pa dkas/ ngag gi rang bzhin de dag kyang / / legs sbyar de ba'in rang bzhin dang / / zur chag 'dren ma zhes pa ste/ / rnam pa ba'i ru mkhas pas gsungs/ / zhes 'phags yul du skad rigs chen po bzhi dang / legs sbyar lha'i skad du/ wa grin du ma rda rma gi rti pā ra/ mdzod shri bi rgya rta ra si rda ka sbya tsa mu/ ke la sha'i sa 'dzin gyi phreng bas dum bu gceg tu bskor ba'i byang phyogs bhe ṭa'i rgyal khams 'dir ngag dbang blo bzang chos grags rgya mtsho 'jam dpal rig 'dzin grub pa'i sder grags shing / tshe ring rnam gyi gshe mong btsan pos/ dzam bu ljon pas mtshon pa'i sa steng yongs la —— 324 —

stobs kyi 'khor los dbang bsgyur ba gnam bskos 'jam dpal dbyangs gong ma rgyal po'i lung gis paṇa chen er te nir bsngags pa/ nges par thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po nas rtsis pa'i gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi 'jigs bral gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser gyi khri la 'khod pa'i mkhan rab nyi shu pas phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang po'i bca' yig rin po che paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zur 'debs grwa rgyun skor la bstsal ba'i dpyad mtshams le tshan/ lo chen sprul sku stobs ldan dpa' bo chen pos bstsal ba'i bca' yig de nang bzhin mkhan slob thams cad kyis tshul mthun mdzad rgyu'i phyag rtags 'byar ba'i bca' sgrig paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam rgyal dpal bzang pos sa 'brug lo bstsal ba'i thugs dam cig dang /chu stag lo bstsal ba'i thugs dam gcig ste le tshan gnyis shing yos lo mdzod pa no min han spyi dus sgrig lam spyi dang / khya/ da par bun bskyed gtong gi skor la gsar blangs gan rgya 'doms che ba/ mdzod pa blo bzang rnam rgyal gyi dus mkhan slob thams cad zhal bstun pa'i bca' sgrig sogs gdan rabs gong ma na rim dang / mdzod pa rim can gyi bca' sgrig sogs chos khrims khang dang / ja rgyab nga ri sar yod pa'i yig gzhi gong ma kha 'thor du bzhugs pa rnams rtsa ba'i sa/'ir bzung dus snga phyi'i dbang gi tshig rdo/na 'gal ba rnams deng sang si/ dus su dgag bya dang / dgos pa gang che ba de'i dbang du btang / ja rgyab pa brgyud grwa tshang bzhi dang / chos khri/ mas khang bcas par sgrig lam bshad rtsod gang sar smon pa'i thabs tshul ji ltar byas na legs —— pa rte25 —

dgongs len nan tan zhus pa'i bka' lan shog lho bstsal ba la yang zhib tu dpyad nas snon 'os pa rnams bsnan/ lhag par sgrig spo rgyu'i skor dang ming btags sprod mtshams kyi skor rnams ha cang 'dzog che bas dwogs pa chod dka' ba rnams bka' chen dge slong chos grags bzang po grwa tshang khag dang chos khrims bcas par bslab ston zhu bar ched btang gis bka' lan byung ba rnams la 'os mi 'os zhib tu dpyad nas legs pa'i cha rnams bkod/ snga dus kyi sgrig lam skor bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin dam pa de nyid kyi gsung las ji ltar thos pa yid yul du gang zin rnams dang / bzhad pa tshogs gsog pa ye shes tshe brtan sogs rgan rab rnams kyi ngag gros khungs ma las byung ba dag gis kyang zur rgyan sgrig lam kun spyod bshad rtsod gang sar 'di ltar byas na ban thogs che snyam pa rang gi yid yul du 'char ba dga' zhig kyang bsnan/'gor chos 'byung lo rgyus kyi rim pa rags bsdus zhig rang cag gi bstan pa'i chos 'byung bo bye zhwa ser po'i me long sogs las bsdus te mkhas pa rnams dgyes pa'i mchod yon du bsgrengs/ gzhan yang zur mkhar blo gros rgyal pos/rgyal po lang tshos dregs gyur kyang / /rgyan med pa ni skye bos gleng / /de bzhin snyan ngag mi ldan pa'i/ /bstan bcos mkhas la rtsis su ped/ / ces pa ltar/'og mjug gnyis su grong gtam sprangs te rgya gar mkhas pa can gyi mkhas pa'i dbang po dbyug pa can gyi gzhung lugs las drangs pa'i snyan tshig gi me hog kyang cung zad 'thor ba dang bcas slad nas 'dul khrims bshad rtsod blang dor gang sar yig cha mang po 'tshol dgos pa'i blang dor mtha' dag yig cha gcig gi steng nas byas chog pa'i khul du cho babs su bkod pa 'di ni rnam par snang mdzad gangs can mtsho'i phyag gi lhungs bzed du pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru nyi — 326 ——

shu rtsa lnga la 'jig rten gyi khams rab 'byams re gnas par gsungs pa ltar 'og ma 'jig rten gyi khams dpal 'byung nas steng du rim par brtsigs pa'i bzu gsum la 'jig rten gyi khams kyi mdzes ces bya ba/ de la dbus su ri rab/ phyogs gzhir gling bzhi gling g.yog gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa las/lho'i gling mi rnams tshe tshad ma nges shing / lus kyi bong tshad khru bzhi pa/ las dang 'tsho ba'i zas sogs gling gzhan dang cha mthun zhing / khyad chos nor dang 'bru la nyo tshong gi gtso bor byed cing / mtsho ma dros pa'i 'gram na shing dzam bu ṭi kā zhes bya ba yod de/ de'i 'bras bu smin pa ja ma tsam pa mtsho der lhungs pa'i sgra las dzam zhes pa byung bas 'dzam bu gling du grags shing / de yang dza na skye ba la'o zhes pa'i byings bzhag na'i a brjod don yin pas phyis/ bu ka rkyen du byin/ ka la yan bzhin 'ang sogs kyis ka phyis/ sa byen sa mi zad pas phyis pas/ de'i sde sa la sde pa'i mtha' thos na mar bsgyur bas 'dzam bu zhes pa lus can skye ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i gling 'di nyid gling gzhan thams cad las khyad par 'phags pa yin te/ bskal pa chags 'jig gi tshe na'ang 'jig par mi nus pa'i dbus 'gyur rdo rje gdan la gha rtad byang chub kyi shing la sbu rgyab rten ste dus gsum sangs rgyas spyi dang khyad par skal pa bzang po 'di la sangs rgyas stong dang snga spyod pa thams cad kyi bdud rtse bsnyes shing mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul bstan pa'i gnas yin zhing der ma zad/ rgya cher rol pa las/ gnas der nga yi mchod sbyan stong phrag bye ba khrag khrig bzhi bcu byas/ / der ni sangs rgyas bye ba phrag khrig stong phrag drug cu de dag mchod/ / wa ra ṇa si de ni sngon gyi drang srong rnams kyi ga/nas/ /zhes wa ra ṇa sir bdag cag gi ston pa slob pa lam gyi gnas skabs su mchod —— 327 —

sbyin stong phrag bye ba phrag khrig bzhi bcu mdzad pa dang / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig stong phrag drug cu la mchod pa mdzad pa bdag cag gi ston pa nyid kyi thugs kyis dran par gsu ngas pas gling 'di nyid sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku thams cad kyi zhing khams lta bur 'dod dgos pa 'dra zhing / ga'an yang gling 'di nyid kyi phyogs bzhir mi 'gyur ba'i gzer chen bzhi zhes shar phyogs rgya nag gi yul du rgyal ba thams cad kyi mkhyen pa'i spyi gzugs rje btsun smra ba'i lha mchog shing ṭi sha'i lnga ba las 'khrungs te gtsug lag rtsis kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa'i gnas ri bo rtse lnga/ lho phyogs su bdag cag gi ston pa zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bskur bzhengs te tshas rgyal zla ba bzang po la sogs pa'i sgod ldan gyi gdul bya la dang po'i sangs rgyas gnyis med dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud gsung ba'i gnas de'i thugs gsung sku'i dkyil 'khor ye shes ba ma bsdus bar bzhugs pa dang bcas pa'i dbal ldan so ba'i phung po'i mchod rten dang / 'phags mchog phyag na pad+ma'i khams ri bo gru 'dzin/nub tu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde thams cad kyi 'byung gnas o rgyan rdo rje 'chang gi pho brang he ru ka rang byung gi gtsug lag khang / byang du sprul pa'i chos rgyal bdun dang rigs ldan nyi shu rtsa lngas dam pa dang po'i sangs rgyas kyi lam la brten nas 'ing khams de'i bskal ldan gyi yid can rnams smin sgrol gyi lam la bkod cing 'god par mdzad bzhin pa dang / ma 'ongs pa na kla klo'i dpung tshogs ming gi lhag mar byas te mi 'gyur sa chen dum bu bcu gnyis dbang du bsdus nas rdzogs ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston 'gyed pa po drag po 'khor lo can byung ba'i gnas sham bha ste mi 'gyur ba'i zer chen bzhi/gzhan yang yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ gnas sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dur khrod chen/ po — 328 — —

brgyad sogs ma tshogs mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin du 'du ba'i gnas de dag gis mtshon brjod kyis mi lang ba'i yon tan du mas spud pa'i gling chen po 'di nyid du yul 'khor lnga brgya/ ljongs chen po bcu drug yul phran stong / mi rigs mi gcig pa sum brgya drug hru/ skad rigs mi gcig pa bdun brgya nyi shu sogs yod par gsungs pa las/ lha mo dri ma med kyis zhus pa'i mdo 'gyur mi 'dra ba zhig tu/ nga mya ngan las 'das te lo nyis stong lnga brgya na gdong dmar can gyi yul du dam pa'i chos rgyas par 'gyur ro zhes dang /mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi rdo rje'i glur/ / shar rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na/gnas pur rgyal bod ces bya ba yod/ / ri mthon po gnam gyi ka ba yod/mtsho dma' po g.yu yi maṇ+ḍal yod/ / gangs dkar po shel gyi mchod rten yod/ / spang ser po gser gyi lhun po yod/ /dri zhim po sman gyi bdug spos yod/ / ston bkra ba gser gyi me tog yod/ / dbyar bkra ba g.yu yi me tog yod/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ /gnas de na khyod kyi zhing khams yod/ /zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan rigs gzigs/ /ri pad+ma stong ldan dbyibs legs pa/ /dus dgun gsum dkar po shel gyi mdog / dus dbyar gsum sngon po g.yu yi mdog / dus ston gsum ser po gser gyi mdog dus dpyid gsum khra bo gzi yi mdogamadog phun sum tshogs pa'i ri bo la/ /ltas khyad bar 'phags pa'i mtshan ma yod/ /dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba la/ /dar dmar po ra gi cod pan yod/ /mi khyed kyi bstan pa phyogs bcur 'phel/ / dpal be'u sa ri skyes brgyan pa la/ /nag bkris yal 'dab rgyas pa yo/da/ /mi khyed kyi bu slob phyogs bcur 'phel/ /ri bogs chad g.yu yi bum pa la/ /chu yan lag brgyad ldan chu —— 329 ——

mig 'bab/ /mi khyod kyi thugs rjes bsil bar byed/ / gnam sngon mo g.yu bya'i gdugs su phub/ /las nyon mongs tshad pa zhi bar byed/ /mi khyod kyi dge bshes 'phel ba'i rtags/ /ri zur gsum brag gzhung gnam du mtho/ /nged mkha' 'gro'i rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba 'dra/ /mi khyod kyi bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan spel/ /sa rtse brgyad lung pa phyogs su gyes/ /kye 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad phub pa 'dra/ /mi khyod kyi mi mthun gcod pa'i rtags/ / thang chen po'i dkyil na ri chung nyal/ /mtsho chen po'i nang gi nya mo 'dra/ /mi khyod kyi spyan mnga' 'phel ba'i rtags/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ mi khyod kyi zhing khams de na yod/ / zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ 'bru sna tshogs smin pa'i zhing sa can/ / 'bru bang mdzod rgyas pa'i rtags su bzang / / shing sna tshogs skyes pa nag/sa kyi khrod/ / gnas khang bzang 'phel ba'i rtags su bzang / / chu mi che rgya mtsho chen po yod/ / chu mi chung rgya mtshor dpag med 'bab/ /chu snyoms pas yul mi rtag tu bde/ / kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan ras gzigs/ / gnas de na khyod kyi zhing khams yin/ / zhing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ /shar lhun po'i rtse nas nyi ma 'char/ /phyos/sa ga 'a/na gsum mi nor shugs la shes/ /'char mi snga sru dus bsam gtan 'phel/ /'char mi byi nyi 'od smin pa la/ /lus bag phebs bde bar spyod par byed/ / rga/sa mi snga pho rab bdun stong 'phel/ / rgas mi 'chi mdzangs ma'i las rnams bsgrub/ /kye gangs ri'i mgon po spyan/ ras gzigs/ / yul bkra shis 'byung de khrod kyi zhing / / 'ing de na khyod kyi gdul bya yod/ / las skal ldan bsod nams bsags pa'i mi/ / chos dge bcu'i 'od zer spro bar byed/ / ces rdo rje'i glu blangs pa dang / bla ma'i 'al nas/ rje rgyal ba rnams kyis lung bstan pa'i/ —— 330 ——

yul byang phyog/sa/ kha ba can ljongs na/ dbyibs pad+ma sto/nga ldan kha phye ba/bdan de /la phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba bzhugs/ sra/sa thugs rje chen ngo/sa byin pyis rlobs/ zhes byang phyogs sto ṭa'i ljongs 'di nyid ni lha lda na/ gyi sa dpyad dang bcas / 'phas/sa mtshag 'jig rten dbang phyug gi 'dul zhing du lung bstan 'ing // rnam /'dren bu ram 'ing pas kyang 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyus la bod kha ba can gyi rgyal khams su thog mar mi'i 'gro ba spel la phyin nas dam nga/'i chos da/ra bar gyis shig ces bka' bsgos pa ltar/'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug gis kyang de bzhin du zhal gyis bzhes te thog mar kha ba can gyi mtsho rim gyis bre ba dang / de rjes spre'u dang brag srin tshogs pa las mi'i 'gro ba mched cing / de rjes dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes pa dang srol btod pa dang dar rgyas su mdzad pa sogs 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i 'phrin las las byung ba rag bsdus tsam gong du bkod pa ltar dang / rgyas pa gzhan las shes par 'gyur zhing / de ltar gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mdo sngags kyi dam pa'i chos ches dar bar gyur cing /'khor rnam bzhi yang phal cher tshang ba dang / gzhan yang khro phu lo tsā ba byams nga/ dpal gyis kha che'i bsod nams pa chen po shākya shri gdan 'dren pa'i pho nya mngags pa'i zhu shog tu/ ma ga rda sogs rig 'byung gnas ni sdig to yi/ dmag tshogs kyis bcom o rgyan kha che bal yul yang / log spyod kyis gang deng sang bstan srog las gnas ni/ bod yul 'dir bzang skyes chen byang phyogs 'a/bas bskyod zhu/ zhes gsungs pa la brtags na bod yul 'di chos tshigs kyi dbang du byas pa'i yul dbus yin par dwogs pa ma dgos shing /g.yin yang bod kyi sa bkra srin mo gan rkyal du gnas pas snying steng dga' bzhi —— 331 —

'khru/ snye pa/ ldang za/ tsa/tsus la sa/ khang mtha' 'du pa ma nga du' rgyu ga na gyi sa/tsus 'a ba khang zam sa dang // bas ma 4 sa / dmi1 'gyur lhu ma/ gyis grub pa'i sa/tsus las// ga pa nya / nga/pal e rgyam/ chen ngo sa byem gyis/ brlabs nga —che sku sa/sung thugs rdzams kyi ba/ben bams sogs/ gams/ chen byad nga ra cam/ tshan / /sa/ kyis/ mtshon bge/ mtsham/ ma lus nga1 byur bur spungs pa'i ngu ra rgyal bod kyi/ rgyal khams /'di/ la sngon spru chos rgya' mi dngo na rdzam po/sum4 gyi rkye ring la skor gsum du ba'i/// khams gsum du dbye ba 'a/sa sto/da ra/nga 'a ris smo /ra sa/sum mi/ spu rang / mang yu/rā // bzang la tsa/sum zher slor ga/ cib/ 'i / bru —/za1 sbal ti sa//sum la sko ra gcig 'a/nga zhung / khri/ ste/ sto da mi da gsum 'a/ sko ra bcig/ ste mnga' ri/sa sror gsu ma/ dbus la dbu ru dang / g.yo ru ga/nyes// ga/tsang la sa/yas rā dang / ru 'a/sa/ tsa/nyis te dbu btsang ba'i/ mdo khams 'a/ mi da khams/ btab/sa pa la/ mas gcig mdo mi da g.yar mo thang btags pa khams ga/cigabong kha la gī thang btags pa kha/ mas gcis// ste mid khams gsum rjams su dbye ba las// dbus gtsang ru ba'i 'i ya gya' g.yas ru'i char tsa/togs pa/ bar skabs bod la chos kha gsum zhes pa'i tha snyad byung ste/ stod mnga' ris gung thang nas sog la skya bo yan dbus gtsang dam pa'i chos kyi chol kha/ sog la skya bo nas rma chu'i khug pa yan mdo stod mgo nag mi'i chol kha/ rma chu'i khug pa nas rgya mchod rten dkar po yan mdo smad dud 'gro rta'i chol kha ste gsum las dbus gtsang dam pa chos kyi chol khar gtogs pa'i yul gru/ de yang gong du drangs pa'i bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung du/ chos dge ba bcu yis khyad 'phags pa zhes pa'i dge ba bcu ni/ khang sa 'ing sa sa yi dge/'thung chu zhi/nga chu chu yi dge/ gam 'brog rgyang 'brog rtswa yi dge/ khang shing ——— 332 ——

sgyud shing 'ing ge/ dbo// long rdo 'thag rdo rdo yi dge ste / dge/ ba bcu ma lus nga ra 'o/ngas su/ rdzogs par tshang shing // ga/zhan yang sa//nam la 'khor lo rtsi bas brgyad// sa la nga/ma 'dab brgyu/da/ log/sa la bkri/ru5/ rtag/sa brgyad tshang bar ga/nas shing / shar gyi stag skya bo/ lho'i g.yu 'brus// sngon mo// nub kyi bya dmar po/ byang rga/ rus sbal nag ngo ste/ gtsug/ lag khang gi lha bzhin) spa ba dang bcas nga // ga'i/sa la/ bas ma grub rtse dang zung du 'brel ba'i lha zhol/rgya dal/ra nag zla pa la/ ka smir/ dbus ga/tsang / mnga' ris/bod chen po'i rgyal khams pa sogs skad rigs dang mi rigs mi gcig pa du ma 'du ba'i tshong 'dus dang bcas/ chos bsgrub pa'i ma thun rkyen mkho dgu'i yo byad thams cad 'bad med bde blag ldun grub tu 'byung ba/ myang smad kyi sa'i cha phyi rig pa'i gnas chen po bcu phrag tu longs pa thugs su chud pa'i mkhas pa mahwa nga/ṇ+ḍi ta dang / nang gsang sbas/sa rdo rje thegs pa'i ma la rten nas grub pa'i go 'phangs mthon por gshegs pa du ma bste ba'i gnas/bskal pa dgu brgya dgu bcu rtsa gcig gi snga rol du sangs rgyas 'od mdzad ye shes tog gi spyan sngar me tog ut+pal dang gser gyi dong rtse phul nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de/ rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum gyi mdzad pa mtha' dag mthar phyin nas bla na med pa'i 'bras bu mngon du mdzad pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ rig pa dang zhabs su ldan ba/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lor sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal rtsegs rgyal po rtsod ldan snyigs ma lnga ches cher bdo ba'i gdul bya rnams rjes su bzung ——— 333 ——

ba'i slad du dge slong rdo rje 'dzin/ nga 'i zlos sar bsgyud ba nges/ pa ngom gyi thams cad mkhyen pa chen/ ngo dge/ 'dun grub nga/ dpal bzang ngo/sa phyag 'debs par ma dzad nga/'i ga/da/na sa chos grwa chen po bkris lhun po dang/la spru sde chen phyogs thams cad las rjam rnga/ra rgyal ba'i gling gi da/ge 'dun 'du ba'i gtsug lag/ khang dri'i gtsang khang dang bcas nga dang zung du 'brel ba ma las pa'i yo/na tan kun gyis phyug/ cing / grub pa'i /bor/ ra los bsgyur ba/ri ma/khan rgyud rin po che ma rim pyis dam nga /'i chos/ 'a 'chad rtsod rtsol sa/su ma/ thos bsam sgo ma gsum gyi sgo nas rgyal ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa la bya ba rlabs po che mdzad pa'i gnas dam ba'i chos kyi gtsug lag/ khang / lus/sa zung khrims kyi 'khor los mnga' dbang bsgyur te legs pa la sa/zengs bstod cing / khrims las 'das pa'i nyes can la 'chad/ pa chos dang mthun pa'i tshar ba/cong// nga/'i gnas/ sa la spyod pa'i rgyal po'i ba sgam/ ma tshogs mkha' 'gro sprin bzhin du 'du zhing 'jam dpal dus grwa'i dbang po'i rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu zhol bas 'khor 'das kyi phyag rgya ma lus pa zil gyis gnon zhi/nga / gang la gang 'tshams pa'i 'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dpal dang ldan pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rdo rjes srid pa gsum gyi 'jigs pa thams cad kyang 'jig par byed pa'i rig pa 'dzin pa'i pho brang / chos min gyi g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos kyi mtshan ma mthor por bsgreng ba'am lugs gnyis kyi khrims las 'das pa'i rgol ba ngan ba'i g.yul las nom par rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags kyi mtshan ma'i dar chen mthon por 'phyar ba 'am/ spyi sger gyi bstan srid dge 'dun gyi sde dang bcas pa rnam par 'khu ba'i nag po'i sems 'chang dgra bgegs kyi dpung tshogs ming gi lhag mar bcom ste/ de dag las rgyal ba'i dpal —— 334 ———

'i/tsham 3 byed3 ngo nga ba sgrengs — — 〉:re lus/mu 4 zwang bu pho brang chem pe(/'i ga/zi/ma chung da nga/ bza— sa kyi /lha gnas rtses/sdum pa ra/sa//'a lda na ngang ba//nyis su ped pa 3rte ma thum pa'i rtsa/tsham ma thams cad las rnar/ par rgya' 'ing / rgyal tshab mi/ pham ma gon po'i pho brang sa la /'phos pa lta bu'i sang nger/ bdag/ cas gi ston nga rjam 'drem/ du/ ram 'ing rwa/ rdon grub ces nga/ sa rngo/ 'u/ga gi lo'i chu sto da zla ba'i lha la nga/ga 'a lda ma gyi sa/mas las/ glang chem/ dkar po'i zol gyis 'phos te/ rgyal rtsi pe/ma ྅ ro/ sgyu 'phrul ma/bi/ ldums su zhus/ru1 te drab/ po zhes rnga/ nyu ba//rā/ pho spre'u'i lo/ 'i sa ba zla ba'i tshes‘ bdun/ la lum bi'i tsha' du spu bldams te rgyal nga 'es/ nga/ 'ing rta ma/ tsa/'i tshes bco lnga la byang chub kyi ming gre dung du/ rdo rje'i min par po krung bcan5/ rte sro sa 1ma bdud btul/ rdo rje'i rnal —'byor zug/sa tho rengs ma ngon par rdzos/sa pa sangs rgyas te lo de'i chu sto/da zla ba'i tshes bzhi la 'jis/ rten gyi byed po tshangs pa dang / brgya sbyin gyi gsol ba btab nga 'i ngor wa ra ṇa sir lnga sde bzang po la thog mar bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas bgrang bya nyis stong brgyad brgya dang gnyis 'das pa/ de'i bstan pa gnas pa'i tshad ni/ myang 'das chen po las/ rigs kyi bu sbrang pha mchu snyung gi mchus rgya mtsho'i gting du ma lus par thug ces zer ba'i bla'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dam pa'i chos nub zhes mi bya'o/ rlung dras// po 'gas pas bcing du rung ngo zhes zer yang bla'i/ de bzhi/na gshegs pa'i chos ba nub bo zhes mi bya'o/ri rab ri'i rgyal po la kha'i dbugs kyis sbus te zhig drung gyel zer yang bla'i/de bzhin ga/shes/sa pa'i chos nub bo zhes mi bya'o/ me thab ta la zhes bya ba'i nang nas pad+mo skyes zhes zer yang bla'i/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa'i chos nub bo zhes mi bya'o/ zla ba ni tsha la nyi ma ni bsil la zhes zer yang bla'i/ de ——— 335 —— —

ba'i ma sa//thegs pa'i tshas nub bo 'em mi bya'o1/ zhes dang / yid ba'en zam par bkod nga/'i rgyud 0/ sa sems/ can ku/ na gī tshogs chen po // ji prid rdza/ma nga/ra sa//nas de srid// 4she ngas/ rgyas spru(7/ nga rgyum mi chad / gro'/ bo'i chos/ kyang nub pa meb/ / ces/ nges pa'i rdon du sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dus 'khor ba ji srid ma/ sto/nga gi bar du nam/ nga/nga nub par mi 'gyur yang de bzhin gshes/sa nga/ ni ska/da ceg la bskal pa dang bskal pa skad cig mar ston nub pa'i mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bas/ma gyi mi khyab pas 'gro ba ra)nga rang gi bsam pa dang mthun par 'pho ba dang / ldums su zhugs pa dang / bltams pa dang /btsun mo'i 'khor gyis rol nga/ nga/nga / khyem las phyung ba dang / dka' ba dpyod pa dang // mngon/ par rdzos/sa pa sa ngas/ rgyas nga dang / tshas kyi 'khor lo bsko/ra ba dang / yongs su mya ngan/ las 'da' ba'i tshul ston cing / dam nga/'i chos zhig cing nub pa das kyang stom/ nga/sa rang cas// rnams kyi mos/ bor sgron bskal las mun bska/la yun ring 'ing—mang bar mdo/ dang bstan bcos khungs ma du mar bshad la de bas ma rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid kyi gnas tshad kyang gdul bya so so'i mos blo'i dbang gi/sa gcig tu ma nges te mdo bskal bzang du lo lnga brgya gnas bar bshad pa dang / 'dul ba lung phran tshegs sogs su lo stong dang / myang 'das su lo stong dang brgya/ting nge 'dzin dam pa'i mdor lo stong dang sa/sum brgya/ snying rje pad+ma dkar po'i bam po bcu pa bram ze rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi smon lam chen po lnga brgya par lo stong dang lnga brgyar bshad/ cing / zla ba snyeng pos zhus pa'i mdor lo nyis stong / rgya sa/ra gyi slob dpon a bha yas mdzad pa'i thub pa'i dbro/ngas rgyan sogs su lo nyi stong lnga brgya/ dka pa ma'i 'bum ṭīka tu lo lnga stong /—— 336 ——

nga la rbo phyir mi 'ong ba'o / sa/sum nga/ 'a/ ni rgyum du zhugs4 nga/'o// ba'i nga la ni lhab ma/thong ngo // lnga nga 'a/ mi ting nge 'dzin no/ drus// pa /7/ mi tshul /lbi/ mas so / bdun pa la dri chos ma nge ma ba 'o༈/ brgyad nga la ni mdo sde'o/ dgu pa la ni 'bul ba'o/ lnga brgya nga phrag/ bcu la ni rtags tsam mo// de lda bu 'a —lnga brgya/ mtha' ma 'es bya'o/ —za brgya zhes bya ba khag gcig ga/'a/na du 'bo/na te/ lnga brgya zhes bya ba'i ring ngo bor ba'o zhes zer no1/ gzhan da/sa la ni /'di skad smra ste/ mi rnams la ni tshe tshad lo brgya yin no// de la drang po'i lnga bcu la ni la dos/ dang / gzus/sa dang / stobs dang / shes rab la/ sogs/ nga/ 'phel bar 'gyur ba yin no// phyed phyi ma'i lnga bcu la ni de dag rim gyis 'grib par 'gyur ba yin no// de bzhin du /'jig rten thams cad kyi dus kyi mtha' ma/ la babs pa'i tshe phyed phyi ma'i lnga bcu'i mtha' ma la babs pa dang 'dra bar mtha' mar gyur pa dam pa'i chos nub par 'gyur ba'i dus kyi tshe mdzan par dzogs par nub par 'gyur ba'i dus na ma ngon par rtogs pa yod par mi 'gyur ro/ lung gi/ chos kyang 'dri ba dang / 'drir 'jug pa dang /klog pa dang / 'don/ pa la sogs pa la nyon mongs pa dang / grogs ngan pa la sogs nga sa kun nas dkrug pas 'jig rten rnams 'jug par mi 'gyur ro/de lta bur gyur pa ni nub nga 'o/ zhes nga 'i don ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pa zas gtsang sras po'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad lo lnga stong du bshad pa 'di nyid grags che zhing / don la yang gnas pas de'i tshul cung zad bshad na/'bras bu'i dus / bsgrub nga/'i dus// lung gi dus/ rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i dus rnams las/ 'bras bu'i dus la chig stong lnga brgya/ bsgrub pa'i dus la chig stong lnga brgya/ lung si/ dus la chig/ stong lnga brgya/ rtags tsam — — 338 la

'dzin pa lnga brgya ste bsdoms pas lnga stong / de yang so sor phye na/ 'bras bu'i dus la nang gses kyi dgra bcom pa'i dus la lnga brgya/ phyir mi 'ong ba'i dus la lnga brgya/ rgyun du bzhugs pa'i dus la lnga brgya ste bsdoms pas 'bras bu'i dus kyi chig stong lnga brgya/ bsgrub pa'i dus la yang nang gses kyi lhag mthong gi dus la lnga brgya/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dus la lnga brgya/ tshul khrims kyi dus la lnga brgya ste bsdoms pas bsgrub pa'i dus kyi chig stong lnga brgya/ lung gi dus la yang nang gses kyi mngon pa'i sde sgod kyi dus la lnga brgya/ mdo sde'i sde sgod kyi dus la lnga brgya/ 'dul ba'i sde stsod kyi dus la lnga brgya ste lung gi dus kyi chis/ stong lnga brgya/ rtags tsam 'dzin/ pa lnga brgya pa phrag gcis/ ste thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms na lnga stong du 'gyur ba las nyan thos/phyir mi 'ong / rgyun zhugs te 'bras bu'i dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag gsum dang /bsgrub pa'i dus kyi steng na/sa lhag// mthong dang / ting nge 'dzin/ gyi lnga brgya pa phrag gnyis dang / tshul khrems kyi le'u'i steng nas lo nyis brgya dang lnga bcu nga drug 'das te bsdoms pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad kyi steng nas lo nyis stong bdun brgya lnga bcu nga drug 'das shing / lhag ma mngon pa mdo sde 'dul ba ste/ lung gi dus kyi lnga brgya pa phrag ga/sum dang / rtags tsam 'dzin rnge brgya pa phrag gcig tshul khrims kyi le'u'i lo 'phros nyis brgya ba'i bcu zhe ba'i ste phyogs gcig tu bsdoms pa'i bstan pa'i gnas tshad yongs su rdzogs nga ra 'gyur gyi bar la lo nyis stong nyis brgya bzhi bcu zhe ba'i 'dus pa/ dngos po jes pa shing khyi lor chos rgyal tho tho ri'i snyal shal bltams nas/ rnam rgyal zhis nga/ chu sprul lor pho brang yum bu'i steng spang skong phyag rgya pa dang / mdo sde za ma tog sogs babs nas dam pa'i chos kyi dbu brnyes te lo chig stong lnga —— 339 — —

brgya ba'i/ bcu zhe gsum 'das pa 'gal ba zhes pa sa glang lor 'jig rten dbang phyug srong btsan sgam po bltams shing / bag med ces pa chu glang lor bod yu/la rdo rje gdan lha ldan sprul pa'i gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa bzhengs nas lo chig stong nyis brgya nyer gsum 'das pa/ rab myos zhes pa lcas/sa rta lo 'jam dpal dbyangs khri srong lde'u btsan bltams nas /dgal ba zhes pa sa glang lor sangs rgyas gnyis pa o rgyan chen ngo spyan drangs te/ bong bu zhes pa lcags yos lor zan yangs mi 'gyur ldun gyis grub pa'i gtsug las/ khang btab nas lo chig stong brgya dang nyi shu rtsa lnga 'das pa/ mi zad ces pa me pho khyi'i lor dpal ga/sang ba'i bdag po'i rnam sprul mnga' bdag khri/ ral can bltams nas lo chig/ stong dang bcu 'das pa/ sna tshos/sa zhi/sa pa chu pho rta lo'i lor dpal mnyam med dī pam ka ra bltams 'i/nga /rgyal ba zhes pa shing pho rta'i lor mdzad pa mtha' ma bstan nas lo brgyad brgya dang nyer gnyis 'das pa/ khro cho/ zhes pa shing 'brug lor 'phab/sa mchog/ 'jis/ rten dbang phyug 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bltams te/gser 'phyang zhes pa pe bya lor/ dpal ra bsgrengs kyi dben/ gnas btab te lo brgyad brgya dang bcu dgu 'das pa/ ting ye'u zhes pa me bya'i lor mdo smad/ rtsang kha'i yul grur rgyal kun ma/byen pa'i rang gzus/sa rje btsun bstan pa'i 'khor lo mi'i srid pa bzung ba rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang gras/sa pa'i dpal bltams nas/ 'ga'/ ba zhes nga sa glang lor lha ldan/ smon lam chen mo btsugs thing / gam/sa che'o/ po ri bo dge ldan btab/ bsgyur byed ces nga1/ sa phag lor skye bo las kyi sgreb pas g.yo/gas pa rna/ma sa kyi ngor dga' lngan du rje btsun mi pham mgon po'i thugs kar thims nas lo bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu nga —— 340 ———

bdun 'das pa/ skyes bdag ces pa lcags mo lug lor nges pa thams cad mkhyen pa phyag na pad dkar 'chang ba dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang bo bltams shing / rab byung zhes pa me yos lor chos grwa chen po bkra shis lhun po dpal thu sde chen phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i gling 'di nyid btab nas lo bzhi brgya dang nyi shu rtsa dgu 'das pa/ dmar ser can zhes pa pe sprul lor de bzhin gshegs pa 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal rtsegs rgyal po rtsod ldan gyi gdu'/ bya rnams sgrol ba'i slad du sdoms brtson rgyal po'i skur bstan pa mdo sngags phyi nang gi 'e/sa bya mtha' dag rig pa rgyal ba'i dbang po ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho bltams shing / khyu mchog ces pa lcags sbrul lo/ra gsang ba'i bdag po mi'i zlos gar bsgyur ba bstan/ 'dzin chos kyi rgyal pos bod khams yongs la dbang bsgyur te/ tsi tra zhes pa chu rta lor rgyal dbang thams cang mkhyen pa chen po'i chab 'bangs su phul rte sngon byon chos rgyal mes dbon gyi mdzad pa bdag gir bzhes pa nas /ro nyis brgya dang sum hru so bzhi 'das pa/ srin bu zhes pa shing mo yos lor kho bo cag btsas nas lo nyi shu rtsa gcig 'das shing / blo ngan zhes pa lcags mo bya lor thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun grub pa dpal bzang ngo/ 'jigs med gdong lnga'i khri la 'khod nas lo bco lnga 'das te/ da lta mchog gsum gyi byin mthur sgo gsum ga/sar 'tshes ma gos par g.yo ba med pa 'khod nas spyi sber bstan pa dang da/ge 'dun gyi sder sman/ pa'i lhag bsam gong nas gong 'phel gyi tshul du gnas bzhin pa/ skyes bu'i tshe tshad 'phel 'grib kyi skor gzhan du gsal ba ma mthong yang / lnga 'gyur phyogs su thang yig las/ lo ni brgya brgya dag la lan re 'breḥ ཿtshe lo bcu pa da/ la mthil du thugaḥces dang / kun mkhyen klong chen —— 341 —

rab 'byams phas/ /lo brgya song nas gcig 'phel dang / /brgya nas gcig ni bri bar bshad/ / ces tshe lo yar 'phel gyi dus su lo brgya brgya nas re re 'phel ba dang / mar 'grib kyi dus su yang lo brgya brgya nas re re 'bri bar bshad pas rnam 'dren bu ram shing pa tshe lo brgya pa'i dus su byon pa nas lo brgya phrag nyi shu rtsa brgyad 'das shing / brgya phrag re nas lo re bre bas deng skabs skye bu'i tshe tshad bdun cu don gnyis kyi steng du slebs nas lo sum hru so drug 'das pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang mtshan 'phags yul gyi sgad du rji ru shar phyogs kyi rgyal khab chen por be tsir grags pa ke la sha'i sa 'dzin gyis bskor ba'i byang phyogs kyi rgyal khams 'dir 'dzin byed ces 'bod pa me pho byi ba'i lo'i nam mkha' thod ldan ma'i zla ba'i gang phyogs kyi rgyal ba dang po res ga/za' lus dmar// rgyu skar dbo/ spyor ba me rlung / spyor chen bye dgu sogs gza' za/ra 'phrod spyor phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin gyi phyed snga cha'i bdud rtsi thun mtshams kyi thog mjug yongs su rdzos/sa par 'bad ba chen/ pos bres/skyabs mgon thams cad mkhye/ na nga chen po nas spyi sbe/ra gyi bstan nga dang //bye brag rang re'i gdan sa chen po de nyid kyi lugs zung gi lar rgya thub/sa kyis ma bor bar 'dul khrims kyi skor la bstsal ba'i bca' yig rin po che bo/nga si dbo/ngas don las phyob//sa dus sa/nas skabs thams cad du nam yang mi 'as la bar sdig spong dbe// sgrub kyis/ nyam/sa len 'phyug/ med rgyun 'khyongs/ su yong ba mdzod/ phyag/ mdzod nas me bye/ zla 7tshes 2la/ / / / / 342

kun gling rgyal thog gnyis pasaXse 'bras dga' dang rgyud grwa stod smad sogasaXdagon khag gi dge 'dun pas nag chang sogs mi dge ba'i spyod tshul dang chas gos khyem pa spyi mtshungs byed mkhan ma lta rtog 'jug gnon dgos pa'i rtsa chigabod chu rta/ ( spyi lo 1ka'i 2 )tho don / gdan sa chen po gsum dang rgyud stod smad sogs kyis gtsos dge 'dun kyi sde spyi'i mkhan po/ bla ma/ slob dpon sog//sa las sne spyi dang khyad nga/ra lha zhol gyi gnyer mi dpon dang bcas bya ba zhi drag gi sne mor mngags slebs dmangs dang bcas pa rnams la springs pa/ 'jig rten/ gī khams su bde spyid 'byung ba'i rtsa ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che la rag lus shing // sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yong min dge 'dun kyi sde rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub 'phel ba dgo/ru/ pa skye bo kun gyis shes pa de ltar la gzhigs pa'i gzhung sa nas da phan lo lo'i rtsa tshig thum mo che dang / dmigs bsal gdan sa chen po sogs la 'dul khrims la gces spras/ kyi dam bsgrags byed dgos yang dang yang du song ba de — — 3‘13 —

ltar yin kyang / chos skad dang snyan jag gi lam nas drangs pa'i tshig mdzes drags pa'i skyon yin nam/ rtsa tshig la rjes gnon ji bzhin ma byung bas mdzes lam la bzhag pa'i skyon yin gang ltar ser skya sne mo ba rnams nas rna ba 'dred pa lta bu'i rtsa tshig la rjes gnon mi yong ༅/ga shag gi zem 'jog du bzhag pa'i rkyen gyis deng sang gdan sa chen po gsum dang rgyud stod smad phyogs kyi grwa tshang dang gzhis dgon yas mas rnams kyi kro/ da du dam sri 'byung po'i rgyud kyi brlams pa'i btsun pa 'ga' zhig nas 'di phyi'i bde 'bras dang lugs gnyis kyi bka' khrims btsan po khyad du bsad de lha zhol gyis mtshon khyem pa'i grong du yun ring ci dgar sdod pa dang nag chang sogs bag med kyi chos 'dul ba'i bcas pa dang mi mthun pa'i spyod ngan sna tshogs byas pa'i mtha' dbus kyi skye bo mang po zhe khrel ba dang rang rang bo/ lha dang srung ma bdud du babs pa'i bstan bshig tshabs che ba sna tshogs shig med pa'i nges pa mi 'dug cing / des na 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i gser gyi bka' lung btsan po'i mkhan po slob dpon dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams la mgo 'dren slabs g.yar byas te chos 'chad nyan dang slabs khrims sogs la gces spras tshul bzhin byed dgos pas bkod 'doms bgyis zhes lan gcig ma yin pa yang dang yang du phebs pa ma zad/ 'dzam gling bstan 'gro'i dpung gnyen gangs can lha gcig phyag na pad mo yab sras gang gi sbu tshe mdzad 'phrin/ rgyas shing / rlabs chen 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa dus las yol ba med ba 'byung ba'i sbu rim 'bas brtan sogs la 'bad brtson bgyis pas dge 'dun gyi sde rnams khrims gtsang ba zhig med tshe/ mdzad 'phrin la 'gal rkyen du 'gyur nyen dang / bstan pa'i bgegs chag 'byung nyen bcas — 344 —— —

bdag lta bu yang las don khur du lce stabs rang gzhan brje bas mi nus jo bzang gi sdod thebs bral gshis/ da nas bzung lha zhol sogs su btsun pa sgyug mar gnas pa rnams dang phyogs nas lhags pa bcas kyi btsun gzugs yin phyin myos 'gyur sogs kyi spyod ngan bag med byas ngan yod min sne mo ba rnams nas nam pa kun tu lta rtogs byas pas mig mthong lag zin byung rigs gang yin 'dzin bzung tsha 'jun gyi khrims khang rang du bzug thog grwa sa sogs gnas khungs gang yin kyang rgyu mtshan rnams 'phral zhu byed dgos rgyu dang / khyim pa dang chang ma'i rigs nas btsun par chang sbyin pa'i mthong thos dwogs rigs cir gyur yang rgyal khrims ri ltar lce ba'i chad las drag po mig bltos la phan pa gtong lugs dang / btsun pa yin phyin rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha 'u/gas kho na byas pa las/ 'bar chas kyi phyu pa sogs 'go zhwa rkang lham gang yin skya min ser min gyi ser mo ba'i rkang 'dren du 'gro rigs gyon chog rgyu min cing / btsun pa'i 'bar chas kyi phyu pa skya min ser min lta bu kun dang ma 'dres pa gon pa gang yin 'dzin chang gis khrims rar rdzong ba dang lhag par rtse drung 'ba' reng rnams kyang sngar gyi ngan pa lang shor lta bu'i btsun chas spras pa'i bag med kyi chang 'thung ba sogs btsun pa'i 'a/bas 'dren 'gro rigs kyi spyod lam rigs gtan nas byed mi chog sngar srol la pho brang nang dang gzim 'gag sogs la btsun chas byed pa dang khyem pa'i gnas sogs so so'i gnas su mi skya dang 'dres pa'i chas byed pa srol lam yod 'dug kyang / dus phyis spar bkab med pa'i lha zhol dang / phyogs yas mas mtha' dag la btsun chas kyi myos 'gyur bag med du spyod pa bstan pa'i zhabs 'dren tshabs che tsam yod 'dug pa dang rtse drung gi sger g.yog rnams la 345 ——

kyang grwa sa phan tshun nas 'ongs te/ skya min ser min gyi grwa sa rang gi zhabs 'dren kho nar 'gro rigs chas sogs skye bo kun gyi mig yul du ma mdzes pa de lta bcas/ da nas bzung sger g.yog btsun pa yin na rab byung gi chas sha dag byed pa las phyu pa'i rigs gyon mi chog mi skya yin phyin btsun par dma' 'bebs 'gro rigs kyi gon pa skya min ser min yid du mi 'gro ba'i rigs gyon mi chog ceng so so'i bab 'brel gang yin gyi gyon ba dkar po dang sngo ljang thig rigs rgya mtshos sog/sa kyis mi skya kun dang 'dres pa'i chas ji bzhin byed pa dang rtse drung dang sger g.yog rigs 'di don la ma gnas pas go med brgal ral rigs byed mi byung na 'dzin bzung gi 'di gar brda spyor 'phral 'phral tshem lus ped pa byed/ lhag tu sa dge rnying sogs grub mtha' la ma bltos pa btsum/ gzugs yin phyin myos 'gyur la spyod pa sogs 'du' khrims dang 'gal rigs kyi spyod ngan sus byed pa byung kyang yan por ma song ba'i 'dzin bzung gi khrims khang du 'jug pa las mi nus jo bzang gi zem 'jog du bzhag chog rgyu min/ 'dul khrims bab/ yangs kyi bstan bshig byas pa'i nyes can gang yin pa de dag gdan sa chen po rnams kyis gtsos pa'i dgon pa 'di'i khongs grwa tshang khag 'di/ kham tshan mi tshan dang bcas nga/ jeb dpyod kyi yig thog tu skyel ba'i 'phral 'phral rgyu mtshan dgos rgyu dang de bstun 'di gnas mkhan po/ bla ma/ slob dpon/ dbu chos sogs 'go yod le thogs can la rgyu mtshan tshags 'dzin phyi lam khebs pa byed rgyu dang /dbon po dang 'ba' reng rnams kyis btsun chas sprad de chang 'thung ba sogs drag zha/na sus byed kyang yan por ma song ba tsha 'jun gyi khrims rar skyel ba'i khrims kyi bda' 'ded tshul bzhin byed dgos rgyu dang / da nas bzung ser — 346 —

mo ba yin na rab byung gi chas dang mi skya yin phyim mi skya'i chad ba bcas dbye ba chod pa byed dgos/ dbon po dang 'ba' reng rnam sa kyang btsun chas byas phyin tshangs spyod/ la gnas dgos/ tshangs spyod la ma gnas tshe khyim pa'i chas ji lta ba bzhin byed nga/ las btsun pa'i dma' 'bebs 'gro rigs kyi chas gos byed mi chog lha 'o//la gyi gnyer mi dpon sogs kyang da nas bzung skya min ser min gyi chas gos/ dang spyod lam ngan pa de ris/sa mi mthong mi shes pa'i tshul gyi mi nus jo bzang du cha tsam sdod rigs gyur kyang / khyo/ da/ rang rnams la'ang ba7/'a khri/ yas rin po che'i dgongs don rnag thog rtsa bu'i rjes gnon yong gras yin 'dug pas rang gzhan spi bgyi ba dang / 'di phyi'i bde 'bras 'a bsam blo zhib mor gtong ba'i blangs dod go ma 'dzol ba dgos shing / grwa sa grwa tshang dang phyogs kyi dgon khag sogs kyi mkhan/ po/ bla ma/ slob dpon/dge bskos bcas nas rang rang gi khur du babs pa'i sgreg lam gang yin la zem 'jog mi byed pa 'chun 'doms tsha nan che ba byed tshe/ bstan pa la dge skebs che bas yong gras bcas de ltar spang blangs yang dag yong ba'i las sne 'go yod rnams kyi so sor mtha' 'doms kyang len lugs gyis zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge chu rta zla tshes bzang por phun tshogs srid zhi'i 'du gnas pho brang chen po po ta la nas dge/ / / /kun gling rgyal thog gnyis pa'i tham ka phab/

twa la'i bcu gsum pas bkra shis chos 'phel gling dgon la bstsalaXba'iXbaca' yigabod rab byung bco lnga paXs byi/ (spyi lo 1shā8shā )leg/sa byas skal bzang mngon par rgyas pa'i chu 'dzin dkar po lang long dbus/ // theg chen dam pa'i chos kyi sgra dbyangs 'brug stong ldir ba'i sgra snyan gyis// // sko 'a bzang mdo/ngas ldan legs bsha/da sbrang char 'thung 'dod rnams kyi thos 'dzin du/ /son pas dga' ba'i sa/ra gyis brel mdzad 'jam dgon bla mas dge legs stsol/ /srid zhi'i phun/ tshogs yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab chu klung si/sa brlan pas// /rab mdzes sngon med gser gyi dpag bsam yongs 'du'i ljon pa cher rgyas shing / /byams dang snying rje'i 'bras sman 'khur gyis rab tu lce ba'i 'gro tshogs kyi/ /re ba ma lus yongs su skong mdzad rgyal dbang rim byon gtsug na mdzes/ /'jig rten gsum gyi gtsug tor pad ma srid kyi bkris dngon pe rgyu/ /bzhad pa'i gnyen gyur sbangs rtogs yon tan rab tu rdzogs kyang 'gro kun la/ /rjes su brtse bas mi yi tshul bzung ngur sprig gar rol grags snyan gang / /'bar ba'i kun gzigs ye the/sa mgon po byang chub bar du 'bral med skyongs/ / thub bstan lung rtogs smra ba'i sgo brgya rnams/ /'khrul med legs par bye ba'i snyan grags kyi/ / ba dan mkha' la la 348 ——

sgreng mdzad ris/ med/ nga/'i/ // mkhas: grub 'o/ pa khya rnams ri gus nga/sa 'dud/ /mang ma nga tshas kum mkhyen pa'i nyin byed kyi/ /gsal sa/sa 'a/ 'od/ kyi 'jis/ rten mum nga 'i sa/shed/ /mdzes ma/dzes ge/ sa ra rbo/nga pa'i /'dab rgya'i tsa/nyem // ba/zang bzang kun 'dus /3jam dang la snyeng ngo/sa srung / /chu skyes dag/ra po 'dzum/ nga 'i dri bco/ma la/ / zang drug/ ba'i ma 'dus skru/ ma sa ldam dbe 'dun sde/ bkra shis chom/ 'phe' gleng rga/ 'dus grwa cher/ / pri/ mas/ su bca' ba'i yi/ ge deng 'dir spel/ / zhes ru/la khyad/ par can 'a/ bstsong/ phyag ga me tog ma ngon nga ra /3thor bas spun bsus bye slob dpon cheza po dang/la ldan zla ba da/sa pas sla ra yang mi ba po'i sbu mnga' byod kyis srid gsum byon mas spru/ma rnams kyis sa/shes/sa nga/ dang ni bltams dang byang chub 'i/ ba'i 'khor lo/snang sto na par mdzad// de ltar khyod kyi 'jib rten g.yo/ bas// spyod can re ba'i zhags nga1 mi// ma nga pos bcings pa ma 'u/sa thugs rjes thu ngan 'ang/sa par dkro bar ma/dzad ces tsa/sungs nga/ ltar/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyams med za/kyu godas 'jig rten ma/ rig pa'i zhags pas bcings pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag rnam par grol ba dang yongs su grol ba'i sa la 'god pa'i slad du ga'al du med pa'i dka' ba spyad de sa bcu lam lnga rim gyis bgrod nas 'jis/sa bral 'og min sbug po bkod pa'i zhing du sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa rnam par spangs nas 'bras bu nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgyas te/ slar yang 'dod khams su mdzad pa bcu sa/nyis kyi 'dul ba'i dus la babs par nye ba nas dga' ldan gyi lha'i bu dam pa tog dkar dran ba'i na shes bzhi/na du rang cag 'dzam bu gling 'dir rgyal po zas gtsang gi rigs su gzigs pa lnga'i sgo nas yum sgyu ma lha mdzes ma'i lhums su bzhugs nas sku bltams/ de nas rgyal ——— 349 — —

srid spangs te dka' ba spyad pa dang bdud 'dul ba dang mngon par byang chub pa sogs kyi tshul bstan te gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal ji lta bzhin du chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa rnams kyi snyeng po 'dul ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dngos dang ston pa'i gos chod par 'dul bar bstod pa las/ rgyal ba ston pa de yi bstan bcos dag / mdo dang chos mngon yin gsungs 'dul ba ni/ / ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yi phyir/ / gnyis 'gyur phyag bya sangs rgyas chos gcig bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ gzhan ya nga shes rab sgron me'i rgya cher 'grel pa las// bstan pa zhes bya ba ni lha dang mi'i bdud rtsi'i go 'phangs thob par 'dod pa rnams yongs su shis par bya ba dang spangs bar bya ba dang / mngon gsum du bya ba dang / bsgoms pa bya ba dag la phyin ci ma log par ston pa ste bcom ldan 'das kyi gsung rab ces bya ba yin no/ zhes nga/ ltar gyi lung gis bstan pa dang / lam ma bzhugs kyi dad sogs dang 'phags bzhi'i mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis su yod/ pa las/ de lta bu'i bstan pa rin po che ji skad du/ slob dpon dbyeg gnyen gyis/ / ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te/ /lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ /de 'dzin byed ba smra byed pa/ / sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ /zhes bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i bya bas rnam pa kun tu 'dzin dgos pa de nyid dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pa yin te/ de lta sgo'i dge 'dun gye sde zhes pa ni tshul khrims dang ldan pa dag yod na yod kyi men na mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun rnams tshul khrims yang dag pa'i bcad mtshams las mi 'da' zhing / chos spyod bcu'i bya ba la brtson dgos pas/ de la 'jam mgon bla ma mi yi gar rol kun — 350 —

mkhyen gnyis pa rgyal ba tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa la thos bsam bsgoms pa lhur len pa'i 'dus sde bkra shis chos 'phel gling gi mchog dman 'bring rnams kyi kun spyod dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa bkod pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po la/ so thar dang byang sems/gsang sngags kyi bslab bya dang gsum las/ dang po so thar gyi gces bsdus la gang zag sde 'dir gsar du 'jug 'os pa la/ dge tshul slong gang rung gi sdom pa dang ldan pa zhig dgos pa yin/ rab tu byung dgos rnams zhu bar 'os pa'i dge 'dun la ma zhus pa dang / rang rang gi sdom pa skye ba'i skyon bcas dang / dge tshul la bla gos dang / thang gos lhung gzed/ gding ba/ chu tshags dang / tha na'ang chab ril dang 'phreng ba sogs tshags su ma byas pa/ dge slong yin na gong gsal de dag gi steng du snam sbyar sogs 'dul ba nas bshad pa rnams ma tshang ba sogs kyi nyes skyon yod med legs par brtags te/ bsgrub bya de yang rtags dang cha lugs tshig snga phyi'i cho ga sogs nyes med phun sum tshogs pa'i sgo nas sdom pa 'beb pa gal che zhing /yul dus kyi dmigs bsal dgos pa 'gar yang med mi rung gi mthun rkyen rnams ma tshang ba rab tu mi byung / byung 'os rnams rab tu byung nas chos skor du 'jug 'os ba'i rigs rang yul du pha ma nye 'brel nas gnang ya ma zhus pa dang gzhan gyis chos skor nas gnas dbyung byas pa/ nas chang rku gsum gyi gtam dang slob spyon yod pa'i rigs gtan nas mi 'jug de ltar ma yin pa'i rigs 'di ga'i gnas brtan la dge rgan gyi snyan gsan phab/ de nyid nas kyang dgos pa'i bla ma dge rkos sogs la snyan gsan phab/ de nyid —— — 351 —

nas/ kyang dgon pa'i bla ma dbe/ skos sogs la nyan ga/san zhu dbo/sa pa dang / bzhug/sa dus yang bla ma la mjal rten/ lha rdzas dri med sta gom/ byed dgos pa dbe/ rgan gyis 'khur du blangs/ bzhus/sa rjes su shes rab dang brtson pa che ba cho/ma/sa kyis 'dul ba lung sde ba'i la bslab dang / 'bring bo/ /'dul ba mdza rtsa ba sos//sa la ba mi/ba cing khong du chung/ pa bya dbo//sa/ /bla ma/ dang slob dpon nga/se/ ba'i bshes ga/nyen gyi mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig la brten 'os pa rnams kyi bsla ba bya zhib bshad nges phra zhing phra ba zam/sa nges su bcug nas de don bzhim/ tshang mas nyams su len dgos shing / de lta bu'i dge tshul slong si/ lbung bya mi mthum phyog/sa choms ngo shes nas bslab khri/ mas/ rnams snyeng nang be/ khras thig gam mig 'bras bzhin du bsrungs dgos pas/ dge tshul gyi blangs 'das so drug/ dang / dge slong rnams kyis pham pa ba'i// lhag ma bcu sa/sum/ ma nges pa ga/nyis1/ spang ltung sum cu/ ltung byed 'ba' 'ib pa dgu bcu/ so sor bas/tsa/sa pa bzhi/ nyes byas brgya dang bcu sa/nyis sogs 'dul ba lung sde ba'i nas bshad pa'i bcas mtshams rnams la kun mkhyen snye ma'i gnyen gyis dri med spyan gyis gzigs pa bzhin thub pa'i rjes su bzhugs pa rnams la legs par gdams pa yin pas/ lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal me 'obs lta bu las skyabs 'ing rang gzhan gyi don sum tshogs pa bsgrub pa'i phyir/ ji skad du bka' bstsal ba rnams srung bsdoms yang dag pa da/nga ldan pa de ni 'jig rten na lha dang bcas pa kun gyi mchod gnas dam pa gnas skabs thar thug gi bde ba nges par brten pa'i mchog nyid dang de las 'gal na sdug bsngal gyis 'chings ba dam po dum mas mnar zhing thar pa'i bo/ skabs med pa sogs kyi phan yon dang nyes dmigs legs par bsams nas —— 362 ——

blang dor tshul bzhin byed dgos pa ni tshul khrims yang dag nga/ra ldan pa'i mdo las/ de phyir ston pa'i tshul khrims rang bsngags bshad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas byung dang 'phrad/ / tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun/ gyi mchog /tshul khrims ldan pa dri dang byug pa yin/ /zhes dang /ji ltar bum pa bzang po rin chen sgod/ / de bzhin tshul khrims chos rnams bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /ji ltar bum chags rin/ chen snod mi rung / /de bzhi/na tshul khrims ral bas chos kun gtugs/ / dang po tshul khri/ mas med nga/ra gyur pa de/ /phyi nas myang ngan 'ad/sa pa 'thob snyam mam/ /sna med sna lhum la sogs gang yin 8 / /de la me long das/ ni dgos mi 'gyur/ /rna bas ma thos mig sngar ma mthong yang / /bstan srung mi de mtho ris 'gro bar 'gyur/ / zhes tshad ma'i bka' dang dgongs 'grel du ma las gsungs pa bzhin yin pas bshad tshad tsam gyis ma 'tshim par don nyams su len dgos rgyu yin/ mdor na tshul khrims dang ldan pa'i rgyud la ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab la sog/sa pa'i yon tan mtha' dag ngang gis skye bar 'gyur ba dang phyi mar mtho ris kyi brten bzang dang / thar pa dang thams bcad mkhyen pa'i go 'phangs thob pa'i rgyu'i ga bo bo 'ang tshul khrims yin la/ phar phyim/ theg par ma zad sngags kyi skabs su'ang / dpung bzang gi zhus pa'i rgyud las/ ji ltar lo tog thams bcad sa la ni/ / brten nas skyon med bar ni skye ba ltar// / de bzhin tshul khrims brten nas chos dkar mchog / snying rje'i chus brlan pas ni rnam par skye/ / zhes sa la brten te lo tog thams bcad skye ba bzhin du tshul khrims la brten nas yon tan thams cad skye bar gsungs pas ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa gnyis kyi sngon du tshul khrims rnam par dag pa srung — — 353 —

ba nges par dgos la/ gzhan yang kun mkhyen dbyeg gnyen gyis/ rgya mtsho dang ni glang rjes kyi/ / khyad par das/ rngi gang yin dang / / sbyin pa dang ni tshul khrims kyi/ /khyad par dag ni de yin na// /gang zhig dngas ba'i sems kyis ni/ / lo brgya sbyin pa spyin pa bas/ / gang zhig nyin gcig tshul khrims ni/ / srung ba de las khyad par 'phags/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar tshang mas phyag len la ma nyams par bstar dgos pa yin no/ gnyis pa la/ byang sem/sa kyi sdom pa 'dzin 'os rnams kyi byang sdom blangs nas bdag ga/zhan mnyam pa rje ba'i sems dang rgyu 'bras man ngag bdun la sbyangs nas smon sems dang 'jug sems skyed de phyin drug gi nyams len la brtson zhing spang bya mi mthun phyogs srung zhing / blangs bya mtha' dag nyams su len tshul mdo sde dang / byang chub lam rim/ tshul khrims li'u'i rnam bshad sogs nas gsungs pa ltar spangs blangs byed/ gsum pa ni/ snga gas kyi sdom pas dbang po smin par byed 'os pa bdag gis sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i rgyud las/ bla ma sangs rgyas kun/ dang mnyam/ / de nyid rtag tu rdo rje 'chang / / de bzhin gshegs pa rin chen tog/ ces rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par gsungs ba bzhin/ bla ma lnga bcu pa dang 'jam mgon bla ma'i gsang sngags lam rim chen mo sogs las ji skad gsungs pa bzhin du brten nas dbang bskur ba mnos te/ dbang 'dus der mkhas blangs pa'i dam sdom rnams srog la thug kyang mi dor bas legs par bsdos te/ rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la dpyis phyin par bslabs nas mthar khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phangs mngon du 'gyur ba rgyud sde rgya mtsho de nyid khong du chud pa'i nyams len la 'bad brtson byed/ byang sems dang srugs kyi bslab bya dang —— 354 ——

'gal ba byung na gzhung dang mthun pa'i dam sdom gso ba gal che ba/ mnyam med jo bo rje'i rnam thar bzhin nyams su len dgos pa yin no/ gnyis pa bye brag tu 'di ga'i sgrig lam kun spyod kyi rim pa la/ hor zla dang po'i tshes gcig gi skya rengs dang po shar ba'i dus su 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mo dmag zor rgyal mo'i tshes tor chos sde chen po dpal lngan 'bras sprungs sngags pa grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes ltar phul nas/ tshes bdun nas smon lam dbu 'dzugs nas bcu bdun nyin grol bas bar nyin re'i zhal 'don gyi rim pa rnams gdan sa chen po bkris phan bde gling gi phyag len ltar mdzad pa dang sa ga zla ba'i tshes bco lnga tshun chad la bzang spyod sgon lam nyi ma rer 'gro che gsungs nas bco lnga'i nyin stong mchod dang brgya mchod kyis mtshon pa'i dge ba'i bya ba la brtson pa nan tan phyag len la bstar ba byeng/ zla ba lnga pa'i tshes lnga nas 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sgo nas ma ṇi'i bum sgrub dbu 'dzugs nas nyin re bzhin mthun bzhir bcad nas tshogs pa dang /mthun mtshams la yang yig drug dang gzungs ring sogs kyi sprags rgyun ma chad par gnang ba phyag len du thebs pa mdzad/ lhag par 'di'i ring la sha chang sgog btseng sogs mi gtsang ba'i rigs su ma rtogs pa'i zas dang spyod lam sogs la bag dang ldan par longs spyod nas gong gsal de rnams spangs ba gal che 'o/ bcu gnyis kyi nyin der grol ba'i lnga rol du tshogs 'khor sogs kyi dga' ston la rol ba phyag len la jebs par byed/ zla ba drug pa'i tshes bco lnga nas nyi shu ga/nyis kyi bar rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gsung ba bkris phan bde spru/nga gi phyag bzhes ji ltar ba ba'i na du byed/ zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin gtsug gtor rnam rgyal ma'i stong mchod rgyas par phul —— 355 ———
