ba phyag len la thebs par byed/ zla ba bcu pa'i tshe nyer lnga nyin dga' ldan lnga mchod chen mo'i dus bzang la 'al 'don chos spyod rgya gang che dang kun bzang mchod sprin tshar du dngar ba phul phyag len du bstar ba mdzad/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nyi shu bdun nas nyi ma gsum gyi ring la bskang gso rgyas pa btang nas mjug tu gtor rgyag sogs sngar gyi phyag srol ma nyams pa byed/mdor na nyin ga/cig gi kun spyod ga bo bor gyur pa la mtshon na skya rengs gnyis pa shar ba'i tshe dbang sgon dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi ldan ma'i rnal 'byor gyi ngang nas khrus kyi de nyid rgyud sde nas gsungs pa bzhin du 'bad cing / dbang brtul dang dge tshul blo gsar ba bdag gi tshul mthun gyi gos legs par gyon te blo tshod kyi ltung bshags lta bu'i sdig spyongs dang phyag sogs byed de'i rjes su—skya rengs gsum pa'i skabs chab ril nas dung brda dang po dang gnyis pa rim gyis btang ma thag zhi 'dul gyis tshogs la 'du zhing /bka' rab 'byams pa gnas brtan bgres song rnams 'du khang la sngon du phebs nas 'gyur srugs dang dmigs brtse ma gsung ba dang bar shar ba dang ga/sar bu ba rnams kyis sgo dbyangs dmigs brtse ma dal bus bdun nam gsum song ba'i mtshams su tshogs chen dge bskos kyis 'du khang du spyan drangs pa'i brda 'phul ba dang mnyam du dung thengs gsu ma pa gtong ba/dbu mdzad kyi 'al 'don bskul ba sogs dus mtshungs byed/ gral la 'khod mtshams kyi rim pa yang rang rang gi bslab pa'i go rim ma 'chol bar bzhugs pa las rkang 'gyogs dang shed che chung gis mi byed/ ka ba dang ba'i gas pa sogs la mi brnye la/ gos kyi kha ma gtum par mchil snabs mi 'dor ba/ gnyid dang gleng mo lag rtsed/ kha g.yeng mig g.yeng kha gtums

sa/zhogs gcus sogs ma yin par mu tig star la brgyus pa ltar yid du 'ong bas bzhugs shing / bza' 'thung gi tshe yang bub bcag gi sgra dang bcas pa dang / lces ldag pa sogs mi mdzes pa rgyang ring du bsrings nas kha zas sman dang 'dra ba'i 'du shes/ kyi bsten par mdzad/ zhal 'don gyi rim pa la yang thugs mi g.yeng zhing mgrin gcig dbyangs gcig gis gsungs/ dbu mdzad kyis 'don 'dur rta dbyangs ji 'dra gsungs kyang tshang mas de ga'i mu mthud pa ma gtogs g.yas 'khyer g.yon 'khyer sogs gtan nas mi byed/de nas 'al 'don da/nga por gdugs dkar bzlog grub dang / skyabs 'gro/dga' ldan lha rgya ma/ dpal ldan sa gsum ma/ gnas bcu/ skyabs mgon rgyal ba yab sras rnams kyi zhabs brtan gtsos chos spyod kyi rigs bab ltos dang sher snyeng dang seng gdong ma'i bzlogs pa bcas/ sgrol ma/ tshe gzungs dang rnam rgyal ma'i gzungs ring / smon lam rgyas bsdus gang rigs dang / chos skyong rnams kyi gtor 'bul dang bstan 'bar ma bcas gsung / de nas tshogs grol ba'i tshe sngar ltar spyod lam gyi 'byon nas so so'i gzim shag tu phebs rjes chos mtshams skabs yin na gnas brtan bgres song rnams nas so so'i 'al 'don mdzad pa dang / bar shar ba dang gsar bu ba rnams kyi rang shag tu phebs nas so so'i 'dzin chos kyi dpe cha dang /dus rgyun yang blo dang bstun pa'i rje yab sras sogs kyi bstan bcos dang /sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab la thos pa byed/ so so'i dge rgan nas kyang dpe 'khrid dang bslab sbyangs sogs la brten bskul byed dgos pa gal che zhing mdor na so so nas kyang lam ring che chung dang bka' gdams gzhung drug sogs dus rgyun gzigs pa phyag len la bstar ba byed/ dgongs zhus kyi — 357 —

skor la 'di ga'i las sne sogs dgongs pa zhus na/ tshogs 'dus rgyas 'dzoms nas gnang na ma gtogs snang ba gang dran gyi las byed mi chog pa ga bo cher bla mas 'khur du bzhes/ rgyun gyi dgongs zhus rnams 'ag gsum gyi dgongs pa dge bskos dang / de min rnams bla brang dang dge bskos gnyes la zhus pa tshang mas 'khur du blangs// yang tshogs la phebs mi thub pa'i rkyen nad pa nyams thag pa dang sku gzugs mi bde ba'i rigs dang / gsar bu ba rnams kyang skyor sbyangs la yong mi thub pa'i rkyen nges shing dag pa yod na dge bskos la dgongs pa zhus/ gsar bu rnams nas zla re ba'i na chos spyod rab gsal dang 'jigs byed ga bo byas bskang gso rgyugs len dgos spyor sbyangs kyi dus su dge bskos nas bsgor ba dang / ga/sar bu ba rnams kyis kyang dgon pa'i chos skor du bzhugs pa tsam du ma song ba 'don tshas spyod kyi rgyugs phul zin grub nas sbyangs pa mthar phyin na 'di ga'i rgyud pa grwa tshang du bzhugs nas slob gnyer la brtson pa nan tan byed/ de nas sbyin bdag gi 'byor pa dang bstun par bsnyen bkur 'bas tog gang zhus kyang de la rtsod gleng so/ga/sa gtan nas mi byed/ sbyin bdag gi 'dod pa ltar dang gung tshigs la dkon mchog rjes dran dang yon sbyongs sogs kun spyod rnams sbyin bdag dad pa skye ba'i rgyu las khyim pa sun 'byen gyi rigs byed sa med/ sbyin bdag/ gi bsnyen bkur pyung tshe dgon pa'i bdag po sprul sbu rnams dang / khri pa gdan zur sogs las sne so sor sku skal sngar gyi phyag srol ma nyams par phyag len du jebs pa byed/ chos thog chos mtshams gang gi skabs su yin na'ang zla ba byung ngo cog gi gso sbyong dang / dbyar snga phyi gang 'os shig 'al bzhes mdzad la dmigs bsal nad pa lta bu ma gtogs tshang mas dbyar gnas dang dgag ——— 358 —

dbye gso sbyongs bcas gzhi gsum gyi nyams len rnam par dag pa byed/ de nas zla ba bo re bzhin tshes pa gnyis la jo rje sgra dbyangs gling gi phyag srol ltar ga bo byas pa'i chos srung spyi'i bskang bshags 'gro che dang rab gnas yang chag med dang / dgon ba'i gling phyi nang bar gsum mtha' dag la dus kun gad bdar legs par bya/ zla ba brgyad pa'i nang gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag so sor sa dkar gsol ba sogs sngar rgyun bzhin byed/ lo re bzhin gtong rgyu'i dge 'dun gyi gsol phogs chag med du byed pa dge skos kyis bkod khyab byed/ chos thog re re la rdo gcal sku rim tshogs pa dang bar bar du dung rgya gling sogs la sbyangs pa snyan gsan rnams gtong dus su gtong ba rnams sngar gyi phyag srol ma nyams pa byed/ 'di ga'i na bza'i skor la/ dbyar gyi dus dang gso thrung sogs kyi skabs 'dul ba nas bshad pa ji lta ba bzhin dang /dgun dus sogs la yul dus kyis dbang gi na bza' bab mtshungs byed/'on kyang zab 'phyor tu gtogs pa'i ther gzan nga/nga / bstod 'gag dmar ser ma dang gos chen/ gsham thabs sdo snyel mang / gos chen gyi na bza'i rigs su gtogs pa dang / 'phreng ba kun rgyan can/ gser dngul dang rin po che'i rgyan rnams sbangs pa tshang mas 'khur du bzhes/ de yang dus kun tshang mas dge ba'i bya bas dus 'da' nga ma gtogs 'ga' zhig nas gnyis gsum tshogs nas mig mangs dang / sha tha ra/ ra phas sogs kyi rtse ba/ dgon nang du mchongs rgyugs dang ku co 'don pa/ chang dang tha ma kha 'then pa/ skra sor phyed do las lhag pa/ bla ma dang dge bskos sogs la kha lan lag lan slog pa/ gzan med par phyi nob4 du 'gro ba sogs mi mdzes pa'i rigs byed sa ped/ gal srid de 'dra'i rigs byung na dge skos kyi chad — 359 —

pa 'os mtshams 'gel/ dgon 'dir srog gcod sogs rtsa ba bzhi 'chab bcas byung ba'i dge tshul slong dang / 'khrug slong gi gri rgyug rdo sogs kyis rma tshabs chen byung na gnas nas dbyung dgon nang du nang mchod dngos gnas las chang gi 'grims 'grul mi byed/ bud med kyang bzhag sdod mi 'juganyin mo mchod pa dang bsnyen bkur sogs kyi phyir 'ong dgos rigs la dge skos la gnang ba zhu/ gling gseb tu tshong pa'i rigs kyi nyo tshong byed sa med/nyer mkho'i yo byad tshong mi byung na gling gi phyi rol du 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i nyo tshong byed cing / su thob dang shed khyer dbang med byas pa byung na dge skos kyi chad nga/ bab mtshungs 'gel/ bla gnyer gyi rta phyugs dgos nges ma ba/togs gling nang du dud 'gro zhag gsum las lhag pa mi bzhag pa dge bskos kyi 'khur du blangs/ de nas dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas sogs bag med par 'dzems pa gal che/ bla ma su yin na'ang rang nyid chos dang mthun pa gzhan gyi mig brgyan du 'os pa zhig byas nas ga bo bo 'dul ba dang gang mthun la yul dus dang bstun pa'i nyes med du 'gro rigs la 'di mthun gyi bkod pa byed pa sogs dgon pa'i sgrig lam rnam ga 'ag thams cad kyi 'khur blangs te khrims gtsang thing dge 'dun 'phel rgyas kyi sgo nas dge ldan bstan pa rin po che'i brgyan du gyur pa'i thabs tshul la 'bad/ dge bskos kyis rang nyid spyod lam tshul mthun gyi sgo nas g.yo rgyu dang nye ring du ma song ba phyi nang thams cad lta rtog legs par bcug ste bag yod pa dang chos spyod 'phel ba'i thabs kyis khrims gnon che ba/ dbu mdzad kyang chos spyod dang bskang gso sogs kyi gdangs 'dur dbyangs dang rnga rol sogs la snang bar gang dran du mi 'gro ba dang / spyi gnyer nas kyang dge 'dun spyi'i phyi nang gi nor rdzas rigs bar — 360 —

ma dor chud mi za zhing / kha na ma the ba med pa'i thabs tshul gyi sgo nas dge 'dun gyi 'bas tog la brtson par bya dgos/ sku gnyer dang khang gnyer gnyis nas dge 'dun gyi gtsug lag khang dang 'du khang so so'i sbu gsung thugs rten la srid zhu bskur bste lhur len pa la gtsang sbra dang byi dor tshul bzhin du byed/ ja mas yang dge 'dun gyi rung khang nang la gtsang sbra che zheng gsol ja bzhes thug sogs bzhes spro ba byed pa dang / mdor na 'di ga'i rgan gzhon bar gsum gyis chos 'dul ba'i dgongs don dang mthun par bya ba nyams len la bstar ba byed/ gsar bu ba rnams kyi gnas brtan rgan pa rnams la brtsi zhing bsnyen bkur byed pa zhwa phud gzan 'beb sogs tshul bzhin byed/ lhag par bla ma las sne sogs la brtse med du mi byed cing /gal te de 'dra'i rigs byung na so so'i dge rgan dang bcas pa la bslab sbyangs byed pa bla ma dge skos kyi 'khur du blangs par bya'o/ mdor na mnyam med jo bo rjes/ sems pa'i spyod pa che ba la dad pa shin tu brtan par bya/ / brga/ yod dran dang shes bzhin dang tshul bzhin yid la byed pa yis/ / kun nas nyon mongs dmigs pa la rang sems yin pa phyir bzlog ste/ / sangs rgyas chos kyi dmigs pa la rtag tu bzhag pa nyid du bya/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar/dkar chos thams cad kyi rtsa ba bla ma dkon mchog dang las 'bras la shin tu brtan po gzhir bzungs/ dus rtag tu dge ba'i phyogs rnams la nyams su len cing rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa mtha' dag mi dge'i phyogs su mi gtong bar bsrung ba'i bag yod dang / blangs dor gyi gnas rnams mi brjed pa'i dran pa dang / rang gi sgo gsum gyi spyod pa la bzang ngan ji ltar yin pa brtags te shes bzhin du 'jug pa'i shes bzhin dang yang dag pa'i don — 361 —

rnams la yang nas yang du legs par bsam pa'i tshul bzhin yid la byed pa rnams kyi sgo nas dus nam gyi tshe yang sems rgya yan du mi gtong bar dge ba'i chos kyi phyogs la ci nus su 'bad pa bya zhing / gtan gyi mdun ma thams cad bsgrub pa'i thabs legs su 'dod pa rnams kyis ji skad bshad pa ltar nyams su len pa la mdo sngags gzhung lugs la thos bsam byas nas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa 'phel ba mdzad dgos/ spyir bstan nga/ dge 'dun gyi sde la rag las pa dang / dge 'dun gyi sde ni skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rkyen dang 'byor lda/na bsod nams bsags pa'i zhing sa bla na med par 'gyur zhing spyir kun mkhyen bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs dang / bye brag dpal mnyam med ri bo dge ldan pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid rgya mtsho'i gos can gyi gzhi mtha' dag la khyab cing mi nyams gong 'phel du 'gyur ba'i thabs tshul la 'bad pa lhur len pa mdzod cig smras pa/ bgrangs yas dpag med bskal par legs bsgoms tshogs gnyis bgrod kyi yo/ngas smin pa'i/ /rmad byung spungs rtogs yal ga'i khyon yangs rnam pa kun tu rab rgyas pa/ / ngo mtshar chos tshul 'bras bu g.yo bas bskal bzang 'gro kun rtag 'tsho ba'i/ /dus gsum rgyal kun yang yang rab bsngags thub dbang dpag bsam ljon pa rgyal/ / gang gi mdzad bzang thub bstan ring lugs dri ped dal 'bab mdzod kyi khams/ /bslab gsum lung rtogs rin chen du mas yongs su rab gtams kun dga'i dpal/ /ci dgar dbang bsgyur rgya bod paṇa grub rim byon dam pa'i tshogs rnams la/ / dwang bas lus kyi 'khri shing g.yo ba'i sor bcu'i pad mo spyi bor 'dzum/ / thub bstan lugs bzang yid ba'in dbang gi rgyal/ / bshad sgrub rgyal mtshan rtse mor rab bkod nas/ / phun — 362 —

tshogs 'dod rgu'i yongs su rab brnyil ba'i/ /zhwa ser cod pan ring lugs 'di rko/ rmad/ / sum brtsen yu/la gyi rab mdzes skye/da tshal du/ /ngo mtshar sbrang rtsi'i zi'/ mngar cher ga yo bas/ / blo sa/sal shra ma ra yi rtse dga'i gnas// //bste gnas pad+ma nga) kar po'i mgo lhog ldem/ /myur ma dzad mgon dang rnam sras chos kyis rgyal / /dmag zor rgyal mo rgyal chen sku lnga dang / //bstan srung chem po rdor legs la sogs pa'i/ / mthu ldan srung ma/ ye shes spyan ldan rna/mas/ //khrims gtsang rnam/sa kyi 'phrin 'a/sa rnam pa ba'i// /ci 'dod stsol la da/ma med log lta can/ /gal srid mchis na yud tsam ma bzhag par/ /bsgral zhing sde 'di skyongs la rtsal ma 'an/ /deng dus thub bstan chu lha'i phyogs yib nga/sa/ /mkhas rlom phal cher chos brgyad mdzes ma yi// /bzhin ras la g.yeng 'dod yon lhur len na/ /kye ma rgyal ba'i bstan/ pa su yis 'dzin/ / stom/ pa'i bcad mtshams sin+t+ra wa ra'i 'dab/ / phra zhib rnam dpyod nyi zlas 'byed min yang / / legs ba'i/da 'dus phra'i 'gram 'chang gis mthor tshe/ /rang dbang 'dab stong can la ga la yod/ /de'i phyir mdo sngags gzhung lugs mang thos nas/ / thos don rgyud steng 'bad brtson lhud bzhes na/ / da dung nyi ma'i gnyen gyi ring lugs 'di/ / chig stong bdun brgya lhag gnas gor ma chags/ / 'dir 'bad legs byas dge ba las byung ba'i/ / rnam par dkar ba'i lhab/ bsam de yi mthus/ skyabs mgon gnyis mtshon skyes chen dam pa rnams/ / zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas gyud cig /bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal brgyad 'byor bcu'i gru gzings la brten nas/ /gzhung lugs rgya mtshor bde blag bgrod pa yis/ /sbu gsum rin chem gling du phyin gyur cig / zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge rab — 363 —
4 pho byi lo'i chu stod ‘ bzang pho brang nas dri

thor nod—rgyal bosaXzhus ltan mtshan nyid grwa tshang giXdagon sdeXgasanaXbatab zhu rgyu'i snyubs mgon rtse ma/sa sa/senaXtham chen mo phab pa'iXbaca' yig zin bris //bod rab byung sa glang / ( spru lo 1kar la )sbu/ ga/su/ma/ dkyil 'kho/ ra yongs su rdzogs 'ing mtshan dpe'i mu byu/ da cir yang bkra/ / mdzad bzang snang ba bye bas skal bzang gdul bya'i blo gros pad mo 'byed/ / ‘rtog bsam snying stobs che zhes ka ) ḍi sra3sa ba/ sa bsnga gas pa'i dbyangs snyan bsgrags/ / lha yi lha mchog sha kya sed bhe tshad med snang ba'i gter gyis skyongs/ / gang gi zab rgyas gdams pa'i bdud mi'i chab/ /thar 'dod ngang pa rtsed 'jo'i dga' ston du/ / spel mdzad ga spyod ba bdun dad 'byem gling rgan/ / gdengs can dbang po rnams la rab gus 'dud/ / brgyad ldan chab 'dis dbul ba'i skye rgu yongs la brtse bas mi bzod par/ /rnam 'dren pa blda dgo)ngas na zab tu 'khyil ba'i 'phags yul ma dros las/ / gces pa'i srog la'ang 'phangs med brjod kyi mi langs — —— 365 la

dka' spyad du ma/ yis/ /'dren mdzad rdos ba lto ༷ṇa bka' drin bsam bzhin bsam bzhin lan brgyar 'dud/ /zla bral lung rigs snang ba 'bar ba'i gzis/ /rgyal bstan yang snying pad dkar skyed mos tshal/ /bskal bzang bung ba'i dpal du 'dzum mdzad pa/ /ku mas na nyiXn bye0da dasang pos shis pa stsol/gang gi lugs bzang 'od stong rab 'bar ba/phyogs res mig btsums 'byung bya'i tshogs rnams la/ /lugs dang rigs pa'i sman gyis mig 'byed pa/ / sras mchog lha rje'i tshogs rnams spyi bos mchod/ /rlabs chen thabs shes zung du 'jug pa'i rlung shugs drag po yis/ / bdud kyi dpung tshog/sa gsan sde lhag med bsreg pa'i byen za che/ /rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na rnam par 'gying ba rdo rje'i lha/ /'ji0gas ka ku dwo ka/ gis 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams shis pas skyongs/ /ba pa0'i rgyas ka rgya mtsho'i gos can steng / /yongs su khyab la mi bzod log 'khu ba'i/ bdud kyi dpung la spyan zur gzigs pas kyang / /snying la 'jigs ster srung ma'i tshogs rnams skyongs/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'o mtsho 'khyil ba la/ /ngang pa'i tshogs bzhin 'dus pa'i khrims ldan ste/ /bsad sgru0ba da0ra ga gli0nga zhes grags de yi/ /dge 'dun rnams kyis nyams len ka stig spel/ / zhes yul khyad par du 'phags pa rnams la mchod par brjod ba dang rtsom par dam bca' ba'i tshigs su bcad pa pun ḍa ri ka'i 'phreng ba— mngon par 'thor bas sngun bsus te/ skabs su babs pa gang gleng bar byed pa la/ ji skad du slob dpon chen po bye ḍi ka/ pa0'i zhal nas/ slar yang mi g.yo'i sku mnga' khyod kyis srid gsum byon nas sprul rnams kyis/ /gshegs pa dang ni bltams dang byang ——— 366 ——

chub je ba'i 'khor lo'ang ston par mdzad/ / ces gsungs pa ltar 'o skol spi ston pa mnyam med ka0 se5 hūṃ de nyid kyis/ dang por bla na med pa'i byang chub mtshag tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar nges pa lnga ldan gyi longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgyas nas chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi/ stong bka' bstsal pa de dag thams cad mdor bsdu na kun mkhyen gnyis pa ga da ston pa ga/ba gyi gsung las/ston pa'i dam chos rnam gnyis te// / lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do / /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che ni lung gi bstan pa dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis su nges la/ de yang de nyid las/ de 'dzin byed po smra byed dang sgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ 'e/sa gsungs pa ltar/bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba ni/ lung sde sgod sa/sum gyi 'chad nyan dang lam bslab pa gsum gyi nyams len kho na la rag las/ nge/ lta bu'i bstan pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po 'di nyid kyang / sngom 'phags pa'i yul du bstan pa'i gtad rabs bdun dang / 'dzam gling mdzes par byed pa'i ka drug kyi ba sogs paṇa grub dang chos skyong ba'i rgyal po rnams kyi mthu la brten nas dar rgyas su gnas pa yin/ ri bo bsil ldan gyi yul ljongs kyis mtshon pa'i yangs pa'i khams su yang / sprum// ras gzigs dbang bsam bzhin du mi'i rnam rol spyong bsan pa / hūṃ sogs chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum dang / lha gcig di/ bam ka ra/ thugs rje chen po 'byem ston gau/la rdzu 'a zang gnas bcas yab sras dang / 'gro ba'i nyi zla rnams kyi thugs rje 'od zer (la brten nas rgyal bstan 'dab brgya'i skyed tshal 'di nyid —— 367 ——

skal bzang bung ba'i dpa' du mi / nyam/sa nga ra /'dzum bzhin nga yim// ji ska/da du 'du/1ra bar bstsod pa lam 1/ ji lta ra sa ni spye rgu rjams/ kyi bzhi/ / de la/sa /3bras choms skye bar 'gyur ba lhar// / nge ba'i na /'dul/ ba'ang ldom/ brtson rnam/sa kyi sa/'i// / de ba'i na de —pas bsod mams rnams kyang bye 1 tshul /skrums yom tam zam sa kyi tsams su dgongs/ / de yi gnas ni 'dul ba yim par tsa/sung ma1/ / rlas bsungs nga ltar dam nga /'i tshas 'dul ba 'di nyid ne bstan nga/ rin/ po che'i sa/zhi rtsa dang / da/lar ngo/'i yon tan thams cad pyi/ byu gu bskyed nga//'i spung sa lta bu yin// yang de nyid la sa1/ mdzod ma chos/ 'du— ba dzogs pa 'di ga/nas nga / / de sri/da/ tshas sgron/ 'di ni gnas gyur 'i/nga / // zhes gsungs pa ltang dus sa/sum/ rgyal ba tham sa cad bye bces/ nga 'i snying nor dam pa'i tshos 'dul ba'i dbo/ngas pa ji lta ba ba'i na dge 'dun rdzams tshul khrims ma nga das/ nga 'i bcas ma/tsham/sa// 'a /sa mi 'ad༅ri bar/ chos spyod rnam/ bcu'i bya ba la brtson/ dbo/sa pa yin/ de/— snye ra ma khan pos gtso bor do dam byed dgo/sa te/ mkhan po yang ma khas ba tsun bzang ba/su/ma gyi yon tan dang ldan nga/'i dbe/ ba'i bshes gnyen/ zhis/ nges par dgos 'ing / de yang rab byung na gdan sa chen/ po rnams kyi ming btags che lo/ ga thon zin/ dang / di ltar ma byung yang bka' pod lnga la bslab sbyangs mthar phyin pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa 'i/ga dgos/ dge/ skos kyang rgan rab nas/ bya zhing / dbu mdzad sogs las sne chung khag rnam sa kyang mkhan/ ngo sa bab 'os kyi skos phyag mdzod pa sa/nyes ni rgan rabs mas gzhung sems dang ldam nga// bla phyag thun rdza/nga du spyi rdzas sa/tong rtsa'i skor mtha' da/ga la do dam legs par byu zhing / dbos sar mi chad mi dgos sar mi lhag pa byed// grwa tshang 'di'i chos gas ra du 'jug nga/ —— 368 —

rnams rab tu byung ba dge tshul4 slong gi sdom pa dang ldan ba zhis las/ rab tu mi byung ba skra bcang so/sa bsgyur tsam dang / rtsa ba'i ltung ba las gang yang rung ba e//tsa/ byung ba// gzhan nas gnas dbyung dang dbyung nges kyi nag can/lta grub mi ga/tsang ba'i ris/sa 'jug par mi bya/ rab tu 'byung dbo/sa rnams so so'i 'jig/ rten dge/ rgan mas/ rab byung si/ sdom pa skye gnas mdzes sa/sum gyi bar chad mtha' das/ yod med 'dul ba nas bshad nga/ ltar legs par brtags nas/ bar chad kyi dag na mkhan por snyan gsal 'bul/ chos bo/sa dang rtags cha lugs sogs tshang bar bya 'ing / dngos spyor gyi 'bul ba dad 'dun dang bstun par ma mtha'i lha rdzas dri med gcig nga bos/cho sa sogs snyes med phun tshogs kyi sgo nas sdom pa 'bog nga gal 'i/ma/ tu che/dbu ma'i ring song ma tshus/sa bar du chos 'jig rten dge zan gnyis re nges par du dgos shing / tshom la sa/ dman pa bsten pas/ mi dag nyam 'gyur zhi/nga / thad 7/ra 'bab sa brten na so na gan/sa/ gtso bo brten pas dam pa 'thob pa/ra 'gyur/ / zhes sa/su ngas pa ltar/ dke ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan nga/ 'i/ga bsam spyor sa/nyis kyi sgo nas bsten tshul/ 'jam ma so/na rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang gras/sa ba'i dpal gyis rang cag rjes 'brang pa rnams thams cad mkhyen par bgro/da pa'i lam gyi cha thams cad ma tshang ba med par lhug par bstsal ba'i byang chub lam gyi rim pa che chung nas gsungs pa ltar tshul bzhin du bsten pa las/ da/ga/'a dus bsten cing /sdug dus kha gtong rgyab los/ nas 'gro ba ni// mngon mtho dang nges legs su bgrod pa'i lam rtsa ba nas log pas thos bsam sgom pa'i bya ba gang la tshul ji ltar 'bad cing bsgrub kyang / bye ma rtsir pa las snum ji lta ba bzhin 'bras —— 369 la

bu ped par zad kyi/ skye ba nas tshe rabs thams cad du ngan song las thar ba'i skabs dang bral bar 'gyur ba yin pas// rgan gzhon kun gyis nyams su blang bya'i thil du byed pa sa/ces/ dge rgan rnams kyis kyang sa/sar bu pa rnams la rtsis bzhag sogs 'dzin sbyang 'khri/ da gsum la bslab bya sla chos sprul chos su ma song bar khur du blangs/ mkhan po las sne rnams smos ci/ rang las rka/na pa la'ang zhwa 'bud gzan 'beb sogs gus shing rtsis 'jog gang che byed/ dge 'dun rnams nas yul dus dang mthun nga/'i rab byung gi gos/ dmar ser mtha' sa/nyis su ma lhung ba gyon pa las khyim pa'i gos dka/ ra nag dang gos chen snam ther 'go rnam sog/sa rin thang che ba'i ris/sa pyon par mi bya/so so'i gur du 'tshog/sa nas rdon med kyi gleng mo dang bla slob das/'a snye'i bar gcabs dkyugs mi bya// dgon nang du rta ba tho/ma pa dang / rkyang 'bod ku co lag 'brel/ mchong rgyus/sa sogs kyi spyod/ lam mi mdzes pa dang / gri me lcags gang za tha khug sogs 'dos/sa nga ra mi rung / dgos pa gal che ba dang / tshes dus bzang por da/ge bskos la dgongs zhus dgon nang du bud med 'grul bzhud byas chos/ cing / de yang nyi nub gong du phyir thon/ rtsa ba bzhi dang / chang 'thung ba/ bla ma las sner kha lan lag lan byed pa byung na bo chen ngo brgyud su la'ang mi lhos par gaṇ+ḍi shog thams cad kyi gnas nas dbyung bar bya/ myos 'gyur gyi rig/sa chi ge mang du 'thung nas zi ba/ lhag par sbo tso hub gang tsam dang / tha mi kha 'then pa byung ba dang / so so'i dge rgan dang bslabs pa rgan par kha lan lag lan/ bla ma las/ sner mi gus pa'i rnam 'gyur/ gos mi rung ba gyon pa/ spyod lam mi mdzes pa spyad pa/sha da ra khas khu tsur sogs rtsed ngan rigs rtsed pa byung na/ tshogs dbus ——— 370 —— —

brkyang phyag brgya stong sogs kyis mtshon tshogs chu gad bdar sogs 'os bab kyi chad pa 'gel nas phyin chad spang sdoms su bcug 'di ltar dge 'dun gyi nang khrims/ 'dul ba'i bcas pa dang 'gal ba rnams la grwa tshang 'di kha'i bla ma las sne rnams nas ci thad kyi chad pa mtho dman gang gi yang ngo la blta bar mi bya zhing drang por khel/ de ltar 'gel tshe sa gnas kyi bdag po dbang shed can su thad nas ngan rgyab byed ceng las sne dma' 'bebs tu byed pa rnam pa kun tu mi rung / bla ma las sne gdan zur nas ngo dga' phyogs lhung gi sgo nas drang por mi spyod na sa gnas kyi bdag pos chad pa 'gel/cho/gas pa'i mang ja grol ba dang / zhwa ser zla ba/ma/ gzan chab blug/ phreng ba rgyan med sogs ma tshang bar med par zhogs pa'i chos rar 'du ste/ chos grwa tshugs mtshams nas zhag gsum/ nya stong brgyad gsum/ chos grwa'i sgang bcas la brgyad stong pa klog cing / de min so so'i 'dzin grwa'i sa bcad du tshul dang mthun par bzhugs/ dge skos kyi lag brda gtong ba dang yar tshogs/ gdugs dkar sgrol sher tshar gsum re/ chos rgyal ma/ bdag gzhan ma 'don nas thal skad gtong ste grol ba dang 'dzin grwa so so'i sa bcad du bgro gleng byed/ yas rim nas rtsis bzhag kun slong kun spyod bye brag rnams gsal gtab cing tshul ldan gyi sgo nas nyan par byed// dam bca' yas rim nas tshugs thal skad gtong tshul/ rtags bsal 'phang lug/sa kyang gdan sa chen po'i phyag bzhes mi nyams pad dmigs pa'i rim pa khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gtong ba gal che thing / rtags bsal yang lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas brgal rtags tshul mthun tsha gad spro nges shig las kun slong skyon can gyi sgo nas tshig ngan mtshang 'bru dma' 'beb kyi rigs rnam pa — 371 —

kun tu mi byed/ 'dzin grwa gong ma nas 'og mar dam bca' 'gro/ gsar bu bar blo skyed 'byung nges kyi lan thob mkhar brda byung ba dang grwa jar 'dzin grwa rgan gzhon gyi rim pa ma los/ yar dal bus so so'i gral du spyod lam zhi dul bag yod kyis 'khod des dbu mdzad kyis rta 'dur dbyangs gsum ji ltar gsung ba de bzhin mgrin dbyangs gcig gis 'don pa las/ g.yas 'then g.yon 'khyer mi bya/ zhal 'don yang rgyan 'jug gtso byas chos spyod dang /sbyin bdag gi sku rim 'don 'os sigs rang gzhan gyi don 'grub pa dang /bstan pa'i mig rgyan du 'gro ba gal che/ bza' btung la spyod pa'i tshe yang dge 'dun srung gi rtogs brjod yid la byed pa'i sgo nas longs su sprud/ grwa ja grol phral dgung tshigs chos rar tshogs dgos// dam bca' mas rim nas tshugs shing / gong ma la dam bcar 'gro gus shing rtsis 'jog si/ sgo ma/sa lan thob/ dge skos kyis las/ brda rga/tong ba dang yar tshogs sku rim rnam ga/sum 'don/ gong ltar mi ba 'ag nyan phral dam bca' yas rim/ nas tshugs la gong ma nas da/ma bcar 'gro/ chos thun 'dir rtsod pa rgyun sa//nga ring byed/ sbu rim chos rar nyi ma ma nub tsam nas 'du ste/ dam bca' mas rim nas tshugs/ gong mar dam bca' 'gro/ dge skos kyi lag brda byung ba dang yar tshogs phral skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ deng brtsam ma/ 'jug pa mtshams gnyis re// sgrol ma nyer gcig phyi nyin ma/sa so gcig nas chos sgang bar du bzhi re 'phar 'i/nga de nas bzhi re brid de nas 'dra ma byed/ 'on kyang dbyar dgun gyi chos thog chen por tsha grang gi dbang gis 'phar brid gong ltar mi byed kyang chorga/ pas chos sgang bar lnga bcu las nyung min byed/ de rjes legs bris ma 'er snying tshar bzhi dang seng — 372 —

gdong ma dang bzlog pa/ lo gyon ma dang tshe gzungs a ra ba tsa bcas tshar bdun re/ gdugs dkar bstod pa/ bla brgyud gsol 'debs dang byams chen ma gnyis re mos/ bstan 'bar ma 'don phral thal skad gtong ste grol ba dang / dam bca' tshugs gong ma nas dam bcar 'gro/ yas rim na/sa grol/ bsdus grwa'i 'dzin grwa bzhir/ ra stod bsdus grwa/ blo rtags gnyis su/ blo rigs dang // rtags rigs/ don bdun cur don bdun hru dang ston chos chen po nas shing rta'i srol tshugs/ 'dzin grwa gzhung gsar 'og ma dang / gong ma/ skabs dang po dang phar phyin bzhid la/thal phreng skabs dang ngo/ dang skabs gnyis pa bzhi pa bcas shog/ dgongs kyi chos rar rtsod/ dbu ma ga/yar snying gnyis la dbu ma'i stod cha smad cha//mdzod par mdzod gnas brgyad bka' ram 'os tu rnam 'grel le'u dang gnyis/ dgung tshigs su 'dul ba ga'i/ stod/ bka' rams/ su 'dul ba'i gzhi stod ga'i mid/ dgung tshigs su ma dzod gnas brgyad sa dkar lnga mchod gnyis la srod chos bsdus rwar rdzas ldog dang / rtags spyor mtshon spyor gnyis lo ltar re mos/ blo rigs yan chad skabs gsum pa/ lnga pa brgyad pa re mos/ dbu ma gnyis la bdag 'gog dus gsum re mos/bka' rams rnam gsum la/ 'dul ba'i spyir bstan/ dus tshigs re mos/ spru bzhag rnams kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs ba 'ad pa'i yig cha'i steng nas ma gtogs rang 'dod gang shar gyis mi bya/ dgun chos chen po zla chos zla bcu gcis/ pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas tshugs/ zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu drug nas byams smon/ 'ag bdun/ zla ba dang po'i tshes gsum nas cho 'khrul smon/ lam chen po tshes bco lnga'i bar nges nga /ra dgos kyi/ rab zhag nyer gcig — 37rte ——

zla gnyis pa'i tshes gsum nas bar tshes zhag bco lnga/ zla ga/sum pa'i tshes gsum nas dpyid chos chen po zla chos/ zla bzhi pa'i tshes bahru bdun nas dbyar chos dang po 'ag/ nyi shu/ zla lnga pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas dbyar chos/chen ngo/ zla chos zla drug pa'i tshes bco lngar dbyar spra ma khas blangs kyi spyor chos dang tshes bcu drug/ nas la/ sa blangs dngos gzhi/ 'di nas tshas mtshams chen po yin/ zla bdun pa'i tshes nyer dgu la glo bur dgag/ dbye/ gnam sang la ljongs rgyu/ zla brgyad nga/'i tshes gsum nas ston chos chen po zla chos/zla dgu pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas sa dkar chos thog zhag nyi shu/ zla bcu pa'i tshes bcu bdun nas lnga mtshad 'ag bco lnga/ zla chos la 'ing glo/nga ba'i/ nyi shu chos thog la 'ing slong gsum/ bco lngar gnyis/ dgun chos chen ngo/ra gzhung gsar 'og nga/ rnams byams gzhung gi dam bca' mtshan bud// dpyid chos chen por phar phyin sa skabs bzhi pa'i dam bca' mtshan bud tshugs/dbyar chos dang por phar phyin 'dzin grwa ba'i so so'i rtsod chos kyi thug chos ra yar tshogs la so so'i 'dzin grwar bzhugs nas dge bskos kyi las brda 'byung ba dang yar tshogs phral/ skyabs 'gro dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ sgrol ma nyer sa//cib sher snyeng tshar ga/sum/ bstan 'bar ma bcas thal skad gtong ste gros rtsod si med/ chos mtshams smon lam la/ skyabs/ 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ sgro la ma tshad gsum/ legs bres ma/ sher sbing tshar gsum/ ltung bshags/ deng nas ma/ bzang smon/ byams smon sogs smon lam gang rgyas/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ bstan 'bar ma bcas 'don phral thal skad mi gtong bar grol/ chos mtshams rnam sa su chos thos/ tu rtsod rgyu'i rtsi ba 'ag/ thal 'phreng / g.yin yang zur brgol sogs rgya bod ——— 374 ——

kyi gzhung chen zhogs pa'i blo 'dzin/ nyin mo sbyang ba/ dgong mo skyor ba ltur brtson byed pa las 'khyams nyul gyi rigs mi byed/ bzhi thog gi spyor brda/ lnga thog gi dam bca' khams tshan so sor rgyun gang ring tshugs/chos mtshams chen por lnga thog gi dam bca' mtshan bud spel bar khams tshan so sor tshugs/ der khams tshan gzhan yang 'du dgos/ dam bca' spyor sbyang sogs bla ma dge bskos nas blta rtog legs par byed la lhod yangs su ma gtong / dbyar sba ma khas len pa 'dun 'dzin chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gzhi gsum che ga ltar byed/ zla ba ngo re'i dus 'brel gso sbyong rnams kyang chag med nad pa ma gtogs mtho dman rgan gzhon su la'ang dmigs bsal ster du mi rung / ga bo bo so sor thar ba'i bcad ba'i mtshams las ma 'das pa'i srung sdom la brtson dgos pa ni bde legs kun gyi 'bras bu g.yur du za ba'i gzhi gcig pu tshul khrims gyi sdong po kho na yin pas tshul khri/ mas yang dag pa'i mdo las// de phyir ston pas tshul khroms rab bsngags bshad/ / tshul khrims ldan pa sa/ngas rgyas byung dang 'phrad/ / tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnam kun/ gyi mchog tshul khri/ mas ldan pa dri ngad byugs pa yin/ / zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ mkhan slob kyi spyam sngar khas blangs pa'i da/ge tshul slong ge sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs ngos legs par bzung nas srung la/ spyod lam kun tu bas/ dang ldan pa dang / gnam rtse steng ma sogs bslab bya rnam/sa la nyan bsam byed nga/ 'a /sa/ len du thebs pa gces/ drod dus kyi gso sbyong dang dbyar khas blangs nga/'i ring la gzan sham stod 'gag pyon/ nga las phu dung can su la'ang dmigs bsal med kyi ga 'a/na du nad pa sogs 'a yu/la dus dang bsnyun par gyis/ ngh+ru/na bdag nas 'gyed kyi bsnyen bkur byung na bla ma gdan — 37pasnye

zur/ dge bskos dbu mdzad/ phyag mdzod gnyis/ bla phyag gra tshang sbug ja chab dge g.yog mgon khang pa dang dkon gnyer/ ja chab kyi g.yog po/ gzhan yang bla sprul dmigs bsal can yod pa rnams la skal 'phar sbyin bdag gi 'dod pa dang bstun pa las rtsod gleng mi byed/ mgon khang du yid dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa tshad ldan song ba dang rab chos skyong so so'i bsnyen pa sngon song gi bzhi gra nas/ 'jigs byed kyi cho ga rgyas pa mgon chos lha gsum/ mgon rnam gnyis/ sbu lnga bstan skyong bcas kyi bskang bshags 'phrin skyems ma chag par gang mang thog khyad par mgon po phyag drug pa dang sku lnga bcas kyi bskang 'phrin 'gro cho dgos/ zla gtor dus gtor tshes gtor skabs su mkhan pos sdor slob byed/ de bzhin du tshes dgu/ bcu dgu nyer dgu rnams la bstan 'gro spyi'i phan bde dang /sgos su grwa tshang 'di'i chos 'chad nyan gyi bar chad sel ba'i ched du dmigs nas drug cu pa ma chag bar gyis/ 'dzin grwa phar phyin pa rnams/ bla ma lha bab/ bcu bzhi/ grwa ja/ gling kha bcas chos mdzad lnga/ skyor dpon nyer gnyis/ ja ma/ do dam pa 'dzin grwa rgan rabs nas byed la/ dus bzang so so'i 'don cha dang bsnyen bkur sogs kyi srol bkros sgo mang gi phyag bzhes ltar byed/ 'dzin grwa bka' ram par slebs nas dbang po rab la lo dgu/ de min bco lnga'i bar gang rigs slob gnyer dang mtshams par dka' bcu'i ming btags sber ba bla mas khur du blangs/ de yang dam bca'i sngon rol du/ ma mtha' lo gcig gi ring la chos mthun gcig tsam kyang ma chag par chos ra 'grims te gtong sgo dam bca' dbyar dgun kyi chos thog gang rung zhig la yul dus dang mtshams par byed/ bka' pod lnga'i ——— 376 —

gzhung tshan ji 'dra zhig nas bgro gleng btang rung bag tsha med pas tshad ma'i lung dang rigs pa'i sgo nas gtan la dbab pa'i brgal rtags kun gyi yid rab bskong ba dgos shing / ming btags kyang lo gcig la re gnyis las mi rung la/ lo ngo re bzhin ster dgos min bla mas bab ltos gyis/ de yang dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur grwa ja bzhes thug 'gyed dang bla mar 'bul ba sogs so so'i 'byor ba dang mtshungs pa dgos/ bla mas dgos pa gal che ma gtogs par chos ra'i rtsi bzhag chad lus su ma song ba dang / chos mtshams chen por dbu ma'i ring song man chad rgyugs len pa dang / dpyid chos chen po nas ston chos chen po'i bar lam rim chen po'i bshad lung gang rgyas/dpe cha 'dzin sbyang dang 'chad nyan mtha' dag gi do dam legs par byed cing /chos thog re bzhin du sgrig lam kun spyod kyi skor la tshogs gtam zhib rgyas su yang yang gtong ba bla mas khur du blangs/ dge skos kyis dbyar chos dgun chos chen por bca' yig snyan sgron dang bstun pa'i tshogs gtam gang rgyas dang / chos thog gzhan la yang sgrig lam phra rags mtha' dag dang / sgrig 'gal rigs la dmigs phug pa'i tshogs gtam bca' yig ltar yang yang thong / grwa mang chos ra 'grim lugs 'khrid sbyang sogs gang spyir bag yangs su song ba khur du blangs/ dgongs zhu zhag gsum tshun la dge bskos dang /de phan bla ma la'ang zhu de yang dgos pa yod nges shig la ster gyi/ dgos med du pha ma nye 'brel la kha 'do/gas nas don med du 'khyams par 'dod pa rnams la dgongs pa ster bar mi bya'o/ ji skad du spyod 'jug las/'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang / / bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cis/ / ces —— 377 —

gsungs pa ltar dge 'dun rnams na/sa rnam 'dren bu ram/ shing pa'i bstan pa rin chen dbang gi rgyal po'i yang snying / mnyam med rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyi mdo sbags zung 'brel gyi ring lugs rin po che gser sbyangs ba bo ma lta bu 'di nyid/ nam mkha' ji srid gnas pa de srid du/'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas pa'i gsos su gong du ji skad bshad pa ltar nyams len gyi thil du mdzod cig mdor na rang rang gi khas blangs pa'i dam tshig sdom pa tshul bzhin du mi srung ba dang dge 'dun gyi nang khrims ma rtsis pa rnams/ dpal ye shes kyi mgon po/ las gshin/ dmag zor ma sprul pa'i chos rgyal pe har sogs kyis lus sbog gi steng du dka' chad brag tu dbab par gdon mi za/ thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad cing / sgo kun nas tshul dang mthun par spyad bar dag nyin mtshan kun tu srung skyobs dang 'phrin las 'grub pa la skad cig kyang mi g.yel bar gnyer du gtad do/ smras pa/ bshad sgrub bde 'byung gtsug rgyan me lha'i dbyings su 'dzegs dang lhan/ / mnyam med thub pa'i ring lugs yang snying rin chen 'byung gnas che/ /skal bzang gdengs can mtho ri'i dga' bdes 'tsho ba'i dpal cig pur/ /rnam par 'phel la bred pa'i go skabs nam yang med par shog / rlabs chen thugs bskyed mkha' yi glang po lang long g.yo ba'i dbus/ /legs byas 'bum gyi lus stobs rab rgyas zab rgyas chos kyi sgra/ /dbyangs can lhug par ldir bzhin 'phrin las sbrang char bsnyil ba las/ /dge legs rtsi bcud spel mdzad bstan 'dzin sgra brgya zhabs brtan shog / khrims kyi brlan gyis rab tu gtams pa'i 'du pad tshal 'dir/ /rnam dpyod rmad du byung ba'i lus kyi stobs ldan shra ma ra/ /mtha' klas lung ——— 378 ——

dang rigs pa'i spyo dbyangs snyan par tro/ gas ba'i na du1 // ngang gis 'dus rte nyams/ tos/sa sbra nga rtsi 'i ro la rtas spyo da shos/ / tshad med mthu rtsal dang ldan/ srung ma'i tshogs/ / / rgyal ba'i spyan sngar 'al bzhes g.yar dam de 1/ ma bsnye la sde 'dir tsha tsa pa'i sems 'chang rnams/ // sgro'/ /la tshul ldan srung spyobs/ ma sa/ yeng hrus// bsnan dang bldan 'dzin 'dus nga 'i sde bcas la /ma sma da sri zhu ldur len spyim nga 'i bdag sum/ rtsen ba nge/ spyong sa steng /'phos 'dra ba'i/ / dpal la ci btsa/ra lo ngas su/ spyod nga ra thos / khrim/sa su bca' ba 'i nyin byed dbang po la ma/// // sprang blangs drang po'i 'od rnon 'bar ba dang / //lhan gcig mi bsrum mu tshogs bder gan/sa pa'i// /go skabs 'phros te tshu' lngam/ nga/nga mo 'dzum/ / rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas byin brlabs dang / /dpal ྅ na thub pa'i ba7/'a sru/nga mthu stobs kyis / /'dus pa'i sde/ dang skye rgu mtha' das/ la// / bkra this dge mtshan bye ba ‘3bar gyur cib// ces thor god rgyal/ po spo yan tshos// thu mas// /mtshan snyed grwa tshang gas ra 'dzus/sa kyi khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge 'di lta bu zhig dgos zhes bskul ba ltar/ // nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng gi rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po badz+ra rda ra ta la'i bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyogs phyog/sa las rnam par rgyal ba sdes/ / rab byung bco lnga pa'i 'gal ba zhes pa sa mo glang lo'i dbyar zla tha chung gro bzhin gyis nya ba'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes dge bar nor gling bskal bzang pho brang nas bres/zhes dngul tham chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

drugaXzu sngags bon bcas kyi bca' yig drang thig dge legs kyi 'od snang bzhugs/dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i lo rabasaXbargyadaXcu'i yas mas tsam/oṃ su ste// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ /dus mthar bsam bzhin byon pa'i bka' drin can/ /dus gcig min par 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i/ /dus gsum kun gzigs sngags 'chang chen por 'dud/ /'di drug cu mthil la sngags bon rnams la bslab bya byed rgyur/ dus phyis rang re'i gdan sa chen po dpal ldan sa skya 'di nyid kyi chos grwa lho byang gi dge 'dun rnams nas mdzad rgyu'i sgrig lam kun spyod la spyon sel hrung zad zhu dgos rnams nged rang nas zhib cha 'khod pa'i bca' yig so sor bcos yod pas de dang chabs cig khyed rnams kyang mang ja dang / 'chams sku'i zhabs phyi sogs dge 'dun dang rjes 'brel du kha shes 'du dgos 'dug pa rnams la sngar nas bzung mig ltos ngan pa nyag rkyang gi mgo 'jug med pa zhig 'dug par brten dus phyis gzhung zhabs pad mchog nas mang ja'i dpyad khrar yang zur tshogs phud pa'i zhes dmigs bsal bkod snang 'di la dpags nas — 380 —

slar khyed rang tshor mang ja'i rigs rtsa chag byung dogs 'dug pa dang / lhag par sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ni drug cu mthil pa dang sngags bon la bka' drin shin tu che ba yin kyang / mgon des gsungs pa'i lha khang chen mo'i bca' yig las/ sngags bon btsun ma rnams kyang rang rang gi chas gos lugs mthun yod/ cing / lo bco lnga lon pa yan dge 'dun dang ma 'dres par 'khyams snad du thongs/ mi skya gzhung ma'i chas dang / skya bo'i chas/zon pa 'bar zhwa gyon pa rnams mi gtong / zhes gsungs pa 'dis sngags bon btsun ma rnams kyi cha lugs gsal zhing / yang bca' yig/ de nyid las/gdan sa de khrod nas 'byon pa rnams kyi cha lugs sngags dgon gyi bca' yig nang bzhin byed zhes gsungs pa 'dis/ gtso bor bde chen gling pa dang /zhar la ser khyem pa drug hru mthil pa rnams kyi bca' yig zur tsam rga/sungs 'dug pas na/ da yang tig ngeng/ rang gi cha nas bla ma gong ma'i dgongs pa dang mi 'gal zhing / chos grwa lho byang bo/ zhabs tog tu gyur ba da/nga / sde mi ser la byams skyong shin tu che bar byas pa'i/ sa skya'i mnga' 'bas tshang ma phyug po dpal 'byor can kho na ngos/ gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde thob pa zhig byung na ce ma rung snyam pa'i lhag bsam 'khor yug tu yod kyang / lugs gnyis kyi khrims 'di sra thang ma byung ba 'di'i gegs chag lta bu'i nged rang gi nu bo de chung ngu nas che'i dus byas gdung brgyud kyang chad la nye/ lo phyugs lam du mi rgyug mnga' 'bangs rnams dbul zhing 'phongs pa sogs sdug bsngal sna tshogs zhig yong 'dug pa nas slad chad nged rang tshe mthar phyin zhing / gdung brgyud chad med 'byung ba dang / chab 'bangs rnams la lo phyugs legs pa sogs bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ba'i — 381 —

phyir/ snga srol bzang po bzhin byed dgos tshul tshas grwa lho byang gi bca' yig dang / phyas/ gnyer gyis mtshon drung 'khor ser skya/ 'bul sdud tshong khas/ gzhi/sa gnyer sogs tshang mar kha lta'i yi ge bcas yod pa dang cha 'dra bar /khyed drug hru mthil pa rnams kyang da nas bzung skra bregs/ mang ja sogs dbe/ 'a/dun dang cha 'dra byed dgos rnams la gos dmar/ gzan dmar /bod lham bcas gyon/ lo bco lnga yan chad mang jar yong rgyu dang / lngags bon rnams kyang rang rang gi cha lugs 'as/la ped bod lham gyon pa bcas dang /lo grangs drub hru ma/thil pa dang cha 'dra rngo/nga ba ma ga/tos/sa/ bab chol nga/ ma bzung sa/tan na/sa mi byed// 'don cha'i rim pa sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshad med ba'i/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs tho lo ka gcig/ ja mchod bskal bzang ma dang ngo mtshar ma/ sngas/sa chang chen po'i sku bstod the/sa bya kun la ma yo/ngas rdzogs// 'jam mgon kyim mes zhabs kyi sku bstod/ ngag da/bang lha yi mkhyen brtse ma / rgya04 ba gnyis nga/ ma nas/ ring 'tsho'i/ bdem/ tshis/ gi bar re/nga sang bzhin bsam pa myur 'grub ma// ltung bshags/ sa skya'i rje btsun ma le tshan/ bdag gi dus gsum ma/ sangs rgyas sku gsum mnyes pa'i sogs/ byang phyog/sa skyong ba'i sogs/ gangs can bod kyi sogs/ 'gro ba'i bla ma sogs mang jar yong mi gang yod na/sa sngags kyi rgad bu rnams phud/ nged rang dang lo mnyam man chad nas bzung slar mang ja sgug dgos tshang mas slob dpon rgya mtsho dpon la rgyugs 'bul byas ngos/khyed dang tsho'i khrod nas dbu byed gang 'os zhig gi/sa bskul nas mang ja mang ba'i skabs phral rgyu dang / las dus med cing nyung skabs sde tshan gcis la tshang ma gtong rgyu dang / las dus thub/ skabs sna kha re gnyis btang nas grol — 382 ——

ba ma gtogs// rnam pa kun tu bag med byas pa byung na mang ja'i skabs gtso bor lha khang chos khrims pa dang / sger du chu bskor zam sne ba sogs khyed rang tsho'i mgo yod rnams nas kha lta sogs 'jur gang dam byed dgos par lha khang chos khrims par yang re'i rgyu mtshan song bas de bzhin dang / yang drug cu mthil pa nas dmigs bsal byed dgos/ dgu gnam gang gi dus gtor dang phag rnying dbyar rims la mang ja spor do dang / rdor gnyer /lang nas do bskor/ dus gtor gyi chas ka lcags ya re dang / sha 'os/ mtshams las 'ing lnga thog bzhi/na dbyar mthong lo gsar gyi rten dang / thug rgyu nas khal phyed gnyis re zhu ba'am/ yang na da lta bzhin spyi mchod pas nyos nas zhing rin ṭam bcu re/ drug cu mthil pa spyir sprod byed rgyu gnyis dbyengs la slebs gang che las tshan/ gyis do dam byas ngos de dag/ gi skabs su bskang ba sogs mi thon pas tshas spyod gang 'grub re gtong / sa 'dul gyi 'tshams pa rnams rin chen sding par btugs pa'i shes na dang mi shes pa rnams nas 'don sngar srol ba'i na dbyar rim khag rnying skabs stong ja/ phyed ja/bsdus chang byas nas slebs skyang yod tshe sngar srol bzhin dang / chos khrims pa chu zam gnyis dang / bcu dpon rdza ma ba dang gtso thab pa gnyis la phyed 'dren chen mo dang / stong dpon don bkras dang rgyab hral ma gnyis la bzhi cha yong ba'i rgyu mtshan drug cu pa'i sgrig lam kun spyod tshang mar 'go 'dom yang dag byed dgos kyi gsol ras yin par nges shing / dus mdos sogs kyi skabs 'tshams sku'i 'bas phyi dang / dung spu khag gang dgos/ ga bo thab pa'i nag reng pa/ btang bla'i rnga zlam thob zhwa/ gru stag dge slong gi gzugs/ phur sgrub hor shang gi gras/ dus mdos zab mo'i skabs bud — 383 ———

med kyi 'chams sogs tshang ma khral 'jal stong min tsam du ma song bar thag pa khur blangs rang gzhan ngo mi tsha ba zhig dgos rgyu dang / mdzod pa'i skor las byed khungs la/ dus chen dgongs rdzongs gang yod rigs la phyag mdzod dang / tsa/nyer tshang du brda' gtong dang / tshogs byengs dang phyed 'dren chen mor thud ltar 'gyed dgos/ las chen/ dbu chos/ las thog spyi chen rnams kyi zur sprod dang spyi 'byed zhu dgos/ cho ga dus ma dang / rag kha tshogs chen sogs la yang 'gyed dgos gong mtshungs dang / rags kha tshogs chen yod sa'i snga nyin mar thud ba/zhugs gral bskyed dgos la/ ban tshang pa dbu mchod/ dkar rgyang pa/ bde gling dbu chos/ chos grwa lho'i dbu chos spyi las/ lho mchod dpon/ bla brang drung chen// mthil sku gnyer/chos sde lho byang sgo ra ba dang ba'i/ thog sgo ra ba/ drug hru bcu dpon gnyis /drug cu chos khrims gnyis mdzod g.yog bcas la sbyin bdag sa gnas lam/ sprod dang / 'bum ther gang yod la tshogs brda' dang / ko 'gyed spyi 'gyed las thog pa dang nyis dpang gis byed dgos/ thud bskyed zhu gong mtshungs/ mus chen dang mchod 'bul la bla rigs la brda' gtong dang /phye 'dren bskyed khungs dbyangs dpon bcu bzhi/ zor las pa lnga/ dkar rgyang pa/ mdzod g.yog bzhi cha bskyed khungs rin sgang btsun ma dbu mdzad gsum/ spyi sa bzhi/ sngags bon chos sgo gnyis/ drug hru stong dpon gnyis/ chos khrems gzhon pa/ sgo ra ba gsum/ ja tsha gnyis/spyi pa bzhe rnams la bskyed dgos/ cho ga'i rigs la rigs lnga dar dpyang yod med las thog pa dang mdzod g.yog gnyis kyi skor nas med rigs kyi mar thud bsdus nas 'byams tshul la 'bul/ gza' 'dzin byung tshe gnyer tshang —— 384 ————

du 'gyed brda'/ nas 'gyed yod rigs la brda' gtong gong mtshungs/spe ser 'ong phud skabs rgya la gsum la brda' gtong dang zur sprod zhu dgos/spyi pa'i lo gsar/ dbyar mthong sogs kyi btub/ rtsal lud gyi rgyab 'gro/lo gsar gyi phyed 'dren bskyed khungs gong mtshungs/ sa bir gyi sa rtsi gtong dgos dang / skas 'dzugs/ bsangs gtong / gzhi len gcig bskyur gyi brda'/ las chen par zur sprod/ spyi 'gyed zhu ba sogs gong mtshungs/gcig bskyur bu ram deb nang ltar zhu dgos/ bdud brtsi lnga mchod bu ram zhu khungs gong mtshungs/ mdos chen nyer brgyad la tho sgrig/ bzhugs gral las tshan la brda gtong / nyer dgu las tshan bskong tshogs gong mtshungs/zla ba dang po'i tshes bco lnga la bkris lha khang gi rnam rgyal gur zhu ba/ shing dang chas len/ brda' gtong / dge tsha'i rab gan/sa skabs gur zhu dgos dang / 'bul mi grong rab bzhi'i 'bul dgos/ skyed lha nang gso gnyis kyi mdzod pa/ gtor spod kyi dgos cha deb nang ltar zhu dgos/ phag rnying dbyar rim rnams kyi zhu dgos kyang gong mtshungs sdud khral dang / 'gyed dkor skal sogs kyang btsun chung dpe 'dra dang / zhar byung rgyug dmar sogs grwa tshang dang 'brel ba tshang mar yang gang la gang dgos de dang de 'phyug med du bgyid cing / sbags bon rnams nas dmigs bsal byed dgos/dus mdos/ sku rim chen mo/ phag rnying lha mo gsol mchod kyi skabs sogs sbags bon gyi 'don pa gtong khungs tshang mar las slar ma song ba'i spyong brdar dang de dag gi skabs kyi mdos dang / 'cham rnga rol chas gos tshang ma khyed rang tsho'i gzhung bzhin 'gangs gtsang ma gtogs byis pa'i rtsed mo lta bu'i chal chol du ma song ba zhig gal che zhing / dar chen so so spyod len — 385 —

dang / nged rang si/ klu dar 'dzugs rgyu/ skyed lhas byas 'gyur gyi gzim phug bzhi dang / /'jam chu'i sa rtsi dang / phur sgrub gtor 'bul/ mgon/ po mnga' gso'// mdos sde nged rang phyogs 'grul 'gug dus bzhi thob/ phun tshog/sa gleng lha khang / rtse rnams su dar 'dzin sogs khral sa/nga babs 'a/'ang las mi dang 'khur med du ma1 song ba'i hur bskyed sos/sa ba/dan sa 'i/ 'bas phyi zhu dgos tshang ma phyag nyer las tshan rim can gyi bkod khyab ba'i na byed dgo/sa las/ gang ldar da lam gyi yi se/ 'di khyed rnams la snyeng rje med par dbang 'o da kyi tshig kha dal lta bu ma yi/ par/ khye/ da rang tsho'i 'di phyi'i don dang bstan nom/ lar rgya la bsams nas bris pa yin pas/ 'dis/ rdo da/ma par bka/krā gros pa'i ga sgo bo rgya mtsho dpon la mdzad dgos pa bzhin grwa sa che ba dan sa pa rim can/ dang / chu skor zam sne ba sogs rang rang gi 'bo/ yod tshang mas do dam dang de la gzhan rnams kyis dang dod lhus slangs ga/la che zhing / las tshan rnams kyis lugs mthun ma byas pa dang lugs mthun byas kyang g.yin gyis ma nyan pa sogs byung na gzhung du gsal slebs pa gyis bden rdzun dbyed 'byed dgos/ phyis lam khegs pa'i bkod khyab tshang ma de thog nas byed pa yin pas tshang mas rgo/ 'tshal/ zhes legs nyes gsal ba'i yi ge drang thig dge legs 'od snang 'di yang / sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bres pa dge bar gyur cig/ / /—— 386 ———

chosaXsde chenaXpo theg chen dam chos dga' tshal gling giXkhrims su bca' ba'i yi ge phyag na padaXkloXzhal lungaXblang don nabaXgasalaXbyed /bkar /dbas /bya bab bab(1bkabs thod/sa khye/ (spyi loX1shā9shā )oṃ sa ste/ tshogs gnyis sa 'dzin dbang po las thon zhing / /mkhyen brtse'i grib bsil yangs pa'i yal ga can/ /don gnyis 'bras bu'i dog pa g.yur za ba'i/ /thub dbang dpag bsam ljon pa rgyal gyur cis /mang thos chu gter dbus na gnas bcas shing / /tshul bzhin rnam dpyod gdeng ka mngon par mtho/ / rnam grol dbang gi rgyal po'i cod pan can/ / rgya bod 'dul 'dzin klu dbang tshogs de bsngags/ /khyad par sa la'i sman ljongs dbu ma dang / /nges gsang rim gnyis nyams len zung 'jug gi/ shing rta'i srol 'byed rje btsun bong kha pa/ sras dang bcas pa'i rnam rgar snyeng la sims/ /blo bzang 'jam pa'i rdo rje bong kha pa'i/ /rnam dag ring lugs rin chen ri bo khur/ /ris med skal bzang 'dul bya'i dpal yon du/ /legs mkhas rgya mtsho'i bla ma phyag gi gnas/ /'dul gzhung kai la sha yi sa 'dzin las/ /legs la — 387 ——

'ong rnyog bral bca' khrims gang ga'i rgyun/ /khungs ldan legs bshad chu klung stong phrag dang / /lhan cig dad ldan rgya mtshor dbab par bya/ /de yang so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni byung ba bde/ /chos ldan pa yang bde ba yi/ /dge 'dun mthun pa bde ba ste/ /mthun pa rnams kyi dka' thub bde/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lung rtogs kyi bstan pas bsdus pa'i dam pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba dang / de'i don tshul bzhin du sgrub pa'i dge 'dun rnams gshe yang slar mi gshe khro yang slar mi khro ba sogs dge spyong gi chos bzhi'i bka' thub la gnas nas 'khor lo gsum gyi nyams len la 'grub pa rnams ni srid zhi'i legs tshogs thams cad 'byung ba'i sgo gnyis su med pa yin la/ lung gi bstan pa de la yang sde sgod rin po che'i rnam pa gsum du yod pa'i ya rgyal 'dul ba'i sde sgod ni/ sde snod gzhan gnyis ltar rgyal ba'i lung gi bstan pa yin pa ma zad dgag sgrub gnang gsum gyi bslab pa'i bcas mtshams phyin ci ma log par ston pas na ston pas kyang go chod pa ches phul du byung ba ni/ lung rnam 'byed las/rgyal ba ston pa de yi dam chos dag / mdo dang chos mngon yin gsung 'dul ba ni/ /ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yin phyir/ /gnyes sur phyag byas sangs rgyas chos gcig gzhan/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ 'dul ba'i sde sgod kyi gten la dbab bya'i lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab ba rin po che yang gnas skabs lha mi'i mngon mtho phun sum tshogs pa dang sa bcu dang lam lngas bsdu ba'i nges legs bya ba gsum rgyu dang bcas pa'i rnam byang gi yon tan rnams ma skyes rnams bskyed cing / skyes zin gong 'phel du bya bde'i gzhi dang rten du gyur pa yin te/ 'dul bar bstod pa las/ sa las 'bru ——— 388 —

rnams skye bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de yi de las bsod nams rnams kyang skyed/ /tshul khrims yon tan rnams kyis gnas su dgongs/ /de yi gnas ni 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs shing / lhag par sngon rdzogs ldan gyi dus su/ lo dang bskal ba bye ba brgyad stong gi bar du/ tshul khrims kyi yan lag cha tshang bar bsrungs shing / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig mang por mchod pa'i yo byad thams cad kyis bsnyen bkur byas pa bas/ de sang snyegs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su tshul khrims sna gcig nyin mtshan tsam du srung ba phan yon che ba ni/zla ba'i sgron me'i mdo las/ bskal ba bye ba gang gi rnyed du dang ba'i sems kyi zas dang skom rnams dang / / gdugs dang ba dan mar me'i 'phreng ba yis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig rim gros byas/ /gang gi dam chos rab tu 'jig pa dang / /bde gshegs bstan pa nyams su gyur ba'i tshe/ nyin mtshan du ni bslab pa gcig spyod pa'i/ / bsod nams de ni bde bas bye brag 'phags/ /zhes sogs phan yon dpag tu med pa gsungs pa ltar yin kyang /ma bsrungs na nyes dmigs kyang shin tu che ba yin te/ tshul 'chal gyi dge 'dun gyi rdzas tha na'ang gtsug lag khang gi sa steng gang zas su su'i 'dab ma gang / btung ba chu thig tsam la'ang longs spyad du mi dbang zhing / bcas kyang phra mo cig las 'das kyang ngan song du skye ba sogs nyes pa mtha' yas la gsungs te/ rnam 'byed las/ lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag / zos par gyur pa mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi ldom pas/ /yul 'khod bsod snyoms za ba yin/ / zhes dang / 'di na la las rgyal po'i tshig chen yang / /lan 'ga' 'das na chad pa thob mi 'gyur/ /thub nga/'i bka' lung tshul min 'da' byed na/ /dud 'gror skye gyur e la'i 'dab klu bzhin/ /zhes — 389 —

sogs gsungs pas/ des na tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che bsrung na phan yon che la/ ma bsrung na nyes dmigs kyang shin tu che ba de lta bas na/ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes su rab tu byung / drang srong chen po rgyal mtshan bcang / thub pa'i btul bzhugs la slob par khas che ba rnams kyis ni/tshul khrims rnam bar dag pa la 'bad pa nyed nyams len gyi snying por byed dgos la/ de'i tshul yang mkhan po dang slob dpon la bsten pa sogs srung thabs rnam pa lnga gsungs pa rnams ni/ 'dul ba'i gzhung chen po rnams nas dang ma mtha'ang dge tshul dge slong gi bslab bya mdor bsdus te khong du chud par byas te shes dgos kyi/ 'dir mtha' dag/ par bris kyi ga la lang /skabs su babs pa grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi dge 'dun rnams kyi thun/ mong ma yin pa'i sgrig lam kun spyod kyi rim pa ni bsil ldan mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig 'dzam gling mkhas grub bye ba'i 'byung gnas rigs grol gyi chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde'i grwa tshang bzhi'i nang mtshan dpal ldan bkris sgo mang gi phyag srol dang phyogs mthun par brjod par bya ba la/ thog mar chos sde 'dir gsar 'jug gis zhugs sgo ni chos thos/ ma gtogs chos mtshams sogs dus gang rung la bcug mi tshag/ cing / de yang phyogs gzhan nas rab tu byung zin yin na bslab sdom dang lta grub gtsang min/ gsan nas gnas dbyung byas pa sogs kyi nag can yin min gyi brtas/ dpyad legs par byas te dgag bya de/ rnams dang mi ldan na 'jug/ gsar du btsun pa byed dgos rnams ma mtha' dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung gi tshul brems dang ldan nga/ra byas nges dgos/ skyabs sems dang / sgrol sher rgyugs pa sprad de 'jug gsar 'jug kyi bla ma'i — 390 ———

mjal khar 'gro dus ja ldir gang dang kha btags rgya chen re gtong / dus bzhi'i chos grwa gang yin kyang tshogs rgyu'i nyin dge bsgos dang chab ril ba gang rigs kyi brda phul ba bstun/ nyi ma mdung gang tsam lus pa'i tshe grwa bgres gzhon tshang mas zhwa zla gam bzhes nas chos grwar rang rang gi 'dzin grwa'i go sar zha/la bla ma'i bzhugs khrir phyogs te bzhugs/ de nas dge bskos kyi lag brda phul ba dang / bzhugs khri'i mdun ngos su g.yas spungs g.yon spungs med/ par zla gam thang la gting ba lta bu'i dbyibs can du tshogs shing / de dgong thog mar skyabs sems dang / de rjes dpal ldan rtsa ba'i ma sngon du btang bas dmigs brtse ma tshar bdun/ de nas ma dal brel ran ya dang de rjes po ta la yis mar 'gor sbyar ba'i sgrol ma tshar bdun/ sgrol 'dzab/sgrol gsol/ legs bris ma'i mjug tu bcom ldan 'das ma dang / sku'i skyon spangs ma gnyis sbyar ba/ de rjes sgra bsam brjod med ma 'gor sbyar ba'i sher snyeng tshar gsum bzlog bcas dang/ slar yang sher snying tshar gcig gi mjug tu/ kun mkhyen lnga pa'i gsung seng gdang ma'i mngon rtogs spyan 'dren bzlog pa bcas btang ba'i mjug tu/ mkha' spyod ma tshar gcig gang gi sgo nas ma tshar gsum/ de rjes gzhon nu'i cha lugs ma sngon du 'gro ba'i a ra nga/ tsa na nyer gcig brtse ldan khyed kyi ma'i mtha' rten dang bcas nga// rgyal ba kun gyi ma sngon du btang ba'i lo gyon ma'i gzungs nyer bcig gi mjug tu/ dge ba 'di yi ma sbyar ba/ de rjes ga/dung dkar bstod pa tshar gcig de rjes skabs gnas kun 'dul ma/de rjes bstan 'bar ma/ chos rgyal ma/ de rjes bdag g.yin ma'i dbyangs kyi mjug rdzogs pa dang / dbu zhwa bzhes nas thal rdab sngon du btang ba'i (rte91 —

thal skad byas nas grol zhing yar tshogs kyi dgong mo 'dir mjug tu rtsod pa mi byed/ sang nang bar nas bzung zhogs chos gsum gyi ring chos don byed cing chos bton tshar ba dang dge bskos kyis brda phul bstun tshogs lugs sngar dang 'dra ba la zhal 'don bde gshegs btsugs nas ma 'gor spyar ba'i gdugs dkar tshar gcig bkod pa bzlog pa dang bcas pa/ de rjes 'phags pa dkon mchog ma 'gor sbyar ba'i sher snying tshar gsum/ mkha' spyod ma sngon du 'gro ba'i seng gdong ma'i gzungs brgya tshar gcig gi mjug tu khyu thā sngon du 'gro ba'i bzlog pa'i mjug tu bgegs rigs stong phrag ma sbyar ba/de rjes sgrol ma tshar gcig gi mjug tu rje btsun bla ma sbyar ba/ de rjes chos rgyal ma dang bdag gzhan ma'i mjug tu tha skad gtong zhi/nga / zhogs chos gsum po 'di'i ring rtses bzhag mi gtong / de rjes rtsod pa ji ltar 'tshams pa'i rjes su 'dzin grwa so sor dam bca' skor/ gzhan yang nya stong brgyad gsum gyi chos 'don yod pa'i skabs su yang zhogs chos skor 'di bzhi/na du byed// nyin bzhi pa nas bzung zhogs chos rnams tshogs lugs yar tshogs kyi dgong mo dang 'dra bar sngon du chos 'don pa rtsod pa sogs mi byed cing /zhal 'don gyi rim pa zhogs chos dang po rnams ji lta ba bzhin gdugs dkar gyi sngags ring du slebs pa dang / rtsis bzhag zhu mi gtong / bdag gzhan ma'i mjug tu thal skad mi gtong bar bla mas bsngo ba byed/ bsngo ba'i mjug tu tshigs bcad gang rigs zhig btang nas mar grol nas rang rang gi 'dzin grwar gnyis cha byas nas rtsod pa byed cing / rtsis bzhag gtong ba'i rim pa bka' rams kyi 'dzin grwa nas bsdus chung gi bar rim par gtong zhing / de yang rang gis 'dzin grwa'i rtses bzhag zhu ran pa dang / lham phud nas phyag — 392 ——

gsum re phul nas bla ma'i mdun du gus pa'i spyod lam gyi tshogs la bla mas rtsis bzhag tshar gsum btang ba dang / skyor dpon gyis tshar gcig skyor/slar yang phyag gsum re phul nas rang rang gis 'dzin grwar skebs pa dang /skyor dpon gyi tshar gsum bskyar ba'i rjes su thams cad kyis bsdebs skyor byed/ bye brag tu ston chos gnyis pa dang dgun chos dang po gnyis kyi ring /srod chos la bka' dam dang / 'dul mdzod kyi 'dzin grwa rnams bsdoms nas 'dul ba'i spyir bstan pa dang / dus tshigs re mos dang dbu ma'i 'dzin grwa gnyis la/ srod chos dus gsum rnam bzhag dang / bden gnyis dang / tshad 'gog ri mo ba dang / phar phyin 'dzin grwa rnams bsdoms nas skabs gsum pa/ lnga pa/ brgyad pa rnams re mos dang / bsdus grwa'i 'dzin gra rnams bsdoms rgyan 'jug gam/ mtshan spyong rtag spyor gang rigs gtong / rtses bzhag btang tshar rim gyis 'dzin grwa gong ma gong ma rnams nas 'og ma rnams la dam bcar 'gro/ de nas bla ma gzim chung du phebs tshar ba'i tshod tsam la bka' rams kyi 'dzin grwa grol zhing / de bzhin du yas rim nas grol ba ma gtogs bsdebs grol byas mi chogade nas nyin chos ni nyi ma dgung yol tsam nas tshogs shing de'i tshul yang thal skad sogs kyi brda byung ba dang 'dzin grwa mtho dma' gang rigs yin kyang mi gsum slebs phyin dam bca' 'dzugs/ bzhi lnga sogs skebs pa dang rang gi 'dzin grwa'i sa khongs ma stong pa'i sgo nas 'dzin gra gong ma rnams su dam bcar 'gro/ de nas nyi ma snga phyi'i bab la bltas nas dge bskos kyis brtsi bzhag zhu mi gtong zhing / bla ma chos rwa'i sgo 'gag tu skebs pa dang yar tshogs dus mnyam yong ba byed/ tshogs nas zhal 'don gyi rim pa — 393 —

gdugs dkar ma gtogs zhogs chos dang 'dra zhing / sher snying gi 'gor smra bsam brjod med ma dang mjug tu bdag sogs rnams kyi ma dang / sgrol ma'i mjug tu mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid mngon 'don/ dpyid chos dbyar chos ston chos rnams la nyin chos kyi skabs bla mas lam rim chen mo dang /'jam dpal zhal lung gi bshad lung gtong dgos la/ de'i tshul gyi chos grwa'i zhal 'don dkyus ma rnams tshar ba dang / de ma thag chos grwa'i 'go mjug dang rkang rnams la maṇ+ḍal rgyag pa dang / rgyun bar sa gzhi/ spos byug ma dbu mdzad kyis bskul zhing / de jes bla ma mdo tshar gcig bskul nas bzlog pa tshar re'i mjug tu sangs rgyas chos tshogs ya tshar gsum btang ba'i rjes thog der phun tshogs dge legs ma nas bzung lam rim bla brgyud rigs bsdus shig bskul/ de'i mjug bshad pa ji ltar 'tshams pa'i rjes su bla mas chos bshad pa las byung ba yi/ zhes gsung ba dang / gas pas chos nyan pa las byung ba yi/ zhes pa'i tshigs bcad gcig gsung zhing / de rjes bsngo ba tshar nas grol bstun ba mi bzhag gtong lugs rtsod pa byed lugs sogs zhogs chos ji lta ba bzhin byed/ de nas sku rim tshogs lugs nyin chos ji lta ba bzhin la yar tshogs nas zhal 'don gyi rim pa yar tshogs kyi dgong mo dang ha lam 'dra ba la/ khyad par deng nas mar mdang ring gtong //de'i mjug tu dbu ma 'jug pa'i bskul mtshams gnyis re dma' thar byas pa'i gang thon re dang / sgrol ma tshar nyer gcig nyung thar byas pa 'don/skyabs gnas kun 'dus ma dang / byams chen ma gnyis re mos byed/mar grol nas rtsod/ pa byed lugs dang dam bca' mjug lugs nyin chos kyi skabs bzhin yin/ nyin re'i chos thun gsum po gang gi skabs su'ang dge —— 394 ———

bskos kyis lta rtogs les/sa par byed cing zla bo ma byung tshe dge/ bsgo/sa la rda/bo/ngas nga zhu/ nyin chos la rtsi bzhag med pa'i sra/bas dbu chos sa/nyis / gros bsdur gyi thog nas dam bca' 'dzugs pa/ dbyangs spyong byed nga/// rgyam 'jug chos spyod 'do/na/ pa sogs gang 'os byed chos grwar 'jus/ tu lus ma/ phyab/ gsum re 'tsha'// chos grwar yong ma thub rigs ༅/ra na tshas thun sa/ci po mas bzung nyim tsa/sum tshun gyi dgo/ngas pa dge bskos dang de phyin gyi dgongs pa dbe/ bskos dang bla ma sa/nyis kar zhu bar chos yim na tshogs gtam ba/nyis re dang / zla tshas/ yi na na tshogs gtam gsum re bla ma dge bskos gang rigs kyis nges yar gtong // dbyar chos dang dgun tshas gang rung 'a/ dam bca' chem mo sog/sa byung na nyin chos kyi skabs chos grwa'i 'al 'dom bsku la ma tshar ba'i mjug tu gzhung las pa dang dam bca' ba rnams bla ma'i bzhus/sa/ khri'i mdun nas mad gzigs kyis gra' bsgrigs nga/'i pham/ tshun du tshogs dmangs cha gnyis su phye nas bzhugs thing / de ma thag nyin dang por dpal ldan yon tan ma dang / de'i phyi nyin rnams su mkha' mnyam ma re mos kyis gtong / rigs lung chos spyod gsungs tshar ba dang dam bca'i bshad pa 'jug zhing / de'i mjug po ti gang yin gyi dam bca' gzhung las par brjod cing / gzhung las pas yar langs te thal skad btang ba'i/ gong der dam bca' rnams tshogs mang kyis gsan nges su sgrogs/ de nas thal skad sngon du 'gro ba'i gzhung bkod nas/ lung rigs kyi sgo nas gzhung 'jugade nas dka' bcu rab 'byams pa bgres gzhon go rim ltar bzhengs shing brgal rtags dri ma med pa'i gros gleng byed pa ma gtogs rigs lung la bsnyad pa'i tshig ngan skyon brjod rigs byed pa med dam bca' nyin rjes ma'i mjug la 396 — —

tu gzhung las pas tshig bkra byed cing / de tshar ba'i rjes su bstan 'bar ma dang / bdag gzhan ma'i mjug tu thal skad gtong / yang grwa skor byed mi byung tshe bshad chen phar phyin dang bshad chung dbu ma dang 'dul mdzod/rnam 'grel gang rigs rgyag de'i tshul yang mgo'i mchod brjod/ spyi bshad/ gzhung dngos/ mjug gi mchod yar sogs chos grwa chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi phyag srol bzhin byed ba las snang bar gang dran gyi bshad srol rigs byed pa med/ chos grwa'i mjug tu dus bzang gtong tshe thog mar dmigs brtse ma'i gdangs ring de nas skyabs sems/ spyan 'dren/ khrus khang bskyed nga/ khrus gsol gos rgyan dang // gang bum nyer spyod dang /'dod yon rgyal srid sna bdun rnams phul/ maṇ+ḍal gyi mjug tu deng nas byang chub ma'i chos dbyangs ltung bshags bsngo ba'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa dkyus ltar btang rjes sa lam skabs gsum pa sogs chos spyod zhabs brtan/mjug tu smon lam rnam lngas mtshon smon lam gsung rgyun gang yod dang /mthar yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ chos srung gi gtor 'bul/ bstan 'bar ma'i mtha' rten dang bcas pa gsung zhing / bla ma tshogs la byon tshe gter 'bul gyi gong der bsngo ba byed/ dge bskos gsar rnying brje mtshams dbyar chos dang dgung chos gang rigs la byed cing / gsar pa langs nas zhag gsum gyi thog chos gra dang / grwa ja'i sgrig lam skor gyi tshogs gtam rgyas pa chos grwa dang / grwa ja so sor gtong / chos mtshams kyi skor la/ chos mtshams byed pa'i zhogs pa bla ma yang chos grwar nges par byon cing / zhal 'don thog mar sgrol ma tshar gsum/ sgrol gsol// legs bris ma/ de rjes dmigs brtse ma'i mjug tu deng nas ma/ sher snying tshar gsum bzlog — 396 —

bcas/ de rjes smon lam gsung rgyun gang yod/ bstan phar ma/ chos rgyal ma/ bdag zhan ma rnams la gdangs ring btang nas mjug tu thal skad mi shes bdag gi 'chad rtsod ma dang / lhag bsam rnam dag ma'i tshis/ bcas gnyis tshar gsum re dang / bstan 'bar ma'i gong der bla mas bsngo ba ma/dzad cing mjug tu chos mtshams kyi bgyi 'og rnam/sa bla ma dge bskos ga/nga rung gi/sa tshog/sa gtam rtsa ba lhongs nges su gtong / de nyin nas bzung chos mtshams kyi ring brel ba che bzhag chung bshol gyis grwa tshang rang gi 'don tshas spyod kyi rigs dang / lhag par rang rang gi thad ka'i brtsi bzhag 'dzin bshar sbyangs la gcig tu brtson par byed cing / chos grwa tshogs pa nye ba na chos thog rga/ skabs su mkho ba'i yo chas rnams tshags su tshud bar byas te chos grwa'i skabs su g.yeng ba g.yin mi dgos pa'i 'dun pa snga mo nas gtong /mang ja tshogs lugs skor la// mkhar rnga sogs brda rnams byung ba dang 'du khang gi nye skor du spyod lam gang mdzes kyis 'khod cing mngon chung gi zhal 'don dang khas len 'dri ba ma gtogs dgos med kyi 'chong rgyugs 'thab 'dzings/ ku co rgyang skad sogs khyim pa bsun 'byen du 'gro rigs mdzad pa med/ 'du khang gi sgo phye ba dang lham phud nas/ bya thi ba tshang la 'jug pa ltar dal bus tshogs shing / gral du bzhugs tshul yang bslab gral dang mkhas gral go ma log par mu tig star pa brgyus pa ltar 'bud spyongs med par bzhugs pa las rkang mgyogs gral mi byed cing / tshogs su bzhugs nas kyang / gnyid dang gleng mol kha gtum gzhog gcus/ mig g.yeng lag rtsed ka ba rtsig zhal la snye ba sogs byas mi chog bza' btung gi skabs su'ang kham ha cang che ba/ khu ba g.yas g.yon du spo ba/ zas kyi kha bkang ste rgod la 397 — —

pa sogs mi mdzes pa'i rigs mi byed/ 'al 'don gyi rim pa mang ja dang po'i rgyab tu bstan pa bstan 'dzin dang bcas pa spyi bye brag la 'tshe 'ing / grwa tshang rang gi phyi nang gi dkrugs zhing / dge 'dun gyi rdzas dang / nag chang la sbags pa sogs la dmigs pa'i mdo sgrub tshar re dang / de nas skabs sems sogs 'don zhing / ja mchod 'dren mnyam ma nges par gtong / de mas sbyin bdag sogs kyi rim grom dmigs bsal can yod na de lugs dang // sa/zhan ma ja tshul sogs yin phyin rgyan 'jug gis mtshon pa'i grwa tshang rang gi thun mong ma yin nga/'i 'do/na chos spyod rigs gtong ba dbu mdzad kyis 'khur len byed dgos la dbu mdzad kyis gdangs sdur gang bskul gyi tshang mas mgrin gcig da/byangs gcig gis gsung ba ma gtogs ga/yas 'khyer g.yon 'khyer sogs phyogs rgyas/ gi ris/sa dang rang 'dod kyi sger 'don mi byed nga ra mgo mjug/ kun tu rgya mtsho'i nang du rdo bskyur ba'i gnyer ma'i dpe dang mtshungs nga/ dgos rgyu yin/ tshogs 'dus ma thag chab gril ba'i gsal gral na/sa brtsams te sru chab skor zhing grol khar g.yon gyi mtha' gral nas brtsams te chab gtong lag bde ba rnams kyi kyang ja thug sogs bzhes pa rnams dal bus gus pa'i tshul gyis 'dren pa ma gtogs bzhes byad ma khengs pa dang 'bo ba sogs hang bcag gi rigs byed pa med/tshogs dmangs kyi ja phebs tshar ba dang bla brang gnyer tshang so sor tshwa gzigs 'os mtshams re dang / rgyun bskangs pa yod na 'ding tshod kyi gcod pa las ha cang bag 'phangs su mi 'gro ba'i tshod 'dzin dge bskos kyis byed/ phar phyin gyi slob gnyer ma thon ring chos 'jig rten dge rgan gnyis re bsten dgos shing / 'jig rten dge rgan gyis za lugs 'gro lugs sdod lugs 398 ———

sogs dang lho bos 'a/ sos/sa pa'i bya byed che phra rnams slob cing / chos kyi dge/ rba/ma/ tshas dpe cha tsis ba 'ag/ blo/ rting bskul dang / chos thog dang chos mtshams gang gi skabs su'ang la/ sa blangs slob pa/ dpe char mdzub khri/ da gtong ba rigs lung byed tshul sogs chos dang 'brel ba'i bgyi 'os kun bsam pa bzang pos slob/ slob pa sa/zhon pa rnams kyis rang las slob pa rgan/ pa rnams nas chos ldan gyi bo/ ba das/ len dang / zhwa phud sa/zan 'bebs kyis mtshom/ pa'i sri zhu dang mthong gzos gang che las ribs rgyud sog/sa la brnyas1 nga1'i dam//7 'debs spyon/ brjod sog/sa mi 'os pa'i las mi byed /rgyum nga ra khyag tu bzhugs skabs kyang dpe cha 'dzin skyor sogs tsham da7ra chos spyo da kyi dus 'da' ba ma gtog sa bsdebs tshogs kyi long sa/6ma mig mangs// sha tha ra// sho rgyag// sob/sa rnam g.yeng bas/ ched kyi rigs rtsa ba nas mi byed/ rtsa ba bzhi chang dang bcas pa'i nyes pas gos na nges par gnas dbyung byed cing // de rnams las gzhan pa'i bla ma dang nga/be/ bslos sos/sa kha lan lag lan byed pa sogs sgris/ lam che phra dang 'gal rigs la bab dang bstum/ pa'i nyes chas phyis lam khebs zhes ga/tong / sne mo bas sgris lam tshul ba'i na sa non/ nga/ la grwa/ rba/na ga tho/ /na dang mi chung su thad nas kyang ro gyod dang /thod dpung ngoms pa sos/sa ga/tan nas byas tshag rgyu min/ dgon nang du bud med ris/sa zhag sdod byas mi chog cing bhan rgyugs/ tsam la yong rigs byung na dgongs lhongs nges su zhu/ zla ba ngo re'i gso spyong rnams4 dang da/byar gnas dgag/ dbye rnams nges par chag med byed cing / de yang dpal ldan 'bras spungs sobs grwa sa chen bo rnams kyi phyag len ltar las snang bar gang dran gī lus sa sro'/ byeb/ pa med/ de bzhin du rgyun par yul dus kyi dbang — 399 ————

gis rab tu byung gi rtags cha lugs ji bzhin 'grub dka' yang rab byung bsnyen dzogs gso spyong dbyar dgag so/gas 'dul ba'i las la 'tshogs pa'i tshe rab byung gi rtags spyi dang / khyad par chos gos rnam gsum rang la yod na dang / de min brnyan po tshun chad kyis tshang bar byas te las la 'dug dgos kyi yul dus la brnyad pa'i gos phu thung can dang / pags rigs kyi gos lham sogs gyon bzhin du las la 'jug pa rnams thams cad du mi rung ste de ltar byas na gnas skabs kyi las mi chags par ma zad/ chos la dbang za ba dang bstan ba'i rgyun la gnod pa sogs nyes dmigs mtha' yas pa yod pa/kun gzigs chos kyi rgyal po lnga pa chen pos/ las mchog rnam rgyal gser mdog tu rgyas par bka' bstsal ba ltar dang / gzhan yang mkhas grub bstan pa'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang pos/ tshul 'chal rtags 'dzin pa'i mkhan slob las/ / nor 'khrul cho ga nyams pa'i lag len gyis/ / skra 'breg lus bsgyur tsam gyi rab byung la/ / sdom pa thob par 'dzin pa gzugs brnyan yin/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ pas so/ rgyun par tshogs chos grwar 'gro ba'i tshe yang / dgang bza'/ me lcags/ tha khug gri dang / khi thi che sogs ske rgyan glo rgyan gyi rigs 'dogs pa med/ bla brang dang gnyer tshang sogs kyi phyed sgo la bla mas kyang chos grwa'i skabs su sbyin bdag sogs dmigs bsal gal che rang byung na ma gtogs grong chog la 'gro ba dang / sngags kyi zur chos rigs byed pa med/ de mtshungs gra dmangs nas kyang / spyi don sogs dgos pa khyad par can yod na ma gtogs chos grwa'i ring bla ma'i mjal khar mi 'gro/ rtsis bzhag kyang yig cha gsar rnying sogs grwa sa chen po rnams su grags pa las gzhan snang bar gang dran gyi zin bres sogs khungs med kyi — 400 —

rigs sa/tong ba med/ dge 'dun lnga brgya yan chad kyi mang ja'i thebs la mar khal gsum dang ja khal gnyis ma mtha' byed dgos/ gnyer pas kyang phogs dang ja tshul sogs gtong sgo che phra tshang ma nyams chag dang g.yo zol med par gtong zhing / sku gsung thugs rten mchod cha dang bcas so hrug sogs phyi nang gi dge 'dun gyi rdzas rnams bsam pa rnam dag gi sgo nas mi 'bag cing / yar rgyas gong 'phel du gyur ba'i thabs tshul dang spyin bdag gi sne len/ sogs gang cir mi ltos yar lta byed pa ma gtogs bsam chung dang sgal ral sla bcos su 'gro rigs nam yang mi byed/ 'gyed byung tshe bla mar sbu ska/la bcu dang / dbu chos gnyis la skal ba lnga re dang / chab hril ja ma sogs la skal 'phar re/ ja mas kyang sbyin bdag dang dge 'dun gyi rdzas rnams chud ma zos par gtsang sbra dang / lag 'bras gang thon byed cing / rung khang du thab g.yog/ pa sogs la rigs ngan lta grub mi gtsang ba'i rigs mi 'jog rgyun bzang ba yod rjes bla brang gnyer tshang re mos kyi zhabs tog gang legs byed pa sogs sne mo ba che phra kun gyis rang rang gi bgyi 'os rnams khur du ma song / rgyan du song ba zhig byed dgos/ mdor na grwa tshang 'di'i mgo bla ma na/sa bzung tha ja ma ba hrel pa'i bar gyi las sne che chung dang grwa bgres gzhon tshang ma sa// ji skad du rje bdag nyid chen pos/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhi/na nor las lhag/ 'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ / rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ / tshul 'di bsams nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ /spun pa 'phyar ba bzhi/na du rtogs gyur nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len/ par bya/ /zhes bka' bstsal ba'i don thugs la bcangs te bca' yig 'dir gsal ba'i sgrig lam mtha' dag phyag len du thebs pa — 401 —

rnam nga kun tu mdzad 'tshal/ dgom nga/'i snye sko ra rgyang grags kyi mang tshum/ chad du yu la mi sobs sus kyang gan/ga lus//sa/ rta rnga bong / bya ri dwag/sa//bcan gzan nya sram so /gas grob/ chags kyi rigs sa/nga yang mda' rdo dz+nya rgya sos/sa spyor ba ba/nga si/ru/ kyang bsad/ mi chog cing / de mtshungs grwa tshang rang si/ sbyim/ bdas sogs phyog/sa ba/tos/sa yim min gyi sprul sbu// cho4/ rje/ bla ma che chung / wang nga/'i li/ pi si/ gung / dza sas/ dzang bo/ thu sa la chi/khun du/ rda ro kha sogs mdor— ma/ ser skya 5sa// 'am sus kyang rang rang se/ stobs 'byor la dpags si 'i bsnyen bkur da/nga phu dud sog/sa dge 'du bde bar gams ba'i mthum/ rkyem/ sprub pa las dgos med kyi dbang shed //'phrog bcom brdes/ btsos/ sos/sa sa/nod 'gal du 'bro rigs gtan nas byed pa med/ 'di dom/ bzhin sprub pa rnams la myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon ngo dpal ldan phyag drug pa /lcam dral rnams dang / sor rtogs ye shes kyi ngo bo sprul pa'i tshas rgyal chen po rdo rje grags ldan bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshog/sa dang bcas grib med ye zla/sa kyi spyan ba'in nye bar gzigs te 'di phyi'i legs tshogs ma lus nga sgrub pa dang / log par 'khu ba'i tshog/sa la mthu stobs rdo rje'i chad pa drag po dul las yol med du 'beb ba gdon mi za bas bdag legs so 'dod pa rnams kyis bas/ yod par byos/ 'ig gong gsal gyi spang blang tshul bzhin bgyis pa rnams la nged nas kyang rnam kun dge ba'i skyabs 'jug byed/ slar yang smras pa/ gser mnog cod pan 'chang ba'i ring lugs zhes// / 'khrul bral nam mkha'i nor bu rtags 'char bas/ / phan bde pad tshal kun nas rgyas mdzad pa'i/ / blo bzang grags pa'i dpal gyis shis la stsol/ / theg chen g.yas su 'khyi'/ ba'i — 402 la

chos kyi dung / / mang thos khang bzang brtse nas legs sgrogs te/ // legs bshad gsar pa'i bro/ rgya phye ba 'dis/ / 'dzam gling yangs pa'i khyon kun khyab gyur cig/ / khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma tsong kha pa'i/ / chos srid dang 'brel dga' ldan phyogs kun las/ / rnam rgyal pho brang chen po'i chab srid bstan/ /srid mtha'i bar du 'phel 'i/nga rgyas gyur cig /de yis mthu las bod dang rgya hor sos/sa/ /rgyal khams kun tu dus ngan chad pa zhi/ / chos mthun rdzos/sa ldan gsar pa'i dga' ston la/ / ngoms med spyod pa'i skal bzang thob par shog / lhar bcas skye rgu'i phan bde kun gyi srog // thub bstan spyi dang bye brag bong kha pa'i/ /lung rtogs bshad sgrung bstan pa dbang si/ rgyal/ srid zhi yongs kyi bla na mchod gyur cig / ces dad stobs kyi dbang phyug pa yi phyag rdor skyabs nas chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi nang tshan bkris sgo mang grwa tshang gi sgris/ lam dang mtshungs pa'i chos sde gsar 'dzugs bgyis par/ sgo mang grwa tshang gi khrims su bcad pa'i yi ge dang mthun pa'i 'char gzhi dang bcas bca' yig la tham chab kyi gos tshal ltar/'di na tham ka phab pa yin pas tshang mas blang dor tshul ba'i na du spyod pa gyis/rnam 'phyang zhes pa sa pho khyi lo'i dbo zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes dge bar 'phags pa rin po che dbang phyug gi gzhal med khang pho brang chen po ta la nas bres/ bkris dge bar gyur cig/ / //

dung dkan bkra shis chos rjong dgon gyiXbaca'aXyig lcags byi/ (spyi lo 190 ༷ )phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rgyal sras dang slob mar bcas pa thams cad kyi zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ dge legs dpag yas 'byung ba'i sgo gcig bu/ /dam chos rgyal srid kun la dbang bsgyur zhing / /'phags sras stong gi dbus na lham me ba/ /chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur rgyal de la 'dud/ /de yi dri med spyan gyis gzigs gyur nas/ /rang gi 'khor la legs par bcas pa'i khrims/ /'phags tshogs bye bas spyi bos mnos gyur pa'i/ /rnam dag bca' ba de yi rjes 'brangs nas/ /thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas phyir du/ /chos kyi bca' khrims phyogs 'ga' brjod pa 'di/ /yid la smon pa ji bzhin legs 'grub par/ /mthu chen rnams kyi bka' drin mdzad du gsol/ /ji skad du/ spyod pa la 'jug pa las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig / ces gsungs pa ltar/ lus can rnams kyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa sel ba'i sman dang bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu ni rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'di nyid yin la de la yang la 404 —

gnyis las lung gi bstan pa ni sde sgod rnam pa gsum du nges shing sgrub pa'i bstan pa yang bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum du nges so/ / de la yang tshul khrims kyi bslab pa ni bslab pa gzhan gnyis skye ba dang / gnas pa dang 'phel ba'i brten du lan cig ma yin par rgyal bas bka' bstsal bas na/'dir gtso cher tshul khrims kyi bslab pa las brtsams te rang re'i grwa 'di na gnas pa rnams kyi kun spyod dag par bya ba'i thabs su khrims su bca' ba 'ga' zhig brjod par bya'o/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa yab sras kyi bca' yig chen mo gtso cher de nyid sor bzhag dang de'i thog tu deng sang yul dus dang gang zag gi dbang gis gsar du 'god dgos pa 'ga' zhig byung ba la/gtso bor bud med kyi nyes dmigs spong dgos pa 'dug pas rgyal sgo shar nub nang tshun du gnang ba ma zhus par bud med yong sa med/ gal te khrid mkhan byung na nag skyon mthong tshor yod nges byung na bla ma dang dbu mdzad dge skos sgros nas chad pa 'gel lugs byed/ bla ming du phyogs nas bud med byung na zhag gcig las mang ba bsten sa med/ gzhan ma bud med zhag tu bsten dgos byung na bla ma dang dge skos gnyis ka la snang ba zhu da/gos yod/ mngon dod kyis byas pa byung tshe grwa pa spyi la tshab ra mang ja/ bla mar gser zho drug gi 'bul chas zhu chag med par bsgrub/ dbu mdzad dge skos la rnam gzhag rten gsum la snyan dar dung dar gser zho do re ba'i dar phan / slong nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang khri grogs med par zhag gcig kyang sdod dbang med/phyi na/nga gang du'ang phyi dro'i kha zas mi spyod/ sbyin bdag gi ched du bos pa dang bla ma dang dge skos la gnang ba zhus pa yin na ma gtogs grong gseb tu zhag bcu las lhag pa sdod sa med/ gal te de las zlas na zhag re'i chad pa la 405 la

bre re bkag med 'bul/ zla ba longs par bsdad na bla ma'i drung du phyag 'bul du yong dus gsol ja 'am phyag mjal stong min re 'bul/ grwa pa spyi la mang ja zhu/ bla brang du ba mdzo mo 'o ma yong ba'i rigs ma gtogs gzhan ma dgos med kyi rigs bsten sa med/ gling phrod du dzi'u rjes su ma 'brangs par phyugs kyi rigs gtong sa med/ grwa pa rnams kyi mthun rkyen du 'gro nges kyi ba mdzo mo re re tsam las lhas/ pa bsten sa med/ ma/thun rkyen du /'gro ba'i sgog bceng kho las bzhi lnga las lhag nga/ 'debs sa med// gling gseb kyi shing rnams bla brang du du ma zhus par gcod nga dang shing 'bras phran bu tsam ma ga rtogs bas/ med / 'beb sa med chang nyos nga dang mngon mtshan che ba'i chang skyon gyi rigs byung na dge skos kyis brtags nas rgya phyag/ dang dal/ ra me/'i rgyu mkha/pha phyed ma gang 'os byed/ bla brang du'ang chang 'thung ba dang chang smyom spru rig/sa byas ma/ chad nga/ gong dang mtshungs/ bla brang si/ nang ga/zan dang tshogs kyi sgrig khri/ mas thun/ rngo/nga du byed sa med/ sa/la te byed dbos byung tshe grwa ba'i rtags cha lugs ma rdor ba nga/nga g.yin gyi spyon khag/ mi/da pa byed/ spyo /ra bu rnams kyang rang sang sdod ring phyi nang gi 'dzin 'bras sa/nga legs byed dbos 'ing grongs chad byung tshe de/ yi rgyun gyi tsha bo yod na ma tsa/tos/sa phyir nyo tshang byed sa med// grwa pas spyil bu sa/sar rgyas byed pa dang zhig ral sa/so ba so/gas byung ma/ 'gangs che chung la dang/sa/sa nga/'i bla brang nas gnang spyin dang chen thun skyen du sang 'gro byed/ bla brang dang 'a sa ste yod pa sus kung dge/ 'dun spyi las kyi ched du gros mthun yin na ma tsa/tobs// btsun nga gom 'drar bsngas/sa nga sos/sa mi 'os pa'i las mi 'chos/ tshas ma thun gyi las su bslo/sa pa tham/sa cad skyo ngal med nga ra bsgrub// rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lus/ba ma/ nyer/sa nga —— 4()6
