ni bstan pa'i dngos gzhi ru yin pa/ dge slong rnams kyis chos gos rnam gsum/ dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang sla gos sham thab 'ding ba chu tshags sogs rab byung gi rtags cha lugs tshang ba re nges par dgos/ stod gos phu dung dang kha dog dkar po sngo ljang sogs dang / skra dang kha spu ring mo 'jog pa dang / kong sked glo cha mi ga lba dar sogs mngon mtshan dod pa'i rigs byung na dge skos kyis 'phrog tshogs su zla gam dang sbyar ma zha thul sogs 'byor pa dang bsnyun pa'i ci mdzes rigs gyon/ de rnams ma 'grub rin bla ma dang dge skos la gnang ba zhu dgos yod/ phyi nang gang du'ang tshogs la zhwa ser ma gtogs zhwa rigs gzhan mi gyon/ dung dang 'khar rnga ldan ḍi sogs ma byung bar du mi 'du zhing byung ma thag tu spyod lam mdzes pas 'du/ tshogs su tham rgya sgril chags la zhogs pa yin na/ ltung bshags mngon du btang nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ gnas bcu gsol 'debs/ yag na bdun pa rnams ma song bar ja dang po mi 'dren/ dang po song nas/ nang khrims kyi mtha' 'gag byed kyi gong sher snyeng tshar gcig bton nas mdo sgrub kyis mtshams gcod/ de nas sa gsum ma sogs bla ma'i gsol 'debs rigs thung gang 'os gdam ma byed/ nyin re la sa lam gsum po ma chag pa byed/ sbyin bdag gi sku rim byed dgos byung na ma gtogs bstan pa bstan 'dzin spyi la dmigs ba'i tshe gzungs dang sgrol ma/ sher snyeng / gtsug tor/ mtshan brjod/ smon lam bzhi po gang rigs/ 'jug tu bde chen lhun grub ma rnams chag med 'don dgos shing / dgong mo sbu rim mi byed pa'i dus su bstan 'bar ma nges par 'don/ tshogs phyag ma byas par gral du mi sdod/ tshogs mchod gcig song nas ma skebs na rgya phyag mang ja gnyis — 407 —

pa ma song bar tshogs nas mi langs/ tshogs mchod kyi skabs su gtam gzhan mi gleng / mgo bo gos kyis g.yogs pa/ rgya tsho'i sdod lugs mi byed/bag med kyi rtsed mo mi byed/ glo bur du 'gro dgos pa byung na dge skos la gnang ba ma zhus par 'gro sa med/ ma zhus par phyin na brgya phyag mang jar gnang ba ma zhus par spyil por sdod sa med/ tshab ra byung tshe ldung gzed/ khyer dgos shing / med na phor pa dang lag ras dang lag khug ma gtogs gzhan ma bye/ ra sa med/ thang rkyal sogs pags gnod kyi rigs dang phad sgod mi mdzes pa khyer ba byung na dge skos kyis phrog pa dang / mang ja yod med la ma ltos par dge skos spyi brda mam byung la slebs dbo/sa/ phar 'byon tshur 'byon gyi dus su yang thams cad kyi gos 'dum bur bzhes/ dran shes bzhin bag yod kyi sgo nas 'byon pa ma gtogs brtson mthar ba'am jag pa'i bdas ma 'dra ba'i rings btab dang / ar nyams kyi rigs sus kyang byed sa med/ sbyin bdag dad can mi bslu ba'i skor spyong yin pas mchod 'os 'bad dgos/ ma byung yang rang don rang gi sgrub pa la su la'ang yus mi 'gro bas sgo gsum chos la spyod dgos/ 'don pa yang sgreg nas dad can dang ba 'dren pa dang 'byor ldan bsod nams gsog thub pa cis kyang byed dgos/ tshogs su gso ba'i dus gral mdzes la lta ba ma byung gong nas lag phor 'degs pa kha cag mig hrig gre brdar ba/ cag chag tsub tsub phu phu/kan rtogs pa/ lag ldag pa/ phor ldag 'bab la sems dang sprang ngo/ gral la rtsar ba lta bu mi byed/ nad pa mtshams pa dmigs bsal gyi rigs byung na ma gtogs gzhan ma tshogs su ma byung ba la mang ja tshab ra 'gyed sogs kyi bskal ba mi gter/ dge 'dun spyi'i bya ba byed pa dang / rab tu byung —— 408 ——

'dod kyi glo bur du 'ong ba dang / sbyin bdag gi ched du bos pa'i khyim/ pa yin na dge skos kyis dge 'dun la gnang ba zhus nas gter ba ma gtogs/khyim pa la dge 'dun gyis zas dang gos la sogs pa'i snyed pa sbyin du mi rung ba nan tan du gsu/ngas pa ltar mi sbyin/ dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas bla ma dang dge skos dkon gnyer rnam/sa la ma zhus par mi khyer// spyi 'bul du spyi rdzas kyi rigs 'os sa byung tshe mi dgos par spyi thog tu 'jog rab byung gi rtags cha lugs kyi rigs spyi 'bul du byung tshe dge skos kyis brtags nas de rnams sgrub pa'i nus mthu mi 'dug na phyed rin blangs nas rgan rim la gter/ gral du tshig rtsod byed mi byung na tshogs shing khur tshad gnyis re 'bul/ bdeg tshogs byas na gtsang khang du dkar me la/ la gnyis re 'bul/ rmas 'grams yod pa'i brgyab 'gre byas na snyes pa che chung gis chad pa la bla ma dge 'dun dbu gnyer pa rnams gros bstun byas nas spyod brkus 'phrog byas pa byung na dngos po shor 'khos che chung dang nag nyes la dpags pa'i chad pa spyo da lugs gong bzhin byed/ ga/zhis byes sa/nga du 'ang grwa pa nang gi chad dor lus spyi byung yang ngos thog tshe khri med/ tu gtod/ ngos ma thog tshes zla gcig gi ring dge skos kyi lag tu 'jog rdzun dang phra mas phan tshun dbye ba'i gyod rtsa thug pa byung na/ mang ja rnam dag dang bcas pa bsgrub tu bcug gling gseb dang dgon pa'i nye logs mang pos mthong ba'i sar mda' 'phen pa/ rdo sgor rgyag pa dang sho dang mig mangs kyi phran rgyag pa sogs bag med kyi rtsed mo byed sa med/ gling nang phan tshun du 'bod gtong dang skad log mi byed/ bro pa dang gzhes ra lcags ri'i nang du byed mi 'jug grwa rigs rnams lta smos kyang dru dgos sus kyang dgon pa'i nye 'khor du brdung 'phrog 'thab rtsod kyi — 409 ————

rigs byed sa med/ gal srid byed mi byung na nag nyes che chung gi chad ba len/ chad pad khas ma len na nyin zhag gcig dar po cher sgrogs/ gling khyi la mi 'os pa'i rdo rgyag mi byung na grwa pa sus mthong gi kha len/ gri brgyab tshe mang ja 'gel/ bla ma dge skos dbu mdzad rnams la rnam gzhag bsad pa byung na mang ja rnam dag dang gser zho bzhi'i chad pa 'gel/ tshong 'gangs che chung ci yin kyang bla brang dang dge sgyus la ma dris par tshong mi byed/ bre log dang srang log mi 'dzugs/ ma dris par byas na dngos po dang zong gnyis ka dge skos kyis len/ phogs blangs nas gling nang du za ba ma gtogs gzhan du mi 'khyer/ sgrub mchod kyi skabs su cho ga rnams sa phyogs nas sbyin bsregs kyis bar mchog grwa gang yod rnams rgyugs 'phrod nges dgos shing / cho ga blo la yod phyin dril bu yang thams cad kyis rtsol ba gang che byed dgos/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yang so sos bzhengs dgos/mdor na chog ga mchod spyod bskang gso sogs 'don bya'i rigs thams cad bla ma'i mdun du rgyugs 'bul ba dang yi ge 'bri klog nas bzung slob gnyer che phra thams cad bla mas bkod pa gang byas la nyan/ phyogs su 'gro dgos byung na bla ma dang dge bskos la gnang ba ma zhus par 'gro sa med/ cho ga mchod spyod mi shes pa rnams sgrub mchod ring lag bde byed du chug rgyal sgo nang tshun la bshas ra byed sa ped/ dgon pa nas mthong ba'i sar nya dang ri dwags gang yang shor sa med/ shor mi byung na 'os rigs kyi chad pa len/chos tshugs nas zhogs pa chos 'don ma chag pa dang / gung tshigs grol nas chos rar yong skabs dang bstun pa'i sgrol ma sher snyeng gang 'gro 'don/ de nas bla mas spyi chos dang brtse bzhag gang rigs gtong / dgong mo'i sku rim — 410 —

gyi rim nga 'a/ thos ma ra bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu rnam/sa/ sbu tshe brtan/ phyir tshe bzungs tshar nga/cu// de song nas/ ma slebs na brgya phyag sgrol ma tshar bzu gcig// leb/sa blu/sa/ ma nga/nga 'don sher snying tshar sa/sum/ / gcus gtor tshang sa/cig legs pris ma yang 'don/ sher snying tshar gsum/ gtsus shor tshar sa//ces bla ma 'i/ bstsod nga/ sa/nga rig/sa gcig/ sa/tor 'bul / bstan 'bar ma rnams ma chag// nga ra byed pa bcas 'ib par thes 'dod na/ bsla ba khri/ ma/sa chen go dang bca' yib/ chen cho/ rnam/sa 'a rtogs spyod byed dgo/sa so/ mdor na gzhung sa chen pe nas sangs rgyas/ kyi bstan pa da/nga sem/sa can gyi bde skyed la dgongs nas/ grwa tshang 'di nyid btsugs nga/ yin nga/sa 'dir bzhugs grwa dpon slob thams cad kyis klog pa thos bsam/ spongs ba bsam gtan bya ba las kyi 'khor lo sogs pa'i gsum gyi rim pa la gang gnas mdzad pa dang /lhag da 'di nyid kyi gdan sar rim byon gyi bla ma rnams kyis 'u/gas gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dzin/ skyong sbol gsum gyi bstan pa'i 'bas 'des/sa su gang 'gro mdzad pa dang / sne mo mi sna'i rigs kyang nye ring gzhogs skyor spangs pa'i bab thog gang 'dug gi bskos lugs byed/ dbu mdzad dge bskos rnams kyis kyang rang 'dod phugs tshang dang nye kha gzhogs skyor khe 'dod grags 'dod kyi rigs su ma song bar/ dkon mchog dpang gtsugs gis sgrig lam ga bo bor 'don dgos/ lhag tu dbu mdzad su byed kyis rang phyogs spyi'i cho ka mchod spyod bskang gso rnams kyi phyogs sgrig dang gdangs dbyangs rnams yal bar dor nas rang gi rtogs bzo dang gzhan gyi ci byung gang byung gis rigs mi 'dzugs/ rang phyogs spyi dang mthun par byed dgos lhag par bla mas gong 'khod rnams rim par mdzad rjes grwa pa rnams kyis bla ma'i la 411 la

'bas spyi bor— slang na/sa ci gsu ngas sgrub nga dang // 'di phyi'i legs tshos/sa kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas gshes gnyen bsten tshul ma lo ga nga/ cis/ cis kyang 'bad 'tshal/ bla ma grwa tshogs spyi thog nas bris pa'i don bzhin bgyis/ ces dung dkar bkra shis chos rdzong gis dgon gnas dge 'dun sde da/nga bcas pa 'phel zhing rgyas ba'i phyir du lcags bye zla ba dang po'i yar tshes dge bar yig bo/ra bkod/ pas bkra shi/sa dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du shog mang ga ma ma/ / / //

yib// tshang gisaXdapa' 'khon chos sde'i bca' mig thubaXbastan gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba'i zhal bshus/chu yos/ ( spyo lo 190 2 )oṃ su ste/ 'dir dbe 'dun rnams kyi nang khrims bca' yig gi rim pa khrigs chags su spel ba hrung zad brkod pa ni/ zla med ston pa sangs rgyas de'i gsung chos/ / dge 'dun bcas te mchog gsum rin chen dang / /rgyal sras mi pham 'jam dbyangs 'ing rta che/ / klu sgrub thogs med zab rgyas gdams pa'i gter/ /'dzam gling mdzes byed mkhas shing grub pa'i gtso/ /'jig bral tai lo na ro pham thing mched/ / 'jig rten mig gcig sgra bsgyur rim byon sogs/ / bsod nams zhing gyur kun la gus phyag 'tshal/ /bstan la rmad byung rgyan gyi phreng ba'i tshogs/ / rgyal blon byang sems lo paṇa skyes mchog gi/ /drin las lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan mar me mdzod/ /yab sras rgyud par bcas dang chos kyi rje/ /sa paṇa bu ston 'jam mgon tsong kha pa/ /rigs lam smra ba'i seng ge dge legs dpal/ / dge 'dun grub nas kun mkhyen dam pa'i mgon/ / srid zhi'i 'dren pa ma lus spyi bor mchod/ /la 413 ——

gser ldan byo/ na la stobs 'byor 'khor lo yis/ // dbang du bsgyur te thub pa'i bstan nga yang / /phyob/sa dus kun —tu spel ba'i mi dmangs/ che/ /gras/sa pa don ldan chos rgyal rnam gnyis kyi/ / mdzad pa phyag ris ngo mtshar du ma'i chos// / skal ba mtshag bi/ 'dren byed sgra 'dzin nas// / mthong chos gtam gyis yid la kun dga'i dpyid/ / dbyen tshe gzur gnas thams cad mgrin gcis/ tu/ / dpal gyi 'byung gnas theg gsum rgyud sde bzhi'i/ / chos 'khor bshad sgrub zung 'jug chos grwa che/ / sde 'di'i bstan 'dzin 'dus pa'i bca' ba'i khri/ mas/ / gus pas spel la lha rnams dgyes par mdzod/ /de yang mgon po klu sgrub kyis mchod rten brgyad kyi bstod pa las/ dang po byang chub mchog ga sems bskyed de/ / bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing / /bar du rtsod pa'i bdud gzhi/ 'joms mdzad pa/ /bcom ldan seng ge de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar bdag cag rnams kyi ston pa lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyi bla ma chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de nyid kyis 'gro ba sbug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen por bying zhing nyams thag pa skyabs ma mchis shing mgon ma mchis pa dpag tu med pa rnams la dmigs pa med pa'i brtse ba chen pos nye bar dgongs te/dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ bar du dpag par dka' ba'i tshogs gnyis rgya chen po yongs su rdzogs par mdzad nas mthar rdo rje gdan gyi spo la mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas ba'i tshul bstan te nyon mongs kyi spyod pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gis gnyen por chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong gis bsdus pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i sgo nas gdul bya mtha' mal pa smin grol gyi lam la 'god par mdzad cing / khyad par du ston pa rang nyid kyi —— 414 —

rjes su 'jug pa'i gdul bya rnams la rjes su brtse bas snye bar gzigs nas spang bya nyes par spyod pa'i chu klung 'gog pa la mthu dang ldan pa'i chu lon lta bu'i bslab par bya'i rim pa mtha' yas pa zhig mdo rgyud las gsungs pa gang yin pa de rnams las/ 'dir chos grwa chen po dang la 'khor sde chen po legs bshad sgrog pa'i tshal gyi gtsug lag khang na gnyug mar gnas pa dang / glo bur du lhags pa'i dge/ 'dun spyi dang / so sor dmigs su bsal ba dag gis phyag tu bstar bar bya ba'i khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa ni/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal mi na gcig pu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ bstan pa snyed dang bkur bste dang / / bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun gyi sdug bsngal ma lus pa sel ba'i sman dang / phan bde thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pu ni/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che nyid yin la/ de la yang gsal ba'i dbye ba mtha' yas kyang / bsdu na mdzod las/ ston pa'i dam chos rnams gnyis te/ lung dang rtogs pa'i bdag nyid do/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar lung gi bstan pa dang / rtogs pa'i bstan pa gnyis su nges shing skye rgu thams cad kyi phan bde'i gzhir gyur ba'i lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas pa yang / mdzod las/ de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / /bsgrub par byed pa kho na yin/ zhes gsus pa ltar lung gi bstan pa sde snod rin po che rnam pa gsum bshad nyan gyi sgo nas 'dzin par byed pa dang /rtogs pa'i bstan pa lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che rnam pa gsum nan tan gyis bsgrub cing nyams su len pa'i sgo nas 'dzin par byed pa la rag las la de ltar lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che tshul bzhin du 'dzin pa yang bstan pa'i la 415 la

rtsa ba tshul khrims rnam par das nga la tshul bzhim/ du slob pa la rag las te //dper na sa gzhi de sno nga/ bcud kyi 'jig rten tham/ru cad kyi sa/zhi rten/ yin pa ltar tshul khrims rnam phar dab/ pa de ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi bslab pa dang tshos/sa gnyis la sogs pa'i yon tam/ thams cad kyi ga'i/ rten yin nga/'i phyir no/ de ltar nga nga // byung chub lam gyi rim pa las nge/ la tshul khrim sa kyi bslab pa ni ting nge 'dzim/ dang shes rab kyi slab pa la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyi rten du gsung rab dgongs/ 'grel dang bcas ba las lan du mar bsngags pas na thog mar tshul khri/ mas kyi bslab pa'i dbang du byas nga1'i hogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan dgos so/ zhes gsungs 'ing de dang mthun/ nga/ra lung mi/na gyi ga/zhi dang // dpung bzang gis zhus pa so/gas las kyang sa/sungs so/ de ltar tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rnam par dag pa la gams nas //thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob pa'i phyir du thos bsam sgom/ gsum gyi bya ba la tshul bzhin du brtson dgos te mdzod las// tshul sa/nas thos dang bsam ldan pas/ / sgom pa la ni rab tu spyor/ / zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung /tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las kyang yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / zhes gsungs pa ltar no/ rgyu mtshan des na chos grwa chen po 'di mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams kyis kyang gong du bshad pa'i bstan pa'i rnam par gzhag nga/ spyi'i go rim dang mthun par tshun khrims rnam par dag pa la gces spras byed pa gzhir bzung nas mdo rgyu dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i tshig don la thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don gnyis sgrub pa'i tshul la 'bad pa chen pos bslab nga ra 'tshal —— 416 ——

zhing // chos grwa chen po (ra dir bzhugs dge 'dun rnams kyang gtso bor dam pa'i chos bsgrub nga 'i phyir du 'dus pa sha stag lags pas tshul khrim sa dang dam tshig gtsang zhi/nga phan tshun thugs mthun la ngang tshul 'jam nga 'i sgo nas dbus mtha' sos/sa las gsungs pa ltar gyi chos spyod bcu'i sgrub nga ‘pha brtson pa dang // khyad par chos sde 'dir rab tu byung ba dang bsnyem par rdzogs par byed 'dod pa rnams kyis kyang 'dul ba'i gzhung lugs la sa gsungs pa lte ra sdom pa gang zag las nod dgos rnams bsten mkhas/ kyi yon tam dang ldan pa'i mkhan po dang slob dpon mchan nyid dang ldan pa las len zhing / dge 'dun las nod dgos rnams mkhan slob dang bcas pa'i dge 'dun grwa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i drung du las/ kyi cho ga rnam par dag pa'i sbo/ nas tshul bzhi/na du nod par bya la/ de ma/ nga / dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung gi tshul khrims sngon du song ba'i sgo nas tshig snga ma dge tshul gyi sdom pa dang / dge tshul man chad gsum ka sngon du song ba'i sgo nas tshigs phyi ma bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa rnam nga/ra dag pa nod bar bya zhing / dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob rjes blangs 'das so drug dang / de dag gi phyogs mthun gyi nyes pa/ ltung med kyi rnam gzhag rnams mkhas pa snga ma dag gis mdzad pa'i dge tshul gyi bslab bya che chung dang /ma mtha' yang de rnams ston pa'i sdom tshig lta bu'i tshig bzung ba'i sgo nas 'os pa'i mkhas slob sogs bsten nas nges par byas te tshul bzhin du srung ba dang /bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa thob pa rnams kyis kyang ltung ba nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyis bsdus pa'i dngos gzhi'i ldung ba/ sbyor ba dang sbyor ba sbyor ba'i ltung ba bslab bya dang 'gal ba'i nyes byas sogs dge slong gi bslab pa'i mi mthun phyogs rnams dge slong gi bslab bya che chung dang / ma mtha' yang de — 417 —

rnam/sa stom pa'i sdom tshig/ lta bu'i tshig/ blor bzung ba'i sko/ nas 'os pa'i zu/la/ na slob so sa/sa 'a bstem te leg/sa par/ nges nga/ra byas nas tshul bzhin du srung bar bya'o/ mngo/ra ma/ dgre/ tshul slo/nga sa/nga yin kyang // rtsa ba ba'i yam/ 'a/sa dang bcas nga spong ba'i tshul khri/ mas mib/ 'bras ltar gces par bsrung dbos 'ing /bstam/ pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la lhams len snying ngo/ra byed dbos bas/ sa'i gsu ma gyi cho ga/ rnam par nga/ yang phyag len la gdab par 'tshal zhing //lhas/ par sngags mtshan/ blud kyi grwar gtogs pa'i dbe/ tshul slong si/ bslab pa dang ldan pa chos sbe 'dir bzhugs thams cad sa/so spyong la mi ge/ye/la bar 'byon de rnams kyi rab tu byung ba'i rtags bla gos/ thang gos/ 'ding ba/ ldung bzed rung ba tshad ldan rnams tshang bar bya zhing / dge slong yin na rtags de rnams kyi steng du snam sbyar dung ba tshad ldan yang 'chang dgo/sa 'a1//ga/'an yang chos sde 'di'i rab tu byung ba yin/ phyin phran tshes/sa kyi yo byad phreng ba chab ril sogs kyang 'chang dgos shing / chab ril 'chang ba'i dbo/sa pa yang / lung sil bu dang 'od ldan sogs las bza' btung la longs spyad rjes sogs su kha dag pa dang sred pa spang ba sogs kyi phyir chab len dgos par gsungs pa de'i phyir yin pas de yang tshul dang mthun par byed pa dang / sngar khrims su bca' ba 'di dag ma thob pa rnams kyis kyang zhag gsum 'das nas ji tsam grwa sar bzhugs kyi bar lus ngag gi spyod tshul gnyug mar gnas pa dang mthun par mdzad/ glo bur du lhags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la bkur bste rim gro cher byed/ sa ga zla ba'i dus chen gyi sgrub mchod chen mo hor zla gsum pa'i gnam gang lta bu la 'dzugs pa'i tshe de nyin cha gsum/ hor zla bzhi pa'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig la sa chog tshes gnyis nas sta gon thig — 418 —

'debs/ tshon bskye ba sogs nyin gsum gyi bar mdzad nas de rjes dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba sogs tshes bcu bdun gyi bar dang / bcu bdun gyi nyin cho ga'i kha skong gi sbyin sreg dang / dkyil 'khor gshegs gsol dang bsdu ba sogs bya la/ de rnams kyang rgyud dang de'i 'grel pa dang / khyad par tshad ldan gyi cho ga so so'i gzhung dang mi 'gal zheng / rang bzos ma slad pa'i mthong rgyud kyi phyag len rnams par dag pa dang mthun par mdzad nas/ tshes bco brgyad kyi nyin mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pa thams cad gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo sogs mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs dang bcas te rdul mtshon chu bo chen por spyan 'dren par 'byon zhing / klu'i cho ga dang rdul mtshon klu la gtad pa sogs tshul dang mthun par bya/ hor zla lnga pa'i nang du sman bla'i cho ga 'dzugs shing / de'i ring la nyin re bzhin sman bla'i cho ga tshar gsum gsum ma chag pa byed/ sman bla byes rjes gza' tshes dge bar dbyar chos btsugs nas grwa rgyags 'gyed pa dang chos kyi rim gro sogs mdzad/ de'i phyi nyin nas snga dro mkhan pos chos dang phyi dro slob dpon rnams kyi chos dang rig lung dbyar chos ring rgyun ma chad par byed/ spyi'i rig lung ba srod kyi dus su tshogs pa rigs grwa che 'bring chung gsum lung grwa'ang de bzhin du bya la/ rig lung la 'du bar 'os pa'i drag zhan rnams las pas lan 'debs pa'i rim pa dang sogs pa'i rim pa tho sgrig ste ma chag pa byed dgos shing / lan 'debs dang sogs res yal bar dor ba byung na dmigs che ba'i yi ge nub re bzhin btab ste dkar me srang re'i chad pa 'gel/ chos zhag gsum gyis ma grol gong du snga dro nas bzung ste gzhung las pas dpe cha snon dgos rnams chos gzhug la — — 419 la

bsnan tshar ba byed/ dpe cha'i rgyugs sprod dgos kyi mar mtha'i tshad dpyid ka dang dbyar chos kyi rgyags blangs pa rnams kyis dbyar chos gzhug la tshad ma'i gzhung par shog nyi shu rtsa lnga/ phar phyin gyi gzhung par shog bzhi bcu zhe gcig dgun chos ga/zhug la tshad ma'i shog bu bcu/ phar phyin shog bu phyed dang bcu bdun/ yang tshul bzhugs nas blo gsar bas tshad ma'i gzhung shog bu phyed dgu/ phar phyin gyi shog bu bco lnga/ yang dgum/ tshad ma'i shog bu bcu/ phar phyin gyi shog bu phyed dang bcu bdun/ yang dgun/ chos kyi 'go nas bzhugs pa'i blo gsar bas tshad ma'i shog bu phyed dang bdun dang phreng gnyis/ phar phyin gyi shog bu phyed dang bcu gcig dka'i shog grangs gong dang mtshungs/ rjed gso bas 'dab 'gyur sprod/ sngas/sa pa'i dpe cha sprod dgos rnams kyang yig grangs gong dang 'dra/ dbyar chos kyi gzhug la dpe cha'i rgyugs lam 'phrod pa rnams la ston rgyags dang dgun chos kyi rgyags mi sprod/ dgun chos kyi mjug la dpe cha'i rgyugs ma 'phrod pa rnams la dpyid rgyags dang dbyar chos kyi rgyags mi sprod/ dgun rgyags blangs na/sa rang shed kyis chos ma grol bar thegs pa byung na dpyid ka'i rgyags yig la mi 'debs/ dbyar chos grol ba'i sang gi nyi shad nas srod khyer gyi bar nyi ma lnga la grwa bskor 'khor ba'i dge bshes rnams dang blo gsar ba lan thebs nges rnams gzhung las pas nye ring spangs pa'i blo mnyam pa bsdebs te blo mtho rim gyi slong ba byed/ chos sde'i slob gnyer ba mthil ma gzhig pa byes pa gang yin kyang rig lung che ba dang bar ma gang rung pher bar las pa'i mthun snang du grub pa yin na ma gtogs tshas dus spyi'i rigs grwa dang lung grwa chung ba chos thog re ma bsags par bar pa gsog med cing / bar pa chos thog re ma la 420 la

bsags bar che ba gsog ba med pa dang / che ba chos thog re ma bsags par byes kyi grwa bskor byed sa med par bcad dbyar tshul zhugs gong gi tshes bcu nas bcu bzhi yan gzhis pa'i grwa ba/ dab tshogs su dre/ 'bring nyis thus nas dro/ de 'og chig khyer gyis ja dkar gyi mang ja mang 'bras tha ma mi re stod bcod dam/ ja dkar nag be/ stod ja/ stod 'bras gang rung bsgrubs pa'i sbyin bdag ngo bo la gzhung skyur ba byed ceng / 'dren pa ma shom pa'i grwa bskor ba4rnams chos tshugs pa'i zhag sum bcu so lnga nas gzhung len gzhis pa'i grwa bskor ba rdzogs nas byes pa'i grwa bskor ba gtong/ yang dgun chos hor zla bcu gcig pa la 'dzugs pa'i tshes bahru nas tshes bcu bzhi yan gong bzhin gyi 'dren par rab 'bring mtha' gsum yo/da pa rnams kyi gzhungs len 'dren pa med ba rnams zhag sum cu nas gzhung len gzhis pa'i grwa bskor ba rdzogs nas byes pa'i grwa bskor ba gtong ba gong dang 'dra// gzhung las pa rang gi gzhung skyur cing las tshab mi gzhug dus 'khor bas thog drangs sngags grwas sgrub mchod kyi dus gzhung gnan nas bdas/ 'jus/ longs pa rnams spyi skyur langs pa dang dod mnyam zhing dpe cha 'go 'dzin rnams mtshan nyid pa'i gzhung 'dzin rnams dang rgyugs mnyam por sprod pa byed/mtshan nyid pa'i dka' chen bzhi dang / spyod 'jug rig nga/ gter gang yang rung ba'i rgyugs sprod pa sngon du ma song ba bstan bcos chung ba gzhan rnams kyi rgyugs/ sprod pa med cing / de bzhin du sngags pas kyang dus 'khor/ gur/brtag sam gsum bde mchogs gsang 'dus rdo rje 'byung ba rnams dang mnyam pa'i dkyil 'khor che ba gang yang rung ba'i rgyugs sngon du ma sprad par dkyil 'khor chung ba gzhan rnams kyi rgyugs sprod sa med par bcad/ spyi — 421 —

skyur la langs pa/ dgun chos la bsdad pa/ mdo sngags kyi dpe cha 'phrod pa rnams la dgun rgyags dang dpyid chos kyi rgyags dbyar rgyags rnams sprod cing / sa ga zla ba'i dus mchod chen po slob dpon rnams ma gtogs dge bshes brgya re 'byon pa spyi skyur la langs ya'i dge bshes rnams kyi nang nas blo mtho ba drag bsdus/ grwa tshang nye snyoms nas byon rgyu yin/ dbyar chos kyi mjug zhag bcu'i gong du dbyar zla sgrub mchod btsugs nas dkyil 'khor 'dri ba/ sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs pa sogs zhag bcu'i bar mdzad/ rdul mtshon spyan 'dren pa bya/ dbyar tshos gyes nas grwa tshang rnams so so'i gzhis dgon du ston chos la phebs pa'i skabs su yang so so'i slob dpon dge 'dun dang bcas pa thams cad kyis 'dul ba'i bca' khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas nas 'chad nyan dang thos bsam sgom pa sogs kyi bstan pa'i bya ba rnams la 'bad pa chen po mdzad pa dang/hor zla bzu pa'i nyi shu gnyis gsum gyi skabs slob dpon dge 'dun dang bcas pa rnams so so'i sa/zhis dgon sogs nas chos sde 'dir 'dzom nges bya zhing / nyer bzhi'i nyin lnga mchod btsugs nas ma mtha' yang nyin gsum gyi bar sman bla'i cho ga tshar gsum gsum dang/ bla ma sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi gsol 'debs bstod pa/ bsngo ba smon lam sogs thugs dam gyi rim pa dang / nyer lnga'i dus mchod dang yo byad sna tshogs pa dang / lhag par mtshan mo'i dus mchod me gang mang 'bul ba la brtson pa gtso bor mdzad pa sogs kyi sgo nas 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i thabs la mkhan slob dge 'dun tshang mas thugs 'khur shin tu che ba mdzad 'tshal lnga mchod gyes 'phral lam/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i la 422 la

gza' tshes shis par dgun chos 'dzugs pa dang de'i nyin phyi ma nas dgun chos ma gyes kyi bar nyin re bzhin mkhan slob kyi chos rgyun ma chad pa byed cing chos zhag gi grangs sogs dbyar chos ji lta ba bzhin bya/ dgun chos gyes nas/ hor zla dang po cho 'phrul zla bar grags pa'i yar ngo'i tshes gcig lta bu la sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa dang / dkyil 'khor 'dri ba/ sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag 'jug dang dbang blangs pa sogs zhag bcu bdun gyi bar mdzad nas rdul mtshon spyan 'dren sogs tshung mthun par bya/ sgom grwa'i tho khongs tshun/ spyil po'i gling gseb tu gzhis bzhugs kyi sgrub pa dang /'khrid khu sbyin bdag chu skyel ma gtogs/ skya btsun gyi 'grim 'grul mi byed cing / mgron po zhag tu mi bzhag rab lo sgrub/ 'phring zla dgu/ tha ma dbyar dgun zla ba gsum gsum mtshams dam pa dang bre me'i gtam la sogs pa rnam g.yeng gi 'du tshogs mi bya/ mdor na nang du yang dag 'jog la brtson pa kho na lhur len/ dgun chos dang dbyar chos bar gyi grwa tshang so sor dpyid chos kyi skabs su yang 'chad nyan slob gnyer sogs la tshul bzhin 'bad pa ston chos kyi skabs bzhin bya/ gzhan yang chos grwa 'dir bzhugs pa'i rab byung gsar bu ba rnams kyis thog mar dbu can dbu med kyi yig klog legs par slob cing shes pa gzhir bzung ba'i steng du le lo dang rnam g.yeng sogs kyi dbang du ma song bar brtson pa chen po chos sde spyi'i tshogs dang /grwa tshang so sor zhal 'don du mdzad pa'i chos spyod dang cho ga'i rigs rnams dang bskang gso sogs yongs rdzogs blo la 'dzin cing skyor spyong legs par byas te mkhan po'i drung dang spyi skos kyi tshogs gang rigs du rgyugs gtsang 'bul bya zhing / rgyugs ma 'phrod pa rnams la chad pa brgya phyag gcig gnyis — 423 —

ji ltar 'os pa 'gel/ lhag par tshas sde 'dir skyes chen dam pa gong ma rnams kyi rdul mtshon la brten nas rgyud sde bzhi'i dkyil 'khor phal che ba thams cad sgrub cing mchod pa/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba/rgyud dang de'i 'grel pa rnams kyi bshad nyan sangs rgyal su bgrod pa'i lam gyi mthar thug bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams len sogs gsang sprags rdo rje jeg pa'i bstan pa'i srol bzang po dang por gsar du btod/ bar du dar zhing rgyas par ma/dzad pa'i rgyun da lta'ang gnas nga yin pas srol bzang po 'di nyid 'dzin pa'i khur bzhes pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis de lta bu sngags kyi phyas/ len dang bshad sprub tshul bzhin byed pa la thog mar lam thun mong ba rgyud spyong ba dang bla ma lnga bahru pa lta bu'i tshig don khong du chud par byas pa'i sgo nas rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin du bsten te/ rgyud sde nas bshad pa'i rnam par dag nga 'i dbang gis rgyud smin par byed cing / dbang dus su khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin du srung bar byed dgos la/ de la byang sems kyi sdoms pa'i mi mthun phyogs rtsa ltung bco brgyad dang/ nyes byas zhi drug rnams dang / de rnams kyi phyogs mthun kyi nyes pa spyon 'jug gi ba mi ba bya sogs dang / sngags sdom gyi mi mthun phyogs rtsa ltung bcu gcig sbom po brgyad/ de rnams phyogs mthun gyi nges pa/ rigs lnga spyi dang so so'i dam tshig dang sdom pa la sogs pa tshul bzhin du nges dgos pas/ sdom pa nyi shu dang bslab btus sogs las gsungs pa'i byang sems kyi rtsa lhung ston pa'i tshigs bcad/ sngags kyi rtsa ltung dang / sbom po rnam gzhag ston pa'i sdom tshig slob dpon bha bo lha dang / klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa sogs kyi tshis/ khong du chud par byas te don rnams 'os pa'i slob dpon sogs las nyan pa'i rang —— — 424 —

gis mkhras pa sba ma dag gis mdzad pa'i byang sems dang / sngags kyi bslab bya che chung / rtsa ltung rnam bshad che chung sogs la blta zhing dpyad pa'i sgo nas nges par bya 'a/// bsnyen pa sngon du ma song bar bdag 'jug dang dbang bskur ba so gas byas na nyes dmigs 'i/na tu che bar gsungs pas ma mtha' yang las rung yan/ chad kyi bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro ba dang / gang nyams su blang bar bya ba'i kyil 'khor so/ so 'i ngag 'don gyi rim pa dang / sa chog/ bri thig gar dbyangs/ rab gnas sbyin sreg sos/sa kyis mtshon/ pa'i sngags kyi phyag len/ rnams rgyud dang 'brel ba sogs so so'i cho ga tshad ldan gyi gzhung dang mthun nges pa zhig bslabs nas mkhan slob sogs kyi drung du rgyugs sprod pa dang / rang gi nges nas brtse bas gzhan la tshul bzhi/na du slob pa dang / bskyed rdzogs la sogs pa'i sngags kyi nyams len la brtson pa'i sgo nas dal ba don ldan du byed pa'i thugs khur rgya chen po bzhes par 'tshal/ dbyar gyi skabs ldur phyogs so so nas 'dir grwa skor la byon pa rnams kyang sa ga zla ba'i sgrub mchod ma tshugs gong du 'dir 'dzom nges bya zhing / 'dzoms rjes ma/lan slob kyi drung du 'jal ba dang sa ga zla ba'i bzhugs gral rnams kyi skabs bshad pa dang bgro gleng dam bca' 'jog pa sogs sbar srol bzang po dang gzhung las pa'i ngag bkod dang mthun par bya/ mi na bla'i tshogs su grwa skor ba rnams kyis rang rang gi gzhung ji ltar thob pa'i bo/ rim dang mthun par skabs babs kyi bshad pa tshul dang mthun par bya/ min bla'i mjug nyin bdun brgyad tsam gyi gong du nyin re bzhin gung tshigs thon 'phral sngags mtshan nyid kyi slob dpon rnams dang grwa skor ba gang yod dang / chos sde'i mtshan nyed kyi dge bshes ring lung tshul bzhin gtong nges rnams bla brang du — 425 —

tshogs nas grwa bskor ba rnams re mos kyi bshad pa bsdus tsam dang dam bca' bzhag nas slob dpon mtshan nyid pa rnams dang / mtshan nyid dge bshes rnams kyis po ti lnga'i rig lung rnam par dag pa mdzad 'tshal/ dbyar chos kyi mgo nas mjug gi bar nyin re bzhin phyi dro'i dus su slob dpon dang grwa skor ba rnams dang chos sde'i mtshan nyid kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams 'tshogs nas grwa skor ba rnams skabs su gang babs kyi bshad pa dang / dam bca' 'jog pa/ chos sde'i mtshan nyid kyi dge bshes rnams kyis lung rigs rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas bgro gleng bya ba sogs la brtson par bya dgos/dbyar chos grol rjes spyi skyur la bzhi sa mkhan rnams kyis kyang khral lhur ma song bar rang rang gi skabs su gang babs kyi bshad pa/ dam bca' 'jog pa/bgro gleng byed pa/ lan 'debs pa sogs la thugs 'khur shin tu che ba mdzod/ 'dir rab byams pa'i mtshan rtags kyi phyir phebs pa dang / spyi skyur la phebs pa thams cad kyis kyang yul dang grub mtha' sogs kyi sgo nas phyogs rigs su bcad pa dang / don chung gi phyir rtsod pa dang kun slong spyon can rnams spangs nas bstan pa dang rang gzhan gyi 'phral yun gyi phan bde la gtso bor dgongs pa'i lhag bsam bzang pos spyi bshad gtso bor bton pa lta bu ma yin par ji ltar 'tshams pa re sngon du btang nas skabs su babs pa'i gzhung dngos kyi bshad pa 'gal zlos ma 'brel ba sogs kyi skyon dang bral zhing dngos gtsang ba 'chad tshul khyad par du 'phags shing sgra dag gsal sogs kyi sgo nas mkhas rnams kyi yid 'phrog pa dang dam bca' lan 'debs/ bgro gleng sogs kyi skabs su yang shags rgyag gis mtshon pa'i ngag kyal dang rtsed mo sogs gtso bor bton pa ma yin par bstan pa la phan pa'i skabs babs kyi bya — 426 —

ba de tshul dang ma/thu na par bya/ /'di das/ si/ tshe rig lung la 'du bar bos/ nga rdzam sa/ kyis kyang dma' dbab 'dod sog/sa kyi:kun sngo/ / nga ngan/ ba da/nga sa/yo sgyu sa kum nas blangs pa'i mdzes chos sum song bar lung rig dri ma ched pa'i sgo/ nas bstam pa'i/ ba/da bang ra du 'gro nges bya/ mdo/ra ma/ bya ba 'di slo/ra gī 'khur 'dzin pa'i ma/la/ na skrob da/nga grwa sko ra ba rnams da/nga ba/'i/ byes kyi dge ba'i bshes sa/nyem/ tham/sa cad kyi/ sa rang rang gi/sa bya bar 'os 'i/nga byed dgos/ nga/'i chos ldam thu /pa/sa sa//nga la yang bsam chung dang gal chung du ma/ song bar bsta/ma pa din po che la dgongs pa'i thugs khur rgya chen ngo ba'i/sa pa dang / tshas sde 'di nas grwa sa gsan du slob sa/nyer gyi phyir 'byon nga/ rnams kyis kyang grwa sa rang rang gi bca' khrims dang ma 'gal ba'i steng nas ngo/na med kyi bya bas dus mi 'da' bar dom/ lnga/na slob gnyer sogs la 'bad brtson drag po bya zhing gtso cher grwa sar rgyun ring thung ji tsam sdod kyang chos sde 'di'i spyi dgos kyi las snes mtshon skyed sdug mi g.yel ba mdzad/ dbyar dgun ston dpyid kyi chos rnams dang / lnga mchod/ sman bla/ sgrub mchod che chung sogs kyi gtong sgos mtshon spyi dgos kyi gtong sgo gtong mkhan drag zhan rnams kyis kyang dge 'dun gyi 'du sgo 'phrog pa nye ba'i mtshams med yin pas nyes dmigs shin tu che ba dang / dge 'dun ni tshogs gsog pa'i zhing mchog yin pas tshul bzhin mchod pa phan yon che ba'i tshul thugs la bzhag nas gtong sgo'i rigs rnams tshul dang mthun par gtong bar 'tshal/ gtsug lag khang chen po dang / sku 'bum gyi dkon gnyer gyis mtshon pa'i dkon gnyer drag zhan thams cad kyis kyang rang rang gis bya dgos pa'i dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang gtsug lag khang gi phyag dar la sogs pa'i las rnams la bsam chung du ma la 427 la

song bar dus nam/ yang g.ye' ba dre/da par bya/ dkom/ mtshas/ si/ mtshod rdzas dang dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas thin tu gnyan pas dkon sa/nyer spyi pa/ dus mchod che chung si/ gnyer pa/ bod /'brog gis bsod stoms sdud mi rnams kyis yon mchod bka' bgros ma/sa bskos pa'i las byed/// rtsis dpang dang bcas pa'i sar rtsis dab/ par byas nas sa gzhis kyi margo/ byas/ bod 'bros/ gi rdzas/gtod kyi dngos po/ bim ba 'ag/ gtan 'dra/ sa/tod yig snga phyi//gnyer pa rim pa rnams kyi 'phrod yis/ yis/ tshang sogs mchod yo na mthun snang grub nga ra gzigs ('bul thub nges byed/ sa/tsug /lag lang dang mchod rten la skya btsun sus kyang tsa/nod pa byus pa byung na gnod pa che chung 'a1 dpags nga/'i /zhig gsos sogs ji ltar 'os pa'i chad las 'gel/ sku gzugs kyi cha shas bcag pa/ logs ris bsubs pa/ shing bton pa/bad skyur ba// gyo mo bcag pa/ rdo dang 'jim pa'i rgyab logs la lag dal gyi ri mo dang yi ge bris pa sogs byung na chad pa dkar me zho gsum nas zho phyed yan gang 'os len cing nyes pa bsgrag/sa pa'i brgya phyag 'gel1/ dus ma yin par dung drag tu 'bud pa'am/ gaṇ+ḍi'i sgra drag po byung na bya ba glo bur bu yod pa yin pas skabs su gang babs kyi 'du bar 'os pa rnams rna sran mi bya bar myur du 'du/ sa/la te dge tshul la pham 'dra dang / dge slong la pham pas bsdus pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bzhi gang yang rung ba byung na/ btang snyoms su mi bzhag par lus steng sogs su chad pa ji ltar 'os pas bskal nas gnas dbyung mngon tshon can bya/ khyad par gzhan gyi rdzas brkus pa la brten pa'i rtsa ltung byung na dngos po gang 'khyer gsum 'gyur nor bdag la sprad nas gnas dbyung sogs snga ma ltar bya/ rtsa ltung dngos ma byung yang de'i char —— 428 la —

gtos/sa kyi tsa/zhan/ gyi rdzas brkus pa'i nyes pa byung ma rdzas bdatsa/ la dngos po ga/sum/ 'gyur gong ltar sprad nas tsha ba mang ja so sa/sa ji ltar 'os pa'i chad pa 'bel/ dbo/na pa'i nye 'bo/ ra du skya btsun sus kyang dpung bsdebs nas lag 'dres pa'i 'thab rtsod byas pa dpon slob mthun snang du grub nga/ ma ga/tos/sa chos sde'i rgyag yig la thebs pa'i grwa ba yin nges kyis grwa tshang 'dor len byas pa/ grwa tshang phan tshun rgyab gnon byas nas 'a/ga 'dres pa'i 'thab mo byas pa/ khrom nas gzhi nam du longs pa'i sprud pa sheng 'khyer pyis 'phros/sa nga// lcags ri/'i nang /sring rnying 'brel zling la brten pa'i zho sa/nga du longs pa'i gsa' 'dzin/ byas pa rnams byung na tshogs su tsha bam/ ma nga ja dang / 'bul/ ba mtha' rgyangs dang bcas pa'i chad pa 'gel / chos khri/ mas pas chos mthun gyi khrims bcad nga/ la lag bteb/sa pa'i lan bzlog pa byung na tshogs su tsha ba dang / mang ja 'bul ba/ mtha' rgyangs dang bcas nga /nyes pa bsgrags pa'i brgyang phyab 'gel/ chad las mi 'khur bar 'dred 'dzur byas pa byung na slob dpon grwa tshang dang bcas pas bkug nas gnas dbyung byed pa'am / slob dpon grwa tshang bsten byed su yin gyis gong gi bsnyen bkur gyi chad las 'khur ba gang rung byed/ skya btsun dpung grogs med par 'thab mo byas pa/ btsun chung 'thab pa'i rgyab gnon byas pa byung na mang ja/ 'bul ba mtha' rgyangs dang bcas pa'i chad pa 'gel/ chos khrims pas chos mthun gyi khrims bcad par tshig ngan smra ba'i lan bzlog pa byung na/ mang ja/ 'bul ba mtha' rgyangs bcas pa dang nyes ba bsgrags pa'i brgya phyag 'gel/ gzhan yang zho 'o ma sogs spyad pa phran tshigs ngan shed kyi 'khyer ba byung na dngos po 'dab sbrel sprad nas brgya phyag 'gel/la 429 la

rab byung rgyags len gyis chos sder rgyab log/ byed pa byung na chad pa dam/ra me zho do/ tshogs su mang ja// 'bu/la ba mtha' rgyangs dang bcas pa grwa tshang la 'o/ gsum re 'a/ chag ngo bsrung med nga/ra len pa'i do dam bla brang spyi pa/ do dam/ chos khrims pa rnams kyis byed/ ngan rgyab skya btsun sus byas kyang rdzong sdod la rgyu tshan labs nga/'i gser srang phyed re'i chad pa 'ge/la/dge 'dun rgyags len rnams kyis phyi dro'i kha zas la longs spyod pa byung na chad pa dkar me mtshan thung dang / nyes pa bsgrags pa'i brgya phyag 'gel1/sngags pa rnams kyis dkyil 'khor che ba'i mang gi dkyil chung ma gtogs par btab pa/ sngags mtshan gyi dge bshe/sa la gtogs pa yan gyi gting lhung gang rung re ma tshang ba/ khyad par du dge slong rnam sbyar ma tshang ba/ phyi nang gi skye shing rtsa ba nas bcad pa/ shun pa bshus pa lo thog dang sgog pa bcoms ba/ lcags ri'i nang du bon chos byas pa/ skya btsun sus kyang chang btsos pa/ skya nag rnams la btsun bas chang drangs pa/ btsun pa rang gis gzhis byes gang du'ang chang btung pa/ lcags ri'i nang du chang khur ba/ chang sgod shag tu bzhag pa sogs byung na gser zho re dang nyes ba bsgrags pa'i brgya phyag bcas chad pa ji ltar 'os pa 'gel/ chos mthun gyi dgos pa khyad par ba ma gtogs gung tshigs yol nas sde 'di'i rab byung grong gseb 'grim pa/ zhing bdag ma gtogs 'ong gseb 'grim pa/ chu rtsed byas pa/ skye shing yal ga bcad pa rdo skor rdeg pa/ mig mangs/ cho long rtse ba/ mchongs dang mda' rtsed byed pa/ chos sde'i nang du skya btsun sus kyang slong 'bod chen po byed pa/ dgos med kyi ku co 'don pa/ ser sbreng gi dus bang gtong ba/ zhwa mo g.yug pa/ ku co 'don pa sogs gzhan ma — 430 —

dad nga/ra 'gyur ba'i/ spyo da nga/ byed mi byung na/ chad pa dkar me nyin mtshan thub nga dang nyes pa bsgras/sa pa'i brgya phyag 'gel/ chos sde'i rab byung rnams kyis gri thung bcang ba/ gos/ phu dung can gyon pa/ gling bu bus nga /rung ba'i tshos kyis kha ma bsgyur ba'i gos pyon pa sogs byung na/ dngos po ngo bo 'phrogs nas gtsug la ga khang dang mchod rten gyi rdzas la 'bul/ khyad par chos sde'i rab byung rnams kyis dgon pa'i nang du gos phu dung can gyi rigs gyon pa byung na/ dngos po 'phrogs pa sogs sngon ma ltar byas nas gos pyon mkhan la nyes pa sgrags pa'i brgya phyag sogs chad pa ji ltar 'os pa dang dkar me zho re'i chad pa 'gel/ spyi sgos kyi tshogs su tshogs pa'i tshe dge tshul slong rnams bslab gras tshul bzhin ma byas pa dang gung tshigs yol phyin chad dus rung gi bza' btung la longs spyod pa dang / tshogs su zhal 'don mi byed par long gtam mang du smra ba/ lham gyon bzhin bza' btung la longs spyod pa/ bza' btung bzhes rjes chab ma slangs par langs pa/gral la ring thung dang 'bur skong yod pa lta bu'i ma stoms par bzhugs pa/chos sde'i nang du stod 'gag dang gzan sham med par 'gro 'dug byed pa rnams la brgya phyag dang mar me mtshan thub sogs nyes pa che chung dang bsnyun pa'i chad pa 'gel/ tshogs su bsnyen bkur la tshogs pa'i dus phebs 'phral la mdo sde skal bzang / rgya che rol pa/ brgyad stong pa mtshan 'bum rnams gsung sgrog de rjes gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi thub pa'i phyag gi skabs su mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi bstod pa/ de rjes bzang spyod smon lam/gsol ba thon nas 'jam dpal mtshan brjod smon lam dang bcas pa sgrol ma tshar bdun gsol 'dab dang bcas pa mdo tshar bdun/ bdud — 431 —

bzlob/ ba dang bcas ba mdzad cing / ga/'im/ ngo/'i ngon du bsnyen bkur byung dus bang ma grol nas dri med kyi gzungs rings/ dang / ngan song spyong ba'i sa/zu/ngas byen brlabs can rnams ba brtse bas ma nga du 'don/ rgyum nga/'i tshul la ri khro/ /da rwa/ ma gyon gyi gzungs gsum brgya re// rgyas 'breng bsdus gsum tshar re// sgro/la ma dang yum sgrub sog/sa gong bzhin ma dzad/ sa/zhung gi/ sbu rim/ 2 2bka' 'gyur 'jam dpa/pa mtsham/ brjod/ tshe dpag med kyi mdo/stobs po che// gdus/sa dkar/ 'o/ da/ zer can sogs skabs su sbyar mas sgru ba nga/ bcas sa/som/ gshin gyi sku/ rim/ dang1// sgrib spyong la dmib/sa nga 'i 'a/ la 'don mdzad dbo/sa kyi rim pa rnams lhag bsam rjam dag gi sgo nas legs par spru ba par bya/ gzhan yang tshogs su bsu/ 'de/bas pa/ zan/ ril rdeg/ nga / ja brag thor res / tshod ma 'bo/ phor pa rdeg nga // bzhad ba/da chen po byed pa/ btsum/ chung 'thab pa rnam/sa byung na de'i ma do las nyes pa bsgrags pa'i brgya phyag sos/sa chad nga/ ji ltar 'os pa 'gel // tshogs ska/la dang 'gyed skal lhas// po blangs nga/ byung ma thob ska' dang lhag po gnyis 7/ tshur blangs nas nyes nga bsgrabs pa'i brgya phyag 'gel/ rab byung za/ma/ ga/zho/ na bzan sham 'ab tshang ba dang / rab byung gi bsla//ba nga/ gtan nas ma blangs pa dang // blangs kyang bslab pa phul ba dang rtsa ltung gi bslab nga nyams kyang btsun pa'i rtas/sa tsam 'dzin pa dang mo yan gyi ser skyabs rnams spyi sgo yi tshogs gang du yang mi gtong// gal rte khyad gsod/ kyi bsam pas tshogs su yong na ji ltar 'os ba'i chad/ pa 'gel/ dge 'dun thams cad 'du dgos pa'i mang ja lta sgo'i tshe tshog/sa su 'gro mi thub pa'i rkyen dgos pa chen po byung na /chos khrims nga/ dag la dgongs pa zhus nas sdod/ pa ma ba/togs rang dgar bag —— — 432 ——

rnged ldu mi rdo da cing // tsho /sa/sa/ su yo nga ma/ yo/nga si gas kyi rtsa/ sa/sa /'jug/ tshas khri/ mas/ nga das// bo/sa bya/ de lta/ra brtags pas dgongs nga ma zhus nga ra dom med du sdod/ par she/sa na ji ltar 'os pa'i chad pa 'gel// lo gsum/ phyogs gsum dang / zla grangs kyi mtshams dam po la yo da pa/ dge 'dun spyi'i bya ba gal chem la btang ba/ sna/ skor byed nges ngo bo dang / nad ka 'gro 'dus / mi pher ba la tshos/sa skal 'bul 'i/nga / gzhan tshogs su ma phebs pa rdzams la ska/rwa ba mi/ 'bul/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs gral che chung gang du'ang sha mi 'grim//'gyed kyi brgya dpon bcu dpon/ rnam sa kyis phas/ brngan bzos nga/ byung na/za ma la/ na du 'dus/ la smar sho re'i chad pa 'ge/la/ spyi sgos gang du'ang thab las pa sogs kyis rang ska la ma sa/togs/ zhong 'gril/ lag/ skud sos/sa kyi za 'dod mi byed/ chos sde'i lcags ri'i khongs su mi nag can chud phyin hor lugs kyi lus sbog gi gnod pa chen po las thar du bcug pa'i sgo nas mi 'jigs pa skyabs kyi sbyin pa gam/nga nas che chung la dbags pa'i bod lugs kyi 'jal len khrims mthun sgrub bar bcad/ gzhan yang bza' pe mi sde/sgos g.yog sogs dgon par ltos pa byung na mkhan slob/ spyi chos sogs kyis rdzong sdo da dang mol ba'i ji ltar 'os pa mthun snang du grub pa mdzad cing /de ltar ma yin/ par chos sde nas rang shed kyis ngan rgyab mi mdzad/ chos sde'i shar gyi rin chen sgang gi chu rgyu dang brag nag po/ lho'i brag 'og dbyin bzlum mchod rten dang / la btsas/ nub kyi btsad skor ma ṇi sgung / byang gi brag skya la kha rnams/ kyi khongs su ri dwags rngon pa dang / tshong pa sogs kyis dud 'gro'i srog bcad pa byung na/ mang ja 'bul ba dang bcas pa'i chad pa 'gel / gong gi sa khongs su sha'i phyir du dud 'gro bdas pa'i tshong pa'i sna —— — 433 la —

bstem byas pa byung na/ nga/lor mi/ zho gsu/ma/ re'i chang/ nga/ 7re she 4// rta bangs mchor rtem nas ma lan ngo/ so sas dmis/ba bam//ra bo/nga du/da rjams ma tsa/togs ser kai drag/ 'an sus kung rta so/sas/ mi com/ mang/'a 'bas kyi ri rgya klung rgya rgyum du bsrung rgyu deb the/ra ri na chen bang mdzod/ tsha gsa' ba rngams dang /chos/ sde/ ba/'is/ da das na so so /'i nye skor dang rang da/bang ba'i sa phyos/sa su ri rgya klung rgya'i bsru/nga sdo/ma/ 'pha shā/ du dam nga/ dang / phugs su rgyun bsring beng brtan/ pa'i do da/zu/ mab// za slob nga/ge/ 'dun/ rnams dang dpon slob bya ba la dbang ba rnams kyis byed/ dbo/na pa'i mang du dus nam yang ma/da' dang pe mnga' rgyag pa dang so// rtsed/ sob/sa kyi ku co mi byed/ sa'i/ ba thes can dang /byes/ mi/ grwa tshang dang ba/nas pos khas/ jes/ nges ma gtogs/ gzhis/ byes kyi skya btsun jes/ med yam/ pa gtsug las/ khang dang mchod rten spyi rdzas/ yod pa'i sa/rtse thol gyi lcog/ rnams su dri bzag cing // dkon gnyer/ spyi tshul sob/sa kyi g.yog/ tu'ang mi bsten/ gal te bsten cing 'ag sdod byas pa byung na //bsten mi la dkar me zho re'i chad pa 'be/'a// gor zla dgu pa'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin nas brtsams gtsus/ lag khang dang mchod rten gyis rtse gang legs gsol nas 'a/ga bcu khongs su grub pa byed cing / de bzhin du bla brang // grwa tshang so so/ lcags ri lcog brang khang so so rnams la yang sa rtsi sngar rgyun bzhin gang legs gsol ba da/nga / de yang hor zla dgu pa'i nang du grub pa byed/gtsug lag khang // mchod rtem// sgom grwa rnams kyi nye skor du klog phrug yig phrug mi bsten/ gzhan yang gtsug lag khang dang / mchod rten gyi nye skor/khron pa'i kha/ lcags ri'i nye phyi/ lam kha sogs skye bo 'du ba'i gnas su ba/shang lce dang ngar snabs mi 'dor/ rang gi bcos pa dang bdag pa ma yin la 434 la

ba'i brang gnyer 'jog pa rnams kyis gzhi ba yod pa'i brang srung mi gzhagazhi/nga yod pa'i btsun pa rnams kyis kyang lta rtog dang / ga 'a/na la las grogs bcol ba ma gtog/sa rang gis dngos su zhing la chu bcus pa/ rbos dang /yur ma dang / tshar ma brnga gtubs sogs byed pa gnya' thong 'khur ba rnams byung na/ khrims gnon mkhan rnams kyis ji ltar 'os pa'i chad pa 'gel/ sa ga zla ba'i sgrub mchod chen rma'i skabs su yang tshes bcu bzhi nas bco brgyad kyi bar nyin lnga la khyim pa 'ga' zhig gis longs spyad pa'i phyid chang hrung zad khyer rgyun yod 'dug kyang chang 'di bag med kyi rtsa bar 'dug pas/nang mchod ma gtogs da phyin chad dus nam du'ang dgon bar chang 'khyer ba byung na khyer mi der grwa tshang yongs rdzogs su mang ja gcig nas grwa ja'i bar ji ltar 'os pa'i chad pa gcod/ gong gi nyin lngas mtshon pa'i sa ga zla ba'i gar 'phyam sogs kyi ltad mo chen ngo 'i dus rnams ma gtogs nyin phyed nas bud med dgon par sdod du mi 'jug gzhan yang gong gi dus de rnams las gzhan pa'i zla ba re re'i dus bzang bzhi dang / dus gzhan la yang mchod mjal lta bu'i dgon pa dmigs bsal can gyi phyir bud med dgon par 'gro dgos byung na/ bla brang chos khrims dag ngang / sgo ba dag la gnang ba tshul dang mthun par zhu zhing de rnams kyis kyang gnang ba ster 'os mi 'os brtags nas/ ster 'os tshe nyin ma phyed yan chad la gtong ba bya la/ gzhan gnang ba ma zhus pa/ zhus kyang ma byen bzhin du rang shed kyis 'gro ba byung na/smar rdo/ re sogs kyi chad pa ji ltar 'os pa 'gel/ dus nam yang chos sder bud med zhag tu sdod pa/ chos sde'i nang du bung med kyis chu len pa byung na/dkar me zho re sogs kyi chad ba ji ltar 'os pa 'gel/ khron khar dud 'gro la 435 — —

la chu mi blud/ chu tshas/sa la ma btsab/sa chu mi 'byed/ lcab/ma/ ri'i nang du ba dang mdzo pho mo ma gtos//sa rbig/ nga/ kha zag can gī dud/ 'gro 'ag sa/sum las lhas/ pa mi bsten 'ing / dbyen bzlum mchod rten man nas lcag/sa ri'i bar gyi lcang tho/'a rnam/sa kyi bsrung bsdoms kha ta dang / dus dus su chu gtong ba'i rdo dam sgo/ ba las thob/ ma/ yo da pa byed// lca ga/ sa/ ri'i sa/nyer nga sa lcags ri'i 1nyar bcas/ thig tshags gtong ba wa rtsa 'chos pa/ sa rtsi bas mi legs po yong ba/ skor lam sogs kyi sa/da/ bdar tsang legs yo nga ba'i kha ta ngo dam spyi chos rna/mas kyis byed/ 'a/sa dus ma gtogs rgya sgo/ re phye ma/sa gzhan rnam/sa bsdams te sde mis/ yan par mi gtong // rgya sbo'i nang du sha dang / nya ma// sgob/ nga/ rnams tshong du mi gzhug chos/ sde'i mtho lo/ ngas su/ bro ba/ glu ma ban//spre'u'i 'a bag sogs/ kyi rtse da mo byed du mi gzhug khya/ da par tshas sde'i nang du dus ma/ma yang glu dang ga 'as sos/sa 'jem du mi 'jus cing // sal te re ltar byed nga byung na dka/ra me zho re dang mang ja sogs ji ltar 'os/ pa'i chad pa 'gel/ rgya sbo/'i nang du glo nga mo ba mi tsa/tong/ drag/ 'an/ sus kyang khyi mi bsten cing / srang khyi rnam/sa phyir 'bud ma nus pa dang // khyi rnams brtse ba'i yul yim/ pas spyin pa'i yo byad kyi tshul ga'i sa dang / chos/ dus brang ba// nga re re na/sa bro do ma spyi chos kyis bsdus pa'i do dam byas/ tshogs dang btso thab kyi lhag rol bsko sa pa'i do dam nga/ sbing rje cam dang / spyi pa'i tsa/yog / zams kyis bsdus pa'i lcas/sa ri'i phyir myur du byin// de da/ga sis mtshon pa'i chos sde'i bca' khri/ ma/sa dang 'ag/la ba'i nyes pa chung 'bring che sa/sum sa/nga byed mal/ na de la bca' yig/ gi don dang mthun pa'i chad la/sa ji ltar 'os pa 'gel 'ing / chad la sa las byung ba'i rdzas rnams kyang mkhan slob da/ge ——— 436 — —

'dun dang bcas pa'i spyan/ lam du 'pho 'gyur med nga mngon sum du phab nas gtsus/ lag khang / mched rten/ dge 'dun spyi'i rdzas bo/nga 'og la 'bul/lhag nga ra mkhan slob chos khri// mas sne mo ba rnams kyi las bya rgyu'i ga bo bo ni nye ring phyogs lhungs dgo/sa med ngo srung / mngon lkog rang 'dod phugs tshang so sa/sa spangs nas bca' yig ltar gyi dge 'dun gyi khrims dang sgrig lam tshul bzhin gnon pa 'di yin pas le lor ma song ba rwa/nga len yang dag byed dgos kyis/ bya ba go/nga sa/sa la rnams thub/sa bzhugs dang / mdor na mkha' mnyam 'gro ba kun gī bde spyid/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan nga nga/nga / de dge 'dun gyi sde rnam par das/ pa dang / de yang 'dul khrims/ dang brtsa/da sgrub kyi bya ba rnam par dag pa la rag las pa sogs gyi gnad mkhyen pa'i sngon gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis dge/ 'dun gyi khrims su bca' ba mdzad pa'i sgo nas bstam/ nga/ rin po che 'dzin spyong spel bar byed pa'i sbol bzang po dus dbang gis ches/ cher nyams nga/'i skabs 'dir mkhan/ slob spyi chos sog/sa las byed rja/mas dang / dge 'dun thams cad kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan nga dang / rang ga 'a/na sems can thams cad kyi /'phral yu/na gyi phan bde la sa/bo bor dgongs/ pa'i thug/sa bsam rgya chen po bzhes nas da/ge /'dun spyi'i khrims su bca' ba 'di gzhung /leg/sa par srong ba dang / sgo sa/sum gyi spyod pa thams cad sdom ga/su/ma kyi bcad mtshams dang mi 'gal bar byed pa'i bya ba 'a/sa kyi 'khor lo dang / thun mong dang thun mong ma/ yin pa'i lam gyi rim pa la blo sbyong ba'i sgo nas nyams su len pa/ sgrub pa bsam ga/tan gyi 'khor lo/mdo sngas/sa kyi gzhung rnam sa la blo nus nga/nga mthun pa'i bslab sbyang byed pa1/klos/ pa thos bsam kyi 'khor lo ste/ 'khor sa/su ma gyi bya ba la nan tan snying —— 437 —— —

por byas pa'i sgo nas phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i thabs la brtson pa chen po mdzad par 'tshal/gtsug lag khang rnams klog pa dang / /ṣa 'don gyis rgyas legs gnas shing //rtag tu dge 'dun mthun pa dang / /dge 'dun don yang 'grub par shog/'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed da/nga bkur ste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig / bslab pa gsum ldan ngur smreg 'dzin pa yi/ /'dus pa'i tshogs kyis gnas 'di yongs gang zhing / /rtag tu bshad sgrub bya bas srid mtha'i bar / thub bstan phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog / zhes chos grwa chen po dpal 'khor bde chen legs bshad sgrog pa'i tshal gyi 'dus sde'i khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge thub bstan gsal ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba 'di mdzes byed ces pa chu mo yos lo dbo zla'i yad tshes dge bar gru 'dzin phyogs rgams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris/ / / /

tā la'iXbla ma sgru phreng bcu gsum pas phun tshogs bkra shis gling dgon du bca' yig bstsal 'chan snyan zhu/sa sprel/ (sbyiXlo 190shā )mchog gsum slu med skyabs kyi dam pa mchog /mchog thun dngos grub stsol mdzad yid dam lha/ /lha dang drang sbong bden tshig grub༄ pa'i mthu/ /mthu stobs rdo rje phar ba'i rwa bar bsrungs/ / rnam 'dren smra ba'i nyi ma shākya'i rgyal/ / rnam mang 'phags bod mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs/ / khyad par jo 'brom blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang / /khyad 'phags dam pa rnams kyis shis par stsol/ /phan dang bde ba'i rin chen ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bu ram shing pa'i ring lugs mdo sngags chu yis ba/ter/ /bshad sgrub rlabs 'phreng 'phyur ba ngur sprug 'dzin pa'i dpal/ /de phyir bca' khrims blang dod gsa'/ ba'i me long bskrun/ / ces shis pa brjod pa sog/sa kyi lam yangs par bya ste/ ji skad du/ 'dul bar bstod pa las/ rgyal ba ston pa de yi bstan pa ni/ /mdo dang chos mngon yin gsungs 'dul ba ni/ / ston dang bstan pa dngos yin de yi phyir/ / nyis 'gyur phyag bya sangs rgyas chos gcig yin// /zhes rga/sungs pa ltar thub dbang bstan pa'i nang mdzod bla na med pa ste/ btsun pa chos skyob kyis mdzod mchog 'dul ba rdzogs pa 'di ga/nas pa/ de srid — 43 9

chos ston 'di ni gnas 'gyur zhi/ /zhes dang so thar gyi mdo las/ mthun pa'i gzer rnon brgya pa yi/ /srab ni so sor thar 'di yin/ /zhes sems kyi rta 'dul spyong byed pa'i thabs mchog tu gsungs/ de'i phyi 'dul ba 'dzin pa dge sbyong gi tshul la'ang bsngags pa ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen sgron/ /'bar ba'i sgod ni dka' thub can/ /dge spyong rnams ni yin phyir ro/ /zhes dang / mdo sde rgyan las/ rab tu byung ba'i mchog dag ni/ /yon tan tshad med rnam dang ldan/ / de lta'i sdom brtson khyem pa yi/ / byang chub sems dpa' las khyad 'phags/ /zhes spyir bsngags shing / khyad par dge slong la rab tu gces pa'i mdo las/ dge klong zhes bya chos kyi rgyal mtshan te/ /dge slong zhes bya rdo rje srog shing yin/ /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing /sdom pa gong ma len pa'i rten kyang khyad par can te/ lam sgron las/tshangs spyod dpal ni mchog yin te/ /dge slong sdom pa dag tu bzhed/ /ces gsungs pa ltar/ 'dul ba dang 'dul khrims 'dzin pa la bstod cing bsngags pa ni tshul khrims yon tan kun gyi gnas su dgongs/ zhes dang /yon tan tshul khrims zhing du rnam 'phel na/ /'bras bu nyer spyod chad pa med par 'gyur/ / zhes sogs lung rigs kyi rgyu mtshan mtha' yas shing / yang sgos su/ mkhas grub chos kyi rgyal pos/ skye dgu rnams kyi phan bde ni/ /ma lus rgyal ba'i bstan las 'byung / / bstan pa'i chu bo 'phel ba'i gzhi / /dge 'dun chu gter chen po lags/ / zhes gsungs pa nyid gal che bas mkhas grub gong ma rnams kyis 'phags bod sogs yul gru du mar dge 'dun gyi sde mang du yod la/ de yang ston pa bcom ldan 'das nyid nas/ shing rul dag ni spang bar bya/ / bre ta dag kyang bsad par bya/ / jes gsungs —— 440 la

pa ltar dge 'dun 'dul khrims rnam par dag pa gal che bas 'dir bca' khrims kyi rim pa brjod pa la 'jug go/ 'di la gnyis/ gling bslangs pa dang / bslang ba'i don bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ dang po ni dpal dkar 'chang ba'i skye 'phreng bcu gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sder 'bod pa bdag ni/ chos brgyad kyi 'ching ba dam po g.yo 'gul ped pa'i rgya las grol te/'dzam gling gnas chen kun gyi gtso bo ri bo rtse lngar grags pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs gzhon nu zur phud lnga pa sogs du ma'i rnam rol gyi 'gro la phan pa'i 'phrin las 'jug pa'i zhing 'dir lhags te 'jam dpal bde chen gling du gnas skabs spo ra thu'i dge bshes yon tan rgya mtsho nas 'bad pa chen pos gsar 'debs kyi dgon pa 'di ngos la gtsang phul thog mdo sngags kyi 'chad nyan legs po 'byung ba'i bka' drin bstsal zhes nan tan byas pa ltar 'khur du blangs te bshad sgrub 'dzin pa'i dgon sde phun tshogs bkra shis gling zhes btags shing / rab tshes bgrangs bya zhe gnyis pa'i hor zla bdun pa'i bco lnga la dgon gsar du bskyod nas chos srid kyi dga' ston rgya cher byas/se 'bras dga' gsum gyi mkhan po rgyud stod smad kyi dge bshes gzhan yang lha rams pa/ mdo smad dang sog yul gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen du ma dang bcas bka' pod lnga'i dgongs don las brtsams pa'i 'bel gtam 'ag mang bgyis te/ chos srid kyi legs tshogs 'phel ba'i rten 'brel sgo du ma nas bsgrigs so/ gnyis pa bye brag tu bshad pa la gsum thog mar dge ba sde 'dir 'jug pa'i rten gyi mtshan nyid/ bar du dge ba bca' khrims dngos/tha mar dge ba tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ dang po la gnyis/ sgrig la 441 la —

gnon pa po mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dang rten dngos po dang po ni/ ji skad du/dam chos 'dul ba'i dgongs don bsdus pa'i khrims/ /las 'bras drang thig 'debs pa'i las byed pa/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin sten gnon mi yo ba'i/ /bca' khrims rmang gzhi bstan no/ zhes gsungs ba ltar rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul dang mthun par 'dul ba 'dzin pa dge 'dun gyi las byed dgos so/khyad par du chos kyi gdan khri la mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'dzoms pa'i gnas brtan rgyal tshab lta bu dgos pa las/ gzhan du thub bstan srog byed 'gro ldog mi 'phrul ba'i/ /bshad sgrub dbugs bral 'byung po'i stang stabs gar/ / bsgyur ba'i chos brgyad rol ba legs byas kyis/ / rtse 'jam g.yeng bas 'phrul rnams snying rje'i yul/ /zhes smras pa'i no lang lta bu'i rigs bkur bar mi bya'o/ de'i phyir/ 'di ltar thos pas grub pa ma bcom zhing / /grub pas btsun pa ma bcom par/ /bstan la phan pa sgrub pa la/ /skyes bu dam pa zhes kyang zer/ /zhes gsungs pa'i dam pa re dgon du nges par bsten pa gal che'o/ dge bskos kyang sham thab kyi gral rgan rim tsam ma yin par tshogs chos kyi rgyus che ba/ spyi sems dkar ba/ las 'bras brtsis zhing mtho dman bar gsum dang 'cham pa'i skyong mkhas pa/ blon po chen po'i yon tan lta bu ldan pa dgos/ dbu mdzad kyang 'don chos dbyangs rta skad bzang ba dus dang mthun pa'i dal brel kyi tshod shes pa mchod yon kun dga' zhing spro ba 'phel ba zhig dgos/ mdor na bla ma dge bskos kun gyi mthong che zhing zhe sa byed pa byung na sgrig lam rang shugs kyi 'ong ba tshul bzhin brtson pa bya'o/ gnyis pa sde 'dir 'jug pa'i rten gyi gang zag ni lta grub gtsang zhing rab tu byung ba'i bar chad bzhi dang / spang ba gnyis/ log pa gsum la 442 la

so/gas (dgal rkyen dang bral 'ing / mthun rkyem lnga tshang ba/ lnga phrug nyer sa//cig/ ci rigs dang lngan pa'i ma/khan po tshad ldan las rab tu byung ba/ 'od ldan rtsa bar/ slob dpen la gus tshum khri/ mas yongs su dag ces sogs gsungs pa ltar chos bdun ldan nges par dgos/ gnyis pa bzhub/sa nas nyams su blang bya'i bca' skru/ mas kyi rim/ nga/ ni chos grwa dang tshogs kyi bsgrims lam/ de las sa/'an yang gsum nga/nga po ni// zla chos/— bar chos sogs se 'bras dga' gsum spyi ngang ba spun pa las 'di kho na ltar zhes nges bzung med/ de'i phyir yig cha ya/nga rje btsun chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi yig cha gtso bzung gis bka' pod rnams kyi rtsa ba blo 'dzin steng nas gzhung 'brel skor du mar klog brtson dus rgyun gyi skyor sbyangs legs po byed/ bgro gleng dam bca' gang tshe yang grwa sa chen po'i dmis/sa stos dang mthun par byed/gnyis pa tshogs kyi sgrig lam ni/ rgyun ja nyin re bzhin zhogs tshogs su skyabs 'gro/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ zhabs brtan gsol 'debs/lam gtso/ lam rim bsdus don/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma gsungs nas mang ja dang po 'dren/ / de nas tsha bsur bsngo/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol/gnas bcu/ 'jigs byed dpa' gcig grub nas ja gnyis pa 'dren de nas gdugs sher seng gsum gyi bzlog bsgyur/ bzang spyod smon lam gsungs nas tshogs grol/ gdugs mchod kyi bsnyen bkur yod skabs bla ma mchod pa 'don/ nya stong brgyad gsum la blon bla bcas 'don/ skabs dang bstun te ja thug 'dren/ dgung tshigs skabs su smon lam rnam gsum gsungs nas ja 'dren/ mgon chos lha lcam sogs kyi gtor 'bul/ dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam/ bstan 'bar ma gsungs nas tshogs la 443 la

grol/ zla re bzhin tshes kal gsang 'dus/ tshes 1༷la 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ snyer lnga la bde mchog lu i pa/ bdag 'jug sogs skabs dang bstun/ nyer dgu la dus gtor dang srung spyi'i bskang ba 'gro nges/ drug hru pa bcas gsungs/ de ltar mdo sngags kyi bshad sgrub yongs su rdzogs pa'i gnas 'dus shing / bstan 'gro'i don gyi rim gro yang 'dir 'dus pas khral chos mi bya bar ngos dag pa bya dgos/ gsum pa der ma 'dus pa'i skor ni/ dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas ga/nga yod chud mi za zhing do dam legs par bya/ gtsug lag khang la dag gtsang thog rgyun gyi ma/ra me dang /dbyar dgun dang mthun par mchod pa 'bul ba gal che/ pham pa byung ba la dmigs bsal med par gnas dbyung byed/ chang dang tha mi kha sogs kyi nyes pa byung na bsdoms sems yod pa la chad pas phyir bcos med na gnas dbyung byed/ bla ma las sne dang grwa nga/ rgan pa yon tan can rnams la bkur bzo bya/ kha lan las/ lan byung tshe grwa sa chen po'i srol bzhi/na tshar gcod bya/chos thog sogs kyi 'gro stangs 'i/ba rgyas bca' yig zur rgyan 'god pa las shes dgos so/ gsum ba tha mar dge ba'i bras bu ni/ mdo las/ tshul khrims ldan pa 'jig rten kun gyis bstod/ ces sogs phan yon mtha' yas shing / grags khyab bdor gnyid lha yis bsrung sogs mang / zhes dang / gang gi rgyal ba'i chos bsrung na/ rgyal ba'ang rtag tu de la bsrung /zhes dang / rje thams cad mkhyen pas gnas skabs 'bras bu lha mi dang /mthar thug 'bras bu byang chub gsum thob par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar dang / spyod ma las/ dge slong bsod snyoms byed pa bdag rang tsam/ /'grang par byed kyi gzhan bdag mi gso ba/ /skyob pa de la lha dang mi rnams la 444 la

dga'/ /'e/sa 'od srung chen po byung ba dang ma ma thun par 'di dang phyi mar 'jig te/ kun gyi mchod pa zhing gi/ dam pa chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ro/ de ltar bslabs pa'i rim pa rnams la shes bzhin khyad du gsod pa dang / tshul bzhin 'jug pa la tshar gcod jes 'dzin gyis 'phrin las gang dras/ byed par ga/nas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtsho dang / ya/nga sgo/ gsum rgyal yum 'dod khams dbang mo bka//3 sdod nga/nga bcas pas rtag tu bya ra mdzod ciga'adir smras pa/ de ltar dri med 'dul gzhung sde bzhi'i chu klung 'khyil ba nas/ /ma khas dang grub pa'i zhal lung 'di bzhin khrims ldan/ 'dus pa'i sde'i/ /bca' khrims g.yung drung phyag rgya lhag bsam per gyis legs bris pas/ /blo gsal ngang mo thog bsam 'dab zung bskyod pas brtson gyur cig / dam pa'i mgon gyi lhun po brjid/ / mkhas btsun bzang po'i mu khyud 'dzin/ /chos srid nor bu'i rna cha g.yo/ /bskal bzang 'dab mas mdzes gyur cig /tshul der thog/ med 'phrin las rnam pa bzhis/ stong grogs mdzad pa'i rdo rje'i g.yar do can/ / khyad par dmag zor rgyal mo bo tsag bcas/ / legs nyes blang dor 'byed pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / ces bca' yig blang dor gsal ba'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i gnam lo zung gi lhan pa'i mkha' mtsho/ stod 'brel ltar gī la ya ste phur bu/ dbang rgang dang mthun par sa sprel lo nyin byed dbang po bu mo'i khyim du spyod pa'i dkar phyogs kyi rdzogs pa gsum par ri rtse phu gsar steng gi gzim chung bde spyid kun gsal nas bres/ zhes gos ser thog bres te dam gser gyi rgyal po bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

cha prengaXrjing 'ji dgon du bod ljongs spyi tshogs nas phrug dam bca'aXyig bstsal rgyu'i snyan zhuXzin thras/chu glang / (spyi lo 191 2 )bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi dbus/ / gdul dka'i 'gro la cher brtse ba'i/ //kun mkhyen don/ kun grub pa yis/ /'e/sa pa'i dge mtshan deng 'dir stsol/ /gang gi rgyal bstan lung rtogs kyi/ /yang snyeng dge ldan sde'i nang tshan/ /cha phreng rjing 'dzi 'dus pa'i sde'i/ /blang dor bca' khrims yi ger 'god/ / ces shis nga ra brjod pa'i dbyangs kyis sngun bsus te/ de yang chos ldan/ bod ljongs chos kha ga/sum gyi ya gyal mdo smad nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon la phan bde'i dge legs kyi snang ba 'bum du spis pa'i cha phreng rjing 'dzi dgon zhes bla dwags su grags pa mkhas shing grub pa'i dbang phyug rje blo bzang yar 'phel gyi gdan sa 'di nyid du 'khod pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i 'dus sde rnams kyi khrims su 'doms pa la skye rgu kun gyi srid dang zhi ba'i dge legs kyi 'jug sgo nyag gcig pu ni 'dren pa mnyam med kun mkhyen mi 'jigs bzhi ldan gyi bstan pa kho na yin la/ de yang lung dang rto/ gas nga/'i bdag nyid du gnas pas lung gi bstan pa sde sgod rin po che gsum gyi tshig 'dzin cing don smra bar byed pa dang / rtogs pa'i ———— 446

bstan pa lam bslab pa gsum la sgrub nga/ nyams len snying por byed pa ni ston pa thugs rje can gyi rjes 'jug rang re nyan thos kyi brtul zhugs 'chang ba dag gi bslab bya'i gnad dam par gyur pas na mdo las/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing/ // dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad/ / rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul/ / 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin/ / zhes ji ltang) 'doms par mdzad pa ltar/ dge tshul slong gang yin kyang lam gyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen dam pa bsam 'byor gnyis kyi bsten tshul ma log pa'i sgo nas bslab gsum rnam par dag pa gzhi/ra bzungs/ gzhi gsum nyams len sogs 'dul ba lung sde bzhi dang / bla ma lnga bcu pa/ bslab bya gnam rtse lding ma bcas nas ji ltar 'doms pa bzhin dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i dgongs don 'phyug med du byed pa zhig med du mi rung ba yin cing / rnam kun tshogs brda dang bsnyun rgan rim bslab gral ma 'dzol bar spyod lam cha lugs bag yod tshul ldan gyis nyin ltar rgyun jar skyabs sems dang / gsol 'debs sbon lam/ bzlog bsgyur sogs chos spyod kyi rim pa spyi dang bye brag zla ba dang por bka' 'gyur dang / zla ba gnyis par bstan 'gyur gsung sgrogs/ zla ba bzhi par 'jigs byed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ zla ba bdun par mgon chos lha mo sogs chos srung spyi'i bskang 'phrin/ zla ba bcu par mgon po'i gtor sgrub/ zla ba bzu gcig par chos srung gi bskang 'phrin byed rgyu sogs so so'i spyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga phyag len ma nyams pa kha mig yar blta sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar mdzad pa mang po yid la dran zhing / rjes su spro ba'i lhag bsam gyi bstam/ pa rgyas shing / 'gro ba bde ba'i smon 'dun rgya ga/nga che dang 'brel ba nyams len chos spyod kyi byed sgo gang ci sla bcos su ma song ba ——— 447 ——

gong 'phel rgyun 'khyongs su gnas pa dgos rgyu dang / gtong sgo'i gnyer 'dzin rnams nas kyang bstan pa'i sbyin bdag khas/ gi da/da rdzas 'chud mi 'dza' bar mchod rgyun nyams med kyi sri zhu tshul bzhin sgrub pa sogs mdor na ji srid rgyal bstan rin po che nam gnas/ kyi bar de srid 'dir lugs zung 'dzin spel gyi bya ba las dang / klog pa thos bsam/ spong ba bsam gta/ ma/ sogs jeg mchog 'khor lo gsum gyi bya ba la rtag tu gzhol bas srid pa'i rgya mtsho sdug bsrul gsum gyis na kras gtses pa'i mkha' mnyam mar gyur lus can mtha' dag sku bzhi'i rin chen gling du bde bar bkri ba'i rlabs chen tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i zhing sa mchog tu 'gyur ba zhig nges par 'bad 'tshal/ smras pa/ de ltar legs tshogs kun gyi gzhir 'gyur pa/ / bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' bzhin bcas pa'i khrims/ / tshul bzhin nyams su mongs shig/ blo ldan/ dag / bla med byang chen 'thob 'gyur gdon mi za/ /'dir 'bad bsod nams snang gter gyis/ / lnga bdo mun pa rab gsal nas/ / thar 'dod bung ba nyer 'tsho'i dpyid/ / bstan pa'i pad mo bzhad gyud cig / ces cha phreng rjing 'dzi dgon gyi 'dus sder khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa 'di ni sha kya'i dge spyong pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes chu mo glang lo'i rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes 14bzang por rang byung 'phags pa'i gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po ta la nas jis/ zhes gos ser thog bris te bod ljongs spyi tshogs nas phul ba'i gser dam chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /— 448 ——

thob rgyal nab rgyas gling dgon gh+ri bca'aXkhrims bstsal rgyu'i snyan zhun tā la'i bcuXgasum pa'i chog mchan 'khod pa/chuXglang / (spyo lo 191 2 )na mo gu nu/ ni iṇ+ḍa ya/ bgrang yas bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i spyan sngar lan mang thugs bskyed sa bon las/ /bsod nam/sa le shes tshogs gnyis ljon pa bskal chen du mar skyes bsrings pas/ /phun tshogs sku bzhi'i 'bras bzang yongs smin rnam 'dren shākya seng ge yis/ /srid zhi'i gdung ba drung nas 'byen pa'i dge legs bye bas rtag tu bsrungs/ /mgon de'i zab rgyas bstan pa'i rta ljang can/ /gangs ljongs lha lam ngos su 'dren pa la/ /phul byung snying stobs go cha cher btsan pa'i/ /rgyal blon lo paṇa rnams kyang phyag gi gnas/ /mdo sngags gzhung la bcas pa'i gnang bkag 'gal 'dur smra ba'i dam bca'i sprin/ /rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin gzigs pa'i rnam dag lung rigs dri bzhon gyis/ /pha mthar bskrad de slar yang thub bstan nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od ji bzhin/ /gsal mdzad grags snyan zhing kun yongs khyab 'jam mgon bla mar snyeng nas 'dud/ / mgon de'i bzhed sbol gtsang mar 'dzin pa'i la 449 ——

thus bstun la/ /dus/ kyi mthar yang ches cher gas phaṭa / ba'i bya ba mchog /sprub la snyer gzhol phan dang bde ba'i byed pa po/ /bshad sgrub chos kyi dga' ston rab rgyas gling 'di ru/ /'dus pa'i dge 'dun sde rnams la/ /blangs dang dor bya'i gnad ma lus/ /srong por 'doms pa'i khrims kyi tshig / rab tu dang ba'i yid kyis nyon/ /ces mchod par brjod cing / sgod ldan la nyan par bskul ba'i tshig gis sngon du bsus te/ skabs 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni/thob rgyal 'khru/ ngas gzhis kyi sbu tsha rjes mjub/ rnams nas gzhis ma lag snod bcud dang bcas ngos skye 'phreng bcu gsum par dad 'bul byung 'brel bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi spyi phud kun mkhyen mi mjed snying ngo/'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / bye brag 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid dar rgyas yun du gnas pa dang ngos ring du 'tsho zhing 'gro kun chos 'byor bde spyid kyi rtsed dgas rtag tu 'tsho ba/ zhar byung 'khrungs gzhis mi nor ltos bcas kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi bde bar gzhol ba'i gtan bde'i bsod nams kyi mchod sdong chen po sgrub pa sogs kyi ched 'jam mgon bla ma'i ring lugs lta grub gtsang ma'i dge dgon thub bstan gsal byed rab rgyas gling zhes gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar skrun dang 'brel bshad sgrub 'chad nyan byed po'i 'go 'dzin mkhan po dbus 'gyur gdan sa khag 'khor res kyi gtong rgyur/ gtsang khul dgon khag tsho bsdus grwa grangs lnga bcu tham pa gsar 'dzugs bgyis pa dge lugs kyi lta grub gtsang ma'i phyag srol rma med rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyu'i thog mar khyim pa gos dkar can lo bdun yan chad rab tu byung ba'i 'gal rkyen nyes pa lnga dang bral zhing / mthun rkyen phun tshogs gsum ldan ste de thams cad nges 'byung gi la 450 la

bsam par zin pa dgos/ yo byad rnams rang nyid la dbang ba'am tha ma g.yar po tshun chad kyi tshags su tshud par byas nas/ slob dpon bstan mkhas kyi yon tan dang ldan pa zhig gi drung du dge bsnyen dge tshul rim bzhin du blangs lo nyi shu lon nas dgos ched dmigs bsal 'dra byung na ma gtogs bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa len/ rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs rnams rgyun du bzungs te blangs 'das so drug dang / khrims nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gsum gyi so so'i bcas mtshams las mi 'da' bar legs par srung dgos/ rgyun tshogs yin res zhogs tshogs su skyabs sems dang 'brel sgrol dkar tshe sgrub/thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ sman bla mchog ldan rgyal ba ma/ tsha ding ma/dgung tshigs dgong ja bcas par sprun 'dren khrus gsol/ gnas bcu/skabs gsum pa/ lo rim bsdus don/ lam rim gsol 'debs/ yon tan gzhi gyur ma/ thabs mkhas thugs rje/ thub rnams spangs rtogs dpal ldan yon tan ma/ dpal ldan sa gsum/ jo bstod/ 'phags bstod/ 'jam dpal mtshan brjod/ rten 'brel bstod pa/ mnyes gshin byams ba/ bstod sprin rgya mtsho/ nyi gzhon 'chad ka thub dbang zhal gyi pa za/ ngo mtshar bsrugs pa/ gsang ba'i rnam thar/ gdugs shes seng gsum/ sgrol ma 'khor bcas/ sgrol dkar gyi bstod pa/ gtso rgyal ma/ smon lam rnam brgyad/ ngos ring 'tsho'i smon tshig rgyal ba ma lus pa/bstan 'bar ma/ mgon chos lha mo'i bskangs 'phrin/ mgon khang du bskang bshag 'phrin bcol sogs ci nus skabs dang bstun de 'bad/ zla ba yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong dang 'brel ba'i gzhi gsum gyi nyams len chag med/ tshes ldan ma shar la sgrol chog tshes 15nam shar la gnas brtan — 451 —

phyag mchod dang 'brel ba'i mchod sprin sna lnga brgya tshar/ tshes 25nam shar la sman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zla 2tshes 22nas bdun gcig ring 'jigs byed bdag 'jug gi cho ga dang sbyin sreg zla 4tshes 1nas bdun gcig ring rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che gsung sgrogs/zla 6tshes 4nyin 'bum gsung sgrogs/ zla 'a lha babs dus chen nyin rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i cho ga zla 1༷tshes 15nyin bla mchod bde stong dbyer med kyi cho ga dang / tshogs mchod/ zla 12tshes 22nas bdun gcig ring chos rgyal gyi sgo nas glo bur las bcol gyi zor 'phen/ zla 1tshes 1nyin tshes gtor bcas dang / brag sna ri khrod du dge slong bzhi dang dge tshul gcig bcas nas zhogs tshogs su 22skyabs sems dang spyan 'dren khrus gsol/zla ba yar ngo mar ngor gso sbyong dang 'brel gzhi gsum chag med/ tshes ldan ma shar la sgrol chog tshes 15nam shar la gnas brtan phyag mchod/tshes 20nam shar la min bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zla 4nam shar la sprung gnas dkar po cha brgyad/ rgyun du lha mgon gyi bskang 'phrin/lha babs dus chen nyin rgyal ba mi 'khrug pa'i cho ga/ zla 1༷tshes 25nyin bla mchod bde stong dbyer med kyi cho ga dang 'brel tshogs mchod bcas dus thog so sor nyams chag med pa dgos rgyu dang / dge 'dun gyi don du thag ring grang zug che sar 'gro dgos byung tshe dgon las rgyang phrag brgal te gos phu thung can dang / jo zhwa/ kha dkris bcas dge skos la gnang ba zhus gyon/gsar khral dang las sne 'khor mtshams so sor rang 'khri theg pa 'khur len byed/ dgon pa'i 'don chos kyang rgyugs rab 'bring mtha' gsum sgo nas lo lnga tshun blo 'don rigs dge skos dbu mdzad bcas nas rgyugs blangs thog — 452 —

nas thon pa byed dgos shing / ngan g.yo sgal ral gyi blo 'dzin ma bgyis pa sogs byung phyin gtsug lag khang dang / dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas nyams gso byed 'jug rgyus mtshon bab 'brel gyi rgyugs chad yan song med pa 'gel bkod las/ nye skyor phyogs lhung gi mig lhos shas rkyen rigs bgyis mi chogacho ga lag len dang dbyangs rol/ gtor bzo sogs tshang ma bslab pa'i rim pa bzhin bslabs te chags med pa dgos rgyu dang / rtsa bzhi chang dang bcas pa'i 'gal rigs mthong thos dogs gsum rigs sgrig nas dbyungs/sho ra bad tha mi kha 'then mkhan byung na nyes pa lus steng du rtsa 'dzin sogs mig lar phan pa byed/ dgon nang du bud med zhag sdod kyi rigs nam yang byas mi chog dus mchod dang / chos mjal sogs bya ba chos ldan gyi don du dge skos la gnang ba zhus te gtong / nam rgyun tshogs chang dang gser skyems tsam ma gtogs gsang sngags pa la bsnyad pa'i nag chang 'dzems med spyod pa dang / gar dang glu gzhas sogs bag med rigs gtan nas byas mi chog ar po sogs dmigs bsal byung phyin dge skos la gnang ba zhu dgos/ dgon gye mchod rgyun gtong sgo/ ja thug grwa phogs bcas la nyams chag mi 'byung ba'i gtong thebs zur song ltar de don sne mo ba mtha' dag nas chud gzod du ma song ba'i dge 'dun rang la thim pa dgos rgyu/phyogs mtshungs dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas che phra chung gsum thams cad la yang rang rang so so'i khag 'khre ba'i byed sgo 'thus shor med pa byed pa las spyi don la bsnyad pa'i sger don sgrub pa dang / spyi rdzas ngan kha 'gril gyi bed spyod za thung gi rigs gtan nas byas mi chog rang rang gi don la zhing kha 'debs pa/ tshong bun bskyed kyi rigs gtan nas byas mi chog dus ston sogs la 453 ——

gnas mjal ser skya pho mo drag zhan su thad nas lugs mthun khrims 'khur tshul mthun byung na dang de min re zung nas ra zi 'khrug rtsod rigs bka' khrims la ltos med byed mi byung na/ bla brang dang dge skos mol bsdur drang 'brel khrim sa gcod byed/ sbyin bdag khag nas 'das gson gyi skyabs zhu byung rigs khral mngon sla bcos su ma song ba smin 'gro dgos rgyu/ spyi sger gyi don dang grong chog sogs grong gseb tu dgos med zhag sdod/ khyim grogs med pas dben pa skyabs yod du bud med dang lhan cig 'dug 'breng byed pa sogs khyim pa bsun 'byin rigs la dge skos nas chad las yan por ma song ba 'gel rgyu/ dgon pa'i nye 'dab tu ser skya khag nas rta bzhon pa/ rgyang glu len pa/ dril bu 'dogs pa/ mgor skra dang ras bcings pa sogs dge 'dun la ma gus pa'i rigs byas mi chog dgon gyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa shag so sor dbo kha thigs tshags sogs kyi nyams pa sor chud mi nyams gong 'phel byed pa/ dge 'dun spyi nas kyang nad pa dang dmigs bsal btang 'os rigs ma gtogs tshogs la gnang ba ma zhus par shag tu bsdad mi chog tshogs dus kyi skabs kyang tshang mas kun spyod mi mdzes pa'i rigs spangs te dbu mdzad nas 'go bskul byas pa ltar tshang mas mgrin dbyangs gcig tu 'don nga sogs rje bla ma'i bstan pa rin po che'i mdzes rgyan du 'gro nges zhig dang / las kyi sne mo ba che chung tshang mas kyang so so'i khag 'khrir nye kha phyogs lhung med pa'i sgrig khrims gang 'doms chos byed pa tshul bzhin gnas thabs thog gtong gnyer khag nas kyang chos gzhis kyi 'dzin skyong la gces spras thog rtsa bas rtsis sprod dang / lo mas gtong sgo sogs phogs yig dang / rtsa tshig dim pa'i 'bru don las mi 'gal bas mchod rgyun nyams chag med pa dgos rgyu —— 454 ——

bcas de don ji srid bar sor gnas dgos rgyur dam can srung ma'i tshogs kyis kyang legs nyes stang 'dzin g.yel ba med par sde 'dir chos srid dpal 'byor gyi legs tshogs rnam par rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig 'dir smras pa/ blang dor nyams su bstar bya'i nor bu'i tshogs/ /legs par bsdams pa'i yid kyi bang mdzod du/ / bzungs nas rgyal bas bsngags pa'i lam bzang por/ /nyams len 'dod rgu char du bsnyel bar rigs/ /de don rdo rje dbyengs kyi dbang phyug ma/ / dam nyams bstan dgra bsgral slad drag mo'i skur/ /yongs bzhengs dmag zor lha mo re ma tis/ /tshar gcod rjes 'dzin las la ma g.yel zhig / 'dir 'bad dge bas bskal pa ji srid bar/ /chos dang mthun pa'i phan bdes 'jig rten khams/ /'tsho ba'i dga' ston yun tu gnas pa dang / / bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas gyur cig / ces thob rgyal thub bstan gsal byed rab rgyas gling gi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa 'di ni rab byung bco lnga pa'i nang tshan chu mo blang lo'i rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes 19dge bar pho brang chen po po ta la nas bris/zhes gos ser thog phab te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser tham chen mo bstsal zhu rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

rtseXgazim 'gagaXgis se na dgon la bstsalaXba'iXrtsa chig zhal bshus/sa rta/ (spyo lo 191shā )bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos sde chen po se ra theg chen gling gi slob dpon/ las sne/ 'dus tshogs dmangs dang bcas pa mtha' dag la bzlo ba/ khams gsum phan bde'i snying po rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yun du gnas shing / 'gro ba'i bsod nams gsog pa'i gzhi rten bla na ma mchis pa de ga chos sde chen po'i dge 'dun mchog dman bar par bcas pa'i 'dul khrims kun spyod skor spungs blangs phra zhib 'khod pa'i bca' yig rgyal mchog gong ma bskal bzang rgya mtsho nas bstsal ba'i dgongs don la 'gal med nyams len rtsa 'dzin ji bzhin med pa'i bar skabs slob dpon las byed rim 'byor nas tshul min sgrig 'chal rang bzo sna tshogs thog gtsug lag khang gi sri zhu 'dzin spras la 'thus shor sogs mtshan don nyams dmas su 'gro gzhi ji snyed byung rigs lam ngan mu byams su mi 'gro ba'i rtsad gcod bab bkod zur du song zin pa bcas des na lus can yongs kyi phan bde'i srog rtsa kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / bye brag 'jam dgon chos kyi rgyal po bong kha pa chen po'i gser mdog cod paṇa — 456 —

'chang ba'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid dar rgyas yun gnas kyi rtsa ba tshangs spyod dge 'dun kho nar rag lus la/ de yang 'dus tshogs rnams kyi bgyi bar 'os pa'i thos bsam 'khor lo'i bya ba yang dag par sgrub brtson gyis 'dzin skyong dgos pa rtogs gsal ltar 'go 'dzin slob dpon so sos bka' sde snod dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i 'chad spel chos 'chad nyan dang /brtsi bzhag dpe 'dzin skyor sbyangs/ rtsod pa/ rgyugs len gyi rim pa mtha' dag dam pa gong ma rim byon rnams kyi thugs bskyed bzhed sbol smad po che'i phyag ris ltar ma 'phyugs pa dus rtag tu lhod yangs skad cig tsam ma song ba'i rtsa 'dzin slob dpon las sne rim 'byor nas dbang po rab 'bring rtul gsum gyi blo dang 'tshams pa'i brtson sbyangs la bskul brda nye dga' phyogs lhung spangs pa'i lhag bsam rma med dgos rgyu ma zad/ grwa sa'i bla sprul dang/slob dpon zur sdod sogs nas kyang pha yul gyis mtshon thag ring du rang mtshams 'gro skyod mi chog cing / lhag par grwa skor ming btags gtong lugs skor kha bshad don stong mgo bde mthor snyegs ster sbyin rjes 'breng du ma song ba'i thos bsam gyi 'bras rtags rnam dpyod 'gran bral rnams la lha rams dang / de 'og tshogs rams/ gling bsre/ rigs rams sogs slob gnyer bzang zhan gyi rnam dbye go rim ma 'phyugs pa zhig zhib 'jug gi sprod pa las/ rtags gsal khyab gsum gyi rigs la rags pa tsam yang blor ma chub pa'i rigs la dge bshes kyi ming btags che chung gang yang sprod len gtan nas mi chog pa sogs kyi skor nye lam rtsa tshig zur song don bzhin 'gal med nyams len rgyun 'khyongs nges/ chos khrims kyi byed po rnams nas kyang gtso bor 'dul khrims gnon bsdems byed sgor le shor rang 'dod phyogs — 457 —
