lhung dbang gis khrims 'chal dge sbyong sha tshugs 'dzin pa'i dam nyams sdig can las 'bras dang / lugs gnyis bka' khrims btsan po khyad du gsod mi 'ga' zhig nas nag chang dang / sho/ ra sbad/ mchongs/ rdo sgor sogs dge sbyong chos las nyams byed bag med rgyan po 'gyed pa'i rtsed mo'i rnam grangs la brten pas zhe sdang nga rgyal gyi phyogs langs rang gzhan gnyis phung mig ltos shas rkyen de rigs lta ci/ mar 'ul las rgyug / ston dpyid so nam zhing g.yog gis mtshon nges 'byung gi bsam pas kun nas blangs pa'i rab byung bslab sdom yang dag par ldan bzhin du spyor ba khyim pa'i brtul zhugs 'chang ba'i bstan par rma 'byin gyi spyod ngan de rigs gtan nas mi chog cing / rnam kun mang jar 'gyed yod min la ma ltos pa'i 'dus tshogs gang che'i thog dbu mdzad nas tshogs 'don rta dbyangs kyi rim pa sngar srol nyams med dgos rgyu las/ sla bcos rang bzo dang / rnam kun mang ja/chos ra gso sbyong sogs kyi skabs tshogs pa je nyung gi rang bzhin dal sdod/dbyar gnas grol te dgag dbye'i skabs rang khyim sogs la bag med 'gro bskyod yul sdod byed pa/ gzhung sger 'gyed yod skabs skal ba 'gro khungs skal tho nang gsal ltar lhag las byed khag nas thog mtha' bar gsum zer ba sogs ming 'dogs sna tshogs kyis slong rtsod sne btags tsam mi chog cing /de mtshungs rdo gcal steng skal len ces pa'i mdzes lam du mi chags pa de rigs gcig kyang bskyod gtong byed pa/ dgon gyi gling gseb phyi nang sa gnas khag la rnam kun gad bdar gtsang sbra dang ldan med pa'i sa btsog nyams mi dga' ba chos sde chen po'i mtshan shas yong rkyen de rigs mi chog pas mtshon dam chos 'dul ba'i dgongs don las 'gal 'gro'i chu rka 'go nas — 458 —

rnyogs gzhi 'di phyi gnyis med kyi las ngan su thad mas phra mo tsam mi 'byung zhing // dgon nang rgyu 'grul tshang mas spyod lam rang snang gang dran gyi khyad gsod byed mir 'go/ 'byar mig bskos slob dpon las sne bya spu gnon rim pas kyang zom 'jog ma yin pa'i zhib 'jug thog chos sde chen po kha 'khyer gyi khrims 'gal byed mang rigs gtan nas mi chog pa sogs blang dor gyi rim pa gang ci'i gnas la bca' yig chen mo'i dgongs don la chu bo'i rgyun bzhin bar med nyams len star chags su bgyis na de lhag rnam grol don gnyer gyi bya ba gzhan du ma mchis gshis tshogs chen dge skos gsar 'byor skabs bca' yig mjug tu rtsa tshig 'di'i ngo bshus thog nas lo ltar zengs re 'dus tshogs su sgra dag gsal gsum gyi snyan sgron dang 'brel bas mjug gnon zab 'doms dgos rgyu ma zad/ bsnyen bkur rgyun ja'i skyor tshad lag deb nang bzhin zhu len gyi rgyu rdzas bar ma dor mi 'gro zhing / tsha 'khol thon gsum gyi las 'bras dper 'os spyor dngos rjes gtsang dgos rgyu las/ bar lag nas rang bzhin 'dod rngam gyi ham 'khyer dang/ ja ro thengs gnyis lhag bskyar bskol rnying sum du 'gro rigs gtan nas mi chog cing / gtsug lag khang le lag nyams gog mi 'byung ched lo ltar zla 2nang bla spyis bskor zhib kyis skyon gshor gyur rigs tho 'god dang 'brel bas 'khri khungs so sos nyams bzo 'phral 'phral dgos rgyu'i bkod khyab dang / rab gsal sgo 'phyor sogs kyi chu len ras yol/ sbra yol rtsa 'thor khag slad nas rtse shod phyag mdzod gtong khungs nas rgyu cha zur du zhu sprod ngal ba ma dgos par 'khri khungs so sor ma rtsa gsar 'dzugs zin don rang khongs nas chibs bsgyur skabs dang rnam kun bcas par bdag gces le thogs med pa dgos rgyu'i bkod — 459 —

khyab rgyas dpyad legs par zin pa bcas de lugs slob dpon la sa sne rim 'byor dang / 'dus grwa mtshos/ dman mtha' dab/ nas bca' yig chen mo dang rtsa tshis// snga phyi'i 'bru don 'gal med dgos rgyu las/ sger don spyi 'khyer bcos lhad sna tshogs kyis 'dul khri/ mas nyams 'chal dang thos bas/ma 'khor lo'i bya ba 'a/sa la 'grus brtson med pa'i rang 'dod sgrig lhad/ bsnyen bkur// sri zhu 'dzin spras zhu sgor 'thus shor sogs 'gal char gleng ngan phra mo tsam shar tshe le su thogs la nyes pa sla da 'doms gcod nges las/ rang bzhin yan por 'jog thabs med pa bcas de don rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas yun du ga/nas shing / rang rang 'di phyi'i bde 'bras khe nyen la gces pa'i spangs blangs 'dzol ped dgos rgyu'i rtsa tshig 'di bzhin bla spyi'i sprod khongs yig/ rigs dkar chag tu bkod de rtsa 'dzin nyams len rgyun 'khyongs su yong ba bgyis/ sa rta zla ches bzang por bris/ zhes pa'i zhal bshus la zhus dag nges 'drong song / rtse gzim 'gag nas zla 1༷tshes 17la / /

ta la'i za ma za phreng bcaXgasam pas g.yi li chaXgod 'as sa la sa sa sa ra /ra / sa rdo shagaXg dgan pa ga gsum rnam pad gral ba 'a gling du bstsal ba'i bca' migaldugs sprel/ (spyi lo 192 0 )bod zla 12tshes 20nyin thib /'jug song /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig bkra shis gang zhig ston pa nyi ma'i gnyen/ /bkra shis gang zhig dam chos nor bu'i sgron/ / bkra shis gang zhig da/se/ 'dun ris/ grol dbang / /bkra shis gang zhig mchog gsum spyi bos mchod/ /phan bde dri bzang 'thul ba 'dul ba'i tshal/ / phan bde non gnyer bung ba nyer 'tsho'i gzhir/ / phan bde ngo mtshar 'bum du bzhad pa'i gnyen/ /phan bde snang byed gtad rabs ri bor bsngags/ / rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab rin chen sna bdun gyi/ / rgyal ba'i bstan la lung rtog chos kyi srid/ / rgyal ba rnams dang mnyam pa'i mnga' thang can/ / rgyal ba gnyis pas 'gro 'dir shis pa stsol/ / lhag pa'i lha mchog zhal dgung 'bar ba dang / / skyes bu gsum gyi srung ma'i tshogs kyi gtsos/ / dkar phyogs spyong pa'i lha klu'i gzi nus kyis/ / nag phyogs rab pham dbu 'phang srid rtser snyegs/ / dge —— 461 la

leg/sa rgya mtsho'i pha rol bgrod pa'i gru/ / dge ldan/ ring lugs phyogs mthar spel ba'i slad/ / dge sdig blang dor ma log 'du'/ ba'i khrims/ / dge la spro ba'i 'jug ngogs 'di na dbye/ / de yang 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo nyid ni mtho la brling bas bar mtshams med par bskor zhing ma rig pa'i mun pa stug pos khyab pa/ skye rga na 'chi'i g.yang sa 'jigs su rung bas bcad cing chags sdang gi dug chu dras/ po lhung lhung 'bab pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gcan gzan dang / sprul gdug/ pa dag gi ngar sgra 'byin zhi/nga mtho ris dang thar pa'i sros/ la rgol ba/ rnam pa du mar lus sems yongs su gdung bar byed pa'i 'dam rdzab dang ljan ljin la sogs pas gang ba'i srid pa'i 'brog dgon pa chen po 'dir ya mtha' thug pa ma mchis ba'i dus nas las nyon ga 'a/na dbang btsan po brdeg 'cha' zhing 'khyams pa'i ngang tshul la yid/ sun pa'i rnam dpyod can dag gis ni thog ma kho nar srid par 'khyams pa'i rgyu'i ga bo bo ni gang / de las thar pa'i thabs tshang la ma nor ba ni gang zhes zhib tu bsam par bya zhing sdug bsngal dang kun 'byung gi mun pa sel ba'i sgron me ni thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che kho na'o/ zhes lung dang rig pa'i lam nas nges pa drangs bar bya'o/ de sgrub pa'i dus kyang ji skad du/ rgyal sras zhi ba lhas/ mi yi gru la brten nas ni/ /sdug bsngal chu bo che las sgrol/ /gru 'di phyis nas rnyed dka' bas/ /rmongs pa dus su gnyid ma log / ces dang /'jam mgon bla mas/ dal ba'i rten 'di yid bzhin nor las lhag /'di 'dra rnyed pa da res tsam zhig yin/ / rnyed dka' 'jig sla nam mkha'i glog dang 'dra/ /tshul 'di bsams nas 'jig rten bya ba kun/ /sbun pa 'phyar ba bzhin du rtogs gyur nas/ /nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa dgos/ /—— 462 —

zhes ga/su/ngas pa rte/ra dam nga/'i jos rnam par das/ pa sgrub nus yid bzhin gyi rbo/ra bu las kyang che cher lhag pa'i dal 'byor gyi chos bco brgyad ldan pa'i rten khyad par can thob pa'i dus lan cig 'dir/ chos rgyad le lo'i 'dir sna bya bzhag/ gi los/ lam du ma 'phyan bar gtan gyi 'dun ma lag rtser son pa'i chos gsha' ma zhig da lda nyid nas brtson dgos pas/ de'ang byang chub lam/ gyi sgron me dang lam rim che chung sogs nas gdul bya lam la 'khrid tshul ji skad 'doms pa ltar/ rang rang gi blo nus dang 'tsham par chos ma nor ba re nyams su blangs te dal 'byor la snyeng po ci lon bya ba ni nges par gnad du che/des na 'dir chen po hor gyi sa'i dum bu / g.yi li cha har shog gi dbo/na pa theg gsum rnam par grol ba'i gling gi dge 'dun pa rnams kyis lag len du bstar bar byu ba'i bca' khrims hrung zad brjod pa la gsum/ sgrig la 'jug pa po'i rten gyi gang zag zhugs pa'i bya ba/ bya ba de ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu'o/dang po ni/ ji skad du/mi nyid dbus skyes dbang po tshang las mtha' ma log gnas la dad / /ces dang / sangs rgyas rnams la lhag par byas/ /de la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskrun/ /dge ba'i bshes kyi mgon bcas pa /'di nyan pa yi stso/da yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar spyir rang 'byor phun sum tshogs pa dang / sgos su sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che la sogs pa zab pa dang rgya che ba'i gzhung lugs la thos bsam sgom pa'i sgod du rung ba dgos shing lhag bar yang 'jam gon bla mas/ de ltar so thar rigs brgyad po/ /sgra mi snyan pa ma gtog/sa pa'i/ /gling gsum skye pa bud med kyi/ /rten la skye yi za ma dang / / ma ning mtshan gnyis so/sa/sa la min/ /zhes 'dul gzhung rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa 'khrus ma med du gsungs pa bzhin dge tshul slong gi sdom pa skye ba'i — 463 ———

bar chad dang mi ldan pa dgos la de yang phyogs ga/zhan thu chos sgor zhugs zin ba zhig yin na/ khams bzhi'i rtsa 'gal byung ba dang gnas dbyung byas pa yin min sos/sa 'dris 'gros//sa can gyi khungs so sor dri rtsa zhi/ba mor bgyis te gang cir gnod rkyen dang sgro bskur du 'gyur ba'i dgag bya dang bral bar thag chod na 'jus/ bstan pa'i sgor gsar zhugs yin na slob dpon la sde 'du dir zhugs chog pa'i brda 'bul zhing / slob dpon gyis kyang zhugs na rung min gyi bar chad spyi dang / khyad par ma bsad pa la sogs pa sdom pa skye bo'i bar chad yod med leb/sa par brtags nas bslab tshigs snga phyi'i tshul khrims gang 'os rang gi sbyin nga/'am/ gzhan la 'bogs su bcug nas sgrig la 'jug par byed/ gzhan nas 'ongs pa dang gsar zhug/sa gang yin kyang khag theg lta bur grwa pa rgan gras tshul ldan yid brtan khel ba zhig gis khungs byas te 'jug dgos/ nga/ge tshul slong du sgrub pa'i tshe mkhan po dang slob dpon rdza/mas kyis kyang rang rang la 'du'/ ba nas gsungs pa'i brtan mkhan kyi dpal yon spyi dang khyad par sdom pa 'bogs pa dang / bar chad 'dri ba sogs da chog nyes med phum/ sum tshogs pa'i mkhas nga 'i yon tan tshang bar bya zhing / bsgrub bya rnams kyi kyang 'khor ba la yid spyo zhing / bslab pa srung bzhin srung ba'i spang blang kyi gnad phyin ci ma log pa la sgrub 'dod kyi bsam pa skom pa chu 'dod bzhin khyad par can mngon du 'gyur ba bsgrub bya'i mtshan nyid dang med du mi dung ba'i yo byad drug sogs tshang ba bya/ cho ga yang bu ston rgams cad mkhyen pa dang / kun mkhyen lnga pa chen po'i las chog ni dbang po mchog rnams la sgrub byed rgyu mtshan dang bcas pa sogs kyis shin tu dge mod/ tshig tshogs che bas 'jug dka' la/ lcang skya gong ma'i 'bogs —— 464 —

chob 'di/ de sa/nyis kyi sngag/sa tshig nas/ 'gro/ba su bsdus 'ing khungs btsun la mkhyen bde bas de bzhin byed lhag par 'jug chog bslab pa brjod/ pa ni/nges par gnad che bas nan tan bya/ bsgrub pa'i dge tshul slong dag gis kyang mkhan slob kyi bslab pa brjod/ pa rnams sa bon du byas te rjes mdzad pa'i dge tshul slong gi bslab bya che chung gnyis sogs la 'dris par sbyangs dgos/gnyis pa zhugs pa'i bya ba la ji skad du 'jam mgom bla mas/ dang por rgya chen thos pa mang du btsal/ bar du gzhung lugs thams cad gdams par sha/ra/ tha mar nyin mtsham kun tu nyams su blangs/ zhes gsungs pang— lta ra lag len du thebs par bya rgyur/ de/ yang dgon gsar du song gshe/sa mdo snga gas ga/zhung lugs rab 'byams thos bsam rgya chen mad7//sna na 'ang mthar skyab 'gro/ las 'bras/ stobs ba'i// sdom pa gsum ldan yin na sdom gsum/ so thar gyi sdom ldan tsam las dge slong yin na 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i snying po / da/ge tshul yin na kwa ri kā sum brgya pa la dge rgan legs par bsten nas mdzub 'khrid kyi slob gnyer dpyis phyin byed dgos/ skyabs 'gro sogs drug po de dag gi/ gzhung che chung gang slob rang rang gi blo stobs dang mos pa'i bab bstun bya/ sgrigs la ma zhugs pa'am zhugs nas lo gsum lhag mi 'gyang bar skyabs 'gro/ dga' lha/ bla mchod/ chos spyod bstod chen bzhi/ sa lam skabs gsum/ rje'i gsang rnam/ smon/ lam rnam lnga/'jigs byed/ mgon ngo / chos rgyal/ lha mo// rnam sras/ gser zhun ma/ de dag gi gtor 'bul dang gser skyems/ bstan 'bar ma dge ldan bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon la rma bcas nges par dzā la 'dzim/ da/rgos/ cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo sogs zla ba bcu gnyis so sor ston pa mchog dang /— 465 ——

rje bdag nyid chen po la sogs ba sangs rgyas byang sems kyi mdzad mtshad dang bde gsang sogs rgyud sde'i cho ga ga/'an tshub/sa thub na/ dbus 'gyur gdan sa gsum dang rgyud grwa rnam gnyis/ zhis gi/ phyag len la gtugs te ma nor bar 'dzugs pa gal che sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa sa/nas mi gnas ni/las rgya rtsa gcig sogs 'dul ba'i lag len rngo da med kyi rjes su 'gro bar 'dul ba sa/zhung dam pa las gsungs shing / sngo na dus nyes byas phra mo kyang ma gos pa'i tshul khrims las bstan pa nyam dar/'a ba'i dus su bslab ba sna ga/cig srung ba bsod nams che bar zla ba sgron me'i mdo las gsungs la/ khyad par du 'dul bar bsto/da pa las/ ji ltar sa ni/ skye rgu rnams kyi gzhi/ / de las 'bru rnams skye bar 'gyur ba ltar/ /de bzhin 'dul ba sdom brtson rnams kyi gzhi/ /de bzhi/na de las bsod na/mas rnams kyang skye/ /zhes dang / dpal ldan zla bas/ yon tan tshul khrims ba'i/na du rnam 'phel na/ / 'bras bu nyer spyod chad pa med par 'gyur/ / zhes sogs rgya cher sa/sungs pa ltar tshul khrims rnam par dag pas zhing sa la brten nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi myu gu skyes pa ni shākya'i bstan pa la zhugs pa'i snying po yin pas de la rtsal ci yod kyis 'bad pa gnad du che bas bslab pa yongs su sbyong ba'i gzhi gsum gyi nyams len mtha' dag nges par lag len du bstar dgos/ de'ang rje bla ma'i mdo rtsa'i mchan 'grel dang / ṭika chen rin phreng gi dgongs pa ga bor bzung thog 'dul 'dzin chen po'i gzhi gsum cho ga'i phyag srol rnams 'khrul med khungs btsun gyi lam nas lo gcig la ngo bo nyid kyis na/ zla bshol yod tshe dus 'brel gyi gso sbyong nyer drus/ nga/nga / med tshe nyer bzhi 'byung ba yin mod/ 'on kyang dgag dbye'i skabs des go chod pa yin gyi/ logs su mi — 466 la

dgos te/ mdo rtsar/ dgag dbye byas pas ni de ma grub pa nyid ma yin no/zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ las la dngos su 'du ma nus na/ 'dun pa dang yongs dag 'bul dgos shing / de la len pa po dang 'bul mkhan dang /'bul tshul gyi spyir btang dmigs bsal rnams zhib cha lag len du phebs par bya/ tshes grangs nor ba byung na/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin gang rung zhig dang bstun te dus gzhi brtan por 'dzugs/ gso spyong dang / dgag dbye'i byin brlabs bya tshul ni/ mdo rtsa ba las bzhir ma tshang na dus kyi bar du bsdad de byin gyi brlabs par bya'o/ 'ba' zhig na 'dug te'o/ lhag ma gzhan dang bcas pa nyid yin na mdun du'o gsum ni 'khod de'o/bzhi'i dgag dbye yang de bzhin no/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas lag len bya dgos pa byung tshe tshul dang mthun par byed/ dbyar gyi skabs su zhag gcig nas zhag zhe dgu'i bar gyi byin brlabs gang rigs rang gzhan gyi don du byed dgos shar tshe phyag len ji bzhin ma nor bar byas te 'gro ba sogs 'dul 'dzin gyi bslab bya chen mor legs par bltas nas don thog tu 'khyol bar byed/ dgon gyi slob dpon sogs blo kha mtho ba rnams kyi 'dul ba gzhung dam pa'i nang tshan bya ba'i phung po dang / mdo rtsa ba'i bslab pa yongs spyong gyi gzhi gsum dang / las sman gos gsum gyi gzhi dang /gnas mal gyi gzhi rnams la nges par thos bsam gtso 'don byed dmigs bsal gnang ba zhu 'khrol dang 'brel ba yin na ma gtogs dgon nang du bud med mi gtong zhing zhag sdod gtan nas mi rung / yul dus kyis dmigs bsal mi byed ka med rigs ma gtogs skya chas gyon pa dang / glo gri 'dogs pa la sogs pa'i ya ma zung gi yo byad dang kun spyod rnams gtan nas mi chog— 467 —

don med kyi 'du tshogs dang ku co sogs mnyam med thub pa mchog gi ring lugs mi mdzes shing / thos bsam sgom gsum sogs rnam byang dge ba'i chos la gnod rkyen du gyur ba gang yin kyang bya mi rung / pham pa byung na/gnas dbyung bya zhing / lhag ma yan la mchod me snyan shal gtsug lag khang du phyag bdar dge 'dun la phyag 'tshal ba sogs kyi chad pa nyes pa'i lce yang dang sbyar nas gcod/ srog chag phra mo yan chad la gnod rkyen byed pa mthong na yang tshog/sa kyi dbus su tshig gi tshar bcad de brkyang phyag 'tshal du gzhuga'akhon 'dzin 'thab mo sogs byung tshe chos srid kyi lugs gnyis ka nas yul dang bstun pa'i nyes pa bab lce gcod/ 'di skor la dge 'dun gyi nang khrims sam sgrig yig 'dul ba'i lag len khungs gtug sa 'dus mang gros bsdur gyi sgo nas zur du 'jog pa legs kyi/ tshig tshos/sa che ba la 'jigs pas 'dir ma spros/ de ltar rab byung rnams thub pa'i bcas pa dang 'gal na/ shi nas ngam/ 'gror 'khyams dgos shing / tshe 'dir lha'i zal 'byor la sogs pa sngags kyi dngos grub kyang mi 'thob pas nyes dmigs shin tu che ba yin te/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa las/ tshul khrims 'chal la thub dbang gis/ / sngags 'grub par ni ma gsungs te/ / mya ngan 'das grongs 'gro ba yi/ /yul dang phyog/sa kyang ma yin no/ /zhes dang gzhung da/ma pa las/tshul khrims 'chal ba'i gang zag/ la ni nyes da/migs bcu ste/ bcu gang zhe na tshul khrims kyis bdag snad pa dang zhes pa nas lus dang bral nas shi ba'i 'og tu dmyal bar skye 'o zhes dang / dgra bcom chos kyi tshong dpon gyis/ 'di na la las rgyal po'i tshig chen yang / / 'das na lan 'ga' chad ba 'thob mi 'gyur/ /thub pa'i bka' lung tshul min bzlas gyur ma// /ngan 'gro 'gror —— — 468 —

rgyur e le'i 'dab klu bzhin/ / zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ba ltar lag pas rtogs dpyod dang ldan pa dag gis dran shes bag yod la gnas pa'i sgo nas 'bad par bya'o/gsum pa zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni/ gnas skabs lha mi'i dpal 'byor dang / mthar thug thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang nges par thob pa yin te/ 'jam mgon bong kha pas/ gnas skabs 'bras bu lha mi dang / / mthar thug 'bras bu byang chub gsum/ / 'thob par 'gyur zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ / brtson ldan rnams kyis so sor thar/ / rtag tu gus pas 'bad de srungs/ / zhes dang 'jug pa las/ mngon mtho'i rgyu ni tshul khrims las gzhan med/ zhes dang 'dul bstod las/ sangs rgyas rnams dang rang rgyal rnams kyi kyang / / byang chub gang brnyes thub slob rnam dag gi/ /sems can dgra bcom yon tan ldan rnams kyi/ / de la'ang rgyu ni 'dul ba yin par gsungs/ / zhes dang sdud pa las/ khrems kyis mi khom brgyad spong de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed/ ces mdo rgyud ga/zhung lugs rgya mtsho nas tshul khrim/sa rin po che'i bsngags brjod blo yul las 'gongs pa gsungs te/ mdor na mngon mtho nges legs kyi bsdus pa'i phun sum tshogs pa thams cad tshul khrims gtsang ma'i phan yon du hrol gyi 'dus par rigs lam stong gi grub la/ khyad par du lam rim las/ bsta na pa rin chen mchog gis ma khyab pa'am/ / khyab kyang nyams par gyur pa'i phyogs der ni/ /snying rje chen pos yid rab bskyod pa yis/ / phan bde'i gter de gsal/ bar byed par thog / ces thugs sbon gnang ba'i bzhed dgongs rjes su bsgrub phyir blang dor gyi rim nga/ 'di dag ched du spel ba lags pas bdag la mos shing — — — 469 la

legs su 'dod pa rnams kyi nges par nyams su bstar te dal 'byor thob pa don dang ldan par bgyis 'tshal/ smras pa/ 1 'gro rnams srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i slad/ /'gro ba rnams la dam chos bdud rtsi'i sgo/ /'gro ba'i mos pa ji bzhin dbye ba'i mgon/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa rgyal ba rnams kyis dgongs/ 2/gang dag zhi ba'i dbyings na zhi ba'i blo/ /gang gi ma lus ma rnams bde ba'i thabs/ /gang dang gang yang sems pa de dang de/ /gang zhig nyams thag nyams su smin gyur cig 2/ sa dang lam gyi gzhi rten 'dul ba'i khrims/ / sa yi mthar yang 'phel na snyam pa'i blos/ / sa gsum rab gsal thub mchog nyi ma'i dpal/ / sa zla'i ljon 'dra dran nas bstod ba dge/ /zhes g.yi li cha har gyi dgon pa theg gsum rnam par grol ba'i gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyi blang dor khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge dzaspu'i gser gyi ljon shing zhes bya ba 'di ni pad dam/ra 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge spyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes lcags mo bya lo'i mchu zla'i dmar phyogs kyi gra'/ tshes 2 1dge bar dbus 'gyur sa'i thig le nor gling bde skyid kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bres/ zhes bos ser thog bris te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser tham chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan (1// / / /

phrug/ ngam bca' yig bstsal 'char snyan zhu/ ba/sa sgre /sa / ( spyi lo 19 2 0zla 1 2 ches ༈ 0 )dregs spyem bod zla 3 2tshes di gnyin /jib mjug song /rma su sti/ bde /spegs su gyur cig mthu nus rdo rje'i thog char dbab pa 'i/sa/ // mu ste/sa/sa brag ri bye ma/ra 'thab/ byed pa/ / 'gran med smra ba'i skyes ma/jos/ zas gtsang sras/ / dad pa'i pad dka/ra /da dab ma brgya pas mtshad/ /mtho/na de'i mdzad nga/ rmad byung gzugs brnyan /dbum/ / mkhyen pa'i me /thong gtsang mar ༅ra ba /mas/ / bo mtshar kun bzang mtshad pa'i sprin spyo ba/ / yab rje /3jam da/nga/la zang por bsam spyin dad/ / dung phyos/sa nor 'dzin yangs pa'i this// re der/ / mar me sa/cig las gnyis su mtshad nga/ ba'i na/ / tsha 'phrul mtshad nga/'i dge mtshan mngon pa yi/ / bca' khri/ mas dbyangs can phang 'gro 'di naXbardung / / de yang 'jam dpa/ma rtsa brgyud da dang mdo sde gdams ngag 'bogs pa'i/ rgyal po'i lung gis zin pa'i dus mchod khyad pa can tsha 'phrul smon 'a1ma chen gro zhes yengs su grags pa /'di nyid dang dang por rje bla mas bsar /'dzub/sa mdzad pa nas bzungs dam pa'i skyes mjog rim par byon pas /'dzin snge/rten 'a/ 'dzin ‘mas rlabs che bar brten shar phyogs rgya mtsho'i 17/

mtha' la thug gi/ bar du khyab cing / lhag par gong sa lnga pa chen po dang/sa skyong bur sa ra yab sras kyi sku ring pa gang ci'i sri zhu bla lhas tu gyur pa'i rgyun da lta'ang nyams med gnas pa 'di lags shing / nye lam rab byung bco lnga pa'i lcas/sa khyi lor bos nas nag chu 'bas brtan dgo/na gyi dge 'dun pa rnam/sa la smon lam chen mo'i 'gyed skal spyi mtshungs spel bar/ rje sprub khang pa mtshag nas kyang bstan pa dang / ngos ring du 'tsho ba'i rim gro'i cha rkyen du dgongs te 'bas brtan dgon du rab byung bco lnga pa'i 'ing yo/sa lor cho 'phrul dus mchod chen/ mo gsar 'dzugs ba/nang ba ba'i na dge 'dun sa/nyus/ mar sa/nas pa dang / sgro bur du lhag/sa pa rnams nas ji ltar lag len nyams su bstar rgyu'i rim pa la/ zla 1tshes 4phyos/sa/ kyi dge 'dun rnams dgon nang du 'dzoms dgos shing / /'bas dgon las sne rnams nas mchod bzhengs gling phyi nang gi gad bdar rngo byad 'dzin spras sogs 'khri khungs so sor snyer bsngogs tshag tshud kyi 'ib 'jus/ gzengs thon pa dang gtong sgo bre 'jal 'degs 'gyog/sa dgos rigs la sprub bla mdzod pa nas blta rtog bkod 'doms nan tan bya/ tshes 5la yar tshogs yin zhing / rdzong sdod sbrel po'i sar sngar lam ltar smo na lam ring btson khrims ngang 'phen dang /gtsang sbra sa/da bdar sogs la gnang ba zhu ster thog bab bkod chog nga/'i dgongs zhu'i thog nas do dam pa sprub bla mdzod pa dang / /mas sne bcas nas khrims 'chal du mi 'gro ba'i dngos shus/sa bskor g.yeng gang zab byed/'don cha yar tshogs pa dang dus mnyam par dag/'a lha bar rta/ yid 'ong mchod yon mtshams ja mchod 'dren pa mnyam med bar rta/ rnam thar 'al sa/sum/ ja rgyab shes snyeng tshar ga/sum gzungs bzlog dang bcas pa bgegs 47 2

rigs ma bar rta/ gtor 'bum rgyas pa/ ja gnyis pa'i rgyab tu bstan 'bar ma dang / byams pa'i sgu gzugs ma bad rta btang nas grol/ tshes 6zhogs tshogs la ltu nga bshags// gtso rgyal ma bar rta tshigs bcad bzhi la rta chen/ ngos ring 'tsho'i gsol 'debs ja mchod bdag sogs 'khor bcas/ ja rgyab skyabs 'gro dang / gnas bcu yongs rdzogs bar rta/ ja gnyis pa'i rgyab tu shes snying bzlog bcas bgegs rigs ma bar rta bla brgyud man snying bcud bsdus yongs rdzogs sbyin bdag gi rim 'gro/ ja rgyab tu byams smon rgyas rta dang bar rta res mos kyis nyin dang por bar rta/ dngos po dngos po bskul mtshams nas grol/ tsha rting mar skabs gsum pa dang /thub rnams spang rtogs res mos kyis nyin dang por skabs gsum pa/ ja mchod 'dren mnyam bar rta/ ja rgyab tu nyin dang por dpal ldan sa gsum gnyis par lam rim gsol 'debs rgya chen spyod brgyud yan gsum par smra ba zla med/ bzhi par lam rim bsdus don lnga par skabs gsum pa/ drug par gnas bcu/ bdun par ngos ring 'tsho'i smon tshig brgyad par byams chen chos rje'i gsol 'debs rnams bar rta 'then/ de rjes sbyin bdag gi rim 'gro/ spyod 'jug bar rta/ dud 'gro rnams ni gcig la gcig ces pa'i mtshams nas 'dur/ byams pa'i sku gzugs bar rta btang nas grol/ gsung chos la bla ma gdan khrir 'khod skabs dmigs brtse ma rgyang 'then mjug phyag gsum 'tshal/ stan la 'khod zin pa dang bla mas shes snyeng bskul te gzungs bzlog bgegs rigs ma dang bcas pa bla brgyud 'jug ma rdzogs tsam la dbu mdzad yar langs/ phyag gsum btsal te snyan gsan dang bcas pa'i maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul/ tshigs bcad gnyis —— 473 ———

la rta chen/ bla mas sangs rgyas tshes tshas/sa ma brkye dang/ rjes ba༅/da pa dang /skyes rabs so ba'i pa'i /3chad nyan byed mjug// tu tshas ba༅/da pa las zhes sogs chigs bcad// bsngo ba/ dmigs brtse ma rgyang ka'i phen byas nas grol/gung tshigs tshogs pa dang bzang spyod dbyangs// ja mtshad pa dang dkar ltar bsngags/ ja rgyab tu dag(ra lha mkhye/na srid ma/ thub rnams spang rtogs/mkha' mnyam ma nyi gzhon 'char ka ma/ der ni ring /dbad/ 'khrungs rabs// bde chen ldun grub/ 'bas brtan sang rig/sa la rta 'then/bzang spyo da kyi 'jug/ bsdu spyi na bdag rim 'gro// ja galīs pa dang thug nga/ la bo/nga tsa///sal rnams bab brte1sa bton rjes thos/ mtha' ma bar rta btang nas grol// sgam tshogs la /bla ma khrir 'god ska bas dmis/sa brtse ma rgyang 'phen/ /les/sa pros ma bar rta de lha/ra skyabs 'os nas bar bsnyu/ma mtshams chis sa bcad gnyis la /'dur ches 1 5/nga/ skabs sa/su/ma/ pa tshes g.yin rnams la blo bzang rgyal kun/ byams skron dang thos/ mthan sna ma res mos kyis/ byams smon la/ tshul khrims pha rol phyi/na rjogs shog/ ces nga dang / thog mtha' mad/ bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin par shos/ ces pa'i mtshams su dbu mdzad nas bla mar mngon pa kha zhu/ dbu mdzad gdan la 'khod pa dang /mchod dbyangs rgan pa nas sa gzhi byen brlabs bar rta/ ma lus ma rta chen/bcom ldan bskal pa nas 'dur/ sku khrus gsol bar zhu zhes pa dang mnyam du mchod dbyangs pa rnams langs te khrugs kyi khangs pa rta chen/ khrus gsol rgyas bsdus nyi tshod dang bstun nas byed/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho/ de las gzhan yang de srid/ bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ zhes pa'i bar maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa/ deng nas ma 'am sa gzhi ma sogs tshigs bcad gnyis rta chen/ — 474

hūṃ/nga bshags5 dang /'brel bar phyag 'tshal/ mjug ma rdzogs tsam 'a/ stan la 'khrod/ phyag (mtshal ba dang zhes pa tshigs bcad rdzogs pa dang bla mas gzhi bdag gtor 'bul bskul/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs zhes pa'i skabs su dbu mdzad langs te gsang rnam bsku‘ma/ yon tan gzhi gyur 'dur skabs dbu mdzad phyir 'gros log mchod rdzas rnams bldu/ bsngo ba dang 'grel ba'i bstan 'bar ma mthun 'gyur/ de nas dbu mdzad kyi bde spyon 'go bskul gyi bdag dang gzhan gyi na/sa mthun 'gyur rjes/ ji srid thub mchog ma bar rta/ yid la bsam pa tsam gyi zhes pa'i skabs dbu mdzad dang chos dbyangs pa rnams 'a mo gyon la mdun du hrung zad yongs te rgyal mtshan rtse mo sogs shis brjod tshar gsum dmigs brtse ma rgyang 'then gyis grol/ dgong jar gdugs dkar rgyas pa/ ja rgyab tu rten 'brel bstod pa/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi smon lam/ rta mgrin/ kun rigs smon lam/ bde chen ldun grub/ lam rim smon lam/ 'char can 'phrin bcol ja rjes ma'i rgyab tu lha mo'i gtor 'bul 'bras spungs rta chen btang nas grol/ nyin gzhan rnams de dang 'dra ba las/ tshes 15la tsha rteng med/ gung tshig la bzang spyod bar rta/ 'das sa ngas ma'i 'gor ja mchod 'dren mnyam/ ja rgyab tu gong gi tsha rteng ma'i chos spyod re mos sbyin bdag rim gro/ bzang spyod 'jug bsdu/ ja gnyis pa'i rgyab tu spyod 'jug bar rta/ thug rgyab tu thog mtha' ma bar rta 'gyed bshar ka langs ring lha mo'i gtor 'bul dang /byams pa'i sku gzugs ma/ gsung chos skabs bsngo ba grub rjes dbu mdzad nas gtang rag maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa/ tshigs bcad 'jug bstan 'bar ma dang /rgyal rtse'i shis brjod/ dmigs brtse ma'i rgyangs 'then bcas/ mtshan 475 —

mor stong mchod dang 'bre' ba'i ma/tshad /dbum khu'/ don sangs rgyas/ chos tshogs tshar gsum/ dga' lhag sa ga'i byin brlabs rta chen/ khrus gso /la mdor bsdus/ maṇ+ḍal bzang spyod/ rgyal ba ma lus bcas/ tshes 16 17gnyis la 'jigs byed dang yang gsang tshogs skong rgyas pa/ tshes 1dal sprums sgu gleng ba smo/ra du gdan zhu'i ser sbreng dang / phyos/sa ba'i ra sa/ngas rgya/sa chos/ tshos/sa lan gsum/ sa bzhi byen ba/rlabs/ khrus ba/sol/brtan bzhugs sngogs bcu ma tshar gsum / rgya'/ rtse'i shis brjod/ byams nga/'i sbu gzugs // bde lhun / mu/ngas spyo/sa bstam srung / bstam 'bar ma / rgyal ba ra/ lus bcas /'jo/na/ 'khor nas spyom 'a/ma/ tshogs nas legs bris ma// sgo bzang rgyal kun ma// byams smom// khrus bsol bsdus pa/dga' lha/ yo/ma nan sa/ji gyur ma/'i 'jus/ tu bsngo ba / tshas kyi rgyal ngo // bdab bzhin ma gsum la mthun 'gyur/ ji srid thub ma chog man chad spyi 'gre ltar byed/ ma dor ma 'di/ra/ tshig/ sa/sal 'khod/ mim/ 'a/ ma lho sa par lha ldan smon 'a/ma chen mo'i phyas// srol ji lta ba ba'i ma/ las len du jebs par bya zhing / gtong gnyer rnams nas kyang deb gzhung zur bko/da ltar ji srid rgyal bstan nam gnas kyi bar dkon mchog sri zhu'i zhing /khyad par can la nyin re bzhin bsnyen bkur nyams med lhag bsam rjes thon dgos rgyur/ sgrub khang bla brang mdzod pa rim 'byor nas gang cir 'go 'doms stangs 'dzin nges nan dgos pa bcas drag zhan bar pa mtha' dag nas ji srid rgyal bsta/na nam sa/nas bar gong don blang dor 'dzol med tshul bzhin du spyod par gyis/ smras pa/ 'phags pa'i yul du smra ba'i seng ge yis/ / mu stegs glang chen spyos bur/ tal ba'i tshul/ / rjes dran gus pa'i mchod pa rgya mtsho'i sprin/ / —— 476 ——

(snang da / ba / rdzo bla ma /'i drin da sa rngu lam/ kar tha ྈ tsa/ che1sa5 / / le sa/sa mdzad mkhras/ pa'i/ chu' nge/ra ru ron dwo sa/sa nas/ / /pū/nga rdobs ga ste na 'dzin 'i/da ba'i ma hru ma che che'i—/ / dgong ma / nga/'i/ rlabs phreng dus su/ gsal ba 4/nga / / bstan dang 'a pa spyo ro'i snyer 'tsher dme// rdzu da cis/// /'di (ra/ sgo gsum /dang shin ma thobs rmye rba kum/// / thos / bas / ma rngo shā/ nga 'i shes rab phyos tshon zom/ ma// / ma rib// zlangs/ pa'i g.yu 'a1 ngo pham/ bya sa te / rgya ma pa'i/ bo/ zo) ma nga ring rnge/na sna ba/sa gyur cig /ces/ nas chu khya/bas brtan dbom/ gī spyo na 'a/ma / chen cho/'i bca' khrims lhug por sgrob/ 1༄ dbyangs/ can pha/nga /re gro'i sga/ da byangs༄ zhes bya ba (ka'i mi/ nga nga/ dal//ra 'chang nga/'i skye phreng ba/cu gsum nga ngas/ dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs/ bra'/ dbang phyug phyo7ba/sa /las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bco lnga pa'i bgrang bya'i na/nga tshan lcas/sa mo bya lo'i ma chu zla'i dam1ra phyogs kyi gral tshes 2 1dge par nor ṭā/nga bde spyid kun dga' 'khyil pa'i bska4la bzang pho brang nas bris / zhes gos ser thos/ pris te bod sprongs lha mi/sa phun ba ba'i gsar tham ma na sna nga sdig 'a rgyu‘ (1sa na 'thus ci kun snyan (1/ / / /

byams gling grwa tshang giXbaca' yig ngo ma byams blan song ba'i ngo bshus thus dag song /meXstag ( spyi loX192 6 zla 2ches 1 1 )spangs rtogs mthar son/ mnyam ped 'dren nga/ rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /zab dang rgya che'i mdo sbags mdzod 'dzin dam ba'i chos/ /rig grol re skong nor bu'i bang mdzod dge 'dun te/ / rin chen nom gsum srid na mchog dge'i shis pa stsol/ /mtshar sbug nyin byed 'bum phrag 'bar ba'i dpal/ //dpal ldan smra ba'i seng ge ngur smreg tshul/ /tshul gnas 'chad rtsod rtsom mkhas bstan pa'i bdag 'jam dbyangs mi dngos 'jam mgon bla mar bsngags/ / rgyal ba'i lung bzang mchog tu skyong ba la/ / rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las glog gi zlos gar can/ / ma rung snyeng rtsa sgog mar 'byin pa'i zil /bzod par dka' ba srung mas dus kun spyong / /zhes thog mar dge ba'i shis brjod kyi phreng ba sngon du btang nas skabs kyi don gleng bar bya ba ni/ 'jig rten thams cad kyi ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyi dang po byang chub mtshag tu thugs bskyed/ bar du bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags/ mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas te zab rgyas tshas kyi tsā mo brgyad khri ba'i stong legs par phye 178

bas mkha' mnyam skye rgu mtha' dag rnam byang bzhi ba bdud rtse'i grong khyer du 'dzud par mdzad pas/ lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'gro ba'i sgron mer sa gsum na cir yang mdzes par gyur de lta bu'i bstan pa rin po che 'jig rten na gnas mi sa/nas kyang 'dul ba'i las dang lag len yod med kyi rjes su 'gro ldog byed par 'dul ba lung dang / 'dul bstod sogs su rgya cher gsungs gshis khyim med par rab tu byung ba rnams kyis khas blangs pa'i bslab khrims la gces spras byed rgyu dam pa'i don gyi snyeng por gyur pa des na 'dir lho rgyud nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i rgyan gcig grwa nang dga' ldan byams pa gleng gi dge 'dun pa rnams kyi blang dor khrims su bca' ba'i rim ba kun gsal me long 'god pa la gsum/ 'jug pa po'i rten gyi gang zag de ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul zhugs nas nyams su blangs pa'i rim pa'o/ dang po ni/sde 'dir gsar zhugs sdom pa zhu dgos yin tshe sdom pa skye ba dang gnas pa dang mdzes pa dang / khyad par du 'gyur ba'i bar chad spyi dang / khyad par tshad ldan gzhan nas gnas dbyung pa yin min sogs legs par brtags te yul dus la ltos pa'i dag rten du nges pa rnyed pa/ yi ge 'phral spyor gyi klog chas sgra dag thon nges/ yo byad tshag tshud/ bsten khungs dge rgan 'os can dang bcas pa zhig dgos/ gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten dge rgan nas snyan gsan bab bstun sgrigs zhugs kyis mi ring bar mkhan slob bstan mkhas gnyis ldan gyi drung nas nyes med phun tshogs kyi bslab tshig rim par len pa snga srol ltar byed/ gsum pa ni/ khas blangs pa'i dam sdom mig 'bras bzhin srung ba las do gal che ba gzhan med pas 'jam mgon bla ma'i dge tshul slong gi bslab bya gnam rtse ldeng mar brtson pa nyams len nan tan du — 479 —

byed nga/sa ma/tshom/ dge tshu'/ gī blangs/ /dzadas ngang / dge/ dwo/nga gi/ ltu nga nga snge pe —rnge so/gas / das//ba/ spru ba sam/nga sa//su/ma gyi bcas mtshams jib nges/ thos/ snyes dus zo// gro tsam nga/nga /mi/ 'byung ba'i thabs / brtson hūṃ ra /spen cing // rgyun nga/ra dge tshu/ma /skre///nga ge ba'i/ba bya'i sa(ga che phra rnam/sa la rang blos sa/nga spyo gas su/ slo ba spyo nga bye/da lda/ma nga gong ma sa/snyes blangs mo/da na nga/nga de gas/sa srung tshu/nga/ blun ci ma /ro sa/ par nges su/ bcus/ ste bcas/ (snas/la gye nyes pas ma rgos/ nga/ jig bya dbos nga gnad du sa//la/ rī po/sa ma rnam lnga sgyu sto ga/ par bdo ba'i rang rtag/sa su/ blun dro/ngas pha/ma mo ches mdo sprus/sa lam kyi tsa/'i rtsa mthun mong lam sbya ngas dang / thun rngo/nga dam tshis// srung sdom/ rtswa ltar bor nas/ rtos/sa nga mtho snyeb/sa kyas dre/nga snyan ga/sang tshas zab zab ma/nga po rtsad ga/cod byed/ pa ni bo tsha /khre‘pa med kyi /bye phag ci/ bu'i/ — spyo tshul dang // dus gsu/ma rgyal ba thams cad thugs /lpe/nga ba'i da yi na/ pas 'di smo/ra la tshang mas gtan 'dun ma no/ra ba'i 'khur le na kyis/ zla gam bro/ bcad nya mgo/ ma/ nga ma/ rdo je/ gong ba ma mtshungs///'dab ma ser po/ zhwa ser/ tshos/sa phor sogs rngo/ byad bdan sa rnam ba/sum ltar dang / stod rag/ lha/ma sgrogs dmar ser/ chab ri/ma/ chab shubs/ gding ba tshad ldan sogs spyod /mam gang cir bzang ngan mtha' gnyis su ma ldung ba bya zhing / smyon tshul la /mas snes sgogs (mjug phra zhib byed/ gos phu dung can/ gri ring blo 'dogs/ 'bar zhwa sked rgyan// rgya sog gi lham/ phreng ba rgyan can sogs gtan nas mi tshag gzan med par sgo ra phyi nang du rgyu ba/ ca sgo'i sgra dang rgyangs 'bod sogs 'i dul gyi 'tsher mar 'gyur ba'i rigs mi bya/ tshogs tshas kyi tshe na(rang brda btang ba dang mnyam du zhwa go zla gam phreng ba chab ril sogs dang bcas dmigs brtse ma ‘7/8()

'don ba'in pa'i/ ngang nas 'du khang sgo 'phyor du bung ba tshang la 'du ba lta bur rba/na rim nas dal bus nang la phebs pa las / dpung sgres/sa/ ba'ad gad rtsed 'jo long satam/ so/sas mi mdzes nga/'i ris/sa mi dung // gra(la du bzhugs ste/ngas chu'/ mthum ma tsa/togs ya yo dang // rtsig pa/ ka/ ba 'al ba sogs la bste ba// zla sa/ma sos/sa kyi kha btum/ kha/ sba ma bab/ga nga/ra mchil smabs 'khor ba// ma chi'/ snabs rang sa/ra 'dor ba sogs mi byed/ bde sas nga sogs kyi spru ba mtshad byed ma de'i/ sngon du dbang dang bsten pa nges nga ra dbo/sa/// za btung sga/ngas cas/ cag/ phu phu rā /gas lce sgra dre/da cing / hub kham/ ran nga/ra zla tsa/ma/ sos/sa ba/ bzhes phor hrung zad sgreb nas/ longs spyod pa ma gtog/sa lce phyi ro'/ du phyungs pa dang / bcom sgra dang bcas pa sogs bcad 'gal ma dad nga/ra ('gyur ba'i rigs mi rung / bza' btung lang lus kyi srin por sbyin nga/ sa/tong ba dang // rang nyid lhar ga/sal ba la ma chod 'bul/ sog/sa su bsam nas spud na dkor chung bas de ltar las len du 'debs/tshog/sa grol skabs su'ang ral gri shubs/ nas bton pa ba'i na bgres sa/cho/na rgo/ ma los nga/ra dal buya phebs/ tshogs dbar dang / snga dgong du ga/sar bus 'dzin skyor// rgan pas sbyor chos lam rim ba spyod rdzogs sogs gang nus thos bsam sgom pa'i ched shag sgo bcad de gcig bur sdod pa las don med kyi 'du long byed mi chos rgan sa/zhon tshang mas yon tan gyi rigs la sbyangs brtson dang / bsnyen sgrub byed mkhan rigs la bkag cha mi byed par ma zad/ zhen bskul gang 'os su gtong / gung tshigs skabs phud mchod mthong brgyud lag len ltar bzhengs nas dkon mchog rjes dran gyi mdo 'don zhing / phyi dro'i kha zas mi za/ thun drug rnal 'byor la tshang mas nan 481

tan bya/ zhwa 'bebs gzan 'bebs sogs yul lugs dang bslab pa rga/na gzhon gyi brtsi 'jog go ma 'dzol ba dgos/ dgon pa'i spyi gnyer sogs gtong 'dzin dmigs bsal can ma gtogs gzhan ma rnams bun skyed sogs nyo tshong dang mngon mtshan gyi nyes rigs su gtogs pa gtan nas byed mi chogamachong rgyug dang / lag pa g.yugs pa/ rgyab tu bsgo ba/ gzan gyi kha btum pa sogs byung spyod khyim pa sun 'byen gyi las su 'gro ba'i rigs rnams bkag bsdom nan tan byed/ dgon nang du rta bzhon pa/ dril g.yer 'dogs pa/ kha dkris gri gzer sog stod 'bud pa/ ku co 'o dod 'bod pa sogs drag zhan su thad nas mi chog smon dus ma gtogs dgon nang du chang rag 'khyer nyar mi chog bud med ming sring na ba thugs 'phrad lta bur nyin khyug grwa shag tu bskyod dgos dmigs bsal byung na bla brang dge bskos la dgongs zhu byed/ dgon pa'i mtshams nang khyem pas kyang 'thab 'dzin dang / glu gar/ kha snar dud 'then sho rgyag sogs nam yang mi rung bas rtogs 'jug gi byed 'dzol la chad las bab bstun gtong / rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga ni srog bsdos su srung gal che ba ma zad/ lhag par 'byung nye la nyes dmigs che ba'i chang 'di ni/ bcom ldan rang nyid kyis kyang yang yang smras par mdzad de lung las/ nga'i rab tu byung ba rnams chang rtswa'i rtse mor chags pa'i thigs pa tsam yang btung bar mi bya/ gang gis chang btung ba de ni/nga'i nyan thos ma yin zhing / nga da'i ston pa ma yin no/ zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas 'gog brtson chig bsgril byed/ gal te rtsa bzhi chang gi nyes pas gos pa dang mda' rdo gri mtshon gyis rmas pa sogs nyes can zhu ngo mgron brgyud med par gnas dbyung thog mang ja nyes chad sogs bab che chung la — 482 —

gzhigs pa bla ma 1mas snes spyo/ bcad dang / skya rtsa bcas snga srol ltar grwa tshang spyi/ phan rang bdas/ tshag rgyur 'di skor mi skya /'go dmangs rnams nas kyang theg pa khur len bgyis/ khyad par dgon 'di nyid byams gleng paṇa chen bsod nams rnam rgya/ya khu dbon gyis phyag btab pa nas bzung mdo brgyud spyi bye'i bshad sgrub kyi lugs bzang rma med la brten byams sprung skron lam bzhes dgon khas/ 'du mi mtshad /dbul zor 'phen sogs ga rtsa 'dzin byams gleng bla brang nas byed nga/ dang / dgon las/ sgar chen mthu sto/bas dbang phyus/ gis btab pa'i sgrub sde ba 'dab 'brel stabs dbyar gnas dang / rgyun gyi gso sgrengs /ma 'du bas mtshon lo 'khor sgrub mchod che chung dus gtor khag bcas spyi da/ra nas sgrub tshugs dgos rigs chog sgrigs zur gsal ltar sgra dag lhag chad med pa blo 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i rta 'dur dbyangs gsum/ 'bud dkrol brdung gsum/ gar thig rdul mtshen sogs rang lugs khungs ldan jib sbyongs yar rgyas dgos shing / bla brang / spyi pa/ zhig gso/byams dgon can gtong 'dzin rnams nas gtong sgo deb mthun nyams ped dgos/ par mchod zhing / bogs shas 'bab khungs sogs 'dzin dbang la gtogs pa sngar yod rtsod 'phrog chad 'khums ped pa len sprod bcas phyi nang kun nas dge bcu'i khrims la gnas nga/ bgyis bos/ mdor na sdom pa gsum gyi nyams len gtse ('din thog dmigs bsal dgon 'di nyid sba sor rje gong ma rgya/ma mtshag brgyad pa chen pos rta tshag rje drung ye ges blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon por bstsal ba sgo mang grwa tshang du jos pogs thebs su 'bul sbyor gnang ba bar lam mkhan thog nas dgon sder brdabs bsigs ci che byung stabs mkhan 'dzin kum gling bla brang nas bya nu/sa slad phugs brtan ched 718 rte

chos phogs spar cha dang 'brel shing glang nas bzungs gtan 'jags su bsko bzhag song ba ltar mkhan po las sne 'dus sde bcas drag 'an tshang mas blang dor khag 'gal med rtsa 'dzin rgyun 'khyongs su dgos rgyur bstan srung ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams nas rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las kyi 'jug pa nyin tshan kun tu g.ye/la med byed pa dang bsam sbyor ngan pa'i las la spyor dang spyor du 'jug pa'i rigs byung tshe mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las ji dgar mdzad du gsol/zhes grwa nang byams gling dgon gyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa kun gsal me long zhes bya ba 'di yang pad dkar chang ba skye phreng bcu gsum pa sha kya'i dge spyongs ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sde dpal bzang pos rab byung bco lnga pa'i nyag ma drug sbe pa me stag zla 1 2tshes 2 1dge bad nor gling bde spyid kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang pho brang nas pris/ zhes 'khod pa'i spug dam bca' yig bo ma byams gling mkhan po'i sprod khongs su yod pa dang te bag med pa'i tshig zhus nges nan zhus/ kun bde gling bla brang phyan khang nas/ me yos zla ༈tshes 1 1la/ / // / — 484

twa la'i bla ma sku dreng bzu gsum pas rnam rgyal dge ldan lha khang la bstsal ba'i bca' yig bzhugasaXso/me stag ( spyi lo 192 6 )bod zla 5tshes 12nyin zhib 'jug song /ston mchog smra ba'i nyi ma zas gtsang sras/ / lung rtogs rin chen mdzod la phyag byas nas/ /bshad sgrub bya ba las kyi 'khor lo'i tshu'// /rab sa/sal yi ge'i me long 'di na spel/ / de la rnam rgyal dge ldan lha khang gi nye khor du gtogs pa'i dgon grwa rgan gzhon tshang ma'i lag len khrems su bca' ba ni/ 'jug rten yu/la dus kyi dmigs bsal sbyor 'os rigs ma gtog/sa bar chad zhi bral/ lo bdun lon cing / chos grwar lo bcu ma mtha'/dge bsnyen dang / rab byung gi sdom pa ma nyams pa/ bla spyi'i zhabs khongs sogs dmigs bsal can min na rgyugs 'don 'phrod nges/ gnas gzhan nas sgrigs dbyung byas pa min pa sogs dgos/ rgyugs len tshogs la dbu dge zung dang / chos grwar bla dge dbu gsum gyis byed/ 'jug sgo mang ja nam yod dang chos grwa'i 'go gzhung mjug gsum/ 'jug tshul tshogs chos la 485 ———

yo byad tshag tshud thog rang mos khag jeg dge rgan gyis las sner ngo sbyor zhus te mang ja dang zhogs tshas la rim par 'jug rtsod pa sngon song yin na 'dzin grwa mas rim nas dam bca' bzhag ste gang mos su zhugs tshagagazhan kha dog dkar dmar nas 'jug dgos zhugs nas lo gcig tsam la 'don cha sogs skyor sbyang byed rung yang da phan mtshan nyid kyi gzhung rang ga bor 'don bya dgos las gzhan mdo sbags kyi cho ga than thun sogs la 'bad 'bungs mi chog rigs lam chung 'bring che ba/ grub mtha'/ gzhung gsar skabs dang po/ phar phyin/ dbu ma/ 'dul ba/ mdzod bcas 'dzin grwa bcur bya/ rigs lam che bar rtags rigs 'gro jing gzhung gsar du don bdun cu rtsod/ brtsi ba 'ag dang yig cha srur rgyun byed skabs su gang babs kyi rtsa ba blor bzung thog 'grel pa tshad ldan gyi steng nas tshig gi 'bru gnyer ba/ spyi don gyi khog 'bub pa/ mtha' dpyod kyis brdar sha gcod pa/ bshad thabs lnga dang / rtses 'go lnga sogs 'chad rtsod rtsom pa lhur len pa'i thabs tshul 'khrul bral rmad du byung ba rnams kyi sgo nas mthil phyin par sbyangs te bka' pod rnam lnga'i dngos shugs zur gsum gang gi cha shas phra mo tsam yang chud zos su mi 'gro ba'i slob gzher dpyis phyin pa phyogs kyi mthar 'jam mgon bla ma'i bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su cir 'gyur bya/'dzin grwa so sor sdod yun ma mtha' gzhung gsar man la lo re/ phar phyin gnyis la gsum re/ dbu ma yan la gnyis re dgos nges yin kyang rnam dpyod bzang gras rtsod 'dzin gang cir dbyer thon pa byung na lo la ma lhos par 'dzin grwa spos chog sngags la'ang gzhung mthun smin grol tshad ldan du thob pa'i thos bsam pa dag dus bzang zur tshogs kyis sbyang brtson gang nus su —— 486 ———

byas na legs/ chos thog rnams kyi lag len 'don cha sogs sgrig yig zur gsal ltar byed/ gzhung bshad gzhan med skabs dgun dpyid dbyar gsum la lam rim dang sdom sa/sum 'chad dus 'brel gso spyong chag med dang dbyar gnas la sor mdo rgyas pa 'don/ mtshan phud dam bca' dang /dus bzang ma yin pa'i tshas mtshams rnams su mtshan mo skyor rta/ chos thog skabs dpon slob 'chad nyan la mi gnod pa'i grong chog tu bskyod rgyu las/gzhan grwa pa gcig kyang song mi tshag rgyugs 'phrod phyin chos mtshams la bla dge thun mong nas yul dang grong chog sogs la btang bas 'thus/ chos grwa yar tshogs kyi snga char shog bu mda' tshad lnga re'i rgyugs nges can du sprod len bya zhing / de lhag bzung ba rnams la legs dar gzengs bstod byed/ cho 'phrul dus mchod chen mo lha sa'i phyag len ltar dang / dga' ldan lnga mchod kyang gnad smin bya/ tshes bcu 'jigs bka' phur sgrub sogs kyi nyams len srur rgyun yi ge zur yod bzhin byed/ rtsa bzhi chang gi skyon dang / gri brdung rdo dbyus/ sogs kyis 'khon 'dzin rigs byung na sgregs nas dbyung /de min nyes tshabs che chung la gzhigs pa'i chad pa mig lar 'doms nges gcod/ nye du bud med dus mchod skabs la gnang ba zhu 'khrol gyis dgon nang du gtong tsam las 'ag sdod mi tshag rta khyi sogs nyar mi rung /dmigs bsal ma gtogs rol mo dkrol ba dang / tshong khe rigs mi chog pa ma zad/ dmigs bsal yod pa rnams nas kyang dgon par tshong mngon tshan can byed mi rung / ri rgan/ mtsher ba/ na ri/ sngo mda' man chod nas me mda' 'phen pa dang / dgon gyi mthong sar sems can gsod pa dang / bla spyi gnyer khag su yin kyang shas lug nyo tshong sogs gtan nas —— 487 —

mi chog gsang sngags chos gling sogs sgrub grwa khag nas bsnyen sgrub lag len ji ltar bya ba'i rim pa yang sprar bzhin sor gnas rgyun 'khyongs bya rgyu las/'dir dmigs bkar ma dgos pa bcas mdor na bstan pa'i yang snyeng so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims la gces spras srung sdom phyin ci ma log pa gong 'khod 'bru don gyi blang dor 'dzol med ji srid rgyal bstan rin po che nam gnas kyi bar rgyun 'khyongs su spyod par gyes/ zhes khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum ba shākya'i dge sbyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bco lnga pa'i me pho stag lo'i zla 5tshes 2 ༷dge bar nor gling bde sbyid kun dga' 'khyel pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas pris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser dam chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus nas 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

tā la'i bla ma sku phrengaXbatse gsum pas mdo smad na honaXbakra shis lung digs gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yigabod zla 5tshes 12nyin zhib 'jug song /me stag ( spyi lo 192 6 )stobs bcu'i rdul brtsegs rab dkar gangs kyi rir/ / dgag sgrub gnang ba'i nga ro cher bsgrags pas/ / mu stegs glang po'i khyu tshogs 'dar byed pa/ / shukya seng ges srid 'dir dge legs stsol/ / de la 'dir mdo smad ra hor bkra shis lung rigs gling gi ser mo ba rnams kyis nyams su blang bar bya ba'i rim pa ni ji skad du dpal mgon klu'i 'al gsung las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ / yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten legs par gsungs/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ mngon mtho nges legs kyis bsdus pa'i dpal yon ma lus par 'byung ba'i gnas gcig pur gyur pa ni/ bstan pa'i nang mdzod so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims rin po che 'di las gzhan du ma mchis shing/ bslab pa gsum gyi yongs spyong thun mong lam sbyangs mngon du ma gyur par/ ches gsang lngags kyi dngos grub rab 'bring mtha' gsum gdul bya dbang po rnam brtul gang gi dbang du byas kyang 'byung dka/'a ba — 718 9

'jam pa'i rtsa ba'i rgyud sogs drug pa rdo rje 'chang gis ji ltar lan gceg ma yin par gsungs pas na/ mdo sngags gnyis ka'i lam gyi srog gnad dam par 'khums gshis tshul khrims rnam dag g.yag rnga bzhin srog bsdos kyis srung gzhir bzung thog zas gos gnas mal spyod lam gang cir yul dus dang bsnyun pa'i khyem pa sun 'byin du 'gro ba'i rigs mi bya/ sgrub mchod/rab gnas/ dgu gtor gsum spra 'gyur rdzogs chen dgon gī lugs ltar/dbyar gnas sogs gzhi gsum las/ len 'dul 'dzin rin po che'i cho ga bzhin / cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo lha ldan dang 'dra bar byed/ zla ba phyed bgos su chos thog chos mtshams kyi srel btod pa'i chos thog gi sgrig khrims rnams 'bras spungs blo gling ltar bya/ rtsa bzhi chang gi nyes pa dang // gri mdung rdo rmas sogs la gnas dbyung byed/ de min spyon tshabs dang bsngun pa'i chad 'gel rigs kyang bo dag/'a zol 'jog tu ma song ba phra thib 'dul ba mdor bldus kyi dgongs pa phyin ci ma log par dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun zhing / bslab khrims gtsang mar ci dgar gzhol thabs dus bab ci 'os rigs pas 'byed pa las 'dir dmigs bsal yig tshogs ma dgos pa bcas ji 'khod 'bru don rnams la sgang blang 'dzol med yong ba gyis/ zhes pa 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge spyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bco lnga pa'i me pho stag lo'i zla 5tshes 2 0dge bar nor gling bde spyod kun dga' 'khyil pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bres/zhes gos ser thog bris te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser dam chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /49 ()

tā la'i bla maXsbu phreng bce gsum pas mdo smad lung dkan dga' ldan chos 'khon gling laXbastsal ba'i bca' yigame stag (sbyi lo 192 6 )bod zla 5tshes 12nyin zhib 'jug song /kun nyon g.yul ngo pham byed theg gsum chos/ /lung rtogs smra ba'i seng ge zas gtsang sras/ / gtad rabs gser ri chu dbus yon shāka sogs/ /'dul 'dzin nor bu'i phreng mdzes 'dzam gling rgyan/ /de la 'dir mdo smad lung dkar dga' ldan chos 'khor gling gi khrims su bca' ba hrung zad brjod par bya ste/ /de yang so sor thar pa'i mdo las/ mang du thos pa nags kyi nang dag rgyu/ /lang tsho yol ba rnams kyi gnas pa bde/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/mang thos tshul khrims zung 'brel du dben par gnas pa na/ 'di phyi'i tshe dbas thams cad du bde zhing bde bar 'gyur ba'i rgyu yin pas/ khas blangs pa'i dam sdom mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba gzhir bzhag thos bka' dang dgongs 'grel kyis bsdus pa'i gzhung lugs rgya mtshor thos bsam ngoms pa med par byed pa gang zhig rab tu byung ba rnams kyi las su che zhing / de la la 491 la

dkyus sa / bste na lta dī//'i ma/nga khri// ma sa/ 'ji/ bas chags/ yan lab/ da ma/kho/ ban pa/ che gshes chos thog tshas ma/tshams kyi 'a tsa len rnams/ dbus 'gyur se ra byes/ mal/ sa snyam grwa tshang gi rjes su blta/ rgyun gyi spyor sbyangs dpe khri/ da// chos grwa/ra ga/zhung gi bab / tshig gi 'brel/ don spyi gnad sob/sa sa/nga cir rtsa 'bre/la ba༅/da lngur spyi don/ mtha' dbyo/da tshad ldan gyi sa/sung zur phra mo rer yang zab gsal rigs la/ma (re bum/ phra/ga si/sa brdar sha/ tshad nga 'i blo/ba sa/snyed 'ol spyo tsam/ du ma so nga ba byed/ tshogs chem pas sdom la/sum ngang 'a/ma rim sbyang brtsom tsa/sha' mar 'bungs// 4//sang 'dus dang / bang/ ma/chos 'jis/sa/ byed kun ze)sa/ mi/ 'a//khrus/ pa bcas pa kye spru baXmatshad sa/'i ga/su/che// /lnga ma/chod bzang spyod sog/sa kyang lo ltar nyams/ mi/da rgyun 'a/spyongs/ ga/tsa/sa dang 'ag/ma mthun che chung gi tshar gcod rjes sgyur dzin/ gang 'os skabs sbyar spyi lngar phyogs ldung zol 'jog tu ma/ gyur ba'i zhib cha thon nges mig lar phan pa byed/grong chog tu'ang 'a1sa sbos btang na ma sa/tos//sa rang mtshams mi cheg/ dus mchod sogs da/migs bsal skabs dgongs pa zhu 'khrol byung na las rgyu/ na par bud med dgon nang du gtong 'grul dang 'ag sdod gtan nas mi rung /spyi gnyer sogs dmigs bsal du ma gtogs pa dag gis tshong khe bed mi tshas/ pa bcas gong 'khod 'bru don rnams la blang dor 'jug ldog phra 'ib tshul bzhin du spyod pa gyis/ zhes tshangs par spyod pa'i khrims su bca' ba 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shukya'i dge spyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rdam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bco lnga pa'i me pho stag lo'i zla 5tshes 2 0dge bar nor gling bde skyed kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bres/ zhes — — 492 —— —
ldu/ru

tā la'iXbla ma skuXphreng bzuXgasum pas hon yul dunaXbade wang gi bkraXshis rjogs ldan dge rgyas gling du bstsal ba'i bca' yig zla ba gzhon nu'i 'dzum rlabasaXzhes dra/ ba zab(1bkab thod/me stag (spyi lo 192 6 )bod zla 5tshes 12nyin zhib 'jug song /stobs bcu'i snang ba rab 'bar rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dag gsal gnyen po'i phyogs gyur chags bral chos/ /rig grol bden mthong 'phags pa'i dge 'dun te/ / skyabs gsum bsam 'phel nor bus shis pa stsol/ / thub pa'i chos tshul mthar thug lung rtogs bstan/ /bshad sgrub thos bsam sgom pas 'dzin spel dag phan bde'i rba rlabs 'bum phrag spro ba'i gnyen/ /dge 'dun chu gter rnam par rgyas gyur cig /rdo rje 'chang gi spyan sngar bstan pa dang / /de 'dzin skyong ba zhal bzhes srung ma'i dpung / /sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon gang bas/ /tha tshig gnyan po'i las la ma g.yel zhig / de la la 494 la

'dir sor yu/la dar bde tā wang shog si/sa dgon bkra 'is rdzogs ldan dge rgyas lha 'ang gling gi dge 'dun pa rnams kyi lag len khrims chags su spe ma ba la bzhi/ sde 'dir 'jug pa po'i rten/ gyi gang zag de ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul/ zhus/sa nas blang dor bya ba'i rim pa nyams su blangs pa'i 'bras bu'o/dang po ni/ gsar zhugs yim na 'dul ba nas dgad nga/'i bar chad 'i bral dang / dgon gzhan nas phas pham ba'i ra mthong thos dwos/sa gsum gyis gnas dbyung byas pa sogs ma yin pa dgos// gnyis pa ni las sner snyan/ gsan 'bebs tshul / mjal kha zhu lugs tshig snga phyi sprub stangs sogs gang cir bkra shis phan/ gling deb yig gi rjes su 'brang // gsum pa ni/ khas blangs pa'i 'dul khrims rnam par dag pas ga'i ra bzung thog dgon gyi 'don cha/ skyabs 'gro/ las 'bras/ stobs bzhi/ blo spyong / sdom gsum sogs kyi gzhung che chung gang 'os la blo dang 'tsham pa'i 'dzin skyor thos bsam bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su smin nges byed/ sdom pa thob dus phra zhib grib tshod kyis brtags pa'i dgongs don ltar rgan gzhon bsten bkur gyi gnas ma log pa'i rtsi 'jog skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan du 'gro ba bya/ yul dus kyi rung mthun spyor 'os phu rung sogs gyon dgos byung yang khyim pa dang khyad 'byed pa gnad gal che zhi/nga dmigs bsal du ma gtogs pa rnams kyis ther gzan sogs mi gyon/ gzhan gos kyi gzhi dang gang mthun byed pa las yi gar mi 'ongs pa'i cha lugs ya ma zung khyim pa sun 'byin du 'gro ba'i rigs mi chog phyogs bskyod sogs dgongs zhu'i rigs so so'i chos kyi slob dpon/ grwa tshang dge skos/ mkhan po/ tshogs chen dge skos/bla ma khri pa rnams la skabs sbyar gyis zhu 'ing / thams cad la zhu dgos zhig 495 —

/re ma/ ldang du bo/nga 'khod 'phru/ dom/ los nga ra sprub pa dang tshub ba'i na dri byed nga1 rmam1ngo—/ —ba—/ tsam ma gsum 1 li'i bsgo mo seng she/'i sa/dong cam sos/sa bstan srung dam can rgya ra/jo'i nga/ma/po// tshogs pa dang bar snang gi phyo/ na gang ba rnams kyis tshar gcod rjes /'dzin spru 'dzin la sa zu༄ thong nga'i chos /rwa myong 'gyur du grub par brog na mi za bas rda/ sa tu dran rkes bas/ yod brten par 'chal 1/ba'i rnga/ 'am ra sngu/ bla/ngas/ nga/'i 'a bras bu ni 'jam ma bom bla zu//sa / tsams/ zo bas nga zang/ bu /lha mi dang 1 mtha/ra thus 'a pa bras bu byang chub bsu/ma 'pheb ra/ra 'gyur rmeng/ gsungs/ rnga/ 'i phyir// brtso na lda na rjam ra kyi/ sa so/ sor thar/ rta/ ba/ tu sdus rngo༄ sa 'bad rdo srung zu/sa gsungs rte ra ro// zhes4 chos5 khrim/sa/ bzang pong 'am zas pab tshu05 zla ba tsa//lo/na nu'i 'dzum/ rla/bas che/sa bgyi ba /'di yang pad da/tsa//ra 'chang ba'i rmye phreng bcu sa/su ma pa shākya'i dge// spyong ngas/ dbang blo bzang thub bste/na rga ma che 'jis/sa bral dbang phyug phyogs las rjam par rgyal ba'i sdes ra pa ba byung brtsa lnga pa'i me pho stas/ tsha /'i zla 5tshes 2 0dge bar nor gleng bde spyi da kun dga' 'khyil pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas dris/ zhes rgo/sa ser thog bres te bong/ ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser dam chen mo bstsa/la rgyu zhus na /'thus ci na sbam/ da / / / /

twa la'i blaXm snyu phrengaXbazuXgasum pas mdoXsmad dgon gsan bkra shis dga' ldan chos 'phel gling la bstsal ba'i bca' yigame stag ( spyi lo 192 6 )bod zla 5tshes 1 2nyin 'ib 'jug so/nga / che mchog shākya'i rigs 'khrungs sa gsum na/ /ngo mtshar stobs bcu'i dpal mnga' lha yi lha/ / pad da7/ra ltar bsrugs rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras/ / don kun grub pas sa/tan bde'i mchog sbyin mdzod/ / de la 'dir mdo smad dgon gsar bkra shis dga' ldan chos 'phel gling gi 'dus sde'i sgreg khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa ni/ yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi ma khas blangs pa'i dam sdom mig 'bras bzhin srung ba mngon mtho dang / nges legs kyi go 'phang bde blag tu bskrun pa'i rtsa lag ru gyur pas na/ dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bcas mtshams phra rags kyi tshul 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i gzhung 'grel mtha' dag la zhib bar ma sbyangs na blos rnam par dpyod pa'i mig ldongs sar 'gyur bas des na thabs mkhas mdor bsdus kyi dang bzhin yul dus dang bstun pa'i dge 'dun gyi nang khrims pad+ma'i sbubs ltar gtsang la 498 —

ba dang / gser gyi gnya' shing ltar bkur bar 'os la/ de yang dang por thos pa rgya cher ma btsal na bar du thar pa'i lam gyi bgrod tshul la rang byan chun dka' bas mchod rgyun gyi rten gzhir de sru gnam bskos gzhung sa nas sa zhing cha rkyen du sbyar ba dang 'brel mtshungs sbyin bdag khag gi dad rdzas bu lon lta bur longs spyod par mi 'gyur ba'i lag len spong ba thos bsam dang klog pa nyams len gyi bshad sgrub 'bad brtson bya ba las kyi 'khor lor nyin mtshan kun tu tshul gnas kyis dus 'da' ba las yal yol btang snyoms kyi rigs mi mdzad/ re zhig 'dris khyad kyis brag dkar sprul sbu'i yi ger brtsi ga 'ag byas na 'thus/ chos thob dang chos mtshams kyi bya ba rnams mos mthun yi ge zur yod ltar byed/ ma ṇi ril sprub/ 'jigs kun sprub mchod/ dbyar gnas/ lnga mchod dgu gtor/ dus 'brel gso spyong sogs sngar yod dge rgyun mi nyams gong 'phel nyams nga/ sor chud sogs dngos gtsang 'khrul pa dang bral bas rgyal bstan spyi sger gyi 'bas 'degs gang 'grub bya/ sgrigs la 'jug pa po'i rten dang / de ji ltar 'jug tshul/ sgregs 'gal kyi nyes chad gtong lugs sogs 'dul dgongs yul bab dgon sde tshad ldan dag na nyams su bstar ba rgyal bstan dag ther gyis mig rgyan du 'gyur nges pa las/'dir dmigs kyis gsal ba'i tshig tshogs ma dgos pa bcas 'bru don blang dor 'dzol med tshul bzhin du 'bad par rigs so/ ces nyams len gsal bar 'doms pa'i yi ge 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge spyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bco lnga pa me pho stag lo'i zla 5tshes 2 0dge bar nor gling bed skyid kun dga' 'khyel pa'i — — 499 la
ru5

tī la'i bla ma skra preng bzu gsum pas byang phyogs hon yul gh+ri dgon gsan bshad sgrub dge tshogs sping la bstsal ba'i bca' migame stag ( spyi lo 192 6 )bod zla 5tshes 2 2nyin jib 'jug song /pad dkar ltar bsngags lung rtogs/ nor bu'i ma/dzod/ / tsa/sung skyes 'dul 'dzin/ mtshar spug gser ri'i phreng / / snyis/sa dus smra ba'i khyu mtshab/ blo bzang grags/ /slob mar bcas pas 'gro 'di shis pa stso(ma/ /de yang byang phyogs hor yul gyi dgon gsar bsha/da sgrub dge tshog/sa gling gi 'dus pa rnams la khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa hrung zad sper bar bya ste/ lung sde ba'i 'i brjod don mtha' dag bsdus na/ sdom pa ma thob par byed pa/ thob pa mi nyams par srung ba// nyams na phyir ba/cos pa'i thabs gsum du 'du ba de dag las/ len du bstar ba la sgregs su (mjug pa po'i rten gyi gang zag sor sdo ma skye gnas khyad 'gyur gī bar chad dang mi lnga na pa dgos shing / mdzes pa'i bar chad yul dus spyir btang dmigs bsa'/ du zhib mor phye bas 'thus/dgon sa/zhan nas 'ongs pa yin na yang sdom pa'i gtong rgyu ma phog nga//da( )1

gnas dbyung ma byas pa/ dbyung bar 'os pa'i 'thab dkrol can dang /lta grub mi gtsang ba sogs ma yin pa dgos/ bslab pa'i go rim ma 'chol ba'i rgan gzhon rtsi 'jog 'dul bstan rin po che'i mdzes rgyan du 'gyur nges bya/ zas gos gnas mal rnams kyang mi rung tshad lhag bzang ngan pyon tshul sogs gang cir 'dod zhen ma dad nyes dmigs kyi phyogs su gyur pa ma lags pa'i gzhung mthun bag yod dang 'brel bar spyad pas dus mthar ston pa mchog gi bzhed dgongs ci 'grub byed/ gzhi gsum nyams len spyi dang /khyad par dus 'brel gyi gso spyong dngos gtsang chag med bya/ dge tshul slong gi bslab bya gnam rtse ldeng ma gnyis dang / thub bstan byi dor sogs so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa'i gzhung che chung / lam rim blo spyong sogs la thos bsam sgom pa ya ma bral bas 'di phyi'i bde 'bras don ldan du byed/bla ma dge bskos dbus mdzad mdzod gnyer sogs las kyi sne mo ba'i rigs skabs su babs pa'i yon tan dang ldan zhing / spyi sems lhag bsam drang tshugs che nges bsko gzhag byed pa las/ phyogs lhung ngo dga' zol 'jog gi rigs mi chog tshogs 'tshogs stangs/ 'don pa 'don lugs/ rgyun gyi sgrig lam kun spyod sogs yul dus kyi dmigs bsal re zung ma gtogs sgo mang grwa tshang ltar yin/ mang bskol 'gyed gtong mchod mjal sogs kyi skabs gnang ba zhu khrol byung na las bud med dgon nang du 'grul bskyod mi rung zhing zhag sdod nam yang mi bya/ gling gseb tu rta bzhon mtshon 'dogs/ku co rgyang 'bod sogs spyod lam mi mdzes pa'i rigs mtha' dag gtan nas mi chog rtsa bzhi chang gi nyes ltung byung na zhu brgyud med par gnas nas dbyung / las sner kha lan lag lan slog pa/ mi dpung dgra sdebs bgyis — 502 —

pa/ 'khon 'dzings rgyu shed byas pa sogs la 'gal tshabs che chung la gzhigs pa'i nyes chad mig lar 'doms nges gcod/ de ltar 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i dgongs zab yang snying du bsdus pa'i 'bru don la blang dor 'dzol med tshul bzhin yong ba gyis/ zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge nor bu'i do shal zhes bya ba 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge sbyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bco lnga pa'i me pho stag lo'i zla 5tshes 20dge bar nor gling bde skyed kun dga' 'khyil pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bres/zhes gos ser thog bris te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser tham chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

twa la'i blaXm sbuXphreng bzu gsum pas b.raXkhams hon yeXtha bon g.yung drung nabaXbartan glingaXlaXbastsal ba'i bca' yigaXpad dkan chun preng zhes byaXbaXbazhugs so/ me stag ( spyi lo 192 6 )bod zla 5tshes 24nyin zhib 'jug song / rmad byung kun bzang g.yung drung rtag pa'i skur/ / mngon bzhengs sgyu 'phrul rnam 'gyur 'bum brdal te/ / zab dang rgya ches lus can smin grol mdzad/ / gshen rab mi bo che 'dir bsngags par 'os/ / de yang mnga' ris 'ol mo lung ring du srid bzung ba bon gyi ston pa gshen rab rjes 'brang dang bcas pas bsil ljongs kong po 'on/ rtsed thang sogs su g.yung drung bon gyi bstan pa rgya cher spel zhing bshad sgrub kyi sde mang du spel ba las/ser smad khongs gtogs hor tsho stod shog ye tha khul hor spyi tshe ring dbang rgyal ye tha be ru brgya spyin dbang po/ sba bla ma nam bzang gsum mchod yon du 'brel te kong dgon g.yung drung gling gi dgon lag g.yung drung rab brtan —— 504 ——

gling zhes 'bod pa gsar bskrun bgyis pa nas rus rgyud kyi gdan rabs zla rgyal bzang po'i bar hor spyi dang / ye tha'i shog dpon rim pa dad dam btsan po'i mthu zung du 'brel bas legs par bskyangs 'ing / khyad par spa bla ma nyi ma 'bum gsal gyi ring bde chen gling pa'i gter lung las/ ma 'ongs snyegs ma lnga bdo'i dus ཿmtha' yi dmag dpung bzlog pa'i slad ཿ sa gnad drag po bco brgyad la ཿ gu ru'i zab gter 'brel byed pa ཿzhes sogs gsal bar lung gi zin pa'i sa gnad gras/ ar lung yar gyi sa mdor lung mthun bon dgon bslab khrims mtha' gtsang zhig byung na bstan 'gro spyi sger yongs la sman sa/shis sde 'dir 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis lag len du bstar bar bya ba'i rim ba ni lo tshigs dang bsnyun so so thar pa rigs brgyad kyi sdom pa gang 'os sgod de ji ltar khas blangs pa'i rang rang gi bca' khroms phra rags mig 'bras ltar bsrung bar bya zhing / bslab pa yongs spyong gi ga'i gsum gyi nyams len gang ci 'dul ba dang mthun nges ngos gtsang nan tan byed/ byang sems dang / gsang sprags kyi dam tshig/ kyang nyes lhung gi dri mas ma gos pa rnam par dag pa ga'i bzung thog hor zla dang po'i tshes ba/cig nas brgyad bar mdo g.yung drung klong rgyas kyi cho ga dang 'brel bar sher rgyal dus mchod mchod spyin stong rtsa long nges/ ngan song dong sprug gi bum sgrub nyin/ mtshan khor yu/ga ma bhan 'ag dgu/ hor zla gnyis par khro bo ga bo mchog gi bskang mdos chen mo nyin bcu/ hor zla gsum par rig 'dzin gsang ba'i sgrub chen snyen mtshan khor yu/ga ma zhag bcu drug gar 'cham dang 'brel ba/ hor zla lnga/ par phyi rgyud rnam par rgyal ba'i tsha ga nyin bcu//hor zla drug par dbyar gnas dang 'brel bar ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs 5()5 —

grangs gsog nyin brgyad/ hor zla bdun par zhi khro dam pa rang grol gyi sgo nas nyin re stong mchod 'gro nges kyi cho ga nyin bco lnga hor zla brgyad par bzlas chog rin chen sgrol ma'i bum sgrub chen mo nyin mtshan khor yug ma gar 'cham dang 'brel ba nyin bcu hor zla bcu gcig par gdugs dkad gtor bzlog nyin drug hor zla bcu gnyis par khro phur dgu gtor chen mo nyin bcu gceg hor zla dang po nas dgu pa'i bar nyin re bzhin mang ja brgyad dang gung tshigs gcig chag med kyis tshe sgrub/ sdom gsum smon lam/bsam pa lhun grub/ bar chad lam sel/ du tri pu/ mdo bzlog bsngo smon bcas rgyun 'don dngos gtsang thog rtsa bzhi dang 'gal ba'i rigs rnams lus longs spyod kyi nyes chad dang 'brel sgregs nas dbyung / de man 'gal tshabs che chung la ga'i gas pa'i lus thog dang / rgyu dngos kyi chad nga/ phyogs ldung zol 'jog tu ma song 'ing / sngar 'gyod phyis sdom la gnas nges bya dgos sogs sgrig lam bca' yig don 'brel la mdo smad thi drag spyi khyab dang / hor spyi rim pa nas sa rigs 'byed gtan/ grwa rgyun bdag thob/dkor za dge khongs/ grwa no/da rang khungs rtswa za/ mchod rgyun la khral rigs sgrub chag 'jags gsum gang ci da lta phan gnas bzhin ci yin ltar la bsgyur bkod mi chog cing / lhag par dgon 'di bzhin bon dgon gzhan lung dkar sogs las bca' khrims gtsang ldan yod/ phyin slad kyang nyams pa sor chud/ mi nyams gong 'phel rnam dbye thon pa'i thabs tshul gzengs bstod ngos/ da lta'i bla ma g.yung drung 'brug grags sogs rus rgyud bla rabs rim par rnying khungs dus kyi go ming ci yod sor gnas thog grwa rgan gzhon tshang mas rang lugs kyi thos bsam sgom gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pa —— 506 —

gong /thal yong ba snyeng dbus su bcangs te mjos/ dman tshang mas sprang blang 'dzo/ra meb rtsa 'dzin rgyun /'a/byongs tshu/1/ bzhim/ spyod nga/ kyis// zhes blang dor khri/ mas su bca' ba'i yi ge pad dkar chun phreng 'di yang nub phyogs sa steng gi rgya'/ bstan yongs kyi bdag/ gror lung 1mas kyi dbang bskur ba pad dal//ra 'chang ba'i skye phreng bahru sa/sum pa shākya'i dge/ spyong ngas// dbang blo bzang thub bstam rgya mtsho 'jis/sa bral dbang phyus/ phyos/sa las/ rnam nga/ra rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bco lnga pa me pho stas// lo'i zla 1 2tshes 2 1dge bar nor gling bde skyid kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bzo/la bzang pho brang nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser dam chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan (1/ / / //

kong po chos rtse sprul sku thub bstanaXmakhas btsun bltan 'dzin lung digs kyi zhu ba/me pos/ ( spyo lo 19 27 )bod zla 5tshes 2 1nyin zhib 'jug so/nga /kong ngo tshas rtse sprul sku thub bstan mkhas btsum/ bstan 'dzin lung rig/sa /ma 'dri rtsad zhib man gyi zhu ba gus pa shing bye lo rtse gzim /'gag brgyud/ lo gsum ring gzhis dgon du bsad 'thus dgongs pa zhus 'khrol gyi gzhis dbo/na tshas rtser sdod mur lnga lo me ltag zla ba 8nang dpal ri ri smo/ra du ba spyod skabs gzhung rgyugs brag phyi gnas po'i bu mo g.yang can sgrol dkar zer ba 'das gor bgegs dbang gdon spyod kyi bab log byung gshis ri bong rdo brdzus su sdod nus bral ba'i grwa sa'i sgrigs 'then gī 2snyan 'bul zhu dgos byung ba'i 'gal 'dzol la bka' nyes thugs rje gang che'i thog slad sngar 'gyod phyis 'doms zhus chog par lha dgongs gsal dwangs thugs rje che ba zhu rgyur hrer bsas med zhu'i rtags/ / / /608

bo/nga po chos rtse sprul sbu bslab spyon byung ban gzhis dgon dang bla brang la the byus tshul min rigs mi zhu ba'i gan rgyaX/ba/ ga 'brel dge/me yos/ ( spyi lo 19phyo7 )bod zla 6tshes 77nyin la/lugs gnyis 2gong ma bye/ ma bdag rin po che'i 'bas drung du/zhu ba/ ming rtags gsham gsal rnams nas blos blangs 'gyur med/ kyi gan rgya gtsang 'bul zhu snying / don rtsa kong po chos rtse sprul sbu thub bstan mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin lung rigs shing byi lo rtse gzim 'gag brgyud lo gsum ring gzhi/sa dgon du chos spyod 'dzin skyong spel gsum du dgon nas yong dgos nan brjod zhu ba ltar dngos 'brel yin shag gis dgongs pa zhus 'khrol bkrin bla med du che ba snying bcangs kyi bka' dgongs 'gal med tshul mthun zhu dgos de ltar yang gzhis dgon du bskyod rjes gong ma'i rnam thar 'dzin skyong rgyab bskyur gyi dpal ri ri skor skabs bslab sdom nyams skyon byung nges la ri rbang rdo brdzus su sdod blos bral bas grwa sa'i sgrigs 'then zhu dgos byung ba 'di dag chos rtse sprul sku gong ma'i skye srid la brten pas gzhis dgon dang / chos sde chen po se ra theg chen gling du sgrigs bzhugs kyi sprul sku'i la 509 —la

ming bzos dang 'brel las blangs dam sdom mis 'bras bzhin srung te bsam pa'i mig/ rgyam du /shā—gyur ba 'ig nges nga ra dbo/sa tsa/nas de dab meng/ pas /'a'u/ phyi'i bde 'bras dang / bstan lar ma bsam pa'i chos sde'i 'bas 'drem/ gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren/ chen ngo/ mtshag gi sku tshar gyur pas mtshan shas yo/nga ba/'i sogs la bsam shes bral bas bslab sdom nyam sa skyo na song rkyen ba'i sa dbo/na du sgri/ga khrom/sa tshul sams med pa'i bas/ med rang snang ga/nga dran gyi spyo/da ngan sdom shor gyur pa'i 'as/'a/ (mdzol ci cher sa/'ibs tshe do bdag dang mdzod pa /las byed/ bud med g.ya nga can sgro la da/ra 'das mo'i khyi‘ma tshang bras phyi gnas po bcas par rtsa zhib mthar 'ded kyi ba/'a nyes ji bstsal sdis/ bsas/sa rang 'khur zhu rgyu 'a/sa ma 'das kyang bla dngo/na thub/sa rje'i bdag/ nyi/ da chen po mas byams yangs gang che'i bka/'a dpyad spyi phebs/ dgongs don khungs/ so so'i bka' nyes 'bab rkyang sgrub 'bul zhus zin pa bcas slad sprul sbu'i go ming phyir 'then gyi da phyin spyod ngan lang shor las ma 'das stabs sngar byas la 'gyod bshags dang / phyis 'doms mtha' 'khyol gyi bla brang dang / gzhis dgon du je byus tshul min byed mang sne btags tsam mi chog par tshul mthun 'gro bzo sdod mkhas dgos rgyu dmag spyi dza sag brum pa ba nas spun la'i bkod 'doms rang don rang gces zhu rgyu zhus pa 'di don las nam yang mi 'gal thing / 'gal char 'dre rigs sne btags tsam byas gleng shar tshe khrims zhabs rin po cher 'ba' gser srang bcu tham pa gtsang sgrub thog bka' nyes ji bstsal sdig bsags rang 'khur zhu zhus do bdag thub bstan mkhas btsun bstan 'dzin lung rigs kyi rtags/ khag theg 'gan len dmag spyi ga sag brum pa ba'i rtags/ / / /—— 510 la

bong po tshos rtse sal sa thab bsam mkhas btsam bsam / /za sna kyang /nya / / da / mnya /'jin lung digs sogs la chad gcod kyi 'chan gzhi snyan zhu/meXyos/ ( spyi lo 8 1927 )bod zla 5tshes 2 1nyin zhib 'jus/ so nga shā/me yos/ chos rtse bla brang mdzod pa las byed nas phul snyan dang //tshas rtse sprul sku thub bstan mkhan btsun bstan 'dzin lung rigs kyi zhu ba rtags 'byar zur 'bul zhus gsal/ shing bye lo rtse gzim 'gag brgyud lo gsum ring gzhis dgon du chos spyod 'dzin spyong spel sa/sum du dgo/na nas yong dgos nan brjod bzhin bskyod 'thus zhu ba ltar dngos 'brel yin shag gis dgongs pa zhu 'gro/ la bkrin bla med du che rung / gzhis dgon du bskyod rjes gong ma'i rnam thar 'dzin skyong rgyab bskyur dpal ri ri skor skabs bslab sdom nyams skyon byung nges la ri bong rdo brdzus su sdod blos bral bas grwa sa'i sgrigs 'then zhu dgos byung lugs zhu skor chos rtse sprul sku gong ma'i skye srid la brten pas gzhis dgon dang / chos sde chen po se ra theg chen gling du sgrigs zhugs kyi sprul sku'i ming bzos dang 'brel gshis khas blangs dam sdom mig 'bras bzhin srung te bstan pa'i mig rgyan du 'gyur ba zhig nges par dgos — — 511 la

tsa/nad/ du mchis kyang / 'di phyi'i bde 'bras dang / bstan par ma bsam pa'i tshas sde'i (nabs /'dren dang bos kyi tsha rigs 'a brten pa'i ming ma/sa bslab sdom nyams skyon yong rkyen 'di da/ga gzhis dgon du sgrig khrims tshul san/sa med pa'i bag med rang snang gang dran gyi spyod ngan sdom shor byung sa/shis bud med dang bcas mas le thogs 'ag/la 'dzol che bar gzhigs tshe sprul ming mdzod pa las byeng/ nga/nga bud ped sa/yang can sgrol dkar 'ad/sa mo'i khyim tshang brag phyi sa//nas po bcas par rtsa 'i/ba mthar 'ded kyi nyes pa slad 'doms gcod 'os las ma 'das kyang / bgegs dbang ldos/ med byung dbang la bsam da lam ring yangs bzos gang ches sprul ming thub bstan mkhas btsun/ bstan 'dzin lung rigs la nyes nga gser srang 1 2 15 1shadang /chos rtse bla brang gi mdzod pa las byed nas kyang lcags dmar skam chun spyod ngan 'di rigs mi 'byung ba'i dge skyon zhib brtag gi do dam chung skyon la nyes pa bab lce thob rung / da lam ring spyir dran rten nyes pa gser srang / 5 79 bud med g.yang can sgrol dkar 'das mo'i khyem tshang brag spyi gnas por gleng sel nyes pa gser srang / 2 2 4 bcas bstsal te slad sprul sku'i go ming phyir 'then gyis da phyin spyod ngan lang shor las ma 'das stabs sngar byas la 'gyod bshags dang / phyis 'doms mtha' 'khyol gyi bla brang dang gzhes dgon du the byus tshul min byed mang sne btags tsam mi chog par tshul mthun 'gro bzo sdod mkhas dgos rgyu dmag spyi brum pa ba nas spun la'i bkod 'doms rang don rang gces kyi rtse yig tshang las khungs su gan rgya khag 'brel 'jog 'bul dgos rgyu'i 2snyan zhur srid tham 'go mchan bstsal te 'khrun gcod bkod khyab zhu rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /—la 512 la

twa la'i bla ma sbu preng bzu gsum pas rnam nab mthongaXsmon/ dwags po grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rnams la bstsal ba'i bca' yis/saX'adrug (spyi lo 1928 ) bod zla 5tshes 29nyin 'i/ba 'jug so/nga /oṃ su ste/ kun gzigs smra ba'i nyi ma zas gtsang sras/ /kun rbongs gdung ba zhi mdzad dam pa'i chos/ /kun phan bslab gsum rgyan mdzes rigs grol sde/ /kun nas dang ba'i yid kyis lan brgyar bsngags/ /lnga rig nor bu'i 'od non 'bar ba'i gzis/ /gangs can 'dzin ma'i khongs nas lham me ba/ /'jig rten mig gyur rngog lo zhu dbon zhes/ /snyan pa'i ba dan srid zhi'i bla na g.yo/ / ngo mtshar dpag yas phan bde sbrang rtsi'i mdzod/ / 'dul khrims puṇ+ḍa ri ka 'dir 'byed kyi/ / 'jigs mdzad dmar gsum bse yi khrab can sogs/ / lha dang srung mas bya ra ma g.yel cig / de yang gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba rong ston shākya rgyal mtshan pa'i srol skyong bkris rnam rgyal sogs dam pa du ma'i gdan sa rnam dab mthong smon dwags po grwa tshang gi dge 'dun rnams kyi blang dor khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa la thog mar sde — 51 rte

'dir 'jug/ pa po'i rten la khang tshan dge rgam so/ sos legs nga/ra bzags te rung bar nges pa ma/ mal/ na/ por bzhus//sa rten la/ btags dang / dngu(ma zho gsum/ bzang ja spor brgyad mar lo/ med spyi nyag bcu drug dbu chos la sne ga 'ag/ dngul skar lnga re/ gter par shing rin dngul zho gsum (dbul jing slar bstan bshig sgrig 'as/la mi byed pa'i gan rgya khas/ 'bre' mtha' btsan len/ dbe/ tshul slong gi sdom pa ma blangs par zla gsum lhag bsdad mi tshas/ bstan pa'i sa//'i rtsa zla ba mar ngo mar ngo'i dus 'brel gyi sa/so sbyong ma chag par bya la dbyar dgag gnyis kyang gdan sa chen po'i srol bzhin sa/zhung mthun byed/ lo ga/sbug/ ring gsang phu dbyar chos rbe ba'i chos thob/ dgu la ga/zhung chen gī rtsod sgra/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ ma ṇi ril sgrub//bka' 'gyur dag sgrog sgrol bstod 'bum ther/ srung ma'i gtor sgrub/zor 'phen/ cho 'phrul smon lam dang 'brel ba'i bco lnga mchod pa bcas kyi dus mchod rigs sngar lam nyams lad med pa dus thog so sor phyag len ma 'chug pa smin tshugs 'bad cing / gzhi gsum phyag len gyi skabs su gaṇ+ḍi'i brda dang bstun te mnyam par tshogs pa las snga shor phyi lus mi rung / gal srid de 'dra byung tshe dge bskos nas sdod tshod ma byas bar phyag 'tshal du 'jugaslob gral ston gral gnyis kyi srol ji ltar 'os par/ bka' rams pa rnams ming btags dang / bsdus ra pa rnams 'dzin grwa rgan rim gyis sdod pa las rkang pa su mgyogs mi byed par mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bur spyod lam zhi dul bag yod kyi ngang nas 'du/ gding ba med par tshogs gdan la longs mi spyod/ ngar snabs mchil ma kha lud sogs gtsang khang du 'dor ba nyes dmigs shin tu che bas nam yang mi bya/ lhag par 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang la 514 ———

'gal zhing / khyim pa sun 'byin gyi cha lugs chas gos ya ma zung gyon bcangs mi chog rnam kun lcags ri g.yas g.yon rdo gcal sogs su gzan sham med pa dang / ku co'i sgra/ phan tshun dbyen dkrug sogs kyi rtsing spyod gtan nas mi chog dbon chos mdzad sogs gtong ba la ja thug bdun/slob dpon la dgu tshan dod/ dbu chos la 'gro khungs sne gzhag spyi 'bul dngul srang sum hru skor dang 'gyed dngul tsha grwa gang rigs dgos/ lag bde grwal 'go go mtshungs shig tu 'jog chos grwa'i gaṇ+ḍi brdung 'phral bla grwa mnyam tshogs kyis lo bstod/ bla brgyud gsol 'debs rnams 'don/slob dpon pas rong bkras gnyis kyi yig cha'i thog bka' rams pa nas bsdus chung bar 'dzin chos ci nus su gtong / gzhung pa dang bsdus ra bas rtsod pa rgyun 'khyongs byed/ gung chos la brgyad stong dang / gser 'od pod re 'gro nges bklags/ dgong char sgrol 'don 'di bstan 'gro spyi sger gyi gegs bar zhi byed du gnad che bas skyabs sems/ sgrol bstod nyi shu rtsa gcig mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar/ lo bstod/ sa skya gong ma lnga'i bstod pa/ ngos ring 'tsho'i smon chig bkras rnam pa sogs de ga'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs/ srung ma'i bstod 'phrin sher snying / tshe gzungs bcas 'gro che tshang mas theg pa 'khur blang gis 'ur 'don dgo/sa rgyu las khral mngon sla chos rigs mi chog slob gnyer la 'jug tshul yang kha dog dkar dmar nas yas rim ma 'chol bar bya/ bsdus chen nas mkhan pos bsdus grwa dang chos spyod yong tshad brtags te su yong gzhung rgyug tu bskyur bcug pa'i gling bsre bka' bcu'i ming btags ster/ bka' rams grwal ston dang tshogs gsog pa sngar rgyun nyams med byed/ klog 'don chos gyod kun rig —— 515 ——

cho ga'i rgyugs sprod rigs spos ring tshad kyis len/ rgyugs ma sprad bar kun rig cho ga chos 'don bzhi sde bcas la rgyugs sprad pas ma 'dang na ma gtogs sger 'bod zhu gtong gang yang mi chog chos 'don bzhi sde dge bskos nas shag bskor gyis gtong / grong chog sogs dge bskos med skabs de ga'i rgan pa tshab byas nas gung gseng log tshod snga phyi 'gro sdod sogs la yon bdag mi cho sa pa'i rigs mi byed/ phogs 'gyed tsha grwa sogs slob dpon la gsum skal/ dbu chos/ smon lam dam bca'/ ja ma gsum la nyis skal/dung khen tsha grwa gcig nyis skal bla brang skyogs tshad brgyad/ spyi gnyer skyogs tshad lnga re/ las sne gtong gzhi 'dzin mi ma gtogs khe tshong bun bskyed rta bong sogs bsten gso mi rung / dgon nang du bud med zhag sdod lta ci tho khongs tshun yong mi chog/ skya bo yang dgongs pa zhu ster gyi 'gro dgos/rtsa bzhi chang gi nyes skyon byung tshe nongs pa ngos len/ la gnas dbyung dang 'brel nyes chad dang / gsar ja chos tshab 'phral 'dzugs bcas sprar lam ltar bya/gri mtshon rdo rgyug sogs kyis rma kha khrag shor sogs la brkyang phyag rgyab lang tsho 'dzin byed mir gser zho/ sho sbag rtsed 'jo'i bag g.yeng byed mi rnams 'phral 'phral bcun thog basbum phyag khri tshar 'gel/ ba/tsang khang steng shod bar gsum/ lha khang le lag mgon khang khag grwa shag rdo gcal shar nub bcas la gtsang sbra gang che'i 'dzin spras le shor med ba dgos/ da phan 'dzin/ zhing bdag pa'i 'byed gsal chos thebs 'dzin dbang gis mtshon phyi nang sprod rigs che phra mtha' dag la slob dpon las sne 'phos mtshams so sor deb gzhi rtsa 'dzin gyis rtsis sprod len tshul ba'i na dgos rgyu ma zad/ jib pa sa sprul sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos gnang ba'i bca' yig dang / shing stag ——— 516 —

mthun grub bca' yig la pho lha ba'i 'go mchan gyis zur brgyan te legs spel nyes bsub bsregs bcad brdar gsum gyis bstan 'gro'i phan bde lam du lhongs pa bcas chos srid blang dor 'dzol med yong ba gyis/ zhes pa 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge spyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drug ba'i sa 'brug zla 1 1tshes 15dge bar nor gling bde skyid kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser tham chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

tā la'i bla ma sku phrengaXbazuXgasum pas mdo khams lhaXrtse byamasaXpaXgling dgon du bstsal ba'i bca' khrims/sa 'drug (spyi lo 192shā )bod zla 10tshes 1ka chad pa'i 19nyin zhib 'jug song /mi 'jigs zab rgyas nga ro cher bsgrags pas/ /mu stegs stobs ldan gnyis 'thung rgan po'i khyu/ /skrag mdzad smra ba'i seng ge thams cad mkhyen/ /go tam lha yi lha la gus phyag 'tshal/ / bde gshegs gsung rab kun gyi snyeng po'i phul/ / rnam dag tshul khrims gser gyi bye ma can/ / yan lag brgyad ldan 'dul ba'i gang gā ma/ / mkha' khyab skye dgu'i gdung sel mchog der bsngags/ /so sor thar pa'i bde lam yangs po nas/ /zhi ba bdud rtsi'i grong khyer 'jug 'dod pa/ /skal bzang dad brtson rig pa'i zhor ldan la/ /blang dang dor bya'i de nyid gsal bar bya/ / de ltar mchod par brjod pa dang /bshad par dam bca' ba'i ngag gi thog mar dge bar byas te skabs su gleng bar bya ba mdo khams lha rtse byams pa gling gi dge 'dun pa rnams kyi sgrig khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa mdo tsam spel ba la/ thog mar sgrigs la 'jug —— 518 —
