pa'i tshe dgon gzhan sngon song min na so thar gyi sdom pa skye ba dang / gnas pa dang / mdzes pa dang / khyad par du 'gyur ba'i 'gal rkyen spangs shing mthun rkyen tshang bar byas nas las sne rim par snyan gsan 'bebs pa sogs sngar lam tshul mthun du 'jug cing / dgon gzhan du zhugs pa zhig yin tshe rtsa bzhi chang gi mthong thos dogs gsum med pa dang / bsgrig khrims dang 'gal 'dzol gyi gnas dbyung byas pa min pa sogs yul dus la ltos te 'jug par mi 'os pa'i skyon kun dang bral ba dgos/ zhugs nas nyams su bstar rgyur bgres gzhon tshang mas so thar byang sems gsang sngags kyi sdom pa rnams las rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i bslab khrims mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung ba gzhir bzung thog so so'i blo dang 'tsham pa'i 'don kha khral/ thos bsam sgom sgrub le lor ma shor ba'i sgo nas rab byung gi rtags tsam 'dzin par ma song ba bya/ zhugs nas lo bcu tshun la 'don cha nges par rdzogs dgos shing / rdzogs pa na blo gros kyi bab dang bstun te dbyangs rta 'dur gsum/'bud brdung dkrol gsum/ thig rdul tshon/ rgyan bca' bzo/ dge tshul slong gi bslab bya gnam rtse ldeng ma/ byang chub gzhung lam slob ma'i re skong dngos grub snye ma/ mdo sngags lam rim sogs la thos bsam slob gnyer ci thub byed/ de thog nas lugs gnyis shes bya yong stangs kyi rim pas dge 'dun gyi bya ba'i sne mo che chung gang 'os su gtong / bla ma dang /byang 'dren gnyis ni rgan gzhon rim 'ded mi byed par de dang der 'os nges kyi yon tan ma tshang ba med pa zhig la las sne gros mthun gyi sgo nas nye ring phyogs lhung ma song bar bsko/ dge bskos dkon gnyer chab ril gsum ni mi nus pa'i nad pa sogs dmigs bsal khyad par can yin na ma gtogs — 519 ——

bslab pa'i go rim ltar byed/ gtsug lag khang gi steng shod bar gsum byi dor dang gtsang sbra/ dus kyi mchod pa 'bul bsham/ las sne dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i gdan khri bsdu 'grem/ dbo kha thigs tshag dung dang mkhar rnga'i tshogs brda rnams dkon gnyer chab ril gnyis la 'khris pas tshags tshud byed/ rung khang gi gad phyis me 'bud chu len sogs la bkod 'doms/ dge 'dun gyi bsnyen bkur rigs tsha 'khol thon gsum gyis mtshon pa'i dad rdzas gshin rdzas chud zos su ma btang bar sha khu shar thim gyi dper 'gyur ba'i 'gan 'khur 'al ta bas len/ dpe rgyugs ma 'phrod pa'i shes dman rnams las bzhi bzhi res mos su lag bder rgyug mang po ma mchis tshe gang yod gtan 'jags su bskul/ thebs rtsa'i rigs nyams med gtong len tshags tshud kyi ngos nas 'khri khungs so sos skabs su gang babs la mchod spyin dge ba'i sgo 'phar lhug par 'byed pa las yal yol dman chad du 'gro ba mi bya/ zla 1tshes 1la lha mo'i tshes gtor/ de'i 2tshes nas tshes 29bar gsang 'dus sgrub mchod sbyor dngos rjes gtsang rdul tshon chab 'dren dang bcas pa/ tshes 2kal 'cham dang sbyin sreg tshes 19la dgu 'cham/ tshes 20la 'cham chas mchod rdzas rtsis sprod byed/ de nyin dge bskos gsar bzhengs thog mkhan bla thun mong ma dpe rgyugs 'bul/zla 2tshes 1nas tshes ka bar bskang gso dang 'brel ba'i gshegs tor/ zla 4tshes 'a nas tshes 21bar ngos ring 'tshams tshe sgrub cho ga zla 5tshes 12nas tshes 17bar bskang gso/ zla 6tshes 15la tshul shing dang / tshes 16la dbyar zhal bzhes/ zla 7tshes 29la glo bur dgag dbye se 'bras dge gsum gyi phyag bzhes bzhin gang cir 'dul ba 'bum sde'i snying po 'dul ——— 620 — —

'dzin rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan pa'i gzhi gsum cho ga ltar phyag len gtsang mar bya/ de rjes chab bzhugs zhag lnga/ dbyar gnas skabs nyin rer tshogs thun bzhi las zhogs kar ja thug gsum/ tsha rting la ja gnyis/gung tshigs la ja thug gsum/ dgong tshogs la ja gnyis yod pa de dag gi skabs su rim pa bzhin gsong 'dus bdag mdun/ gnas bcu dang /ngos ring 'tsho'i smon tshig sa lam skabs gsum dang bla mchod/ chos spyong gtor 'bul dang 'phrin bcol 'don/ tshogs bar rnams su skyor sbyang byed/zla ka tshes 1nas tshes 2 0bar sman bla'i sgrub mchod/ zla 9tshes 1nas tshes 1༷bar 'jigs byed sgrub mchod/ zla 10tshes 1nas tshes 7bar nyi ldog sku rim dang 'phar ma'i zhabs brtan sgrub rgyur nyin re bzhin grwa rer rtsam mda' zo gang re rgyag tshes 2 5nas tshes 27bar dga' ldan lnga mchod/ smin rgyas dang rtsam pa gong mtshungs/ de rjes 'du ra dang / mchod khag sogs kyi gtong thebs rtsis sprod byed/ skabs der de dag gi las byed 'os 'gab gang yod du bsko gzhag byas par sus kyang dgongs zhu byed mi chog chos mtshams su 'khor 'ag gnang ba zhus na yang byang sum mdo zam pa/ nub nyag sga nga / shar rgya 'bog sgang / lho ka ye'i nyag ka tshun skya chas kyi 'gro 'ongs mi rung / rtsa bzhi chang lnga'i skyon gyis gos pa las mi bsad la grwa tshab sogs chad pa spyir btang babs log ltar gyi thog rta lcag brgya re gnad 'phrod dang 'brel bar gnas dbyung gis sa gnas rdzong gzhis la rtsis sprod byed/pham pa gzhan gnyis dang chang gi nyes par babs log bzhin bya/ babs log/ byung ba las sne thon zin yin na mkhan por snyan 'bebs zub phyi dang /dngul zho drug lag 'don mang ja gcig dkar me snyan shal/ nyes pa —— — 521 —

dngul srang bzhi bcu zhe drug lus steng dbyug pa bdun hru don lnga gnad 'phrod/ grwa tshab 'dzugs dkyus ma yin na gzhan gong mtshungs la nyes pa dngul srang sum hru so drug lus steng dbyug pa lnga bcu tham pa/ sa dkar khal rgyab gsum dang bcas pa'i chad pa 'gel/ sdom 'phrog bud med nas kyang dngul srang bcu dgu 'bul zhing / cho 'phrul zla ba'i tshes 15gling skor du brkyang phyag tshar gsum 'tshal/ nyes pa gzhan rnams la phyag 'tshal mchod me snyan shal sogs bab dang bstun pa'i chad pa mig lar 'doms nges chags sdang du ma song ba gcod/ rnam kun dgongs pa zhu gnang med par dbo/na du bud med 'grim 'grul/ rta g.yag bong khyi sogs 'jug nyar/dpung 'bebs ma byas par skye dman dgon 'gram nas 'grul ba spyod sogs mi bya/ skya bo'i rigs nas dgon par gri ring me mdung 'khur 'dogs/stod hreng / dgon gyi nye 'khor du rta bzhon pa/ dgon pas mthong sar sems can gsod pa sogs ma gus bo tsha khrel med kyi spyod ngan rigs mi chogadage 'dun pas kyang ko lpags mnye ba dang / sbud pa bkal ba sogs dman pa'i las la 'dzems bag bya/ zla 1 tshes 1nas tshes 2 0bar gsang 'dus sgrub mchod skabs ser skya dran rgan sus 'gal 'dzom byas na yang sngar lam drang 'brel khrims gcod byed/ dgon nas sngar lam sngo khrims sa/na rgya 'bul len dang 'brel zla 2tshes 15nas zla ka tshes 1༷bar sad ser bsrung bar bya 'ing / byed 'dzol byung rigs la dgon pa'i ngag bkod dang len dgos pa las 'then 'khyer mi chog dpal 'bar spyi bso nas lo ltar ser gla nas rkyang ru'i khal bzhi re da lta phan bzhin sprod/ grwa shag sogs ar las byed pa la dgon gzhung nas ros/sa ram gang phan bya/ rjes mjug med pa'i —— 522 —

thi rdzas las sbo thun klo/nga nas/ do dam gyis mchod sbyim du chud mi za bar btong /lcag//sa ri spu ma'i nang du rang sa/'an su thad nas kyang ston thog rtseb/ pa dang /g.yul las so gas mi chog chos rwa/ dgon gyi nye 'khor/ nub phyob/sa na gling rnams la/ rang 'tsham rtswa shing sa/rtsad 'drem/ mi rung /// gas/nga dbri sa/ shod bcas la sa/nas kyi bla ma dbyar sdom 'dur du sngar lam ltar 'gro tshagamador na 'jam mgon bla mas gnas skabs 'bras bu lha mi dang mthar thug 'bras/ bu byang chub gsum 'thob par 'gyur zhes sa/sungs pa'i phyir// brtson ldan rnams kyis so sor thar rtag tu gus pas 'bad de srungs/ zhes gsungs nga/ ltar gyi don phyin ci ma lo ga ba'i blang dor 'dzol med yong ba gyis/jes pa 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dbe/ spyong rgyal ba'i tshul 'chos pa ngas/ dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyog/sa las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug zla 1 1tshes 15dge bar nor gling bed skyid kun dga' 'khyil pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser tham chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

tā la'iXbla ma bzuXgasum pas mdo /lams sho mdo dgonaXdaga' ldan/ bshad sgrubaXgling la bstsal ba'i bca' yig 'dul ba—'bum sde'i dgongasaXdon rnam pan bkra ba bzhugasaXso/ sa sbrul/ (spyo lo 192 )bod zla 7tshes nyin zhi/ba 'jug song /ngo mtshar mkhyen pa'i tsha zer stong 'bar bas/ / gtan bde nges legs pad+ma dkar po'i tshal/ / kun nas rgyas mdzad smra ba'i nyi ma che/ /zas gtsang sras kyis 'gro 'dir shis pa stsol/ /mkhyen gter zur phud lnga pa'i ye shes zhal/ /'dzul grol lung rtogs nor bu'i 'khri shing can/ / pha rol rgol ba rnam gnon chos kyi rje/ / blo bzang rgyal bas byang chub bar du skyongs/ /shākya'i rjes 'jug dad pa'i rigs ldan la/ / blang dor thub dgongs lhug rjen du spel bas/ / bka' srung drag shul pe char 'bum 'bebs pas/ /rtag tu dge ba'i 'phrin las ma g.yel cig / de la 'dir snga sor bar khams khul bzher khog tu dgon pa ri khrod/ ko shar ba/ ka tho/ sdong khol ka —— 524 ——

nub bcas nyams stong bzhad tsha rnam rgyal bkris nas sho mdor zla bsgril gyis dge dgon das/'a ldan bshad sgrub gleng gsar 'debs bgyis nga1ra bar skabs rta tshag ho thog thu'i 'dzin khungs bar khams dam//sgyur shod kyi char gtogs 'di nyid kyi blang dor khri/ mas su bca' ba'i rim pa 'dul ba 'bum sde'i dbo/ngas dom/ rnam par bkra ba yul dus dang bsnyun pa'i mdor bldus tsam 'bo/da pa la/sde 'dir gas/ra 'jug rten gyi gang zag ni 'dul ba/ nas gsungs pa'i bar chang// ba'i bra' mthun rkyen kum/ tshang / yi ge khral spyor la mkhas pa'i klog rtsal sgra das/ thon nges lugs zung rten khongs can/ mkhan slob brtan mkhas gnyis ldan las tshigs snga phyi'i sdom pa gang 'os nyes med phun tshogs su blangs pa/ dgon sde gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i rigs yin na yang gnas dbyung ma yin zhing rtsa ba bzhi dang chang bcas pa'i mthong thos dwogs gsum med pa/rab tu byung nas khas blangs pa'i dam sdom mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba gal che bas sdom pa so so'i bslab bya'i gzhung che phrar slob spyong dang 'brel rang rang gi bcas 'gal phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i 'jug ldog phra rags mtha' dag la lhur len byed/ zhwa ser dang / zla gam rdo rje gong gcod mas mtshon rang lugs yo byad kun tshang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba gyon tshul sogs gang cir dge bskos nas rtogs 'jug nan tan bya/ gos phu tshar can/ gri ring glo 'dogs/ sked rgyan glo cha/ rgya sog gi lham sogs sgrig 'gal rigs mi chogashas/ dang srang bar rnams su ca co'i sgra dang / rgyang 'bod sogs spyod lam bag med bsam gtan gyi tsher mar 'gro rigs gtan nas med par zhi dul bag yod kyis dus 'da' bar byed/ chos zhu/ dus mchod/ rten mjal nye 'brel nad 'phrad sogs dmigs bsal 'os nges la nyin gnang zhu ster 525 —

tshul mthun las/ khral 'ul sos/sa la //lag 'bo/sa/sa kyi bud med/ dgon nang 'ab sdod dang / rang mtshams bskyod sdod rigs nam yang mi chos bza' btung rnams tha mal sred zhen gyis ma bslad nga/ra mdo sngag/sa kyi spyod tshul gang mos bya mig so sor rgyun nga/ra ba//sa/ra bu rnams nas dpe 'dzin skyor sbyang /rgan pa rnams/ ma/ngo/ spras//sa 'a/ma/ rim che chung / de'i yan lag blo sbyong sdom gsum bslab bya so gas la thos bsam sand smin skyongs/ 'thab 'dzing glu gar sho rgyas/ sogs tshum min ba/rlang spyod rigs drag 'an tshang mas mi tshas/rtsa bzhi chang lnga'i 'gal rkyen dang / gri mtshon mda' rdos rmas/ sa/bod byung ba rnams la ngo 'dzin/ jol 'jog tu ma/ song bar lus steng rta lcag brgya nas sum brgya'i bar 'am gal tshabs che chung rim sa/tong dang / rgyu chad mig lar 'doms nges btang ste gnas dbyung sogs tshar gcod byed 'dzin skabs sbyar drang 'brel bya/ tshogs 'don phal cher sngag/sa chog tu song ga'i sa rgyud sde rang rang gi dbang bsnyen sngon du ma song ba dag gis gya tshom du mi 'jug par bla ma lnga bcu pa'i dgongs don gathir bzung bsam gzhigs ma nor bas 'bad brtson che bskyed byed/ gnang ba ma zhus par tshogs su mi 'ongs pa'i rigs la dam sbrags spyi spom zol 'jog tu ma song ba bya/ gtong 'dzin rim 'byor nas gtong sgo gang dgos dpes gsal ltar chos byed dge 'dun spyi'i sri zhur smin pa'i hur skyed nyams med mig sman mig phan du 'gro nges dang /gtong rtsa rnams sprod len skabs deb yig zur yod ltar rtsa 'dzin rgyun 'khyongs dgos par mkhan gnyer dge bskos sogs las sne rim 'byor nas do dam nan tan dgos rgyu/ g.yas dkyil g.yon gsum dang / ljong dkar chu stod sogs nas dgon ma lag gi deb yig nang gsal grwa rgyun btsun khral —— 526 — ——

da khor sa nga/ge/ khong ba/// gtong thebs/ sa la/ nga / bte sdom/ ga'i ma dge gson tsa/mas// yeng 'bab khas/ ba/ rtsa 'i/ nga sa// nor ma/ dbo/ma/ dud sogs /4kyi rtswa bza' chu 'thung sngar lam ji yod dang / dad 'bul gyi sa khang sog/sa 'di lo phan gnas bzhin rnams 'a / bsgyur bzad sa/cod 'jen dang /khra/ la 'ger su na sa/tser mchod—rgyun/ do phog 'gro ga'i mi/ chos dbus btsang du slob gnyer la 'gro mi/ dngos ga/nas rigs la gnang ba zhu ster dgo/sa pa ma zad/ tshur 'byor ma/tshams ming btas//sa che chung gi/ ga/dan thob ster//dngo na si 'i g.yog/ sogs rang 'dod phyogs ba/sbyod 'gyangs 'bo/ra la dmis/sa bsal mi ster/ mchod nga/'i las dom song ba'i rig/sa dngos sa//ma/sa la dmis/sa bsal byed/ rtsa tshig rim 'bre'/ ltar dgon ma lag gi rgyab mdun sos/sa sngar thob khungs su rngon 'gal skru/ mas 'bras la mi gtugs pa byung tshe lus steng du chad pa sa/tong / dus mchod khag tshog/sa chos tshug/sa stangs/'don chog phyag len gyi rim pa'i 'i//ba cha sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang / mi dbang pho lha// rta tshag sku gong ma bcas nas bca' yig zur rgyan rim 'brel ltar sor gnas nyams len byed/ dgon 'di'i zhol du khyim grong chags sdod yo/da gshes mi skya dgon na/nga yong mis dgon gseb tu zhwa pyon /stod 'bud/ /3du tshogs/ long gtam/ gri mtshon 'dogs nga// chang 'thung glu gar/ 'thab 'dzin/ rta bzhon g.yer dril sgrig pa sogs 'gal cha byung tshe nyes bkod bab bstun btang 'thus bcas/ mdor na ser skya mchog dman kun nas 'di phyi'i bde 'bras la bsam tsa/'i/gas kyis blang dor 'dzol med rgyun 'khyongs dgos rgyu bcas tshul bzhin sgrub pa rnams la dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis 'gal rkyen sel zhing / mthun rkyen lhun grub gyi stongs —— 527 la

gro4/sa mi g.yel nges/ lhag par dus snyigs ma/ ches cher ba bo bas zu/ rung mda' lnga 'i/ brtul zhug/sa su 'jug nga/ co/ra tshe tshas srung dam can rgya mtshos/ drag po'i pa 'phrim/ /sas rdo/ rje'i thos rngo ngar rol bas tshar sa//cod par mdzad du tsa/so/la///'dir smras pa/ ris/ bdun so thar yan las/ brgyad ldan mchor// dad brtsom/ sa/ser mis/ g.yas 'khyil rtsen pa las/ stobs bcu ma nga 'a ba'i lugs bzang nga/da tsha' ba 'ad/ dri bsung phyogs kun 'thul bas mdzes gyur cis/de ltar blang dor bre// ma sa su bca' ba'i rim pa 'dul ba 'bum sde'i dgongs don rnam par bkra ba zhes bya ba 'di yang pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dgre/ spyong ngag/ dbang blo bzang thub bstam/ rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam bar rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drus/ pa sa mo sbru la lo'i khrum stod zla ba'i dkar tshes rngamachog/ tu da/ge bar nor gling bde skyed kun dga' 'khyel pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i ga/ser dam chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na/ 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bzu gsum pas byang bya do bkra shis bsam gtan gling dgonaXl bstsal ba'i bca' khrimasaXnab gsal sgron me zhes bya ba zab(1da/ba thod/lcags rta/ ( spyo lo 19 ༈ 0 )bod zla 1 1tshes 2ka nyin 'ib 'jug song /na mo shākya mu ni ye/ spang rtogs mthar phyin mnyam med 'dren pa nyi ma'i gnyen/ / zab dang rgya che'i mdo sngags mdzod 'dzin dam pa'i chos/ / rig grol re skong nor bu'i bang mdzod da/ge 'dun te// /rin chen rnam gsum srid na mchog dge'i shis pa stsol/ / mtshar sdug nyin byed 'bum phrag/ 'bar ba'i dpal/ 1/ dbal ldan smra ba'i seng ge ngur smreg tshul/ /tshul gnas 'chad rtsod rtsom mkhas bstan pa'i bdag // 'jam dbyangs sprul pa yab rje bla mar bsngags/ / rgyal ba'i lung bzang mchog tu skyong ba la/ / rnam ba'i/'i 'phrin las glos/ gi/ zlos ga/ra can/ / ma rung snyeng rtsa sgos/ mar 'byen pa'i zil/ /bzod par das/'a ba srung mas dus kun skyongs/ /rkyes thos mar dge ba'i shis 529

brjod kyi phreng ba sngo na du btang na/sa zo/bas ngo/na gleng bar bya ba ni/ dus ga/sum rgya' ba thams cad kyi phu ma chen rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ sa//ma/ rkya(pa du bzhus/sa ba'i sa/sang chu 'khyil ba/ byang sa/na/ma mtsho chen mo'i nyin la do chen bco brgyad dang / srib /la gdong chen bco brgyad du yod pa'i nang tshan bya do nam mal/ 'a sa/su nga gi do ru grags pa'i/ gnas su snga dus rje btsun sga lo pa chen ngo 'i sgrub gnas mdzad shu'/ du dge slong spong ba pa blo bzang nor bu nas bstan 'gro spyi dang / phyogs de'i skye 'gro'i bsod nams kyis thing sar ched btab dben gnas bkra shis bsam sa/tan gling 'di nyid kyi bca' khrims rab gsal sgrol me mdor bsdus su 'god pa la/ dgon 'dir gsar du 'jug pa'i rten gyi sa/nga zag ni/ 'dul ba nas gsungs nga/'i bar chad bzhi bral/mthun rkyen kun tshang / yi ge 'phral spyor kyi klog rtsal sgra dag thon nges thog lugs zung rten khongs dang bcas pa 'is dgos shing mkhan slob brtan mkhas gnyis ldan 1phas tshigs snga phyi'i sdo ma pa gang 'os nyes med phun tshogs su blangs te sgrigs la 'jug dgon sde gzhan nas 'ongs pa'i rigs yin na yang tshad ldan gyi gnas dbyung byas nga/ min pa/ rtsa bzhi chang la mthong thos dogs gsum med ba sogs sngar srol ltar dgos/ rab byung rnams khas blangs pa'i dam sdom mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba gal che bas sdom pa so so'i bslab bya'i gzhung che phrar slob spyong dang 'brel rang rang gi bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba nyes byas phra mos kyang ma gos pa'i thabs su brtson pa lhur len byed/snam sbyar bla gos sogs dge spyong la 'os pa'i rang lugs yo byad kun tshang mtha' gnyis su ma lhung ba dang / gyon tshul sogs gang cir dang ba 'dren pa 'go byed so so nas rtogs mjug bslab bya nan tan bya/ gos phu thung can/—— 530 ——

gri ring glo 'dogs/ ske rgyan glo cha/ rgya sog gi lham sogs sgrigs 'gal rigs nam yang mi tshag srang bar rnams dang nye mtshams su ca co'i sgra dang / rgyang 'bod zhi dul bsam gtan gyi tsher mar 'gro rigs gtan nas mi byed /chos zhu/ dus mchod/ rten mjal/ nye 'brel nang 'phrad sogs dmigs bsal 'os nges la gnang ba zhu ster tshul mthun byung na ma gtogs rnam kun bud med dgon nang du bskyod 'grul zhag sdod rigs nam yang mi chogabaza' btung rnams tha mal sred zhen gyis ma bslad par mdo 'dul sbas kyi sbags kyi spyod tshul ma 'gal bar dang len/ tshul/ bzhin du bya/ ༅ga so sor rgyun bar gsar bu ba rjams nas 'dzin skyor sbyang dang / rgan pa rnams nas mdo sngags lam rim che chung de'i yan lag blo sbyong sdom sa/sum bslab bya sos/sa la thos bsam gnad smin byed/ lhag par 'thab 'dzing glu gar/ sho sbag sogs bag// ped kyi spyod par ye nas mi 'jus/ par drag 'an tshang mas spyod lam bag/ yod tshul ldan gyis khyim pa sun 'byin gyi las mtha' dag 'go ba'i nad bzhin rgyun du 'dzems cha gal che/ rtsa ba'i chang lnga 'i 'gal skyon dang / gri mtshon/ mda' rdos rmas phog byung ba rnams la ngo 'dzin zol 'jog/ tu ma song ba skabs bstun lus steng rta lcags tsha nan grangs bcad/ dang / 'as/la tshabs che chung gi rgyu chad mig 'a/ra 'doms nges btang ste gnas/ dbyung sogs tshar sa/cod rjes 'dzin phyogs su ma lhang ba bya/ tshos/sa 'don phal cher sngags chog tu song gshis rgyud sde so so'i dbang dang bsnyem pa sngon du ma song ba dag/ gis ni gya tshom du 'jug pa/ /bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas par/ /dkyil 'khol las la 'jug mi bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe 'di dang / phyi mar phung tshabs shin tu che bas 'bad brtson/ nan tan dang 'bre'/ gzhi/ gsum —— 531 —

ga bor gyur gyi rgyun tshogs sgrub mchod khag sogs sngar sbol phyag len rnams rdo lag brgyud kyi nyams pa med cing / lo ltar dbyar gnas skabs so thar gyi mdo rgyas pa yongs rdzogs byung na rab tha mar ma nges nges pa gnyis yan sgra dag gsal gsum gyi 'chad nyan rnam dag dgos rgyu/ gnang ba ma zhus par tshogs su mi 'ongs ba'i rigs la dam bsgrags spyi spom zol 'dzog tu ma song bar bya/ ga/tong 'dzin rim 'byor nas gtong sgo gang dgos deb gsal ltar hur bskyed mig sman mig phan du 'gro nges ma gtogs rang 'dod g.yo khram mig stos ngan 'gran gyi dngos shugs brgyud gsum du nam yang mi chogagatong rtsa rnams kyang sprod len deb yig zur yod ltar rtsa 'dzin spang blang 'dzol med dgos rgyu/ dgon gyi grwa rgyun dkor sa/ rtsa bza'/ chu 'thung sbar 'a ma ji yo/da/ dang / dad 'bul bcas pa 'di lo phan gnas bzhin rnams la bsgyur bkod ga/cod 'then dang // khra/ la rigs/ 'ge/la bsun rig/sa nam/ yang mi chos/ rtsa tshig/ rim pa'i dgongs don mi 'jigs sros/ si sbyim par dgon/ gyi rgyab mdun sogs sbar thob sa khrongs su rngen/ 'as/la khri/ mas 'bras la mi gtubs pa'i rigs byung tshe lus steng chad pa drag pos 'jigs zil nges 'bebs bya// mi skya rna/mas nas/ dbo/na gyi gling gseb tu rta bzhon//sto/da 'bud/ don med 'du tshogs long tsa//tam / gri mtshom/ 'dogs nga /las sner mi med// chang 'thung / glu gsas/ 'khru/ ga rtsod rkyen ngan sogs gtan nas ma chog pa bcas blang dor phra 'ib ke'u tshang nub sprul gong ma 'jam dbyangs smon lam gī bca' yis 'bru don la da phan rtsa 'dzim byed mus ltar mtshag dman tshang mas /'as/la med nyams len rgyun 'khyungs su da so//sa rgyu 'a/sa/ rang rang gi 'di phyi'i bde 'bras la bsam med log spyod ris/sa ༅ra tshe chos — 532 —

srung ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams nas mngon spyod drag po'i 'phrin las kyi tshar gcod dang / tshul bzhin brtson pa rnams la dam chos sgrub pa'i rkyen phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen ci mchis sel nas/ mthun rkyen mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa bde blag tu stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ 'dir smras pa/ ma smad lung rtogs rgyal bstan 'phel 'grib kyi/ rtsa ba dge 'dun sde la rag lus phyir / khri/ mas gnyis 'jug bya'i bsgrigs yig gzhi/ra bzung gi/ tshul sa/nas bstan 'gro'i dge mtshan blar bzhad shog ces go bar bya ba'i bca' yig blang dor rnam gsal zhes bya ba 'di yang / rgyal ba'i chos tshul dang /pad dkar 'chang ba skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge spyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jis/sa bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang tshan lcags rta zla 12tshes 12dge bar nor gling bde sgyid kun das/'a 'khyil pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bris/zhes gos ser thog bris te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser tham chen cho/ bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

twa la'i bla ma pyaXphreng bzu gsum pas jongaXpo rabaXbartan dgon la bstsal ba'i bca' yig gsal byed non bu'i 'od snang zhesaXbya ba bzhugasaXso/lcagasaXrta/ ( sbyiXlo 192 0 )bod zla 11tshes 28nyin zhib 'jug song /oṃ su ste/ ston pa bla med kun mkhyen stobs bcu'i bdag skyo ba pa bla med lung rtogs bdud rtse'i mdzod/ / 'dren pa bla med bden mthong 'phags pa'i tshogs/ /skyangs gnas bla med rin chen gsum gyis skyongs/ /mi mthun 'dul ba'i pad+ma'i tshal yangs por/ / dgag sgrub snang ba'i me tog 'bum bkra bar// /thos brtson mchu non sbyo ra ba'i skal bzang dag /dbyes/ gi blo gros mdzes pa'i rgyan du che/ /de'i phyir blang dang dor bar bya ba'i tshul smra mkhas bca' ba'i yi ge khrims bsdebs pa/ sa/sal byed nor bu'i 'od snang 'dir spro na/ zhi ba'i bde la 'dun pa'i mig bo/sa lhos/ de la 'dir nong po rab brtan dgon gyi gzhung stsal bca' yig nang phyis 'phar sgrub mchod la 534 ——

khag dang bcas zhib gsal zur bkol cung zad 'god par bya ste/ sde 'dir 'dus pa'i grwa rgan gzhon tshang ma bca' yig dngos gzhi'i don ltar dge tshul slong gi sdom ldan min pa med gshis brtan mkhas gnyis ldan gyi slob dpon legs par bsten te rnam 'byed sdom bsdus kyi bslab bya mtha' dag dang / lung las gsungs pa'i 'byung nye'i nyes byas rnams kyang yid yul du nges par byas nas mkhan slob zung la rgyugs 'bul dang 'brel skabs bab dgag sgrub gnang ba'i bcas mtshams mig 'bras ltar bsrung ba gzhir bzung thog rnam pa kun mkhyen mchog gi nye rgyur klog pa thos bsam gyi 'khor lor gzhol ba gnad du gal bas bsdus grwa/ blo rtags/ grub mtha' rtsa 'brel/don bdun cu/ phar phyin/ dbu ma rnams rje btsun pa'i yig cha'i steng nas gsar du 'dzugs rgyur dpe 'khrid skyor sbyangs rtsod rim sogs ser byes mkhas snyan grwa tshang gi lag len ltar bya/ de yang smag num du mar me spar ba lta bur yul mthar rgyal bstan rin po che'i btsas su 'gyur nges dgos/dbus 'gyur chos sde chen po'i phyag len bzhin bslab pa yongs su spyongs ba'i gzhi gsum gyi nyams len dngos gtsang ma chag par byed/ dus 'brel gyi gso sbyong rnams la nyi ma ma 'dzol zhing / mdo 'don pa pos kyang blo thog nas nor 'khrul med par sgra dag gsal gsum du 'chad pa gal che/ dbyar skabs rang don du mtshams las rgyang grags gcig gi phyir yang mi 'gro/ spyi don chos ldan gyi bya bar ba spyod tshe zhag gcig la sogs pa'i byin brlabs byed/dbyar nang mtshams kyi phyi rol du 'ag mang ba sdod pa/ zhag mang por byin gyis brlabs pa'i dgos don grub zin kyang mtshams phyir rang bzhin sdod pa byed du mi rung bas mtshams phyag len gyi rgyun gang yod ma nyams par byed/—— 535 ——

dbyar ral ba'i rgyur 'gro rigs rnams phra mo nas nyes chad dang 'brel bar 'gog sngags phyogs cho ga phyag len phra rags dbus kyi rgyud stod ltar la de'i sngon 'gror rgyud sde rang rang gi dbang rnam dag dgos par ma zad/dbang don dam sdom srog bsdos su bsrung bar bya dgos shing / bsnyen bzlas kyi rgyud dag par ma byas par dkyil 'khor gyi las la 'jug pa sogs gtan nas mi rung bas nges par gzab/ zla 1tshes 1nas tshes ra bar cho 'phrul smon lam lha sa bzhin/ de'i tshes bcur bla mchod/ bcu gcig nas bco brgyad bar gsang 'dus zhi sbyin dang bcas pa/ nyi shu gsum nas nyi shu dgu'i bar lcags mkhar/ gnyis pa'i tshes 1nas tshes 25bar ma ṇi bum sgrub/ de'i tshes 27nas gsum pa'i tshes 7bar 'jigs byed bdag 'jug ji sbyin dang bcas pa/ bcu nas nyi shu gcig bar bde mchog bdag 'jugasbyang ba/ rab gnas/ las bzhi'i sbyin sreg nyi shu gcig nas nyin gsum ring gsang 'dus bdag 'jug nyi shu dgur dgu gtor/ zla 4tshes 7nas tshes 21bar yang dgon dge slong spyi nas bde mchog dang /'jigs byed gnyis kyi bdag 'jug dang / sbyang chog nyer dgur dgu gtor/ bzhi pa'i tshes 20nas lnga pa'i tshes 2bar chos grwar skam tshogs thos bsam rtsod rigs dang 'brel bar ngos ring 'tsho'i sgron tshig dang /bstan 'bar ma/ gdugs sher seng gsum gyi bzlog bsgyur/ phebs thub min byung tshe dbu skyor gnyis la gnang ba zhu/ 'du khang du skam tshogs la thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas / ngos ring 'tsho'i smon tshig blo bzang rgyal bstan ma/ dbyar gnas ring rgyun gyi chos spyod/ bka' 'gyur dag sgrogasman bla'i mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ zla 7tshes 14nas tshes 2ka bar — 536 —

sprung gnas cha gnyis gtong / ljongs rgyur mtshams kyi phyi rol rgyang grags gcig gi bar du 'gro/ de'i tshes 7nas tshes 11bar chab zhugs/ zla 9tshes 14nas sprung gnas cha gcig de'i tshes 26nas tshes 2'bar yang dgon du lcags mkhar/ zla 1༷tshes 10nas tshes 17bar rnam rgyal stong mchod dang 'jam po gsum gyi sbyin sreg bya/ lnga mchod gang rgyas/ tshes 26nas tshes 2'bar bskang gso'i thog glo bur las brtsol mjug zor 'phen pa/ zla 11tshes 15nas tshes 2'bar skam tshogs thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas dang / ngos ring 'tsho'i smon tshig zla 12tshes 10nas tshes 17bar sman chog chen mo/ de'i tshes 2 2nas tshes 2 5bar 'cham spyong / tshes 26nas tshes 1'bar bskang gso dang mjug tu 'cham dang 'brel ba'i zor 'phen/ gnam gang la gar 'cham bcas lo 'khor tshas spyod kyi rim pa ji srid rgyal bstan gnas kyi bar mi nyams gong 'phel dgos rgyu/ spyi bsos gtsos pa'i mchod gnyer khag nas gzhung stsal phogs deb nang gsal ltar mchog gsum bsod nam/sa kyi zhing la dad rdzas sha khu shar thim las chad 'jog 'khri 'jen sogs rang 'dod bsod nams ma yin pa'i las ngan rigs nam yang mi chog las sne gsar rnying brje mtshams spyi rdzas sprod len che phran gang cir ngo dga' zol 'jog tu ma song bar khams dwangs mig 'doms yong nges byed/ spyi bye'i gad bdar// sa dkar btsag gtong/ snye yol sogs phyi nang snod bcud kyi 'bas 'degs 'khri khungs so sor le shor med pa'i bskor g.yeng ba lta rtogs dge bskos nas byed// grwa rgyun dkor sa sogs 'khri sgrub bdag thob skor ga/tan she rim pa'i dgongs don sor gnas bya dgos/dgon nye'i phyogs mtshams kyi ri klung skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags la — 537 —

rgya rnyi mda' rdo sogs kyi gnod 'tshe gtan nas mi chog nges med ri dwags bshor rigs byung na mtshon cha mgon khang du bsdus thog khrims mthun mig lar 'doms pa'i chad pa 'gel/ rang dbang phu mda'i rtswa chu shing gsum la ri dwags gsod 'ded sogs nyer 'tshe sun 'byin bsam gtan gyi tsher mar 'gyur ba drag zhan sus kyang mi bya/ kun dga' rwa ba nyams gso/ zhal ba/ar las/ sa rtsi/ bsnyen bkur/ mchod mjal gyis mtshon pa'i dmigs bsal gnad che ma gtogs bud med dgon nang du mi gtong / de yang rang don yin na las sner gnang ba zhu/ nyi ma yol nas bud med dgon par 'grul sdod bya mi rung / dgon nang du ser skya drag zhan su thad nas bro gzhas sho sbag gling bu sgra snyan/ rgyang 'bod mgo dkris/ stod phud/mtshon 'dogs rigs mi chog dge 'dun rnams kyis kyang na bza' tshul dang mthun par gyon pa ma gtogs gos spubs can/ ske rags sna tshogs/phor shugs/ rgya lham/ sgom thag gri/ mtheb kor/ sor gdub sogs khyem pa sun 'byen du 'gyur ba'i cha lugs ya ma zung dngos shugs su mi spyod/ grwa sa dang rgyud stod du slob spyong byed pa rnams la dmigs bsal ci 'os su/ ster/ spyi bso dang mchod gnyer khag la ma gtogs zhing las/phyugs skyong / khe tshong sogs nye 'gyangs gang sar nam yang mi chog 'khor zhag tu bskyod skabs zhag gnyis gsum tshun mkhan dger dgongs pa zhu khrol las rgyun gtan grwa rkyang gis rta drel brten nyar mi rung / phyogs 'gro dang 'khor 'ag gi gnang ba zhu ster skor gdan sa'i phyag srol ltar mkhan por ja khog ldir gang ngam/ dod dngul skar phyed brgyad re 'bum len las/ sne mo bas rang 'dod phyogs ldung rigs med pa dgos rgyu bcas 'dir tshig — 538 —

ga/sal ma 'khod pa rnams kyang sngar mod/ bca' yi/sa/ 'bru don ltar sor tsa/nas byed pa las rang snang sa/nga shar nam/ ma nga mi tshag pa bcas tshangs spyod rnams nas kyang // bstan 'gro'i sman yon legs tshogs bzang por tshul ba/din brtso ma/ pa 'di phyi'i gtan 'dun la ci dab/ra 'jug pa'i blang bo//ra phyi ci ma log par sgo kun nas spyodaXpar ris/sa so/ smras pa/ lung rtogs/ shar gyi ri bo'i phras/ ba nas/ /les/sa 'ongs dgre/ 'dun 'dus sde'i 'od stong can/ / shar ba'i mod la bdud rigs mun pa'i blog / rab sangs chos dkar snang bas khyab gyur cig / ces pa 'di yang bad dkar 'chang ba'i skye preng bcu gsum pa rgyal ba'i tshul 'chos shākya'i dge sbyong ngas/ dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs /pas rnam nga ra rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drug pa'i lcags rta zla 12tshes 1 2dge bar nor gling bde skyed kun dga' 'khyil pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bris te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser tham chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

twa la'i blaXm sbu breng bzuXgasum pas chab mdo dga' ldan thegaXchen byams paXgling du bstsal ba'i bca' yig/chu sprel/ ( spyi lo 19 2 2 )oṃ su ste/ 'bas zung 'khor lo'i ri rbo rnam bkra ba'i / srid 'i'i sgod pan la 'chang stobs bcu'i rtsal/ / lhun/ grub zab rgyas chos kyi gdong lnga'i sgra/ // bsgrags mdzad shākya seng ge la phyag 'tshal/ / ring mo nyid nas tshogs zung yon tan ma la ya yi dri bsung gis/ //rbongs pa'i blo ngan 'thibs po kun 'joms shes rab ches cher rab tu gsal/ / mdzad bzang lo 'dab spug po'i 'khur ldan grags snyan srid pa'i rnam par mdzes/ / dus gsum rgyal ba bong kha pa zhes kun gyi ral pa'i bla na mchod/ / rgyal ba'i lung bzang dmachos/ tu skyong ba la/ / rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las glog gi zlos gar can/ / ma rung snying rtsa sgog mar 'byin pa'i gzi/ / bzod par dka' ba'i srung mas rtas/ tu skyongs/ / zhes thog mar dbe/ ba'i mchod brjod kyi phreng ba hrung zad spros nas ska bas don gleng bar bya ba ni bod dang bod chen po'i rgyal khongs su gtogs pa'i nang tshan mdo khams chab mdo'i yul du zhwa ser ring lugs — —— 540 ——

'phel rgyas kyi gzhi 'dzin byams pa gling zhes yongs su/ grag/sa pa'i chos sde chen po 'di nyid rja so ra /3jam mgon bla ma bong kha nga chem pos gnas 'dir 'bas kyis bcas/ skabs mgon po phyag drug pa dang/ gnas brtan bcu drug 'a/la gzis//sa shing/ ma 'ongs pa na /'phag/sa nga/ kun las bdag tu bzung ba'i bshad sgrub gyi chos sde chen po zhig 'byung bar lung bstan/ pa bzhin rab byung brgyad nga lī me rmo/ sbru' gyi gnam lor rje bdas/ nyid chen po'i dngos slob byang sems/ rmes rab bzab pos phyag/ 'debs par mdzad de sde sgod 'dzin pa sum sto/nga lhag tsam 'dus/ par rje gong che bsod nam sa rgya mtsho ya na ma/la/ sa shing grub pa'i rnam thar can gyi gdan rabs rim byon gyi nang tshan o rgyan chen po'i gter lung las/ da lta 'i bska ba dpal brtsebs 'di ཿ ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la ཿ rnam zhes bya ba'i sa phyogs su/ ཿ 'phags pa'i mi rtsan mug ngo/ pa ཿ 'khor ni lnga brgya lhag tsam 'byung ཿ kham pa 'dul 'ing byams/ nga/ bzhengs ཿ snyan brgyud chos kyi bdag po ste ཿ zab don chos kyi sgo lang phye ཿ zhes gsungs pa bzhin 'phags pa lha sku phreng rim byon las sku phreng gsum pa nas bzung yab sras sbu phreng rim par 'jags bskyangs kyi bshad sgrub gnyis phyogs nas dar rgyas shin tu che ba byung 'dug rung chu byi lo log smon rgya dmag gis kla klo'i rang rtags las kyang shin tu ngan pas dgon gnas grong khyer snod bcud rtsa brlag tu btang / gzhung dgon rnying khungs la brten bstan pa mchod sbyin gyi mnga' bdag gnam bskos gzhung sa dga' ba brgya ldan pas bod ljongs bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde rtsar sdeg gron la 'dzem med kyi sa rta lo sa sde rang gzugs rang bdag thog 'di ga'i bkod 'brel chos sde snga sor chud pa gsar btab dang 'brel bar mtshan nyid kyi rtsod grwa bar lam —— 541 ——

nyams mad du gyur pa'ang lcag/sa rta nas gsar 'dzubs byed bcus/ nga/ bcas chos sde 'di nyid kyi dge 'dun nga rnams nas spangs blangs khri/ mas su bca' ba'i rim pa cung zad brjod pa ni/ de yang sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed nga 'i skabs la sdom pa 'bob/ pa po'i mkhas slob brtan mkhas kyi yon kan ka/nyis dang ldan/ zhing kha smo/nga gi chos/ dgu ldan gyi drung du sdom pa nod pa po rang blung/ 'gal rkyen bar chad ba'i/ dang bral zhing mthun rkyen nges pa lnga tshang ba'i sgo nas sdom/ gsum rim gyis nod pa sgyums dge tshul slong gang gi sdom pa dang dgon g.yin nas sa/ma/sa da/byung byas pa rnams chos sde 'dir mi 'jus/ thob pa mi nyams pa srung ba'i skabs la rtag/ tu dran shes bag yod/ dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ji ltar khas blangs pa'i sdom pa so so'i ngo bo nges pas bslab bya'i ribs spyi dang bye bras/ rnams la spong blang nam/ tan gces spras su/ bya/ de yang tshogs su phebs skabs gral du bgres rim gyi phebs nas bzhugs gral du 'khod bstun 'al /'don gdang da/byangs lhug 'dur gang yin yang dbu mdzad dang bstun pa las/ lnga phyi gong 'og 'dzol ba/ gtam 'chol bzhad gad rgyang dang ka bar snye ba sogs mi mdzes pa'i rigs mi byed rnam pa kun tu skra sor gang lhag 'jog pa/ chab sla' las tshan las byed de byings nas gos phu dung ma sogs khyem pa'i rtags 'chang ba/ glu gar sho sbag sogs kyi rtsed 'jo/ tha mi kha dang / rna tha/ shig ras la sogs spyad pa/ skabs min rnga rol 'bud dkrol skad cor rgyangs 'bod kyis mtshon pa'i khyim pa sun 'byin cing dge 'dun gyi nang khrims dang 'gal ba'i rigs dngos shugs nas mi byed/ chang ni nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba dang phung dkrol kun gyi gzhi yin pas / na/nga mchod/ chang phud tsam las ser mo bas rtswa rtse'i zil pa tsam yang longs spyod ——— 542 —

rgyu lta ci/ dgo/na nang 'khyer 'grem mi chos/ cing / de 'brel mar thang du 'grem /3grul/ mang ma nag chang gi/ nyes pa yo nga ba'i gzhir 'dug pas// dgon 'di'i grwa rigs za/mas mas dke bskos la gnang ba'i 'dzin/ thel zhus nas thon te dge bskos mas kyang dbo/na thog nyi ma / ma/ zhud kyi bar du de ring song ba'i the'u bsdu ba dang/ sang 'gro dgos rnam sa la the'u sbyin/ sros/ bcad pa'i sha 'di rang cag byams/ brtse mi tshe ba'i khya/ nga/ nga ra du byas pa'i bstan la zhugs pa rda/ma ma kyis btsa/ med ci dgar spyod pa mi mdzes nga/ 'dus/ nga/sa tshog/sa su tshos ma'i rdor bsil dang chab zhugs lta bu'i za/bas las sha sko la 'grem spyod mngon tshan/ che ba mi bya/ ar las dang ka/ la 'ur lta bur 'a/la ngor gnang ba zhu ba tsam/ 'a1sa de bying zam yar ma dkar thang ma/ ra mo che tshun khyem pa'i rtag/sa 'chang ba 'dug tshe zhal ngo nas rtsad gcod kyis chad pa 'gel// bye brab/ rnam grol gling gi grwa tshang se ra sngags pa'o gal bcar phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang dang phyogs mtshungs sngags grwa rang 'jags la dge bsko sa zur bskol kyi na/nga khul sgrig lam gnon bsdim sngar lam nyams med chab bla'i sgrig yig zur gsal ltar mtshan grar bzhugs mos su yod bkag med las dpe cha ba che 'dzug ma dgos shing sgrub khag brgyad po ser byed phyogs mtshungs/ khang tshan re'i khongs kyi rang rang mos brtson blo nus dang bstun pa'i thos bsam lhur len thog tu dngos gzhi'i dpe cha'i rkang 'dzin sngar rgyun dbyar gnas nang don sgrub sde che khag gnyis so sos gra bzhi re chung khag drug so sos gra gnyis re'i cho ga 'dzin rgyugs rdzogs shing blo gsal lo gzhon lo ltar bzhugs gtong la mkhan po mdo sngags gnyis kar mkhas nges drag sprugs bsko bzhag gis rang lugs bshad sgrub srol bzang gong du 'phel — 543 ———

thabs 'khur che lhod med dgos shing sde 'di dmu tshos/sa yi dam re'i bdas/ mdun dbang chog yongs rdzogs tshog/sa rgyun snga shā4ma nyams med dgos par brten chos thog jo bar sgrol sher 'don grangs so gas yul dus kyi la sa dmigs su bsal dgos ma gtogs nga//pe cha ba gsar bu 'jug rim bzhum/ma / nas sgrig nyams su len tshul/ nga/byar ston chos thog gong du 'dzin/ rgyugs// sprod len/ sogs ser byes grwa tshang dang phyogs mthon ngos ga/zhung la 'jug pa'i rim pa yang / bsdus grwa nas mdzod bar rim ba'i na thos bsam nyams 'os/ tu chud nas sngar rgyun rab 'byams pa'i mi/nga btags len/ zla nga bahru gcig pa skor nas dgun chos sgrub khag so so'i khongs su 'don chog ma chag pa byed pas tshogs bar dpe khrid brtse bzhag tshogs grol nas brtsi bzhas/ bskyar sbyangs/ 'jug tu rtsod brda dang dam bca' tshugs lo ltar tsha 'phrul zla 1tshes 1 nas tshes 15bar lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i phyag srol bzhin mchod pa sna lnga stong tshar 'bul gsham dang 'brel mtshan nyid grwa tshang dang sgrub khag mnyam tshogs kyi tshogs thun gnyis la mang ja gnyis re btang thog bla mchod bde stong dbyer med ma/ gnas brtan phyag mchod/ ngo ring 'tsho'i smon tshig bstan 'bar ma/ gsung chos sgron lam/ dam bca' bcas gsar btsugs rnams tshul bzhin bya/ mdo phyogs thos bsam song nas blo nus dang bstun sngags la 'jug par rgyun 'don gtan la 'bebs lugs dang nyams su len tshul sogs dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang dang phyogs mtshungs bsnyen rdzogs dmangs khongs sngags chog blo 'dzin rdzogs min la ma ltos par 'jug de byings bsnyen rdzogs dmangs su gsar zhugs rnams nas 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i bdag bskyed 'dzin rgyugs ma 'phrod bar — 544 —

mi 'jug/ skor zla bcu nga ri/ lnga ma tshad dang nyid ldo ga dgu chung / dgu/ chen sogs la 'jigs byed bcu sa/sum ma'i mngon rtogs/ drug cu ma'i lcas/sa ma khar// chos skyong khag gi bskang tshogs rgyas pa rnams bsnyen rdzogs dam ngas tshog/sa yo/ngas da/nga / 'jam dgo/na bla mar mgon ngo phyag drus/ pas 'a/la tsa/zigs par grags ba'i sa gnad mgon khang du sngon/ yod da/ge slong nyi shu rtsa brgyang thos gzhung gnas gra/ ba'i/ dang // rjes 'phar bcas khyom/ grwa sum cu so sa/sum nam nyin/ re skyabs se/mas/ ltung bshags/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma/'jis/sa byed bcu gsum ma'i bdag bskyed/ mgom/ ngo/ phyag drug/ pa da7//ra mag zhal ba'i/ chos rgyal phyi nang // dmag zor ma// rnam sras / lcam sring bcas chos skyong rnams kyi bskang chog rgyas pa dang 'brel bar bskang bshags tshar sa/sum re rnams nyin bzhin rgyun gtong chag med byed/ bsnyen rdzogs bcu nas lo phyed sa/nyis ring 'jigs byed bdud las rnam rgyal gyi bsnyen chen/ bsnyem/ rdzogs grwa bcu tham pa nas lo gcig tu skyabs 'gros mtshon sngon 'gro 'bum bzhi dang / dmigs brtse ma/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i las rung rgyas pa/ mgon po phyag drug pa/ chos rgyal phyi nang sogs bsnyen mtshams bshol zla dang bcas pa rtag tu chag 'gyangs med par gtong dgos rgyu'i mtshams khag gnyis kar rnying pas bsnyen mtshams them pa dang / gsar pa de 'phral 'jug pa nyin snga rjes las mi 'gyangs pa dang /gra sgrub so sos rang rang yi dam gyi las rung yang sngar rgyun bzhin tshad ldan byed/ bslab pa yongs su spyong ba'i thabs gzhi gsum gyi phyag len 'dul 'dzin pa'i yig cha gsal byed bcas pa'i dgongs don nyams med skyongs dgos par hor zla drug pa'i nya na/sa dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum ring rnams grol la 545 la

grwa tshang bsnyen rdzogs dam/ngas la/ mtshan nyid/ chos gra pa/ gzhan — long mos pa su yod rdams nas 'gal med kyi de'i ring rtsa /'jus/ rgyan gsum sogs chos spyod rnams re mos dang / bhan ltar lam rim bcas 'chad nyan /rtags gas la gtong ba rnams chag med byed1/ zla ba byung ngo cig gi yar mar gyi gso sbyongs dang // bkris da/nga / gnod pa bzlogs gos sbyangs skabs bsnyes mtshams par dang / nad mnar ltas gsal rnams las de byings slob dpon/ rnams nas bzungs dge tshul yan tshang ma yong / bstan srid 'bas rim dang skeg bcos lta bu'i skabs las/ rnying bon gtong thabs sogs grub mtha'i bsri lhad mong gzhi mi chog tshogs 'du lnga phyi'i skor zla 1 1tshes ldanas mgon mgul bskang ros pa'i nyin gsum rdo gcal gzhung du skabs 'gro/ sgrol sher sogs gsung thi/nga / de rjes tshogs yongs bsdu tshags gi nyin bdun bar 'ur 'don byed pa'i nyin dang po gnyis la sher snyeng tshar gsum re dang / de rjes rtsa gdugs re mos kyis 'don/ tshes 17nas nyin brgyad bar dgong ja tshogs dgos par 'ur 'don du gsang 'dus sgrub sde nas gsang chog dang yi dam cho ga de byengs dge 'dun rnams nas rtsa gdugs dang / dge slong rnams nas spyin sreg tshes 2 5nas rdo gcal gzhung du sngags rgyun tshugs par rgyud sde so so'i bdag bskyed blangs/ sngags rgyun grol nas 'du khang du nyin gnyis ring rtsa sher tshar re dang / nyin gsum par rtsa sher/ chos spyod sogs mtshon rgyun tshugs/ zla 12tshes 1༷nas rdo gcal du bskang re pa nas dgu/ 'og ma'i 'ur 'don nyin gnyis dang / de rjes tshogs dmangs nas nyin gnyis bar sher snying tshar gsum te/ de mtshams nas tshes 2 4bar rtsa gdugs re mos — 546 ———

kyi 'don/ tshes 25nas nyin gsum bar rdo gcal gzhung du sngags rgyun gong mtshungs dang / sngags rgyun grol nas dbyar yod dge 'dun rnams 'du khang du tshogs pas nyin gsum kar rtsa sher tshar re/ zla 2tshes 2nas tshes 12tshes bar tshogs bar tshogs yongs nas 'du khang du dus bzang gi smon la bzhin 'brel 'don/ sgrub mchod brgyad kyi mchod dpon rnams nas spyan 'dren khrus gsol/ tshes 5 shā 10 12rnams la dbyar bdag slob dbon gang yin nas bsngo ba mthun gyur dang chos bshad sogs rgyas pa byed/ tshes 14la tshogs dmangs nas smon lam 'don/ gung tshigs grol nas nyin snga ma ltar bya/ tshes 15nyin dge slong rnams nas phyogs bzhi'i mchod 'bul/ rgyal ba mi pham mgon po'i snang brnyan shing rta thog tu gdan 'dren pa sogs gling bskor ser sbrel sbrel dang / grol bston 'du khang du gsang 'dus shing brjod sogs sngar lam gyi phyag bzhes ma nyams pa byed/ zla 4tshes 1༷nas nyin gnyis par bskang re pas gtso dgon bzhugs tshogs yong nas tshogs chen sgo 'phyor du nyin ltar gdugs dkar tshar re 'ur 'don tshes 15nyin rtsa sher dang / dgong khar tshogs chen sgo drung nas dbu 'dzugs pa'i rtsa bskor byed/ zla6tshes 16nas zla ba gcig ring tshogs chen sgo 'phyor du 'ur 'don/ rje 'gong ma bsod nams rgya mtsho'i gzim khang sa yul du mdo smad spyi 'doms bka' blon las 'phar sman stod pa de nyid skabs gzhung gnas nas/ sku lnga'i dgon khang gsar bzhes dang 'brel dkon gnyer gcig dang / rgyun bskang gra bzhi/ ched 'dzugs thog yi dam rta mgrin yang gsang gi las byang lnga pa'i gsung rdo rje'i sgra dbyangs/rgyal po sku lnga'i gsol mchod rdo rje sgra dbyangs bcas btsugs pa rnams dang —— 547 — —

gong gsal dgu gong 'og gi sngags rgyun/ dgong ja/ rgyun gyi mang ja dus bzang smon lam dgun tshogs rnams la slob zur/ spyi bso las zur/ gzhung bskos gnyer khag las tho rnams las de byings la dmigs bsal dgongs pa byin ster med/ nyams na phyir bcol ba'i skor la/ sdom pa'i mi mthun phyogs nyes ltung phra ba rnams gzhung bzhin bshags/ rtsa ba bzhi dang /myos 'gyur gyi btung bar longs spyod/ mi mang kha bsgril phyogs 'then gyi dge 'dun rtsod 'khrug slong ba'i 'go rtso dang / ngan rgyab byed gte/ las sner kha lag lan len slog pa rnams chad las ji ltar 'os pa dang 'brel bar gnas nas dbyung thog pham pa byung ba rnams nas so so'i grwa tshang khongs su kha btags/ nyes chad rgya dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga sgrub rje shog thod mdo sgrub dang 'brel bar gnas nas bskrad/ de byengs lag 'thab sogs len rtsa che rigs dang / khyim pa sun 'byin cing / dge 'dun gyi nang khrims dang 'gal ba sogs kun spyod ngan pa byung ba rnams la len rtsar dpags pa'i nyes bkod drang 'brel 'dom nges gtong / gzhung gi las tshan/ chab mdo'i bla phyag chos gra'i mkhan po 'du gra dang / gnyer chen phyogs thon rnams phud de byengs mtho dman su thad nas bskor lam nang tshun du rta bzhon pa/skabs min gri thog khyer ba/ me mda' dang nor gcan rgyun nyar byed pa/dgon gyi sa mtshams ka ba/ thog ti/ kyo ba dra mo che dang / mdun rgyab g.yas g.yon ri klung rnams nas rngon dang / rtsa shing btu ba/ dus mchod dang / ar las skabs lta bu las dgon gseb tu bud med 'gro ba dang /zhag sdod byed pa sogs rnam pa kun tu mi chog de 'dra'i dgon gyi bca' khrims las 'gal ba zhi drag su thad nas byung yang nyes pa che chung la dpags la 548 la

te zhal ngo dang / spyi bso mnyam sbrel/ don gnad gal che'i rigs la 'du grwa rnams dang / mkhan po bcas rtsa 'dzin nye 'gyangs phyogs lhung yangs pa'i drang po gzhung bsrangs 'doms nges dang / des kyang ma 'chun na chos srid 'khur 'dzin sogs chab bla rang khungs skabs sbyar bstan rgyun la man pa'i rgyab gnyer dgos rgyu/ spyi bso mtshon spyi sger mchod gnyer rnams nas mchod thebs sngar yod dang gsar sbyor byung ba rnams la bgri tshag gces spras thog bun gtong dang / tshong spel sogs thabs 'pho gang yod kyi mi nyams gong 'phel las/ mchod rgyun chad phum zom 'jog bsnyen bkur je zhan je phrar ma song ba'i gtong sgo gang ci chag nar med par mchod yul gang cher bsam pa'i dus gtong dgos rgyu/ dgon pa'i chos gzhis grwa rgyun/ mi rtsa sogs da lta phan gnas shing 'jags pa'i dbang rigs gtan 'jags las/gzhung sger mchog dman sus kyang bsgyur bkod 'gro ga/zhi'i rigs gtan nas mi chog dgon pa'i lar rgya bshed sgrub bya ba dang bcas pa je mtho je rgyas su 'gro ba'i mthun rkyen gang 'gro lhur len dgos pa dang / mdor na dge 'dun pa rnams nas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa mig gi 'bras bu ltar gzhi byas la mdo sngags kyi don rnams thos bsam go rim ma 'chol bar nyams med/rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyas shing thos don sgom bsam rang rgyud la spyor bas nyams su len pa sogs rang gzhan gyi tshogs gnyis bde blag tu rdzogs pa'i thabs bla na med pa'i 'bad brtson lhod med bgyis pa rnams la chos mthun lam du lhong pa'i skyabs 'jug bgyid yod cing / ci ste bsgo ba rnar zon pas bca' khrims la ji mi snyam pas mtshon 'dir tshig gsal 'khod min la ma lhos par bshad sgrub mthun la 549 ————

rkyen dang bcas par gnod 'gal log par 'gro ba shar na chos srung yi shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyis bka' chad drag po thog tu 'bebs pa 'don mi za zhing /'di nas kyang rjes gnon nyang rtsad rgyab gnon yan bor ma song ba bgyid rgyu bcas de don ji srid bar rtsa 'dzin nyams len tshul bzhin yong ba 'tshal/'dir smras pa/ phun tshogs rnam par dag pa'i gru dzing la/ brten nas thar lam nor bu'i gling mchog tu/ rab bgrod don gnyes 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byor la/ 'gro ba mtha' dag longs su spyod gyur cig zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge sa steng rgyal bstan yongs la mnga' dbang bsgyur ba pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum pa shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drug pa'i nang tshan id ra ces pa chu pho sprel lo'i zla tshes dge bar nor gling bde skyid kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bres/ / / /

tā la'i blaXm sbu prengaXbazuXgasum pas sbas gnasaXpad ma bkod gten khongs mkhan ljongs eXwam bde chen chos 'khon la bstsal ba'i bca' yigachu sprel/ (spyi lo 192 2 )bod zla 5tshos 29nyin zhib 'jug song /oṃ su ste/ skal bzang rnam 'dren rgyu skar bye ba'i dbus/ / thugs bskyed snang ba mchog gis mngon 'phags pa/ / zas gtsang sras po smra ba'i zla ba des/ / 'gro la dge legs bdud rtsi'i gru char bsnyel/ / bde gshegs gsung rab kun gyi snying po'i phul/ / rnam dag tshul khrims gser gyi bye ma can/ /yan lag brgyad ldan 'dul ba'i gang ga ma/ / mkha' khyab skye rgu'i gdung sel mchog der bsngags/ / bstan pa'i nang mdzod sde bzhi'i lung gi don/ /blang dor 'jug sgo'i bca' khrims 'di spel na/ /bka' srung zhing bcu'i khrag la rol ba'i tshoṭa/ /dus kun dge ba'i mel 'tshe ma g.yel zhi/ga /de yang dus gsum mkhyen pa slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi lung zin sbas yul pad+ma bkod du bdud 'joms bla ming pas gsar btab gter khongs mkhan ljongs e wam bde chen chos 'khor dgon gyi grwa rigs rnams bslab — 551 —

khrims mtha' gtsang zhig byung na bstan 'gro spyi sger yongs la sman yon shin tu che gshis/ sde 'dir 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams lag len nyams su bstar bya'i rim pa ni/ lo tshig dang bstun so sor thar pa rigs brgyad kyi sdom pa gang 'os nod de ji ltar khas blang rang rang gi bca' khrims phra rags mig 'bras ltar bsrung bar bya zhi/nga / bslab pa yongs spyong gi gzhi gsum nyams len gang ci 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i dgongs don phyi ci ma log par nyams len nan tan byed/ byang sems dang / gsang sngags kyi sdom pa'ang rtsa ba dang yan lag gis nyes ltung gi dri mas ma gos par rnam par dag pa gzhi bzung thoganyams len gang ci o rgyan smin grol gling gi lugs bzhin lag len khungs btsun thog zla ba ngo re bzhin yar mar gyi gso spyong chag med dang / lo ltar dbyar gnas dgag dbye dang 'brel ba'i thog 'dus grwa rnams nas byang chub sems sdom/ bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs bka' gter khungs ldan bla med rdo rje theg pa'i dbang lung nod de rgyud sdom gsum ldan du sgrub nas dam sdom bslab bya'i gnas las nam yang mi 'gong ngos/ 'dus grwa rig rtsal mi dman pa rnams bshad grwa zur du btsugs te rtsis dkar nag gso dpyad sogs thun mong rig gnas kyi slob gnyer ci 'khyongs thog thun mim gzhung lugs spyi dang / spyod 'jug sdom gsum/ rgyud gsang ba snying po rnams kyi bshad pa thog mtha' 'khyol ba lo re chag med sgrigs su chug pa'i thos bsam ldur len dang / rgan gras grangs bcad kyi rim khrod du sngon 'gro bsags spyong rim pa nas bzung dngos gzhi bskyed rdzogs kyi rnal 'byor so so'i man/ ngag nyams len du spyor ba dang tshang mas rgyun tshogs su rang lugs chos spyod kyi rim pa ni/ zla re bzhin yar mar gyi tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ gsol — 552 —

'debs/ tshes bco lnga gnas brtan phyag mchod dang 'brel bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam dang / ngos ring 'tsho'i spyon tshig tshes nyer dgu la dbang drag rdo rje gro lod kyi gter zor/ tshes sum byu la rdo rje phur pa'i 'phrin las dang 'brel bar bstan srung dam can rgya mtshor bskang bskul 'phrin bcol/lo ltar zla ba dang po nang bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sgrub chen/zla ba bzhi pa nang zhi khro dong sprug gi cho ga zla ba lnga par gu ru snang srid zil gnon gyi sgrub chen dang / bla ma gsang 'dus kyi sgo nas sprel zla tshes bcu'i dus mchod zab rgyas/ zla ba bcu gnyis pa'i nang dus rim rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub chen dang rjes 'brel drag zor las spyor gnad smin zab spros bcas lo 'khor bstar chags su ma nyams pa dus dang rnam kun gyi tshogs sgrub nyams len dang / 'don chog gdangs dbyangs/ dkyil 'khor bris thig 'bud dkrol brdung gsum gyi rol mo'i bye brag gar 'cham sogs rnyed pa 'tshol slad khungs med mkhas bzo ma yin par smin gling pa'i dpe srol khungs thub dang 'brel ba dgos rgyus mtshon rtsa bzhi gtso bor gyur pa'i bslab khrims rnams dge 'dun spyi khrims dang ma 'gal ba'i spang blang 'dzol med kyi sbas gnas su rgyal bstan 'phel rgyas su yun gnas 'byung ba'i rgabs tshul lhod med yong ba gyis/'dir smras pa/ thub bstan zla ba'i ma ma yang snying nor/ /rmad byung ring lugs nyin mor byed pa yi/ /'phrin las 'od kyi skye 'gror rgud pa'i mun/ /rab bcil phan bde'i snang bas khyab par shog / rab dkar 'dus sde'i pad tshal rnyog byed pa/ / nyon mongs brlang por spyod pa'i gnyis 'thung rnar/ / bag yod khrims su bca' ba'i lcags kyu yis/ / dul bas rnam thar — 553 —

gtsang mar gnas par shog / ces go bar bya ba'i yi ge sa steng rgyal bstan yongs la mnga' bang bsgyur ba pad dkar 'chang ba'i skye phreng bcu gsum shākya'i dge spyong ngag dbang blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho 'jigs bral dbang phyug phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sdes rab byung bcu drug nang tshan id ra zhes pa chu pho sprel lo'i zla 5tshes 26dge bar nor gling bde skyid kun dga' 'khyil pa'i bskal bzang pho brang nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bris te bod ljongs lha mis phul ba'i gser dam chen mo bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan (1/ / / /

srir/ spyong rwaXsgreng gis dge dgon/ kunaX'aphel glingaXl bstsal ba'i bca' yigashing khyi/ (thru lo 192 4 )zla 11tshes 12nyin zhib 'jus/ song /mtha' dag rnam kun mkhyen nyid gang gi blo/ /kun tu bzang por spyod pa'i grags pa yi/ /ba dan srid zhi'i zur phud blar gnon pa/ /rgyal kun bdag po 'di yi sde 'di skyongs/ /rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rgyud du de nyid kyis/ /bkod pa'i lnga phrag rgud pa'i gdung sel ba/ / pad dkar lta bur grags ba'i dri bsung ni/ /zhing kun dog por byed des dge legs stsol/ /glog zhun bye ba'i lang tsho smin legs su/ /nol sgeg ut+pal mtshon cha'i sgyu thabs kyis/ /srid gsum brtan g.yo 'gugs mas khrims ldan sde'i/ /bung ba 'bum phrag pad mo'i tshal 'dir phobs/ / rgyal kun 'phrin las ut+pal dkar po yi/ / zil dngar 'chi med bcud du 'dzags pa gang / /ut+pal lcug phran g.yo pa'i phyag rgya yis/ /tshe dpal mchog sbyin mdzod cig myur skyobs ma/ /shin tu 'jam zhing zhi ba'i dpal ldan yang / /rnam 'byed ral gri rnon lo'i 'khrul 'khor gyis/ /mtha' dag 'ching rgya gcod pa'i dpa' bo che/ /khyod kyis kun rmongs dgra srog gcod par smon/ /dad gsum kun mthong 'phyis pa'i do ra na/ /ye la 566 ——

thes mi nga brnyam bskyo da pa ji stsed/ rnga 4she /dge/ les/sa bas ma rgur 0jo ba'i norartsebu'i sprin/ //bstebs la dgyes pa'i bka' drin 'dzir stsol cig / lta sgom spyod pa'i khyad par gyis lhag pa'i/ / blo bzang ring lugs bcud len rtag ba'i ba pas/ / rnam thar gtsang ma'i lang tsho brtas pa'i 'u sa/ / mkhas kun bsngas/sa pa'i dga' ston lhur byos shig / zhes lhag pa'i lha mchos rnams 'a mtshod cing bsto da nga 'i me tog/ sngon du 'thor nas skabs non gleng bar bya ba ni / de mang bod dang bod gzhung si/ khongs su tsa/togs/ pa'i nang tshan nag shod/ 'bri ru khul du zhwa ser bstan pa'i bdas nyid chen po rig//sa sngags 'dzin pa stag phu pad ma badz+ra bcom lda na 'das 'phags4 ma sgrol mas bstan srid spyi bye'i sand dmigs dang / lhag par mtha' dmas/ khag rbon du rang gter lha tshogs bzhugs pa'i gtsug lag khang 'a/sa bzhi'i dbyibs can 'phral du ga/sar bzhengs dgos pa'i gsang ba'i lung byang phebs pa bzhin bstan 'gro kho/ nar thugs 'khur che bskyed kyis rab byung 15lcags sprel lor lha khang gzhi gting nas gtsang khang dbus la rgyas pa'i las mthun ser po gru ba'i/ rang sa/ter lha tshogs dang / de'i steng zhi ba'i las mthun lha khang dkar po thrum po rje 'bangs nyer lnga/ gtsang khang g.yas khang gi las mthun dmar po zla gam du grub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs/ gzhan yang chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po blon 'khor sogs lha khang mang du bzhengs/ rab gnas sogs grub nas bstan pa chab srid dang / mtha' dag bzlos pa'i las spyor rtags thon mang du mdzad/ lha khang thor nyams mi 'byung ched gnyug mar gnas ba'i dge 'dun gyi sde gsar 'dzugs mdzad de gnas tshul rnams rang cag rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dam pa gong sa skyabs mgon rgyal dbang thams —— 556 la

cad mkhyen gzig/sa bka' drin zla med sku phreng bcu gsum/ pa chen por snyan sgron zhus par dgyes brtse'i dbugs dbyung dge ldan lub/sa bzang kun 'phel gling zhes pa'i mtshan gyi byin gyis brlabs nas sgrub sde'i spyi'i mthun rkyen thabs shes byed 'os sogs mi nyams gong 'phe'/ dar rgyas yun ring gams thabs dgos pa sog/sa bka' bzang rgas mngon par gzengs bstod mdzad ba bzhin 'di mas kyang sgrub sde 'di nyed kyi dge 'dun nga rnam/sa mas sprangs blangs khrem sa su bca/lda ba'i rim pa hrung zad brjod pa ni de yang sdol ma thob pa thob par byed pa'i thabs la/ sdom pa 'bog/ pa po'i mkhan/ slob brtan mkhas kyi yon/ tan gnyis dang ldan zhing / kha skong gi chos dgu ldan gyi drung du sdom pa nong/ pa po rang nyid 'gal rkyen bar chad bzhi/ dang bral zhing mthun rkyen nges pa lnga tshang ba'i sgo nas sdom gsum ri ched/ gyis nod pa las dge tshul slong gang gi yang sdom pa med pa dang / dgon sa/zhan nas gnas dbyung byas pa rnams chos sde 'dir mi 'jug thob pa mi nyams par srung pa'i thabs la rtag tu dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas ji ltar khas blangs pa'i sdom pa so so'i ngo bo nges pas bslab bya'i rigs spyi dang / bye brag rnams la spangs blangs nan tan gces spras su bya/ de yang tshogs su phebs skabs gral du bgres rim gyis phebs nas bzhugs gral du 'khod bstun zhal 'don gdangs dbyangs lhug 'dur gang yin yang dbu mdzad dang bstun pa las/snga phyi gong 'og 'dzol ba/ gtam 'chol/ bzhad bgad/ gyang dang /ka ba snye ba sogs mi mdzes pa'i rigs mi byed/ rnam pa kun tu gos zhwa zla gam gding ba sogs rab byung ba'i rtags chas rnams tshang zhing / dgon gyi las tshan re zung las de byings gos phu dung ma sogs khyim pa'i rtags 'chang ba/— 557 —

skra so ra gang lhag/ 'jog pa/ glu sa/ra/ tho sbag/ sogs kyi rtsed 'jo/ tha mi kha/ dang / sna tha shig/ ras la longs spyod pa/ skabs min rnga rol 'bud dkrol/ skad cor rgyang 'bod kyis mtshon pa'i khyim pa bsun 'byen cing / dge 'dun gyi nang khri/ mas dang 'gal ba'i rigs dngos shugs nas mi byed //chang 'di nyes pa kum gyi rtsa ba dang / phung dkrol kun gyi ga'i yin pas ma/nga mchod/ chang phud tsam las// ser mo bas rtswa rtse'i zil nga/ tsam ya/nga longs spyod rgyu lta ci/ dgon nang 'khyer 'gri/ma mi chos/ cing / re 'brel grong khyim du 'grul 'grim mang na nag chang gi nyes nga yo/nga ba'i ga/zhi 'dug pas dgom 'di'i grwa rigs rnams nas dge skos 'a/ sa/nang ba'i 'dzin thel zhus te sprel zla'i tshes bcu yol nas/ zla 6tshes 1 ༈bar dang dbyar gnas grol nas zla ba gcig tsam ring grwa so so'i nang du 'gro sdod chog nga/ las de phan dgon du gtan sdod kyis tshogs chos 'grim zhing / 'dzin skyor sbyangs la brtson dgos pa dang / dgon gyi 'char can mchod phogs sngon yod nyams med thog skya rtsa so so nas kyang 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen ldeng nges sbyar dgos/ srog bcad pa'i sha 'di rang cag byams brtses mi 'tshe ba'i khyad par du byas pa'i bstan la bzhugs pa rnams kyi bag med sbu dgar spyod pa mi mdzes par 'dug pas tshogs su tshol ma'i rdor bsil dang / chab zhugs lta bu'i skabs las/sha skam 'gres spyod mngon tshan che ba mi bya/ ar las dang / khral 'ul lta bur dge skos la gnang ba zhu ba tsam las/ de byings khyem pa'i rtags 'chang ba 'dug tshe dge skos nas brtsad gcod kyis chad pa 'gel/ 'dzin chos kyang lo gsum bar bshar sbyar tshogs rgyugs dang / 'don cha ma nges pa'i rigs bla ma las sner skru rgyugs sprod dgos/ gzhan yang rol dbyangs/— 558 —

thi/yo tshon sreng gling gar 'cham / gtor bzo so ba//sa phu/ma du phyin pa slob spyo nga ngang dbyar ga/na/sa dang / smos/ 'a / /ma / chen mos dbus dus / tsa/tor skabs/ spyi don ba 'a che'i ris/sa la phram/ bu 'gro dgos byung na bla ma 'a/sa/ sner gnang ba zhu ster las thams cad tshog/sa dbo/sa ba dang / spyi mchod rnams mas kyang rtsa ba'i rtsis sprod dang // lo mang dus mchong / mtshad sa/tor dkar me tshams deb ga/sal zhwa chags/ med/ pa gtong dbros/ dbo/ma gyi 'tsho 'dzin dgon khas/ be gra rgyum/ rnams kyang 'don cho4 thes yen/ so sa/sa chos srid la ra spyor ban thogs nges ba/bos rgyu/ 'tsho pa'i ban /sril snams kyang 'das grong nga/nga ches /3tsho zin min gyi tshab gsar du 'phra' 'dzus/sa dbo/sa rgyu dang // lo 'bo/ ra rgyun ja rgyum/ thug// re dang / phob/sa grwa rer dngul sra/nga lnga re/ 'bru phos//sa ma lnga re bca sa chags ped nges 'bul thog bde sa/sang 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub mtshad dang // bla mchod bdi stong dbyer med ma //gnas brtan phyas/ mchod/ gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i zhabs brtam /stag phu sku thog snga rjes kyi dag snang nye brgyud rim pa'i sgrub mchod/ bstan 'bar ma/ mgon po phyag drug pa dkar nag zhal ba'i// chos rgyal phyi ma/nga // dmag zor ma// rnam sras/ lcam sring sogs chos skyong kyi bskangs chog/ rgyas pa// bsnyen rdzogs bcu god na'i/ yid nga/ma lha'i las rung dang / bsnyen chen/ skyabs 'gro mtshon sngon 'gro bsag/sa sbyang sogs rtag tu chags 'gyangs med bar gtong dgos rgyu'i mtshams khag/ rnying pa bsnyen mtshams thim pa dang / gsar pa de 'phral 'dzugs pa nyin lnga rjes las mi 'gyangs pa dang / gzhan yang yid dam gyi las nung sgo kun nas tshad ldan byed/bslab pa yongs su sbyongs pa'i thabs gzhi gsum gyi phyag len 'dul 'dzin la — 659 — —

nga//ri yis cha gsal byed bcas pa'i dgongs / don nyams med skyongs dgos rgyu/zla ba byung ngo cos/ gi yar ma/ra gyi gso sbyongs dang / bkris dang gnod bzlog bso spyo ngas ska/bas bsnyen/ mtsha sta—/mu/ pa dang // nad ma nar ltas gsal rna/mas las de byings slob ba/ngo/na rnam/sa nas bzung dge/ tshul yang tshang ma yo/nga dgos /bstam srid 'bas rim dang ge/ga bsgos lta bu'i skabs las/ sa/tong thabs sogs bon chos grub ma tha'i bsre lhadaXyong ga'i/ mi chog cing / g.yon yang tshogs 'du spra phyi slor 'a rang gter zab chos dag snang si/ rim pa dang //dkyil 'khor chem ngo 'i sgrub mchod kyis mtshon sngar phan phyag bzhes bzang po gang na ci yo da mi nyams par bo/nga 'phel du gnas pa byed/ nyams na phyir bcos pa'i thabs la/ sdom pa'i mi mthun/ phyogs nyes ltung phra ba rnams gzhung bzhin bkags/ rtsa ba bzhi dang myos 'gyur gyi btung bar longs spyod/ mi mang kha 'gril phyogs 'phen gyis dge 'dun rtsod 'khyus/ slong ba'i 'go rtsom dang / ngan rgyab byed gte/ snyems sner kha lan/ lag lan slog pa rnams chad las ji ltar 'os pa dang 'brel bar gnas nas dbyung thos/pham pa byung pa rnams nas snyes chad sgrub rjes shog thod mdo sgrub da/nga 'brel bas gnas nas bskrad/ de byings lag 'thab sogs lan rtsa che rigs da/nga // khyim pa bsun 'byin cing // da/be 'dun/ gyi nang khri/ mas las 'gal ba sogs kun spyod ngan pa byung ba rnams la lan rtsar dpags pa'i nyes bkod drangs 'brel 'doms nges gtong / dgon sa/zhung gi las tshan phyogs thon phud/de byings mtho dman su thad nas bskor lam nang tshul rta bzhon pa/ skabs min gring 'bog 'khyer ba/ me mda' dang / mda' 'phen pa/ nor gcan rgyun nyar byed pa dgon gyi sa mtshams ga/yas g.yon mdun rgyab ri klung —— 560 ——

rnam/sa mas sngo ra/nga / rtswa 'ing btu ba / dus ma chod dang / mar las zabs che bu las da so/na gseb tu ngud med 'gro/ ba dang /— 'ag sdod byed pa sog/sa rnam pa kun/ tu mi byed de 'dra'i da so/na gyi/ bca' khrims las 'gal ba 'i drag/ su/ thang nas byung yang nyes pa che chung la dpas/sa te bla ma las snge rtsa 'dzin nye 'a pa kyangs phyogs hūṃ nga spa ngas pa 'i drang ngo/sa gzhung bsrangs 'jo/mas nges bang / des kyang ma 'chun ma chos srid/ 'khur 'dzim sogs/ spyo sngod so so nas skabs sbya nga bstan rgyun pa// sman pa'i rgyab tsa/nyer dgos rgyu/ spyi bsos mtshon spyi sber mchong sa/nyer rnams nas mchod thebs sngar yod// gsar— spyo nga byung ba rnams la bsri tshag gnyes sprad thog/ bun gtong tshong spel sogs thabs 'khos gang yo/da kyis mi nyams gong 'phel las / mchod rgyun chad 'khums/zom 'jog bsnyem/ bkur je 'an je phrar ma song ba'i gtong sgo sa/nga 'khri chags nar med pa mchod yul gal cher bas ma pas sa/zab rgyas dus sa/tong dbo/sa rgyu/ dgon pa'i mchod pa dang / phogs thebs sa zhing / sems can 'jog yu/la gyi sa rig/sa grwa rgyu// mi rtsa so/gas da lta phan sa/nas 'ing 'jas/sa ya'i dbang rig/sa gtan 'jags las/ gzhung sger mchog dman su thad nas bsgyur bkod 'gro gzhi'i rigs ga tan nas mi chog/ pa ma/bo/ smad spyi 'doms ba/'a blon dang // hor 'tsho'i spyi 'doms ser skya rim 'byor nas btang ba'i lag 'khyer dang /'tsho pa so so nas mchod rgyun thog dad 'bul zhus pa'i dngos rigs/ sems can/ sa zhing / mi rtsa sogs sngar yo da gnad don 'gal med kyis dbo/na/ pa'i lar rgya bshad sgrub kyi bya ba dang bcas pa je mtho je rgyas su 'gro ba'i mthun rkyen gang 'gro lhur len dgos pa dang / mdo/ra na dge 'dun pa rnams nas lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab nga mig gi 'bras bu ltar ——— 561 —

bsrung bar byas ma mdo sngags kyi don rnams thos bsam go rim ma 'cho/ma bar mnyam/ meng/ rgyal ba gnyis nga/'i ring lugs dri ma med pa bshad sgrub gnyis kyi sgo nas rgyas ming / thos don sgom/ bsam rang rgyud la spyor bas nyams su len pa sogs rang sa/'an gyi tshogs ga/nyis bde blag tu rdzogs pa'i thabs bla na/ med par 'bad brtson lhod med bgyis pa rnams la chos mthun lam du lhongs pa'i skyabs/ 'jug bgyid yod cing /ci ste bsgo ba rnar gzon pas bca' khrims la ji mi snyam pas mtshon 'dir tshig gsal 'khod min la ma ltos par bshad sgrub mthun rkyen bcas par gnod 'as///ma log par 'gro ba shar na tshas srung ye shes kyi spyan ldan rnams kyi bka' chad drag po thog tu babs pa gdon mi za zhing 'di nas kyang rjes gnon nyang brtsad rgyab gnon yin por ma song ba bgyid rgyu bcas de don ji srid bar rtsa 'dzin nyams len tshul ba'i/na yong ba 'tshal/'dir smras pa/ so sor thar pa thub pa'i nang gi mdzod/ /yongs su bsrung ba'i rnam thar nor gyi bu/ /blo bzang lta sgom byi dor rnam gsum gyis/ /skye dgu'i ba dan bla na mdzes gyur cig / tshul ba'i/na gdams pa de bzhin spyod pa yi/ /khrims ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba ngur pa'i khyu/ /bshad sgrub mgrin rnga 'khrol ba'i tshom bu ni/ /zhwa ser ring lugs rgya mtsho'i dpal gyur cig / las bzhi'i 'phrin las rnam myur thog rgod shugs/ /'chang ba'i bstan srung dam can rgya mtshos kyang / /chos ldan bu bzhin skyong ba'i sdong grogs dang / /les/sa nyes stangs 'dzin bya ra ma g.yel mdzod/ / zhes go bar bya ba'i yi ge rab byung 16pa'i nang tshan dngos po zhes shing pho khyi lo'i zla 12tshes 2 1dge bar gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po tā la nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te srid tham bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /— —— 562 ——

sing smong rwa zangaXmis cho phar chos 'khon glingaX'agrom mas / ra sa / / da / / / / / la bstsal ba'i bca' yig sa stag (sbyi lo 192shā)oṃ su ste/ snyan pa'i bar na 'jig rten gsum na grags/ /dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra grags pa/ / thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog mdzod brnyes pa'i/ /'bas la tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus mchod/ /mkhyen rab 'jam dpal dbyangs dang gnyis su med/ / rab 'byams shes bya ma lus thugs su chud/ /'dzam gling mkhas pa kun gyi rgyan gcig pu/ /sa skya paṇa chen zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ /tshogs gnyis lhun po'i ngos las legs 'khrungs shing / /blo gros yal 'dab gzhan phan 'bras bzang gis/ /blo gsal gdul bya'i re ba skong mdzad pa'i/ /chos kyi rgyal po dpag bsam shing der 'dud/ /rdo phud chos 'khor gling gi 'dus tshogs kyi/ /blang dang dor bya nyams su bstar ba'i tshul/ / gsal byed bca' yig rmad byung ke ta ka'i/ / do shal mchog 'di kun gyi rgyan/ du chongs/ /zhes tshigs su bcad pa'i snyan tshig gi shis brjod sngon du btang nas gleng bar bya ba ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa sgrib gnyis kyi dgra tshogs ma lus pa bcoms shing yon tan mtha' dag mngon du mdzad zin pa'i 'dren pa mnyam med zas ga/tsang sras po'i lung dang rtogs la 563 ———

pa'i bdag nyid can gyi bstan pa rin po che ni/ ji skad du/ /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman/ gcig pu/ / bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig/ ces gsung ba ltar lha dang bcas pa'i yid can kun la gnas skabs mngon mtho dang /mthar thug nges legs kyi 'dod rgu ma lus pa 'byung ba'i sgo ni bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi spyi phud kun mkhyen nyi ma'i gnyen gyi lung rtos/sa kyi bstan pa rin po che 'di nyid dar rgyas kho nar rag las shing / de 'dzin gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir gdul bya so so'i ska—la ba dang 'tshams pa'i grub mtha' tshar du dngar ba'i nang tshan sa skya'i ring lugs 'dzin pa ma khas grub chen po sgra ba mngon shes su grags pas gtsug khang brgya dang bdun phyag btab pa'i nang tshan rdo phud chos 'khor du grags pa'i blang dor khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa ni slob dpon chen po dbyig gnyen gyis/ /tshul gnas thos dang bsam lngan pa/ /sgom pa la ni rab tu sbyor/ /'es gsu ngas pa ltar rang g.yin sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bsde ba'i don sgrub nga ra 'dod pa rnams kyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po cher 'jug sgo theg pa che chung gi chos tshul mtha' klas na'ang / yon tan thams cad kyi gzhi rten lhag pa tshul khrims kyi bslab pa yang dag par gnas te rim bzhi/ thos bsam sgol ga/sum la spyor dgos pas thog mar dgon 'di/ra gsar bzhugs pa rnams rab tu byung du rung ba'i 'gal rkyen bral zhing / mthun rkyen tshang min leg/sa par brtags nas rung mthun gyi gos dang / yo byad rnams tshang bar byas te bslab gzhi bcu 'dzin pa'i dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i bar rim blangs thog 'tsho ba'i yo byad kyang tshags su tshud par bya/ de yang dgon sde g.yon/ nas ga/nas dbyung rigs sgrigs su mi — — 564 ——

'jug lo nyi shu lon mtsham sa chos spyod 'don char gtogs pa gang na ci yod rgyugs sprod dang 'brel mkhan slob dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i spyan sngar/bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa yang dag par mnos/ bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa legs bar brten nas lung sde bzhi nas byung ba'i bslab bya'i gnas phra rags kyi 'jug ldog la mkhas pa'i khong du chud par bya/ dge tshul slong gang yin kyang rtsa ba bzhi/ las 'das na dge 'dun dang lhan cig chos dang zang zing gi longs spyod byar med/ pas gnas nas dbyung zhing ltung ba gzhan dag kyang phyir bcos kyis bshags bsdoms gzhung ba'i/na bgyis te rang rgyud la nyes ltung gis ma gos pa gtsang bar bya/ sbog chags phug ron yan rkyen thal dang yang nor zho gang las lhag pa'i dngos po phyi nang gang du'ang ma byin par blangs pa/ 'gyed phogs 'phar blangs sogs ra 'khrod na gnas nas dbyung / yang ma nyes pa'i rkun khag sogs byung tshe ngan khag 'dzugs mir 'gal tshabs la gzhigs pa'i nyes chad dang / tshogs gzhung du mang thus/ grangs phyag sogs kyi gcod rgya yan por ma song ba gtong / mi bsad sogs bsam spyor gnyis brnag gi tshul min tshabs che'i byed 'dzol byung tshe bca' yig sgrogs dang 'brel lus steng la rtsa ra bcad de gnas dbyung gis sgo'i phyir 'don pa dus mnyam chos khrims pas gaṇ+ḍi brdungs/ dkon gnyer nas dung tshag bud mdo tshar sa/sum bton nas dgu bzlog byas te nyes can ngo ma sa gnas khrims bdag la rtsis sprod byas rjes su thad nas grwa tshang la bsnyon rtsod mi chog 'thab rtsod rmas tshabs can shi mal du tshud pa'i nyen che byung na drag 'go ma thon bar 'gal can gnyis ka tshogs sgrigs bstag ste ja thug phogs skal rnams sa/cod/ drag skyes mtshams phyis lam 'doms pa'i gcod rgya gtong /—— 565 ———

de min rmas tshabs rigs 'gal tshabs la gzhigs pa'i rmas 'jal nyes chad dang byas nyes chung tshags rigs la tshogs gzhung du grang bcad kyi phyag dang /gral gsham 'jog pa sogs skabs bstun byed dgos/ phu thung can dang /gzan dkar nag spyon pa/ skra tshad las ring ba mtshon cha 'chang ba sogs ngan pa mig bslad du 'gyur ba'i cha gos ya ma zung gyon mi tshag tshogs gral du 'du ba'i tshe spyod lam bag yod kyi sgo nas bslab gral rgan rim ma 'khrugs par 'byon bzhugs kyis ma grol bar du gnyid log pa/ long gtam smra ba/bzhad bgad byed pa/ kha g.yengs mi g.yengs kyis blta ba/ gcig la gcig mnyed pa/ bza' btung la longs spyod pa'i skabs zas cag cag hub hub lces ldag pa sogs 'dul ba'i kun spyod dang mi mthun pa'i rigs mi bya/ grwa khang so so'i steng dang gleng gseb nye 'gram du skad rgyangs/ ku co//mchong / rdo sgor/ 'ur rdo 'phen pa khrims grogs med par bud med dang lhan cig dben par 'dug 'greng lam du rgyang grags brgal bar mnyam 'gro byed pa sogs gzhan gyi ma dad pa'i rkyen du 'gro ba'i khyim pa sun 'byen du 'gro rigs mi chog spyi pa gnyis kyi bogs shas sprod mi dang / ar las sogs kyi skabs las byed bsnyen bkur zhu mi'i sbyin bdag gnas skor ba sogs bud med rnams nyin mo dgon nang du bskyod dgos rigs skabs so sor chos khrims par gnang ba zhu sprod kyis gtong ba las/ dgon nang da/nga /grwa mi/ga la zhabs sdod mi chog chos khrims pas shing 'dren sogs kyi 'bod brda dgos dus bla brang gi steng nas ting ting brdung pa dang / gzhon 'dral rnams bskyod phyogs lhung gi bsam pas sde ris su bcad de dge 'dun gyi dbyen du 'gyur ba'i phung dkrol chen po byed mi byung na byed lte sgrigs dbyung la 566 ———

dang / gzhan ma le thogs kyi rigs la 'gal tshabs la gzhigs pas mang ja dang / thugs rgyal mtshan sogs babs 'os nyes 'doms bcad de rtsod pa chos phyogs su zhi bar byed/ 'gyur gyi btung ba longs spyod pa na myos ni nyes dmigs che bar gsung pas dngos shugs brgyud gsum du spyad par mi bya/gal te spyad pa mthong thos byung na thengs dang por chos khrims pas lus steng la rtsa ra rta lcags 5༷dang thengs gnyis par rta lcags 75gnad 'phrod gtong /des kyang lam nor ldog shes med pa'i chang 'thung 'gal tshabs gsum pa thon mtshams lus steng la rta lcags 1༷༷btang ste gnas nas dbyung / mgon khang phan tshun du nang mchod chang phud phran bu dgos nges rigs kyang mngon mtshan gyis blangs mi chog tha mi khar grags pa 'di yang bdud kyi sbon lam log pa'i mthu las byung bas sku gsung thugs rten gyi rab gnas nyams pa sogs nyes pa che bar slob dpon chen po'i gter lung sogs las rgya cher gsung par nges shes kyis ngo sgog gang par spyad par mi bya/ phyogs mtshungs rta bong phyugs sogs 'tsho skyong dang / tshong bun skyed/ nam zhing las sogs nam yang lag len mi chog snga dus dgon 'dir 'phags bod kyi mkhas grub dang / bye brag 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsungs rab dgong 'grel sogs la thos bsam sgro 'dogs mthil phyin gyis bka' bcu rab 'byams gra skor gtong sbol yod /'dug kyang bar lam 'chad sgrub gang ci gzugs brnyan tsam du gyur gshis mdo sde'i rgyan las/ / 'di na dang por thos la brten nas tshul bzhin yid la byed pa 'byung / / tshul bzhin yid la byed pa las ni yang dag don yul ye shes 'byung / che/sa gsung ltar thos bsam sgom gsum phyin ci ma log pa zhig byung na gnas skabs dang / mthar — 567 — —

thug gi don rgya chen po 'grub tu nges pas sngar lugs su ma song bar blo nus dang bstun pa'i rig gzhung rnams la slob gnyer gyis 'chad sgrub nyams pa sor 'chud kyi thabs la 'bad dgos shing / cis kyang de ltar ma thub che sdom gsum rnam nges dang / lam 'bras/ snang gsum/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi rtsa 'grel sogs lam thung mong ba dang / thung mong ma yin pa kye rdor la sogs pa mdo sngags kyi gzhung rnams la dbang lung 'khrid gsum tshad ldan yang dag par nod de thos bsam sgom gsum gyi kams len rnam par dag cing rang lugs gar thig dbyangs rol sogs cho ga'i yan lag mtha' dag la'ang nges par brtson pa lhur len dgos rgyu/ bla brang spyi pa las 'dzin rnams nas kyang las 'khur ring spyi don 'tsho ba'i 'du 'god kyi so nam dang tshong bun/rta bong dgos nges grangs bcad bcas dmigs bsal las de lhag sgrig lam kun spyod la gnod 'gal 'gro rigs mi chog slob dpon gsar bsko'i 'os 'char 'bul skabs gong 'khod slob gnyer rab 'bring gang rung zhig ma thon pa'i blun mtshang can 'os khongs mi 'jug slob dpon nas kyang chos spyod 'dzin spyong spel gsum gyi do dam 'khur bsam gang che dang 'brel bgyi ba gang ci bstan rgyun la sman thabs ldur len dgos rgyu/ bla pa'i sprod rigs dang / spyi pa/ dkon gnyer sog/sa kyi spyod khongs rten mchod dang / spyi rdzas gsar rnying sbas bzangs tshang bsgyur sogs tshul min rigs byung na brda 'ded yan por ma song ba gtong / chos khrims pa yang gdong gral gnyis kyi bka' rab 'byams bgres rigs nas dbyar dgun gyi zla ba drug te sngar srol ltar byed pa dang / de ring gtsug lag khang sogs phyi nang bar gsum du gad bdar gtsang sbra yid du 'ong ba'i bskul lcag dang 'brel bca' sgrigs dang —— 568 —

mthun pa'i sgrigs non che zhing nye ring phyogs lhung rang zon spangs te bstan pa'i mig rgyan la min nges gtso 'don dgos rgyu/ grwa rigs re zung nas bla ma dbu chos la ba mi med khyad gsod tshul min tshabs che'i rigs byung na gnas dbyung ngam/ spyi chad mang thug dang / brgya phyag 'gel ba sogs 'gal tshabs la gzhigs pa'i bkod 'doms byed/ rgyun zur gtong sgo gang yin kyang kha tsha rul sum can ma yin pa'i gang zab gtong ba dang / dad spyor 'char 'phar mang thug gi rgyu 'gro sogs ci byung dus skabs so sor sha khu sha thims su smin 'bul byed/ dmigs bsal yod nges las sne thon zin dang bslab rgan bgres gras/ nad pa/ mtshams pa dmigs bsal gtong 'os dngos 'brel rigs la ja rgyugs tshogs gzhung ltar skyog tshad kyis sprod len byed pa las/ de lhag ja rgyugs sprod len dang / tshogs su bskyod 'dzems kyis rung khang du ja 'thung ba sogs nam yang mi chog tshogs la phyis pa rnams la'ang chos khrims pas sdod pa'i brda ma byas bar phyag 'tshal 'jugaspyi bsod la bskyod skabs snod phad 'khur ba sogs sngar srol ltar gyi thogaganas tshang so so'i chas ka rkud pa tsam yang ma 'byar ba'i thog bsod stoms kyang gang sbyin dad rdzas dad len byed pa ma gtogs 'thab rtsod su thob dang /la/ ma star la rdo 'debs/ sgo khyi brdung ba/ zha mo gcus zha gyon pa/gzan gsham brjes pa sogs khyem ba bsun 'byin gyi rtsing spyod mtha' dag dor te zhi dul bag yod kyi 'gro 'dug spyod lam tshul bzhin dgos rgyu blang brang dang / gtsug lag khang phan tshun/ spyi khang khag bcas la gzhig ral che nges bcas byung na gsar rgyag nyams gso bya 'os spyi pa bla brang gnyis nas mgyis te nyams 'jig tu mi 'gro ba'i bdag gces byed cing rgyun gtan spyi — 569 la

khang gang yin rnams la sdod mi so sos dbo kha thigs tshags dang / gzhig ral phan bu byung na spyi srung pas 'phral 'phral byed/ rgyal sgo shar nub gnyis kyi mdun du tho rdo brtsegs tshun la nag chang gi 'grims 'grul dang / lus la go mtshon thogs pa/ don med rnam g.yeng 'du long rgya che'i rigs rnams byed du 'jug mdor na rgyal sras chen po zhi ba lhas/ 'dir ma spyos pa ci zhig dgos/ / dran pa dang ni shes bzhin dag / thams cad 'bad pas srung shig ces/ /bdag ni de ltar thal mo sbyor/ / zhes gsungs pa ltad dge 'dun bgres gzhon bar gsum tshang mas phyi nang nye 'gyangs kun tu 'dul ba'i sde snod rin po che las ji ltar bstan pa bzhin du dran shes ngo tsha bag yod dang ldan pas phan bde'i rtsa ba tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rin po che dang dge 'dun gyi nang khrims sgrig lam che phra mtha' dag rang sbog ltar gces par bsrung ste phyi ltar dkan thos kyi spyod pa zhi zhing dul ba'i sgo nas nang du rim gnyis kyi zab gsang rnal 'byor la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas lung rtogs kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel ba'i nyams bzhed dkar phyogs kun phan gyi 'phel bar co 'dri ba'i thab tshul la brtson pa chen pos ci nas kyang 'bad par 'tshal/ smras pa/ 'gro la bde skyid 'od stong spro ba'i mgon/ / rgyal bstan nyi mor byed pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ / phyogs dus lha yi dzing ring yangs pa'i ngos/ / g.yo med rtag tu 'char zhing rgyas gyur cig / tshal bzhin gdams pa de bzhin spyod pa yi/ /khrims ldan ngur smrig 'chang ba ngur pa'i khyu/ / bshad sgrub mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'khrol ba yis/ / nor 'dzin rgya mtsho'i khyon kun khyab gyur cig/ las bzhi'i 'phrin las rno 'gyur thog rgod shugs/ / 'chang ba'i bstan srung dam can rgya mtshos kyang / /chos ldan bu — 570 la

bzhi/na/ skyong ba'i sdong grogs dang / // legs nyes stangs 'dzin bya ra ma g.yel mdzod/ / ces rdo/ phud chos 'khor gyi 'dus tshogs rnams kyi blang dor khrims su bca' ba'i yi se/ ke ta ka'i do shal zhes byas ba 'di nyid rab pyung bcu drug pa'i nang tshan 'bru mang zhes pa sa pho stag lo'i zla tshes dge// bar phyogs kun las rnam par rgyul ba'i pho brang chen po po ta la nas bres/ che/sa gos ser thog bris te srid tham bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

gdan sa gsum dang rgyud stod smad/ dge sde cheXchung giXdage 'dun pa na/sa chang 'thung tshulaXmin chos khrims las 'gal mi chog pa'i rtsa chigs stab/ (spyo lo 192shā )lha 'o/la gyi gnyer mi dpon sos/sa sne mor mngags slebs mtha' dag nas nges dgos// snga sor lhar bcas skye rgu'i gtsus/ rgyan rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen gzigs chen po sku 'tsho zhing bzhes dus lo ltar ri rgya klung rgya'i rtsa tshig chen mo/ bstsal ba'i dgongs don la/— 'jig rten gyi khams su phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gzhi rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che nyag gcig yin zhing /bstan pa de yang tshul bzhin 'dzin pa chos byed dge 'dun la rag las na/dge 'dun gyi sde thams cad dam pa'i chos 'dul ba dang mthun pa'i rang rang gi bca' khrims kyi yi rge/ tshad ldan gyi rigs las ma g.yos pa dang / der gsal min la ma ltos pa'i rtsa ba bzhi dang 'gal ba dang myos 'gyur 'thung ba 'di bag med pa'i rtsa ba/ mig ltos shas pa'i rgyur 'dug pas rab tu byung ba sus kyang mi 'thung zhing / skya bo'i rigs sus kyang grwa pa'i rigs la chang mi ster zhes sogs dam bsgrags tshig gsal du phebs 'dug kyang / 'ga' ———— 572 ——

zhig nas /la3 ngan/ ldos/ shes med 8 'i h+pho 'a/da ngan nga rgyun 'byams dang ste mo ba rnams nas kyang de rig/sa la khrims kyi rjes gnon med pa'i bag la 'a'i rgyur brten/ rtsa tshis dgongs don/ la ma gnas pa'i bam/ yangs kyi gleng ba 'ag/ je 'phel shar bar gdan sa chen po se 'bras dge gsum dang rgyud stod smad kyi bla ma las sne/ bcas tshang 'dzoms thog nas/ zhu tshis byung ba'i rdo khar/ nye lam kun mkhyen skyabs ma bon rin po che'i za/la ma bzhug/sa pa'i tshu(la bstan gyi skabs 'dir rang gzhan/ ser skya kun/ gyis so so'i lugs mthun gyi lta grub sogs lus/sa gnyis khri/ mas kyi ba'i ma ra pa dang thos bsam rnam nga/lo/ra dge/ phyogs rang lugs sgo gang zab mas/ 'bas 'deb/sa rem rem dbos pa'i skabs yin 'dug kyang / gter stom/ dang lha phebs 'dre phebs sogs kyi lung la brten pa'i rab tu byung ba'i rigs sogs nas kyang bdud mi mchod nga / dgos tshul sogs bstan pa rin po che'i rma 'byen 'di phyir mi dge bar spyod/ pa 'ga' yod tshod go thos ltar/ nged rnams nas ma/tha' 'doms dbo/sa rigs gang drag zhu ba gzhir bcas shing / gzhung sa rin po che lugs gnyis bstan pa'i bdag po khrims kyi kha lo par song gshis da sgos 'di rigs skya ser ngan kha 'dril gyi khyab gdan ngan pa je 'phel du mi 'gro ba'i bka' khyab thugs rje che dgos tshul byung ba/ 'di skor grub mtha'i phyogs zhen dang / rang 'dod phyogs lhung gi zhu ba ma yin par/ lar rgya'i bde thabs la lhag bsam dge ba'i zhu rigs yin 'dug pa zol 'jog tu ba 'ag pas ma 'thus par ma tshad/ deng sang rang snang gang shar bag yangs kyi byed spyod ci rigs dang /zhwa ser bstan pa'i rin po che gtso bor gyur pa'i grub mtha' ris med grags shing grub pa gang la brten kyang ci dgar spyad chog pa yod bzhin du khams pa — 673 — ——
