ga/ter ston/ yin tshul zog po der lnga nga ser skya drag zhan mang dag na/sa tshad 'dzin gyi bla mar 'khur ba sogs ri bong ca/ma 'gros/sa kyi rdza/ma 'gyur mi sna tshob/mu byung tshod 'dug kyang / zog chos kyis gzhan mgo rgongs par byas pa la bstan srung dam can rgya mtsho dbyings nas khrel ba'i bka' chad dang mthong tshas spyong 'gyur gyi las 'bras kyi bden pa thog tu babs pas/ rdzun ma zol zog/ gi/ rang mtshang rjen par bstan te kho rang tsho'i 'du byed stongs 'dus/ par da cha les/sa nyes kyi rtog dpyod ma da/gos kyang / rdzun zog gi ram 'degs shes ba'i/na sgri ba chags kyi rigs 'dug tshe slar rim ba'i ma/ rjes ba/rbon byed rgyu yin/ rab tu byung ba'i rigs sogs nas kyang lha phebs 'dre phebs kyi rjes su 'brengs nas tshogs chang dang bdud rtsi mchod pa sogs kyi ming snyan por btags nas dom du chang 'thung / glu gar sogs bag med pa'i spyod pas bstan pa rin po che'i rma 'byen byed pa ni lung ston pa po lha 'dre gang yin kyang tshad 'dzin mi 'os pa dang lhag par tshul 'chal chang 'a thung bag yangs su spyod par gtso bor dgon gnas so so'i bla ma dbu chos sogs kyis chos khrims kyi sgo nas bca' khrims kyi yi ge'i don bzhin rjes gnon dang ri klung gi rtsa tshig rin po che'i dgongs don ltar gzhung gi sne mo ba so so nas kyang ngo 'dzin zem 'jog tu ma song ba'i khrims kyi brda' 'ded slad kyi mig ltos la phan pa'i bkod 'doms byed/ lha phebs 'dre phebs byed mi'i skor yang phyis su gang dran lag len gyi bag yangs dang / de'i rjes su 'breng ba'i drag zhan kyang sna tshogs pa zhig byung gshis je rgyal je mang gi gang la'ang tshad bzung rgyu med pa zhig byung 'dug pas/ da nas bzung khog gzhi/ so sor sngar nas 'bebs bzhin gyi lha babs byed par bgag cha byed rgyu mi 'dug kyang sngar med gsar — 574 —

sbod kyi mi bsgyur lha 'bebs rigs gtan nas byed sa med cing / nger nas/ 'bebs bzhin gyi gral rnams kyang so so'i gnas khang gang yin du lo/ ga zhugs byed pa las lha zhol sogs sde grong chen po'i sa char rang snang gang ma/ra gyi lha phebs 'dre phebs byas mi chog gzhan nas kyang rang 'dod byung rgyal gyi khog 'bod byed sa med pa bcas gong gsal gyi skor la sne sdod so sos khur med/ du ma song ba'i dam bsgrags gang che'i ngos rjes gnon tshub/ bzhi/na dgos rgyur/ slad mas rgong don yal/ bor gyi lam ngag rgyun 'byams gleng bzhas rigs byung na/ sne mo ba rang la rtsad dpyod byed pa las ma 'das pas de ltar mi dgos nga 'i spang blang do khur gang che byed pa gyis/ sa stag zla 5 tshes 12dbe/ ba la/ / // /

mthong spyon dwagasaXpoXgrwa tshang gi/ bca'aXyig bskyun zhu'i sa bon/dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs sum chu//oṃ su ste dra dza zaḥ kun rmongs 'khro 'i/nga bcod/ la ral gri'i ba nyen/ /kun gzigs drang srong chen po zas gtsang sras/ /kun tu dwangs ba'i yid kyi la na brgya ru/ /kun mkhyen ma thob bar du phyag bgyi 'o/ //'khor ba'i nyes pas ma pham mi pham mgo/ma/ /mi shes mun pa'i gshed/ po 'jam dpal dbyangs // / rgyal kun bskyed dang rol mdzad dbyangs can lha/ /rnam gsum yid kyi pad mtshor dgyes nga/ra ro'// /rnam dpyod zho 'thung rus pa'i rtse brgya yang / / lang dag lha la sgol ba'i ri bo'i rkang / /spyod mdzod 'phags yul mdzes byed rgyan drug po/ /snyeng dbus 'od lnga'i klong du rtag bzhugs gsol/ /skye bar goms pa'i rnam dpyod goms gcig gis/ / rab 'byams shes bya'i mtha' kun gzhal ba'i tshe/ / rgya bod mkhas rlom phal gyi khengs pa'i ri/ / bsnyil mdzad rngog lo khu dbon phyag gi gnas/ / srid pa'i phun tshogs stong gis mi khugs pa'i/ /srid pa'i 'gro la rjes brtse'i snyeng rje'i gter/ /srid gsum 'gro ba'i 'dren mchog sa skya par/ / srid pa kun tu gus pas phyag bgyi 'o/ / mtshan dpe'i gzi byin 'bar ba'i gzugs sku'i zla/ / 'jam mgon thugs rje'i nya rgyas yongs gang ba/ /blo gsal kun dwa'i gnyen gcig lo tsā ba/ /kun dga' — 676 ——

rgyal mtshan 'bas zung sa/tsus/ tu rol / /rab 'byams phyos/sa bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus nga/'i/ /thub/sa rje'i bdud rtse rgya mtsho las 'khrungs pa'i/ /pad/ ma dkar 'chang gangs can 'gro ba'i mgon/ /blo bzang rgya mtsho'i 'bas 'a gus pas 'dud/ // rnam da/pyod dge mtshan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dpal/ / bkris dbyangs/ su len pa skya lnga'i dung / /phyogs las rnam par rgyal pa'i rnga bo che / /mtshungs med dpal lda/na bla ma gtan gyi skyabs/ // nges 'byung khrims kyi rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /thos bsam sgom pa'i yal 'dab khur gyi lci/ / zab don 'bras bu'i dog pa g.yur za ba'i// /'dus tshogs dpab/ bsam dbang po phyab/ gi gnas/ /dam nyams khrag gi myos ba'i bzhad sgra dang / / zhing bzu'i dgra bor khros pa'i 'jigs pa'i nyams/ mthong tshe khro tshog/sa ga 'a/na spyo lag bo/ mtshon/ /'tshor nus ma hwa la/ las 'di don sgru bas/ /bsam pas 'dod pa'i don sgrub rig byed ma/ /bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po tshos/sa kyi bdas/ / bsam don yid bzhin sgrub mdzad 'dod pa'i rgyal/ /dmar chen gsum gyis 'od dgu char du bsnyil/ /dmar po byas pa khyod kyi gdong dang lag / zhing bcu'i dgra bor bsad pa'i khrag rgyun gyis/ /brtul lo spyi dang rnal 'byor sgos kyi dgra/ /bstan bsrung bse khrab can gyi mthu stobs stsol/ /ces mchod par brjod nas lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag la gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde'i gzhi rtsa rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dang / de nyid 'dzin skyong spel ba dge 'dun gyi sde la rag lus pa ni/ 'dir skabs su babs pa bod yul gyi rdo rje gdan dpal gsang phu ne'u thog rngog lo khu dbon gyis rjes su nye bar brgyud ba'i chos rje dkon mchog bzang po/ rje shes rab seng ge/ dwags ston bkris rnam rgyal/ thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun — 677 —

grub pa bcas kyi zhabs cag byin brlabs phyag nas 'thor ba'i nang tshan/rig/sa 'dzin pad+ma ka ras lung bstan pa'i shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta bkros rnam rgyal nas sngon gyi thugs bskyed dam bca' btsan pos bskul ba'i dgon 'di legs par bskyangs nas rnam rab mthong smon dwags po grwa tshang zhes ming bstsal 'brel bzhin sngar srol lugs bzang mi nyams gong 'phel ched 'dus sde'i tshogs la sde sgod rin po che rnam gsum dang 'brel ba'i blang dor gyi bca' sgrig yi ger spel ba la/ thog mar dgon 'dir so thar sdom pa thob pa'i rten rung min khang tshan su yin gyi dge rgan nas legs brtags te rung tshe mkhan por bsngo rten kha btags dang dngul zho gsum bzang ja spor brgyad dang /mar ko med spyi nyag bcu drug dbu chos sne bzhag dngul skar lnga te/gnyer par shing rin dngul zho gsum slar bstan bshig mi byed pa'i spyi sgrig gan rgya khag 'brel gyi mtha' 'doms/ sngon nas sdom pa thob zin pa yin na ma gtogs dge tshul slong gi sdom pa ma thob par zla ba gsum lhag bsdad mi chogabaca' khrims dam chos 'dul ba lung sde bzhi'i dgongs don bzhin mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshad ldan nas slob ston legs par byas pa rnams thar pa don gnyer sha stag byed dgos rgyu la/ bstan pa'i rtsa ba'am sa gzhi lta bu gzhi gsum gyi cho ga dang 'brel chos thog brgyad/ gsang phu dbyar chos the ba'i chos thog dgu la gzhung lugs sgro gleng dang / sngags lugs brgyud sde gong 'og ste dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod/ ma ṇi ril sgrub/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sgrogs rgyu/ sgrol ma 'bum ther/ chos bsrung gis sgo nas gtor sgrub zor 'phen cho 'phrul zla bar smon lam dang 'brel ba'i bco lnga mchod pa bcas kyi dus mchod tshogs dgos la/ gaṇ+ḍi khar rnga dung bcas kyi brda byung 'phral — 578 —

mnyam tshogs las snga phyi mi chog gal srid mjug lus tshe dge bskos nas sdod tshod ma byas bar phyag 'tshal/ 'dug stangs slob grwa ston bral gnyis kyi srol/ bka' ram pa'i ming btags/ bsdus gra rnams 'dzin grwa mtho dma'i rgan rim kyi sdod pa las rkang pa su mgyogs mi byed pa'i rnam snang chos bdun gyis tshul mtshungs 'dug dgos/ zas gos 'dul ba'i bca' gzhi las 'gal ba'i log zas/ gos ya ma zung / gri ring / skra ring /lcags ri g.yas g.yon rdo gcal nang bcas par gzan gsham med pa dang /ki swo'i ca co/ phan tshun dbyen 'phrug sogs kyi rtsing spyod dang / 'gro lugs dge spyong khyu 'gros ltar las phar spyang ra lug lta bu'i 'gro ngan mi chogabacangs bya'i gtso bor gsungs pa'i tshogs phyi nang gang sar gding ba med pa dang / ngar bsnabs mchil ma kha zhag sogs gtsang khang du bor ba'i 'di nye tshe'i dmyal bar skye ba'i nyes pa lce che gsungs pa ma zad/ dri ngan zhing tshogs gdan mchod rdzas sogs chud za bar 'gro gzhir ma song bas kha zhag mdzes zhal mngon chung gi blugs nas khu ba gtsang khang du mi bor ba dang / gding ba nges par bcangs dgos bcas gong gsal las 'gal rigs byung tshe mkhan las chos khrims nas 'phral 'phral babs bkod dgos rgyu/ dbon chos mdzad sogs la ja thug bdun/ slob dpon dgu tshan dod/ dbu chos 'gro khungs sne bzhag spyi 'bul dngul srang sum hru skor dang 'gyed dngul tsha ra gang rigs lag bde gral 'gor go mtshungs zhig la 'jog chos ra'i gaṇ+ḍi rdung 'phral bla grwa mnyam tshogs/ lo bstod/ phar tshad brgyud ba'i gsol 'debs rnams mnyam 'don dang slob dpon pas kun mkhyen rnam gnyis kyi yig cha gtso bzung nas gzhung bka' pod rang gzhan gyi grub mtha'i —— 579 —

thog nas ma rmongs par blo 'dzin bka' ram nas bsdus chung bar 'dzin chos nan tan skyes nas gtong gzhung pa dang bsdus ra bas sgro gleng gis brgal brtags sogs sa gang mang byed/ gung chos la brgyad stong dang gser 'od pod re 'gro nges gtong dgos/ dgongs char sgrol 'don 'di bstan 'gro spyi rgos kyi bgegs bar zhi chod gtso che bas/ skyabs sems sngon 'gro/sgrol ma tshar nyi shu rtsa gcig mtshan brjod/ gdugs dkar/ lo bstod/gong ma lnga bstod/ gong sa mchog gi 'bas brtan pa/ dwags ston bkris rnam rgyal sogs de kha'i bla brgyud gsol 'debs/ bsrung ma'i bstod 'phrin/sher snying / tshe gzungs bcas 'gro che tshogs phyi nang bar gsum thar ra tho chos sgrogs gleng bar sgrigs sna drug la tshang mas theg pa 'khur blangs las khral mngon sla bcos mi chog/ slob gnyer la 'jug lugs kyang kha dog dkar dmar nas gzungs snga ma snga ma sngon song nas phyi ma phyi mar 'jug pa las rtsa ba med pa'i rtse mo mi snyegs/ bsdus chen thog nas mkhan pos bsdus ra dang chos spyod yong tshad brtags nas su yong gzhung rgyugs su skyur bcug pa'i gleng se bka' bcu'i ming brtags/ bka' rams gral ston dang tshogs gsog pa bcas sngar rgyun nyams med/ klog 'don chos spyod kun rigs cho ga'i rgyugs sprod chos rgyugs brgyad stong spos ring tshad kyi len pa dang / ma sprad bar kun rigs cho ga chos 'don ba'i sde bcas la rgyugs sprad pas ma 'dangs ma gtogs/ sger 'bod gzhung gtong gang yang mi chog chos 'don bzhi sde dge bskos nas shag skor gtong / grong chog sogs dge skos med skabs de ga'i rgan pas dge chos byas nas gung seng log tshod sba phyi 'gro sdod yon bdag mi mos pa'i las mi byed/ phogs 'gyed tsha ra sogs slob dpon la gsum ——— 580 —

skal/ dbu chos sbon lam dam bca' ja ma bcas la 'gyed tsha ra nyis skal/dung mkhan tsha ra nyis skal/ bla brang skyogs tshad brgyad/ spyi gnyer skyogs tshad lnga te/ las ste gtong gzhi 'dzin mi ma gtogs khe tshong bun skyed rta bong sogs gtan gsos mi chog nag mo'i rgyu 'phrul 'di dgon nang du zhag sdod lta ci tho khongs tshun yong mi chog pas skya bo yang dgongs pa zhu sbyin dgos/bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i gzhi tshul khrims kyi gtso bor gyur pa'i rtsa ba bzhi las 'gal ba tshe nyes pa ngos len la gnas dbyung kyis nyes 'bab gser srang dang / gsar ja 'gro lam chos tshab 'phral 'dzugs phal chen sde lugs rtsa bar gsungs ba'i chang 'di nyes tshabs cher brten sngon nas hwa skor dam ra tshag bsnan byed rgyu rnams nyams med de las 'gal tshe nyes 'bab/ gri mtshon rdo rgyug sogs kyi rma kha khrag shor sogs la rkyang phyagargyab lang 'cho 'dzin byed mir gser zho/ sho sbag rtsed 'jo'i grong nang bag g.yeng byed mi rnams 'phral 'phral bcun thog bskums phyag khri tshad bcas sgrub 'gel dgo4 rgyu ma zad/ gtsang khang steng shod bar gsum/ lha khang le lag mgon khang khag grwa shag rdo gcal shar nub bcas la gtsang sbra gang che'i 'dzin spras le shor med pa dgos rgyu/ da phan 'dzin bzhin bdag pa'i 'byeb/ gsal chos thebs 'dzin dbang gis mtshon dgon gyi phyi nang sprod rigs che phra mtha' dag la slob dpon las sne 'pho mtshams so sor dpe gzhi rtsa 'dzin gyis sprod len tshul bzhin dgos rgyu ma zad/ zhib pa sa sprul sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos bstsal ba'i bca' yig dang / shing stag mthun sgrub bca' yig la mi dbang pho lhas bstsal ba'i 'go mchan sogs kyi zur brgyan te/dkar nag bden 'dzin gyis gnyer bka' gur mgon lcam dral/ gnyen — 581 —

grid spyong stag brag gis kong stod dung dkadaXdagon la bstsal ba'i khrimasaXsuXbaca' ba'i yi ge/chu lug (spyo lo 1942 )bod zla 5tshes 24nyin zhib 'jug song /oṃ swa ste/ ji lta ji snyed ji bzhin kun mkhyen stobs bcu mnga' ba mi'i seng ge / kun 'byung kun nas kun tur nyer zhi 'gog lam bden pa dam pa'i chos/ /grol nas grol ba'i grol lam legs ston tshogs kyi mchog rab dge 'dun te/ /mchog gsum mchog gi mchog sbyin 'bebs pa'i dge legs sprin gyi phreng bar dkrigs/ /rgyal kun yab tu gyur kyang rgyal sras tshul/ /mtshan 'dzin rmongs pa'i mun sel mtshan dpe'i gar/ /blo gter smra ba'i zla ba blo bzang grags/ /kun phan snang ba dam pas kun tu srungs/ / chos dbyings kun gsal mdzes pa'i lang tsho la/ /rjes chags snying rje'i zla ba gzhon nu'i 'dzum/ /gang 'dul mos pa'i dzin bu ji snyed bar/ /shar ba'i yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs kyis skyongs/ /skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi srung ma ga bo/ / myur mdzad mgon dang rnam sras las gshin sogs/ /dam can rdo rje'i srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /srung skyobs rnam bzhi/'i 'phrin las g.yel med sgrub/ /rigs grol brgyad ldan dwangs bsil khrus rjing du/ /'phags nor bdun ldan tshangs — 583 —

spyod 'dus pa'i sde'i/ /ngang mo'i khyu tshogs chos spyod mgrin rnga'i dbyangs/ /'khrol ba'i khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge 'god/ / ces yul khyad par can la mchod par brjod cing shis brjod dngos po nges bstan gyis lam yangs par byas te de yang ji ltar bshad ba ni/ bskal bzang rnam 'dren stong gi nang nas mnyam med/ shākya'i rgyal pos lus can spyi dang khyad par snyegs ma lnga lhag par bdo ba'i mi brjed kyi zhing 'di phyag mtshan du bzhes te smon lam chen po lnga brgya btab/ bya dka' ba'i spyod pa mtha' yas bla na med pa'i byang chub sngon du mdzad de tshe lo brgya pa'i dus kyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa dag gis kyang mthong ba'i skal ba can du mchog gi sprul sbu'i rnam bar 'dul bya'i don mdzad pa ni/ mdo las/ thub rnam sdig pa chu yis mi khru zhing / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la/ /nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan la spo min pas/ /chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar gyur/ /zhes gsungs ba ltar blang dor gī gnas phyin ci ma log par bstan pa'i gdam ngag gi don gdul byas nyams su blangs pas rgud pa mtha' dag bzlog cing / rgar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang thob bar byed pa las thabs gzhan gyis 'gro ba mngon mtho nges legs kyi par dkri bar mi nus shing / chags sogs nyon mongs bag chags dang bcas pa mtha' dag gi rtsa bar gyur pa'i bden 'dzin de nyid bdag med pa'i gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i shes rab sgom par byas pas ldog la/ de yang sems rtse gcig pa'i zhi gnas sam/ ting nges 'dzin sngon du 'gro dgos/ de gyi ba la lus ngag gi nyes spyod mtha' dag las ldog ste sems dul ba dang zhi bar byed pa'i spong sems tshul khrims 'di nyid yon tan thams cad skye ba'i bsten dang / khyad par du mdo sde dang / mngon la 584 la

pa'i sde sgod bstan pa yin yang ston pa'i go mi chod / 'dul ba/ri sde snod bstan dang ston pa gnyis ka yin par 'dul ba lung las gsung pa bzhin rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che yod med kyang bstan pa'i rtsa ba 'dul ba'i sde snod la nan tan dang las kyi cho ga tshul bzhin yod med la rag lus shing / de yang bsil ldan ra ba dkar pos khor yug tu bskor ba'i ljongs 'di snga dar la rgyal blon paṇa grub byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bkrin las rab tu byung ba'i sde gsar du btsugs pa sogs bstan pa rin po che nyin mo'i snang bas blang dor la rmongs pa'i mun pa'i go skabs rgyang ring du bskrad kyang / ma rtogs pa dang log par rtogs pa the tshom gyi dri mas sbag par gyur pa'i tshe khams gsum 'gro ba'i bla ma rje btsun tsong kha pa chen pos bstan pa'i dri ma mtha' dag bsal te rgyal ba'i bka' sde sgod gsum gyi 'chad nyan dang / bslab gsum gyi nyams len rnam par dag pa'i gangs can gyi ljongs kun khyab par mdzad pa sogs thub pa'i bstan pa la thub dbang gnyis pa ji bzhin du gyur pa 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud sogs du ma nas lung bstan pa bzhi/na ri bo dge lugs pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la gtso bo 'don pa rje bdag nyid chen po'i rnam thar gyi ga bo bo yin pas sngon byung gi rnam thar la rjes 'jug gi nyams su len pa zhig dgos par brten/ kong stod dung dkar dgon gyi 'dus sde 'di nyid kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa dpag bsam nor bu'i 'khri shing bkod pa la/ de yang thar pa don du gnyer ba'i gang zag rnam kyis lhag pa'i bslab pa gsum nyams su blang dgos pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang shes rab kyi gzhi rten tshul khrims kyi bslab pa nyams su len pa la/thog mar gsar zhugs pa rnams kyi sdom pa ma thob pa thob par byed dgos pas/ — 585 —

bar chad can rab tu byung na mkhan slob dge 'dun gyi sde sogs la gnod pas bar chad yod med legs par brtag med par nges pa rnams la bla gos thang gos sogs nyer chas rnams tshang bar byas shing / lo tshigs su ma sleb pa dang srung ba'i mtshams ma zin pa ma yin pa rnam rab tu byung ba bsgrub tu gzhug cing gong gi dgag bya dang ldan pa rnams mi 'jug rtags cha lugs rnams bdag gir byar rung ba zla ba gsum tshun la nges par shoms pa byed/sdom pa ma blang pa dang / blangs kyang rtags cha lugs ma tshang ba tshogs su mi 'jug/ rab tu byung zin pa phyogs nas 'ong ba'i rigs gsar du 'jug pa dag byung na sde gzhan nas dbyung ba dang / bslab pa nyams ma nyams sogs brtag bsnyen par rdzogs 'dod pa rnams kyang bar chad dang mi ldan zhi/nga mthun rkyen rnams tshang bar dgos pa sngar dang 'dra/ grwa sar zhugs ma thag nas bzung zla ba gcig gnyis sogs yun ring thung so so'i blo mchog dman dang bstun gnas kyi slob dpon bstan nas lung rnam 'byed las gsung pa'i sdom gyis bsdus pa'i bslab khrims dang / lung gzhi/ dang 'phran tshegs skabs kyi 'byung nye ba'i blang dor rags pa rnams la sbyangs te rab tu byung ba rnying pa rnams dang spyod lam mthun par byed/ dge 'dun spyi'i chos spyod kyi rim pa rnams kyang srur gyi slob dpon de ga 'am/ yang sngags kyi cho ga sogs la mkhas pa gzhan dag yod na'ang ji ltar 'os pa bsten pa'i bshar sbyang la brtson par byas nas rang rang gi shes rab dang bsnyun ngos lo gsum la ma mtha' byas pa'i khong du chud par byed/ rtsa ba bzhi las 'das na gnas nas dbyung / dge 'dun lhag ma'i ltung ba la spo mgu dbyung gsum dang / sbom po ltung byed nyes chas sogs che chung dang bstun pa'i dge 'dun dang gang zag —— 586 —

so sor bshag/sa pa skabs su gang babs byed/ mkhan slob sogs kyi gnang ba ma 'khrol bar grwa sa gzhan du 'gro ba/ dge 'dun dang mi mthun pa'i rkyen zhe ngan 'dzin pa/ ngan lan len pa/ phung dkrugs khro ba sogs spangs nas gzhan du ngo bsrung / phan tshun lag 'gres pa'i 'thab rtsod/ des mtshon pa'i phyi rol gyi dpon skya bza' pa/ skya btsun ris bzang ngan gang dang yang 'thab rtsod dang / byed mkhan gyi rgyab dpung khang 'dzin mi byed/dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas la gang zag gis longs mi spyod/ 'phral gyi nyer mkho'i yo byad ma gtogs zong phan tshun du bsgyur ba'i khe tshong bun skyed so nam zhing las dud 'gro'i 'tsho skyong mi byed/ tshong mi byed par tshong rar 'gro ba lnga mas tshong thag mi bcad par phyi mas hab thob dang dog 'tshang mi byed/ glu gar bro gzhas kyis mtshon pa'i 'dus pa la blta ba/ ko gru'i btsas mi ster ba sogs mi byed/ rtse zhwa ma gtogs zhwa rigs sna tshogs mi gyon/ gos phu thung bcas/gri ring // skra ring / kha sha'i lham zom pa/ ko pags kyi sgod sogs la mi spyod/ gling gi nye skor dang chu 'go lam 'phrang sogs su bshang ci mi 'dor dge 'dun gyi 'du khang gi ka ba dang rtsig pa sogs la 'chil snam mi 'dor/gzhan gyi dngos po bor ba rnyed pa bdag po ngo shes na dang ma shes na dge bskos la gtod/ nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang lhan cig zhag tu sdod pa/tshul 'chal dang gnas gcig tu sdod cing 'grogs pa/ gnang ba ma zhus par grong gseb dang grong chog la mi 'gro/ dmigs bsal gyi dgos pa yod na ma gtogs gling gseb tu bud med mi gtong gling khongs su rta mi zhogadud 'gro zhag tu mi bsrel/ chos zhu dang bsnyen bkur byed mkhan ma gtogs mi skya rigs kyang zhag mang gling gseb tu mi sdod/ skad rkyang gtong — 587 ——

ba ku co 'don pa/ mchongs rgyas/ pa// mda' / 'ur rdo// zo slor 'phen pa/ sho sbag/ sogs rgyan po 'gyed pa/ mi mang tshogs sar long gtam dang / 'du 'dzi'i gtam smra ba/ sde phan tshun gyi phyog/sa ris bzung pa'i ngan bam/gas/ chos kyi 'gro ba la bsnyad nga 'i gzhan dab/ dma' 'bebs pa'i bzhad gad tshig ngan so/gas kyi sgo nas grogs tshangs par spyod pa rnams sun mi dbyung / khyi dang sprang po gling gseb tu mi gtong 'ing / gang zag rga/ bza' btung phyi rol du ster/ sde 'di'i sgrigs khongs su zhus/sa zin nas gzhan du song ba'i tshe rtsa bzhi sogs gnas na/sa dbyung bar 'os nga 'i rgyu dngos bstan dang // myos chang 'dzem med spyad nga/ sogs dang / 'phrugs gseb tu zhugs pa/ khrims grogs med par nye du ma yin pa'i bud med dang gnas gcig tu 'ag tu nyal ba rnams byung na slar dgon 'dir mi 'jugaglor bur lhags pa'i rab tu byung bar dag snang spyong zhing gnas mal dang stan gos g.yor/ rab tu byung ba la phyi dro'i kha zas dang khyim pa la chang dang chang rin mi ster/ chos gos ga/sum/ gding ba/ rkul gzan so/gas rung ba tshad dang ldan pa las tshad ma longs pa'i ngan ngog dang / tshad las lhag cing kha dog bzang por byed pa'i mchod chas mi byed/ thang sham dang / rgyun gzan med par lam srang dang / phyi rol du mi 'gro/ tshogs su 'du ba'i tshe dung gaṇ+ḍi mkhar rnga sogs brda byung ba dang bstun rab tu byung ba'i rtags cha lugs kyis mdzes shing spyod lam bag dang ldan pas myur du 'du zhing bslab gral ma 'khrugs par byed/ gral ma tshes dang long gtam smra ba/ rtsig pa dang ka ba la mnyed ba/ bzhad gad bya zhing slong ba/ gnyid log pa sogs mi byed cing tshogs pa'i chos spyod kyi ram 'degs/ bza' 'thung gi cag — 588 —

cag dang / hub hub/ lces ldag pa sogs 'dul ba da/nga 'gal ba'i ris/sa mi byed/ bya ba glo bur ba byung na ma gtos/sa bsngo ba ma tshar bar mi 'gro/ 'gyes pa'i tsho'ang gzhan dag mi dad pa'i spyod/ tshul mi byed/ dge 'dun gyi kham khab dang rnyed pa khyim pa dang sprang ngo/ khyi sogs la mi ster/ga/la ste dmis/sa bsal gyi dgos pa byung na dge 'dun la gnang ba zhu/ sgo/ga btsong so/ga/mu dri ngan pa'i rigs lus la gos nga/ra byas nas dkon mtshag gsum gyi rten gyi drung dang dge 'dun gyi kun dga' ra bar mi 'gro/ nang mtshad dang / mkhar las kyi dus sogs ma gtogs chang gi 'grim/sa 'du grul mi byed/ nad pa byung na/ yo byad med tshe dge 'dun dang dkon mchog gi rdzas kyi steng nas de la rim gro byed/ nad sos nas rang yul lta bu nas rdzas len rgyu yod na dkon ma/chog gi rdzas la 'bag tshe gun sa/sab/ med kyang nad pa yul gnyan pas nyes par mi 'gyur/ sde 'dir mi gtogs pa'i skya btsun nad pa'i ris nye 'khor du byung na nad g.yog zas gos sman sogs kyis phan gdags/ nad rim yod sar phyin na dge 'dun spyi la gnod pas mi 'gro/dgon pa nas rgyang grags gcig tshun gyi ri klungs su ri dwags dang nya gshor ba sogs byang na dgag pa'i ri rgya klungs rgya byed/ dbyar gnas dang dgag dbye gso spyong rnams ma chag pa dang tshogs 'don gyi rim pa yang gnam lo gsar tshes kyi dga' ston du rgyal ba'i bka' srung 'dod khams dbang phyug dpal ldan lha mor tshes gtor 'bul ba'i spyor ba'i rim pa ni sbu gnyer gyis gnyer tshang nas mchod thob rnams deb gsal bzhin zhus te mchod bzhengs nas mchod gtor gsham bsgrigs mthong brgyud phyag len ltar tshags tshud byed/nyi dros phyi cha tsam la tshogs brda dang bstun dge 'dun tshang ma 'du khang — 589 —

du 'dzoms/ skyabs sems / 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma/ bla brgyud gsol 'debs nas bzung bdag ba spyod bzlas pa/ gtor mgron skyes chog rgyas pa dang / mchod bstod sa/nga rgyas/ dang 'brel lha mo'i mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs byin gyis brlabs te bden stobs mdzad/ de'i rjes dbu mdzad nas lo gsar gyi thugs dam gdangs dbyangs kyi mtshon pas mdzad sgo tshogs gtam rgyas pa btang / di nas dbyangs sgrigs rgyugs len mdzad de tshobs grol/ srod 'khor zin mtshams tshogs brda byung 'phral 'du khang du 'du nas/ dgo/sa 'dod kun 'byung / lha mo/ mngon rtogs ma/sa bstod pa'i bar da/nga / lha mo'i rten 'bul tshes gtor tshog/sa mchod zab rgyas/ tshes 2nyin nam lang nas spyor chos/ thun drug dga' lha/ gnas bcu rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam/tshes 2tho reng mtshams nas 'jigs byed/ bstan skyong che gnyis/ bstan srung spyi'i bskang ba tshangs pa/ rgyal chen shugs ldan gsol mchod bcas gnad smin dang / spyor chos/ thun drug dga' lha/ gnas bcu/bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam/ tshes 6nas tshes 12bar thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgo nas ma ṇi bum sgrub kyi cho ga dwags grwa'i phyag len bzhin nyin ltar thun gsum re/ tshes 15nyin rje btsun rnam par rgyal ma'i stong mchod/tshes 16nas tshes 22bar nyin re rdo rje mi 'phrug pa lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub mchod/ bdag mdun bum dbang bcas pa tshes 2 2nas/ tshes 29bar mgon chos gtso gyur gyi lha mo/ g.yu grags zhal bzhi/ rnam sras lcam sring /tshangs pa/ shugs ldan/ mtshom lha/ gzhis bdag kyi bskang 'phrin rol mo gdangs dbyangs gang zab smin rgyas thog chos rgyal glo bur las bcol gyi la 590 la

bro/ ma/sa sa/tshwar bzlos sa/ma/da smim / tshes da du shin byams pa sa/dan zhu/ khrom tshos/sa sang yim/ la mi 'dru sa pa ma chi dung phyur// tshe dbang ngang / tshes/ rdzas/tshogs/ sos/sa gang rgyas byed/ zla 2tshes ldanas tshes 2༷bar chos thob tshugs pa'i nyin re spyo/ra jos/ gnas bcu/ bstan srub spyi'i bskang 'phrin gtor 'bul/ mngo/ thar pa chen ngo tshar bcu re/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig skrol bstod/ ga/dugs dkar sher snying / seng gdong ma/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i sbo/na pham bcas nyin re chas/ med khar/ tshes 15nyin/ sa/nyer tshang ma/sa bsangs rdzas // gzhon/ khyal sang yim/ nas bas ngas shing / 'dus dmangs nas yul lha tsa/so/la mchod/ rten khrus yul khrus bcas byed/ zla 2tshes 1nas/ tshes 15bar nyin re spyor tshas chag med khar/ 'jigs byed lta bcu gsum gyi sgrub mchod rdul tshon dkyil 'khor bres thig dang / bdag 'jug sgra dbyangs gling gi chog sgrigs ltar khang skong sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/tshes 16nyin/ 'jigs byed bdag bskyed dang 'brel rab gnas dang bkris gang rgyas byed/ tshes 17nyin/ sgrol chog nyin 'phyongs/ tshes phyo5nas zla 4tshes 2khyabar sman gling mdo chog yid bzhin dbang rgyal nyin re tshar gnyis te/ tshes 10nas tshes 15bar thugs rje chen po pad mo lugs kyi sprung ba cha gnyis gsum/ tshes 16nyin/ 'jug chog bla mchod bde stong dbyer med gang rgyas/ tshes 17nas tshes 2༷bar chos thon tshugs pa'i nyin re sbyor chos/ thun drug dga' lha/ gnas bcu/ gtor 'bul/mdo thar pa chen po tshar bcu/ sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig sbon lam rnam gsum/ bstan 'bar ma/ de nas zla 6tshes 12bar chos mtshams byed/tshes 14nyin gung tshun dge 'dun tshang ma 'dzom pa byed// tshes 15zhog pa — 591 ——

dbyar gnas tshugs te dbyar 'al bzhes spyor ba'i bso sbyongs ma/dzad de gsol gnyis las kyi sgo nas dbyar/ nga dab/ bskor ba/ tshu'/ 'i/nga 'dren nga/ so sa/sa 'dul sa//zhung ‘ltar phyag len 'ams med byed/ tshes 16zhog nga/ dbyar khas len byed/ glo bur chos/ lda/na gyi bya bar mtshams thor krol dgos byung na byen rlabs tshul mthun byed// 'ag tha ma'i skya reng 'char gong du mchams tshud dbo/sa/ zhal 3don gyi rim nga gzhi gsum gyi phug len 'jug das/sa/ dbye bar nyin/ re spyor chos thun/ drug/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dga' lha/gnas bcu/ gtor ma brgya rtsa/ sher snyeng // (dbum rgyas 'dring bsngus gsum nyin re pod gnyis re/ smon lam sde lnga/ spyod 'jug sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gdugs da/ra/ seng sa/dong ma// bstan rgyas ma bcas chag med khar/ chos spyod kyi rim nga re mos sa/nga rgyas byed/ zla 7tshes ldanas tshes 14bar rgya'/ dbang thams cad ma/khyen gzigs chen po'i 'bas brtan du ched dmig/sa thub dbang gnas/ brtan bcu drug gi cho ga rgyas pa nyin re tshar gnyis dang tshes 15nyin rnam par rgyal ma'i stong mchod/ zla ka tshes 1nas ljongs rgyu nyin gsum la spyor chos gtor 'bul/ bstan 'bar ma bcas mdzad dgos/ tshes 15nyin gnyer tshang nas bsangs rdzas/ gzhon khral gang yin nas bsangs shing 'dus dmangs nas rten khrus/ yul khrus/ bla mchod dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'khor/ tshes 16nas tshes 2 0bar chos thog tshugs pa'i nyin re sbyor chos/ thun drug dga' lha/gnas bcu/ thar mdo tshar bcu// bstan 'bar ma bcas gnas smin byed/zla 'tshes 6nas bde mchog dril bu lha lnga'i sgrub mchod rdul tshon gyi thig chog nyin gsum/ tshes 9nas tshes 2 5bar bdag 'jug smon lam/ shis — 592 ——

brjod / spyim sre/ga rdus pa tshon/ chu shag/ bar nyams med byed/ tshes 2 2snyem tshogs 'bor dang / slong mchod sa/nga rgyas/ zla 1༷tshes 1nas tshes 14bar 'char can mnga' khul phu mdar bso da snyoms byed/ tshes 14nas// tshes 26bar lnga mchod chem/ mo/'i dus mchod nyen re spyor chos /thun drug/ dga' lha'i rnal 'byor/ sa/nas brtan phyab mchod// gtor ma brgya rtsa/ 'bum thang sgrogs/ bla mchod dang 'brel bas tshogs 'khor mtshar sprin dang / dngos gzhir sa/yo med bkod pas mdzes pa'i gling me gang rgyas/ zla 10tshes 2na/sa bzang spyod chos thog ma rtsa skal 'grem ltar dkyus sa/cis/ mas bsdu len gyis chos thog dang mnyam tshugs nyin re sbyor chos/thum/ drug/ nga/ga 'a lha/ gnas bcu/ gtor 'bul/ sgrol ma/ bstan 'bar ma/ bzang spyod// smo na lam sde lnga bcas gnad smin byed/ zla 11tshes 2༷nas dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i thig nyin gsum/ tshes 2nas/ tshes 15bar dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi sgrub mchod bdag mdun bum dbang smon lam 'is brjod/ sbyin sreg rdul tshon chu shag bcas rgyud smad phyag len nyams med byed/ tshes 16nyin/ bum dbang dang / tshogs 'khor/ tshe dbang / tshe rdzas bcas gang rgyas byed/ zla ba ngo re bzhin sgrol ma maṇ+ḍal bzhi chog tshar re/ dgu gtor bskang gso zab rgyas/ yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong bcas chag med/ skal ba 'gro khungs gnas kyi bla ma rim byon la ngo skal gcig dang / khri skal gcig gson phogs 'bun 'phar/ gsol dpon gcig la phogs skal 'grem ltar//rung khang nas chu lug zhib dpyad ltar ja re skyog tshad gsum re/ bzhes thug babs mtshungs/ lor gsar ljongs rgyu/ tshul sgrub mchod ma/ rga/rtong las sne — 593 —

su byed nas 'di phyi skyabs yul gyi bsnyen bkur deb gsal chad med gzengs thon/ sprul sku khas/ la ngo za/la la/ ra khri skal te 'bul sro la sngar lam byed/gnas kyi bla ma nas rnam kun dgon par sa/tan bzhu/ gas thog chos 'chad nyan/dbang bskur/ gtor bzlog/ sbyang ba sbyin sreg 'pho ba lam ston/yar ngo ma ra ngo'i ga/so sbyong mtshan gsal sgrigs bzhugs gang yin gyi blang dor sgrigs khrims thig pa 'phar len byung na sbon ci/ de min dbe/ skos dang bcas nas 'dul khrims gnod 'khur tshul bzhin yong min nyang non rtog zhib gnas bla rims byor nas byed/ sgrigs dang 'gal ba'i nyes chad 'gel dgos byung na dge skos la badzā spyor thog nas byed/ bla 'jal/ lha 'jal/ dbang 'dus mang 'gyed spyin bdag sogs dgongs pa zhu 'os phud/de min gling gseb grwa shag tu bud med rgyu 'grul mi chog rtsa ba bzhi dang 'gal ba ngos blangs kyis dgongs zhu med pas pham pa 'chab bcas kyi sbal pa rma can ri bong rdo brdzus su sdod pa dang / bla ma dang dge skos la ma bzung gis kha lan lag len slog pa bcas byung tshe gaṇ+ḍi shog thod kyi sgrigs dbyung thogashag dngos grwa tshang spyi sar rgyab nas mi rtsa mi bdag dmigs bsal yod na rtsis sprod dang / phyogs mi thag ring bdag po 'di yin ped na gnyer tshang g.yog khongs su 'jug de las gzhan ma nyes pa chung bar tsha ra/ mang ja thug dar lcog brje ba/ dkar me snyan dar/ brgya phyag sogs 'gal 'dzol la gzhigs pa'i gang la gang 'tsham kyi nyes chad che chung bab bltas kyi tshar gcod rjes 'dzin 'phyugs med byed/ gnyer tshang gsar bsko'i thad 'dus tshogs su las sne thon zin yan la 'os bsdus te dang gnyis gsum po su bzang rten gtso'i sprun sngar sbon tshig gnas smin thog brtags bskur gyi thon dang gnyis — 594 —

mang tho bkag ste dgon bdag ser mo spyi khyab yig tshang las khungs brgyud 'char snyan dang sbrags bsko gzhag bskyang rgyu/ las rgyun lo lnga grangs bcad rtsa 'dzin dang 'brel rtsis len sprod kyi gtso bo/ rten gsum/ khang zhing /'dzin chas/ 'dzin dbang sa rigs/ ma dngul/ 'bru mar 'degs gshor/ rta nor sems can sogs sprod deb nang gsal dang / bsdu yong deb dam 'byar rgyab bsgon gtan tshig bcas rtsis len gyi 'dzin khungs dgon bdag yig tshang las khungs su bla bogs dngul srang bzhi bcu zam pa re byings mtshungs dus 'bul thog so so'i las rgyun ring sa gan/sa su lha sde mi sde'i khongs rtsa ba'i rtsa tshig nyan 'jog grwa tshang khongs su skyed dbang mi bsad thal cha dang / nags ri me shor sogs 'gal tshabs che rigs skyem stong gzhis sdod par rgyu rkyen 'phral 'phral dgos rgyu las/ de min thob khongs bsdu yong sgo zho/ me tog rtsa shing / nyin mar/ las rgyugs/grwa btsun bcas bsdu deb nang gsal sngar lam ji yod sprod len gnyis kas 'gal med dang 'brel lcags sprul 'di ga'i tham 'byar dpyad don rtsa 'dzin bcas tshul bzhin dgos rgyu/ phan bde'i spyi nor skyabs mgon rgyal dbang mchog gi dbus bstan srid zhabs brtan du ched dmigs kar dgon dge bsgyur gyi gtan 'bebs tham ka'i don bzhin 'khri khungs so so nas lo re'i 'bab dus thog 'phral 'bul byed pa las/ gnyer las 'khos kar brnyad pa'i khra bzungs gtan nas mi chog bsam med 'ga' zhig nas ngan rgal gyur tshe sa gnas rdzong gzhis sne sdod nas rgyab gnyer bkod 'doms thog mchod rgyun mi nyams gong 'phel dgos rgyu/ bsdu yong gi rigs dang 'degs gshor gyi skyed she 'bab/ shas bogs bcas gtong yong kha 'thab kyi lo lo'i —— 695 ——

mchod sprin dang / dge 'dun rer phogs 'bru gad gtsang rgyu'i khal bcu gsum/ ja tshul bsnyen bkur sogs gtong deb dam 'byar nang gsal khar dad 'bul sbyar deb nang gsal bcas kyi lha mi'i mchod phogs 'bab gtong ji yod lo lo'i dus thog so sor nyams chag dus 'byangs phra mo tsam med pa deb mthun ltar chad med gtsang sel dgos rgyu ma zad sa/sar rnying sprod dpang /rkyem stong gzhis sdod rims 'byor dang las sne thun mong nas byed/ bla blang du gsol dpon gcig ma byan gcig gnyer tshang du mgon khang rgyun gsol grwa gcig gtong gnyer gcig lag bde gnyis spyi bso so sor g.yog bye gra re dang / ja skyog tshad re gnyer tshang 'phos mtsham las 'jug lo gsum ring la mi ngo gnyis/ spyi so las 'jug lo gcig ring mi ngo gnyis bcas tshogs yul dgongs pa zhu srol sngar lam ltar byed/ bla brang /gnyer tshang / spyi bso las sne snga rting gnyis bcas nas rta dre'u so so'i las shag tu nyar tshab/sa byed las/ gleng gseb tu btang mi chog las sne snga phyi nas lo gcig ring las sgrel dang btun pas tshogs dgongs tshul mthun zhus thog mchod gtong byed sgo deb mthun ltar byed/ gnyer tshang sa khongs su shing 'bras 'bras bu rnams dbe/ bed spyod pa las/ sdong po rtsa bkog gcod dreg mi chog khar gsar rnying dbar rtsa rkang grangs bsher rtsis sprod byed dgos//ma ṇi ba dang / gnyer spyi'i 'ing bsdu ba mi gnyis/ thab g.yog mi gcig/ bcas grwa skal re sngar lam ltar sprod/ gnas g.yar yod na gling khrims spyi 'gre'i thog lo re mang ja legs pa re gtong dgos/zla 2tshes 1ldanas rkyem stong / sgang pa/ la zur bcas nas rtsa tshig dgongs don lor re 'char can mngon chen bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs nyin 'phyongs lnga gnad smin byed/ de'i rgyu —— 596 la

'gro 'bru mar bsdu deb nang gsal do dam dge skos dang / lhan skug nas byed/ nang khrims byed po dge skos dge 'dun mtshan 'brel ltar 'khor res kyis lo gcig ring bca' yig nang gsal chos thog tshugs mtshams sgrigs srim kun spyod gnon stam/ gtong 'dzin khag gi mchod pa 'bul bshams rtsis bsher zhib 'jug phogs// ja tshul deb gsal rnam dge sko sa rim can gyis gtong khungs khag nas 'degs len thog spyi so/ zhal bdag mnyam sbrel gyi mchod rgyun 'gro khungs so sor smin par byed/ chos ra nyin 'phyongs rigs dang // gso spyong bcas la dge 'dun rer spos re 'gyed/ gzhung 'don ja legs ldan brgyad/ bzhes thug sa/cig mchod pa sna lnga/ rten ga bor dkar me/ gzhung 'don ja thug rigs la ja re spos rkang re 'gyed srol ltar byed/ dge skos lo 'khor la chab ril mi 'gro sa/zhon gras nas mtshan gsal 'khor 'grem byed/ dbu mdzad gsar bskos nas las rgyun gang ring thog gtso cher cho ga phyag len/ 'don gdangs dbyangs/rnga rol sbug dkrol/ dkyil 'khor bris thig sogs nyam sa len mthil phyin thog tshogs gzhung du dge 'dun blo rab dang bstun pas bskul lcags nyal 'gro'i rgyun bzhin byas te thugs dam 'gro dgos rigs gcig rgyugs 'pher ba do 'khur dbu mdzad rim pas byed/ lo re gzhung 'don gsol ja legs ldan lnga dang / bzhes thug gcig mchod sprin gang rgyas 'bul sbol byed/spyi bso mi ngo gnyis nas las thog lo gsum/ ring sprod gsal 'bru dngul/sem sa can/ 'dzin chas dngos rigs sprod deb nang gsal rtsis len thoga'abru mar gyi bskyed/ sheb 'bab bcas nas mchod gtong 'bul dgos/gtong deb ltar nyams med byed/ dge skos nas brda spyor byung mtshams —— 597 —— —

mchod gtor 'bul gsham sar do 'khur mnyam sbrel byed/ sku gnyer mi gnyis nas las rgyun lo gsum ring gtsug lag khang / sku gsung thugs rten/gser kong / dngul ting spub sil/ phan gdugs/ yol ba/ rgyal mtshan sogs sprod gsal che phra tshang ma dngos mdog ltar mis len gyi ru nga lcag thon slad mis lam 'pher ba/ las 'dzin khag nas mchod mar/ mchod 'bru/ mchod rtsam deb gzhi ltar zhus te mchod yul 'bul khongs su g.yo zol med pa bkod pas mdzes pa bsgrigs gsham mchod g.yog nas gus zhabs ldan pa/ lo lo'i shugs bogs/ sprod gsal ma bskyed dang bcas pa deb mthun ltar byed/ gzhung 'don ja legs ldan gsum/ bzhes thug gcig/ mchod sprin gang rgyas/ zhal bdag nas las rgyun lo gsum ring sprod gsal rung khang phyi nang gi phro zangs/ ja phra zo lag sogs yo byad rnams deb mthun dngos mdog rtsis len/ thag ru nga bdag tshag gang thon/ ja thug gang la'ang g.yo/ zol med pa dge spyi'i gtong sgo 'gyogs sprod sar mnyam len/rung khang du 'dzin spras gtsang sbra gang che 'jug char sprod dpal deb mthun ltar byed/ gzhung 'don ja gsum/ bzhes thug gcig mchod sprin gang rgyas/ grwa tshang spyi thog tu 'bab pa'i spyi rdzas do dam lhan spug mi gnyis bskos thog gtso bo gtsug lag khang nyams gso rten bzhengs/ dge 'dun spyi'i don du phyi 'gro thabs len sogs byed dgos dang / lhan spug bsdad rgyun ring gi rtsis rgyag zhus dag tshogs stengs sar khams dwangs byas te mis khra 'khod pa byed/ slob grwa slob dpon lam rgyun gsum re byed par phogs bsnon 'bru khal bcu gnyes re yod pa gling nang rgyun bsdad thog mtshan gsar slob phrug tshang mar thabs mkhas kyi blo rab dang bstun pa'i yon tan slob rgyun — 598 —

bsring thog dbo/ma/ gyi tsha ga 'don chos tshang ma tshogs rgyugs sprod bcug ste 'don chos yar rgyas yong ba'i do 'khur slob dpon nas byed/ ts+tsha/ba grwa thon nas thab 'dzin skabs dge slong sgrub/ dge phrug re nges par khred srol ltar byed/ dung pa rgya sping pa dge skos thon zin phud de byings ma tshan gsal nas lo gsum re 'khor 'grem byed/ dkyil 'khor bros thig mtshan gsal lo bzhi re 'khor re byed/ las/ tshan gī skal /'phar 'gro dgos/ bla gnyer skal ba bcu ba/nyis/ dbu mdzad dgre skos/ sbu gnyer/ 'al bdagadung pa rgya gling bcas skal 'phar te/ sa/nyer zur byas rjes che nges lo na mtho skeb tshogs 'grim dgongs 'khrol babs ma tshungs byed/ nad pa/mtshams pa da/ngos 'brel byung na dgongs 'khrol thog ja thug dang / 'gyed phogs spyi 'gre spyod/ 'di ga'i sgrigs khongs nas dwags grwa slob sa/nyes du grwa rgyun gtong lam nyams med byed/ de min mtshan bsal sgrigs bzhugs tshang mas lam kyi rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshu'/ nas bzungs bslab par bya ba'i gnas rnams dran shes kyi bas dang ldam/ par byas nas 'khor lo gsum gyi bya bas dus 'da' ba las/ thes nga bag yangs spyod pa'i rigs mi chog bla brang dang / 'a1sa sne ma gtog/sa de byengs nas dgon nang du rta bong sems can gso nyar mi chog cing grwa 'das grong byung na thab 'dzin shag rogs dang /dge phrug yod na la sa/ de min 'das ngo/'i rgyu dngos ngo/ dam las sne thun mong nas byas te bla/ mar bsngo rten/ gnyer tshang du n+d+ra ra lam 'gro dgos bcas phud/ de 'phros dge rtsa mchod yul kho nar smin 'gro byed// dab/ phrug yod na sdod sa/nas shag khongs 'jug bya'/ dge phrug la 'jog dwags grwar grwa rgyun phyin rjes rab 'byams nga/ mtshan btags zin pa dang / gnyer tshang — — 599 — — —

las byed thon zin bcas la gdan srol mdun lhogs sngar lam thog cho ga sgrub mchod rigs la tshogs 'grim spyi 'gre byed/ de min cho sa/ blo 'dzin rgyugs sprod zin pa gang yin sgrub mchod nyin grangs ma thon bar grong chog sogs phyi 'gro dgo/ngas pa zhu bster mi chog tshogs chos ra gang la yang bslab gral go rim ma 'dzol ba thi dul gyi ngang nas cho ba/ phyag len ma/thong ba'i brgyud pa'i bzhed srol nyams med byed/ 'du/pa ba mas ba ngas pa'i tshas bos/ rjam gsum rung ba tshad ldan/ gding ba ldung bzed chu tshags kyis mtshon 'tsho ba'i yo byad bcu gsum gal chung du ma song ba tshags su tshud nges byed/ des/ mtshon zhwa ser zla gam rung mthun gī gos spyon te rang gis tshogs bsags sgrib spyong dang gzhan dwang ba 'dren ba'i mig rgyan du 'gro nges byed/ skyem stong ga'i su mgon grwa gcig/ la zur la dgon gra gcig/ spyan lam dgon la dkon gnyer grwa gcig rin phug dgon la dko/na grwa gcig bcas lo gsum 'khor re dgongs zhu sngar lam byed/ dbus lha dgon dang byin legs bcas la grwa btsun bsdu khongs dge tshul te/ btsun ma'i tshes bzu phyag mchod 'dzin spras bcas sngar lam nyams med byed/ zla 2tshes 5nas tshes 15bar gling phyi'i lcags ri chab bzhugs gling kha zhib gso shing 'bras sbyar lcang sogs gsar 'dzugs chu 'dren bcas do dam dge skos dang / rgan bdag bcas nas byas te skye shing sa/cod dregs byas khongs nas spos sman me shing spyi gzhung du 'jog grwa gsar zhugs skabs bla ma skra rten dngul zho lnga dang zub phyi/ gsol ja/ gnyer tshang du gsol ja dang / drin phyi/'dus tshogs su mang ja legs pa gcig rten gtsor dkar me snyan shal sne bzhag dung dar bcas sgrigs srol srur lam byed/ mdor na tshang mas —— 600 —— —

dge 'dun gyi spyi khrims dang / gang zag/ gi 'gog khrim sa mig 'bras ltar gces srung gis bstan pa rin po che dang mjal ba'i dgon don sdeg spongs dge sgrub kyi blang dor phyin ci ma log pa dgos rgyur bca' yig 'di yang lo ltar bla ma nas sgrogs sbyang ngos/ tshang mas sbangs blangs tshul ldan gyi gtan bde'i legs sgo tshugs pa'i thabs tshul rmad po chen sgo gsum ldur 'grus kyi kun sman rtse gcig si/ dge spyor mdun ma'i yangs rtser son pa zhib/ phyag lem rnam dag du ci nas thebs pa 'tshal/ / smras pa mtha' yas 'gro ba'i snyeng la rtag chags pa'i/ / srid dang zhi ba'i rgud tshogs dri ma/ kun/ / spyongs byed bslab gsum mtho ris ga ka'i chab/ / rgyal kun gsung gi snying po gcig tu 'khyil/ /tshul 'chal lta ba ngan pa'i 'dam skyon gyis/ /ma gos bag yod spyod pa'i bad mo la/ / yid rton thar 'dod rkang pa drug pa'i bu/ / rnam 'dren thugs rje'i nyi ma ga/ la bslu/ /de phyir srid pa srin mo'i gling brgal na/ /byang grol bsam 'phel nor bu'i mdzod chen po/ /no/na gnyer skal bzang blo ldan skye bo rnams/ / bca' khrims grub bo che 'dir da zhugs shig / dge 'dis 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams thugs mthun zhing / /legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba dang / /thub bstan bshad dang sprub pa'i rol mo'i dbyangs/ /nam mkha' ji srid mi nub sgrogs gyur cig / ces kong stod dung dkar dgon gyi khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge 'di ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu mo lug lo'i rgyal zla'i dkar phyogs kyi gral tshes dge bar rtse pho brang chen po po tā la'i shod gzim chung kun bzang bde chen nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te rgyal tham bstsal —rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

spo stod phu dgon chos lding dinaXchen spungs kyi bca' yigame khyi/ ( thru lo 1946 )bod zla 5tshes 7snyan zhib 'jug song /oṃ bde legs su gyur cig dge leg/sa yon tan/ bye ba'i dpal gyis brjid/ / rlabs chen 'phrin las rgyun mi chad mnga' zhing / / re 'dod yid bzhin skong ba'i dngos grub gter/ //dkon mchog rin chen gsum gyis shis par skyongs/ / rab 'byams rgyal kun snying rje'i bcu drug cha/ /yongs rdzogs phan bde'i bdud rtsi'i bsil ba 'bum/ /'bebs mkhas gangs ri'i mgon ngo ri dwags 'dzin// / lhar bcas bde 'byung ral pa'i rtse mor ma dzes/gnyug ma lhan skyes phyag rgya chen po'i 'al/ /'gro la rjen par ston mkhas kar ma pa/ / dus gsum ma/khyen pa chos kyi 'byung gnas sogs/ / sprub brgyud bstan pa 'dzin rnams deng 'dir bsngags/ / dran pas mchog thun dngos grub 'dod dgu'i char/ / 'bad med 'jo ba'i yi dam mkha' 'gro dang / /legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod pa'i/ / ye shes 'jig rten bstan srung bcas pas skyongs/ / gang 'ig ngan song g.yang la rab 'jigs 6()2

shing / /srid dang zhi ba'i bde la rgyab phyogs nas// /rnam mkhyen lang dag don du ga/nyer ba yi/ /dge 'dun das/ gi bca' yig mdor bsdu sa spel/ / de la spo stod phu dbo/na tshas lngeng rin chen spungs kyi dbe/ 'dun rnams nas rgya' ba'i bstan bar ji ltar bslab pa'i rim ba khrims su bca(ra pa /ma/ rang cag rnams/ sngon tshe ngabs mang po'i dge rtsa dang smon lam chen po'i ma thus thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che da/ra ba'i yu/la dbus/ 'phags pa phyag na nga/da gro'i 'dul zhing gangs ri'i rwa bas bskor ba'i nang tshan/ spo yul khro/ rgyan gyi sbas lung / o rgyan chen po lang sprul rig 'dzin brgyud par bcas pas byin brlabs/ 'bas kyis bcags pa'i gnas dge bcu tshang ba'i yul du dal 'byor gyi rten bzang ngo thob/ mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rin po che da/nga mjal ba'i dus 'dir bla na med pa'i go 'phang thob thabs 'ib/ ma byas na1 pyin chad 'di 'dra snyed par shin tu dam/'a ste/ so so'i thar pa'i mdo /mas/ sangs rgyas zhes bya'i sgra (3di yang / / 'jig rten das na rab tu dkon / /zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs shing / de ltar rten khyad par can la brten nas snying po rnam dag cig nges par len dgos/ snyeng po len tshul yang / thog mar yon tan kun gyi ga'i rten yi ge 'bre klog sogs byang chub pa jig byas nas/ bstan pa la 'jug pa'i rim pa ni/ phyi nang gi khyad par skyabs 'gros 'byed par gsungs pas// thog mar mchog gsung la skyabs su 'gro zhing / skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya rnams la tshul bzhin bslab/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa ba so thar ris bdun las dge tshul slong ge sdom pa zhes nas srog gcod/ mi tshangs spyod/ ma byen len/ mi chos bla ma'i rdzum/ smra ba rtsa ba bzhi la gcig 'gal yang dge slong la pham pa dang / dge tshu'/ la pham (rte() rte

'dra ste rdza bum chas/sa pa bzhin gsor mi rung pa na/ rtsa ba bzhi/ po srog sga phyir yang mi spyod/ gzhan yang dge tshul gyi blang 'das so drug dge slong blo/ khrims nyis brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa gsum sogs/ ltung ba phra zhib rnams bshags sdom gyis dge gso zhing / nyes ltung spyong ba'i thabs nya stong gi gso spyong / dbyar dang dgag dbye ste gzhi gsum gyi nyams len/ dang 'brel bslab pa rnams tshul bzhim du bsung ba ni rang rgyud la theg ba che chung gi yon tan thams cad skye ba'i gzhi slob dpon klu sgrub sogs kyis gsungs shing /tshul khrims yang dag par ldan pa'i mdo las/ tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang 'phrad/ ces sogs phan yon mtha' yas par gsungs pa'i so so thar pa'i sdom pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gzhi rtsa yin pas na/tshul khrims kyi bslab pas rgyud dag par byas pa'i steng du// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa gang nas gshegs pa'i lam po che byang chub sems pa'i sde snod la ring du 'dris par byas/ sems bskyed/ kyi sdom pa zhes nas/ de'i bslab bya dang bcas la legs par bslab/ rtsa ltung bco brgyad dang / nyes byas zhe drug sa/nga rung gis byang sdom 'a sa nyams pa'i skyon byung na/ bshags sdom dang / slan chad nyes ltung gis ma gos par byas la/ gsang chen bla na med pa'i sgor bzhugs/ smin byed dbang gi rim nga/ tshul bzhin du nos te/ rtsa ltung bcu bzhi/ sbom po brgyad sogs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig rnams mig 'bras ltar bsrung / dam tshig las 'das pa'i skyon byung na/ stobs bzhi'i bshags sdom sogs kyis sor chud par byas te/ smin grol gyi lam la gcig tu gzhol bas dal 'byor don ldan du bya dgos pa ni chos khrims su bca' ba'i snying po yin zhing / de lta bu'i rigs la/ de las lhag pa'i —— 604 la

khri/ mas su bcad 'a ba zur nga/ mi dbo/sa mo da// snyen/sa ma'i dus 'dir 'gro rnams nyon/ rngo ngas rags 'ing lha spyod ming ba la brten/ sngon byon/ dam pa mang pos dbo/ 'dum gyi bca' khri/ mas mang du bstsal ba ltar// 'dir yangartsespang blang ba/ sa/nad du dril ma/// spyir mi 'be/ ba bcu nga/nga // mtshams med pa lnga/ de dang nye ba /rnge/ sob/sa 'i dus/ thams cad/ du spang dgos pa gzhir bcas 'ing / khyad nga1ra chang dang bud med ni spyir nyes pa kun bskyed pa'i rtsa ba yin 'i/nga // sgos su dge 'dun gyi sde la bstan pa bshig pa'i rgyu che shos nyid du nges te/ ji skad du/ chang dang bud med rnam ga/yeng nga/sa/ gis ni/ /tshul khroms 'phros/ nga/'i chom rkun chen po ste/// / 'di phyi'i sdug bsngal ma lus kun bskyed pa'i// / nyes/ pa'i 'byung khungs nyed du mkhyen par mdzod/ /ces gsungs pa'i phyir to/ gzhan sna/nga nye phyog/sa bsgrigs pa/ da/ge/ 'dun gyi dbyen/ du gyur pa'i rigs sos/sa bstan pa la sa/nod/ pa'i bya ba mtha' dag spangs ming / dran shes bag yod pas ci byed chos dang mthun par byed//khyad par gsang ba sngags kyi sgor bzhugs te dam tshig tshul bzhin du ma srung na rdo rje'i dmyar bar bskal pa grangs med du gnas dgos pa dang sngags la brten nas dngos grub rnam pa gnyis 'grub mi 'grub kyi rtsa ba dam tshig kho na la rag lus par gsungs pas/ bla ma ched grogs la dad pa dang dag snang sbyong sems can la snying brtses phan pa sgrub cing / dam sdom mig 'bras ltar bsrung / chos spyod bcu dang thos bsam sgom pas dus 'da' ba sogs rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub cing bstan pa'i zhabs tog tu 'gyur ba'i spyod pa la nan tan du mdzad dgos pa yin/ skabs su babs pa 'dus sde'i nang khrims dmigs kyi dkar ba la/ spyi mchod zhes pa kar gling zhi/ khro'i sgrub la 605 la

ma/chod nyin bahru/ de bzhin du kun rig/ nyen bdun// bde mchos nyam/ bdun1/ thru na ras gzig/sa/ rgyal ba rgya mtsho nyin bdun// nga/da ma bza skru ba chen brgyad hru'i bum sgrub chen mo nyin bcu/ spo rdzong rtse drung bde nga/ngas blo bzang rin chen nas gsar ba'ag lo ltar zla 4tshes 1 5nyin mchod 'bul dang 'bre—ra/ nyin tshos/sa gcis/ dpal mo lus/sa sprung sa/nas cha bzhi/ rkyal/ bal/ 'a da/sa 'don nyin lnga/ chos sde bhan bco zwa/ ja res zhe/sa pa 'jigs byed drug sbe lcags mkhar dang // gro lod yas zor bzlos pa bcas nyin dgu/'chad༄/ sbyang khrim/ lnga/ sku rim/ zhes pa mgom ngo/'i dgu gtor chen ngo/'i sa/ra 'cham dang 'bre'/ ba nyin dgu bcas tshogs chos gang yo/da sbyin bdag/ dang gnyer las 'dzin rnams nas/ so sor zla dus tshes khrur lam 'phyus/ che1da ma ga rtog/sa/ rang 'jo/da dang bsnyun nas nam lhogs byas mi tshag grwa dmangs nas kyang lo ltar gyi tshos/sa chos gang yo/da kyi tsha tsa tshas spyod blo 'dzin sos//sa dpe sbyangs byang chub par byed/ rdor dril ḍa ma ru sogs/ 'os nga 'i yo/ byad gang dbo/sa gra rigs so so nas la thogs/ med pa dang / de mtshungs thigs/ rdul tshon/ cho ga phyag len// 'don rta dbyangs/ mtshad bzo mar rgyan// 'cham gar sta bas/ 'bud brdung dkrol gsum sogs phyag len gang yin la rang bzos 'ol tshod du ma song bar mthong rgyud kyi phyag len du rbebs par byed/dge 'du rnams kyi mdzad spyod skor yang / mdo las/ gro/la nas grol ba'i lam yang ston/ / bslab pa dag la rab tu ga/nas/ / —'ding gi dam nga/ yo/na tan ldan/ /tshogs mchog dge 'dun ldan she / /zhes gsu/ngas pa ltar mkhan slob kyi spya ma/ sngar ji ltar khas blangs pa'i bslab sdom mis/ /3bras ltar srung 'ing / ji dul bag yod kyi sgo nas tshas gos/ rnam gsum 'ding ba/ ba bzed// chu tshags 6()6

sos/sa dge/ tshul slo nga si yo byad rnams tshogs su tshud bar byas nas rab byung gi rtags cha lugs ma nyam/sa par byed pa las/ khyim pa skya bo'i chas go/sa/ skra ring / bo/sa thung sogs mis/ sngar mis/ ma/dzes pa'i rigs dang / go/sa phud nas sto/da gcer ba sos//sa gtan nas mi chos cing / de das/ byed pa byung ma chos khri/ mas pas/ rgyugs/ lnga/ / lnga re g.yi/ra nas/ slan chad sdom du bcub/ tshogs brda dung dang mkha/ ra ༅/ ting ting / rnga brda' sa/nga yin lngar sro/la ji yo da lngar ring thung tshod zim nga byus nga 'i skad mtshams/ ma bcad gong nas tshog/sa 'du dgos / de min tshogs su / rjes lus byung rigs yu/na ring thung la da/pas/sa pas brgya phyag sogs sa/nga la gang 'os bcad/ tshogs 'tshogs skabs/ rdo rje slob dngo/na gyis dbu mdzad mas rim pyis yar byon dam tshas 'dul ba nas grib tshod sor sa/nyis nga/na chad kyi go rim mdzad pa ltar pa bslab pa rgan gzhon la lhos pa ma/ gtogs/ lo bgres sa/zhon da/nga btsan byu/ga dbang shed sogs kyi ma/tho snyegs/ bya sa ped pas/ so/ thar gyi bslab pa go rim dang 1/yo na tan che rim bzhin/ ga/dong gral dang / gdong skyor/ rtsa gral rnams su rim ba'i na nu tig bltar la brgyus pa ltar lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du 'khod/ tshogs brda' bcad pa dang / dbu mdzad nas 'don pa bskul bsnyun grwa dmangs nas kyang rgya mtshor rdo 'phang gi tshul du yas rim gyi/sa 'don pa las kha snga lag mgyogs mi byed/ 'don pa'i gzhung yang lhod bag dang lnga/na pa gdangs dbyangs sogs gang yin dbu mdzad kyi gsung 'gros ltar 'don pa ma gtogs/ sngon rgyug rgyab lus/ ra skad (zug skad/mgyogs 'bul 'then khyer/ gtam smra ba sogs mi byed/ dbu mdzad nas kyang tshogs yu/na dang / bzlas ba'i yu/na tshod/ gyer ga/dngas dbyangs 607

bcas tshod ring thung thams cad sngar bla ma dbu mdzad mkhas pa rnams kyi phyag ba'i/sa kho na las/ rang 'dod sbu mos byas mi chos/ 'don/ mtshams 'jog skabs kyang me long la ha btab nga ltar mas rim nas 'jog pa las/ sa/cod ma tshams mi 'os pa'i rigs mi byed/ cho ga las byang gang yin gyi 'dzab bsnyen sko bas/ lha sngas/sa ting 'dzin dang ra/ bral bar bzlas pa'ang ngag bsnyen dang 'ur 'dom/ sa/nga yin tshul ldan byas ba las/ sgo gsum tha ma/sa du 'chol ba'i rigs// gnyid dang 'ong sa/tam sogs mi byed/ 'bud brdung dkrol gsum byed pa rnams nas kyang / grags/ stong rdo rje'i rang sgrar thes nga sa phyag len tshul bzhin ran par lag tu bstar ba las rang snang sa/nga shar mi byed/ gso/ma zhal yang sgrigs mthun las/ dngul shan ma sogs ra ma lus/ 'dra min ma/ 'os pa'i rigs 'khur mi chog gsol ja dang thug nga/ ba'e/sa ska bas kyang bza' btung gi rnal 'byor dang ldan pas longs spyod ba las/zas la sred zhen dang // cag cag phu phu sog/sa bzhes lugs tshul dang mi mthun pa dang / skabs der don med sgra brjod byed sa med/ tshogs chag khral yang sngar 'bab bzhin nyin re chag na mar spor lnga re// dgu gtor gyi 'cham po nyin gsum dang / bum sgrub kyi nang dbang dang / rgyab dbang gi ser sbreng bcas rtsa chad la chag khral nyin re mar rgya gang re le thog med pa dras/ zhan tshang mas 'degs 'jal thog tshogs 'khor sogs chos ston 'gyed pa'i tshe / che chung ji ltar thob pas chog shes pa las 'dod pas ngo sgrib che chung rtsod pa sogs mi byed/ tshogs grol ba'i tshe'ang gral mjug nas rim bzhin bzhengs nas dal bul grol ba las zing long har rgyugs mi byed/rgyun gtan rang rang gi shag tu bgres gras dbang lung man ngag gsan zin pa — 608 —

rnams nas yi dam lha'i bsnyen sgrub dang 'brel bas rang gzham/ gyi don lhur bzhes dang / gzhon pa rnams nas blo dus dang mtshams par bla ma dge rgan rigs tshad ldan gyi mdun nas da/pe 'khrid dbang lung zhu 'os dang 'brel ba'i nyams len dang / gseng bar du dbo/na gyi 'don cha'i dpe cha blo 'dzin skyor sbyang thog/ 'don rta dbyangs/ rnga rol 'bud bkrol gyi phyag len gtor bzo dkad rgyan/ mcham sbyang sogs la brtson pa lhur len byed pa ma gtog/sa/rgan gzhon gyi bo/ babs zhe sa mi 'jog med par rtsod 'dzing dang / lhag par rang rang nyams par byed sa'i rkyen che shos grong gseb tu 'khyams nyul byed pas mtshon// rkang bro glu gar dang / sho rgyan rtsal 'dren/ don med long gtam/ ku re rgyal la/ sogs ma 'os pa'i rigs nam yang mi chog cing /gal srid rtsa ba bzhi/ dang 'gal rigs shar tshe dge 'dun pa'i gnas nas nges par 'byung / de'ang nyes can su yin nas tshogs dbus gral gsham du brgya phug gcig phul rjes/ pus mo btsugs/ chos khrims pas de nyid kyi byas 'dzol rnams tshogs gtam drag gtong dang 'brel rab byung gi chas gos rnams phud/ gos dkar g.yogs te lus steng du lcang dbyugs nyis brgya tham pa/ tshang ma'i mig lar 'doms slad gnad 'phrod btang thog shog thod mdo sgrub dang 'brel bar gnas nas dbyung / de dbyengs so sos byas 'dzol la dpags pa'i nyes chad che chung gang 'os bla ma dbu chos gros dbang rnams nas chos mthun skabs su babs ba'i gcod rgya byed/ gnas dang bla ma mjal skor 'gro rigs bla ma dang / dbu mdzad chos khrims tshang mar dgongs pa zhu 'khrol dang / nang khyim du 'chi rkyen bgegs dang dgos gal gyi khyim du 'gro mi nas chos khrim mas par dgongs zhus kyis 'gro ba las/

gzhan tshogs tshas yod mi/da la ma lhos par dbo/ngas zhus bya sa med/ ja 'dren ni/ mtshad sna las khra/ la rdzogs pa rnams yar phud/ de min thams cad 'gro res dgos/ se/ra sbreng ba/tor rgyag/ ar las sogs kyi ska/bas//sgreb/sa rim dang chos/ khri/ mas pa sos/sa gnyer yod rnams kyis gang dbo/sa las bsku la byung 'phral/ so so mas gus nga/sa dwang len byed nga las bsgo ba rnar ga/zon/ ngan rgal rigs mi tshas/ dge 'dun gī 'al ta'i spyin bdag dang //dung khang du bsdad pa'i ja 'dren pa sos//sa nas kyang dbe/ 'dun bgres gzhon rnams la dad gus lhas/ bsam gyi bkur ste gang che ma gtogs/ dgre/ 'dum rnams kyang thug/sa mthun khrims gtsang bos/ dge spyong du byed pa'i chos ba'i la gnas pa las rgyu za kha mchu/ rtsod 'jen sos/sa mi byed/ ga/la srid 'thab mo rdung dzogs sogs byed pa byung na dam pa gong ma tsho'i khrims yig bzhin kha rtsod/ khu tshur/ sbar dbrang sogs la brgya phyag rdo dang dbyug pa la stong phyas/ gri mtshon phyung ba dang / rmas 'gram byung na ja 'khor ga/sum/ thug dar cog snyan dar/ dung dar mang ja bcas/ lug lā dang / phas/ rgod gdong yan chad lngar nas gong ma rim byon gyi bka'i re gtad gnang ba'i rngen rgya yin pas/ mi ngan bshan ba re zung gis 'gal rigs byung na/ bla ma gra rigs thams cad kyis 'phral du rtsad gcod drag po 'gugs sbyang gis sbar lam ja 'khor gsum/ thug dar cog mang ja snyan dar sogs gcod dras kyi phyin chad sdom pa'i gan rgya len cing / bla gros kyis ga bos pa'i las gnyer thams cad nas mtshad gnyer rtsis sprod dang /ga/tong rtsa sprod len sogs kau ngaX bro rdzams gtan tshigs yig rigs gzhir zung gis bdag sprod bcas pre sa thos rgyal bstan gong 'phel gyi las la ()1()

brtson pa ma gtogs/ dus dbang la bsnyad pa'i gsar gtam dran bskyed kyis sngar srol bzang po ngan pas bslad cing / gtan tshigs yig ris dang /bsdu bro'i de/ba yig la bzo bcos mchan bar/da sogs kyis mtshon bstan lar gnod pa'i ngan shed kyi bya ba phyi nang drag zhan su thad nas mi chog gtong sgo'i tshogs yi/ yang / gcan gzan 'phar spyang / rba rdo lta bus bsad rigs dang // nyo tshong si/ ༅/ las de min ched du bsad pa'i dge 'dun la bsngo ge/ gtong len gtan nas mi chog cing / de byengs gtong tho nang ltar tshul ldan dgos rgyu las/ dkor rdzas rtsis sprod dang / gtong sgo'i rigs la 'phri bslad/ sbas brkung sogs byung rigs la 'gal tshabs dang bsnyun pa'i nyes chad dang / rtsis sprod len skabs srol rgyun gcig pa'i sgrigs lam dang mthun nges dgos rgyur rang 'dod rigs mi chog pa bcas phyi nang bsam spyor spyod lam thams cad la gdung shugs chig sgril gyis bstan don lhur len dgos rgyu/ bo/nga gi bca' khrims de dag la bgres gzhon mtho dam/na su thad nas 'gal ba byung tshe chos khrems pa nas mtho dman dran gzhan rang gzhan phyogs ldung ngo srung gi grim lhod dang / dngos po'i rjes 'brang sogs ma yin pas dbon mtshag dpang btsug gis blta dgos ma gtogs skyon gnad ther 'don bya rgyu brjod par nus min gyis mi skyon spos bkung / bstan don yas bor// lo zla 'ag grangs ma so/ ci bud kyi rang 'gar le lo phyi bshol gyi dbang du btang na/ bstan pa mgo nas bshigs pa'i nyes tshabs che nges ma zad/bka' srung chos skyong rnams kyis 'khu ldog yong rgyur/ de 'dra'i rigs su ma song bar/ rang bzhin drang pos chad las zhi drag sang 'os slad lar 'doms pa gcod cing / dge 'dun zams nas rgya/ma ba'i lung rtogs kyi 611 —

bstan pa dang mthun ba'i tshas nyams su len pa las/ ban bon 'cha'1 'dres sogs kyi bsre lhad dang / sgrig lam la gtser sun gyi byol thabs bshad mkhas gla ba nags 'dod dang / ri bong 'khan 'dod byed sa med /gal te ngan pa kha mthun/ gcig rgyab gnyis sgon gyis jos khrims pa la rtsis med kyi nga che nga btsan shed gtam shed 'gros kyi ma zung do brtos la/ len byas na brgya phyag bco lnga/ lag len/ byas na dngul srang bco lnga nas/ nyi shu rtsa lnga re'i bar 'gal tshabs dang bstun pa'i gcod dras dgos/ mdor na dge 'dun bgres gzhon tshang mas bla ma dbu chos la gus dud dwang len thogakhyim pa sun 'byin gyi las dang / kun gyi ngan dper 'gran pa'i spyod ngan mtha' dag sdom ste rgyun du dran shes bag yod pa'i khrims grogs dang 'grogs/gzhan phan gyi lhag bsam bskyed cing dgra bo dug lnga'i mgo bo 'bur 'joms su gtong / chos spyod kyi bgyi ba mtha' dag 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du ma song bar lta sgom spyod gsum rnam par dag pa la 'bad 'bung 'don pa gal che/ 'gro ba'i bde spyid thams cad sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la rag las shing / bstan pa de dar rgyas yun du gnas dge 'dun gyi 'dul khrims la rag las par gsungs pas bla ma/ dbu chos/ grwa bgres gzhon/ gnyer las 'dzin sogs khur thang yod tshad kyi dgon gyi bstan pa dang / dge 'dun gyi 'du tshogs rgyas shing bslab gsum nyams len gong 'phel ba sogs kyi thabs la bsam pa rgya bskyed de ngo tsha brel yod kyi lhag bsam rnam par dkar bas mgo 'og lus tshud/ mtho dman bgres sa/zhon tshang mas bstan nus phyar ba gru 'degs kyis 'khor lo gsum dang chos spyod rnam bcu'i bya ba nyams pa sor chud/ mi nyams gong 'phel gyis bstan 'gro'i mig rgyan dam par — 612

'gyur ba'i 'khur bsam ldur bzhes gal che/ de don spo stod rdzong sdod rtse drung rim 'byod nas gong don cha shas tsam yang mi 'gal ba'i 'jug gnon blta thib lho/da/ yangs su ma song ba bstan pa'i zhabs 'degs su 'gyur ba'i lhag bsam do 'khur che bskyed dgos rgyu bcas de don tshang mas khe nyen blangs dor ma 'dzol ba'i nyams len rgyun 'khyongs su spyod pa 'tshal/ smras pa/ / dge legs yon tan du mas/ rab mdzes pa'i/ 'dus pa'i sde 'di'i bkra shis mdzad bzang gi/sa/ / de mtshan/ phan bde'i lam bzang rab rgyas nas/ / 'gro kun rnam grol thar pa'i gling bgrod shog ces phu dgon chos sding rin chen spungs kyi khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge 'di ni rab byung bcu drug pa'i me pho khye lo'i sgon zla'i gral tshes 26dge bar nor gling bde sgyid kun dga' 'khyil ba'i bskal bzang pho brang gi shod gzim chung legs byas 'dod 'khyel nas bres/ zhes gos ser thog bris te rgyal tham bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan (1/ / / /

srid tham bca' yig 'chan zin snyan zhu/shing pag ( spyo lo 1/⑩ ༈ 5 )zla 9tshes 1 1bhan 'ib 'jug song /i su ste/ kun khyab phyobs lhung bral ba chos kyi dbyengs / /'khor 'das ngo/ngas dag rang grol chen po'i klong / / re dwogs tshas zad byar med rig pa'i ga/shis/ / rang rigs 'od gsa' rdo rje'i snyeng por 'dus/ / bsal mdangs 'od lnga 'bar ba'i 'og min 'ing / / sgyu 'phrul 'khor gyi tshom bu 'khyil ba'i/ dbus/ / rang byung rang shar 'gro 'dul mtsham dpe'i gar/ / mtsho bye sa rdo rjes byin /grobs gru char phob/ // rab 'byams rtsa sa/su /ma rjad byung rol sna/'i sprin/ / sems snyed ma bcos gnyus ma'i tsha 'phrul las/ / gnyis med gnyis su snang ba'i bdas/ nyid du/ // skyangs su rten no 'is pa dam pas skyo ngas/ /ga/tum chen mi zad khro/ bo 'bar ba'i gar/ / ma hwa ka/ la sde lnga ga/ter srung bcas/ / rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i dam las ma 'da' bar/ // sde 'dir lebs snyes stangs 'dzin g.yel med mdzong/ / brdo chen 'od gsal gling gi sprub gra yi/sa/ /blang dang don bya nyams su bstar ba'i tshul/ /ji ba'i na yig 'phreng mu tig chun po 'di/ / mchog dman kun gyi za/ ba'i rgyan du tshangs/ / zhes bla ma 614

lha'i ba/sa je'i byen rlabs kyi gru char bcwa ba (nga/ ba'i bden tshis/ rma bya dga' ba'i sprin sgra dal bur glal ba sngon du btang mas ṭā/nga bar bya ba ni/ 'o sko la gyi ston pa sgreb ga/nyis dgra tshogs ma lus nga/ bcom/sa shing ngo/na tan ma tha' dab/ mngon du mdzad zin nga/'i 'dren nga/ mnyam med zas gtsang sras po'i) bstan pa rin po che ni ji ska da du// /'gro ba'i sdus/ bsngal sman gcig ngu// / bde ba thams cad /'byung ba'i gan/sa/ // bstan/ pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur ceg / ces ris su ma chad pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag thog/ ma med pa nas las dang nyon rbongs pa'i dbang gis ldug bsru/ma gsum gyi zug rngu drag po'i nad kyis btabs nga/ rtsa ba nas phyung ste thi bar byed pa dam/ nga/'i thos kyi rtsi mi na ‘lo brten na/sa srid pa dang 'i ba'i phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i gnas rgyal ba'i bste na pa rin ngo/ che lus can rdza/mas kyi legs byas kyi zhing da/ma par bla nas /blar bskur ba'i sri zhu dang bcas te sems can rnams kyi mgon skyabs da phung gnyen du yu/na ring po gam/sa par gyur cig gsung pa ltar/ lha dang bcas pa'i yid can kun /ma gnas skabs mngom/ mtho dang / mthar thug nges/ legs kyi 'dod rgu ma lus pa 'byung ba rgyal ba'i/ lung sgoms kyi bstan pa rin po che man+da da ba'i 'khri shing 'di nyid dar lhos lo nar rag las shing / de 'dzin/ gangs can ljongs 'di/ra sa dge bkar rnying zhi byed so/ga/sa sa/dul bya so so'i rang ska/la dang mtshams pa'i jos (phub//sa rkang /3thung gis dag/'a tshal tshar du mngar ba'i ya gyal lnga 'gyur rnying ma'i nang tshan grol ba ba'i ldan kun bzang gi dgongs pa nyams su len zhing / snang bzhi'i ye 'es ‘ra brtson goms kar len nga/sa kun mkhyen nga/rja/ kha ra'i thug/sa rje'i 'od snang gis nyams rtogs kyi pad mo grol bas dgongs gter nam mkha' mdzod () 1 6

la dbang bsgyur ba gter bton 'od gsal bde chen gling pa dang / rig nga 'dzin tshe dbang rgyal mtshan zung gis blo stobs ma mid pas kun mkhyen ma hā gu ru'i lung don/ ltar snyigs lnga'i rgud mtshan spyi dang / gnam bskos dga' ldan pho brang gi chab srid la pha rol mi dang mi min gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa ji mchis zhi phyir go 'jo'i khul du ra chu mkhar mdo zhes gnas mkhar yul grong dang ma 'brel ba'i dben par bde chen 'od gsal gling zhes pa'i dgo/na ga/na/sa gsar 'debs dang 'brel bam/'a brgyad bde sa/shegs 'dus pa sogs rtsa ba gsum gyi rkye/ brnyan bris 'bur/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur rin po che dang /rin chen gter mdzod sogs sa/sar rnying ris med kyi glegs bam dang / sra mkhre/ gas rdo ba'i gong bur bskrun pa'i mchod sdong brgya rtsa sogs rten dang brten pa gsar bskrun thog thang yig las/ slob 'chad grwa la rje yis mthun rkyen spyor/ bod kyi ban sngas/sa dbu zlum lcang lo can/ zhes mchod gnas sde gnyis su gsung pa bzhin lcang lo sngags pa'i sde'i 'dus tshogs dang /gter sras pad ma mtha' yas kyis gling stod du ngur smrig rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa rab byung mdo'i sde gsar tshug/sa bcas mdo sngags zung du 'jug pa'i sde mi dman tsam yod 'dug pa dus mthar bstan pa'i mig rgyan du gyur gshis/des na rab byung 'dus pa'i sde rnams nas rnam dag 'dul ba'i bca' khrims phra rags mig 'bras ltar srung 'doms thog thos bsam sgom gsum sogs dam pa'i tshul dgu'i yon tan zla ba mthong ba'i chu gter ltar rgo/nga 'phel yo/nga ba/ sngags grwa rnams nas sngags kyi rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam/ tshig srung 'doms thog theg chen byang chub sems bskyed dang 'brel ba'i sngon 'gros rgyud sbyangs/ dngos gzhi/ rim gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin la gzhol ba yar mar tshes —— 616 — —

bcu/ rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho/'i sgrub pa dus mchod sogs klu yis bzung ba'i gdeng kar co 'dri ba'i gces spras kyis dus thog nyams chag med pa dgos rgyu/ dmigs bsal las sne dgongs pa zhus gtong byung las/ de min ser skya mchog dman sus kyang gling nang myos 'gyur 'khye/ ra btung /bud med 'ag/ sdod/ gos phu thung can stson pa/ mgo dkris rgyag pa/ ki sgra dang // rtsod 'dzing / rkang bro glu dbyangs sogs tshul min rigs mi chog pa dang / bla ma las sner rtsi 'jos/ dge 'dun bslabs khrims la bkur bste/ dkon gnyen sogs nas gtsug lag khang la bdag gces dang 'brel bas rten gsum la sri zhu'i rim pa dngos gtsang / gling nang rang rang 'khri khungs la gad bdar shi gson gyi skor la bag med spyod pa spangs te dge rtsa bstan 'gro'i don du smin nges/ chos khrims 'gal rigs la gter ston yab sras brgyud bcas nas las 'bras dpang bzhag phyogs lhung bral ba'i lugs mthun bkod khyab byed cing / sgrub mkhar chag yul sngon/ phan go 'jo'i sa khongs su gtogs pa tsam las/ yul grong gi bdag zung ped pa'i dben ljongs la brten slad phyin sgar dgon nas bdag 'dzin bya rgyur lding khag dgus dang phul thog go 'jo gzhis sdod dang / 'gro 'dren mkhan pos lag 'khyer the'u btang 'dug par spug dam 'go 'chan rin po che stsal 'byar sa mtshams tho rtags kyi khongs su yod pa'i rtsa chu shing gsum dgon pa rang gi sngar rgyun bdag gir 'dzin 'thus kyi sa khongs su ri dwags gshor ba//dbyar gro be sprug gis mtshon pa'i ldum bu'i lo 'bras bsko breg longs su spyod pa sogs med par rang khungs nas 'gog srung do dam dang 'brel 'gal rigs la chos mthun khrims kyi stangs 'dzin yan song med pa dgos rgyu/ mchod —— 617 —

thebs dad 'bul sa thing dang / dkar me/ ri khrod pa'i 'tsho rten she nor/ra lug dang bcas/ par mi 'os pa'i gsar sprod khral 'grel rigs nam ya/nga mi chog pa bcas da phan gnas bathin ci yin rte1ra la bhe slebs 'i drag dngo na rigs che phra dang / go 'jo'i sar 'khod ser skya mjog dman tshang mas phan char mthun 'gyur gang che las gnod 'ga'/ bsam sa/tan gyi 'tsher mar 'gro rigs phra mo tsam med pa dgos rgyu/ gong don las 'gal ba'i bsgo/ ba rnar gdon tshul min rtsing spyod rigs phyi nang su thad nas ma chis rung dgon sde 'o/ngas kyi spyi khya/ ba rtse yig tshang las khungs brgyud gzhung tu tshon zhu byung ba spun rgyal khrims kyi chad pa mig lar 'doms pa gcod rgyur/ de rtsis mtshas dman tshang mas 'di phyi'i khrems 'bras la bsam ga'i bas tshul mthun gyi tshas srid byed sgo che phra bstan 'gro'i don phan mig rgyan du gyur pa'i rtsa /'dzin rgyun 'khyongs kyi nyams nyen tshul ba'i na dgos rgyu yi/na/ 'dir smras nga// rab 'byams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i rgyal dang rgyal sras nyam/ rang 'phags tshogs dang / / drang srong bden pa'i tshig/ la ma nga/shā bsgyu ra rnams/ smon gnas 'grub pa'i bden tshig mdzad gyur cis// / 'jis rten spyi dang rgya hor bod gsum du/ / rgyal bstan dar 'ing bstan ('dzin 3/ bas pad bstan/ / dgen 'dun thug/sa mthun khrems btsang bshad spru ba kyis/ //'gro kun bde spyod dpal la spyod gyur cig / khya/ da par rgyal kun bo bo dpal 'byung gi/ / thug/sa bcud rgyu sde a/ ti yo ga yi/ / 7 das lhun grub zu/nga 'jub rnam 'byor gyis/ /thugs rgyud sa/tam pa'i sde 'di rgyas gyur cig // ces mno sbags zung 'jug bde chen 'od gsal gling gi sprub grwa rnams nas blang dor khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge mu tris/ 'phreng mdzes jes bya ba 'di nyid rab byung 618

bcu drug pa'i nang tshan/ na tshod ldan zhes shing mo phag lo'i zla 'tshes 2 6dpebar phyogs kun las za/ma par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po po tā la nas breru'e/sa gos ser thog bres te srid ngim bstsal rgyu zhus ma/ /mthus mim snyan zhu/ / / //

grid sgrong stag brag gis stag brag dgon pan bstsal ba'i bca' migame phag (spyo lo 1947)bod zla 5tshes 16nyin zhi/ba 'jug song /oṃ swa ste/ gang gi zhabs sen reg pa'i rdul phran yang / srid zhi yongs kyi gtsug gtor rtser 'phos pa/ legs lam bkra shis rdzogs byed don kun grub/ sa gsum 'gro ba'i bla mas rtag tu skyongs/ rgyal kun mkhyen rab dmar ser gzhon nu'i sku/ thun mtshams bla gos/ 'dzin pa'i mig 'phrul gar/ blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa bong kha pas/ byin rlabs bdud rtsi'i zil mngar bcud du phob/ phul byung dbyangs kyi dbyangs snyan ngag gi dpal/ dbang bsgyur blo gter blo bzang rgyal ba yi/ bstan pa mchog 'di mchog tu 'dzin pa la/ ngo mtshar rgya chen rgya mtsho'i mgon der 'dud/ yongs dag dag gsal mkhyen pa'i ri dwags 'dzin/ khri phrag khrag khrig snang ba'i mdzod chen po/ ngag dbang dbang phyug sku bzhi'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs/ dam chos chos bzhi/na 'phel mdzad mgon der sngags/ zla bral srid na zla med rdzogs sangs rgyas/ zab zhi spros bral zab mo dam pa'i —— 620 —

chos/ rgyu skar 'phreng ba rgyu 'dra'i dge 'dun sder/ bstod bsngags glu dbyangs bstong/ sprin/ rgya mtshos mchod/ kun bzang che mchog khra/ po 'thungs 'khor lo sdom/ snang stong sgyu ma'i srin ngo/ khros pa'i nyam/sa/ dpal ldan phyag ba'i/ bal/'a sdod pho nyar bcas / sde 'dir sru nga skyob stang ba/ /'dzin g.ye/la med/ mdzod// 'jigs rung 'kho/ ra ba'i/ 'brog dgon nyams nga ba//brgal ma/sa tsha/ma byang zhi ba'i grong khyer du/ 'jug 'dod skal bzang /7dus pa'i skye sa bu rnams // bca' skru/ mas 'dul ba'i khyu mchob 'di bsten/ cig/ ces yul khya/ da par can la ma chod cing shis pa brjod pa dang / dngos po nges bstan gī 'a༄ ma/ yangs par byas te skabs don ji ltar gleng ba ni// nge yang rang cag/ bros/ ma med/ ba nas da lta'i bar kham sa sa/sum/ 'khor ba 'dir yang dang yang du (ra khyams shing sdug bsgal gsum gyis mnar ba las/ da/ lam stes dbang gis dal 'byor lan gcig thob pa'i dus 'dir/ mi tshe rdo/cha/ med du mi skyel bar chos rnam das/ cig sgrub ma thub na sgo gsum gyi las mi dge ba'i dbang gis ngan song mu mtha' med pa'i g.yang sar ldung ba na cir yang byar med pa ni ji skad du/ dpal ldan zla bas/ sa/nga tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas pa/ /ga/la te 'dir bdag 'dzin par mi byed na/ /g.yang sar lhung pa'i tsa/zhan dbang 'jug 'gyur pa/ /de las phyis nas gang si/sa slong ba 'gyur/ / zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pas chos rnam dag cig cis kyang sgrub dgos/ sgrub bya'i chos rnam par dag pa yang spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ / bstan pa rnyed dang bkur bste dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig / ces gsungs pa ltar lus can rnams kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sel ba'i sman dang /— 621 ———

bde ba ma lus nga/ 'byung ba'i sgo dri/ rgyal ba'i bstan/ pa rin ngo/ che nyas/ tsa/cib/ yi/na la//bstan pa de ma/nga ra /kha/ sa mtshab/ dbyig ga/nyen gyis/ /ston pa'i dam tshas rnam gnyis te/ lung dang rtsos/sa nga/'i bdag nyid bo// /de 'dzin byed pa smra byed dang / / spru ba par byer/ pa kho na yim/ che/sa ga/su/ngas ltar/ stog/sa/ pa'i bstan pa lhag pa'i bslab pa rin po che rnam pa sa/sum sgrub bas nyams su len cing / de brjod byar byed pa'i lung si/sa/ bstan pa sde sbod gsum 'a—chad nyan gyi sgo/ ma/sa bstam/ pa 'dzin nga/ yi/na 'a / de yang thos si ri/ tshoms 'a sa// /sa/la te thos nga/ mang gyur kyang 1 / tshu4ra khrim /sa les/sa nga mi/ sdom na/ / de ni tshul khri/ mas phyir smad cing // / de yi thos nga/ phun tshog/sa min/ / zhes da/nga / (snang sa/sa ma /tshab klu sgrub kyis/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu'i sa bzhin du/ /yon tan kun gī gzhi rten 'a/ga/sa/ nga/ra gsungs/ // zhes tsa/sungs nga/ ltar yon tan thams cad kyi sa/thi rten tshul lce/ mas rnam par dag pa 'ig med na/ bstan pa'i nyams len gzhan la 'bad kyang rtsa ba med pa'i yal ga 'tshol ba da/nga 'dra bas/ thob/ mar tshul khri/ mas sa/la che thing de'i nang nas kyang / rab tu byung ba'i so sor thar pa'i sdom ba ni bstan/ nga 'i rtsa bar gyur nga/sa khyad par du 'phags pa yin/ de'i phyir grub chen/ skal ldan rgya mtshos/ spyir bstan dang 'gro la phan/ nga 'i thabs/ /zhing dag pa'i dge 'dun sde la rag /don de phyir dge 'dun spyi khrims la/ / thabs mkhas pa'i sgo nas phan btags na/ /chos 'dul ba'i phyab/ sbol yun ring gnas/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dge 'dun gyi sde gsar bskrun dang rang gi slob ma rnams sdom pa gsum gī bcad mtshams ga/tsang ma'i sgo nas/ bka' gdams gong ma'i rnam thar zin pa zhig byung na sprub 'bras thams bcad/ kyi nang nas rab ngang du/'a/ du byung bar dgongs te 'jam mgon 63 2

rgyal ba gnyis nga 'i/ rgyul tshab ngas/'a 3/na khri thog bdun bcu pa rgya'/ ba'i dbang ngo spu greng bcu nga/ chen ngo 'i yo ngas/ 'dzin nga rji tā rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang chom 'phe/ra dang/la bzang po ma/sa thug/sa bskyed rmad po ches bstan 'gro'i bde thabs lo/ na'i ched// rab byung bcu bzhi pa'i ti sgrol byed ches pa shing pho spre'u'i lor sngom byon skyes chen rjams kyis byin gyis brlabs 'ing lung bstan nga/'i ga/nas stod da phung bang gi phu stag lung brag gi/ sa'i char yongs kyi dbe ba'i bshe/sa bsnyen rnam/sa/ spru ba la sa/zhol ba'i dben/ ljongs su/ bla brang bste gams dang / mang thos ba'i/ma gleng gi sgrub/ sde 'di nyid phyag/ 'debs par ma dzad cing / re nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i 'ing pho sprel gyi lor dge slong zhal grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga spar thob/ spong ba pa rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa spyi dang bye brag rnams phra jeng zhib pa/ go/nga sa lha mi'i rjam 'dren sku phreng bcu bzhi/ pa chen ngo nas tshis/ don smad du byung ba bstsal ba de ltar yang // mi zad ces nga/ me pho thu/ lo'i sgon zla'i nang bo/nga sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po ma chog nas/ jo 'brom yab sras kyi rnam thar gsal bar mdzad/ de ho thog thu'i cho lo bka' shog sogs gser gyi bka' lung bzang ngo/sa ga/zengs bstod bla med thogadagre 'dum/ yang zhal grangs bdun hru don lnga spar cha mdzad rgyu'i bal//'a slob spyi phebs dang rjes su 'brel bar bod ljongs spyi tshogs nas kang ba de don mthun grub blos blangs kyi mtha' tshig rim stsal don ba'i na/ gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren/ chem/ po'i zhabs brtan dang / bstam/ srid bde thabs kyi 'bas rim sgrub dbo/sa bcas la brten sngags grar bsgyur dgos/ stabs/ 'dul ba'i phyag len zhib phra gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren chen po mchog nas stsal don ltar gzhir bzung thog sngags chog gsar bsnan gī phyag len bab bstun bca' —— 623 —

khrims da/bye bsdu dgos rigs da nga bcas gam bcar phan ba nge/ bas ma ga/tam gling gi// dgre 'a—dum rnams kyi sbangs / blang kyi rim pa hrung zad spro ba 'a/// de ba /ba thog mar 'di/ra bzhu/sa/sa nga 'i ga/sar zhugs sdo ma pa zhu dgos ris ba4 kung da chog nyes meng/ phum/ tshos/sa kyi sgo nas dge/ tshu(rwa/ slong du sgrub pa la /'ga' rkyem bzhi dang bral 'ing / ma thun rkyen lnga tshang ba zhes gsungs pa ba'i na dgos bar 'ab/la rkyen yod med/ nga/nga / bong/ 'dir mu stes/ca/ cam dngos mi/ yong kyang ma/nga sa/sem grub mtha'i khya/ da nga/ra ma/nga bas lta grub mi gceg pa'i rigs kya/nga hro na gyi grub ma//tha' blos btang ma/sa zhus/sa nga yin na la/sa/ de mim/ sa//'an phyogs pa'i ribs kyang mi 'jug sngom/ bcom ldan 'das nal bzhugs dus skye/ bo rma/mas rang bzhin drang bas/ bar chad dris ma/ /lam drang ngo 'debs pa yim/ 'a dub kyang / deng ru nga sto ba///sa ma 'i rang ma dngas kyi sa//yo sgyus ma bo/ bsko ra ba zu nga bas thag nye ring sa/ nas yim// kyang 'dra bar/ rab tu byung min gang ltar kyang sde 'dir zhus sa nga/ ṭa / 'as/1la rkyem/ rā /da ped legs par brtas/sa 'ing // phyi nang si/ /lag sbeg/ tshad thub dang pa ca sa nga/sa nges pa 'drongs nges pa las khyi dang glo ba 'phrad nga/ ltar mi bya / 'dul ba rang nas so bdun lon pa bya nog bskrod nus dang de men bco lnga lon dbo/sa par ba/sung kyang skabs 'dir bdun tsam lon/ pa ha cang chung skyon gī/sa dgon nang du ngu ba sog/sa grong gseb tu slebs ba ltar mi mdzes pas bgrang bya bcu gcig tsam la dma' mthar bzung nas lus bong rgyug tshad ba 'ag pa ltar long nas 'jug de/ nas 'jug pa'i gong nas ra)ba byung gi yo byad rtags cha 'u/gas rnams tshang ba da/gos pas gding ba tshad ldan/ gra lham ras zon nam/ so/ lham sa/nga rigs smad ga yog sa/ma thab gzan rnams rgyu rung ba yul dus dang mthun pa skor 'as/ga — 624 ———

rgyan drus// dang / 'jam sang phrug byibs bstum sos/sa gang rigs zla gam rked/ nga/ 'thud cing rdo ra sogs yod pa/ de dag thams cad tshos rung ba las rgya tshos so sa/sa mi rung bas kha bsgyur ba min pa/ lhung bzed rtse ma shubs sgrigs dang bcas pa/ zhwa ser sgro yod lag pa gos dang ras dmar gang rigs dang bcas pa las ser po dmar po khra pe ba ma yin pa/ ske rag ser po sne dzar nas phram/ bu breg pa/ lham sgrog da/mar ser gang rigs/tshogs phor che chung 'tshams pa dbyebs tshe gling kre kha mar grags pa dang /rtsam khug che tshad phye bre gang shong pa chung tshad bre phyed shong ba'i bar de yang bo/sa chen dang ras ka/ bo'i rigs ma yin pa/ 'ja' gnyis dang ldan nga / zhag phor par gzugs ma che tshad tshogs phor do shong ba nas chung tshad phor gang ba'i bar gang rigs chos gos ngur ser gang shong rigs tshad ldan/ chab ril kha gcod lung bcas chab shubs snam dmar ram/ 'go snam dmar po gang rigs gzab 'phyor la gos chen yang chog chab mthur shing dang sgyug ma'i sprug dkrogs lcags sogs la dkrol tshag med pa 'jam sang khra sbom mtheb chen las ma sbom pa'am/ yang na lcags dang / rag gi mthur ma de mtshungs/ sngags grwar song bas phreng ba rab bo rdi tsi dang rag sha/ byang chub ljon shing / be ta sogs gang rung la bcu shad gsum mam gnyis dang /gzhan grangs 'dzin gang rung gcig bcas je bas gsum gang rigs/ rgyan la gzab 'phyor rigs la 'dzoms rgyan dang thod 'jog the bas byu ru spos shel ma ṇa ho dmar po gang dung bzhi las mi mang ba/ de min 'phreng ba'i rgyur shel dkar dmar sogs rdo rig/sa rwa co sogs mi mdzes pa'i rigs dang /rgyan la du dang / mu men sogs spel ba'i grong pa'i 'phreng ba lta bu ma yin pa/— 625 —

shog/ ka li yang deng sang gra sa yas mas su bsnams bzhin pa lta bu dang /gzhan yang chu tshags sogs kyis mtshon mdor na mkho ba'i yo byad dang lhag pa'i yo byad sogs rab tu byung ba la mkho zhing rung ba byen rlabs chags nges nga rnams tshas/sa su tshud par byas nas rab byung dang / dbe tshul gyi sdom pa gang rigs rgyal ba yab sras sprul sku che khag gra sa yas mas kyi mkhan slob dang / 'di ga'i slob dpon sogs las thob nga/ra byas nas zhugs/ sngon nas rab byung dge tshul bsgrubs zin yin yang yo byad rnams gong bzhin byed/de nas gsar zhugs yin na dge/ rgan sde 'dir zhug/sa nas lo lnga yan chad song ba gang rung 'ig la brten nas/ dang por spug dang / de nas slob dpon dang dge skos ma/ja'/ kha grub nas slob dpon dang / dge/ skos nas kyang 'di ba/'i gsar phral dang / 'dom/ cha thos// ma/ra bzung rgyu rnams bslab bya dang 'ib pa dgre rgan ma/sa byed/ de nas dang por 'jo/na cha 'dzin rgyu la gsar du bzhugs mi yin tshe da/nga po skyobs 'gro sems bskyed/ spyan 'dren khrus gsol maṇ+ḍal/ skabs gsum pa/ das/'a ldan lha brgya ma/ sgrol ma sgrol ga/sol/ legs bris ma// gnas brtan phyag mchod phyogs dus ma rnams bzung nas rgyugs sprad/ thun drus ngag byin rlabs/ de nas 'jigs byed lha bzu gsum ma bdag bskyed/ bum pa dbang chog sbyin sreg sogs 'di ga'i 'don chog par ma nas ngag 'don dgos rigs thog rgyal ba yab sras kyi zhabs brtan 'di ga'i ring 'tsho'i smon/ tshig rnams rim pas 'dzin 'jug cing nyin re'i rgyugs dge rgan nas len cing zla re'i nang du slob dpon sogs las sne lhan rgyas nas rgyugs len/ sa/jis dgo/na ga'an nas yong na khag jeg gong bzhin dang bcas zhub/sa te dge rbam/ zhig la brten nas sngon du —— — 626
