'don cha gong smos nas/ sa/nga bzung smyong ba rnams rgyugs len cing 'di kha rang si/ thun mong min pa bcos dbo/sa rnams 'chos/ de nas g.yar 'dzin dgo/sa nga/ rnam/sa 'dzin du bcug de yang gsar zhugs rnams na sa gsar phral phyas/ bde rgyus/sa pa dang gzhan yang grwa tshang gi las byed 'phar ma dgos rigs rnams sa/zhon pa rnams nas 'khur blangs thos/ rgan pa rnams nas ngag / bkod dang / nogs ram/ dbos rigs kyang byed/ blo ris/ gsal zhing ska/da rme/da nga rnams dang po 'don cha gco bor 'don zhing /// ska/da gzhi yod cing shes rab chung ba rnams nas dang ngo/ 'don cha bzung rim ltar bar bar du dbyangs kyang slob/ phyag rgya dung chen/ rgya gling rkang bling sil spubs 'khrol 'u/gas// gtor bzo/ dkyil 'khor gyi bres thig rdul tshon// rab ga/nas sbyin sreg gi phyas len sogs zhib mor bslab nas rang 'bo/ thon nges sha ste sa yong ba'i spyong mthar byed/ de dag kyang phyogs 'go shes pa tsam kyis mgu sla bar ma song ba dper na dbyangs lta bur mtshon na tshas/ spyod dang bska nga gso sogs kyi so sor skad sa/dngas rgyag lus/sa/ gre gugs dang / gre log lta bu bra mo re la yang rang rang gi lugs srol khu/ nga gang nas yin pa de ka lon nges byed 1de ba'i na du nol cha 'bud dgrol gyi mtshon pa thams cad phul du phyin pa slob shes ga bor 'don byed/ de nas gong smos rnams tshags su tshud nas kyang khengs dregs kyis yo/na tan/ slob sbyong 'phro bcad nas mi sdod par/ da dung 'du'/ ba'i bslab bya'i rigs dang / lam rim blo sbyong / sbags rim chen mo/ bde/ gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bskyed rdzogs sogs la blta rtos/sa dang blo 'dzin/ dge shes/ rigs la dogs gcod kyi dri mol sogs byas/ nas rang si/ nyams su len shes shing sa/'an la yang 'khri/ da thub pa zhis/ byed/ sde 'dir 6 27

zhugs pa rnams kyi yo byad sa/nga du spyos pa'i rung ba de dag las ga'am/ pa'i zhwa mo 'ba' zhwa zhwa rtsos/ sogs zhwa rigs/ mi gcis/ pa dang / gzan rgya tshos sos/sa tshos mi rung ba dang / dar bzan/ a thi/ lan na sogs rgyu mi rung ba ༅/ma thab 'ba' sham// lham sos/ lham dang / chu lham sa/tsang zon sobs gyon mi chog gzhan ya/nga 'as/ gcig gi sar /'gro ba la yang gos phu thung ma dang tsag pa/ zhwa rngo/ dbyar /zhwa dang / lpags rigs kyi zhwa sogs gyon mi chogathag ring por 'gro ba la gos gnang zhu/ thon pa rnams/ kyang ha cang hrul ba sprung chas lda bu dang // ha cang gzab pa sde dngo/ma gyi sras lta su ma yen pa bzang ngan/ mtha' ga/nyes su ma ldung ba gang gyon na dge 'dun la 'phya smod/ kyi gnas su ma song nges 8/ zhig dgo/sa/ ga'am yang gri ring dang me lcags khu/ ga ma sog4 glo cha'i rig//sa kyang bcang mi chog sde 'dir spras/sa kyi cho ga/ mang ngo gtong dbo/sa sta ba/sa zhugs nas ma 'gyangs nga/ra 'jigs byed/ sog/sa bla med kyi dbang ga/nga rung 'i//sa/ lo khongs su ci thob byed/ de nas tshogs kyi dbang du byas na shogs tshogs dus gtor sog/sa kyi skabs su/ 'don nga/ khyon che chung la dpags pa'i chogs snga phyi phran bu dang / dus rgyun bya skad dang po btang 'phral bzhengs brda btang ba da/nga dus bstun tshang mas khru/ sa dang / lus tshag/sa byas nas rang rang gi nyams chen dge spyor phran bu yo/da pa rnams zin par bya// ma/ma langs ba dang 'khar rnga dal bre(ma ran par brdungs nas rgan rim nas sngon du phebs te gral du mu tig bstar la brgyus pa ltar yo 'a/byog med pa rim pas bzhugs na/sa 'khar rnga 'phro bcad pa dang dbu mdzad nas 'don nga bskul ba dus mnyam du yong ba byed// 'al 'don la dang ngo/ra skyabs sems/ de nas ngas/ byin rlabs/ da/ga 'a ldan lha brgya ma dang /——— 628 ——

dmigs brtse ma brgya tshar dang / brel skabs/ nyer ba//cis/ de nas 'jigs byed brgyud 'debs nas bzung dal brel 'tsham/sa par rdor sem/sa sgom/ bzlas tshogs zhing srung 'khor sos/sa dkyus bzhin dang / gra tshang 'di nyid srugs grar song 'i/nga sbyin sreg rab gnas/ sbyang ba gtor rgyag sogs dgos pa dang / dus rgyun kyang bskang gso gtong dgos stabs las bzhi sgrub pa da/nga /chos skyong 'bul bar brnyen nga/ gang che stabs rgyun/ bsnyen kyang zhogs ltar rtsa sngas/sa snying ngo nye snying gsum longs skabs dang ba spun grangs ma nyung ba byed/tshog/sa thun rjes ma rnams la dus gtor min skabs bskang sa/so cho sa chos spyod so/sas gang yin rnams dal brel 'tshams par btang / tshos/sa kyi skabs su/ gral la sdod dus/ rtsis/ pa dang / ka ba sogs la glo stes dang // rgyab snyes/kha gtums pa/ lag rtsed rtse ba/ ska da/ cha byed pa// yar blta mar blta ba 'ad sa/da sogs byas mi chog/ sbrid nga gla'1 ba/ mchil snabs 'do/ra ba sos/sa kyang gos kyis g.yos/sa nas byed/ dbyar ha cang tshad pa tsha bar bsnyad pas zla gam 'bud pa/ dgun grang bar bsnyad pas spyi bo man chad gtums pa sogs kyang mi byed/ gral kyang bslab pa rgan rim ba/thin na/sa byed cing 'om/ kyang gdong gral du 'don cha nges pa dang / skad bzang ba rnams 'khod// de mtshungs/ ga/zhan rnams bslab gral gtsor 'don/'don pa'i ska/bas kyang thams cad kyis bod skad ldir ba ga bor 'don skad che chung gang yin kyang skad gdangs bsgrigs pa las ra skad lug ska/da rgyag mi choga'adon pa dang dal brel gang byed kyang da/bu mdzad dang bstun cing dbu mdzad nas nyi tshod dang bstun pa'i bab bltas las/ rlung gsang mtho dman gyis res 'ga' nyin mtshan ngo mi shes nga/ lta bu'i dal ba da/nga res 'ga' blo tshab lta — 629 ————

sre'i brel ba mi byed// ja thus/ gi phyab/ bde da'u ma/dzad nas brnga/ka' btang ba dang / ma/nga nyung gral dang bstun pas ga/sur/ ba'i gang rigs bslangs te dge skos nas mis/ brte/ byed/// dge sko/sa/ ldod mim skabs dbu mdzad nas byed/ ja thug/ sob/sa da bza/sa/ ska bas kung tsug tsus/ cag cag hu hu du phu dang /lce phyir byung nas za ba rnam ba /rnge/ jes sogs dkar dang phor nga/ lces lda sa/ pa sogs mi mdzes pa'i ris/sa dri/ byed cing lhas/ tu spyin bad/sa/ so/gas kyis ga/nga/na drangs/ pa yin tshe ja thug jib mdos/ bo lhan/ sgra sos/sa dang mi 'im par mi mgu ba'i sna gnyer lko/ba/ shubs sos/sa bhū/ma/ bdas/ dad pa lo tsa/ rigs mi byed /phyas/ bde bas kyang ja zhu skabs gra4ma stod smad thams cad du 'ag cha sloms rngo nga ba las gral/ stod du 'ag kha gtsang dang // grang/ smad du ja rkyang rngo/nga ba lda bu mi byed// thug pa yang gra/ra stod mi/da du dang yi snyigs slom/sa pa yo nga ba byeng /ja thug rnam sa gra/la bar du/ bo ba dang da cang sa/nga ches ba dang ma khe/ ngas / pa ma yi na pa byed/ gra/ nga/ rnams nas/ ja thug/ bzed rke bas —mas/ pa sa//blus kyis bzed cing rnga no'/ dang phyas/ rgya sogs kyi skabs yi/na na sa /la ba 'ab// de/ min las/ pas btes/sa nas sdod// rnga rol sogs kyi zabs yin kyang ja mtshad bsnyul ba dang za rol sa la ba 'ab/ nas phor pa /lag tu bla/ngas nas bdebs / rtsam pa za skabs rtsam khug sogs zla gam nang du mngon chung gis blangs nas spras/ brdzos/ rtsam khug ma bon chung sar /3jog zhog tshogs /pa/ dbe tshul rgan pa ma/sa dge slong rnams la byem len sto/ba cing / dgung tshis/sa su/ tshang mar thus// nga 'i bo/nga du spras/ khu zhus nas tshang ra/'i hūṃ nga bzed du bzed de/ spab brdzos nas cha sa/sum/ bgos nga/'i cha gcig gi/sa phud mtshad chang bu bcas bzhengs/ dgung tshig/sa la brel skabs yin na ma gtog/sa dkon/ mtshas/ rjes — 6 )()

dran rgyas par 'don/ thug pa bzhes grub nas lhag ma'i chang bu 'phangs/yon bsngo dang sher snying tshar nas gral bar gyi thug pa bo ba rnams phyags ma rgyab cing rtsam khug kyang rgyab tu bzhag byin len bsheg de phyin gyi ja la rung chu 'debs rgyu ma brjed par byed/ lung rnam 'byed las/ / lcags gong me lce 'bar ba dag/zos par 'gyur ba mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdoms pas/ / yul 'khor bsod stoms za ba min/ zhes tshul 'chal dang / khyim pas dge 'dun gyi zas la spyad na nyes pa che bar gsungs pas/ de rigs la ma byen pa legs kyang dge 'dun gyi las byed sogs la ja thug ster dgos mang stabs nyin re bzhin gyi zhog jar nyin gang gi ja thug gnang ba zhu/ spyi so nas sbyin bdag gal cher bab mtshungs sne len byas te dge 'dun la dad log 'gro ba'i rigs ma byed/ zla rer dus gtor che ba tshes gcig la bla ma mchod pa dang / chos spyod/ tshes gnyis la bskang ba yongs rdzogs/ tshes brgyad la tshe chog tshes 15la gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug tshes nyer lnga la 'jigs byed bdag 'jug tshes nyer dgu la mgon po phyag bzhi'i bskang ba dang / gzhi bdag rgyal btsan gyi bskangs ba/ spyi rtab bcas rgyas pa/ rgyun du bskang gso sbyin bdag gi 'don chos skabs dang bstun tshogs grol nye nas chab ril gyi chab btang nas 'don pa mtshams bzhag pa dang gral gsham mtha' nas rim gyis bzhengs/dgongs tshogs ma tshogs bar zla gam gral du bzhag bskang gso sogs kyi skabs rnga rnams gra pa gnyis gnyis kyi bar la rgyab tu rnga gdan bting bar rnga rnams nyis brtsegs kyis bzhag dbu mdzad kyi gong du sil snyan dkrol mi'i mdun du lcog rtse'i khar sil snyan/ dbu mdzad kyi mdun du lcog rtse'i steng —— 631 —

spug rnams shubs dang rten khebs kyis bkab nas 'jog rnga len skabs gcig gis gcig la 'drud pa dang bsdeg pa sogs ma yin par dal bus blangs nas pus mo g.yon thad du zla gam gyis lceb nas bzung ba'i rnga zur dang rang gi thod pa'i zur 'khel bar bzung / rnga brdung lugs la zla ba dpal rin gyi rnga'i man ngag las/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i klong mi dkrugs/ /ri rab gling gzhi'i mtha' mi skor/ /ri thang mtshams kyi brag mi gshag / ri dwags rgyal po'i gdong mi bsnun/ / steng nas gnam lcags 'bab pa ltar/ /mkhas pas rnga sgra ba'i bskul lo/ / mya ngan can gyi brang ltar dang / /phongs pas sgo yon slong ba ltar/ / mkhas pas rnga sgra mi bskul lo/ / bya phran gshog pa rdeb pa ltar/ /mkhas pas rnga sgra mi bskul lo/ zhes pa ltar gyi skyon rnams spang zhing thog mar rnga sgra dal bus bskul/ de rjes je drag je drag dang / /bskul ba'i gnas kyang 'di lta ste/ /rnga yu'i thad nas yar bcal ba'i/ mkhyid gang sar ni dbyu gus bsnun/ / de yang lag pa'i sor tshigs la/ / 'phrul btsal rnga g.yog rang lcid kyis/ /rnga sgra bskul gyi rtsol bas min/ rnga g.yog rnga la reg ma thag / 'phral nas tha dad nyid du bya/ / skad cig gcig tsam mi spyor bar/ /so sor byed pa mkhas pa'i lugs/ zhes dang / /zhi ba'i rnga brdungs byed pa na/ / de yi nyams dang ldan par bya/ / rnga thabs dal la lhod par brdungs/ / rgyas pa'i rnga brdungs byed ba na/ / sgeg cing dpa' ba'i nyams kyis bya/ zhes sogs zhib par bstan bcos der blta zhing / sbug dkrol lugs kyang de nyid las/ /cha lang dkrol thabs 'di lta ste/ /thag lung bzang mnyen mi 'tshor bar/ /srin 'dzub mdzub mo la skor te/ /mdzub mo lar nas phyi la dkris/ /lag pa'i mthil du 'phrul chag tshad/ /cha lang sbub kyi rlung mi — 632 —

dgag / spug 'chal mtheb sor phyed pad bzung / /phan tshun phyed lhag non tsam du/ / rang lced hrung zad drag par bskul/ /zhes pa ltar dang / sil snyan kyang ji skad du/ se chal mtheb sor bsgrim pas bzung / / dpung pa lag ngar mtshams nas glod/ /lag pa'i mthil nas 'phrul rtsal nas/ /rang lcid kho nas sgra bskul gyis/ /'dab ma'i rtse mo'i rtsal gyis min/ /brdeb dus gren 'thur gseg lam dang / /phan tshun 'pho sdod phyed mar bsil/ /dkrol dus min pa chol sgra spang / /bar snang mi g.yug gdong mi 'gag / brang dang pus mo la mi brdab/ /'khyags dus bsras la dal bus dkrol/ / 'ber bslang sgra cher 'thab cing gseng / /'brel gnas mgrin pa'i thad tsam ste/ /che 'bring chung skad skabs dang sbyar/ / 'jam 'phar 'ur ding snyan rtsub dang / /phra sbom dang 'khrol la sogs pa'i/ / sgra thabs rnam dbye rtogs par bya/ /ces pa ltar sbyang zhing / de bzhin du rag dung kyang dbugs shed che zhing rgya dang ldir dang 'dor sogs la rnam dbye nyams 'gyur thon cing thang lhod med pa/ rgya gling yang rnam grangs gang bslab thabs cad mthar phyin cing skad thang lho dang sked cad sogs med pa/ de yang so so'i skabs thob rnams la byang chub dang / rkang gleng yang skad gsang ba brjid che ba dgos shing / rnga dung rgya gling dung chen sil sbug sogs thams cad la skyon gtan nas mi shor ba'i ca ga gang dag ga/yog gang bzo byed pa las phar drud tshur drud kyis gas chag tshon rtsi sogs bsnad pa'i rigs byas mi chog ḍa dril dgos rigs kyang thams cad gra 'grigs shing rnga phyi dang / yar len/mar bzhag sogs kyang dus mtshungs par byed cing / rdor dril sogs lha'i ngo bor bskyed pas rten gsum dang khyad med pas gus par byas nas mdun du 6pa /3

dril gdan gyi steng du bzhag nas yar langs mar 'dug skabs sogs su yang 'goms yug dang / g.yas bsgyel g.yon bsgrel du ma song bar byed dgos tshogs grol skabs su yang rgan pa rnams dpe cha la blta rtogs dang / tshogs pa rnams nas dpe 'dzin bshar sbyang sogs byed pa las phyi log rwa sgor du don nas rkang brkyang glo nyal sogs kyis gnyis gsum tshogs nas long gtam ngag kyal sogs mi byed/ slob dpon dang / dge skos la zhwa phab gzan phab dang dbu mdzad la yang ldang ba zhe sa/ de bzhin rgan rim la gzhon pa nas bkur ste zhe sa gang che/ rgan pa rnams nas kyang gzhon pa rnams la bslab bya dang / las bskul byed skabs kyang tshig 'jam zhing bskul mkhas las tshig rtsub sogs mi byed/ tshogs su lham mi gyon/ lham gyon pas gding ba'i steng du gral sked pa bcad nas mi 'gro/ 'du khang gi ka ba 'al ba sogs la mchil snabs mi 'dor/ ra skor phyi nang du gzan med par mi 'gro 'phyongs rgyugs dang / rgyang 'bod ku co bzhad gad sogs kyang mi chog gtsug lag khang gi nye skor dang / chu 'go ldum ra ne'u sing lam srang sogs su zag pa mi 'dor/ zla re nang du gnang chen nyin lnga dus gtor sogs ma 'khel ba byed/tshogs bar sogs su nye skor lcang gling sogs gung sang byed skabs kyang rang gi dpe cha blta rtog 'dzin bshar sbyangs/ dung / rgya gling / rkang gling sogs spyong dgos dang/ dbyangs spyong 'dra byed pa las/ gnyis gsum re tshogs nas mtho bshad dma' bshad sogs mi byed/ lhag tu dpyid kha nyi ma ring skabs su dbyangs spyong dung rgya gling sogs la nan tan du slob gnang chen skabs grong gseb phan tshun du 'gro bar yang gnyis gsum re sdebs nas 'gro ba las/ khrims grogs med par gcig phur mi 'gro de bzhin du grong chog la —— 634 — —

yang 'dra zhing // tshogs thun re re'i dgongs nga dge skos la zhu/ tshogs thun gnyis nas nyin gcig tshun dge skos dang slob dpon sa/nyis kar zhu/nyin 'ag ga/sum phan chad bla brang du zhu dgos/ dus rgyun shag tu yang dgos nges ka med kyi bo/sa log la/ lhan pa sogs phran bu las bzo 'tshems ko ba mnyed pa// thags skud sog pa/ shing bzo rdo bzo sos/sa byed mi chogadabe/ 'dun gyi sde yin phyin 'du'/ ba'i phyag len rnam dag med thabs med cing /de'i yang snying po lta bu ga'i/ gsum gyi phyas/ len yin/ pas nya stong gnyis kyi gso spyong chag med dang / de la yang nad pa tshabs chen dang / dge 'dun gyi spyi don rtsa chen yod na las thams cad tshogs dgos shing / nad pa tshabs chen lta bu yin yang 'dun/ pa nges par 'bul thub pa byed/ gso spyong gi phyag len gra pa nang ltar dang / lhag tu 'di sngags grar song bas sngags byang sems kyi phyir bcos kyang gtong thub pa byung na cis kyang gtong dgos/ dbyar gnas kyang chag med dang / de yang tshang mas khas blangs dgos shing mtshams kyi mtshams gzhu 'dom lnga brgyar rgyang grags su brtsis pa'i rgyang grags las brgal ba mi byed pa sogs kyang bshad pa dang mthun pa byed dgos dbyar dang dgag dbye'i phyag len rnams gra pa dang / rgyud stod smad kyi phyag len rnam dag ltar gang nus dang / gnas la sred pa spong phyir ljongs rgyur kyang jo shāka mjal ba sogs gra pa'i phyag len ltar byed/ chab zhugs nyin gsum lnga sogs gang rung gtong rgyur/ de skabs kyang chab gnang ba dang bla ma gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar klog pa/ sa lam rnam bzhag lta bu'i nges 'byung gi bskul mar 'gyur ba'i rtsed mo dang / mgur ma 'jen pa la sogs pa chos dang 'brel ba'i rtsed mo'i rigs las/ chab bzhugs ring sdom pa gzhan la — 636 —

bcol bzhag byas pa lta bu'i mda' rdo glu gzhas bro ga/ra sogs khyim pa sun 'byin du 'gro ba'i rnam g.yeng rtsed mo sogs kyis gu yang dpa' thal mi byed/rtsa ba'i chang dang lnga la mthong thos byung na zhu ngo sgron brgyud med par gaṇ+ḍa shog gis gnas dbyung / 'thab 'dzing tshabs che dang gri bton pa sogs kyis gzhan la rma bzos khrag thon/ ris/sa byung na yang gong mtshungs/ las sne la las/ lan slog rigs la yang rgyugs rdungs gang mtshams dang gnas dbyung /sgrigs lam chang chung 'gal rigs la dkar me snyan shal mang ja/ phyag stong phrag nas brgya'i bar tshogs gtam nyes nga/ che chung dang bstun pa'i 'gel bkod byed/ tshob/sa 'tshogs nas 'a/la 'don ma bskul bar du 'byor na gleng med dang / bskul nas kyang tshogs rjes lus par phyag 'tshal bcub/gos bgo lugs kyang sham thab ha cang che ba dang / ha cang chung ba dril bu'i shubs lta bu ma yin pa de yang ha cang rtsengs pas pho lhug dang / ha cang 'jol bas drud pa lta bu ma yim/ pa/ gzan gyon lugs kyang gzan sgyur tshul ldan las bal po gzan sgyur sogs mi byed/ de dag/ byas pa byung na yang tshogs su phyag sogs kyi nyes pa gcod/ skra sor phyed do las ring ba mi 'jog dge tshul slong thams cad nas phyi dro'i kha zas bsrung zhing chab len pa dang ra sgor phyi nang shag sogs gang du yang tha mi kha dang sgog pa sogs dri ngan pa'i rigs la spyad mi chog spyod pa byung na tha khug gang za 'phrog ngos phyag dang tshogs gtam gtong / dus gtor khag gi mchod gtor bzheng rgyu sogs mchod dpon gyis do dam dang gtsang sbra gang che dgos pa'i bkod pa gtong /rab gnas sbyin sreg gtor chen sogs dang dkyil 'khor bres thig la dgos pa'i rdzas cha'i rigs rnams dus rgyun mchod dpon gyis 'khur blang gis la 636 ——

'tshol dgom 'tshol/ nyo dgos rigs nyo ba sogs dgos dus lag ma thogs pa byed/ mchod g.yog pa na/sa kyang gtor ba'e/ngas par kha ras dang /snod dpyad 'khru ba sogs gad dar lag pa 'khru zhing sen mo'i bar du yang dri ma/ ma lus par byed nga/ sogs gtsang sbra gang che/ mchod pa bsgrigs skabs su ting kong tshun chad phyis dar dang bsgregs dus kyang ya yo med pa chu dang 'bru sogs 'bo zhing lud pa dang kha ma khengs pa sogs ma yin nga// dus gtor lta bur spyan 'dren bskangs bskul sogs kyi skabs su chos skyong so so'i spos spyor tshad ldan 'du byas te bsregs pa dang / g.yab dar dgos rigs sogs dus skabs su chad lus med pa byed cing / mchod gtor gyi rtsam pa mar sogs kyis mtshon pa rnams kyang gnyer tshang nas byung ba yin na smos med/de min gyi sbyin bdag dam gtsang yin tshe bsre chog cing gzhan ma sde 'di'i ltos bcas dang 'khon sel yod pa'i rigs kyi jos sogs gtan nas ma bsres par byed/ gnyer pas kyang dus rgyun dge 'dun gyi gtong sgam la bsam pas g.yo zol med par dang ldan gyi gtong ba las/ yod bzhin/ du sbas bskums dang dgos sar chad cing ma dgos par lhag pa sogs dang / ja mar sogs kyang spus legs pa yod bzhin du rang gi nom pa phug bcug gis sdug pa nasaX gtong ba sogs mi byed/ de mtshungs ja ma nas kyang gnyer tshang nas gang gtad pa rnams dge 'dun gyi zha/la du 'gro nges las za bde kyi khri ba sogs kyis gtong sgo nor ma nyan du 'gro ba mi byed/ de mtshungs rdza sgod dang khro/ zo lag gis mtshon pas rtsis 'khri rnams la ca ga gang dag gi chud zos gtan nas med pa byed/ ja thug sogs la za bde dang bsam pa log pa byed min dge skos dang spyi gnyer nas yang yang blta zhib thog slob dpon nas — 6rte7 —

kyang bar du rtog/ zhib bcug gal srid bsam pa mi dag ba'i rigs byed pa 'dug tshe dge gnyer bgros nas sbog tu zhu dgos rigs zhus nas nyes chad sogs bab bltas kyis gtong / de mtshungs mtshod khang yas mas kyi dkon gnyer rnams nas kyang rten gsum mchod rdzas rnams la ca ga gang dag dang /yon chab/ spos mar me sogs bla brang nas gang byung rnams bsam pa dag nga ra byed cing rgyun du snga dro bar yon chab 'bul zhing / phyi dro yon chab bsdu ba dang ma ra me rnams kyang lha khang dang mchod rdzas sogs la me skyon mi yo/nga ba'i jib 'jus/ byed/ mchod khri dang sku thang sku brnyan sogs la rdul sprug gad bdar yang yang / rten khebs sogs la snum dang spos me sogs ma theb par byed dgos/ chab hril nas dus rgyun tshogs gdan sa rnams bsdu 'grems dgos par rdul sprug sogs yang yang / dbyar kha sa rlan che skabs tshogs bar du nyi ma sogs la skam dgos min sogs bltas nas ca ga de mtshungs sil spug dung rgya gling rnga sogs rol cha rnams bsdu 'grems skabs sogs su yang rogs byed rnams la ca ga dgos pa'i bkod pa dang / rang nyid nas kyang ca ga tshags tshud gang dag byed cing / bar bar du dge skos nas kyang 'thus sgo tshang min rtog zhib 'jug dge skos dang chab hril lo 'khor re dang / slob dpon dang / dbu mdzad/ gnyer pa bcas dge 'dun gyi zhabs 'degs 'gyur ba byung phyin nam lcogs bar las lo dus mi dgos/ lo re'i nang dge skos langs mtshams 'bras spungs dang dus mtshungs kyi dge skos langs 'phral bca' yig klog cing de'i 'bru don gyi tshul du tshogs gtam rgyas pa dang / gzhan dus bzhir sgrig lam skor gtam rgyas pa dang /dus rgyun skabs thob dmigs bsal dgos rigs las lag tu len rgyu med — 638 —

pa'i rna ba sun sun kyang mi byed/ sgris/ 'gal che phra gang byung ba nga bo 'dzin du ma song ba'i rjes gnon byed pa las/ rang nyed mi ga'i legs pa'i gtam snyan 'dod pa phug bcug gis mchod khrims yan por mi gtong / slob dpon nas kyang bar bar du tshogs gtam dang / dgre slo/sa kyis sgris/ 'doms drang po byung min sogs la zhib 'jug byed/ slob dpon rang yang dus rgyun/ tshogs su 'gro rtag pa dang / rdor slob byed dbo/sa thams cad la da/'a 'tsher dang gal chung mi byed/ grwa pa ba/zhon nga 'i rigs nas phyag len gyi skor dang / dpe cha'i skor la dogs sa/cod dri ba'i rigs byung yang rang bi/sa gang shes lhag/ bsam gyis slob pa las dpe 'khyud dang / brdzu bag bi/sa mgo skor mi byed/ dge skos langs rgyu grwa pa nyung bas lan gnyis tsam langs dgos byung yang langs/ skal 'phar skor la bzhugs khrir skal ba lnga dang //slob dpon la skal ba gnyis/ dbu chos gnyis/ spyi gnyer/ dung rgya spyi bcas la skal ba re/ mchod dpon dang / chab ril/ ja ma la skal phyed re/ mtshams pa dang nad pa/ grwa tshang spyi don phyin rigs la ngo skal de min rang don 'khor zhag dang / bzod bder dgongs zhus rigs la phogs skal dang / sbyin bdag gi 'gyed skal sprod mi dgos/ 'don chos kyi kha btags sogs gang byung dbu mdzad kyi byed cing / spyi thog skyabs zhus su kha btags dngos po lus chad sogs gang byung yang las sne rnams nas sdeb bsags kyis grwa tshang gi dgos byed btang 'phros phon mi chung ba te byung bstun tshong sgyur gyis grwa pa rnams la bgo 'grems byed cing / yang grwa pa 'di kha'i sgrig 'grim rigs gzugs po mi thang ba'i nad yun ring po byas nas 'tsho ba bkres nges rigs 'dug na slob dpon dbu chos bcas nas bgros bsdur — 639 ——

thog sman rin dang 'tsho thebs sogs spyi rdzas nas sprod// 'dir zhug/sa/ nas dang po phyag bde nas bzung gzhon gral thams cad 'jen grub cing / khyad par du dung rgya gling dbyangs rol dkyil 'khor bris thig 'don cha sogs thams cad rdzog/sa shing dbu chos sogs las sne tshang ma'i 'khur 'dzin grub ba 'i grwa rgan byas can rigs yin tshe lo tshad kyi tshogs 'grims rtag par mi nus rigs la yang dmigs bsal dgongs pa ster zhing 'on kyang dus mchod che ba'i rigs la tshogs la yo/ngas gang thub byed yang 'don pa 'dzin skyor dang dung rgya gling bris thig gis mtshon pa'i yon tan rnams (pha dang 'dod che zhing slob pa sogs gsar bu ba gzhan gyi mig lhos la phan pa byed rigs byung na sbug tu zhus nas gsol ras bab mtshungs dang spyi rdzas steng nas kyang phran bu ster 'os byung na las sne bgros thog ster chog pa byed/ lo re'i dus mchod kyi dbang du byas na zla tshes la dgon gnas 'di nyid phyag 'debs mdzad po khri thog bdun cu pa khri/ chen yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi tā ngag dbang chos 'phel gyi sku mchod zhal 'don gsang ba 'dus pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub mchod zla tshes la rje gong ma blo bzang bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyi sbu mchod zhal 'don bla ma mchod pa dang chos spyod/ zla 1tshes la dge yongs 'dzin rin po che blo bzang don ldan gyi sku mchod zhal 'don bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi mchod chog zla 9tshes 1nas nyin bdun bar rgyal mchog bcu pa chen po'i sbu mchod la 'jigs byed bdag 'jug lo gsar tshes 1kyi snga char tshes gtor phyag len bzhin rgyas pa/ tshes 12nas 'di ga'i bstan srung khag gsum gyis gtsos sger gsol khag rgyags brngan lha bsangs dang / dgra lha dpangs bstod nyin gsum/ zla 2tshes 1༷nas tshe chog nyin lnga/ zla 2tshes — 640

15nas rnam rgyal cho ga nyin/ zla 4tshes 14nas bhan gsum la rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs/ zla 5tshes 5nas nyin bcu la bka' 'gyur gsung sgrogs/ zla 6tshes 15nas dbyar snga ma zla ba gsum zhal bzhes/ zla 7tshes 1༷nas gsang 'dus 'jig rten dbang phyug gi sgrub mchod sbyin sreg bcas nyin bdun/ zla ka tshes nas nyin lnga la ku ru ku ka'i sgrub mchod/ zla 9tshes 27nas nyin gsum la seng gdong ma'i gtor bzlog zla 1༷tshes ldanas nyim/ lnga la ye the/sa mgo/na po phyag bzhi pa'i mdos chos/ zla 11tshes 27nas/ nyin gsum la chos rgyal bskangs bshags dbyug mchod stong tshar dang 'brel glo bur las bco'// zla 12tshes nas nyin gsum la gdugs dkar gtor bzlog dang / nyin gnyis la las bzhi'i sbyin sreg de mtshungs gsar 'dzugs dgos rigs byung na'ang sngar yod ma nyams pa'i thog dbyangs rol sogs da lam kun/ gling dga' ldan brtan bzhugs chos 'khor gling gi phyag bzhes ltar dang / dmigs bsal bsgyur dgos rnams kyang rang lugs ma nyams pa dam pa'i phyag bzhes ltar yar rgyas dgos/ sgrol mdos khri blo bzang dar rgyas kyi gsung rgyun/ gdugs dkar gtor bzlog smad rgyud lugs/ seng gdong ma'i gtor bzlog 'jam bzhad dkon mchog 'jigs med dbang po'i gsung ge twa pā la'i gtor bzlog snga tshag bstan pa'i mgon pos mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang gsar 'dzugs dgos rigs byung tshe gang las byung ba'i cho ga phyag len khungs btsun rnam dag las gang byung 'dzugs bde mi chog 'di khar gang btsugs pa'i 'don chos kyi go rim cho ga'i dbyangs rol sogs sngar srol nyams lhad med pa sor gnas las/ mi re'i 'dod 'khyer gyi bsgyur bkod sogs mi byed cing zhal 'don sogs gang — 641 —

gam/nga rigs kyang thams cad kyi rang rang gi// shes rab la dpags pa'i dri gtugs kyi sgo nas 'dul khrims la gces spras kyis thog mar zhal 'don sogs skabs gang yin gyi dmigs rnam gsal gang thub dang de lta mim kyang cho ga'i tshig ris kyi dmigs pa dang / cho ga'i tshig ris 'di rnams kyang dam pa sngon ma rnams kyes gsung byin rlabs can sha stag yin pas 'di 'dra 'a /na rgyu yod bo bskal ba bzang snyam pa'i sgo nas sgra dag cing lhag chad nor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos/ pa dang / kun slong gong smos ltar spyir bstan pa spyi bye brag dar ba/ rgyal ba yab sras sogs dam pa gang na su bzhugs zhabs pad brtan/ cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa/ gnam bskos dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i chab srid mnga' thang 'phel zhing rgyas pa dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun khri/ mas gtsang gi sgo nas dar rgyas yun du gnas pa dang / 'jig rten khams su nad mug 'khrug rtsod 'i/ ba/ khyad par dgon sde 'di la dang po 'jug pa'i mthun rkyen sbyor ba nas mjug dge 'dun gyi sde rnam par dag pa 'di tshugs pa'i bar gyi mthun rkyen sgrub cing 'gal rkyen sel bar byed pa'i mi dang mi min thams cad kyi 'di phyi'i legs tshogs gong 'phel gyis ring min byang chub thob pa/ yang sgos rang rang gis rab tu byung ba'i don tshe 'khor ba thog med kyi sdig ltung byang zhing rnam dkar gang byas rdzogs byang gi rgyur 'gro ba sogs thugs 'dun rnam par dag pa'i sgo nas thugs dam bzlas brjod sogs mdzad na tshe rabs mang po'i sdig sgrib byang bar 'gyur ba ni dpung bzang gis zhus pa las/ so ga nags me mched pa'i me lce yis/ /ma bsgribs bzhin du tshang tshing kun bsregs ltar/ / bzlas brjod me la tshul khrims rung gis sbar/ /brtson 'grus chen po'i me lces sdig pa sregs/ /ji ltar gang la nyi ma'i 'od la 642 la

zer gyis/ /gdungs na gzi brjid ma bzod zhu ba bzhin/ /tshul khrims nyi ma'i 'od zer bzlas brjod kyis/ /gdungs na sdig pa'i gangs kyang zad par 'gyur/ /mun nag smag la mar me byung ba yis/ /mun nag ma lus sel bar byed pa bzhin/ /tshe rabs stong nas bsags pa'i sdig pa'i mun/ / bzlas brjod mar mes myur du sel bar byed/ /ces gsungs/ de ltar cho ga 'don pa'i tshe sems gzhan du ma g.yeng bar bton na phan yon de rnams thob cing /sems gzhan du g.yeng bas bton kyang phan yon ji bzhen mi 'byung ba ni spyod 'jug las/ bzlas brjod dang ni dka' thub kun/ /yun ring dus su spyad byas kyang / sems gzhan g.yengs bas byas pa ni/ /de nyid rigs pas don med gsungs/ /zhes ba ltar ngag kyal gyi nyes pa khegs tsam las sa lam gyi yon tan gang yang mi skye zhing / khyad par du lha khro bo'i rigs kyi bzlas pa byed skabs sod sod dang rdung rdung zhes pa lta bu'i tshig yod pa'i drag sngags bzlas skabs rang rgyud kyi bdag 'dzin sogs nyon mongs dang sdeg sgrib rnams la dmigs pas bzlas na phan yon che ba byung zhing / de lta min par rang gi dgra dang 'dre sogs la dmigs nas bzlas tshe tshig rtsub smras pa'i nyes pa yang yong nyen las phyi ma phan chad du dka' bas kun slong yang de lta bus bzla ba zhig nges par dgos/ 'jig rten dregs pa'i srog sngags rnams kyang phal cher dpal gsang ba'i bdag po dang / rta mgrin la sogs pa'i drung du rang rang gi sbog sngags phul ba dpal phyag na rdo rje la sogs pas de dag nus pa khyad par can dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs pa'i bkar gtogs pa yin pas sdig sgrib dag pa'i nus pa yod par nges la khyad bar du rang gis kyang bstan pa bsrung pa'i ba du dregs pa rnams sgrub de'i phyir du — 643 —

'di dag gi srog sngags bzla ba dang / gsol mchod sogs la brtson snyam pa'i kun slong bzang pos zin na ni rnam smin dkar po 'byin nges te/ lus ngag gi las rnams thams cad ngo bo dkar nag gtso mi che bar rgyu'i kun slong ga bo che bas byas bsags mu bzhir gsungs pa rnams la nges pa rnyed na 'di dag la yang nges rnyed par 'gyur bas 'di dag tshe 'di'i rkyen sel las phyi mar mi phan snyam pa'i rnam rtog gi dbang du ma song bar rgyu dus kyi kun slong rnam par dag pas nyams su blangs na 'bras bu phul du byung ba thob bar 'gyur bas de ltar du bsam pas 'bad par bya/ bsnyen sgrub kyi gzhung ma bsrang /dam tshig gi gnad ma bsrung / rten rdzas cha tsam ma tshang bar chos srung bran du 'khol bar rlom zhing 'phrin las 'tshol ba dang / cung zad don ma 'grub par mkhang ra che ba dag ni/ gro sran btab nas 'bras skye bar re ba dang mtshungs shing / des na gsang sngags bla med kyi dbang thob nas bsnyen sogs ma byas par zhi sogs kyi las gang yang mi 'grub pas/ dang por dbang zhu ba la brtson pa dang / dbang thob nas dam tshig gi rdzas rdor dril cang te'u rgyan drug sogs bcangs dgos pa rnams ngo ma'am/ gzugs bres tshun chad kyi tshang bar byas nas 'chang zhing / cher ma 'byangs par rab 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen chen dang ma mtha' yang las rung tshad ldan te bsnyen mtshams dam po'i ngos nas sgrub dgos shing / de yang dbang thob nas dam tshig la nan tan byed dgos pas bla ma lnga bcu pa dang / rtsa ltung bcu bzhi pa lta bu 'am/ yang na bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i tshig nyung la go bde ba'i dam tshig gi rim pa ston pa'i yig cha gang rigs blo la bzung thog bshes gnyen la dri gtugs kyis khong du chud par byas nas/ dam tshig gi gnas — 644 —

rnams lag len la gang thebs byed dgos shing 'dir gong du jeb tsam smos pa ni yul dus kyi dbang gis 'byung nye zhing khyad par skabs thob tu lag len byed dgos rnams gsal bar bkod pa yin gyi gong du gsal ba de tsam gyis sdom gsum gyi bcad mtshams rnams 'thus pa min pas/ des na so rgar byang sems gsang sngags kyi gnang bkag bslab bya'i yig cha rgyas bsdus gang rung gi steng nas bshes gnyen tshad ldan las yang yang nyan nas ji ltar gsungs pa ltar nyams su blangs te gnas skabs su yang tshas srung gnyan po rnams thugs mi khrel zhing las su bskul na 'khul thub pa dang mthar thug thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba zhig la 'bad dgos shing / mdor na rang rang gis khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa spyi bye brag rnams dang / khyad par 'dus sde 'di nyid kyi sgrig lam tshul bzhin du nyams su blangs nas/gnas skabs su skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan dang / 'byor ldan bsod nams gsogs pa'i zhing sar 'gyur ba dang / mthar thug rang nyid kyang btsan sa zin pa zhig la thams cad kyis 'bad nga ra 'tshal zhes thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa lags pas cis kyang nas phyag len du 'debs par zhu zhing / tshul bzhin bsgrubs pa rnams la 'dus sde 'dir bsten pa'i srung ma rnams nas bsrung zhing skyong ba dang / 'gal bar spyod pa rnams la mi zad pa'i chad pa 'bebs par gnyer du gtad pa yin pas blang dor ma 'dzol ba zhig ci nas kyang mdzad 'tshal/ 'dir smras pa/ lhag bsam nor bu'i ba gam mngon mtho'i rtser/ / dge legs g.yas 'khyel skye ba lnga pa'i dung / /srid gsum gdung ba 'jig ba'i cho 'phrul du/ /don ldan kun dga'i dbyangs su 'di na snyam/ /ma dul bag med gnyis 'thung myos pa'i snang / /tshul khrims 67/ 6

blang dor lcags kyu rnon po yis/ /nyer btab byang grol zhi ba'i khang bzang du/ /bkri ba'i thabs mkhas 'di la brtson par rigs/ /rgya chen thos bsam ma dros 'khyil ba'i klong / /gtan 'dun tshul khrims nor bu'i gdengs ka can/ /rig grol klu dbang bye ba'i nol rtsed kyis/ /'dzam gling phan bde'i gru char 'bebs gyur cig / mahā kā la gnas srung gzhi bdag bcas/ /dmar thrum khrag gi sdang mig da gdongs la/ /tshul dang tshul min tshar gcod rjes 'dzin las/ /myur bar sgrubs shig badz+ra sha ra kan/ /zhes gam bcar stag brag phan bde bsam gtan gling gi dge 'dun rnams kyi khrims su bca' ba'i blang dor phra zhib gong sa lha mi'i rnam 'dren skyabs mgon rgyal dbang phyag na pad mo sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog nas bstsal ba'i sbug dam bca' yig dge 'dun zhal grangs 'phar ba dang / rgyud sde'i cho ga gtor bzlog sogs sngags chog gi phyag len gnang dgos stabs sngon stsal spug dam bca' yig chen mor gzhi bzung kun gling dga' ldan brtan bzhugs chos 'khor gling gi bca' yig nas kha skongs dgos rigs rnams btus te khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge 'di ni srid skyong yongs 'dzin paṇ+ḍi tā kan ting tā kau shrī ho thog thus rab byung bcu drug pa'i me mo phag lo'i gro bzhin zla ba'i gral tshes 27dge bar nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gi nye 'dabs shod gzim chung legs byas 'o 'khyil nas bris/ zhes gos ser thog bres te rgyal tham bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan zhu/ / / /

grid sgrong stag brag nasaXdaga' ldanaXmadoXsngags chosaX'aphel 'chi med grub pa'iXbyang chub gling duXbastsal ba'iXbaca' yig sa glang / (spyi lo 1ṇa49)bod zla 9tshes 1༷nyin zhib 'jug song /oṃ swa ste/ mkhyen pas shes bya'i de nyid kun gzigs shing / /brtse bas 'gro kun bu gcig lta bur dgongs/ /nus pas bdud bzhi'i dpung tshogs ma lus 'joms/ /thub dbang lha yi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sde bzhi'i lung gi rtsa ba rab brtan cing / /spong bdun khrims kyi 'od mdangs lhag par gsal/ /rnam grol thar pa'i rtse mo mngon mtho ba/ /'dul 'dzin gser ri'i phreng ba rnams la 'dud/ rnam dag khrims kyi gzhi bzung mdo sngags lam/ /ma lus 'gro la yang dag gsal mdzad pa/ /thub pa'i bstan la rgyal ba gnyis pa zhes/ /mtshan mchog don ldan yab sras rnams la 'dud/ /khyim las nges 'byung bstan la zhugs rnams kyis/ /'jug ldog blang dor bya ba'i rim pa 'ga'/ /sngon byon dam pa'i gsung las legs btus nas/ /khrims su bca' ba'i rnam gzhag mdo tsam spel/ /sngon tshe bstan dang rnam bzhi'i 'khor skyong — 647 —

bar/ /'al gyis bzhes pa'i thub bstan srung tshogs dang / /khyad par rdo rje shugs ldan 'khor bcas kyis/ /sdong grogs 'phrin las g.yel med sprub par mdzod/ / zhes shis brjod puṇ+ḍa ri kas ngag gi lam yangs par byas te gang gleng bar bya ba ni dpal chen chu bo ri zhes sngon byon dam pa mang pos yang yang zhabs kyis bcags pas byin rlabs kyi mtshan kha mtho ba/ grub brnyes kyi skyes bu ngo mtshar can rgyun mi chad du byon pa/ gnas gsum gyis dpa' bo mkha' 'gro spren bzhin du 'du ba sogs dge mtshan du mas khyad par 'phags pa'i gnas ri'i 'dabs su 'brel zhing / khyad par bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag ped kyi bla ri grags pa tshe'i dbos grub gzhan las myur ba'i gnas dgon dga' ldan mdo sngags chos 'phel 'chi med grub pa'i byang chub gling zhes pa 'di nyid lnga dus dar rgyas su yod pa gor ma chag kyang / bar lam grwa phyi smin grol gling pas dgon bdag byed skabs bstan gzhi sgod bcud nyams rgud ci che byung rkyen gnas 'dzin grwa rigs nas smin gling par bde sdug lan mang brjod rung bdag med rgyang bskyur du btang bar brten/ grub dbang dge bshes blo bzang bsam 'grub nas lhag bsam zhen bskul byung 'dug don ltar gzhung gnas nas gtsugs lag khang phyi nang rten dang brten par bcas pa nyams gso phugs 'pher dang 'brel sgrub grwa sum hru so lnga 'phar btsugs thog tshe sgrub mchod phogs mthun rkyen sgron ze mkhar gzhis 'dzin dbang bdag thob dang / dkor sa dge kho/ ngas tshang ma sngar 'jags chog 'thus dngos/ phyin chad dar rgyas yun du gnas che rtse yig tshang las khungs su lo re dgon phogs dngul srang nyi shu rtsa lnga re 'bul bzhes kyis ji srid rgyal bstan nam gnas bar 'tsho 'dzin rkub ba'i ra dgos rgyur gzhung dgon du — — 648 ———

gtsang chod sgrub sde 'di'i sgrigs sgor bzhugs pa'i spong ba pa rnams kyis nyams su len rgyu'i rim par/ thog mar dgon 'dir gsar zhugs rigs grwa pa dang / gzhis dgon gzhan nas gnas nas dbyungs pa dang / rtsa bzhi gang yang rung ba'i pham pa phog pa/ glen lkugs dbang po ma tshang ba sogs bar chad kyi skyon dang bral zhing / chos gos rnam gsum rung ba tshad ldan dang / 'ding ba/ lhung bzed/ chu tshag gis mtshon 'tsho ba'i yo chas rnams tshang ba/ zhwa ser/ zla gam sogs rung mthun gyi gos dang /phreng ser/ mchod zhal dga' ldan kri kha ma bcas tshags su tshud par byas te las sner brda sbyar nas 'jug cing / 'jug pa'i nyin rten ga bo dang /srung mar snyan dar re/ gnas kyi bla mar zub phyi dang / skal ba lnga/ slob dpon/ dbu mdzad/ gnyer pa bcas la zub phyi re dang / skal ba 'phar re/ 'dus tshogs su mang ja gcig dang / bzhes thug gcig 'gyed ṭam re/ shing rin srang gsum bcas 'bul/ sgrigs su zhugs nas kyang bag yangs su mi sdod par yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten tshul khrims kyi bslab pa la yang dag par gnas nas klog pa thos bsam dang spong ba bsam gtan la brtson pa zhig byung na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i gsos chen por 'gyur pas na rnyed pa dka' ba rnams rnyed par gyur pa'i dus su so thar gyi mdos mtshon 'dul ba'i bslab bya kun la legs par bslab nas rang rang gis ji ltar khas blangs pa'i sdom gsum bca' khrims la nan tan snyeng por byas te dran shes bag yod dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'du tshogs phyi nang / 'gro chag nyal 'dug gi spyod lam/ thugs dam gzhan don gyi rim pa gang ci nas skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i mig rgyan du gyur pa zheg byed nga bos pa gzhir bzhag gi steng tshogs — 649 —

'don chos spyod le tshan/ rang lugs yi dam gyi bdag mdun bum gsum gyi cho ga/ spyi sger chos srung gis bskang gso sogs blo 'dzin skyor sbyang tshul bzhin byed dgos/ tshogs seng skabs lam rim/ blo spyong / bskyed rdzogs sogs kyi dpe cha lta ba dang / dmigs rnam spyong ba/ phyag bskor/mdo rgyud klog pa/ rta 'dur dbyangs rol spyong ba/ phyag rgya 'ching ba/dkyil 'khor bri thig slob pa sogs kyi chos spyod la brtson pa gang che dang /phan tshun blo bskyed yong ba'i chos kyi gleng mo byed pa sogs dal 'byor don ldan du 'jug pa las/ bag med chags sdang gi long gtam smra ba sho sbag sogs rgyal rtse ba/ kha mchu rtsod pa/ gzhan la bsun 'byin gyi tshig dang / ngan gshag dma' 'bebs kyis mtshang 'bru ba dang / shag phan tshun du sdebs tshogs byed pa/ sger don bun skyed dang khe 'dod kyi tshong thabs bcas mi 'os pa'i rigs gtan nas mi byed cing / phyi nang gang du'ang gshe ba sogs la slar mi gshe ba sogs dge spyong gi chos bzhi la yang dag par bslab dgos/nang mchod dang / gser skyems ma gtogs chang len pa dang / dgon pa'i nang du gos phu thung can dang / kha ma bsgyur ba'i ya ma zung gyon pa/gling gseb tu rgyang bod dang ku co 'don pa/ gzan med par 'gro ba/ skra tshad las lhag par 'jog pa bcas mi chog cing / phyogs 'grul gnas 'jal du 'byor skabs dgon 'gram du bud med zhag gcig gnyis lhag mi 'jog tshe sgrub/ dbyar gnas/ dgag dbye gso spyong / yar mar tshes bcu khag gtor sgrub zla bskang sgrub mchod sogs kyi skabs sgrub grwa tshang ma 'dzoms dgos shing / glo bur rkyen dbang gis gzhan du 'gro dgos pa byung tshe tshe sgrub skabs nyin re tshogs chad ṭam re dang / tshes bcur zho — 650 ——

gsum re/ bso spyong la zho lnga re bcas 'gel sgrub dang / gzhan yang nyin grangs ma/nga nyung la gzhigs pa'i tshogs chad rgyag lug/sa dang / dgongs nga ster lugs sogs dbu mdzad kyis babs lta byed/ gzhi bsnyen dang / las rung sogs kyi bsnyen mtshams su yod rigs la phogs 'gyed dang / gtong sgo kha zas skal ba bcas spyi mtshungs sprod gtong thog tshogs chad bsdu len mi chog lo 'khor dgos pa zhu mi byung tshe tshes bcu'i gtong 'di khri/ gtong dgo/sa la bsnyen 'gyed byung rigs kyi skal ba sprod cing phogs thob mi 'gro/'khor mtshams su mang ja gnyis gtong / rnam kun tshos/sa brda byung 'phral du thams cad 'du khang sgor byon te mchil lham phud nas bslab pa rgan ga/zhon go rim 'dzol med kyis bya tshang du 'dzul ba ltar rim phebs kyi gral du 'khod cing / tshogs su ka ba dang / rtsig snyes/ gos kyis ma gtums par mchil snab 'dor ba/ yo gcus bzhugs tshul mi mdzes pa dang / gnyid/long gtam/ bzhad gad/ rtsed g.yeng sogs gtan nas mi chog ja thug sogs 'dren skabs gral du bo zag ped cing / hub cag gi sgra dang lces 'jog pa sogs spangs te kha zas sman dang 'dra ba'i dran shes kyis bsten/tshogs 'don dbu mdzad kyis dbyangs 'dur gang bskul kyang tshang mas thugs ma yengs par mgrin dbyangs gcig tu 'ur 'don dang ba 'dren pa dgos/tshogs grol ba'i tshe bya ma bu tshang nas phyir thon pa ltar bgres rim bzhin phebs nas grol/ zla ba 'byung ngo cog gi gso spyong gi gaṇ+ḍi'i brda byung ma thag tu dge tshul slong thams cad byon nas rang rang gi ltung ba phyir bcos dang /rgyud chags gsum sngon du 'gro ba'i mdo'i 'chad nyan sogs phyag len rnam par dag pa byed/ lo ltar zla 1 tshes 1nas tshes 16bar nyin ltar tshogs — 651 —

thun gsum re'i ring tshe dpag med 'chi med lha lnga'i sgo nas gong sa ma chog si sku tshe tshe sgrub gnad smin dang / thun drug bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ dga' ldan lha brgya ma sngon du 'gro ba'i dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed dpa' bo gcig pa'i bdag bskyed/ mgon chos ga/nyis dang / rgyal chen rdo rje shugs ldan gyi bskang gshags/ zla 2tshes 1nas tshes 4bar dpal 'khor lo sdom pa pū i pa'i ras bris kyi da/kyil 'khor la brten nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub mchod tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa smin rgyas/ chos srung gi bskang gso gtang rag zla 4tshes 1nas tshes 15bar nyin 16ring sku tshe tshe sgrub dang /yi dam gyi bdag bskyed srung bskang sogs gong bzhin dang / smyung gnas cha gcig gtong / zla 6tshes 1nyin tshogs thun gsu/ma ring bde mchog pū mi pa'i bdag mdun bum gsum dang / /'jug tu bla mchod kyi cho ga tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ tshes 4dus chen nyin sgrol chog nyin 'khyongs/ tshes 15nas zla 7tshes 2 ༷bar dbyar zhal bzhes dang de'i ring nyin re mang ja tshogs thun re'i thog gnas brtan phyag mchod dang / sman bla'i mdo chogasgrol chog sbyor chos dang 'brel ba'i lam rim tshigs bcad ma/ gnas bcu dang / sgrol bstod grangs gsog gdugs sher seng gsum/ tshe gzungs/ spyi sger srung ma'i 'phrin bcol/ drug hru ma/ mdo sngags kyi smon lam shis brjod sogs skabs su gang babs nyin grangs cha bgos re mos kyis 'don zhing mjug tu dgag dbye dang / ljongs rgyu tshul mthun mdzad/zla 7tshes 1ka nyin tshogs thun gsum la sman chog zla 9tshes 2 2nyin tshogs thun gcig la sman bla/ zla 10tshes 26nas bzung nyin lnga'i ring bstan srid zhabs rim khro bcu'i gtor bzlog zla 12tshes 1 2nas bzung nyin — 652 —

gsu/ma ring bde/ mchog gi bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas mkha' spyod ma'i sgrub mchod tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ tshes 19nyin 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed dang / mgon chos kyi bskang bshag/sa/ mgon dkar la brten ba'i g.yang sgrub/ shub/sa ldan gyi bskang ba bcas gtong / lo 'jug tu lcag/sa mkhar zur dgu pa dang / rgyal chen shugs ldan la brten pa'i gtor bzlog glo bur las bcol dang bcas pa lo re mos kyis nyin gsum re sgrub cing /rnam kun zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar mar tshes bcu so sor bde mchog lca i pa'i bdag mdun bum gsum dbang chog tshogs 'khor smon shis bcas pa dang /nyin phyi mar spyor chos skal bzang mgrin rgyan sngon du btang ste lam rim bdud rtsi'i snyeng po nyams dbyangs dang bcas te 'don/ tshes 5la 'jigs byed kyi bdag bskyed dang / mgon dkar gyi g.yang sgrub/ shugs ldan gyi zla bskang tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa chag med gtong / 'char 'phar rgyun tshogs spyi dang / khyad par 'di dag gi skabs su phyag len phra rags rnams mi nyams pa dang / gtor bzo tshad dbyibs sogs rang lugs ltar bsgyur bkod med par dang ldan gzab rgyas bcas dus thog so sor 'khel ba smin sgrub dgos rgyu/ las kyi sne mo bar rdo rje slob dpon dbu mdzad gnyer pa/dkon gnyer/ ja ma bcas dgos shing / de yang slob dpon mdo sngags kyi mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing bslab pa rgan pa la bsko/ des kyang sgrigs lam gyi zur phra mo tsam la yang gces spras kyis nyams pa gso zhing / mi nyams gong du spel ba'i thabs la 'bad dgos dbu mdzad ni skad bzang zhing /'don cha thang ba la bsko/ des kyang sgrigs lam kun spyod gnon bstebs dang / gsar bu ba dpe cha 'dzin skyor byed min sogs la rtogs 'jug byas la 653 la

te leg/sa nyes kyi stangs 'dzin dran bskul lhod med byed dgos/ gnyer nga/ ni lhag bsam can la ba tsho/ 'ing / des kyang dgon pa'i spyi rdzas rnams chud zos ral bor du ma song bar 'dzin skyong do tshag byed pa dang / 'char 'phar sa/tong sgo rnams khra/ la mngon sla bcos su ma song bar lhag bsam rnam dag dang 'brel bas gtong deb nang sa/sal ltar bcog 'khri med pa gtong sems dang bas kun blangs kyis 'bu' / dkon sa/nyer yang gdengs 'khel tshad thub 'os pa la bsko zhing des kyang 'du khang dang // mchod khang gis ga/bos gtsug lag khang steng shod bar gsum la gad bad/ra mchong pa 'bul gshoms sogs gtsang sbra thon pa dang / mchod g.yog 'bas zhu/ mgon khang du rgyun bskang ma chag pa bcas byed/ ja ma yang ja thug sa/yos spyor shes nges la bsko zhing / des kyang 'char 'phar ja thug sogs dge 'dun gyi 'tsho ba g.yos spyor gyi rim pa gtsang sbra dang ldan tsha 'khol thon gsum gyi lag 'bras bzang zhing / rung khang du mi rigs gang byung mi gtong / bla ma slob zur/ spyi gnyer/ thag nye'i mtshams pa/ nad pa/ sbyin bdag ga/zhan yang gal che 'os rigs la dmigs bsal las/ de min ja thug gi skal ba mi gtong / dgon pa'i nye skor du rkun jag dwogs gnas can dang / rtsa khungs med pa'i mi 'khyams mi bsten/ bya dang ri dwags sogs rngon du mi 'jug 'di ga'i grwa rigs kyis rang lugs lta grub dang mi mthun pa'i bsres lhad gang dran gtan nas mi chog las sne mi chog las sne 'phos rim nas so so'i mis 'phri sprod dngos gtong rtsa 'bru dngul che phra gang yod deb gsal ltar rtsis sprod khams dwangs lhag bsam zal thon byed pa las/ chad lus dang / sbas skungs spug 'dren rigs nam yang mi byed/ sgrig 'gal — 654 —

gī slo/ra rtsa ba'i chang dang bcas pa mthong thos dwogs/ gsum gyi slo nas rtsad chod pa dang 1/ tsa/mas/ bla/ slob dngo/ma/ dbu ma /dzad/ sogs la kha/ lam/ lag lan slog pa can byung na sher snying gi bzlog pa lan gsum da/nga 'brel bas gnas ma/sa dbyungs/ sgrigs 'then/ rigs byung tshe snan khye/la dang / mang ja sa/cis/ bzhes thus/ gcis (pa pa byed ṭam re// dngul srang sum cu tham pa bcas kyi chad pa 'gel sgrub byed/// de las gzhan pa'i nyes can gyi rigs la gang 'a sa//nga 'tsham sa / kyi chad pa gcod/ de lta ra gong rdon tshul ba'i/ ma du sgru ba ste sa//tso cher bslab khrims/ dang grub mtha' gtsang 'i/nga / sgrig tshugs bzang ba/ bla ma 0ri sa ste 'dus dmangs dang bcas pa rgan bar sa/tho/na gsum rang khrim4/ zes pa 'khur len gyi gus bku/ ra byed sgo ma log cing / dad/ nga dag snang thugs mthun gyi sgo nas dal 'byor don yod la 'bad chig bsgril dgos rgyu dang / yul mi ser skyas mtshon drag zhan mtho dman su thad nas kyang sgrub sde 'di nyid la yul babs dang mthun 'gyur zhabs tog tu ga/nga 'gro byed pa las/ gtong sa/'i mchod thebs la rku 'phrog rtsod brnyas dang / mi 'os pa'i khral rigs 'gel gtser byed pa sogs gnod 'gal log par 'gro rigs dngos shugs brgyud gsum du byas na gtan nas mi 'thus/ 'di ltar khrims su bca' ba 'di'i gnyer kha 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i bstan/ srung rdzo rje shugs ldan rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bcol ba yin pas 'di don khyad gsod kyis 'gal bar byed pa rnams la mngon mtshan can gyi rtags dang cho 'phrul gyis tshar gcod pa dang / tshul bzhin sgrub pa rnams la srung skyob rjes 'dzin g.yel ba med pa dgos rgyu'i bca' yig 'di yang lo ltar dbu mdzad nas tshos/sa su thengs re sgrogs sbyangs nges tshang mas 'di don sgang blang — — — 655 ————

tshul ba'i na du 'bad par 'tshal/ zhes khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge sa mo glang lo'i tha skar zla nga'i gral tshes 27dge bar rang byung 'phags pa'i ga 'al med khang pho brang tshem po po tā la'i shod gzim chung kun bzang bde ldan nas/ bres/zhes dgos se/ra thog bris te rgyal tham bstsal rgyu zhus na 'thus min snyan (1/ / / /

rgyalaXtshab stagaXbragaXnas chab mdo dga' ldan byams pa gling la bstsal ba'i rgyabaXganon bca' yigalcags stag (spyi lo 195 0 )oṃ bde legs su gyur cig thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/snyan/ pa'i ba dan 'jig rteg gsum du grags/ /dam pa'i chos sgra seng ge'i sgra bsgra gas pa/ /thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mjog mdzod brnyes pa/ / zhabs la tshangs dbang gtsug gi nor bus gtus/sa/ / sdug bsngal rgya mtsho ga/ting mtha' med brgal ba/ /'gro ba'i gtso la spyi bos phyag 'tshal te/ / thams cad mkhyen pa'i bslab gzhi/ dkon mchog bstod/ / 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su dbye bar bya/ / nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims sdug bsngal spongs/ /'jig tshogs lta ba gdon gyi rtsa ba 'joms/ /dpal 'byor pa dang me tog mda' can 'joms/ / sangs rgyas la ni mgos gtugs bshad par bya/ /zhes shis par brjod pa dang / phyag bya ba'i tshigs su bcad pa'i sngon bsus te 'dir dga' ldan byams pa theg chen gling gis dgon gnas chen bo'i dge 'dun pa rnams kyi bca' khrims ni/ rang rgyud kyi bslab khrims rnam par dag pa sgrub pa byed pa dang / de las 'gal na chad las ji ltar bya ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni grwa 'dir 'jug pa'i dge 'dun btsun ma —— — 657 ——

pa rnams kyis dam pa'i chos/ 'dul ba rim po che'i tsa/zhung steng // byang sems dang / sngags kyi bslab bya sogs tshul khrims kyi bslab pa rnams la nan tan du mjad dgos/ grwa 'dir thog mar 'jug pa'i dus su rab byung gi sdom pa yang dag par ma bslangs bar mi 'jug cing dbo/na gnas su zhal 'don ma dzad pa'i mdo sngags kyi chos spyod gtso bo rnam sa gtsang sing nge bas 'khyor ba zhig dgos/ grwa 'dir zhugs zin nas chos spyod kyi rigs ma tshang ba med pa 'dzin la le lor ma song ba byed cing / tshul dang mthun pa'i dge/ rgan legs par bsten nas/ 'don pa'i gdangs dbyangs so gas byu ba thams cad legs par tshags su tshud phar byed/ tshog/sa 'du'i za/bas dge skos kyis brda sbyar bstun chos gos sogs rung ba tshad dang mthun pa'i sgo nas bag yod par 'du zhi/nga / tshogs su long gtam smra ba dang / gzhogs snyes kyi 'dug pa sogs bag med/ kyi spyod nga/ gtan nas mi byed/ dbu mdzad nas bskul ba'i skabs su gang babs kyi zhal 'don rnams sbyin bdag sogs lus can dang ba 'dren nges pa'i sgo ma/sa mdzad cing / tshogs gyes pa'i dus su/ yang bag yod pa kho na spyod / grwa 'dir zhugs phyin dbe/ tshul slong skabs su gang babs kyi chos gos / gding lhung phreng ba chab blug sogs rab byung gi rtags rnams tshang bar 'chang zhing / mkhan po dang slob dpon la sogs pas mdo sngags kyi chos spyod bshad pa'i rigs rnams nan tan/ du yid la nges par byed/rtsa ba bzhi chang dang bcas pa la srog sdos kyi sgo nas bsrung zhing / dud 'gro'i sbog gcod pa sogs sbom po'i sde rnams kyis kyang ma gos pa la 'bad/grwa 'di'i dge skos sogs las tshan byed dgos pa rnams kyis rang rang gi skabs su gang babs dang bstun sems yan por ma song bas dge 'dun gyi — 658 ——

zhabs 'degs su 'gyur nges byed cing / rnam par dag pas khrims bcad pa la grwa rigs nas kyang mi 'dod pa'i gtam dang lan ldog pa sogs gtan nas mi byed/ sbyin bdag gi don du 'byon dgos pa rnams la bag yod pa'i kun tu spyod pa la gnas pa las khyim pa mi dad pa'i bag med pa'i spyod pa gtan nas mi byed pa sogs dam pa'i chos 'dul ba'i gzhung bsrongs yul dus dang bsnyun pa'i gnang bkag gi gnad legs par shes par byas nas kun spyod rnam par dag pa la gnas pa nyid la nan tan mdzad/ de dag dang 'gal na chad las ji ltar bya ba ni rtsa ba bzhi'i nyes pa dang / rma khrag 'byen pa'i rgyag res byas pa sogs ni gnas dbyung byed cing / de min nang khrims kyi rigs dang 'gal ba/ tshogs su spyod lam mi mdzes pa sog/sa byung na bla ma dang dge skos sogs nas babs bltas kyi tshogs su brgya phyag 'tshal du 'jug ba/ dkon mchog gi rten rnams la mar me 'bul ba/ dge 'dun spyir mang ja zhu ru 'jus/ ba sogs yul dus dang bstun pa'i chad pa 'gel/phyogs mtshungs 'di ga'i dgon gyi khongs gtogs go phug dgon dang /stag gzig mdzo lung rdzong rtsa dgon bcas kyi dge 'dun pa rnams kyi sgrig khrims kun spyod skor gong don las mi 'gal ba'i byams pa theg chen gling gis bla las rim 'byon nas gnon 'khur 'gal med kyis mdor na kun tu spyod pa'i las thams cad rje rgyal ba gnyis pa'i bstan pa rin po che yar rgyas su 'gyur bas thabs tshul kho nar 'gro ba'i phyi nang drag zhan che phra tshang mas mthun rkyen lhur len dgos pa las bshad sgrub kyi 'gal rkyen du 'gro gzhi'i gnod 'gal phra lo tsam shar tshe rdo rje'i bstan srung rnams kyis bka' yi chad pa drag po 'byung ba gdon mi za ba ma zad/ 'di nas kyang ngan pa rgya yan du ma song —— 659 —

ba'i rgyab gnyer bya rgyur de don spangs blangs don tshang tshul bzhin spyod pa gyis/'dir smras pa/ rdo rje bstan srung thams cad dang / /khyad par gang la gtad pa'i lha/ /de yi ji ltar bcol ba las/ /ma lus thogs med sgrub gyur cig /khrims ldan phun sum tshogs pa'i 'dus pa sde/ /bka' dang bstan bcos zab dang rgya che ba/ /'chad rtsod rtsom gsum yar ngo'i zla ba ba'i na/ /gong nas gong 'phel thub bstan rab rgyas shog / ces go bar bya ba'i yi ge rnam 'gyur zhes pa 'byung ba gsum ldan lcags pho stag lo'i gral tshes dge bar rtse pho brang chen po po ta la nas bres/ / / /
